dab brgya dang bcu gcag pa' dkar chagagaso ba rig pa/ 1mi/ (213)3543 spyor ba brgya pa bzhugs/ 3lus gso ba'i dpyad dang po/ 3zug rngu zad par byed pa gnyis pa/ 8zug rngu zad byed gsum pa/ 10dug nad sel ba'i rgyud bzhi pa/ 11'byung po zhi bar byed pa'i rgyud lnga pa/ 12byis pa'i nad sel ba'i rgyud drug pa/ 13rta ltar byed pa bdun pa/ 13las lnga'i le'u brgyad pa/ 14rgyud phyi ma/ 15slar yang de dag bsdus te bshad pa/ 15'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad/

bal bo'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bram ze dzi ta kar+ṇa'i zhal snga nas dang po rtsa 'grel lan cig gsungs shing /dus phyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta burtse shri tshwa na'i zhal snga nas stod cung zad gsungs nas/chen po rnams kyi gdan sa dpal shel gyi gtsug lag khang du dge slong a mo gha'i gsung gis bskul nas/mang du thos pa'i lots+tsha ba shākya'i dge slong dpal nyi ma rgyal mtshan bzang ngo/sa 'grel pa gsum dang bstun te bsgyur zhing legs par gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(19) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(22)3544 sbyogacad paraces /ba:re cas/mdo /ba(1bkabag/ 23slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub snying pos mdzad/bsdur mchan/(31) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(33)3545 slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bshad pa sman a ba'i cho ga 34slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(38) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(38)3546 sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa bzhugs/ 39yan lag brgyad pa'i sman sde po son chas gtso bo sum cu rtsa gsum bshad pa/ 39sde tshan der ma 'dus pa'i sman gyi ming dang /gang gzhan nas 'byung ba'i sman /kye /ste/ཿnga /brngogatshod /ba/ rte/ga sman gyi dngos po gcig la ming gnyis kyis 'dom pa bshad pa/ 113ཿ//cad bye) 1decad ba/sdosazug nga/ ngasatsanapa/ nga / 117slob dpon zla ba la dga' bas mdzad/2

bsdur mchan/(121) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(142)'isnyi po zhe3547 yan lag brgyad pa nga bsdus pa sa bya ba 143dang po/ mdo'i gnas bstan pa/ 143dang po/ tshe ring bar 'dod pa'i le'u/ 143gnyis pa/ nyin re zhing dpyad pa'i le'u/ ༷ 1rgagasum pa/ dus su spyod pa'i le'u/ 152bzhi pa/ nad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i dbe+ed kyi le'u/ 157lnga pa/ chu sna tshogs pa la sogs pa'i bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 161(bye:re chesde casacad/ 1( 1'o ma'i sde tshan/ 162bu ram shing gi sde tshan/ 164til mar la sogs pa'i sde tshan/ 16666nga :go che/ casacad/ 166drug pa/ kha zas kyi tshul brtag cing shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 168gra ma can gyi 'bru sna tshogs kyi sde tshan/ 168gang bu chags pa'i 'bru sna tshogs kyi sde tshan/ 170g.yos su byas pa'i zas kyi sde tshan/ 171sdog/re /sde zhesacad/ 140rtenatshod rngad rnams kyi sde tshan/ 175'bras bu'i sde 'byen/ 178lan 'bye sogs kyi sde 'byen/ 181bdun pa/ kha zas bsrung ba'i le'u/ 184brgyad pa/ kha zas kyi tshod ran par bza' ba'i le'u/ 191dgu pa/ sman la sogs pa'i bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 196bcu pa/ ro tha dad pa shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 199

bcu gcig pa/ nad la sogs pa'i tshul shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 202bcu gnyis pa/ nad kyi bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 207bcu gsum pa/ nad gso ba'i thabs kyi le'u/ 214bcu bzhi pa/ gso ba'i thabs rnam pa gnyis bstan pa'i le'u/ 218bco lnga pa/ sbyang ba la sogs pa sman gyi sde tshan 'dus pa'i le'u/ 222bcu drug pa/ snum gyi cho ga bya ba'i le'u/ 228bcu bdun pa/ dugs kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 232bco brgyad pa/ sgyugs sman dang bkru sman gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 235bcu dgu pa/ mas gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 241nyi shu pa/ sman sna nas gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 249nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ dud pa gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 253nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ sman gyi khu bas mkhur ba dgang ba la sogs pa'i ces can/re /ba(thu/ rtenag kyi nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ sman gyi thigs pa mig tu blugs pa dang sman gyis mig tshab/sa ngas:re ཿdza bka:re /ba(5/ 258nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ mig brta ba'i cho ga dang /mig sman gyi phur ma bsregs shing btsos pa'i khu ba mig tu blugs pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 261nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ cha spyad kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 263nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ gtar spyad kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 267nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ gtar ga gdab pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 272nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ zug rngu dbyung ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 277nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ gtar ga gdab pa'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 282sum cu pa/ thal sman rnon po dang me btsa' gdab pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 289gnyis pa/ lus kyi gnas bstan pa/ 294

dang po/ lus kyi rum du zhugs pa'i gnas dang po'i le'u/ 294gnyis pa/ lus kyi rum du zhugs pa'i nad kyi bye brag bshad pa'i le'u/ 303gsum pa/ lus kyi yan lag gi bye brag bstan pa'i le'u/ 309bzhi pa/ lus kyi gnad kyi bye brag bshad pa'i le'u/ 321lnga pa/ lus kyi 'gyur ba'i bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 327drug pa/ lus kyi gnas kyi pho nya la sogs pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 339gsum pa/ nad gzhi'i gnas bstan pa/ 346dang po/ nad thams cad kyi nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 346gnyis pa/ rims nad kyi nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 3gogasum pa/ khrag dang mkhris pa dang lud pa'i nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 356bzhi pa/ dbugs mi bde ba dang skyigs bus btab pa'i nad gzhi bshad /ba/ri /re/thu/ ༷ rten(tsho0lnga pa/ glo gcong chen po zad byed kyi le'u/ 363drug pa/ chang nad kyi nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 369bdun pa/ gzhang 'brum gyi nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 373brgyad pa/ tshad pas 'khru ba dang pho ba'i nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 378dgu pa/ gcin 'gags pa'i nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 391bcu pa/ gcin snyi ba za khu'i nad dmigs bshad pa'i le'u/ 385bcu gcig pa/ khong 'bras dang rgyu rlugs dang skran gyi nad gzhi bshad /pa/ri /re(thu/ rtenazadasgyu bcu gnyis pa/ dmu rdzing gi nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 395bcu gsum pa/ skya rbab dang 'or nad dang me dbal gyi nad gzhi bshad /ba/ri /spe(thu/ rtenardo rdo bcu bzhi pa/ mdze nad dang sha bkra dang gzi gu dang srin bu'i nad gzhi 5

pa/sdonatshod ngas:re 6)(5/ 4 06bco lnga pa/ rlung nad kyi nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 411bcu drug pa/ dreg nad kyi nad gzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 416bzhi pa/ gso ba'i gnas bstan pa/ 422dang po/ rims nad gso ba'i le'u/ 422gnyis pa/ khrag mkhris gso ba'i le'u/ 438gsum pa/ lud pa gso ba'i le'u/ 443bzhi pa/ skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba gso ba'i le'u/ 459lnga pa/ gcong chen po gso ba'i thabs kyi le'u/ 465drug pa/ slon pa'i nad dang snying nad dang skom dad gso ba'i le'u/ gye2bdun pa/ chang nad gso ba'i le'u/ 480brgyad pa/ gzhang 'brum gso ba'i le'u/ 586dgu pa/ 'khru ba gso ba'i le'u/ 501bcu pa/ pho ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u/ 512bcu gcig pa/ gcin 'gags pa'i le'u/ 520bcu gnyis pa/ gcin snyi ba za khu'i le'u/ 526bcu gsum pa/ khong 'bras dang rgyu rlugs kyi le'u/ 530bcu bzhi pa/ skran gso ba'i le'u/ 535bco lnga pa/ dmu dze+eng gso ba'i le'u/ 547bcu drug pa/ skya rbab kyi nad gso ba'i le'u/ 558bcu bdun pa/ 'or nad gso ba'i le'u/ 563bco brgyad pa/ me dbal gso ba'i le'u/ 568bcu dgu pa/ mdze nad gso ba'i le'u/ 571nyi shu pa/ sha bkra dang srin bu'i nad gso ba'i le'u/ 5816

nyi shu gcig pa/ rlung nad gso ba'i le'u/ 584nyi shu gnyis pa/ dreg nad gso ba'i le'u/ 592lnga pa/ tsho ga grub pa'i gnas bstan pa/ 599dang po/ skyug sman gyi cho ga'i le'u/ 599gnyis pa/ bkru sman gyi cho ga'i le'u/ 603gsum pa/ sgyug sman dang bkru sman gyi nyes pa grub bar bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 609bzhi pa/ sman mas gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 613lnga pa/ sman mas gtong ba'i cho gas nad phyin te sos par bya ba'i le'u/ 620drug pa/ sman gyi cho ga'i le'u/ 625drug pa/ rgyud phyi ma'i gnas bstan pa/ 628byes pa gso ba'i yan lag 628dang po/ byis pa gso ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 628gnyis pa/ byis pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u/ 632gsum pa/ byis pa'i gdon gso ba'i le'u/ 639'byung bo'i gdon gso ba'i yan lag 639bzhi pa/ 'byung bo'i gdon gyi nad dmigs shes pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 645lnga pa/ gdon gso ba bshad pa'i le'u/ 649drug pa/ sbyo byed gso ba'i le'u/ 655bdun pa/ brjed byed gso ba'i le'u/ 660stod gso ba6) pa na lag 660brgyad pa/ mig mchu'i nad dmigs shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 664dgu pa/ mig mchu'i nad gso ba'i le'u/ 667bcu pa/ mig zur dang mig gi 'bras bu dkar nag gi nad kyi dmigs /ba(1tha/ ngas:re 6)(1/ ( 7)0bcu gcig pa/ mig zur dang mig gi 'bras bu dkar po dang nag po'i cadatshod tha cas /ba/re /re(1/ ( ba/37

bcu gnyis pa/ mthong bar byed pa'i mig nad kyi nad dmigs shes par bya /ba/re /re(thu/ ( rte /rdo bcu gsum pa/ rab rib gso ba'i le'u/ 682bcu bzhi pa/ mthong ba nyams pa gso ba'i le'u/ 691bco lnga pa/ mig nad thams cad kyi nad kyi dmigs brtag pa'i le'u/ 695bcu drug pa/ mig nad thams cad gso ba'i le'u/ 697bcu bdun pa/ rna ba'i nad kyi dmigs shes pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 703bco brgyad pa/ rna ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u/ 706bcu dgu pa/ sna nad kyi dmigs shes pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 712nyi shu pa/ sna nad gso/ ba'i le'u/ 714nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ kha nad kyi dmigs shes pa/ bshad pa'i le'u/ 717nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ pa/ kha nad gso ba'i le'u/ 723nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ mgo bo'i nad kyi dmigs shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 733nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ mgo bo'i nad gso ba'i le'u/ 737mtshon spyad kyis gso ba'i yan lag 737nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rma gso ba'i le'u/ 742nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ 'phra' du byung ba'i rma gso/ ba'i le'u/ 748nyi shu rtsa bdun pa// chag grugs/ gso ba'i le'u/ 753nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ mtshan bar brdol gyi le'u/ ༷ 757nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ re/na bu dang thor bu dang rkang bam dang 'bras kyi phreng ba'i nad dmigs shes pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 762su/ma cu pa/ rmen bu la sogs pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u/ 765su/ma cu gcig pa/ nad phra mo'i dmigs shes pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 769sum cu gnyis pa/ nad phra mo gso ba'i le'u/ 772su/ma cu gsum pa/ gsang ba'i nad kyi dmigs shes pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 775sum cu bzhi pa/ gsang ba'i gnas kyi nad gso ba'i le'u/ 780skyababyebye ngas bka—— ngas:re papazug 15bka 780sum cu lnga pa/ dug nad gso ba'i le'u/ 786

sum cu drug pa/ sbrul gyis zin pa gso ba'i le'u/ 792sum cu bdun pa/ srin bu'i dug nad gso ba'i le'u/ 801sum cu brgyad pa/ byi ba dang a lo ka'i dug gso ba'i le'u/ 809btabs ngas tha/—— /ba:re (bcad (babaka ༷ 809sum cu dgu pa/ bcud len gyi le'u/ 813bstuno bcu pa/ ro tsa gso ba'i le(1/ 831sman pa'i bdag po dge 'dun gsang ba zhes bya ba'i bu sman pa chen po pha khol zhes bya bas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzā ran dha ra dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang ngo/sa bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(840) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(944)35rga yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i sman dpyad kyi /baXgacad /ba/ ༷ 9'ju5dang po/ mdo'i gnas bstan pa/ 945dang po/ tshe ring bar bya ba la sogs pa'i dpyad kyi le'u/ 945gnyis pa/ sman dpyad kyi rnam grangs kyi mdo basbu ba'i le'u/ 955gsum pa/ dus tshigs dang sbyar ba'i sman dang kha zas kyi le'u/ 968bzhi pa/ mi nyams tha mal par gnas pa la nad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i tshod(5tshod /) /spo(bye/ 979lnga pa/ chu sna tshogs la sogs pa'i bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 987'o ma dang zho dang mar dang dar ba dang / phrum la sogs pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 987bu ram shing dang kha ra'i shing dang bu ram dang kha ra'i bye brag dang sbrang rtsi'i byebye rngothutha ngabasdogatshod ngas/re /spo(1/ 99'jug9

ti' mar dang e raṇ+ḍa'i mar dang / yungs mar dang / ba ru ra'i mar dang /zar ma'i mar dang / le brgan rtsi'i mar gyi phan gnod bshad pa'i le'u/ 890chang sna tshogs dang rtsabs dang gcin sna tshogs kyi phan gnod bshad pa'i le'u/ 999drug pa/ kha zas kyi tshul brtag cing shes par bya ba'i le'u/ 1003'bras la sogs pa 'bru sna tshogs gra ma can rnams kyi phan gnod bshad pa'i le'u/ 1003gang bur chags/ pa'i sran 'bru sna tshogs kyi phan gnod bshad pa'i le'u/ 1008'bru zas las g.yos/ sna tshogs kyi bye brag bstan pa'i le'u/ 1010ri dwags sna tshogs/ dang / bya bran sna tshogs/ dang / nya sha 'a sogs pa'i bye brag phan gnod sna tshogs ba da pa'i le'u/ ༷༷ 101511da rngad sna chosags kyi 6)(1/ 1021ldum gyi sna grangs/ shang tshe 'a so gas/ pa'i phan gnod kyi bye brag bshad pa'i le'u/ 1026thing tog sna tshogs/ kyi 'bras bu'i phan gnod bathad pa'i le'u/ 1028la/na tshwa sna tshogs kyi phan gnod kyi bye brag bshad pa'i le'u/ 1033bdun nga// zas bsdam zhing bsrung ba'i cho ga bstan pa/'i le'u/ 1038brgyad nga// kha zas za ba'i tshod gzung zhing zas kyi rim pa sna tshogs /ba/stacad tsho //re /re(bye/ 10ga tsho dgu pa// sman sna tshogs kyi ro dang stobs dang zhu ba'i rjes dang yon tan dang sman gyi mthu'i bye brag dang / sma na rnams chen po lnga'i rang bzhin du gtogs pa dang / chen ngo/ lnga'i mthus phan nga/'i las byed pa dang / sman gyi bye brag sna spyo1gas bshad nga/'i le'u/ 1062bcu nga// ro rnam drug gi phan gnod bshad pa dang / ro bro ba'i sna grangs /bsdo cad ngas//re /sre(thu/ 10(3ra bcu gcig pa/ nad med par 'gyur ba'i tshul bstan pa'i le'u/ 1079bcu gnyis pa/ lus la bad kan dang / mkhris pa dang / rlung gang dang gang na gnas pa dang / rlung dang bad kan dang / mkhris pa la so so'i nad dmigs cir gyur pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 109010

ba'i thabs bshad pa'i le'u/ 1106bcu bzhi pa/ nad pa brta zhing gso ba'i thabs dang /nad yang bar bya ba'i phyir zas dbri ba'am smyung bar bya ba dang /gso ba'i thabs rnam pa gnyis bshad pa'i le'u/ 1117bsdur mchan/(1126)

༄ga /sbyor ba brgya pa bzhugs/1 ༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga sha ta ka /bod skad du/ sbyor ba brgya pa/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo /'phags pa klu sgrub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ring du grags pa'i gso dpyad nanas/ /mtha' yas rgyud kyi gces pa blangs/ /sman pa mkhas par rab mchod pa'i/ /sbyor ba brgya yis bcing bar bya/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i sman spyor gyis/ /lus ni nad med 'gyur ba yin/ /gso dpyad shes pa'i sman pa yis/ /nad rgyu mtshan nyid yongs su brtag /sle tres gla /sgang byi tsher bca' sga dang / /byi tsher gla sgang tig ta parba ta/ /ba shaka 5byi tsher bca' sga gla sgang rnams/ /bskol thang rlung mkhris bad kan rims la btung / /gru tra sle tres bca' sga puṣ+ka ro / /bskol ba'i thang byas bad kan rlung mchog la/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde bcas dang ga med/ /gzhogs gzer nyes gsum las byung rims 8

la'ang bsngags/ /dong ga drod sman nar rtsa gla sgang dang / /hong len a ru ra rnams bskol ba'i thang / /gzer bcas tshad 'khru bad rlung ldan rims la/ /phan no drod skyed bzhu ba byas pas kyang / /rgun 'brum gla sgang hong len a ru ra//dong ga papo ta ka'i thang byas la/ /mkhris byung rims dang bla 'chol stibargyal ba dang / /mgo 'khor tsha skam skom dad ldan rnams phan27/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑦ri bca' sga sle tres bskol/ /drod ④sman nar mo bsres pa'i thang 'thungs pas/ /gsus gzer lud pa tshad rnying dang ga med/ /pho ba'i nad cham ⑤dbugs mi bde rnams 'joms/ /byi tsher parba ta tsaka a ru ra/ /ba sha hong len tig ta ⑦pri yad+ku/ /ka ra cher btab bskol ba'i thang 'thungs pas/ /skom dang khrag mkhris rims dang tshad ldan 'joms/ /rims shā nad gso ba'i dpyad do/ /⑨skyer rtsa 'bras bu gsum dang bī shā latu) / /skyer rtsa phye mar byas la nges par bskol / /thang la sbrang rtsi ldan pa 'thungs pa yis/ /gcin kha snyi ba'i nad skyes ma lus 'joms/ /u di ⑩tsu dang ka ped ⑩bong nga dkar/ /gla sgang dug mo nyung bcas thang byas pa/ /tshad pa gzer ⑫bcas khrag 'khru dang bcas pa④/ /yun rings spyozhugs pa'i 'khru ba rnams la phan/ /gla sgang bca' sga bong nga dkar por bcas/ /sle tres cha snyoms ⑫chu la bskol 'thungs pas/ /me drod zhan pa'i rgyun ⑩gyi nad rnams dang / /tshad zin 'khru ba'i nad kyang sel bar 'gyur/ /lpags ⑫nad lto ba na dang skya rbab nad⑩/ /sbos dang cham pa bad kan mgul du 'gags la/ / pur+ṇa rna ba spyothang shing a ru ra/ /sle tres ba gcin gu gul ldan pa btung / /gla ( stesgang shi kru 0thang shing daṭī (ste'abras—/ / byi dang drod spyosman nar bye bcas thang gis/ /rgyun du kha rkub 111—4

nas 'byung srin bu ①dang / /srin las skyes pa'i nad kyang 'joms par 'gyur//susmre drod ②sman shing mngar na le sham/ /asma bhe dang e raṇa ba ④sha gze/ /brag zhun gtso cher bskol ba'i thang 'thungs na/ /rde'u gseg ma dang bcas gcin sri sel/ /brag zhun asma bhe dang susmre dang / /drod rjosman phye ma 'bras bkrus chu btab btung / /yang na bu ram dang bcas 'thungs gyur ⑤na/ /gcin sri 'chi la thug pa'ang 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /dong ga dang ni gze ma a ru ra/ /byi tsher asma bhe da dub sha ka /bskol ba'i thang la sbrang rtsi ldan 'thungs na/ /tsha zhing gzer bcas gcin sri grol bar 'gyur/ /dong ga dang ni sle tres ba ⑦sha rnams—/ /e raṇa mar khu la bskol thang 'thungs na/ /rlung byung rnam 'gyur ma lus khrag gi nad/ /steng 'og lus kun nas 'dzag rim pas 'joms/ /taṇ+ḍa li skeka'i rtsa ba lig bu mig /'bras kyi chu ⑨la sbrang rtsi ldan 'thungs na/ /kun gyis bskyed pa'i khrag nad nges par 'joms/ /dbugs mi bde la bhātwe ⑪bca' sgas so/ /bri ⑪ha ti gnyis e raṇa ⑫ka ped dang / /ma tu asma k+ṣa ⑫ra shing kun gze/ / san dhe ④e raṇa mar khur bsres byas thang / /rked pa snying nu pho mtshan gzer bas gdung ⑫/ /shing kun shu dag kha ru bca' sga dang / /go snyod a ru puṣ+kar ru rta rnams/ /phyi ma'i cha 'phel phye mar byas rnams kyis/ /lto skran rims rnying gsud nad rnams la'o/ /bca' sga shing kun ru tsha cha snyoms phyespyo| /sga chu la bskol bad kan rlung byung dang / /rtsib logs snying rgyab gsus gzer gsud rnams la/ /btung ngo de bzhin nas khus ⑫rtug 'gags la'o—/ /'jam 'bras lo ma'i bī shā lā tsa bya/ /tsi tra tsha gsum lan tshwa gtso cher brtsegasaspyo/ /bsregs pa'i thal ba zho la sbyar 'thungs pas/ /dmu skran 111—5

skya rbab rkub kyi nad rnams sel/ /shing kun shu dag bca' sga sardzi ①ka /kha ru phyi ma nyis 'gyur phye mar byas/ /chu dron btab 'thungs sna tshogs gsud gzer dang / /snying nad skran dang stod du rlung 'tshangs 'joms/ / shring gi ⑤tsha gsum 'bras gsum kaṇ+ḍa ka /bhātwe puṣ+kar dza ṭā tsha ①sna lnga/ /phye ma chu dron btab 'thungs skyigs bu lud/ /dang ga med cham ④stod rlung mi bde 'joms—/ /dzam bu dug nyung arka shi kru ⑤snu ha bse shing bya kri bri ha ti/ /pa ⑥ri ka ped tshos shing dza ḍa a pa ④marga nisbra sketse tra ka /ba sha ⑨puṣ+kar pa ṭa ⑩la dang sedhe ⑪ldan pa bsregs thal bskol ba la/ /sngar bshad shing kun la sogs btab kyi pa'i khu ba lto skran bad kan nad la btung / /tsa bya rkyastar bu tsha gsum bse yab bcas/ /ba lu dzī ra cu ⑫gang tsi tra ka /phye ma cha mnyam bur bsres dri gsum ldan/ /gre mdzer cham bad dang ga med la bsngags/ /ba lu tsa bya na sham mtshungs gnyis pa/ / mū la cu spyogang dro tsa' sga sum ⑩'gyur/ /bu ram sum 'gyur dri bzangs ri lu byas⑩/ /grang gzhi glo rims spyogazer ba'i gzhang 'brum sel/ /sga dros spyonal sham nā ga rjo 'dab shing tsha⑥/ /susmre mtha' rims gang 'phel phye mar byas/ /'di dag cha 'dra'i kar 'gam gzhang me ⑦zhan/ /dbugs dang mi bde skran 'gul phyosnying nad la'o/ /sedhe shing kun 'bras gsum la la phud/ /tsha gsum bu ram cha rnams ril bur ④byas/ /de rnams mur zhing myangs pas tshim thob cing / /me drod zhan las rab tu byung ba'ang sel /lcags phye tsha gsum rgya shug kyecha thams cad/ /māk+ṣi phye ma dang mnyam de rnams bza' / /rgun 'brum ldan pa'i rjes su dar 'thungs pas/ /skya rbab nad la phan zhing ring du 'gro/ /bu ram ldan pa'i bca' sga'i dro ⑩sman nar/ /gsum 111—6

pa a ru ra 'am bal po'i se'u/ /bad kan tshad rnying ①gzhang 'brum nad rnams dang / /rtug pa 'gags pa rnams la'ang rtag tu bya/ /bca' sga gla sgang a ru ra phye la/ /bu ram ldan pa la ni ri lu bya/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde dang tsho ches rnams/ /kha ru ri lu mur bas bzlog par 'gyur/ /n+ya gro ut+pal ru rta māk+ṣi ②ka /phye ma 'bras phye ④bcas pa ril bu bya/ / sra ba rjokha ru mur bas skom dad dang / /rab tu 'phel ba myur du 'joms par 'gyur/ /ldong ros drod sman nar mo na le sham/ /phye ma ka piṅga skyur khu bar ldan/ /'bras phye cha mnyam māk+ṣ-i rjoka bsres pa'i/ /nus rjopas lan cig ma yin skyug pa 'joms/ /sna khrag 'dzag la drurba'i ⑦khu ba'am/ /bal se'u me tog khu sbyar nges par bsten⑧/ /bud med nu zho rgya skyegs khu ba'am/ / bi ra māk+ṣi ⑨kas kyang i ku 'joms/ /sgyu ru spos dkar khu ba kha ru tsha/ /de rnams bsres pa sau ⑩bi ri la btags/ /des 'dir myur bar gzhi nas med byad cing / /ji lta'i skyigs bu be+er mi 'byung ba yin/ /drurba ⑪sedhe thal ka a ru ra/ /ku the ra kā kañdzi ka dar btags/ /gsum pos byugs ⑫pa'am nu ma'i 'og btags pas/ /shu ba dang ni g.yan pa rnam par 'joms/ /snu ha tsi tra bri ⑫ga arka dang / /mya ngan med shun ru rta tsha ba gcin/ /bcos pa'i mar khus shu ba mdze glang shu/ /gdug pa'i rma dang za 'brum ser ④kha 'phrog /gu gul mig sman spra spyotshil sin+tu ra/ /spangs ⑩ma cha mnyam tsha ba'i mar khus btso/ /khyi rdo za tsag gis ni lus skams la/ /lan cig byugs pa'i nus pa gzhi nas 'don/ /bu rtsi ⑩kā ru rta murba sga/ /rgya skyegs dang ni btsod ⑫dang yung ba rnams/ /drug 'gyur dar ba la bskol grub pa na/ /byugs pas grang dang tsha ba'i rims 'joms so/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑪ri sle tres 111—7

ba ①sha ka /phye ma ①zhun mar la bskol grub pa de/ /'thungs pas tshad rnying lud gzer dbugs mi bde/ /me drod zhan pa'i pho ba'i nad la phan/ /ba ①sha seng ldeng pa ṭa rjol pa tra/ /nilba shing tsha sle tres ta ma la/ /ki phye mar sar la bskol myur grub na/ /me dbal mkhris skran rjomadze las rgyal rjobar 'gyur/ /drug pas khrag dang bcas pa brgya yi skyon/ /rab 'khrugs las skyes yan lag lus kun gzer/ /bye brag me dbal chang gis ra ro ba rmongs pa chang 'thungs las skyes rnam 'gyur la/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri nilba pa ṭa ⑦la/ /sle tres 'bras gsum 'jam 'bras ba sha ka /phye chu mar skernying la ni cho gas btso⑨/ /myur du grub 'dis mdze las myur du rgyal/ /kar ku shraṇ+ḍa ⑩cho ga bzhin du bcos skams nas—/ /mar bskol kar btab tsha gsum dri gsum ⑪zi ra ldan par ⑫btso/ /'di bsten byis rgan khrag 'dzag rlung 'joms bud med la phod cing / /zas skom lud ⑫khrag mkhris skyugs dbugs mi bde dang gzhang 'brum 'joms/ /ba gcin skyu ru māk+ṣ-i ④ka drod ⑫sman/ /kha ru po son du ba dadzñā ⑩dang / /ru rta rnams btso reng bu mthe bong 'dra/ /mar bskus rkub bcug de yi nad 'phrog byed/ /lus gso ba'i dpyad rdzogs so// //kar bcas gur gum cha mnyam mar la btsos/ /cho ga bzhin blugs ()rlung khrag las byung ba'i/ /smin ma mur spyo'agram rna mig mgo bo yi/ /phyed gzer nyi 'khor las byung nad 'joms so/ /a ru ba ru skyu ru nang sa bon/ /sum ⑪gnyis gcig gam ⑩cha rnams zho la btags/ /mig sman de yis mchi ma mang 'byung zhing / /mig tsha rab tu 'khrugs stsopa'ang 'joms par 'gyur/ /111—8

a ru sedhe ba dang lig bu mig /btsag yug dang bcas chu la bsres btags te//mig gi phyi rol rab tu byugs byas pas/ /'di yis mig gi tsho)nad kun zhi bar 'gyur—/ /sau t+ta la sedhe seng phrom btags/ /de nas mar btsos ras dkar po la btsags/ /de yis mig la byugs ①byas mkhyes skyed ①nad/ /dmar tshag dang ni sha mdzer nges par 'joms/ /khrag skyed ④ka ra rgya mtsho'i lbu ⑤bas 'joms / /ba byung drod mesman nar mo srod long la'o/ /lig ⑦mig tsha ba gsum gyis mig 'grib ⑧la/ /ling tog dkar la māk+ṣ-i ⑨sbrang rtsis so/ /nag tshur lig mig dkar bcas rgya mtsho'i sbra⑩/ /nal sham sam kha sedhe btsag yug dang / /ldong ros cha mnyam māk+ṣ-i ka bsres btags/ /rab rib khus bskyed spru nad tshag po 'joms/ /ske tres pu shel lcags phye dug nyung nal sham sedhe gaphe ⑪la—/ /lig mig rdo dreg spang spos yung ba spangs ma sam ⑫kha rgya mtsho'i sbra/ /mtshungs pa phye ma lcags snod du bzhag sbrang rtsi ldan pas sha mdzer dang / /rab rib ling tog khrag 'bur mig sha'i nad la nye bar byugs ⑫pa'ang bsngags/ /shing mngar ut+pal rgya mtsho'i sbra ba shing tsha pu shel gi wang ⑫btsod/ /spang spos ⑩tsan+dan sam kha btsag yug ba lu lig mig nag tshur 'dab⑩/ /de ltar thams cad cha mnyam mig sman 'di yis mig 'brum mig nag tsha/ /mchi khrag skya rib mig sha gzer nas 'phrogs ⑩la bsngags pas rtag tu byug /mig gi sman dpyad do/ /spyothang shing bong nga dkar po sle tres bcas/ /dug nyung hong len ma nu pa tha'i thang ⑪/ /ba gcin las ⑫grub sbrang rtsi dang ldan pa/ /mgrin pa'i nad dang kun la btung bar bya/ /k+ṣa ra te dza ba ti pa tha ⑫dang / /lig mig skyer rtsa yung ba drod ⑫sman nar/ /ril bu sbrang rtsi las ⑫byas kha nang du/ /mur bar bya yi ④mgrin pa'i 111——9

nad kun la/ /skyer rtsa gla sgang dzā ti'i me tog dang 1/ /lo gsar rgun 'brum dug nyung 'bras gsum bskol/ /sbrang rtsi ldan pas lus kyi kha sgo'i nad/ /lce yi nad rnams dus su zhi bar byed/ /ru rta dang ni skyer pa'i rtsa ba seng phrom btsod/ /yung hong gla sgang pa tha (snye)te dza ni/ /zhib btags so rnams ldeg par byed pa dang / /gzer zhing 'khyugs ①la nang khrag 'byin par byed/ /sau bi bur tsu kra sgo'u gsher ma tu/ /khu ba sha rnams gu gul sedhe rnams/ /gang zhig tsha ba'i mar khu la bskol te/ /rna bar blugs rjopas rna ba'i zug rngu sel/ /ba sha nisba pa ṭo la dang rjoparba ta ka pedz+dza ⑦tsa bya skyer rtsa dang / /gla sgang tig ta pu shel byi tsher tsha gsum tra yarnyi ka (kyetsan+dan rnams/ /zhun mar las ⑨grub steng 'og nas skyes rnam 'gyur sna dang mig gi gzer la sogs/ /lpags ⑩nad rims dang khong 'bras rma yi zug rngu mig nad skya rib rnams la bsngags/ /skyer rtsa ⑪dug nyung nisba papo ta dang drod ⑫sman bye tsher shing mngar dang / /tra yaṭī hong 'bras gsum tigha bri sha pa ṭo ⑫la dang gla sgang dmar④/ /de rnams phye mar bskol ba zhun mar las ⑫grub 'di ni mig la phan pa yin/ /mkhris pa khrag las byung dang skya rib rab rib rnams dang stod kyi nad rnams la'o/ /e raṇ+ḍa dkar po yi ⑫rtsa ba dang ni shu dag dang / /sha ta puṣ+pe bri ha ti'i 'bras bu gzhan yang / / star ga'i 'bras bu ⑩'o mar bcas pa 4las grub pa /)/ /rab rib stod dang gtso che'i nad dang gzhan pa'ang 'joms/ /zug rngu zad par byed pa gnyis pa rdzogs so// //dung dang mush+ka ka dag me byes bsregs pa'i thal ba snod du blugs 0byas te//de nyid du 7slar chu la btso zhing bskol ba'i thal ba mar khu'i cho ga rnams/ /111 10

sbyor ba de yis bdugs pas 0rma dang rma tsha skrangs 'bur rtsa (snyeyi nad rnams dang //rnam pa sna tshogs mtshan bar rdol ba'i lpags 1nad yun ring mgul pa'i nad rnams la/ /shing mngar dang bcas skyer rtsa shug pa ut+pal dang / /pri yad+ku dang seng phrom dkar po tsan+dan rnams/ /mar khu dang ni 'o mar btso ④zhing sbyar bar bya/ /rma rnams dang ni gzer dang tsha ba 'joms par 'gyur/ /dzā ti nidza pa ṭo la dang ⑤pa ṭa hong len skyer rtsa yung ba dang / /btsod dang thal tres a ru pu shel spra tshil spangs ⑥ma shing mngar 'jam 'bras rnams/ /mar las ⑦grub pa 'di yis kha nad phra mo dang ni gnad gzer rtsa ⑧yi nad/ /nad dam gzer bcas 'pho zhing 'byung ba'i rma yi nad rnams dang ni 'byang ba 'byen/ /zug rngu zad byed gsum pa rdzogs so// //nal sham dkar por shi ri ṣa'i⑨/ /me tog khu bas brgya phrag bsgo bar bya/ /sbrul gyi ⑩sos btab brgyal bar gyur pa la/ /rab tu sbyar bya btung dang mig sman la—/ /rma bya'i mkhris pa tan+d+ra lbo ya ⑪ka /kā kaṇ+ḍa ⑫bcas mi nyung 'thung byas pas—/ /'gro ba'i dug dang brtan mchog dug gi ni/ /'tshe ba dang bcas myur du 'byin par byed/ /til btags mar khu la ni bu ram dang / /de bzhin arka'i lo ma cha mnyam btung / /sprin gyi tshogs la 'phral du rlung byung ltar/ /khyi smyo'i dug mchog myur du 'byin par 'gyur/ /khang pa'i du ba gu gul dang ldan pa/ /bā dzi garnya tan+d+ra lī ⑫ya bcas/ /ba yi gcin la btags byas snying nad dang / /brtan mchog 'gro ba'i dug rnams 'phrog par 'gyur/ /spang spos pu shel ba bla kaurnyi dza la sle tres ldong ros gi wang parma chuke shi dang / / spriṅgā tsan+da 7yung ba ru rta 111 — 11

ka ra la rta rdo dreg susmre gur gum ①shing shug pa/ /cha mnyam nyungs ④kar brgyad tsha ①nā ga ge sar me tog cha bzhi'i ④lde gus kun tu longs spyod cing / /phun sum tshogs bya sha za rims ⑤dang dug gi nad rnams 'joms 'gyur zla ba shar ba lta bur grags/ /dug nad sel ba'i rgyud bzhi pa rjordzogs so// // nyungs kar dze+e'abras gsum shir+ṣa ka ṭa ⑧dhī shwe 'jam 'bras sle tres dang / /btsod dang ser po gnyis dang tsha ba gsum dang spang spos shu dag shing kun rnams//ra yi gcin la btags byas 'thangs ⑨sogs brten ⑩pas sbrul gyi ⑪sos btab gdon kun dang / /gshed byed smyo byed sha za dang ni srin po 'joms shing rlag ⑩par byed par 'gyur/ /karba pa yi spyorus pa dang ni rma bya'i 'dab ma bri ha ti ⑫rnams dang / /nirma l+ya po son cha shing tsha cu gang byi la'i rtug pa ba sha ka ⑫dang ke sha sbrul lpags dang / /glang po'i so dang shring ga shing kun nal sham dkar po cha mnyam bdug byas pas/ /gshed byed smyo byed sha za srin po lha rnams zhugs pa'i rims n+da 'joms par dran/ /tsha ba gsum dang da la gur gum drod ⑩sman nar mo'i rtsa ba k+ṣu ⑩ra sing hi yung ba spyoru rta nyungs kar gnyis dang asru dug nyung kar ⑪sgog skya 'bras bu gsum dang pu shel tse dang hong len shu dag ⑫spangs ma shing mngar bā la dmar po ldong ros shug pa zhes grags pa/ /da dhi ⑫rgya spos ma dhū 3ka sā pri yad+ku dang bong nga dkar po lig bu mig dang tsa bya thang shing bcas pa phye mar byas pa mar dang srog chags brgyad kyi gcin gyi chu ()la bskol spyostebashad 'thungs pas 'byung po 'bros shing de yis ⑫gdon rnams mchog tu 'joms par 'gyur—/ /rgya spos shing mngar 'jam 'bras rgya skyegs pa ṭo la yi lo ma rak+ta pa 117— 12

trika ①shu dag pa tra la dang shing kun nyungs ④kar dzi hi ser gnyis la tā hong len dang / /po son tsha gsum kā kaṇ+ḍa ④thang shing bi dang pya.a dza garnya 0ma rā/ /arko ṭa dang ko ṣa ta ⑦kri na sham nisba sle tres dug mo nyung / /ru rta shu ka ta ru puju bā la shing mngar a pa ra dzi ta/ /daṭī ⑦tsi tra ka ped cha mnyam phye ma ⑧gcin gyi sde dang mar la bskol/ /yun ring du gzhag kun gyis ⑨rim par sbyor bas myur du 'joms par 'gyur ba yin/ /'byung po chen po'i gdon kun dang ni smyo byed des byas mdze rims zhi bar bshad/ /'byung po zhi bar byed pa'i rgyud lnga pa rdzogs so// //skyer yungs dug mo nyung gi sa bon dang / /sing ⑩hi dang ni shing mngar cha mnyam po/ /de rnams thang byas bu chung ma yi ni/ /bu nad dang ni 'khru ba kun la phan/ /ka ped put+pa da ta ki ⑪dza la/ /seng phrom dang bcas ga dza pithra ⑫lī/ /thang la māk+ṣi ka bsres byugs ⑫pa dang / /'khru ba rnams la byis pa la sbyar bya/ / shring ga drod spyonar bong nga dkar po phye mar byas/ / glo rims ⑫sgyug pa'i nad rnams 'joms pa la/ /māk+ṣ-i ka bcas bong dkar de bzhin gcig/byis pa'i nad sel ba'i rgyud drug pa rdzogs so// //skyu ru ra phye drug cu rtsa bzhi'i srang la rang gi khu bsgos sbrang rtsi mar dang cha mnyam zhing / /drod sman nar mo srang brgyad ka ra nyis 'gyur cha ldan thal ba'i phung po'i nang du gzhag par bya/ /dbyar gyi mtha' ru de bsten ⑩skra dkar dang bral gzugs dang kha dog dang ni spobs pa dang ldan zhing / /nad med blo dang 111—13

yid gzhungs dran pa tshig gsal ①stobs dang ldan zhing sems stobs ldan par 'gyur ba yin/ /shing mngar dang ni sbrang rtsi mar dang ni/ /'o ma dang sbyar rjes su bsten pa yis/ /lus po rgyags ⑤pa rab tu thob gyur nas/ /dga' zhing 'khrigs ①pa yang yang nus par 'gyur/ /shing mngar cu ④gang sedhe drod ⑤sman nar/ /ka ra dang ni 'bras bu gsum rab ldan/ /tshe sbyin ro tsa shin tu yid gzhungs rjoshing / /rgas dang nad rnams rnam par 'joms par 'gyur/ /gze ma skyu ru sle tres phye mar bya⑦—/ /sbrang rtsi'i ⑧mar dang ldan pa bsten pa yis/ /ro tsa bsten ⑨zhing sdug bsngal rnam 'gyur zhing / /skra gnag tshe lo brgyar ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /nisbra'i mar khu rang bzhin gnas byas pa/ /cho ga ji lta ba ⑩ bzhin btung ba dang / /'o ma mar dang rab sbyar de zla bas/ /skra dkar dang ni rgas pa rnam par 'byin/ /gze ma gru ra dang ni ⑪rtsa ba brgyad⑫/ /bā na rī nā ga ba khā ba lāspyo/ /phye ma 'o thug spyobyas 'di btung bar bya/ /de yis 'khrig pa lan brgyar nus pa yin/ /rta ltar byed pa bdun pa rdzogs so// //shing mngar thang bskol skesedhe ba ldan zhing / /dug nyung drod ⑩nar po son phye mar bsre/ /sbrang rtsi bcas pa 'di dag slon la sbyar/ /mgrin nad kha dang gre 'gags nad rnams la'o⑩/ /sau bī ra la a ru ra thang bskol/ / drod nar kha ⑫ ru darnyi phyed ⑪phye ldan/ /e raṇa rjo mar khu dang bcas 'khrul de/ /bshal gyi spyor bas nad rnams 'joms par 'gyur/ /ra sna po son cha dang 'bras gsum sle tres rtsa ba bcu dang bā lā dang / /mar khu sedhe ba bcas pa la mam si btsos ldan sbrang rtsi bu ram bcas/ /sha ta put+pa sle tres ru rta ka ped pri spyo111—14

yad+ku dang drod yo)sman nar/ /shu dag phye ma kañdzi ba 'o gcin bcas mas gtong ②rlung nad rnams la phan/ /ba la phye ma mar khu la bskol dri bzangs ④dang / /bcud grub pa dang 'o ma zho dang sgyur ④chu rnams/ /de bzhin sa hā ra dza ra sna ⑤sle tres dang / /ba ri re rer bskol bas rlung 'joms so/ /sbyar bar bya'o bca' sga'am bu ram la/ /yang na sedhe ba bcas drod rjonar la'o/ /sna kha mjing ⑦pa 'gram pa dpung pa dang / /rgyab dang mgo mig mgul 'gags nad rnams la/ /las lnga'i le'u brgyad pa rdzogs so// //rims la gtso cher parba pa ṭa ⑧sbyar bya skom dad che la skyu ru ra dang skyugs ⑨pa la/ /tsha ba lnga skyes gzer la 'jam rtsi rengs la gi ri ja dang gcin snyi skyu ru'i ⑩khu bas so/ /rlung gi nad la ra sna ⑩dmu rdzing mcher pa'i nad la ba gcin cham pa la/ /drod ⑩nar 'phyo la bi dang ⑫dug la shu ka rta ru skrangs la gugrul ④lo/ /ba sha ka yis khrag mkhris dug nyung gis/ /'khru la 'o bse ⑫shing he mam ⑩lci gzer la/ /spos la thang shing srin nad byi dang gas⑩/ /skya rbab a ru ra dang 'bru gzhan gyis/ /zad byed nad la 'bras bu gsum bshad gzer ba kun la de ltar khu bas so/ /mdze la rtag tu seng ldeng khu ba glo la kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang / /tshigs bcad ⑫gze ma mu ra gshed byed na (nyeg bā lā ba las so/ /bcud len kun la sgyu ru lha bcas gdon gyi 6kyend la brag zhun bshad/ /rgyud phyi ma'o// //rab tu grub pa'i sbyor ba'i cho ga rdzogs par byas/ /grub pa'i don rnams rtogs pa'i sman pa mkhas rnams kyis/ /rtogs 7pa'i sman pa med par su yis 111—15

sbyor ba mthong / /'di don slar yang 'dir ni cung zad bshad par bya/ /shugs bkag ma zos gnyid chags ①skad ches rtsol ba drags/ /bzhon ⑤pa la zhon tsha ba kha bska ①rtsub pa rnams/ /sems gzung rjo'akhrig dang 'jigs dang smyung rjoganas mya ngan drangs/ /dbyar gyi dus su rlung ni rab tu 'khrugs dupar 'gyur—/ /tsha sgyur chang dang lan tshwa rno dro til mar khu/ /khro dang gdung ba lo ma skam pa ⑦'jigs ngal rnams/ /thal sman la sogs ma zhu ma 'phrod zas zos pa—/ /ston gyi dus su mkhris pa rab tu 'khrugs par 'gyur/ /nyin gnyid mngar dang grang ⑧ches nya sha lci ba dang / /shing tog 'o ma bu ram shing gi rnam 'gyur rnams/ /snum bag 'grangs ches zos dang lan tshwa bur chu rnams/ /dpyid kyi dus su bad kan rab tu 'khrugs par 'gyur/ /de ltar 'di rnams rim pas bye brag skyon/ /gdug ⑨pa kun ni ldan pa brgyad du shes/ /sna tshogs nad ni lus kyi grangs bzhin du/ /ming rnams ma lus rjes su rtogs par bya/ /rtsub 'khums 'pho zhing gzer dang sngo bsangs mdog /yan lag zug che yan lag brkyang bskum byed/ /shes rmongs drang ⑩zhing gyong la skom pa rnams/ /rlung gi las su mkhas pas rab tu bstan/ /'dzag cing rdul 'byung tsha zhing 'dod chags skye/ /dri nga rnag 4spredang 'ju dang khro ba dang / / bla 'chol ()brgyal dang mgo 'khor lus mdog ser/ /mkhris pa'i las su mkhas pas rab tu bstan/ /kha mig sna chu grang lci lus g.ya' rdul/ /shes pa rmongs shing sna tshogs 'gags pa dang / /tsho ches mchil snabs yun rings ⑫'byung byed rnams//bad kan las su mkhas pas rab tu bstan/ /de rnams kyis byas 'di dag rtogs rnams ni/ /nad kun ming ni du ma'i rnam pa yang / /bye brag kha cig skye 111—16

ba'i dbang gis 'gyur/ /gang gis ①'di rnams ming gzhan kun du 'gro/ /rgyud ni le lo yid ni rnam ma dag /skyon ni rab 'jug bkres dang gcin yang 'byung / /gsus lci shes pa rmongs shing dang ga med/ /de rnams nad ldan de la nad 'byung 'gyur/ /bcud dang drod dang brtan dang ro tsa stobs skyed lan tshwa ④mngar skyur mar khu dang / /khrus dang drod bsten mas gtong sha dang stan ④bsten yan lag kun la dril phyis dang / /snum gyi dugs dang 'jam rtsis zhi byas bsku byug nye bar bsten pa la sogs pa/ /bza' dang btung ba gnas dang sman 'di rnams kyis rlung ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /kha mngar bska ba grang dang rlung yab mtshan mo zla ba'i zer rjol gnas pa dang / /sa yi khang pa chu yi 'khrul 'khor chu la rtse ⑤zhing bud med lus la reg /mar sar k+ṣi ra dang por lus la bkru sman dang ni khrag gi gtar dpyad bubya/ /bza' dang btung ba gnas dang sman 'di rnams kyis mkhris pa rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /rtsub dang k+ṣu ⑦ra bska kha tsha ba dang ni 'bad rtsol drag dang ngar snabs sbyong ⑧/ /bud med bsten zhing ngal ⑨dub gnyid bcag chu la rtse zhing rkang pa 'chag par bya/ /reng bu'i dud bsten mgo bsro khrus dang sgyug sman dugs ⑩dang mas gtong ⑪la sogs pa/ /bza' dang btung ba gnas dang sman 'di rnams kyis bad kan nye bar zhi bar 'gyur—/ /'phrod zas smyung ⑫dang tsha ba'i chu btung zhing / /zas dang bya na yang zhing kha ba'i bcud/ /rtsub bral dugs dang 'ju ba bsten pa dang / /de bzhin lus kyi steng 'og sbyang bar bya/ /dgun ⑫stod dbyar dang dgun ④smad rlung gi dus/ /mkhris pa ston dang so ga sketsha ba'i dus/ /bad kan dpyid ka me tog 'ong dus 'khrugs⑩/ /de la de bzhin phan pa'i sman bsten ⑩bya/ /111—17

bad kan 'khrugs la sgyug sman sbyar bar bya/ /mkhris pa'i rnam 'gyur byung la bkru sman gtang ①/ /rlung gi bdag nyid 'jam rtsis 'joms par 'gyur/ /'du 'phrod skyes la'ang 'dres ma de dag go/ /rlung la ②sgyur dang mar khu lan tshwa dang / /mngar ba'i bza' dang btung ba rnams kyis so/ /mkhris pa la ni de bzhin mngar ba dang / /kha dang bska ba grang ba rnams kyis so/ /bad kan la yang kha dang tsha ba dang / /rtsub dang bska ba rno ba'i ro rnams kyis/ /de rnams bza' bas nye bar 'gro 'gyur ba/ /nad ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /blo gzhan nyid kyis gang de ma bstan gang zhig bstan/ /nad rnams rang gis yang dag rtogs ①nas ji lta'i tshul/ /sman rnams rjes su blo gros chung ba rnams la byas/ /bstan bcos su ni cung zad gtan ④phab 'bras bur byas/ /yon tan lhag can sbyor ba brgya pa brjod pa yis/ /bsod nams bla na med pa bdag gis gang thob pa//de yis rnam pa sna tshogs nad kyis gzir gyur pa/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams kyi nad ni med gyur cig /sbyor ba brgya pa zhes bya ba'i sman gyi gzhung 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bram ze dze ta kar+ṇa'i ⑤zhal snga nas dang po rtsa 'grel lan cig gsungs shing / /dus phyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta budha shri dhidzñā na'i zhal snga nas stod cung zad gsungs nas/ grub pa'i zhing skyi rong 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang po'i gtsug lag khang la cung zad las mi ring ba/ chen po'i chen po rnams kyi gdan sa dpal shel ⑦gyi gtsug lag khang du sdom brtson dam pa sde snod gsum dang / rgyud dang rgyud kyi yan lag rnams la ⑧legs par 'dris shing / khyad par du che'i rig byed yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i gzhung 111—18

17 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyag/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskyed lan tsha/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang she dang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzer—/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtse/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyad/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉k+ṣa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉snab sbyang /〈〈snar 〉〉snab sbyar/ po)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dug ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang / tunye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgun/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgun/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skab/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khrug hu)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/18 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bkru sman btang / 〈〈snar 〉〉bkrus sman btang / ②〈〈co 〉〉dang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtags/dhi〈〈snar 〉〉btan/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kasa'i/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shrī/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sher/⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/19 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagand/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyan/ du〈〈co 〉〉sbyor/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mi sa steng du nyi ma dang zla ba ltar gyur cig/ //lo tsā ba'i 'gyur bstan la dpe phyi byas nas bris te/ zhus dag legs par bgyis pa 'dis/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed par gyur cig/ //bsdur 'bras re'u migagaso ba rig pa/ (1)

༄ga /sman 'tsho ba'i mdo bzhugs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dzī ba sru tra/ bod skad du/ sman 'tsho ba'i mdo/ /bam po gcig pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sman pa'i mchog ste nyon mongs nad sel de la phyag 'tshal sdenas/ /'phags pa'i brtul zhugs drang srong ma gtogs skyes bu blo ldan pas/ /rlung mkhris bad kan gsum dang 'phrod spyad bag bya spyod lam gyis/ /mi lus 'di thob don yod 'tsho ba'i don tsam bstan par bya/ /'dod khro gti mug gsum las rlung mkhris bad kan gsum srid de/ /lus yul dus la sogs pa kun dang bde bcas dbang bsgyur ①zhes/ /drang srong chen pos gsungs phyir de yi khyad par mdor bstun rjonas—/ /tshul rtags ⑤zas dang gnas dpyad rjodagongs pa nyi tshe 'dir brjod pa/ /lus rtsub skems sems rgod tshig mang grang rlung gi mi/ /dmar ser blo rno khro la drod che dri can mkhris pa'i mi/ /dkar snum tshig g.yung phyi la drod chung gnyid 111—23

chung bad kan mi/ /gnyis dang gsum du 'dres pa yang ni de las shes par bya/ /rgan dang dar dang byis pa rim gyis lta ①zhing shes par bya/ /ngad can grang ba rlung gi yul te tsha gdung mkhris pa'i sa/ /rlan can snum bag bad kan yul te 'dres pa de las brtag /nang par srod ni bad kan tho rangs phyi dro rlung gi dusaske/ /nyi ma phyed dang nam phyed mkhris pa'i dus yin shes par bya/ /dpyid na bad kan ldang ste ②dbyar stod rlung sogs ①ston mkhris ldang / /dbyar smad rlung ldang mkhris sogs ④dgun stod dgun smad bad kan sogs⑤/ /ston ni rlung zhi dgun stod mkhris zhi dbyar smad bad kan zhi/ /lus yul dus dag brjod nas bro rjodrug khyad par mdor bstan pa/ /mngar kun bsil te bad kan skyed ⑦de rlung mkhris sel byed na/ /zhun mar bu ram snying gzer gze ma go dang starka dro/ /mu ka sbrang rtsi skam sa'i sha dang nas dang bu ram rnying ge/ /bad kan sel te nye shing ram nye bad kan mi skyed snyoms/ /tsha ba dro ste mkhris skye ⑨rlung dang bad kan sel byed na/ /srog chags mkhris pa mkhris sel na le sham ni rlung yang skyed⑩/ /skyur kun dro ste mkhris pa skyed ⑩cing bad kan rlung sel na/ /sgyu ru ra dang bal po se'u ni mkhris pa sel bar byed/ /ku shu mngar ni bsel la dar ba chus bslad mkhris mi skyed/ /kha ba bsil te rlung skyed ⑫bad kan mkhris pa sel byed na/ /shu dag sle tres dro ste 'phrod dang sbyar na rlung yang sel/ /bska ba kun ni bsel te rlung skyed ⑫bad kan mkhris sel na/ /a ru ra ni nyes pa gsum pa ④gnod mi byed de snyoms/ /chang ran bad kan rlung sel mang ⑫na mkhris pa skyed par byed/ /lan tshwa dro ste rlung sel bad kan mkhris pa skye ⑩byed na//rgyam tsha lce myang tsha ⑩ni mkhris pa las ⑫yang gnod mi byed/ /mngar dang bska 111—24

dang lan tshwa gsum yang rim ①bzhin mas phyi ste/ /skyur dang tsha ②dang kha ba gsum ni de bzhin mar zhing ①yang / /kha ba bska dang lan tshwa gsum yang rim bzhin mas rtsub ste/ /mngar dang skyur dang tsha dub gsum yang de bzhin mar ⑤zhing 'jam/ /rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ka 'dra ste nyid kyis nyid skyes rjopas/ /lus dang yul dus zas spyod tshul gcig 'dom na nad ldang ste/ /ji ltar mthun par 'phrod sbyar rlung mkhris bad kan mi ldang phan/ /de phyir 'phrod dang mi 'phrod la sogs tshul bzhin 'dir bstan pa/ /rlung ni mngar snum lci dro 'phrod ⑦de rtsub yang bsil mi 'phrod/ /mkhris pa kha mngar bsil dang 'phrod ⑧de tsha sgyur dro mi 'phrod/ /bad kan snum lci bsil dang mi 'phrod rtsub tsha spyod ⑨dang 'phrod / /de bas rang gi lus dang dus gnas zas dang 'phrod spyad phyir/ /dpyid zla gnyis ni bad kan bskyed dus yin te nad ldang bas⑩/ /bad kan drang zhing bkru sman skyug sman btang zhing chu tshan btung / /gro nas bsreg sha sbrang ⑪rtsi la sogs rtsub bska yang ba bza'/ /sbrang chang rgun chang sga chu sbrang ⑫chu bu ram chang nyid ⑫btung / /mar tshil la sogs snum lci kha ra skyur po tsha phrom dag /mngar 'jam skyur na bsil bag yang zhing nyin par log mi bya/ /chu ④tshas lus bkru mnye zhing las bskyod bcag bya ci ran bya/ /gnas kyang ha cang mi tsha mi grang ran dro grib mar 'dug /dbyar stod zla gnyis ma ⑫'bri dus yin nyal po drag shul spang / /ngal dub mi bya bag 'bras 'o ma mar sar sha dag bza'/ /bu ram tshil ni cung zad bza' ste chang nyung yang ba btung / /'o ma bskol grang ⑪kha ras btab dang dar ba 'thungs na phan/ /lan tsha ⑩skyur zhing na le sham la sogs pa tsha skyur spang / /chu 'jam tsam gyis lus bkru sgra snyan mnyan zhing 111—25

gdags—/ /char par reg bya nyin par tsog pur gnyid kyis log na phan/ /gnas kyang ser ①bu drag po'i ngad med dro min bsil bar 'dug /dbyar smad zla ba gnyis na mkhris pa sogs shing ②rlung ldang ste/ /phyi rol tsha la lus kyi nang grang nad gsum g.yos pas ④na/ /rlung nad bsal phyir lus mnye snum bsku sman chu bskol bas bkru/ /rlung nad sel des til mar mas gtong dhidugs dang lums kyang bya/ /zas kyang ha cang tsha min mngar skyur med par ran par sbyar/ /pho ba drod skyed ⑤bag dang mar tshil sbrang rtsi bar 'ga' bza'/ /yos dang 'bras chan mar khus blugs rjodang zan dron sha dag bza'/ /chang yang cung zad btung ste chu dang chu grog ⑦spang bar bya/ /rlan la mi 'dug mi 'gro lus la char pas gsher mi bya/ /stobs dang drag shul ngal zhing dub par gyur pa'i bag dang yang / /nyin mtshan mi bde nyin par mi log nyal po brtun byed spang / /gnas kyang rlan med rlung mi ldang la bsil bar stan bting ske'adug /ston zla gnyis ni mkhris pa skye ba'i dus yin nad ldang bas/ /bsil mngar bkru sman gtang zhing gtar kas khrag kyang ci ran dbyung / /kha zhing mngar la bsil ba'i sman yang rtag tu bza' bar bya/ /dus 'di'i chu ni dug med gtsang dang bkrus shing 'thungs na phan/ /zas kyang 'bras nas sran ma sbrang rtsi kha ra sha la sogs/ /mngar zhing kha la yang ba mar sar 'o ma bza' zhing btung / /chang phyi drag po'i ro yod mi btung ra ror mi bya ste/ /tshil dang til mar mi bza' zil par mi 'gro 'dug mi bya/ /tsha ba'i zas dang yul yang zla grogs yid du 'ong ba bsten/ /chu 'jam tsam gyis lus bkru gos kyang dri ma med pa bgo/ /rgyan dang dri zhim lus la gdags shing nyin mtshan mi bde stiste/ /111—26

gnas kyang dro min ser hūṃbus mi phog bsil bag can la 'dug /dgun stod dgun smad zla bzhi phyi grang nang tsha bad kan sogs1 / /gos dror bgo zhing rlan dang lhags pa ⑦ bag bya nyi ma'ang 'de④/ /zas kyang sha tshon rus khu mar tshil ⑤snum bag 'grangs par bza'/ /mngar skyur lan tshwa drod bag cher bza' gsar tog 'bru dag bza'/ /ran par sna tshogs chang btung ngal ba'i las dag byas kyang sla/ /rtsel spyobacag lus sbyang skabs skabs mgo lus til mar bsku zhing mnye//de rjes byu ru ra la sogs pa sman bskol chus kyang bkru/ /gnas kyang bsro khang dron por me dang stan stug ldan par 'dug /dbyar stod tsha dus dbyar smad rlung dus bkru sman mi gtang ④ste/ /dgun stod dgun smad grang dang rgas la sgyug sman gtar ga spang / /dgun gnyis dbyar stod lums dugs mi bya nad kyis gzir kyang sla/ /de ltar yin yang lus dang nad du gar mthun brtsam ④par bya//rlung mkhris bad kan gsum dang 'phrod pas 'tsho ba'i mdo brjod nas/ /bag byed spyod lam can dag ring du 'tsho phyir yang bstan pa/ /med smra cir yang chos dang rigs pa gzhan dag gsum la 'dzem/ /sngar byas nang nub bsam zhing skyor mudor phyin chag ⑪bag cher bya/ /byed pa gang la rdul med rang nyam med cing 'dod chen spang / /nga rgyal lang tshos ⑪spyi brtol che min shes dman khum ⑫mi bya/ /sdig grogs spang zhing dge bshes ⑫bsten te gtong smos dge bcu spyad/ /gsong des tshul chags gzhan la gnod min mi la byams par bya/ /lha dang rgyal por nyer bsam lung mnyan ④yid dang mthun par sgrub 7/ /rgyal po'i sras dang rma ni chung yang mi brnyas ⑩bag cher bya/ /spyod lam sgyu mas mi bslu bka' khrims yul chos bsrung / /gzhan gyi dpyas ⑩skyon mi brjod rtog ⑫'dod gtum chos 111—27

'gran mi bya/ /dge slong slob dpon pha ma'i gong du mi 'gro sri zhu skyed/ /dge sbyong drang srong srog chags ya mtshan mnyan ①gtod sbrul mi rtse②/ /ma rtogs shing chen mchod rten drung dang lam mdo phug stong dang / /sems can mang du bsad pa'i ④slo sa dur khrod nyal mi bya/ /gnyan pa'i mtsho dang chu mig bzang por mi bkru mi bshal te/ /rdo shing dgon pa'i shing chen mi bcad pha bong gzhom mi bya/ /mchod rten rgyal mtshan arga'i rjogrib ma maṇ+ḍal mi 'gong ⑤zhing / /mi ro gtor ma yas stags rjohom khung thal khung bcag mi bya/ /nam mkha' ban bun nyi ma phyed dang dmar thag chad pa'i tshe/ /mi bza' mi btung yi ge klog min nyal po las dang yang dze+e/ /nyi ma la sogs 'od zer phra sngags mi ring ring mi blta/ /lha khang sgor mi nyal te ri sna grog snar gnas mi bca'/ /ya mtshan shes drag mi bsten bud med ngag mi mnyan/ /bud med rgan la mi spyo rtsal rgyos ⑧smra 'gros dub mi bya/ /gad mo che zhing ring du dgod ⑨dang ngud mo drag po spang / /rtag tu mi 'dug ring du mi 'greng ci nus ran par bcag /sprud pa lud pa khu ⑩chu mchi ma snabs 'phyen ⑪bshang gci dbyal⑫/ /mi dgag ma bsgrus bkres skom nad gnyid gnag min myur du bsal/ /nyal po skigs pa lud pa la sogs tshe lus mjing ⑫mi gcu/ /glal na kha dgab sprid pa smra tshe ha cang kha mi bgrad/ /sen mo ring du mi bzhag bregs te phan tshun brud mi bya/ /mgo lus lag pas mi brdab mgo bo spyodrag tu mi sprugs te⑫/ /don med sa mi bri zhing lag pa mi brdab mchu ⑩mi bri/ /mi nus ⑩bzhin du ci mi gdags ⑫te mya ngan gnan ⑪mi bya/ /dpyid dang dbyar stod ston ni phyugs mar dus bzhin ⑪til mar gyis/ /rtag tu mgo dang rkang mthil bsku zhing bar bar lus kyang bsku/ /ston dpyid ma 111—28

yin dus gzhan ①res 'ga' sna dang rna bar til mar blugs(kye/ /skyer pa'i khaṇ+ḍa stang zil dag gis bar bar mig kyang bsku/ /rtag tu lus kyi byi dor bya zhing sman sngags rin chen gdags/ /ser gebu drag po mi ro'i dri dang dud pas phog mi bya/ /chu tshas mgo lus mi bkru bkru sman sgyug sman gtang ba dang thu/ /cham pa ma zhus btab ste mgo lus mi bkru snum mi bsku/ /skya rengs glushar nas tsog pur du'adug ste de ring ci bya bsam/ /langs nas so shing bca' zhing kha yi skyon bsal lag gdong bkru/ /de nas sman mchog a ru ra ni rtag zos bdud rtsi yin / /lug gi mar min mar sar zhun mar rgas sra tshe ring ste/ /'di la sogs pa lus dang tshe la phan pa'i sman zos na/ /byug pa rgyan dang gos kyis shin du mdzes byas lha yang mchod/ /de nas sri zhu'i gnas dang 'khor la snyan brjod 'dzum bstan nas/ /rje dpon las dang bdag gzhan don la nan tan brtson 'grus skyed④ / /dus bzhir dro bab /duran par zas bza' ngoms par skom 'thung ⑨ste/ /thug pa khu tshan la sogs snum lci drod kun sngar bza' zhing / /'bras la sogs pa bsil yang phyis bza' 'phrad ⑩med phye ma 'gam⑪/ /bab chol ha cang 'grangs par bza' min myos par chang mi btung / /'bras kyis 'grangs rjes phye zan mi bza' drod rjes skom mi btung / /skyo ma ran par 'thungs na lus brta ⑫nang na rgan la bsod/ /bro ⑫drug gang yang gcig la cher zos ④nad ldang ran par sbyar/ /'grangs pa'i rjes la nyal po bang stobs rta rgyug la sogs spang / /shing tog ldam ldum mang d+kun nad ldang ba mos phog pa gnod—/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i ⑩tshes la ldam ldum bza' drag ⑩nad du 'gyur/ /nad can lums kyis drangs te mgyogs na nad ldang skran du 'ong / /mchin pa 111—29

g.yer ma spangs te zos na cung zad snying la gnod/ /zas mchog sbrang rtsi mar rnying cha mnyam zos na dug bzhin gnod/ /mi mnyam che chung byas kyang zos rjes chang du ①'thungs na gnod/ /ma langs zho dang langs ma thag gi zho dron nad kun slong ②/ /chu bya dbyar spang ldum mchog ke'u di ④dbyar zla 'bring po'i sman//sman 'thungs sha ba'i sha gnod ga gon zho 'drer rjorims su 'gyur/ /btsong bsregs rjosbrang rtsir mi 'phrod lhan cig zos na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /ke'u 'am gnag sha lhan cig zos na skran du 'gyur/ /dgun stod rgya g.yer zos na snying ni rjodrags na mig kyang mdongs⑦/ /mar tshil zos dang mi 'phrod lha ba bza' drags na so 'byung / /bra bo ⑧mang du zos na rlung dang lus g.ya' ste/ /nub mo chu 'thung chang ⑨gnon la phug rnying ⑩dang sha skam spang / /nya dang kha tsha mar tshil mi 'phrod snod kyang gcig mi bya/ /nya dang 'o ma lhan cig mang zos nang na zer ma gnod/ /shing tog chang la sogs te skyur dang shang tshe la phug rlon/ / nyungs rnying ⑪'di rnams gang yang 'o mar 'phrod min mang zos gnod/ /'o tshan 'thungs rjes chu grog ⑫'thungs dang rgya sran nag po gnod/ /zla ba spyang kis zin tshe zan zos so na shu ba 'byung / /gnag sha rta sha ⑫lhan cig zos na lus la g.yan pa 'ong / /gnag sha phag sha lhan cig zos na lto yi srin bur 'gyur—/ /nya dang khyim bya'i sha gnyis lhan cig zos na skran du 'gyur/ /khyim bya'i sgo nga'i spri dang sgog skya zos na dbugs mi bde/ /khyim bya'i sha dang ri bong sha gnyis lhan cig zos na cung ④zad 'khru/ /sha mo yungs mar nang du brdos pa zos na lus la gnod/ /ma nu'i sa bon ka tsam spyosbrang rtsir 'phrod ma yin/ /la phug bu ram mi 'phrod zho dang bya gag shar mi 'phrod/ /de ltar 'phrod zas 111—30

goms dang rtag tu chags ①pa dang / /lang tsho 'ju slas zos dang nyung na gnod pa med dang bsre/ /'phrod pa'i zas zos phyi dro'i las byas nam sros bde bar nyal//de ltar nan tan bag byas mi tshe tshad bzhin 'tsho nges pas/ /skyes nas lo bcu'i bar du sma mi dbab cing rang dgar gzhag④ /de nas nyi shu lon te lo bcur bslab dang brtsal ④bar bya/ /de nas lnga bcu lnga lon sum cu rtsa lnga khyud 'khor ༷du//longs spyod grags pa'i yul srid gtam byas nas/ /lnga bcu lnga lon phyin chad chos lam yum gyi ched bsgrub phyir/ /dge la brtson bskyed thos rig goms byed lus sems ci bder gnas/ /de ltar sus nus mi lus thob pa'i don yod skyid cing dge/ /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub snying pos sman pa rnams la brdzangs pa/sman 'tsho ba'i mdo tshigs su bcad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/23 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉po sman 'tsho ba'i mdo klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs/ zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btsal/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsdus/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtags/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pad/24 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉blta/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉steng / ①merjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasog bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉(/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra skyed/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉snying / ⑨⑩⑪⑫⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabaskyed/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamangs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉〉 / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/25 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdem pa/ ①〈〈snar 〉ra// sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rem bzhin/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamangar/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskyed/ ④〈〈snar 〉7'phrod/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉sngaraphros/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskyod/ ⑫〈〈co 〉snga na pas/ ⑪〈〈snar 〉〉sgrang / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉rga chu sbrang / 〈〈snar 〉〉rga/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnying / ④〈〈snar 〉〉spyo/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamar/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabangs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tswa/111—31

bsdur 'bras re'u migagaso ba rig ba/ (2)111—33

545ras /ṅkub dpon klu sgrub kyis bshad pa sman a ba'i cho ga①༄7/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bshad pa sman a ba'i cho ga /sman a ba 'di ni lus kyi rus pa chag pa dang / rkang lag gi rus pa chag pa dang /'phres pa dang / kha bye ba dang / tshigs 'bur ba dang / smas te rma chen po byung ba dang / rlung dang / bad kan dang / mkhris pa dang /dreg nad dang / da sgal ②dang / ro smad man chad 'jas pa dang / na ste mi bde na yang nad kyi ngos ma zin te ci na gtol med pa dang / mig nad sna tshogs pa dang / rgas sra bar bya ba dang / ro tsa bar bya ba la sogs pa'i dpyad—/ lha chen po gu lang gis gu lang gi btsun mo zhes bshad de/ a ba yin no/ /a ba gtang ba'i tshes grangs 'dam pa ni/ tshes bdun dang /brgyad dang / bcu gsum la bzang ngo / /skar ma 'dam pa ni/ ba ru ṇa'i dus la bab pa'i chu lha ste/ bdud rtsi dang sbyor ①ba'i skar ma la bzang ste sman 111—34

gtang ①ngo / /sman gtang ba'i thabs ni nad ci na yang rung ste/ dang por sbrang rtsi la ⑦sbyar te gtang / de'i 'og tu zhun mar la sbyar te gtang / de'i 'og tu 'bru mar la sbyar te gtang ngo / /sbrang rtsi la sogs pa sna re re 'dra ste/zhag bdun bdun sbyar zhing phul ①te 'tshal lo/ /phan pa'i sna grangs ni/lus kyi rus pa chag pa dang / rkang lag chag grugs ④byung ngo cog dang / lus la rma byung ngo cog dang / snying na ba dang / rtsib logs na ba dang / ro stod gzer ba dang / glo na ba dang / rus pa chag go cog la lhag par phan no/ /rlung las gyur pa'i nad brgyad cu snyed yod pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa'i nad kyi rnam grangs nyi shu dang / bad kan gyi nad nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ spyir nad brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa ril 'byang ngo / /dreg nad dang / ⑤tsha grang 'dres pa las gyur pa'i nad dang / mdor na nad ci yang rung ste/ sman a ba btang na nad do cog 'byang ngo zhes lha chen po tshangs pa dang / gu lang gis bshad pa las thos so/ /mig rab rib yod pa dang / ling tog dang / spris g.yogs pa dang / mdongs rjopa dang / mig g.ya' ba dang / na ba dang / mig nad yod do cog dang / mgul pa man chad na ba dang / sna nad dang / rna nad dang /⑦ rna ba mi gsang ba dang / klad pa mi bde ba dang / mchin nad dang / snying nad dang / ro stod mi bde ba dang / 'di rnams la 'bras bu gsum las sna gcig kyang zho re re/ lcags phye zho gsum lcags dog gi nang du chab can rtse gsum las bskol ⑧te/ gang lus pa dang btsags la ⑨chu dron 'jam tsam gyi nang du sman a ba zhib tu btags pa zho gsum btab ste 'jam tsam la nub mo nyal kar ⑩'tshal lo/ /dgongs 'tshal ma ⑩mi 'tshal na/111—35

dro 'tshal ba'i rjes la 'tshal lo/ /sman 'di nyin zhag nyi shu tsam btang na/mdongs ①pa yang mig gis mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang sbyor ba rnam gcig la/'bras bu gsum las sna gcig kyang zho re re/ lcags phye zho gsum/ ba sdemar srang gnyis/ chab can rtse gsum gyi nang du bskol te/ do ni du/ gang ni lus pa dang / btsags te dro 'jam tsam gyi nang du a ba btags pa zho gsum btab la nyal khar sne'atshal lo/ /dgongs 'tshal mi 'tshal ba lta zhig na/ dro 'tshal ba'i rjes la 'tshal lo/ /'di bzhin du zhag bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i bar du 'tshal na/mig phyung ba ma gtogs pa/ dmus long dang mdongs pa yang mthong bar 'gyur ro—/ /lo bcu drug pa gzhon nu'i tshad du 'gyur ro/ /a ba phye ma mar ldan pasarjo—/ /rus pa chag la ⑤nub gsum du/ /'thungs na de yi rus pa ni/ /rdo rje lta bur sra bar 'gyur/ /a ba tsha ba dhigasum de bzhin/ /tsha nag nye'u ⑦shing rtsa ba yis/ /dug ⑧skam rus pa na ba dang / /lud pa de bzhin dbugs mi bde/ /snying na ba dang sha tshod la/ /de rnams cha ni mnyam byas te/ /phye mar byas nas nub gsum du/ /chu dron lhan cig myur du btung / /'bras bu gsum ni 'o ma dang / /mkhas pas de bzhin bskol byas nas/ /mar ni sum cha gcig dang ldan/ /de bzhin a ba bzhi sticha gcig /zan ⑩zos 'og tu nub gsum du/ /'thungs nas 'u sha zas dang zan⑩/ /gyen du za ba'i nad las rgyal/ /rab rib rdzi bor mig ser dang / /tshad rnying g.yan pa tshor ⑫bcas dang / /mig gi nad ni thams cad dang / /gzhan yang de bzhin klad nad dang / /lto nad dang ni snying nad dang / /de bzhin yan lag chag pa dang //zhag gsum du ni rab sbyar na/ /long ba dag ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /a ba so 111—36

ma ra dza dang / /ra yi 'o mar bskol ①te btung / /'thungs na rlung ltar mgyogs par 'gyur/ /a ba phye ma mar sar dang / /kha ra de bzhin pi pi ling / /gzhang gi nad ni thams cad la/ /'di las drag pa gang yang med/ /glang po ba lang khyu mchog dang / /ra dang lug dang mi rnams la/ /a ba mar dang 'o ma dang / /'thungs na de dag shis 'gyur te/ /sha chod rus ②pa chag pa dang / /skom snedang snying nad mgo 'khor dang / /thams cad nad las rnam par grol/ /gang gi lus ni skem pa dang / /gang zhig sha bkrar gyur pa dang / /gang gi lus ni 'jig pa dang / /gal te rus rjopa nar gyur cing / /gso dka' ba yi nad la phan/ /a ba dang ni nye'u ⑤shing dang / /so ma ra dza de bzhin te/ /sbrang rtsi pi pi ling de bzhinadu/ /mar dang 'o mar lhan cig btung / /zhag bdun bar du sbyar ⑦bar bya/ /'dod chags rnam par spang ⑧byas te/ /zhag bdun bar du sbyar ba yis/ /de ni rlung dang khrag las rgyal/ /de bzhin nad rnams kun las rgyal/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa sman a ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //111—37

༄ga /sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa bzhugs/sti༄4/ /sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa las/sman gyi ming gi rnam grangs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chags la ①mngon par dga' ba'i bu/ /zla ba dga' ba zhes bya ba/ /thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal te/ /yan lag brgyad pa las bstan pa'i/ /sman sde po son cha la sogs/ /de las gzhan pa'i sman rnams dang / /gzhung gzhan las bshad sman gyi ①ming / /sgra sbyor nges par bshad par bya/ /ma dha ④na dang / shwa sa na dang / rā ⑤tha dang / piṇ+ḍi dudang / ta ka ra dang /ga ta ga dang / ga lā pha la dang / ga ga la dang / tsa ⑦la dang / sha lārdu sgedang / de dag ni po son cha'i ming gi bye brag yin no/ /ma du ya sha dang / ya shi ma du dang / ma du dhu ka dang / aṣ+ṭa ⑨hā dang / ma byu yaṣ+ṭi ga dang /gī ti ka ta ⑩dang / sta la dza ma dang / de dag ni shing mngar gyi ming gi rnam 111—39

grangs yin no/ / ka dh+ya ka khān bu ni dang / lam ca dang / tum byi dang /yī ku dang / ma hā tsa rmye khā dang / rā dza pu ti dang / paṇ+ḍi pha la dang /pha tig ta lam+bu kyedang / bri had pha lā dang / de dag ni ku ba kha bo'i ming yin no/ /nidza dang / a ri sha dang / su bhat+tha ⑦dang / pi tsu marda dang /sha kha pri ya dang / su tig ta pyadang / sarba to bhat+tha dang / pa bhut+tha khya dang /ba ri tig ta ka dang de rnams ni nidza'i ming yin no/ /ma hā nispa dang / go ri ka dang / shu ka ma lā 'uka dang / bri had nispa ka dang / nidza ka ra dang /ka ra mu ka dang / bri shwa mu shi ka dang / de dag ni nidza chen po'i ming yin no / / byi ma byi ⑦dang / rak+ta pa ta pha khā dang / go ha dang / tuṇ+ḍi gi ri dang / tun+di dang / o sha pa pha khā dang / daṇ+ḍi dang / rak+ta pa tra 'u la dang / de dag ni cim pa'i kwaming yin no/ / ci shā khā dang / za ger cu ru dang ⑩/ ga bak+ṣa dang / ga tsa tsar rnyi tro dang / gha ba da ni dang / stu la phru ⑪lā dang / mri ga cag k+ṣi dang / i tra ba ru ni ⑫dang / de dag ni byi ⑫sha la'i ming yin no/ /tsi tra ba la dang / tum pa si dang / ma dhu sab bha ④bā dang / ibye ba ru dang / ha ti darnyi dang / tsi tra de 7bri dang / ma hā pha la dang / de dag kyang byi ⑩sha la gcig gi ming gi bye brag yin no/ / pra pu sa ⑫dang / ku tu ka dang / tig ta ⑫dang / mu tra la dang / ha ti paṇi dang / tshar dang paṇi dang / mu tā 15pha la dang / pan du pa tra dang /mu kha pri yang ༷ bye dang / de dag ni ga gon gyi ming yin no/ /ku ta dza dang /tsad tsa ka dang / tud tsha dang / bṛk+ṣa ( teka dang / ga rim la li ka dang /ba ༄ 5ri tig ta dang / shang ka bṛk+ṣa 0dang / ku ta tsi dang / ni la yaṣ+ṭi ka 111—40

dang / de dag ni dug mo nyung gi ①shing gi ming ngo / / bad tsha ka dang / ko ta ⑧dza dang / ka le ga ka dang / sha ku pā hwa ④dang / in+d+ra ya ba dang /a bā hwa ya dang / de dag ni dug mo nyung gi ④sa bon gyi ming ngo / /murba ⑤dang / ma dhu ra sa budang / de bi dang / spru lu paṇi dang / ma dhu pra ba dang / sasgo na dang / ma dhu pa ti dang / la ku par+ṇa ⑦dang / pri thag twa tsa dang / de dag ni mur ba'i ④ming du bshad do/ /dzi mu ⑨ta ka dang / de ba ra li dang / bri da tra ko sha dang / gha rwa ga ⑫ri dang / ce ni dang / lo ma sha pa tra dang / karko ti dang / a ku bi sha pa ha dang / de dag ni dzi mu ta ka'i ming ngo / / byi dang ga ⑪dang / kra mid dzid dang / ce la ⑫ka dang /a lasba dang / tsit+tha tan du spyol dang / kri mi ha ra dang / dzan dug ⑫na dang /kri mi na sha na dang / de dag ni byi dang ga'i ming yin no/ /be ha ⑫sa dang /byi ⑩du la dang / tā ma mra dang / badzi la dang / dir+gha ⑩pa tra ka dang / na ti ya dang / gan+dha ⑫put+pa dang / dza lo kā sā ma tri spyotā dang / de dag ni lcang ma'i ming yin no/ /na ⑥di gu la pri ya dang / su shi ta dang / me gha puju dang / dza le dza tu dang / to ya ka ma dang / ni tsu la dang / dza le pe ta pa ⑥dang / de dag ni chu lcang gi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /tsi tra ka dang / da ha na dang / can ni dang / pā tsa ka dang / a na la dang / dzo ti dang /bya ma dang / di pa dang / pā thi na dang / da ru na dang / de dag rnams ni kru trug tres kyi ming yin no/ /darnyi dang / pu ka la ka dang / tsit+tha dang /ni kudza dang / u pa tsa tra ka dang / ku la dang / u dus+thā ⑫ra paṇi dang /bye ⑫sha li dang / ghu na pri ya dang / de dag ni darnyi'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /111—41

tra badhi na dang / shadza ri dang / tsit+tha dang / ni kun ba dang / nya ①gro kro tra ba dha na dang / mu shi kā yā dang / pra t+yan 1 shri ni dang / bye she raṇ+ḍa dang /su ta shri ni dang / a ku kaṇi ka dang / de dag ni tra ban ti'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /ko sha ta ki dang / kri ta tsit+tha dang / dza la ni dang / kri ta ba dha na dang / bhe rda dang / sba tig ta ④dang / ha ghaṇ+ḍi lid dang /ming ⑤dang ga pha li ka dang de dag ni ko sha ta ki'i ming yin no/ /rā dza ko sha ta ki dang / kar ki ti dang / has ti parka dang / dwa pyamarka dang /ko sha ta pha lā shidang / ma hā dza la na khyadang / de dag ni rā ⑨dza ko sha ta ki'i ming yin no/ /ka rañdza dang / nag ta ma la pra dang / pra kir t+ya dang /pus shu mañdza rī ⑩dang / gri pa ta pu ra dang / gung tsha ⑩puju dang / sdig dha ka rañdza ka dang / de dag ni shwe ta ka rañdza'i ming yin no/ / ud kir+ya ⑫dang /ke ri mya dang / mi tri nan+da na dang / tsi ri byil pa ⑫ dang / pu ti sa spyohā dang / pu ti ka ⑫dang / dan+ta dha ba na dang / de dag ni pu ⑩ka rañdza zhes bya ba srin sman me tshu 7ru'i ming yin no/ / pi pi ling dang / ma ga bha 4)dang /kṛt+ta dang / bai de kyi ṭī dang / tsa pa la dang / ka na dang / a pa gul l+ya dang / ma ga ti ka dang / shon h+ye dang / ka lo dang / o na ( stedang /ka ṭu dang / de dag ni pi pi ling gi rnam grangs so/ /ma la dang / pi pi ling rū la dang / ka la mu pa dang / gradz+re 0ga dang / tsha pha la mū la dang /kṛṇ+ḍa mū la dang / sho ḍi dzudza dang / de dag ni pi pi ling gi 3rtsa ba'i ming yin no/ / sen da ba dang / mi ni bhan 3dang / na de ya dang / ba la not+ta bam dang / sin+d+ra da tha dang / sin+d+ra da 'udza dang / sheṣ+ṭa la ba na sdedang /111—42

ba ma la dang / ba ra dang / de dag ni lan tshu'i ming gi ① rnam grangs so/ /sau bar tsha rjol dang / ru ra ka dang / su gnad byi dang / arnya ga da rju ka dang / ak+ṣa dang / ka la la ba na thudang / kṛṇ+ḍa dang de dag ni kha ru tsha'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /bi ta bra dang / kri ti lam dang / man+dha ⑤ dang /ga ḍi la ba na ⑥dang / dra ⑦ba dam dang / khan da la ba na 5dang / kri ta ka dang / durta a su ra dang / de dag ni rtsal ⑨ ru tsha'i ming yin no/ / su mun+d+ra ba la na ⑩dang / tri ku sra dang / tsa ri ru ⑪bha dang / sa mut+tha ⑫dza dang /sa ⑫ga ra dza dang / la ba no ⑫da dhi sam bha dang / de dag ni rgya mtsho'i tsha'i spuming yin no/ /u bhi da dang / phar thi ba dang / tso saṃ dang / bhu myu ca ⑩dang / pra thi bi ⑩bha ma dang / de dag ni lan tshwa shā5khrol bu'i ming yin no/ /lan tshwa rnam pa ⑩ lnga po de dag ni lan tshwa rnams kyi rtenang nas gtso gtsor bstan pa yin no/ /pa ⑪/ṭu dang la tsa ni ⑫zhes smos pa ni lan tshwa spyi'i ming yin no/ /lan tshwa thams cad kyi gor ni rgyam tsha gtang du rung ste/ tsha gzhan med na yang de'i skyin par sbyor ba kun gyi nang budu rgyam tsha gang gtang ④ngo / /ya ba sa ④k+ṣa ra dang / ya ba shu ka dang / ya ba dza dang / ya ba dza shu ga ⑩dza dang / de dag ni nas tshig 'khus pa ⑦thal ba'i ming yin no/ /sardzi 3k+ṣa ra dang / rnge kye ga l+lī ni dang / pā ki dang / sadze+e du ka dang / de dag ni sardzi ⑪ka'i thal ba'i ming yin no/ /ba tsa dang / bu gra gan dang / dza ḍi la dang / shaḍa grargo dang / he ma tsan ⑫ti dang / de dag ni shu dag gi ming yin no/ /shukla ⑫dang / tiṅgā gan+dha dang / u gra ④dang / raspyo gha dang / lo ma sha dang /dza ya dang / de dag ni shu dag dkar po'i ming yin no/ / tra byi di ( mi111—43

dang / tu tsha dang / bā le la dang / ba pu la dang / tu ti da dang /k+ṣu tra'i stil dang / ni kyu ṭi dang / tsan+t+ra dang / gharba bi snga ba ni dang de dag ni ④sug smel gyi ming yin no/ / pad tre ④la dang / bri had e rjol dang /sbu le la dang / trag su gadhe ka dang / tri de ba dang / tri de co da bhut+ta dang / trid tha ga dang / kan+ta ka dang / pa tra dang dhi/ de dag ni sug smel pa tra e la zhes bya ba rnam pa gcig gi ming ngo / /ha ra n+ya dang / re rku rjoka dang / kon ti ra dang / pan+d+ra paṇi dang / bri haju ⑦ti dang / ka pi la dang / ra dza pu ti dang / gan+di ni zhes kyang kha cig 'dod de de dag ni ha re ṇa ⑧ka'i ming yin no/ / sa ra sha ba dang / dum du bha dang / ga 'u ra dang / sidharba ⑨dang / byu ta nā sha ⑩na dang / gra hasnan dang / ka rgya ka dang / shwe ta dang / rak+ṣa na dang / byi ⑪dza ya ba ha dang / de dag ni ⑫yungs kar gyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /a su ri dang / rā dza ka dang /triṣ+ṭi ka dang / rak+ta sā ⑫ra sha ba dang / kya bya ka dang / tiṇ+ḍa ④garnya dang /su ti baṣ+ṭa dang / k+ka ⑫ba ka dang / klu ⑩ra dang / de dag ni skye che'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /tri sbud dang / tro tsidh+ri dang / tri ti ta ⑩dang / kum+bha dang / ku ta ra na dang / sarba nu bhu ti ta dang / tri bu ta dang / shā mā dang / ko sha ⑫pha la dang / de dag ni shing nye rong ste ru ⑪dur byid kyi ming ngo //ma la byi ( )ka dang / pa lirnyi dang / ka la (spreme shi dang / kā lā dang /ma tu ra ra byi da la dang / taspru puṣ+pe 3dang / arta tsadh+ri ka dang / de dag ni ba la ⑫dur byid kyi ming ngo / /'bras bu gsum zhes bya ba ni④/ a ru ra dang /sgyu ru ra dang / ba ru ra rnams yin te/ de'i ming ni/ u dha ma dang /111—44

ba ra ma dang / sherte ①dang / pha la dri ka dang / pha la tri ya dang / de dag ni 'bras bu gsum gyi spyi'i ming yin no/ /ha ri ta ka ⑤dang / a bha ya dang / pad ju dang / sran snem dat+ta dang / byi tsa 0dang / shi ba dang /a bya tha dang / stu ta na dang / a mo gha dang / tse ta ki dang / za ta na dang / a mṛ ta rjodang / de dag ni a ru ra'i ming yin no/ / tra ti pha dang /a ma la ka dang / /dza rjoti ra sa pha la dang / shi ba ⑦dang / ko rang ka ka dang / a mṛ ta dang / pha la dang / shrī pha la dang / a mṛ ④todzha ba dang / de dag ni sgyu ru ra'i ming gi bye brag go/ /bi ta sha dang / kar sha khyapha la dang / ka li z-ik+ṣa dang / ka lo tu ma dang / ba pan+ta ka dang / bu ta tsa sa dang / ha r+yasgo dang / ya man prir ya ⑩dang / de dag ni ba ru ra'i ming gi dbye ba'o/ /su da dang / n+ya ḍa ⑪dang / ma z-ik+ṣa ⑫dang / gan dri ba dang / badz+ra kar mu ka dang / snu ha dang / sa man+ta dugha dang /sbug dang / badz+re ri dang / ni shri sha pat+tha ka dang / de dag ni shi ri khaṇ+ḍa'i ⑫rnam grangs so/ / shaṃ khi ni dang / tig ta la dang / sbud tsa dang / ya pa tig ④ta dang / ak+ṣa spru da ka dang / ba yu phe phab dang / ba yu ra sa dang /ḍa ⑫da pā da dang / ci sar pi ⑩ni dang / de dag ni shaṃ khi ni'i ming yin no/ /ka li ka dang / ka la dang / nī ⑩la dang / ru ni bi sho da ni dang / gā mya dang / tud tsha dang / nī la pus sh+yi spyodang / tsi ra bi ra dang / bā ⑪ti byi dang / de dag ni ni ⑫li'i ming yin no/ /ro tra dang / ga ti ri ta dang /shi be ri dang / ti palpa ka pa dang / shā ⑪ba ra dang / gha na twag ⑫ka dang /bri ha ra dha ⑫da dang / pa buti dang sha ba ra pa dang / de dag ni sha ba ⑫dang 111—45

ri ①gser phrom gyi ming ngo / /sha ba ra ka dang / shwe ta robyā dang / ak+ṣi be+e sha dza dang / dzir na budhe na dang / bri had pat+tha ②dang / kra mu ka dang /sbya la ba ka dang / de dag ni seng ④phrom dkar po'i ming gi bye brag yin no/ /a rag gwa dang / rā dza dṛk+ṣa dang / sha mya ka dang / tsa rus aṅga li dang /kaṇi ka dang / bya di ga ti dang / gri ta ma la dang / re'i ④ta dang / de dag ni dang ka'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /rka bi l+ya ka dang / ra'u rjotsa na ka dang / rak+ta tsūr na rjoka dang / rak+ta ⑦gā dang / rak+ta sham dang / /tsi sgere ki dang / bra na sho da na dang / de dag ni ko bi l+ya ga'i ⑨ming yin no/ /swa ra na ⑩k+ṣ-i ri dang / te ma du ga dha dang / te ma k+ṣi ri dang / ka tsa ni dang / he mā ba tī dang / sarba sba na dug dha dang / ma te mā hā dang /tig tu dug ti ga ⑪dang de dag ni rtsang sman khrol bu'i ming ngo / /k+ṣ-i ra dang /dug dha dang / pa ya sa dang / de dag ni bud med kyi nu zho'i ming ngo /'o ma zhes bya ba gang du 'byung ba der ni ba'i 'o ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /'o ma gyur pa ni ⑫zho zhes bya'o⑫/ /brjod do/ /sha ra zhes bya ba ni zho'i spris ⑫ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /da dhi na na tā zhes bya ba ni zho ga chu la zer ro⑫ /zho bsdus pa las mar tho)byung ba ni mar sar ()zhes brjod do/ /ming rnams gcig ha yang ga byi ()na zhes kyang bya'o/ / sar pi dang / ad dza dang /gri ta dang / ha byi ⑪dang / de dag ni mar gyi ming ngo / /na ud shi dang /ma thi tha dang / tag kra dang / kra la sha yam dang / bi li ḍi ta dang /dadha ⑥ha ta dang / go ra sa dang / de dag ni dar ba'i ming gi rnam grangs so//de bsdus pa'i dbu ba ni ka spyodha ba zhes bya'o/ /go mudrwa tra ⑫dang / go dza la 111—46

dang / gam bu dang / bra h+ma asbo dang / de dag ni ba gcin gyi ming gi dbye ba'o—/ /gcin lhag ma ①bdun po ni so so'i bye brag gis rtogs par bya'o/ /ba lang la sogs pa rnam pa brgyad kyi rtug pa'i ming ni sha kri da dang / ka ri sha dang / tsha ga na dang / ba gi sha dang / de rnams yin no/ / ku sha dang /mud pa la ku na dang / pa ka ①la ka dang / pa ri ba kyang su ①ka dang / a ma ya dang / gha da dang / ro ga dang / twa ga to sha dang / bya di dang /de dag ni dhiru rta'i ming yin no/ / shā la ṭu dang / shan tiblu ⑤ka dang /pu ti pa ta dang / ma hā rjob la dang / shrī pha la dang / shri a hā dang /gan+ta dang shri ⑦dang de las kyang bil ba gzhon nu ni cil pa ⑧kar ba ka ti zhes bya ste—/ de dag ni bil ba'i ming gi bye brag go/ /kasma ri dang / shri paṇi hi ra ⑨dang / karmi r+ya dang / kad pa ⑩la dang / ka h+ma ri dang / sarba pa to ba tra dang / kri sna ⑪mi ti ka dang / de dag ni tad pal gyi ming gi ⑫rnam grangs so/ /asni man+d+ra dang / a ghi spyos bha na dang / tad ka ⑫rī dang /bi ⑫dza ya ti ka dang / bha ni man+d+ra dang / a ra ni dang / ke ta dang / dza ya dang / pa ba ka dang / man+d+ra na dang / de dag ni asni man+d+ra'i ming gi bye brag yin no/ /bai dza arnyi dang / bhan+da nirma tha ni dang / dza ya dang / a ra ni ka dang / dza yarnyi dang / bi dza ya dang / dza ya bha dang / de dag ni tad ka ⑩ri zhes bya ba aldi man+d+ra'i ⑩ming gi rnam gcig ⑫go/ /pā ta li dang / kṛṇ+ḍa dṛt+ta tho)dang / sta li dang / a mo ga dang / am+bu pa bi ni dang / tāsmra pu sgo)shi dang / kun byi 0ka dang / ku su ma a ga ma du ti ka dang /de dag ni pā ta li'i ()ming yin no/ /shwe ta pra na dang / kaṣ+ṭa pa ta la dang /111—47

sha ta kub bi ka dang / ku be+e da ①ra k+ṣa dang / pha le ru ha dang / de dag ni pa ②ta li dkar po rnam ①gcig gi ming yin no/ /bhu ta dṛk+ṣa dang / tun+d+ra ka dang / dir ga brid da ka rjodang / ma yu ra dza ga dang / ba lu ka dang /ka dwang ka dang / ra lu ka dang / de dag ni so na ka'i ming yin no/ /ste ra dang / sa phu mya dang / tri phu na dhu ⑤bha ba dang / bi da ri garnya dang /ang shu ma ti dang / dir+gha mū la dang / t+pā 0ti ka dang / de dag ni sā la paṇi'i rjoming yin no/ /pri thag paṇi dang / kā la shi dang / dha ba na dang /gu ha dang / mṛ ga dang / cin na ⑧tu dang / gri ti li dang / paṇi ⑨dang /sha ka pud tshi ga dang / de dag ni kroṇ+ḍa paṇi'i ⑩ming yin no/ /pa ba pu pu tra dang / kan+d+ra ki dang / sbya la kan+ta ⑪ka dang / ma hā brta ⑫ki ni dang /ma hā tho)ti dang / ma ho ti ka dang / kan+d+ra ka ri dang / kan+ta ki ni dang /dha ba ni dang / dhu pra bar shi ni dang / di dighi spyoka dang / klu tra dang /bārta gi ⑫dang / klu tra ka ṇa ha ki dang / de dag ni shri ⑩ha ti'i ming du bshad do—/ /go k+ṣu ra dang / go k+ṣu ra ka dang / sho dang / ṣ+ṭa dang / kri ⑩kan+ta dang / go kan+ta ka dang / blag sha ta ka dang / go karnya ⑫dang / swā du kan+d+ra ka dang / de dag ni gze ma'i ming yin no/ /de ltar rtsa ba chen po lnga dang / chung ngu lnga ste bcu po de dag ni rtsa ba bcu zhes bya'o/ /gong du bshad pa'i ⑪rtsa ba lnga pa gnyis po ni spyir bstan pa yin no/ /rtsa ba lnga pa lhag ma ni so sor bshad pa yin no/ /de ba da ④ru dang / bhad tra tra ru dang / su dang /ru dang / de bā kāṣ+ṭa dang / bha tā ⑩shwa dang / su ra da ru dang / in+d+ra da ru dang / de dag ni thang shing gi ming ngo / /yugha dang / gan ta mū 3la 111 —48

dang / su ba ha dang / ra ①sa dang / su garnya dang / a ti ra sa dang /ra sa dang / ra sa ni dang / garnya na ku li dang / de dag ni ra sna'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /sngo ba dang / triṇ+ḍa shu ka dang / ba byid tri ④dang / bā dza nam pri ya dang / a sha k+ṣa ta dang / bha ru dza dang de dag ni nas kyi ming ste/de brngos ①pa ni yos zhes bya'o/ /sha ta puju dang / mi mesi dang / sgo sha dang / ṣa ⑤tā hā dang / ka ra bi dang / sha pha dang / a ba ma dube+e dang /ma byu rjor ga dang / chad tra dang / si ma ha ta la pa tra dang / de dag ni me tog brgya pa ste/ shu ti'i ming du bstan pa yin no/ /ku ⑦laṅga dang / tasmra par+ṇa dang / ka la thrat+ta ⑧dang / tsa la ba ka dang / k+ko ta dang / bra blu ma ra dang / ma du dza ⑨ti dang / de dag ni rgya sran gyi ming ngo / /de las kyang ma k+ṣi ka zhes bya ba ni 'bru mar gyi mdog lta bu'o/ /bh+ra ma ra zhes bya ba ni sbrang rtsi dkar po la bya'o/ /k+ṣa tra zhes bya ba ni sbrang rtsi'i mdog ser skyar ⑩snang ba'o/ /po ti zhes bya ba ni zhun mar gyi mdog lta bu'o/ /de dag ni sbrang rtsi'i bye brag go/ / sid tha ⑪ka dang / bhi ga sa dang / sid tha dang / ma dhu tshishā ⑫dang /ma dhu na shu ta dang / ma dha she sha sa dang / pa tsa na ga na dang / ma dhu dzā dang / ma k+ṣ-i ka sa ya ⑫dang / de dag ni spra tshil gyi ming ngo / /sharka ⑫ra dang /se ka ta dang / shu blu dang / shu la dang / shwe te dang / po ⑫to ba la dang / de dag ni kha ra dkar po'i ming ngo / / mar tsharnga dhi ⑩ka dang / a pa gal ba dang / de gnyis ni kha ra'i mdog ser po'i ming ngo / /de las gzhan pa ni sbrang rtsi'i ⑩kha ra zhes bya'o/ /she ⑫kha ri dang / pra tag pu na sha dang / yu ta //)ka dang / kha ra mar dza 8nari dang / a da shal ba dang /111—49

gru po dang / ①dha marga ④dang / de dag ni a pa ④marga'i ming ngo pi pi ling dang / bca' sga dang / na le sham dang / dra u sha na dang / byo rjosha dang /ka r+ya ⑤tra ya dang / de dag ni tsha ba gsum gyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /shing tsha dang / sug smel dang / garnya bha dra dudang / de gsum spyi'i ming yin no/ /ni tri ka ta dang / tri dza ta dze+edang / de gnyis ni dri gsum zhes bya'o/ /de'i steng du nā ga ge sar gyis ⑧bsnan na dri sna bzhi zhes bya'o/ /ho sha dang / na ⑨ga ra dang / bi shwa ⑫be+e sha dza dang / bi sho'u ⑪dang / shri ga be+e ra dang /ra hud tsha tra dang / ka ta sha dang / de dag ni bca' sga'i ming ngo ma ri tsa dang / bal dza dang / kṛṇ+ḍa ()dang / u sha na dang / kuñdzi ta dang / ka ṭu ⑫dang / ya ba ni sha dang / dharma par ta dang / tikyā ④dang / bi ba sha pri ya spyodang / gha na dang / de dag ni na le sham gyi ming ngo / /de bi dang / da ru ha ri ta dang / sardza ⑩ni dang / pa tsa ma pa tsa dang / ka ṭa ka ta spyori dang / ra dza ni dang / ra tri dang / ma ha dang / ni sha dang /k+ṣa pa dang / de dag ni skyer pa'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ / piṇ+ḍa ha ri ta ⑫dang / ga pu ri dang / bar+ṇa ba ti spyodang / ni sha dang / pi ti ⑫ka dang /ra dza ni dang / bi ta dang / ha ri ti dang / ba ra bad 0pha ni dang / de dag ni yung ba ste/ rtsi ⑫ser po'i ming ngo / /sardza ra sa dang / de ba bhu ⑫pa dang / ba ru byu ④pa dang / ag ni ba la bha dang / su ra la dang / sa ra nirdza sa pa ⑫dang / su byu pa dang / yak+ṣa du ⑪pa ka dang / sra rtsi ⑩pog gi ming ngo / /ma dhu ( )pu sha dang / bridha pu sha dang /() shu ka bri ya dang /bhan di dang / shu ka ba pu byu ⑪dang / mri du pu shwa ⑪dang / bi sha ba dha dang /111—50

de dag ni shri sha'i ming ngo / /shi kru dang / she stita ma ri tsa dang / mu kha bhañdza dang / a dig shā ka dang / sau bhañdza na dang /② kṛṇ+ḍa ④garnya dang / su ti ga shan dang / gha na pha la ba dang / de dag ni na le sham dkar po'i ming ngo / /shi kru dang / ha ri da kra rjosha ka dang / spru ⑤la ka pat+tha ka dang / gha na tsha da dang / ti shan garnya dang / mu rung gī rjodang / sa la na dang / k+ṣa ma dang /de dag ni shi kru rnam gcig ha ri sha ka'i ming yin no/ /ma du ⑦shi kru dang /ma dhu ra dang / dzi ha ke sa ri dang / shi kru dang / shi kru ka dang / de dag ni shi kru dkar po'i ming ste/ shi kru gsum pa yin no/ /ma dhu ka dang / tishā ⑧sa ra dang / ma dhu puṣ+pe dang / ma ha da du ④ma dang / do la pha la dang /ma dhuṣ+ṭa la dang / ma dhu ra dang / ghu dang pu ⑩sha ka dang / de dag ni shing tog ma du ⑪ka'i ming yin no/ /ma du ka'i rnam ⑫gcig ni gong ma bas shing chung la me tog kyang chung zhing / ro dang nus pa ni ⑫mnyam pa zhig yod de de yang ma du ④ka zhes bya'o/ /ra sañdza na dang / ta ra ka she la dang / dbe+e kwa tha su mudzha ba dang / ti ra k+ṣa dang / ba la bai shad tsa ⑫dang / kri ti ma dang /kri ti kam kri ta dang / mri ta la dang / de dag ni skyer khaṇ+ḍa'i ming ngo / /nyi gu pat+t+waṃ (nyedang / prid bī ()ge dang / pir thu la dang / snyi spre)thu la dang /ka ba ri dang / dir ke ⑪ka dang / tarnyi dang / nā dī ⑫dang / lta ⑫gu shi ba ka dang / de dag ni sibs kyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /ta ga ra ⑫dang /ku ta la dang / ba tra dang / na tra dang / ka la nu sa ri dang / rnyim hri dang / bar hi na dang / baṃ ka ⑫da dang / shi tha dang / tsa na snu ④na dang / de dag ni rgya spos kyi ming yin no/ / sgod sgod ⑫ni dang / kru ra 111—51

dang / sa man sa dang / shi ta kyu ra dang / yo da ①na ha dang / pra da ri shi dang / be+e da la dang / de dag ni ba la'i ming ngo / / ram̐ sha srog ta ⑤dang / ba ra dwa tsa dang / swa baṇi ①dang / bhablu gha ni dang / ju ri ba la dang / pa li ni dang / pu sha ka dang / de dag ni a ti ba thula'i ming yin no—/ /shar dwa la dang / m+bi la drur ba dang / go lo mi dang / sha ta bar pa ⑤ dang / ha ri ta dang / sarba byi r+ya rjodang / shi ta bal bo ⑦dang /u se ta la ta dang / de dag ni drur ba sgosngon po'i ming ngo / / she ta drur ba dang / go lo mi dang / shwe gan da ⑨ dang / so ta la ta dang / sa ha sra bibyā ⑩dang / a nan+ta ⑪dang / dur dha ra dang / bar gha ⑫bi dang / ru ha dang / de dag ni drur ba ⑫dkar po'i ming ngo / / gan da drur ba dang /gan da la spyodang / ti bh+ra dang / ma tsha k+ṣa dang / bi li dra dang / na di ka ta ya dang / da ra ni dang / sha ku la kyu hunyedang / de dag ni drur ba'i tho )sdong bu'i ming ngo / / ya ba sha ka dang / dirga spru la dang / sa mut+than+ta dang /ma rud bha ba dang / a nan+ta dang / du ra chu la dang / ba la ra da tre dang /tsi kan+ta ⑩ka dang / de dag ni byi tsher ma'i ⑫ming gi rnam grangs so/ /du ra la bha ba dang / da na ()ya sho dang / ya sha dang / dan dz+wa ya ba sha ka dang /kad tshu pya ra dang / tam mra mu li dang / du ra ⑫shar sha dang / du ra bi gra ha dang / de dag kyang byi ( ) tsher ba rnam gcig gi ming ngo / /ba shi dang /bri sha dang / sau ha mu khi dang / bh+ri sha ga ma ta dang / a ta ru sha ka dang /sau hi ga 0dang / sau ha paṇi dang / rak+ta pid ta pra sa da ni thudang / de dag ni ba sha ka'i ming ngo / /ka pi kad tshu dang / ad ma sdegup+ta dang / swa yang 771—52
