—— — —— —— —— — — — ——————byed——— — —— —————————lang rta bong dre'u dang / /stag gzig 1/seng ge dom spre'u/ /byi la byi ba spyang ki dang / /sre mo dang ni dred dag dang / /wa dang 'phar ba khra dang ni/ /chun lag khra sbyang bya rog gi/ /bya rigs khra sngon bya ku run/ /bya rgod 'ug pa ka ling ka — /dung can ma du ha la sogs/ / bya dang gcan gzan rtsal mthus za—/ /phag rgod ru ru ma te skyin/ /ro nyi ta dang glang po che/ /mdzo rgod g.yag rgod bse dang ni/ /byug 5 glang zhes grags ri dwags che/ /chur gnas ngang pa sa ra sa/ /chu skyar ka ran da bya bla / /rgya dang khrung khrung ngur pa dang //so bya ka tasba sogs yin/ /nya ro ha ti ba ti na/ /nya phyis rus 7sbal kum bi ra/ /kar ta dung sram sham+bu ka /nye ldang bar mi tsan ti ka /bu lu chu srin nag khra dang / /nya bo che ni byis pa gsod/ /ja ri tsi li 8 tsi ma stsogs/ /de ltar sha (ni brgyad du bshad/ /ra lug gzas kyi spyod yul ni/ /'dres pas rigs gcig nges ma yin/ /thog ma tha ma skam gsher gnas/ /bar ma gnyis po thun mong bshad/ /de las skam sa'i sha rtug 'gags/ /bsil ba dang ni yang ba yin/ /'dus pa mkhris pa shas che zhing / /rlung 'bring bad kan chung la phan / /ri bong sha ni drod skyed rtsub/ /zhu rjes tsha zhing 'khru gcod bsil/ /bar ta ki rkal sogs pa'i sha /cung zad sgrum dro rtelci rtas byed/ /de rnams las kyang rgya bya'i sha /yid gzhungs drod stobs khu ba 'phel/ /bshang skems mdog bzang rlung shas che/ /'dus pa sel ba'i dam pa yin/ /rma bya'i sha ni bzang min yang / /rna mig skad 'gags rgas srar dz+waphan/ /khyem bya de 'dra'i ro tsa la/ /grang gnas lci zhing bad kan skyed/ /gong mo u pa tsa krar bcas//yid gzhungs drod skyed yi gar 'ong / /thi ba zhar ba'i sha lci zhing / /tsha bro 1/7 /73

— — — — —— — — — nyes pa thams cad skyed/ /bye'u sha 1 bad kan skyed byung snum/ /rlung 'joms khu ba rab tu 'phel/ /sde tshan de las phyi ma rnams/ /rim bzhin lci dro snum zhing mngar/ /gcin mang ro tsa stobs skyed cing / /rlung 'joms bad kan mkhris pa skyed/ /de las ri dwags chen po bsil/ /rtsal mthus sha rlon za ba'i yang / /ro rjes lan tshwa bro zhu rjes/ /tsha zhing sha ni 'phel bar byed/ /gzhang 'brum rnying 2 pa pho ba grang / /skem /nad nyen la mchog tu phan/ /ra sha shin tu bsil min zhing / /lci sgrum ma yin nyes med yin/ /lus dang khams ni mnyam pas na/ /bad kan mi skyed lus rtas byed/ /lug sha de las bzlog pa ste/ /lus rtas yin par shes par bya/ /ba lang sha ni lud skam dang / /ngal dang tsho ches ma snyoms rims/ /cham pa dang ni skem pa dang / /rlung nad gcig pu na ba sel/ /ma te'i 5sha ni lci zhing tsha/ /gnyid che brtan byed shas cher skyed/ /phag rgod sha ni de 'dra zhing / /ngal sel zas len khu stobs skyed 7 / /nya ni mchog tu bad kan skyed/ /tsi li tsi ma nyes gsum skyed/ /la ba 8ro ha ti skyin gor9 / /sha ba rang rang sde tshan mchog /sha ni 'phral bsad pa dag dang / /dar la bab pa bsten par bya/ /rang shi rid dang shin tu tsho/ /nad chu dug gis shi ba spang / /pho dang mo yi stod smad phyed/ /lci ste sbrum ma thams cad lci//rkang bzhi mo yi yang ba yin/ /bya rnams kyi ni pho yi yang / /mgo bo ro stod brang dang rgyab/ /rked pa dpyi yi lci ba yin/ /de bzhin pho ba rgyu ma sogs/ /go rims bzhin du lci ba yin/ /khrag la sogs pa'i lus zungs rnams/ /phyi ma phyi ma 2lci ba yin/ /sha las rlig pa pho mtshan dang / /ma/khal ma mcher ba gzhang dag lci/ /sha'i sde tshan no// ///77 /74

tshod ma pa tha ①sha ti dang / /su sha su ni sha na dang / /sa tin dza ⑤rgya sne'u stsogs/ /nyes pa gsum 'joms rtug sri yang / /de las su ni sha na dro/ /ro ①tsa ra dza k+ṣa pa ti/ /pho ba gzhang 'brum nad sel mchog /rgya sde'u rtug skam 'joms pa yin/ /mon sne'u dhidame ru nyes gsum 'joms/ /mdze sel ro tsa bcud len dro/ /'khru ⑤zhing mgul pa snyan par byed/ / tsang gi ri sgyur me rjodrod skyed/ /pho ba gzhang 'brum bad kan rlung / /drod che 'khru gcod yang ba yin/ /pa to la dang sab ta la/ /nim pa shang ga sba ⑦sle tres/ /a pal gu za rtsa'i sgemyu gu/ /bri ha ti dang bā ⑨sha dang / /ti la par ṇi ⑩ku ta la/ /man ⑪du ka 'dab kar ko ⑫ta/ /ka ra be la par pa ta⑫/ /ṇa ti dang ni ka ta ya/ /go dzi ha dang bar da ④ka /ba na tig ta ⑫ka ri ram/ /ku li ka dang nan ti ⑩dang / /ku tsel shag ku na da ni/ /ka ti la dang ke'u ⑩kam/ /sho ⑫tam ko sha ta ka dang / /kar sha 'jam bsil kha zhing tsha/ /bshang sri rlung skyed bad mkhris sel/ /pa to la zhim srin nad sel/ /zhu rjes mngar zhing yi ga 'byed/ /bri ha ti ⑪gnyis mkhris skyed 'khru/ /drod skyed rlung ni 'joms pa yin—/ /bri shan rlung ⑫dang lud pa 'joms/ /khrag mkhris sel ba'i dam pa yin / /ka ra bel la ⑥kha ba dang / /drod skyed bad kan sel mchog yin/ / bar ta ⑫ka ro kha zhing tsha/ /mngar dro ⑫bad kan rlung dag sel/ /lan tshwar bcas pa me drod skyed/ /yid 'ong zas len mkhris mi skyed/ /ka ri ra ④ni sbos byed cing / /ro bska ⑫mngar zhing kha ba yin/ /ko sha ta ka ⑫bal gu za/ /'khru rnguzhing drod ni skyed byed yin/ /tan du li bsil rtsub pa dang / /ro 111—175

mngar zhu rjes mngar zhing yang / /chang nad mkhris nad dug khrag sel/ / mun dza ①las byung rlung mkhris sel/ /snum bsil ②lci zhing mngar ba dang / /lus rtas khu ba 'phel ba'i mchog /pa lag kya ①lci 'khru bar byed/ / u po ④da ka chang nad 'joms/ /tsu tsu pa lag kya ⑤'dra las/ /de ni 'khru gcod bdag nyid can/ /bi da ri ni rlung mkhris sel/ /gcin mang mngar zhing bsil ba yin—/ /'tsho bar byed cing sgog nad sel/ /lus brta rjoro tsa lci bcud len/ /dzi ⑦ban ti mngar bsil ba dang / /mig la phan zhing nyes gsum sel/ /ku sman da ⑧bum sha ka ling / /kar ka dang ni er ba ru/ /da na dis zhes bya ba dang / da na dis dang ga gon dang / /tsin ta ka dang tsir bi ta/ /bad rlung skyed cing 'khru gcin mang / /bshang sri byu zhing zhu rjes mngar/ /'khri shing 'bras bu'i ⑨nang na mchog /ku sman da ste rlung mkhris sel/ /gcin nad sel zhing ro tsar byed/ /ga gon shin tu gcin mang zhing ⑩/ /ku ba shin tu rtsub pa yin/ /ka ling ka tho7dang er ba ru/ /tsir bi mkhregs gzhon ⑫mkhris sel bsil/ /smin pa de las gzhan du byed/ /'bras bu rnying lung lan tshwar ⑫bcas/ /mkhris skyed bad kan rlung nad sel/ /yi ga 'bye zhing dro yid 'ong / /hen langs lto lbos ④sel zhing yang / /pad rtsa rtsa ba ut+pal rtsa⑫/ /ku mu ut+pal chu ba dang / /chus pa sha ⑩lu ka ta dang / / sring ga dang ga ⑩sha ru ka /kron dza ⑫da na ka lo da⑪/ /rtsub cing bshang sri bsil zhing lci/ /ka lam pa dang na li ka /mar she zhes ni bya ba dang / /ku ti na dza ra ku ⑪kha/ /seng phrom yungs ma lo ni ka /ka ru da ka ga pe du/ /'tsho byed dang ni dzun dzu ⑪dang / /e da ga dza dag dang ni/ /ya ba sha ka lcam pa dang / /a lu ka 111—176

stsogs thams cad dang / /sran ①lo shing mngar lo ma dang sde/ /mngar zhing rtsub la lan tshwa bro/ /bad kan rlung skyed lci ba dang / /bsil zhing bshang byu 'byung sla byed/ /phal cher zhu nas bshang snegaci mkhregs/ /tshos shing khu ba legs babyung la/ /mar cher btab pa nyes mi skyed/ /seng phrom 'dab ma zhes bya gang / /de ni rgya sne'u dang 'drar 'dod/ /tar ka ri ba ra na mngar/ /kha bcas rlung dang bad kan sel/ /pur+ṇa ④rnam gnyis ka la sha /cung zad tsha bro kha zhing tsha/ /drod skyed khong 'khru sbyar dug dang / /'or nad bad kan rlung nad 'joms/ /tsi bi ra yi ⑤myu gu ni/ /drod skyed rlung dang bad sel 'khru—/ /nye'u rjoshing myu gu kha ba ste/ /ro tsa nyes ④gsum sel ba sgeyin/ /sbyig ⑨ma'i myu gu rtsub pa dang / /khong tsha rlung dang mkhris pa skyed/ /ba ru ⑩ra ni drod skyed kha/ /mcher pa gzhang 'brum bad rlung sel/ /ka sa mar da srin ⑪lud pa/ /bad kan sel zhing zhu byed 'khru/ /le brgan rtsi tshod rtsub skyur tsha/ /phyi zhing mkhris pa skyed la 'khru/ /yungs kar tshod ma lci zhing tsha/ /bshang dang lci 'gags nyes kun skyed/ /la phug gzhon nu ro mi gsal/ /cung zad tsha bro kha dang bcas/ /gang yin de ni nyes kun sel/ /yang zhing cung zad tsha ba dang / /skran dang lud gcong dbugs mi bde/ /rma dang mig nad skog nad sel| /skad 'gags drod chung rtug skam dang / /cham pa'i nad ni 'joms pa yin/ /nar son ro dang zhu rjes tsha/ /drod skyed byed cing nyes gsum skyed/ /bad kan skyed byu btsos pa ni/ /snum zhing de yang rlung sel yin/ /skam po rlung dang bad kan sel/ /rjen pa thams cad nyes skyed yin/ /yungs ⑫ma tsha zhing dro ba dang / /bad kan rlung sel mkhris pa skyed/ /shan ta spru la mkhris 111—177

sel zhing / /bsil zhing zhu rjes mngar ba dang / /ro mngar kha zhing bska ba ste/ /bad kan dug kyang sel bar bshad/ /ku ①the ra bye'u rug shi kru②/ /su mu kha dang ske tshe dang / /bu sri na dang pha ni dza/ /zin be+eg gale dang dzam bi ra/ /de la stsogs pa'i ldum rnams ni/ /bshang rjogaci sra zhing me drod skyed/ /khong pa tsha byed kha rtsub tsha/ /yid 'ang lus ⑤dro yi ga 'byerjo/ /mig gnod khu ba srin 'joms rno/ /skrang par byed dang yang ba yin/ /bye rug skyigs lud ⑦dbugs mi bde—/ /rtsib logs zug dug kha mnam ⑧sel/ /su mu kha ni rab tsha min/ /sbyar dug 'or nad sel ba yin/ /'u su'i lo ma kha zhing mngar/ /gcin mang mkhris pa skyed ma yin/ /sgog skya rab tu tsha zhing rno/ /zhu rjes tsha zhing 'khru ba dang / /zhim zhing skra skyed lci ro tsha⑨/ /snum zhing drod skyed yi ga 'bye⑩/ /sha bkra mdze skran gzhang 'brum dang / /gcin nad srin dang bad kan rlung / /skyigs bu cham pa ⑪dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa sel te khrag mkhris skyed/ /kun dong de las yon tan dman/ /bad kan skyed mkhris rab mi skyed/ /ke'u btsos dug sbyar zos ⑫pa yis/ /bad kan rlung dang gzhang 'brum sel/ /rno zhing rtug ⑫pa sri ba dang / /de ni mkhris can la phan min⑩/ /su ra drod skyed kha zas len/ /bad sel dri ma sbyong zhing yang / /mchog tu gzhang 'brum dag la phan/ /sbang phrum shin tu nyes skyed yin/ /me tog 'dab ma 'bras yal ga /sdong bu rim bzhin lci ba yin/ /tshod ma'i rab mchog 'tsho byed yin/ /yungs kar tshod ma tha chad ⑫yin/ /tshod rngad rnams kyi sde tshan no// //rgun 'brum 'bras bu'i mchog yin te/ /ro tsa mig sman bshang gci sla/ /111—178

mngar zhing zhu rjes snum pa dang / /cung zad bska zhing bsil la lci/ /rlung dang khrag mkhris sel byed cing / /kha nang kha bro chang nad dang / /skom lud tshad rims dbugs mi bde/ /skad 'dzer glo rdol ①glo gcong sel/ /bal po se'u mngar ③mkhris rgyas dang / /nyes pa gsum po sel ba yin/ /skyur ba mkhris skyed min cung dro/ /rlung dang bad kan 'joms par byed/ /se'u kun kyang yid 'ong snum/ /yang zhing bshang sra drod zas len/ /mo tsha 'bra go pa na sa—/ /rgya star pa ru sha ka dang / /a mra ta la kasma 'bras/ /ra dza da na ma du'i 'bras/ /rgya shug so bi ra ang kol/ / phal ku sles ④ma ta'i 'bras bu/ /ta mal bi ④shu star ga'i 'bras/ /myu gu la dang rgya kham dang / /a ru ma na pi yal 'bras/ /rtas byed lci zhing bsel ba yin/ /lus tsha glo rdol ⑤glo gcong selaske/ /khrag dang mkhris pa snyoms par byed/ /zhu rjes mngar zhing snum pa dang / /bshang lci bad kan khu ba 'phel/ /ta la'i 'bras bu mkhris skyed 'khru/ /kasma rgya 'bras bsil rjob dang / /bshang lci ⑦'gags pa sel byed cing / /skra byed ⑧yid gzhungs bcud len 'gyur/ /pa ta ma stsogs dro ba dang / /bad kan mkhris pa skyed byed ⑨'khru/ /snum zhing mchog tu rlung skyed byed/ /pi la ⑩ya'i 'bras tsha ba min/ /pi la ⑪ya yi tshi ⑫gu mngar/ /ro tsa mkhris pa rlung nad sel—/ /rgya shug ⑫tshi gu'i yon tan ni/ /de 'dra skam slon ④lud pa sel/ /bil 'bras smin pa 'ju dka' zhing / /nyes skyed 'phyen ni dri nga ⑫byed/ /ma smin drod skyed bad rlung sel/ /de dag gnyis ka 'khru ba gcod/ /ma smin ka pid mgul nad dang / /nyes pa kun skyed smin pa ni/ /nyes 'joms skyigs bu slon bro sel/ /kun kyang 'khru gcod dug 'joms yin/ /'dzam bu'i shing 111—179

tog bshang gci sri①/ /bsil zhing shin tu rlung skyed yin/ /bshang dang lci ba gcod byed cing / /skog ma la gnod bad mkhris sel/ /a mra'i 'bras bu ma smin rlung / /khrag mkhris skyed byed rus chags ④pa/ /bad kan mkhris skyed min ①rlung skyed/ /phyi mngar bad kan khu ba 'phel/ /thrak+ṣa abe+e rtsub bshang sri//byu tsha bad kan rlung dag 'joms/ /sha mya tsha lci skra gnod rtsub/ /pi lu'i 'bras bu mkhris pa skyed/ /bad kan rlung nad sel zhing 'khru/ /mcher pa gzhang 'brum skran srin sel/ /bi lu mngar zhing kha ba gang / /shin tu tsha min nyes gsum 'joms/ /ba lu shun kha tsha zhing snum/ /rlung nad sel bar byed pa yin/ /ba lung 'bras shas ༷rtas byed mngar/ /rlung dang mkhris pa sel zhing lci/ /de yis ⑤rkang yang skyigs lud pa/ /dbugs mi bde dang chang nad sel—/ /kha skam rlung dang bad kan dang / /rtug sra skyugs rjobro yi ga 'chus/ /skran ⑦dang gzhang 'brum gzer nad dang / /me drod chung ba nyid sel to/ /na rang ⑧ga 'bras mngar cung skyur/ /yi gar 'ong zhing kha zas len/ /lci zhing rlung ni rab skyed pa'i/ /yon tan ldan par shes par bya/ /bse shing 'bras bu'i shun pa sha /khong ⑨rtas byed cing mngar la bsil/ /de'i ⑩rus me mnyam yid gzhungs byed/ /bad kan rlung ni sel ba'i mchog /ku shu rnam gnyis lci ba ste/ /mngar skyur bsil dang tsha ba yin/ /yi ga 'bye zhing me rab 'bri/ /kham sha yi ga 'byed sbung mngar/ /smin ⑪pa myur du 'ju bar 'gyur/ /shin tu tsha min lci nyes skyed/ /rgun 'brum pa ru sha ka dang / /ka ra mar dang btsos ⑫rlon skyur/ /mkhris pa bad kan skyed cing 'khru/ /byu zhing nus tsha rlung 'joms so / /rgya shug skyur thung li gu tshe/ /a mra ka ta de bzhin no/ /e ra ba ti tu 111—180

da ①dang / /mri ka lin da dzam bir bcas/ /smin dang ka ra yar ta ②skam//mkhris pa shin tu skyed byed min/ /am+bi ka dang rgya shug skyur/ /skam po drod skyed 'khru ba dang / /skom dang ngal dang rmya ba sel/ /yang zhing rlung dang bad kan 'joms/ /de las 'bras bu kun tha chad/ /li gu tsi ④ste nad kun slong / /kha ba me dang rlung gnod nyen/ /sbrul gyi kha chu stsogs pas phog /srin bus zos dang chu nang rtsang / /sa ngan dus min skyes dhipa dang / /'bru gzhan 'dres zhing mthu nyams dang / /shin tu rnying 'gyur ⑤'bru spang bya/ /tshod ma'ang de bzhin rtsub par ni/ /g.yos pa dag dang mi snyi rjodang / /ro ni smin par ma gyur dang / /la phug ma gtogs ⑦skam po dang / /'bras bu'ang phal cher de bzhin te/ /bil ba ma gtogs ⑧rlon pa spang / /'bras bu'i sde tshan no// //lan tshwa kun kyang bad kan skyed/ /phra ⑨zhing bshang gci 'byin la 'jam/ /rlung 'joms 'ju byed tsha zhing rno/ /yi ga 'bye zhing bad mkhris skyed/ /de la lce myang tsha mngar bcas/ /ro tsa yid 'ong nyes gsum sel/ /yang zhing tsha la mig la phan/ /tsha ba mi skyed ⑩me drod skyed/ / rtsal ru tsha ⑪yang yid 'ong zhing //sgregs ⑫pa sbyong zhing dri zhim la/ /zhu rjes tsha zhing bshang sri ⑫sel/ /drod skyed ④yi ga 'byed byed yin/ /kha ru tsha ni stod bad kan/ /smad kyi rlung ske'abyin drod skyed la/ /bshang 'gags ⑩lto sgos rtug skam dang / /gzer zug lus lci sel ⑩ba yin/ /rgya mtsho'i lan tshwa zhu rjes mngar/ /lci zhing bad kan rnam 'phel byed/ /bkod ma'i tsha ni ⑫cung zad kha/ /tsha dang ba tsha rdo byed gsher/ /117—181

kha ru tsha nag yon tan dri/ /ma gtogs yon tan bi dar ①mtshungs/ /mtsho tsha yang ste sa skam tsha/ /bad kan skyed cing 'ju dka' lci/ /lan tshwa rnams kyi sbyor ba la/ /rgyam tsha zhul sogs rab tu sbyar/ /nas tshig 'khus pa'i lan tshwa ni/ /skran dang snying nad skya rbab dang / /pho ba mcher pa shog nad dang / /lud pa gzhang 'brum dbugs mi bde/ /lto sbos bad kan sel ba yin/ /swa ①rji ka sogs thal tsha kun/ /rab rno tsha zhing srin sel yang / /khrag mkhris skyed byed smin byed la/ /gcod cing mi zhim rnam par 'byed④/ /nas tshig 'khus glutsha kha bas na/ /mdog mdangs khu ba skra mig gnod/ /shing kun rlung dang bad kan sel / /gzer 'joms mkhris pa skyed byed de/ /zhu rjes ro tsha spyoyi ga 'byed/ /drod skyed zas 'ju yang ba yin/ /a ru ra bska zhu rjes mngar/ /rtsub cing lan bo'i ro med yang / /drod che zas 'ju yid gzhungs byed/ /na tshod la 'jog dam pa yin/ /dro zhing 'khru la tshe la phan/ /blo dang dbang gsal stobs rab skyed/ /mdze dang bzhin lus mdog mi sdug /skad 'gags rims rnying mi bzad rims/ /glad kyepa mig nad skya rbab dang / /mig ser pho ba'i nad rnams dang / /skem bcas 'or dang gcin nad sel/ /tshad 'khru rmongs bag myos slon nya srin/ /mchil mang kye lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /gzhang 'brum mcher pa lto sbos dug /gsum tshu'aphel rgyun 'gags skran dang ni/ /da rgan na dang yi ga 'chus/ /rlung dang bad kan las gyur nad/ /de dang de ni sel byed yin/ /skyu ru ra yang de 'dra bsil/ /ro skyur bad mkhris sel de ⑪las—/ /yon tan cung dman ba ru ra/ /zhu rjes tsha mngar skra mig phan/ /'bras bu gsum po 'di dag ni/ /bcud kyis len mchog mig nad sel/ /rma 111—182

'tsho pags nad rma red dang / /tshil ches gcin ①snyi bad khrag sel/ /shing tsha sug smel bha dra 1gsum/ /ge sar bcas pa dri bzang bzhi/ /na le sham ni mkhris skyed rno/ /rtsub cing drod skyed yi ga 'byed/ /ro dang zhu rjes dag kyang tsha—/ /bad kan 'joms shing yang ba yin/ /pi pi ling rlon ⑦ bang skyed mngar—/ /bsil zhing lci la snum pa yin/ /skam po de las bzlog pa yin/ /snum zhing ro tsa ro tsha la/ /zhu rjes mngar zhing bad rlung dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde sel 'khru/ /de gnyis bcud len ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan las shas cher sbyar mi bya/ /dong gra drod skyed ro tsa dang / /'khru gcod yid 'ong mkhregs ④pa sel/ /yi ga 'bye yang zhu rjes mngar/ /khong snum drod che bad rlung sel/ /sge'u gsher de 'dra de dag ni/ /tsha ba gsum ste sha spom dang / /me drod nyams dang dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa rkang bam cham 'upa 'joms /dbyi mo ⑥pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /nal sham yon tan cung zad chung / /tsi tra ka stobs me dang mnyam/ /'or nad gzhang 'brum srin mdze sel/ /'di rnams las ni na le sham/ /ma gtogs tsha ba lnga zhes bshad/ / skran chen 0dmu sprung lto sbos dang / /gzer 'joms drod ni skyed pa'i mchog /bil ba kathra ⑤tar ka ri/ /ba ta la dang dun du c-i7ka /rtsa chen lnga po bska kha dro/ /rlung dang bad kan sel byed yin/ /ang shu ma ti bri ha ti'u / /gnyis gnyis gze rtsa chung ⑪lngar bshad/ /zhu rjes ro mngar ha cang ni/ /bsil /che dang tsha min nyes kun sel/ /ba la pur+ṇa 7 e raṇ+ḍa/ /su pya paṇ+ḍi rnam ⑫gnyis rtsa/ /'bring yin bad kan rlung 'joms yin/ /shin tu mkhris pa mi skyed 'khru/ /nye'u shing ka ko la ma'atsho byed/ /dzi ⑫ba ka dang ri shar bshad/ /'tsho byed ces bya mig 111—183

—la phan/ /ro tsa rlung dang mkhris pa sel/ /'jag ma ku sha 'bras bur yo)shing / /'dam rtsa rtsar bshad lnga mkhris sel/ /gra 2ma gang bu g.yos sbyar zas/ /sha dang tshod ma shing tog zhe sman/ /zas cha cung zad tshan gdus 4)'di/ /rtag tu dgos pa yod pa 5 smra/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/mdo'i gnas kyi le'u drug pa'o// //de nas kha zas bsrung ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /rgyal po'i ( kepho brang nye 'khor du/ /srog 'tsho'i (3slob dpon gzhag (1par bya/ /de ltar byas pas thams cad du/ /thams cad las ni bsrung bar 'gyur/ /khyad par du ni sa bdag gi/ /zas skom dug las bsrung bar bya/ /chos la stsogs dang gang 'brel pa'i/ /'byor ba de de ⑨la rag las so/ /'bras chan dug bcas gsher // bag kyang / /skam bag can ni 'dra bar 'gyur/ /yun ring tshos par gyur pa dang / /tshos pa'ang zhag lon lta bur 'gyur/ /rlangs pa rma bya'i mgrin 'dra zhing / /khong myos brgyal dang lus rngul skyed/ /dri dang mdog stsogs nyams par 'gyur/ /rul zhing rma bya'i sgo ltar 'tsher6spe/ /tshod ma myur du skams 1spepa dang / /bskol ba'i mdog ni gnag khyana'agyur zhing / /der gzugs chung ba'am che ba 'am/ /mi sdug pa 'am mi snang 'gyur/ /dbu ba steng 'byung ri mo mtshams/ / /kha chu 'dra dang chu bur 'byung / /btung ba mngar sgyur tshod ma dang / /sha dag mtshams bye ro dang bral/ /sha khu'i lo ri mo sngor snang zhing / /'o ma zangs mdog zho dri ma/ /dar ba la ni ser dang gnag/mar khu chu dang 'dra bar snang / /chang dang chu rnag sbrang rtsi la/ /ljang snang til 7/7 /84

mar dag la dmar/ /shing tog ma smin smin par ①snang / /smin pa dag ni yongs su 'drul/ /kha zas zlon dang skam ②pa dag /rnyings shing mdog ni nyams par 'gyur/ /snyi ba dang ni sra ba dag /reg pa ①go ni bzlog par 'gyuraske/ /me tog phreng rtse lo ma gsarjo/ /rnyid cing dri ni mi zhim 'gyur/ /gos la nag po tal til dang / /spu rnams 'thul zhing kha tshar 'chad/ /gser dngul mu tig shing dang rdo/ /rin chen stsogs la dri ma chags/ /gzi mdangs reg pa 'od nyams 'gyur/ /sa yi snod ⑤ni mdog bcas byed/ /dug ster kha ni sngo bskams la/ /gnong bag gis ni phyogs su blta/ /rngul zhing 'dar la skrag pa dang / /'jigs shing 'gros 'khyor dhiglal bar 'gyur/ /dug ldan zas ni mes bsregs na/ /me lce gcig 'khyil me stag rgal⑦/ /du ba rma bya'i mgrin 'drar 'gyur/ /me lce mi 'bar 'bar yang mnan/ /sbrang mas zos na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bya rog gis zos skad zhan 'gyur/ /'di ni ne+e tso da ru ha/ /ri skegs kyis mthong ca co 'byin/ /ngang pas zos na rdeg 'chos la/ /shang shang te'u na bar 'gyur/ /sreg pa mig ni mi chags byed/ /khrung khrung dag ni 'dzur bar 'gyur/ /phug ⑧ron khu byug bya gag dang / /ngur pas zos na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /byi la skyo zhing 'dor bar 'gyur/ /spre'u mi gtsang 'dor bar byed/ /rma byas de mthong dga' bar byed/ /dug gi dbal ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de ltar zas ni dug ldan par/ /shes shing ci nas de yi ni/ /srog chags phra mo yan chad la/ /gnod par 'gyur bas ⑨'bad de dor / /reg na tsha zhing g.ya' la na/ /rims 'debs 'brum 'byung tshor ba chung ⑩/ /sen mo spu 'byung lus skrangs te⑪/ /de la dug ni rnam 'jig pa'i/ /111—185

—tsan+dan shug pa pu shel tsi1/ /so ma'i shun bcas bal bu'i 'dab/ /ru rta sle tres a ka ru'i/ /chus bkrus blugs shing bsku bar bya/ /khar chud na ni mchil snabs snyemang / /lce mchu sprid cing be+em por byed/ /lus tsha na zhing so brtse /la/ / ro mi petshor zhing 'gram so 'thams/pe/ /de la dug kun 'joms sman dang / / ur shi stsogs khus mkhur ( )bkang dbo/ /ma zhu'i gnas 'bab larngul ba dang / /brgyal zhing lto sbos myos mgo 'khor/ /ba spu ldang zhing skyug lus tsha/ /mig mi gsal zhing snying mi dran/ /yan lag thig les khyab par 'gyur—/ /zhu ba'i gnas su phyin na yang / /kha dog sna tshogs skyug pa dang / /gcin mang rab tu 'khru bar 'gyur/ /rmya snyom kyeskem zhing mdog skya la/ /gsus pa che zhing nyams stobs zad/ /de gnyis slon dang khrus byas nas/ /ser gnyis bu ram gir kar ni/ /san+d+ra ⑨ba ri nis pa ba/ /ba shi ka dang tshigs brgya pa/ /tan du li ya'i rtsa ba dang / /bya gag sgo nga bal ku za⑫/ /snar gtang mig sman blud /14/bya ba/ /dug zhi'i phyir ni sbyar bar bya/ /dug 'thungs pa mdag steng dang ni/ /de bzhin 'og ni sbyangs gyur nas/ /dus su zangs bzang bdar phye ma/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa snying spyong sbyin/ /snying nad sbyangs nas gser phye ni/ /zhib mo zho phyed sbyin byas na/ /pad+ma'i 'dab mar chu bzhin du/ /gser gyis 4geyan lag la mi chags/ /tshe yang ring du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sbyar dug la yang cho ga 'di'o/ /kha zas dag kyang mi mthun zos//sbyar dug 'dra bar shes par bya/ /rlan can sha dang mon sran gre'uyi/ /sbrang rtsi 'o ma myu gu can/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba la phug gam/ /bu ram dang bcas mi 'phrod yin—/ /khyad par du ni 'o ma nya/ /nya rnams las kyang tsi li tsis7 'o ma 177 186

lhan cig skyur kun ni①/ /mi 'phrod shing tog de bzhin no/ /de bzhin rgya sran khre dag dang / /ba la ku mu ta ②mi 'phrod/ /la phug la stsogs sngo ①rngad ni/ /zos nas 'o ma spang bar bya/ /phag rgod byi dur sha mi bza'/ /khyim bya bri sha ta zhor min/ /sha rlon mkhris pa dag dang ni/ /la phug ma sha'i ④tshod mar min| /le brgan tsi ⑤tshod lug shar dhimin/ /myu gu'i tshod ma pad rtsar ⑦min// ma sha'i ⑧sran tshod bu ram zho/ /mar 'o li gu rtse'i 'bras min/ /chu shing ⑨'bras bu dar bar min/ /ta ⑩la'i 'bras bu zhor mi 'phrod/ /tsha ba gnyis po bu ram ⑪dang / /sbrang rtsi ka ka ma cir ⑫min/ /de ni nya btsos pa'i snod dang //dong gra btsos par g.yos pa min/ /ka ma ta ni snod gzhan du/ /btsos nas nyin mtshan lon mi bza'/ /nya brngos ⑫pa yi snum la ⑫ni/ /pi pi ling brngos spang bar bya/ /mar sar khar ⑫snod zhag bcu lon/ /go bye'i 'bras bu dror mi bza'⑫/ /ba sa bsregs spyoshar mi 'phrod cing / /dar bar kam pi la btsos min/ /'o thug dang ni kri sa ra/ /chang dang lhan cig mi 'phrod spang / /sbrang rtsir ⑫mar sar zhag til mar/ /chu rnams gnyis gnyis gsum gsum mam/ /cha mnyam lhan sbug zos pa dag /phan tshun dag ni mi mthun no/ /mar sbrang cha ni mi mnyam yang / /char pa'i chu ni 'thungs na gnod/ /sbrang rtsi pad+ma'i sa bon dang / /sbrang rtsi 'bru chang kha rar min/ /'o thug rjes la skyo mar min/ /sha mo yungs mar ⑪brngos mi 'phrod/ /u po ta ka til tshigs la/ /btsos pa 'khru bar byed pa yin/ /bya gag sha ni chang dwangs dang / /kul ma sha yi thug mi 'phrod/ /de nyid phag rgod tshil la brngos/ /srog ni 'phral du 'joms par byed—/ /de bzhin sreg pa rma bya dang / /la ba ka pin dza ⑥la sram/ /e raṇ+ḍa 111—187

yi me la ni/ /e raṇ+ḍa ①mar brngos mi 'phrod/ /ha rid ④tra sha skyer pa yi/ /thur ma dag la bskyon ①nas ni/ /skyer pa'i me la bsregs gyur pa/ /'phral du srog ni 'joms par byed/ /de nyid thal ba rdul gyis gos/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'phrod ma yin/ /gang yang ④nyes pa ma sbyangs pa/ /mdor na de ni mi 'phrod yin/ /nyes 'di sbyang bar ⑤'dod pa'am/ /yang na de dang mi mthun pa'i / /rdzas de nyid kyis dang po ni/ /lus ni mngon par sbyang bar bya/ /rtsol can snum bsten drod che dang / /dar la bab cing nyams stobs ldan/ /goms par zos dang cung zad zos/ /mi 'phrod gyur rjokyang gnod mi 'gyur/ /mi 'phrod cha yis goms bya'am⑦/ /cha yis cha yis yongs su spang / /phan pa'ang de bzhin bsten bya ste/ /'di dag ⑧gnyis gsum gyis chod ⑨bya/ /skyon ni rim gyis 'grib pa dang / /yon tan rim gyis 'phel 'gyur na/ /slar skye bar ni mi 'gyur zhing / /g.yo ba med pa dag tu 'gyur/ /mi 'phrod pa yang spangs gyur zhing / /'phrod pa goms par gyur pa nyid/ /'phral du spangs dang ma bsten las/ /nyes pa rnams ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnod pa gnod bya'i bdag nyid can/ /shin tu nyes par ⑩gyur pa la/ /phan med gnod par byed pa ni/ /mkhas pas phyir zhing bya mi rigs/ /zas dang mal stan 'dod la spyod/ /ran zhing rigs par sbyar ba ⑪yis/ /khang khyim 'chos pa lta bur ni//rtag tu lus ni gzung bar bya/ /de la zas ni bshad zin zhing / /de dang der ni bshad par bya/ /bde sdug sgom skem spyostobs che chung / /bud med la phod mi phod ⑫dang / /shes dang mi shes 'tsho dang 'chi/ /gnyid la rag ni lus pa yin—/ /dus min ha cang thal ches dang / /gnyid ni kun tu 'gegs ⑫pa 111—188

dag /bde dang tshe ni nyams byed de/ /dus mtshan yoganyis pa lta bu yin/ /mtshan mo gnyid ni ma log rtsub/ /nyin mo gnyid log snum phyir 'gyur/ /tsog pur 'dug ste yur ba dag /mig rtsub bad kan med par 'gyur/ /so ga rlung 'phel stobs 'phrog dus/ /rtsub cing mtshan mo thung bas na/ /nyin par gnyid phan gzhan dag tu/ /de ni bad kan mkhris pa skyed/ /smra mang bzhon ②dang lam kyis dub/ /ra ro bud med bsten khur las/ /khros ④dang mya ngan 'jigs pepas dub/ /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde tshad 'khru/ /rgan dang byis pa nyams stobs zad/ /glo rdol rngo skem dang gzer kyis gnod/ /zas ma zhu dang bcom dang smyo⑦/ /nyin par gnyid log rigs ma gtogs/ /'di dag de bzhin lus zungs snyoms/ /bad kan skyes shing lus brtas gyura'/ /tshil che 9bad kan mang dang sgrum/ /rtag za nyin par gnyid ma log /dug gis ⑩phog dang lkog nad can/ /mtshan mo nam yang gnyid ma log /dus min gnyid log rmongs bag dang / /rims skyed rmugs shing cham pas 'debs/ /mgo na skrang zhing tu1/slon sgyid skyur/ /rtsa yi rgyun 'gags 7me drod nyams/ /de la bsnyung ⑫dang slon sman dang / /rngul 'byung skesna sman btang ba dang ske/ /gnyid ches gyur la skyug sman rno/ /mig sman rno dang sna sman dang / /smyung ⑩ba sel las /nabud med bsten/ /mya ngan 'jigs dang khros pa (shesbyar/ /'di dag nyid kyis gnyid drags pa(/na/ /'jig cing bad kan rab zad byed/ /gnyid ྾yar pa yis yan lag snyoms/ /klad pa lci zhing glal spe'ong la/ /mi gsal na zhing mgo 'khor la/ /zas mi 'ju rmya rlung skyed ( gend/ /de bas mtshan mo dus bzhin du/ /ci bder gnyid ni log par bya/ /ma goms gnyid 177 — 189

—byedabyed—byed—— — —— ——— ———— ——— — — —— — — ———— — —kyis ma log na/ /nang par ma zos phyed gnyid log /gnyid yar gyur na 'o ma dang / /chang dang sha khu zho rnams btung / /lus bsku dril dang khrus bya zhing //mgo bsku rna ba mig dag 1bya/ /na chung lag ngar gyis 'khyud dang / /sems bde bya ba zin pa dang / /yid dang rjes mthun yul ldan pa/ /ci 'dod gnyid 'ong bde bar skyed/ /nyal po'i bde la sems ma chags/ /tshangs par spyod pa la dga' ba/ /chog shes pa yis mgu ba'i gnyid/ /rang gi dus las 'da' mi byed/ /nyal po'i chos ni spang bya ba/ /bkan min zla mtshan ldan pa dang / /yid du mi 'ong mi sdug spyod/ /mngal ni skyon gyis khyab pa dang / /rab sbom skem dang btsas pa dang / /sbrum ma gzhan gyi /5bud med dang / /rigs gzhan skye gnas mi mthun dang / /bla ma lha dang rgyal po'i gnas/ /mchod rten dur khrod gsod gnas dang / /bste sa lam gyi bzhi mdo chusnye/ /dus tshigs nyin mo yan lag min/ /snying ga mgo bor brdeg spang bya/ / /'grangs ches ltogs dang stan (snyebral dang / /yan lag mi bder gnas dang skom//byis pa rgan dang shugs gzhan nyen/ /nad pa yis kyang 'khrig pa spang / /dgun dus ro tsa byas drags — tshe/ /'dod pas 'dod pa bsten par bya/ /dpyid ston zhag ni gnyis gnyis nas/ /so ga dbyar tshe zla phyed cing / /gzhan du bud med la zhugs na8/ /mgo 'khor ngal dang bla mthu nyams/ /stobs dang lus zungs (/dbang po nyams/ /dus min 'chi bar byed pa yin/ /bud med dag la legs gdams na/ /dran dang yid gzhungs nad med tshe/ /dbang po rtas shing grags 11stobs rnams/ /lhag par 'phel zhing rgas srar 'gyur / /khrus dang byug pa rlung bsil kha ra la sogs bza'/ /chu bsil 'o 771 190

ma sha khu sran tshod chang dwangs 'thungs①/ /nyal po dga' byas 'dod dang bral gyur rjes la bsten⑤/ /de 'dras de yi lus mdangs stobs slar skye bar 'gyur/ /sman pa thos spyod phun tshogs ldan zhing las mkhas snying rje can/ /gags ①dang gnod med lus srung byed pa nye bar bzhag byas nas/ /rgyal po rjorang gi dge ba'i 'bras bu'i longs spyod bder spyod cing / /nad med mthu dang gzi brjid grags pa yun ring 'phel bar 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa lasaske/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bdun pa'o// //de nas kha zas kyi tshod ⑤ran par bza' ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /dus kun du ni tshod zin bza'/ /de ni me drod skyed byed yin/ /rdzas ni lci ba'am yang ba'ang rung / /chad la ltos par bya ba yin/ /phyi ba las ni phyed 'grangs bya/ /yang ba las ni rab 'grangs min/ /bde blag 'ju ba de tsam la//tshod zin zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zas rjotshod ma zin chung gyur ⑦na/ /stobs dang gzi mdangs 'phel mi 'gyur/ /rlung gi nad ni thams cad kyi⑤/ /rgyu nyid du ni 'gyur ba yin/ /tshad las shin tu ches pa yang / /nyes pa thams cad myur du skyed/ /ma zhu'i zas ni mi bzad pa/ /de yis rlung stsogs gzir gyur pas/ /cig car rnam par 'khrugs ⑨'gyur zhing / /de nyid du ni zhugs gyur ⑩nas/ /rtsa sgo 'gags shing be snabs skyed/ /steng dang 'og gi lam dag tu—/ /bskyod pas gsud cing zug byed pa/ /brkam chags can la 'phral skyed byed/ /de las ⑪rlung las gzer mgo 'khor/ /khong sbos 'dar zhing rengs stsogs 'gyur/ /mkhris pa las ni 'khru rims 'debs/ /khong tsha skom 111—191

zhing kha stsogs 'gyur/ /bad kan slon ①zhing yan lag lci/ /tshigs thog mchil ma mang bar 'gyur/ /khyad par du ni nyam ④chung zhing / /me drod zhan dang shugs bkag ④pa'i/ /zas ni rlung gis bkag pa dang / /bad kan gyis ni bar (9bkag pa'i/ /nyes pa be+e'u gesnabs dkrugs (mapas na/ /zug rngu zug pa lta bur gnas/ /'khru dang slon par mi byed parashe/ /gzer la sogs pa mi bzad pa/ /be'u snabs de yin nyes rab gdug(7 /be snabs mi bzad kyis sbubs bkag /rtsib logs kun tu drang por 'gro/ /shing bzhin rengs par 'gyur ⑩na ni/ /ma zhu shing 'dra zhes bya ste/ /myur du gsod byed de spang bya—/ /mi 'phrod lhag za ma zhu bar/ /zad ⑪byed ma zhu dug gi ni/ /mtshan nyid can de mi bzad pa/ /dug gi ming can gang yin te/ /dug gi tshul can myur gsod byed/ /gso dpyad bya bar dka' bas spang / /de nas ma zhu'i be'u snabs 'gyur7/ /gsor rung shu dag rgyam tsha dang / /po son cha bcug chu dron ni/ / 'thung bas skyugs ⑩/ bcug de nas ni/ /dug ⑨dang mas gtong skereng bu dag /dri ma rlung dag legs rgyu sbyar/ /yan lag 'khums par gyur pa la/ /shin tu dugs bya dkri labar bya/ /gsud nad shin tu 'phel ba dang 7 //rting par me btsa' gdab pa bsngags/ /de ni de'i nyin smyung bar gzhagaspyoshe /khrus btang lta bur nye bar spyad/ /ma zhu mi bzad nyen gyur kyang nyege/ /gzer 'joms sman ni btung mi bya/ /be'u snabs ma zhu me drod nyams/ /nad kyi snyisman ni 'ju mi nus/ /de yis nad pa 'phral du ni/ /thung zhing 'chi ba dag tu 'ang 'gyur/ /kha zas zhun sa lto ba ni/ /rtsub srar gyur la sman dag kyang / /nyes pa'i lhag ma sbyang phyir dang / /pho ba'i me ni bskyed phyir gtang / /ma 777 /92

zhu'i 'gyur ba zhi ba dag /nyams smad par ni byas las gyur/ /de gsum nyes pa rnam gsum ni/ / brtags nas ①rab tu sbyar bar bya/ /de la chung la sgyung ②ba phan/ /'bring la sgyung dang bzhu ①bya ba/ /chen po la ni sbyang ba ste/ /de yis dri ma rtsa nas 'byin/ /de bzhin nad rjogazhan dag la yang rang nad gzhi ⑤las go bzlog pas/ /gso ba de las durjes 'brel yod/ /rgyu las go bzlog rnam spang ba/ /sman pas ji lta ji lta bar/ /nad las ⑦go bzlog sbyar ba'am/ /de'i don byed pa spyor bar bya/ /nyes smin me drod skyed 'gyur nas⑧—/ /nyams rtas ⑨snum gyis byug pa dang / /btung dang 'jam rtsi stsogs rigs sbyar/ /bad kan ma zhu'i be snabs te/ /de ni mig dang mkhur ba skrang ⑩//sgregs pa zos ma thag 'dra 'byung / /mchil ma mang zhing nyes g.yo lci/ /rlung las rengs bag gzer ba dang / /bshang ⑪gci 'gags shing sbos drod nyams/ /mkhris las khong tsha skom mgo 'khor/ /rmongs bag sgregs pa skyur zhing tsha/ /ma zhu be+e snabs smyung ⑫bar bya/ /rengs bag las ni dugs rab bya/ /tsha ba'i ma zhu skyug sman dag /btang ba'am gnas skabs gang phan bya/ /ma zhu'i ⑫be snabs lci ④ba na/ /rtsa sbubs thim las yun rings ⑫can/ /bad kan rlung ni 'dres mtshan ma/ /de dang mnyam par bsgrub par bya/ /dwangs ma lus las zas dad chung / /snying na sgregs pa mnam par 'gyur/ /'di la cung zad gnyid log bya/ /ma zhu kun gyis nyin par ni/ /zas ma zos par gnyid log la| /bkres gyur yang las ran par bza'/ /ma zhu spyi yi mtshan ma ni/ /rnam par 'gags sam shas cher 'byung / /na zhing rlung ni mi gsal rgyu/ / mkhregs shing ⑩lus lci mgo bo 'khor/ /zas tshod lhag par gyur pa nyid/ /111—193

gcig pu ①ma zhu ma zad kyi/ /mi 'dod gags ②byed tshig ma tshos/ /byu dang rtsub dang mi gtsang drang ④/ /khong tsha skom dudad chu mang dang / /bsres pa'i zas ni 'ju mi 'gyur/ /mya ngan khro dang bkres pa yis/ / nye bar gdungs ⑤shing zas mi 'ju/ /phan dang mi phan bsres pa dag /zos dhipa mnyam za yin par 'dod/ /'grangs rjes slar yang za gyur pa⑦/ /lhag par za ba yin zhes bya/ /dus min che ba'am chung zos ⑧pa/ /mi mnyam par ni za ba yin/ /gsum po 'dis kyang gsod pa'am/ /mi bzad ⑨nad kyis 'debs par byed/ /dus su goms shing gtsang la phan/ /snum dro ⑩yang dang ma yengs dang / /ro drug ldan zhing mngar bag che/ /shin tu myur min dal bar min/ /khrus byas bkres shing dbe+en par gnas/ /kha gdong lag pa rkang pa bkrus/ /lha dang yi dwags rjed ⑪cing sbyin/ /bla ma byis pa mgron mchod byas/ /dud 'gro rnams kyang rab brtags shing / /bdag nyid legs par brtags nas ni/ /ma smad smra'am yid 'ong smra/ /skye bo gtsang ⑫zhing gus pas stobs⑫/ /yid 'ong gnyen dang lhan cig bza'/ /zas ni rtswa spyodang skra spu stsogs/ /'dres shing khong du slar spyosros dang / /tshod ma zas ngan mang ba dang / /tsha ches lan tshwa mang ba spang / /phrum dang zho dang phrum skam dang / /ba tsha tsha dang la phug rjen/ /phag rgod lug dang ba glang nya/ /ma ste'i ⑩sha dang rid dang skam/ / ma sha ⑩chu ldum nis sha ⑫ba/ /pad rtsa 'bras 'khur ⑩myu gur gyur/ /tshod ma skam dang nas 'dra dang / /bu ram phra mo bza' mi bya/ /sā lu'i 'bras dang gro dang nas/ /drug cu pa dang skam sa'i sha /a ru skyu ru rgun 'brum dang / /muṅga kha ra pa to la/ /zhun mar char chu 'o ma dang / /sbrang rtsi se'u 'brum rgyam ⑪tsha bza'/ /111—194

mig dang stobs phyir mtshan mo ni/ /'bras gsum sbrang rtsi mar sar bza'/ /mi nar 'jog par byed gang dang / /nad sel byed pa gang yin bsten/ /pad rtsa bur shing tso tsa dang / /mo tsa a phra'i 'bras bu dang / /la du 'khur khyeb bu ram can/ /zas ni phyi zhing ⑤snum pa dang / /mngar zhing 'ju dka' bsten ①pa rnams/ /dang po nyid du bza' bar bya/ /de las bzlog pa tha mar bza' / /bar du sgyur tsha lan tshwa can/ /lto yi cha gnyis zas kyis te⑦/ /cha gcig skom gyis dgang bar bya/ /rlung la sogs pa'i gnas su ni/ /cha bzhi pa ni lhag mar gzhag7snye /zos rjes skom ni bsil ba'i chu/ /nas dang bag phye'i ⑥g.yos byas zos/ /zho chang dug 'bags ⑦sbrang rtsi la/ /chu bsil rjes su 'thungs na phan/ /mi 'ju 'gags la chu dron gtang / /tshod ma muṅga'i phyaganod pa la/ /zho ga chu dang dar ba dang / /rang sgyur rtsab ⑨mo btung bar bya/ /skem po rgyas phyir chang btung ste ⑩/ /sbom pos sbrang rtsi'i chu btung ngo / /gcong chen nad la sha khu btung / /drod chung sha zos chang btung bya/ /nad dang sman stsogs sbrum bud med/ /zan bcad dka' thub las rnams kyis/ /skem dang byis pa rgan po la/ /'o ma bdud rtsi lta bur phan/ /mdor na zos ⑪rjes btung ba ni/ /gang zhig zas 7dang yon tan gyis⑫ / /mi mthun mi 'phrod med gyur pa/ /de ni rnam pa kun tu bsngags/ /zas (cherjes skom 'thungs ngoms dang khyab/ /stobs 'phel lus ni brtan byed la/ /zas sdud snyi bar 'gyur ba dang / /'drul zhing rnam par 'ju bar 'gyur/ /de ni nam tshang ⑫yan chad nad/ /dbugs lud glo rdol ⑩cham pa dang / /glu len smra mang la chags dang / /skad 'gags pa la gnod pa yin/ /lus las rnag ⑩'dzag 111—195

gcin nad mig /lkog nad rma yi nad kyis nyen/ /skom spang kun gyis skom 'thungs nas/ /mang smra lam zhugs nyal ba spang / / zas zos nas ①ni nyi tshan me/ /rta zhon rkyal dang 'degs pa spang / /bshang ②dang gci gsal snying ④la dri med nyes pa lam min par mi 'gro/ /gregs pa dag cing bru ba tsha gyur ④thur gyi rlung ni ⑤tha mal rgyu/ /de bzhin me duyi drod bdo dbang po gsal zhing lus kyang rab tu yang / /zas kyi tshod ran cho gar sbyar bzhin za ba de ni dus su 'dod/ /yan lag brgyad ④pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nas sman la stsogs pa'i ⑧bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o//sman rnams nyid kyi ro la stsogs/ /de ni de la bsten ⑨pas mchog /de yang 'byung lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /sa la brten te skye ba yin/ /chu ni skye gnas ⑩me dang rlung / /nam mkha' rnams ni tshogs pa las/ /de skyes gyur dang khyad par phyung ⑪/ /ming ni shas che las gyur yin/ /de bas 'byung ba 'dus pa las/ /byung⑫bas sman ni ro gcig min/ /de phyir nad kyang nyes gcig ⑫min/ /de la gsal ba ro zhes bshad④/ /mi gsal ro rjes mtha' mar ni/ /cung zad gsal ba dag tu'ang 'dod/ /sman gyi yon tan lci sogs dang / /ro ni sa la stsogs bsten pas/ /mtshungs par spyod pa nyer gdags pas/ /ro las ming du btags pa yin/ /de la sa'i ⑫sman lci dang sbom/ /sra zhing dri yi shes rab che—/ /lci zhing brtan dang 'dus pa dang / /nye bar 'phel bar byed pa yin/ /chu yi gsher dang lci bsil snum⑩/ /rtul zhing bska la ro shas che/ /'jam zhing 111—196

bad kan 'dra ba la/ /'drul zhing tshim byed sdud par byed/ /me yi rtsub rno tsha zhing skam/ /phra ①zhing gzugs kyi yon tan che/ /tsha zhing 'bar la mdog skyed cing / /gsal zhing smin pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rlung gi rtsub cing khyab la yang / /reg pa'i yon tan shas che yin/ /rtsub cing yang la dri ma sel/ /rnam dpyod na bar byed pa yin/ /nam mkha'i skephra zhing dwangs skel yang sgra yi yon tan shas che ste/ /khong stong yang bar byed pa yin/ /de ltar 'gro na don dang ni/ /sbyor ba sna tshogs dbang gis ni④/ /sman min ci yang yod ma yin / /de la sman ni gyen du 'gro/ /phal cher me dang rlung shas che/ /thur du 'go ba phal ⑤cher ni/ /sa chu'i yon tan shas cher rjoyin/ /de ltar sman no ro'i bye brag /'di yi 'og nas ston pa yin/ /sman mthu la las bshad pa di/ /lci snum bsil dang 'jam pa dang / /yang rtsub tsha dang rno ba ste/ /de ltar rnam pa brgyad du 'dod/ /sman mthu tsa ra gas bshad pa/ /gang gis bya ba gang byed pa⑦/ /mthu min cir yang mi byed kyi/ /de dag thams cad mthu yis byed/ /des na lci la stsogs pa nyid/ /nus pa'i khyad par ldan pa dang / /yon tan ma lus snying por ni/ /gyur pas mthu zhes bshad pa dag /don dang mthun par btags pa yin/ /gcis pa mang du yod na yang / /tha snyad gtso bo nyid kyis yin/ /de bas go ni bzlog pa'i phyir/ /de ni ro la stsogs pa la/ /srid du zin kyang ma bshad de/ /de bas lci ba la sogs yin/ /gzhan dag tsha dang bsil nyid gnyis/ /stobs yin zhes kyang ston par byed/ /sman ni sna tshogs bdag nyid can/ /nyi ma zla ba'i stobs can yin/ /'gro 'di gsal dang mi gsal las/ /nam yang 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de la 111—197

tsha ba mgo 'khor skom/ /rmya ①rdul tsha zhing myur 'ju byed/ /rlung dang bad kan zhi bar byed/ /bsil ba dag ni tshim byed cing / /'tsho dang rengs par byed pa dang / /khrag dang mkhris pa rab dang byed/ /pho ba'i me dang phrad ②pa las/ /gang zhig ro gzhan byung gyur pa'i/ /ro rnams kyi ni mthar zhu ba/ /de ni zhu ba zhes bshad do/ /mngar dang lan tshwa zhu rjes mngar/ /skyur ba'i zhu rjes skyur ba yin/ /kha dang bska dang tsha ba rnams/ /zhu rjes phal cher kha ba yin/ /ro dang zhu rjes 'bras bu mnyam/ /de la sman ni bzang dang ngan/ /la la ro yis las byed la/ /gzhan dag 'ju bar byed pa yin/ /yon tan gzhan dang nus pa dang / /mthu yis la la byed pa yin/ /sman gyi ro stsogs gang dang gang / /stobs ldan nyid kyis gnas byed de/ /shin tu zil mnan de dang de/ /sgrub byed rgyu ni nyid du gnas/ /yon tan mi 'phrod sbyar ba ni/ /mang pos nyung ngu zil gyis gnon/ /ro dang 'ju ba'i mthu dag ni/ /de yi stobs kyi ④zil gyis gnon / /ro stsogs de ltar stobs ni mnyam/ /ma bcos pa yi stobs dang ldan—/ /ro stsogs mnyam pa'i las gang ni/ /khyad 'phags de ni mthu las skyesarka/ /dan ti dang ni tsi tra ka /ro stsogs mtshungs kyang dan ti 'khru/ /shing mngar rgun 'brum 'dra yang 'khru/ /'o ma mar 'dra mar drod skyed/ /de ltar sman la sogs pa yi/ /spyi duyi las te de yang ni/ /sna tshogs rkyen gyi dbye ba yis/ /sman dbye tha dad gyur pa yin/ /gro dang nas ni mngar ba dang / /lci las rlung 'joms skyed pa yin/ /nya gro ⑤'o ma bsel ba dang / /seng ge kha yis duphag ma yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u dgu pa'o// //111—198

la sogs ro skye ba/ /sa chu me sa chu dang me/ /mkha' rlung me rlung sa dang rlung //gnyis gnyis shas che ①las rim 'byung / /de las ro ni mngar ba dag /gang zhig myangs ④pa'i tshe na ni/ /kha la chags shing lus kyang gni/ /tshim byed dbang po rab dang byed/ /grog ma la sogs dga' ba yin/ /skyur ba kha nas chu 'dzag cing / /so brtse rjospu ni ldang ba dang / /mig dang smin ma 'dzum par byedaske/ /lan tshwa khar ni mchil ma 'du/ /mkhur ⑤ba gre ba tsha bar byed/ /kha ba kha yi dri ma sbyang rjo/ /lce ni 'joms par byed pa yin/ /tsha ba lce rtse skyo byed cing / /tsag tsag byed par 'gyur ba dang / /kha mig sna las 'dzag byed cing / /mkhur ⑦ba sreg par byed pa yin/ /bska bas lce ni bem por byed/ /gre ba rtsa sbubs 'gags ⑧par byed/ /ro yi tshul ni de dag ste/ /las ni ro mngar ba dag gisasti/ /skyes nas 'phrod par byed pa dang / /lus zungs mthu stobs rab skyed cing / /byis pa rgan po glo rdol ⑩skem/ /mdog mdangs skra dang dbang po bzang / /lus rtas skad 'gags phan zhing phyi/ /nu zho skyed cing rma 'byor byed/ /tshe ring 'tsho byed snum pa dang / /rlung dang mkhris pa dug rnams sel/ /ha cang drags na tshil ⑩bcas dang / /bad kan las byung nad ⑫skyed cing / /lus sbom drod bri chang nad dang / /gcin nad lba ba rmen spyostsogs skyed/ /skyur ba me drod skyed byed snum/ /zhim zhing 'ju byed yi ga 'bye/ /dro ba'i nus skyed reg pa bsil/ /tshim byed 'drul byed yang ba ste/ /bad kan khrag mkhris rgyas par byed/ /rlung 'gags rgyu bar byed pa yin/ /de ni 111—199

shin tu bsten drags na/ /lus lhod rab rib mgo 'khor dang / /g.yan pa skya rbab me dbal dang / /'or nad thor bu skom rims skyed/ /lan tshwa sra dang 'khyil pa ①dang / /'gags pa 'byen zhing ④drod skyed byed/ /snum dang dugs kyis rdul zhing rdo/ /yi ga 'byed cing gcod 'byed byed/ /de ni drags pas rlung khrag dang / /skra 'byi skra dkar gnyer ma dang / /skom mdze dug dang me dbal rnams/ /skyed cing stobs ni bri bar byed/ /kha ba rang nyid zhim min zhing / /yi ga 'chus dang srin skom dug /mdze dang rgyal ①dang rims slon ④bro/ /tsha dang mkhris pa bad kan 'joms/ /'drul dang tshil dang zhag dang rkang / /bshang dang gci ba skems pa dang / /yang zhing yid gzhungs bsil zhing rtsub/ /nu ma'i nad ⑤dang skad 'gags sel/ /de ni shin tu drags gyur na/ /lus zungs zad cing rlung nad skyed/ /tsha bas lkog nad 'gags pa dang / /mdze dang ma zhu 'or nad sel/ /rma 'jig byed cing snum pa dang / /tshil dang 'drul bag skems par byed/ /drod skyed 'ju byed yi ga 'byedarka/ /sbyong zhing zas ni 'jig par byed/ /'ching ba gcod cing rtsa sbubs dag /rnam par 'byed cing bad kan sel/ /de ni shin tu drag 'gyur bas/ /skom rjoskyed khu ba stobs zad cing / /brgyal zhing lus 'khums 'dar ba dang / /rked pa rgyab stsogs na bar byed/ /bska bas ⑦mkhris pa bad kan sel/ /lci zhing khrag nad rnam par sbyong / /skem zhing rma 'tsho bsil ba dang / /'drul dang tshil ni rnam par skems/ /be+e'u snabs 'khyil zhing sri bar byedaske/ /rtsub cing be+egs ⑧mdog rab dang byed/ /de ni shin tu bsten drags na / /bshang 'gags lto sbo ⑨snying nad dang / /skom dang skem zhing skyes ⑩mthu 111—200

nyams / /rtsa sgo 'gags shing dri ma sri/ /zhun mar bu ram star ga gser/ /mo tsa tso tsa pa ru sha /nye'u shing ram nye ba nas/ /ra dza da na ba la gsum/ /me da gnyis dang paṇi bzhi/ /'tsho byed dzi ba ri sho t+yab/ /shing mngar ma du ka bim+bi / /shra ba ni gnyis bi da ri/ /cu gang k+ṣi ra shu ku la/ /sa ha 'o can kashra ri/ /'o ma bu ram shing gze ma/ /rgun 'brum sbrang stsogs mngar ba'i sde/ /sgyur ba sgyu ru am+bi ⑤ka /ba lung dang ni star bu dang / /se'u 'bru rngul dang dar ba dang / /tshwa dang ku shu a phra dang / /asla ta ka bha bya dang / / ka ra marda ka pid ta'o/ /tsha mchog rtsal 1ru kha ru tsha/ /bi da rgya mtsho bkod ma'i tsha—/ /mtsho tsha skam tsha ro nye dang / /k+ṣa ra lan bo'i sde tshan yin/ /kha ba kyi lce pa to la/ /tsan+dan ur shi chob le ka /ci skyigs phyanim pa pu tse shel ⑥/ /rgya spos a kar ba tsha ka /nag ta thom la ser po gnyis/ /gla sgang mur ba ba sha ka /a pa marga po son cha/ /'khar ldulcags sle tres byi tsher ba mu rtsa ba che lnga bya gri ⑩gnyis/ /bong nga shu dag bi sha la/ /tsha ba shing kun na le sham// byi dang ⑪ga dang tsha ba lnga/ /ku the ra stsogs ldum rngad ⑫sngo/ /mkhris pa gcin dang go bye yin/ / bska tshan ⑫a ru ba ru ra/ /sbrang rtsi seng sdeng shi ri rmyesha /ka dam u dus+thā tu5ra dang / /mu tig byu ru an tsan btsag /ka pid tha (nyagazhon khardzu ra/ /pad rtsa spyopad+ma ut+pa la'o/ /'bras rnying nas rnying ⑫gro rnying dang / /muṅga sbrang rtsi sha ka ra/ /skam sa'i sha rnams ma gtogs pa'i/ /mngar ba phal cher bad kan skyed/ /sgyu ru se 'bru ma gtogs pa'i/ /sgyur ba phal cher mkhris pa skyed/ /rgyam tsha lce myang tsha ma gtogs/ /lan tshwa phal cher mig la gnod/ /sle tres pa to la bca' sga/ /sgog skya pi pi ling ma gtogs/ /111—201

kha dang tsha ba phal cher ni/ /ro tsa 'bri zhing rlung skyed yin/ / bska las ①a ru ra ma gtogs④/ /phal cher bsil zhing sri bar byed/ /ro tsha ⑦skyur dang lan tshwa rnams/ /go rims bzhin du dro nus ldan/ /kha dang bska dang mngar ba rnams—/ /de bzhin du ni bsil ba nyid/ /kha dang tsha dang bska ba rnams/ /de bzhin rtsub cing dri ma sridu/ /lan tshwa skyur mngar snum pa dang / /bshang ⑤gci thur gyi dbugs 'byen byed/ /lan tshwa las bska de bas kyang / /mngar ba mchog tu lci ba yin/ /skyur las tsha dang de bas kyang / /kha ba dag ni yang ba yin/ /ro rnams kyis rjoni dbye ba las/ /sbyor ba lnga bcu rtsa bdun dang / /brtags ⑦pa drug cu rtsa gsum du/ /rags rim ji bzhin phye ba yin/ /de lnga re re phri ba las/ /lngar gyur pa ni ro gnyis pa/ /gsum pa mngar bcu skyur drug ste/ /lan tshwa gsum ste kha ba gcig⑧ /bzhi pa la ni mngar po bcu/ /skyur ba bzhi po lan tshwa gcig /lnga pa la ni skyur gcig pu/ /mngar ba lnga la brten pa yin/ /sman ni ro drug gcig pu yin/ /ma 'dres pa ni ro drug 'gyuraske/ /lnga pa drug dang ro ni tha dad drug /bzhi pa gnyis pa rnam pa bcwa ⑨lnga yin/ /dbye ba gsum pa nyi shu gcig nyid de⑩/ /sman ni ro drug de ltar drug cu gsum/ /de rnams ro dang ro rjes ro'i dbye ba/ /rab dang rab mchog dag tu brtags pa las/ /rtsis las 'das par byung bar gyur pa ni/ /nad dang sman gyi dbang las nye bar sbyar/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcu pa'o// //de nas nad la stsogs pa'i tshul shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /111—202

nad dang lus zungs ①dri ma rnams/ /rtag tu lus kyi rtsa ba yin/ /de rlung dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub dang / /bskyod dang las spyod shugs 'byin dang / /lus zungs legs par rgyu ba dang / /dbang po rnams ni gsal ba dag /mi gnod pa ni rjes 'dzin yin/ /mkhris pa 'ju drod mthong byed dang / /bkres skom zas len mdangs yid gzhungs/ /blo ldan dpa' snying lus ①'jam pas/ /bad kan brtan zhing snum nyid dang / /tshigs ①'byel bzod la stsogs pas so/ /lus zungs las gtso go rims bzhin/ /tshim byed 'tsho byed g.yogs rjopa dang //snum dang brtan ⑤dang 'gengs pa dang / /mngal ni skyed byed yin par bshad/ /brtan ④par byed pa bshang ba yin/ /'drul dang 'byin pa gcin gyi yin/ /ba spu brtan pa rngul gyi yin/ /rlung ni 'phel bar gyur pa yis/ /skem dang mdog gnag drod bag dga'/ /'dar dang lto sbos bshang ba sri/ /stobs dang gnyid dang dbang po nyams/ /smra mang mgo 'khor zhum par byed/ /mkhris pa bshang gci pags mig ser/ /bkres skom lus tsha gnyid chung byed/ /bad kan drod nyams mchil ma mang / /khong snyom lci dang sha mdog dkar/ /lus grang ⑦yan lag lhod pa dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde gnyid che⑧/ /dngas ma'ang bad kan dang 'dra la/ /khrag 'phel me dbal khong 'bras ⑨mcher /mdze dang rlung khrag mkhris pa khrag /skran dang rnyil nad mig ser dang / /bskyod dka' drod nyams rmongs bag can/ /mig dang gcin pags dmar bar 'gyur—/ /sha 'phel be+e ba rmen bu mdud/ /mkhur tshos brang lto brla ⑩sbom zhing / /mgul stsogs lhag par sha yang che/ /tshil 'phel de 'dra de bzhin ngal//cung zad bskyod kyang dbugs rgod cing / /rkub tshos nu ma gsus ⑪'phyang 'gyur//111—203

rus 'phel rus lhag so lhag 'gyur/ /rkang 'phel lus lci mig rtsa g.yung / /tshigs kyi mgo bo sbom pa dang / /tshigs la thor bu gso dka' ①'byung / /khu 'phel bud med la rab gdung ④/ /khu ba'i rde'u dag tu 'ang 'gyur/ /bshang 'phel lto sbos rgyu 'khrug cing / /lus spru lto ba na bar byed/ /gcin 'phel chu sor zug cing na/ /gcis ①kyang ma gcis snyam sems 'gyur④/ /rngul 'phel rngul che dri mi zhim/ /g.yan pa nyid kyang skyed ces bya/ /mig rngul la stsogs dri ma rnams/ /mang bas lci la stsogs par byed/ /rlung zad mtshan ma lus mi bde//smra nyung rtsol ba chung bar 'gyur/ /dran pa mi gsal ⑤bad kan 'phel/ /sngar bshad pa yi nad rnams 'byung / /mkhris zad drod nyams grang ba dang / /mdog nyams byed de bad kan zad/ /mgo 'khor bad kan gnas stongs shing / /snying 'dar tshigs ni lhod par 'gyur/ /cung zad rtsub ngal skam pa dang / /na zhing sgra cher mi bzod 'gyur/ /khrag zad skyur dang bsel la dga'—/ /rtsa lhod pags pa rtsub par 'gyur/ /sha zad dbang nyams mig mkhur ba'i/ /rus skam rjolhu tshigs na bar 'gyur/ /tshil zad gnyid che dpyi rked spyomangon/ /mcher pa che dang lus skem ⑧'gyur/ /rus zad rus zug so dang ni/ /sen mo skra la sogs pa 'byung / /rkang zad rkang sbubs stong pa dang / /mgo 'khor rab rib can du 'gyur/ /khu ba zad pas ring nas ⑨'byung / /yang na khu ba khrag nyid 'byung / /rlig pa shin tu na ba dang / /pho mtshan tshig pa snyam du sems/ /bshang zad rlung ni rgyu ma'i nang / /sgra bcas 'khyil pa lta bur byed/ /lto bar rgyu zhing gyen du 'gro/ /snying ga rtsib logs mi bzad na/ /gcin zad gcin ni nyung sri ⑫dang / /mdog 'gyur ba 'am khrag bcas nyid/ /111—204

rngul zad spu 'byi spu 'grengs ①la/ /pags pa rnams ni 'gas par 'gyur/ /dri ma shin tu phra ba rnams/ /zad pas brtag ④dka' dri ma yi/ /rang gnas bskams ①dang na ba dang / /stong dang yang ba las shes bya/ /nad stsogs rang nyid ji lta ba'i/ /yon tan 'di ni bzlog pa dag /zad pa dang ni 'phal gyur rjolas/ /'phel 'bri sman pas shes par bya/ /dri ma thogs las 'phel ba ste—/ /shin tu 'byung las zad ⑤shes bya/ /lus ni dri mas brten rjopas na/ /'phel bas zad pa gnod pa yin/ /de la rlung ni rus par gnas/ /mkhris pa rngul dang khrag la gnas/ /bad kan lhag ma gnas des 'di/ /phan tshun rten dang brten pa yin/ /'phel dang zad par byed pa'i sman/ /gcig gi gang yin gzhan gyi'ang de/ /rus pa rlung gnyis la 'di min/ /phal cher rtas pas 'phel bar 'gyur/ /bad kan rjes mthun de yi phyir/ /de las bzlog pas zad pa yin/ /rlung dang rjes mthun de ltar na/ /'phel dang zad pa 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ / sgyung dang brta ⑦bar bya ba yis/ /nad ni rim gyis gso bar bya/ /rlung ma gtogs ⑧te de skyes la/ /de nyid bzlog thabs sbyar bar bya/ /khyad par du ni khrag skyes nad⑨/ /gtar ga bkru ⑪sman dag gis ⑪gso—/ /sha cher skyes las byung ba'i nad⑫/ /gtar ga me btsa' thal sman sbyar/ /tshil chos ⑫sbom skem gso bar bya/ /rus pa zad pa las byung la/ /mar dang 'o ma kha rab ⑫sbyar/ /de bzhin 'jam rtsi gtang bas gso⑫/ /bshang ba 'phel la 'khru ⑩bas gso/ / bshang ba zas ⑩las byung ba'i nad/ /ra lug nang gol zan dron dang / /sbyar thug tu)ma sha gnyis sogs sbyin/ /gcin 'phel gyur la gcin 'bri ba/ /gcin zad las byung gcin snyi gso⑪/ /rngul 111—205

mi 'byung la rtsol dang bsku/ /rngul 'byung cho gas ①gso bar bya/ /lus kyi me drod rang gnas 'dug /cha shas lus zungs rnams la brten/ /de rnams 'bri zhing rab 'bar ba/ /lus zungs 'phel dang zad par 'gyur/ /lus zungs dang po ⑧phyi ma ni/ /rgyas byed zad pa'ang de bzhin no/ /nyes 'khrugs pas ni lus zungs nyen/ /gnyi gas dri ma la gnod byed/ /'og na ①gnyis te mgo bor bdun/ /bu ga dang ni rngul 'byung ba'i/ /dri ma'i gnas ni dri ma ste//rang rang gnas su nad skyed 'gyur/ /lus zungs khu ba'i mthar thug pa'i/ /nang nas gzi can mdangs mchog yin/ /snying la gnas kyang khyab pa dang / /lus ni brtan par gnas pa yin/ /gang zhig 'jig na nges 'jig la/ /gang zhig gnas na gnas gyur pa/ /gang la ④dngos rnams sna tshogs pa/ /lus la brten pa 'byung ba yin/ /mdangs ni sems 'khrugs bkres sems las/ /mya ngan ngal la stsogs pas zad/ /de zad sdang zhing lus rid la/ /yang yang sems shing dbang po nyams/ /gzi nyams rtsub dang yid mi dga'/ /nyam ⑤chung bar ni 'gyur rjob yin/ /'tsho byed sman dang 'o ma dang / /sha khu la sogs de'i sman yin/ /zas gang ⑦mi 'dod gang zhig slong / /de la mi 'phrod 'phrod pa ni/ /spang dang sbyin par bya ba dag /de dang des 'phel zad par 'gyur/ /nyes pa phyin ci log pa dang / /mthun pas sred pa skyed byed de/ /phal cher 'phel dang zad pa dag /mi mkhas pa yis mi shes so//ji bzhin stobs dang rang ji bzhin/ /'phel na nyes pa rgyas par 'gyur/ /zad pas rang bzhin 'dor bar 'gyur/ /mnyam na rang gi las rnams byed/ /gang zhig mnyam pas lus ni 'phel bar byed/ /nyes pa de nyid mi mnyam 111—206

gsod par byed/ /de bas zad stipa'ang 'phel ba lta bu ni/ /phan pa'i spyod pa nyid kyis bsrung bar bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas nad kyi bye brag shes par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /zhu ba'i gnas dang rked pa dpyi④/ /rna ba rus pa reg dbang po/ /rlung gnas yin te de las kyang / /zhu ba'i gnas su khyad par gnas/ /mkhris gnas lte ba pho ba rngul①/ /chu ser dwangs ma khrag dang ni/ /mig dang pags pa dag yin te/ /de las lte ba khyad par gnas/ /bad kan brang dang mgul pa mgo/ /glo ba rus tshigs ma zhu'i gnas/ /dwangs ma tshil dang sna lcer dhiganas/ /brang ni khyad par dag gi gnas/ /rlung ni srog stsogs dbye ba yinabu/ /lnga yi bdag nyid 'dir srog ni/ /spyir buganas brang dang gre bar rgyu/ /blo dang dbang po sems 'dzin byed/ /mchil 'dor ⑦sprid 'byung sgregs pa 'don/ /dbugs rngub zas ni mid ⑧par byed/ /gyen rgyu'i gnas ni brang yin te/ /sna dang lce dang ⑨sgog mar rgyu/ /tshigs ⑩'byin 'bad rtsol mdangs dang ni/ /stobs dang kha dog dran las byed/ /khyab byed snying gnas lus kun la/ /ma lus khyab cing rab tu mgyogs/ /'gro dang 'degs dang 'jog ⑪pa dang / /mig 'byed 'dzums ⑫pa la sogs pa/ /lus can bya ba phal cher ni/ /de la rag ni lus pa yin/ /mnyam gnas me drod nye bar gnas/ /nang grol kun tu rgyu ba yin/ /bya ba zas len 'ju ba dang / /dwangs snyigs 'byed cing 'dor bar byed/ /thur sel gzhang gnas 'dong mo dang / /lgang pa pho mtshan brla 111—207

nang rgyu①/ /bya ba khu ba zla mtshan dang / /bshang gci mngal gnas 'byen par byed/ /mkhris pa'i rang bzhin lnga de la/ /zhu dang ma zhu'i gnas par gnasaske/ /'byung lnga'i bdag nyid can gyis ni/ /gang me'i yon tan shas che bsaske/ /gsher nyid skems ②byed 'ju la stsogs/ /las kyi me yi sgrar bshad do/ /zas ni 'ju dang de bzhin du/ /dwangs ma tshigs ma 'byed par byed/ /der ①gnas bzhin du mkhris pa ni/ /lhag ma rnams kyi gogs byed pas/ /stobs bskyed pa yis byed 'gyur bas0/ /de ni 'ju byed ces bshad do/ /mkhris pa ma zhu'i gnas la brten/ /dwangs mdog bsgyur bas dmar sgyur ⑦yin/ /mkhris pa sgrub byed snying la gnas/ /blo dang yid gzhungs nga rgyal stsogs/ /mngon 'dod don ni sgrub byed pas/ /mig la gnas te gzugs mthong byed/ /mthong byed ces bshad mdog gsal ni/ /pags mdog gsal byed pags par gnasaske/ /bad kan rnam rjolnga brang gnas pa/ /rang gi stobs ⑦kyis sum mdo dang / /snying dang zas kyi mthu dang ni/ /de nyid la gnas chu las byed/ /bad kan lhag ma'i gnas gyur pa'i/ /rten ni gang phyir byed gyur pas⑧/ /de phyir rten byed ces bshad do/ /gang zhig ma zhu'i gnas la gnas/ /de ni zas stsogs 'drul byed pas/ /myags byed ces ni bya ba yin/ /myong byed lcer gnas ro tshor byed/ /rtas byed mgor ⑨gnas dbang po ni/ /tshim ⑩par byed de ⑪'byor byed ni/ /tshigs la ⑫gnas nas 'byor par byed/ /de ltar nad ni phal mo che/ /mi 'gyur bdag nyid can khyab kyang / /gnas yin par ni shes bya ste/ /las rnams kyang di tha dad yin/ /rtsub sogs dro bar ldan pas ni//rlung ni stsogs par 'gyur ba yin/ /grang bas ldang byed snum ⑫la sogs/ /111—208

yon tan dro ①ldan zhi byed 'gyur/ /rno stsogs bsel ba dang ldan pas/ /mkhris pa stsogs par byed 'gyur la/ /dro bas ldang zhing ro rtul stsogs/ /bsil bar ldan pas zhi bar 'gyur/ /snum stsogs grang dang ldan pa yis/ /bad kan stsogs par byed 'gyur la/ /gro bas ldang 'gyur de nyid ni/ /rtsub sogs yon tan gyis zhir 'gyur/ /rang gnas nyid du 'phel stsogs yin/ /dkyel ②'gyur rgyu las 'khrugs ①pa dang / /mi mthun pa yi yon tan 'dod/ /ldang ba log pa'i lam zhugs nyid/ /rang gi rtags ni ston pa dang / /bde med nad ni 'byung 'gyur ba'o/ /rang gnas gnas pa mnyam nyid dang / /nad rnams ma byung zhi ba yin/ /sogs dang ldang dang rab zhi ba/ /rlung ni so ga stsogs gsum tshe/ /mkhris pa dbyar la sogs par te/ /bad kan dgun smad stsogs par ro/ /yang dang rtsub pa la sogs pa'i/ /sman dang lus kyang de mtshungs pas/ /so ga rlung ni sogs 'gyur ④gyi/ /dro ba'i dus kyis ldang mi 'gyur / /chu rnams 'ju ba skyur ba dang / /sman yang de dag ⑤'dra ba yis/ /mkhris pa stsogs kyi dus kyis rjoni/ /grang ba nyid kyis ldang mi 'gyur/ /chu dang sman ni bsil ba dang / /snum pas dus ni mtshungs 'gyur yang / /dgun smad bad kan stsogs 'gyur gyi/ /bsgongs pas ldang bar mi 'gyur ro⑦/ /de ltar dus kyi rang bzhin 'di/ /zas la stsogs pa'i dbang gis ni⑧/ /dus la bab par ma gyur kyang / /'phral du stsogs pa la sogs 'gyur/ /nad ni ldang gyur 'phral du lus/ /mgo nas rkang gi bar du khyab/ /ldog 'gyur chu yi rgyun bzhin du/ /cung zhig ⑨cung zhig dag gis zhi/ /nad 'khrugs sna tshogs tshul can ni/ /grangs med par ni gyur pa'i ⑩lus/ /thams cad nye bar gzir 111—209

gyur pa/ /de rgyu tshul dang sgrub pa dag /re re nas ni bstan mi nus/ /de bas spyi yi brjod pa yin/ /nad rnams dag ni thams cad kyi/ /nyes pa'i rgyu ni gcig pu nyid/ /dper na bya ni lding 'gyur ba①/ /nyin rangs kun tu song gyur kyang / /rang gi grib ma dang mi 'bral/ /'gro kun de ④dang 'dra ba yin/ /yang na ji ltar ma lus pa'i/ /'gro ba mi 'dra sna tshogs 'di/ /yon tan gsum dang mi 'bral lo/ /de bzhin rang khams ma snyoms pa'i/ /rgyu yang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /nad rigs nyes pa gsum mi 'bral/ /de rnams kyis ①ni ldang ba'i rgyu/ /dbang don mi 'tsham rjophrad pa dang / /dus dang nyes pa'i las rnams so/ /de yang dman ༷lhag log sbyor bas/ /dbye ba rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /dbang don rang yul chung ngu 'am/ /mi sbyor ba ni dman rjopa ste/ /shas cher gtad ④pa lhag sbyor ba/ /rab phra'i ske'od dang 'jigs pa dang / /shin tu nye dang shin tu ring / /yid du mi 'ong mi sdug pa'i//gzugs la mig ni lta byed pa/ /lag ⑨sbyor de ni mi zad ⑩yin/ /de bzhin rab drags rdul ⑪la sogs/ /dbang don ji bzhin shes par bya/ /dus kyang grang dang tsha ba dang / /char dus dbye bas ⑫gsum du 'dod/ /de dman grang stsogs chung ba dang / /lhag sbyor shin tu che mtshan nyid/ /rang gi mtshan nyid phyin ci log /log pa'i sbyor ba yin par bshad/ /lus ngag yid kyi dbye ba yis—/ /las kyang ⑫rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /lus la sogs pa'i las dman la—/ /'jug pa dman pa'i ming can yin/ /brtun ngas 'jug pa lhag sbyor ba'o—/ /shugs bkag pa dang btsir ba dang / /mi ⑫bzad lus kyi las rnams dang / /gcus spyodang rdeg 'chos gom 'khyor stsogs/ /ldang bzhin smra 111—210

bar byed pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang 'jig stsogs dang / /srog gcod la sogs las rnams dang / /rnam bcu de yang smad pa yin/ /'di dang gzhan du byas pa rnams/ /de dag ma lus log sbyor yin/ /'di dag nad kyi rgyu yin no/ /ldang 'gyur de ni mtha' yas te/ /sna tshogs nad ni byed par 'gyur / /yan lag nang khrol hutelhu tshigs brten/ /yan lag khrag stsogs pags pa yin/ /de ni phyi rol nad gnas te/ /de brten ma zhu yan lag na/ /lba ba be'u esnabs 'brum pa stsogs/ /gzhang 'brum skran dang 'or nad sogs/ /de dag phyi rol nad ces bya/ /nang nad rtsa ③sbubs chen po dang / /ma zhu zhu ba'i gnas la brten/ /gnas de las ni skyugs ④tshad 'khru/ /dmu dze+eng lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /nang gi cha yi gzhang 'brum skrang 7 5/ /skran dang me dbal khong 'brum pa/ /mgo bo snying dang chu so stsogs/ /rus pa'i tshigs nad gnad yin no/ /de 'byel rtsa dang chu ba dang / /chu ba chen stsogs bar ma yin/ /de la nad lam der gnas pa/ /gcong chen gzhogs phyed mjing ⑥kha yo/ /glad nad stsogs dang tshigs rus dang / /dpyi ⑦yi gzer dang gnod ①nad stsogs / /'byin khyab zug dang snyom pa dang / /lus tsha nad gzer bye ⑨ ba dang / / 'ja' zhing chag snyam rkang rmyelag 'khums/ /bsgongs dang rtse dang skom byed dang / /'dar dang rtsub dang khong stong dang / /skem dang mgul dang dkris snyam dang / /rengs dang ro bska yibro ba'o/ /mdog ni gnag gam dmar ba dag /rlung gi las yin mkhris pa'i las/ /lus tsha mdog dmar dro tshostsosmin byed/ /rngul dang gnag dang 'dzag rma shā1red/ /'drul dang brgyal ⑩zhing myos pa dang / /kha'i ro kha dang sgyur eb dang / /mdog skya dmar rtsa ma 111—211

yin pa'o/ /bad kan las ni mkhrang ①zhing snum/ /g.ya' zhing khong grang ④lci ba dang / /tshigs dam sha rgyas rmongs bag dang / /skrang zhing gnyid che zas mi 'ju—/ /mdog dkar kha ro lan tshwa mngar/ /las kyi mtha' las 'dam ring ngo / /de ltar ji skad bshad pa yi/ /mtshan nyid kyis 2 nad kun khyab/ /de ni ma yengs lta stsogs pas/ /yang dag par ni shes par bya/ /nad kyi gnas skabs dbye shes pas/ /nad pa skad cig re rer blta/ /goms pas nges par thob 'gyur te/ /las rnams grub pa gsal byed yin/ /rin chen la sogs bzang ngan ④shes/ /bstan bcos 'ba' zhig las mi 'byung / /nad ni 'di ltar rnam gsum ste/ /la la tshe 'di'i nyes las byung / /la la sngon gyi nyes las byung / /gzhan dag de gnyis 'dres las byung / /nyes 'byung nad gzhi ji bzhin par/ /las skyes rgyu ni med pa yin/ /rgyu chung ba la dudakyel che'i nang / /nyes dang las las byung ba yin/ /dang po mi mthun bza' ba yin/ /las skyes las ni zad pa ste/ /gnyi ga las byung nyes dang las/ /zad pas zad par 'gyur ba yin/ /nad ni rang rgyud gzhan rgyud las/ /gnyis 'gyur mtha' ⑤'ang gnyis yin te/ /sngar dhiskyes snga ma'i tshul du bshad/ /phyi skyes pa ni bla brnan ⑦yin/ /rang gnas ji bzhin gnas pa ni/ /rang rgyud can de ⑧mtshan nyid gsal/ /gzhan dag de las go bzlog pa/ /dri ma'ang de bzhin shes par gyis/ /de ni nad re stildang ba na/ /ma yengs pas ni shes bya ste/ /de rnams gtso bo zhi byas pas/ /zhi 'gyur zhi bar ma gyur na/ /de bzhin phyi nas gso bar bya/ /'on te bla brnan ⑩stobs che na/ /myur gso de nad kyis gzir ba/ /lus la shas cher gnod byed yin/ /nad la rnam par mi mkhas 111—212

shes—/ /ngo ①tsha nam yang ma byed cig /nad kyi 'gyur ba thams cad kyi/ /ming gi nges bstan yod pa min/ /nyes pa de nyid 'khrugs nas ni/ /khyad par du ni ldang gyur nas/ /gnas gzhan dag tu song nas ni/ /nad ni mang por byed par 'gyur/ /de bas nad kyi rang bzhin ni/ /rang gnas gzhan du 'phos pa dang / /rgyu yi khyad par shes byas la/ /sman dpyad kyis gso myur du bya| /gnod bya yul dang nyams stobs dus/ /me drod rang bzhin na tshod dang //snying stobs goms dang zas rnams kyisakhru/ /gnas skabs rnam pa tha dad pa/ /'di dag phra ④mo yan chad brtag /nad dang sman gyi tshul brtags pas/ /gang zhig gso ba la 'jug pa/ /de ni nam yang 'khrul mi 'gyur/ /nad dkyel che ba'am chung ba dag /phog snya ④lus nyams che chung las/ /gnod par byed pa ⑤snang 'gyur bas/ /de la'ang ma yengs nyid du byarjo/ /sman pa ngan pas ⑦nad rnams ni/ /phyi ba yang bar yongs rtog cing / /nad nyung dag tu brtags pa yis/ /gso ba log pa dag tu 'gyur/ /de bas chung ba'ang ⑧stobs chung ba/ /dkyel ⑨chen nad la rab tu sbyor/ / spyor ba ⑩chung ngur sbyar ba yis/ /nad ni shin tu slong ba ⑪yin/ /sbyor ba'ang ⑫lhag par sbyor ba dang / /log par sbyor bas phyin ci log /dri ma 'byung bar mi ⑫zad kyi/ /lus kyang shin tu ma rung 'gyur/ /de bas rtag tu brtson pa dang / /thams cad kun tu legs brtags nas/ /ci nas nad med brtan gyur pa/ /de ltar sman dpyad sbyar bar gyis/ /de nas gzhan yang nad rnams ni/ /'phel zad dbye bas bshad bya ste/ /tha dad pa las gsum shes bya/ /ldan gsum de yang de dgu yin/ /mnyam ⑫par 'phel bas ⑫gsum nyid de/ /gcig rab lhag pas ⑫111—213

drug tu 'gyur/ /ma lus pa las bcu gsum yin/ /gnyis gcig lhag pa las drug ste/ /mtshungs las gcig yin rab dang ni/ /rab mchog brtags ①pa las drug yin/ /de ltar nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ /'phel ba'o zad pa'ang de snyed yin/ /de dag re re 'phel mnyam khuzad/ /drug ste slar yang de dag ni—/ /gcig zad gnyis gnyis 'phel ba ni/ /go bzlog bcas las 1drug tu 'gyur/ /dbye ba drug cu gnyis su bstan/ /drug cu gsum pa bder rteganas rgyu/ /de bzhin 'di dag dwangs ma khrag stsogs 'dres pa las/ /nad ni zad dang mnyam dang 'phel ba'i dbye ba yis/ /rab dang rab mchog dag las mtha' yas nyid 'gyur bar/ /rang bzhin ci 'dra ma yengs yid kyis khushes par gyis/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas nad gso ba'i thabs kyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /rlung nad gso ba snum dang ni/ /dugs dang sbyang ba 'jam rtsi ⑥dang / /mngar sgyur lan tshwa bro ba yi/ /zas dang bsku zhing mnye ba dang / /dkri snun sman chu blugs pa dang / /gro chang 'bras chang bu ram chang / / snum dro hūṃ'ajam rtsi gtang ba ni/ /'jam rtsi nges pa bde dga' thudang / /skye gnas du ma'i snum dag ni/ /drod che 'ju bar byed 1bhegayos sbyar/ /khyad par du ni sha tshon dang / /til mar dang sbyar 'jam rtsi bya/ /mkhris pa mar sar blud rtse pa dang / /mngar zhing bsil ba'i bkru sman dang / /mngar dang kha dang bska ba yi/ /zas dang sman ni sbyin pa dang / /dri bzang bsel zhing yid 'ong ba'i/ /dri ni nye bar bsten ⑪111—214

pa dang / /mgul du do shal se ①mo do/ /nor bu brang du ②gdags par bya/ /ga bur tsan+dan ur shi ra'iske/ /byug pas skad cig re re bsku/ /srod rjol rdo thal can zla zer⑤/ /yid 'ong gru dang ser bsil bstenadhi/ /bag phebs mdza' bo bde ba dang / /bu la gzhon skad nyams rangs smra/ /chung ma yid mthun las byed cing / /sdug cig ⑦yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /khang pa nyi ⑧rim chu bsil blugs/ /skyed mos tshal rdzing ⑨bzang po ni/ /rgya che dang ni stegs bcas pa/ /chus brlan bye ma bsil ba dang / /spyil bu lus tshad shing khebs dang / /chu 'gram pad+mar bcas par ni/ /bde ⑩gnas khyad par 'o ma dang / /mar sar bza' dang bkru sman bya/ /bad kan cho gar ldan par ni/ /skyug sman bkru ⑪sman rnon po btang / /zas ni rtsub chung rno ⑫zhing dro/ /tsha zhing kha dang bska ba bza'/ /chang ni yun rings lon pa btung ⑫/ /rtse dga' dang ni gnyid mi log /rtsol ba'i tshul ni sna tshogs dang / /sems las rtsub pas mnye ⑫ba dang / /khyad par sman khu ⑫skyug sman btang / /sbrang rtsi tshil 'joms sman bsten bya/ / sgyung ba dud bdug mkhur bkang ⑫dbo/ /bde ba med nyid bde phyir bya/ /nad rnams so sor gso ba dang ()/ /nad las dpags te bshad pa yin/ /ldan pa dang ni 'dus pa dag /de ni so so'i tshul bzhin brtag /rlung ni zung du 'jug pas na/ /rlung mkhris phal cher so ga'i bya/ /bad kan rlung la dpyid kyi bya/ /bad kan mkhris pa ston gyi bya/ / zung du 'jug pa rlung gi mchog /yang dag 'dres pas gnyis bdag can/ /me dang ldan pas sreg par byed/ /zla ba ldan pas bsil bar byed/ /⑫nad ni dkyel spyosogs dus su bsal⑩/ /ldang na gzhan don med par gso/ /thams 111—215

cad ldan na tshabs ①che ba/ /nad gzhan gnod pa med par gso/ /nad ni sbyor bas zhi bya ba/ /gang gzhan ldang bar byed pa dag /de ni dag min gzhan dag ni/ /ldang bar mi 'gyur rnam dag yin/ /rtsol drag tsha ba rno ba dang / /gnod par 'gyur ba spyad ⑤pas kyang / /khong pa yan lag rus pa dang / /gnad du rlung ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bzhin de la rtsa sgo ni/ /rnam par sbyangs pas 'byung bar ①'gyur/ /smin byas rlung ni tshar bcad pas/ /khong pa'i nang du 'du ④bar 'gyur/ /der gnas nas kyang rgyu dag la/ /sdod cing ring du thogs pa yin/ /de ni dus sogs stobs thob nas/ /gzhan la brten yang ldang bar byed/ /de la gnas gzhan gnas pa ni/ /de nyid stobs ni med nyid la/ /gso bar bya ba rang gi ni/ /stobs kyis gzhan zil gnon byed na'o/ /bla brnan 5nad ni zhi byas na/ /rang gnas gnas pa gso mi dgos—/ /phal cher rtsib dulogs 'gro ba'i nad/ /nad pa yun rings ⑦nyon mongs byed/ / lus me'i ⑤stobs ni shes pa yis/ /de la rings thabs dag mi bya/ /de ni sbyor bas zhi bya 'am/ /khong du bde bar bsdu bar bya/ /khong du 'dus par shes nas ni/ /ji ltar nye ba bzhin du bsalalku / /bu ga 'byung 'gags stobs nyams shing / /lci zhing rlung ni khung ⑩ du 'khrul/ /khong snyom mi 'ju ⑪ mchil ma mang / /bshang ⑫gci sri dub zas mi len/ /nad rtse ma zhil spyi yi rtags/ /rtse zhil de las bzlog pa yin/ /khong pa'i drod stobs chung nyid kyis / /lus zungs 4mdang po mi 'ju ba/ /nad ni pho bar zhugs pa dag /dwangs ma ma zhu yin par bshad/ /gzhan dag nad nyid rab 'khrugs pa/ /rab sdug phan tshun 'doms ⑫las byung / /ko dra ⑫ba yi dug bzhin du/ /nad 111—216

tshabs chen po 'byung bar bshad/ /nad tshabs de dang 'dres pa dang / /gnod pa gnod bya gnod 'gyur dang / /nad gzhan gang dag de las ①byung / /ma zhu ba dang bcas par bshad/ /de ni lus kun zhugs gyur pa/ /nad nang zhugs te rtse ma bcil/ /ma smin dbyung bar mi bya ste/ /ma smin shing thog khu ④bar mtshungs/ /de ni dbyung bar dka' bas na/ /rten ni 'jig ④par byed par 'gyur/ /de ni smin dang drod skyed snum/ /dugs bya rtse bcil de bsil ④brka/ /ji ltar nye dang stobs ji bzhin/ /sbyangs pa'i dus su bsal ⑤bar bya/ /kha nas rigs par sman btang bas/ /ma zhu'i gnas las nad myur bsal/ /nam tshod yan chad sna sman gyis/ /zhu ba'i gnas yod mas gtong rjobasal/ /steng ngam 'og tu 'byung bar rtsom/ /nad ni rang nyid 'byung ④bas na/ /sman gyis nad ni mi dgag ste/ /bkag na de nyid nad skyed 'gyur/ /de bas dang por nad 'byung la/ /bsdad de phan par bza' bar bya/ /'khyil la ④smin pa de dang nges/ /smin byas de bzhin bsal bar bya/ /dbyar ston tha chungs dpyid zla 'bring / /thun mong ⑨dus su rim bzhin du/ /so ga dbyar dang dgun bsags pa'i/ /rlung sogs nad ni myur du bsal/ /so ga dbyar dang dgun gyi tshe/ /rab tsha char dang grang ba'i dus/ /de rnams dus mtshams thun mong spyoste/ /de tshe nad ni mi bzad bsal/ /tha mal bde gnas dbang byas ⑪kyi—/ /nad pa ⑫nad kyi dbang du ni/ /grang tsha char gyi dus dag gi/ /gnyen po ji bzhin byas nas di/ /sbyor ba'i dus su bab pa na/ /bya ba dus la mi sdod ⑫do/ /sman ni zas ma zos ⑩sngon dang / /dbus dang mtha' dang kham gyi bar—/ /zas bar tseg spyobu zas bcas ⑫dang / /zas mnan mtshan mo 111—217

btung ba'o/ /bad kan bdo 'das nad hūṃpa ni/ /nyams stobs ldan la ma zos btang / /thur sel ༄ )rlung la zas sngar thubatang / /mnyam gnas ldang la bar du yin/ /khyab byed nang par zas za'i mthar/ /gyen rgyu'i rlung la dgongs ka'opya/ /srog ces bya ba'i rlung ldang la/ /kham kyi bar dang zas bar bza'/ / dugs dang byugs shālud dbugs mi bde/ /skom dad skye la tseg 93bu'o/ /yi ga 'chus la sna tshogs zas/ /sman dang zas bcas mesbyar bar bya/ /skyigs bu lus 'dar lag 'dar dang / /zas nyung za la mnan pa gtang / /nam tshong 3yan chad nad la ni/ /mtshan mo'i dus su btang ba bsngags/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas gso ba'i thabs rnam 17pa gnyis bstan pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o⑩ //gso ba rnam pa gnyis yin phyir/ /gso thabs rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /de gcig brta skyebar bya ba yin/ /gnyis pa nyams ni smad pa'o/ /de dag rgyas bya lkusmyung ba zhes/ /rnam grangs dag tu bshad pa yin/ /lus sha rgyas phyir rgyas bya ste/ / yang ba nyid phyir sgyung bar bya/ /⑫/de ni phal cher sa chu dang / /cig shos las ni gyur pa thuyin/ /las a+yogang snum dang dgag pa dang / /dugs dang khong rtsub bya ba ste/ /'byung ba ⑪de yang gnyis yin phyir/ /gnyis las 'da' bar mi byed do/ /de la'ang spyong shā 7dang zhi bya ba/ /rnam pa gnyis po smyung tshub yin/ /gang zhig nad ni phyir 'byen pa/ /sbyong ⑪yin de ni rnam lnga ste//mas gtong skyugs ( 7sman lus nad bkru/ /mgo bo'i 4 kyend bkru gtar gas 111—218

dbyung / /gang zhig nad ni mi sbyong dang / / snyoms gnas glongs ①pa ma yon ④dang / /ma snyoms snyoms par byed pa dag /zhi ba yin te de rnams bdun/ /smin dang drod skyed bkres skom dang / /rtsol bcag nyi tshan ser ①bu bsil/ /brta ④ba dag ni rlung dang ni/ /rlung bcas mkhris pa zhi byed yin/ /brta ⑤bya nad dang sman dang chang / /bud med mya ngan gyis nyam rjochung / /khur dang lam gyis glo rdol ⑦dang / /lus rtsub nyams dma' ④rlung shas che/ /sbrum ma bu btsas byis pa rgan/ /so ga'i dus dang gzhan yang brta⑨/ /sha dang 'o ma ka ra dkar/ /mar sar mngar bag mas gtong dang ⑩/ /gnyid log nyal ⑪bde bsku byug dang / /khrus dang bder ⑫gnas nyams dga' brta⑫/ /gcin snyi ma zhu snum rab zos/ /rims btab brla rengs mdze nad can/ /shu ba khong 'bras mcher pa na/ /glad ⑫nad sgog nad mig nad dang / /sbom po dgun dang gzhan dag kyang / /rtag tu sgyung bar bya ba yin/ /de la sbyang bya shas che sbom/ /stobs ldan mkhris pa bad kan rgyas/ /ma zhu'i nad dang rims dang skyug⑫ /tshad pas ⑪'khru dang snying nad spyocan/ /lus lci gregs mang bshang ⑫gci 'gags/ /yi ga 'chus sogs kyis na ba/ /'bring tsam sbom sogs phal cher ni/ /dang por smin dang drod bskyed bya/ /nad ni 'di dag gis nyam ⑪thag /spom dang stobs sogs chung ba la/ /bkres dang skom pas tshar bcad do/ /nad kyis nyam thag stobs 'bring brtan/ /ser ⑫bu tsha rtsol gyis smad na/ /nyam chung mi brta ⑪smos ci dgos/ /nyams smad bya ba brta ⑫mi bya—/ /brta bya nyams smad 'jam pos bya/ /yang na yul dang stobs sogs las—/ /rigs pas de ni nye bar spyad/ /brta bas stobs ni 'phel ba dang / /111—219

de yis bsgrub bya'i nad zad 'gyur/ / sgyung bas ①dbang gsal dri ma rnams/ /mi sri ②khong yang yi ga 'bye④/ /bkres dang skom pa lhan cig 'byung / /dang ga snying dang sgregs pa dag /nad kyi rtse zhil spro ba che/ /snyom bag med pa dag tu 'gyur/ /de dag tshad la sogs pa dang / /mi ldan sten ④par byed pa dag /rab sbom rab tu skem sogs 'gyur/ /de yang sman bcas bshad pa yin/ /tshul ni shin tu brta ba dang / /nyams smad de nyid las shes bya/ /shin tu tsho ches 'brum ⑤gcin snyi/ /rims dang dmu rdzing mtshan bar rdol/ /lus rmongs gcin sri be+e'u dusnabs chags/ /mdze la sogs pa mi bzad 'byung / /de la tshil dang rlung bad kan/ /sel bar byed pa thams cad phan/ /dzur na khre rgod ku lat+tha/ /nas dang sran chung mon sran sde'u⑦/ /dar ba dar rnying zho ga chu/ /sems las bya dang mi nyal bya/ /sbrang rtsi 'bras bu gsum ⑧pa'am/ /sle tres gla ⑨sgang a ru ra/ /skyer khaṇ+ḍa dang rtsa ba ni/ /chen po lnga dang gu gul dang / /brag zhun gyi ni sbyor ba dang / /ag ni man tha'i ⑩khu bcas phan/ /nas tshig 'khus thal byi dang ga⑪ /bca' sga lcags phye sbrang rtsi dang / /nas dang skyu ru'i phye ma yi/ /sbyor bas shin tu tsho nad sel/ /tsha gsum 'bras gsum pu tse ⑫shel—/ /shi kru byi dang bo ⑫sbri ra/ /shing ④kun go snyod kha ru tsha/ /la la phud dang 'u su dang / /kru trug tres ⑫dang ser po gnyis/ /bri ha gnyis dang chu rtsi mo—/ /ha pu sha dang pa ta dang / /ke pu ka yi rtsa ba ste/ /'di rnams phye ma mar sbrang rtsi/ /til mar dag ni cha snyoms pa/ /nas ⑩phye'i cha ni bcu drug bskyed—/ /sbyar ba 'thungs na de 'joms so/ /shin tu shas che'i ⑩bdag nyid kun—/ /gzhan yang de 'dra'i nad rnams dang / /snying nad mig ser sha bkra 111—220

dang / /lus dbugs mi bde sgog nad sel/ /blo dang yid gzhungs sems dran byed/ /zas 'ju pho ba'i drod kyang skyed/ /smyung drags rab skem mgo 'khor lud/ /skom dad che zhing yi ga 'chus/ /snum drod gnyid mig rna ba nyams| /khu ba gzi mdangs skad gsang ①zad/ /chu so snying klad byen pa brla / /dku ②do rtsib logs na rims sde'adebs/ /tshig mang stod du rlung nad 'jug / rmya zhing ④skyug bro rus tshigs na/ /bshang gci sri ba la sogs pa| /sgyung ba drags pas ⑤'byung bar 'gyur/ / rab tu dutsho bas skem nyid ⑦mchog /shin tu tsho drags ⑧pa yi sman/ / shin tu tshil ches me rlung sel/ /brta dang nyams smad yod ma yin/ /gang zhig mngar dang snum bag bza'/ /bsod bde dag gis skem pa sel/ /de las shin tu bzlog pa dag /nges par bsten pas sbom nyid sel/ /de la bza' btung sman rnams ni/ /⑨brta bar byed pa thams cad sbyar⑩/ /sems las med dang dga' ba dang / /nges par brta bar bya ba dang / /gnyid cher log pas skem pa yang / /phag dang 'dra bar lus rgyas gyur⑪/ /lus ni brtas shing tsho ⑫byed pa/ /sha dang 'dra ba gang yang med/ /sha mi za la ⑫sha za'i shas/ /lus ni shin tu brtas ⑩byed yin//sbom la nyams smad lci bas bya/ /de las bzlog pa skem la phan/ /nas dang gro ni gnyis ka la/ /de la ⑫'os par byed pas brtag /nad kyi dbye ba tha dad kyirka/ /gcod 'khru la sogs dbye ba yis/ /nad ltar tha dad gyur kyang ni/ /gso ba gnyis las yod ma yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcu bzhi pa'o// //111—221

de nas sbyang ba ①la stsogs pa sman gyi sde tshan 'dus pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o—/ /po son cha dang shing mngar dang / /ku ba kha bo nim pa dang / /bim pa ga gon bi sha la/ /dug mo nyung dang mur ba dang / /de ba da li byi dang ga /lcang ma tsi tra kru trug tres/ /ko sha pa ti ka rañdza/ /pi pi ling dang rgyam tsha dang / /shu dag sug smrel yungs kar te/ /'di dag sgyugs ②pa'i sman gyi sde/ /dan ti dang ni tri bid ta②/ /'bras bu gsum dang bi sha la/ /shang ki ni dang snu ha dang / /seng phrom dong ga ni li ni/ /khron bu dang ni kam pi l+ya/ /'o ma ba gcin 'khru bar byed/ /po son cha budang dug mo nyung / /ru rta de ba da ⑤li dang / /shing mngar shu dag rtsa ba bcu/ /thang shing ra sna la la phud/ /sha ta pus pa rjopa ta la/ /rgya sran nag po sbrang rtsi dang / /rgyam tsha lce tsha shing nye ro/ /'di dag mas gtong ⑦bkru sman te⑧/ /a ba marga byi dang gasti /tsha ba gsum dang skyer pa'i rtsa/ /su ra la dang shi ri ṣa/ /bri had shi kru'i ⑩sa bon dang / /seng ldeng ma du ka'i snying po⑪/ /rgyam tsha dngul rdo pha bong dreg /sug smel gnyis dang go snyod sbom/ /mgo bo'i ⑫nad sbyong byed pa yin/ /thang shing rgya spos ru rta dang / /rtsa ba bcu dang ba la gnyis/ /bi ra ta ri'i spyosman sder gtogs / /be+e da ri sogs rlung nad sel/ / drur ba ⑫dang ni byi tsher ba/ /nim pa ba sha ka'i lo ma/ /kha sral phre'u 'ol ma se/ /nye'u shing pa zhes bya dang //shi ta ba ki pri ⑫yang ku/ /n+ya go dha sogs shug pa sogs/ /sbi ra rnam gnyis pad+ma'i ze—/ /ban ⑫n+ya thal tres sogs mkhris sel/ /dong ga sogs dang arka ⑩sogs/ / muṅga sogs dang po ⑫son sogs/ /bye'u rug pa sogs gla sgang sogs/ /dug mo nyung sogs bad kan sel/ /dzi ⑩brnyi dang ram nye ba/ /111—222

me da ma hā me da dang / /muṅga ma sha hūṃpaṇi dang / /ldum bu zangs rtsi ba dang ni/ /dzi kyeb ka dang shing mngar te/ /sde 'di 'tsho byed ces bya yin/ /bi da ri dang e raṇ+ḍa / /prish+yi kha li pur+ṇa kyerna/ /de ba ha sa de ba dang / /paṇi gnyis dang kha sral dang / /'tsho byed lnga dang rtsa chung lnga(cho/ /thal tres dang ni lcang ma gyedang / / haṃ sa gyepa ti zhes bya rnams/ /bi da ri ⑦sogs 'di snying phan/ /nyam chung rlung dang mkhris pa sel/ /lus skem skran tshigs yan lag na/ /dbugs mi bde dang lud pa lu/ /sel bar byed pa'i sde tshan yin/ /thal tres dang ni pu shel tse thu/ /tang bal dang ni ma du ka /tsan+dan dkar dang dmar ba dang / /shing mngar pa ru sha ka rnams/ /tshad pa mkhris pa khrag rgyas dang / /skom dang rims kyis btab pa sel/ /shug pa puṇ+ḍa rī ⑨ka dang / / dṛt+t+waṃ ṛt+t+waṃ kyecu gang dang / /sring gi sle tres 'tsho byed bcu/ /nu zho skyed byed rlung mkhris lco1sel/ /nyam chung tshim byed brtas rke9byed la/ /'tsho byed ro tsa nyid du byed/ /pa ru sha dang 'bras bu gsum/ /rgun 'brum dang ni kad pa la//ka ta ⑫ka'i 'bras ra dza dan/ /se'u 'bru ba ra da du rnams/ /skom dad che dang gcin sri dang / /rlung gi nad rnams sel byed yin/ /añdza na dang pha li ni / /spang spos pad+ma ut+pa la/ /skyer khaṇ+ḍa dang sug smel dang / /shing mngar nā ga ge sar bcas/ /dug dang nang gi tsha ba dang / /mkhris pa rgyas pa sel bar byed/ /pa to la dang pu tse ⑩shel/ /tsan+dan dkar po mur ba dang / /sle tres skra lor snyebacas pa dag /bad kan mkhris pa mdze dang rims/ /dug dang skyug bro yi ga 'chus/ /mig ser gyi ni nad rnams 'joms/ /sle tres dang ni shug pa dang / /nim pa 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / /tsan+dan dmar po 111—223
