zhes bya rnams/ /mkhris pa dang ni bad kan dang / /rims dang skyug bro lus tsha dang / /skom dad che sel ①me drod skyed/ /dong ga dang ni dug mo nyung / /ka ka tig ta pa ta li/ /nim pa sle tres drur ba skedang / /mur ba be+e dang ka ta gdang / /pa tha ci sprigs she rgya dhika /ka rañdza gnyis pa to la/ /lo ma bdun pa kru trug ⑤tres/ /su ṣa byi ta po son chaX/ /sa ha ra tsa zhes bya dang / /rgya shug gi ni 'bras bu rnams/ /de ni slon bro mdze nad dang / /dug dang rims dang bad kan dang / /g.yan pa dang ni gcin snyi dang / /rma ⑦red pa rnams sbyong bar byed/ /a sa na dang ti ⑧ni sha /stag pa shwe ta stib ha dang / /ka ta ra dang seng ldeng ⑩dang / / ban da ⑪dang ni shing sha ba/ /a dza sring ga ⑫tsan+dan gsum/ /ta la a kar pa la sha /sa la kha ⑫ra pa tra dang / /dha ba ka ling ka spro ④tog /tsha ga karna bad tsha ka /tha ram ⑫zhes ni bya ba ste//a sa na sogs de rnams kyis⑩/ /sha bkra mdze ⑩nad bad kan dang / /srin nad skya rbab gcin snyi dang / /tsho ches nad ni sel bar byed/ /ba ra na she rgya ⑫ka gnyis/ /nye ⑪shing tsi tra mo ra ta⑫/ /bil ba añdza ⑪sring gi dang / /bri ⑫ha ti ni rnam gnyis dang / /ka rañdza gnyis dza ya gnyis/ / shi kru ku ⑫sha ru rta 'o / /ba ra ni ④sogs bad kan tshil/ /me drod chung dang rlung nad 'khyims/ /klad pa la brten ④nad sel zhing / /skran dang khong 'bras 'joms pa yin/ / ru sha ka ⑪shing kun spangs ma⑦/ /rgyam tsha brag zhun ⑫nag tshur gnyis/ /gcin sri rde'us 'gags pa dang / /skran dang tshil ches bad kan sel/ /be+e lan ta ra a ra ni/ /spra tog ⑥bri sha sru sru'i rtsa/ /i ⑩ka ta dang gze ma dang //sa ha ra dza ⑪ba na dang / /ka sha dṛk+ṣa ⑫da ni dang / /'dam bu ku sha rnam ⑫111—224

gnyis dang / /kun+d+ra ①dang ni kha sral dang / /ba lu ka dang mo ra ta/ /ku ru ta dang ka ram ②pa/ /lcam pa zhes bya'i sman sde 'di/ /be len ta sder la sogs pa/ /rlung las gyur pa'i nad 'joms shing / / rde'u'i phre'u yod pa ④dang / /gcin sri ba yi nad rnams sel/ /seng ⑤phrom sha ba ra ro tra/ /pa la sha rjodang rnyin dzi ni/ /thang shing kad pa la ra sna/ /ka tam pa dang chu shing dang / /e la ba lu a shwa ⑦ka /pa ri pe ⑧la mo tsa ka /'di ni seng phrom sogs zhes ⑨bya/ /tshil ches bad kan sel ba'i sde/ /mngal nad 'joms shing 'khru ba gcod/ /mdog bzang ()dug nad sel byed yin/ / arka ⑪dang ni a ral ka⑫ /nā ga darnyi bi sha bye⑫/ /ga bra ra sna bri sha la④/ /a ba marga ka rañdza/ /ka ka da ri ka rañdza/ /gi ri kar ⑫gnyis e gu dang / /arka ⑩la sogs sde tshan 'di/ /bad kan tshil ches dug rnams sel/ /srin nad dang ni mdze nad 'joms/ /khyad par du ni rma la phan/ /bye'u rug rnams ⑩gnyis ku the ra/ /ka la ma la byi dang ga⑫ /kha ra pa tra kad pa la⑪/ /bri sha kaṇi sha kun tidu/ /ske tshe ka pid tha'i lo ma/ /ga bra mon sne'u ka mu ka /rkang ⑥mar bi sha muṣ+ṭṛ dang / /bu sri na dang 'bam po'o/ /bye'u ⑫rug pa la sogs pa'i ⑫sde/ /bad kan tshil ches srin nad sel/ /cham pa yi ga 'chus lud pa/ /dbugs mi ⑫bde 'joms rma red sbyong / / muska ka dang ⑫snu ha dang / /'bras bu gsum dang tsi tra ka /pa la sha dang dha ⑪ba dang / /shing sha pa zhes bya ba rnams/ /skran dang gcin nad rde'u chags/ /skya rbab dang ni tshil ches nad/ /bad kan rgyas dang khu ba yi⑦/ /nad rnams sel bar byed pa yin—/ /dug mo nyung dang mur ba dang / /bar gi ⑪dang ni pu tse ⑥shel/ /111—225

na le sham dang bong nga dkar/ /chu sgog lhasug smel pa ta dang / /nyungs 3kar zi ra u ra lu/ /a za mo dang po son cha ③/ /shu dag zi ra nag po dang / /shing rīkun dang ni byi dang ga⑤ /pa shu gan+dha tsha ba lnga/ /rlung dang bad kan tshil ches dang / /cham pa skran dang rims dang gzer/ /gzhang 'brum gyi ni nad rnams sel/ /shu dag gla ñtsasgang thang shing dang / /dong gra bong ⑦nga a ru ra/ /ser po gnyis dang shing mngar dang / / kṛṣ+ṭa paṇi dug mo nyung / /shu dag yung ba la sogs sde/ /be+e'u snabs tshad pas tsu7'khru smin gcod—/ /tshil ches bad kan rgyas rlung 'khyil/'u / /nu ma'i nad rnams sel bar byed/ /pri yabyu dang ra gan dud/ /lig bu mig dang stang 17 zil dang / /lcim ⑫rtsa pad+ma ge sar dang / /btsod ⑫dang ya ba sha ka dang / /shal ma li dang de'i khu ba 6/ /sa mang ga dang pu lkun ma/ /tsan+dan da ta ka'i me tog /saṃ pa sha dang shing mngar dang / /na ma ka ra tu ni shing / /rgya skyegs shing dang kad tshu rami/ /seng phrom bil rkang da ta ⑩ki/ /pad+ma'i ge sar ka tang ka /pri lhorngeyang saṃ pas+tha /)sde gnyis/ /zhu ba'i tshad pa'i 4 ) 'khru ba sel/ /'byor byed mkhris pa dag la phan/ /rma yang 'tshob par byed pa yin/ /gla sgang shu dag kru trug khutres/ /ser po gnyis dang kha ba gnyis / /go bye pa tha ( rte'abras bu gsum/ /bong nga dkar nag ru rta dang //sug smel dang ni shu dag rnams/ /nu zho mngal nad dri ma sel/ /n+ya gro dha dang a shwat+tha/ /u dus+thā bhe sher seng phrom gnyis/ /'dzam bu gnyis dang ardzu na—/ /ka pi ta dang kad pa 3la/ / bla ga sha skye.a mra lcang ma dang / /pi ya la dang pa la sha /narnyi rgya shug ka dam pa/ /bi ra shing mngar ma du ka/111—226

n+ya gro dha sogs sde tshan 'di/ /rma ①'tsho 'khru gcod chag grugs sbyor/ /tshil ches khrag mkhris skom dad che/ /mngal gyi nad rnams sel bar byed/ /e la gnyis dang du ru ka /ru rta garnya pri yang ku/ /spang spos ②pa la bya ma ka /spri ①ka tso ra tso tsa rjodang / /shing tsha garnya bha dra ⑤dang / /rgya spos rjobo la sbe ⑦ne+e ya/ /rgya mtsho'i sbra ba chu srin sen/ /thang shing dang ni a ka ru/ /gur gum shi ri ba sa ka /tsan+dan gu gul lce ⑧pog dkar/ /bur ⑨na ma dang kun du ru/ /nā ga ge sar zhes bya'o/ /e la sogs ste ⑩rlung bad kan/ /dug rnams sel zhing mdog gsal byed/ /g.yan pa thor bu'i nad rnams dang / /sha bkra bas ldag ⑪sel bar byed/ /sha ma darnyi dra ⑫brnyi/ /ku ta ra na kra mu ka /shaṃ gi ⑫ni dang sa ta ④la/ /khron bu dang ni ga bak+ṣi/ /su dha k+ṣ-i ra kam+bi bye⑫/ /sle tres dong ga ka rañdza/ / baṣ+ṭa an+t+ra shi kru ⑩dang / /a mra ⑩shing ro tsha'i 'bras bu/ /dur byid la sogs sde tshan 'di/ /skran dang dug dang yi ga 'chus/ /bad kan dang ni snying nad dang / /gcin sri ba yi nad rnams 'joms/ /de ltar sum cu rtsa gsum bshad/ /sde tshan de las ma rnyed na/ /de dang mtshungs pa gzhan dang sbyar/ /mi 'dra'i sbyor ba spang bar bya/ /sde tshan de dag gnod dang gnod bya sogs ltos tespyo/ /cho ga bskol dang snum dang bsdams ⑪pa la sogs ldan/ /btung dang snar gtang mas gtong dang ni ⑫phyi rol du/ /bsku zhing byugs pas shin tu gso dka'i nad kun 'joms/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcwa lnga pa'o// //111—227

de nas snum gyi cho ga ①bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /snum byed sman rnams phal cher ni/ /lci zhing bsil la skekhong 'khru snum/ /rdul ①dang bral la mnyen ④zhing brlan/ /de las bzlog pa rtsub byed yin/ /zhun mar rkang dang tshil til mar/ /snum rnams kyi ni mchog rab 'dod/ /de dag las kyang zhun mar ni/ /sbyor rjes ⑤'jug pas mchog yin no/ /de dag sngon bzhin mkhris pa sel/ /phyi ma bzhin du cig shos sel/ /mar bas til mar lci de bas/ /tshil de tshil bas ⑦rkang lci'o/ /de las gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi/ /zung dang gsum pa che zhes bya/ /dugs bya sbyang bya chang bud med/ /rtsol chags sems las che ba dang / /rgan po byis pa stobs chung sdegs⑦/ /rtsub dang khrag dang khu ⑧ba zad/ /rlung nad kyis nyen rab rib dang / /shin tu dbye dka' la snum bya/ /shin tu drod chung rab drod che/ /shin tu sbom dang rid pa dang / /brla rengs tshad 'khru ma zhu dang / /sgog nad dbyig dug dmu rdzing dang / /brgyal skyugs ⑨bad kan yi ga 'chus/ /skom dad chang nad kyis nyen dang / /dus min bu skyes sna sman dang / /mas gtong ⑩bkru sman byas la min/ /de la blo dran ⑩yid gzhungs sogs/ /'dod pa rnams la zhun mar bsngags/ /rmen bu bad kan srin bu dang / /tshil ches rlung nad yod pa dang / /lus yang mkhrang ⑫'dod lto srab ⑫pa'i/ /lus can rnams la til mar phan/ /rlung dang nyi tshan lam bud med/ /khur dang rtsol bas lus zungs zad/ /rtsub nyon mongs bzod me drod rno④/ /rtsa sgo rlung 'gags lhag ma phan/ /tshigs ⑫dang rus pa gnad rnams dang / /lto na mes tshig rma byung lhung / /mngal dang rna ⑫ba glad nad la⑩/ /tshil yang mchog tu phan pa yin/ /til mar dbyar phan 117—228

zhun mar ni/ /dbyar mtha' rngu de bzhin dpyid kyang bsngags/ /thun mong dus la snum rnams ni/ /nyin mor ②nyi ma gsal tshe bsngags/ /rings skel dgun yang til mar gtang / /tsha ba'i dus su'ang mar tshan ④gtang / /mkhris pa rlung dang mkhris par bcas/ /ldan pa la rnguyang mtshan mo nyid/ /mtshan mo las gzhan rlung bad kan/ /nyin par sbyar bas mkhris nad 'gyur/ /bza' hūṃ sogs zas dang mas gtong ④dang / /sna nas gtang bsku mkhur zu bkang dbo/ /mgo bsku rna mig dgang ba yipya/ /snum ni rigs par dpyad ⑩par bya/ /ro yi dbye ba re ⑪re yis/ /drug cu rtsa bzhir rnam par brtags⑩ / /snum ni gzhan gyis zil spyoganon zhing / /chung ngu dgos ⑩pas rim par bshad/ /ji skad bshad pa'i rgyu med pas/ /dngas ma btung la dpyad spyomi dgos/ /snum gyi ⑩las ni myur bsgrubs ⑩pas/ /snum de'i cho ga mchog yin no/ /gang zhig thun ni gnyis dang bzhi/ /brgyad kyis rim bzhin 'ju spyo'agyur ba/ /tshad chung 'bring dang che ba ste/ /de las chung ngu bza' ba mchog /nad la sogs la brtags nas ni/ /thog mar shin tu chung ngu bza'/ / snga de'i zas de ⑪zhu nyid na/ /sbyang phyir dwangs ma mang du btung / /zhi bya ltogs byas rjo zas med par—/ /'bring tshad tsam ni bsngags pa yin/ /brta 0ba sha dang sha khu sogs/ /de yang 'bras chan ⑤nyung bcas pa/ /byis pa rgan po skom gyis gdungs 0/ /snum 'gras ④chang dad che ba dang / /bud med snum ni rtag skebasten dang / /drod chung bde dang dka' mi bzod/ /lto snyi nad dkyel ⑫chung tsha dus/ /nyam chung ba la bsngags pa yin/ /dang po bar dang zas rjes zos/ /lus kyi smad par stod las byung ⑦/ /nad rnams sel zhing lus kyi stobs/ /bskyed pa'i 111—229

rim bzhin byed pa yin/ /de ni legs par smin phyir dang / /khar chags pa ni phyi ba'i phyir/ /snum dag 'thungs ①rjes chu tshan btung / /e raṇa ba la ta kar min/ /zhu 'am ma zhu'i dogs skyes na/ /slar yang chu tshan btung bar bya /des ni gregs pa dag 'gyur zhing / /de las khong yang yi gar 'ong / /nang par 'thung ngam 'thungs pa dang / /'thungs par gyur tshe kha zas ran/ /gsher dro bad kan mi skyed dang / /shin tu snum min 'dres min bza'②/ /kha lag chu dron kyis bkru zhing / /bud med mi bsten mtshan mo nyal/ /shugs dgag drag shul las rnams dang / /khro dang mya ngan nyi ④tshan grang / /ser ༷bu'i khar 'dug rta zhon 'gro/ /mang smra rab mtho'i stan la 'dug /sngas ⑤ni rab mtho rab dma' dang / /nyin nyal dud rdul gnas pa spang / /gang gis rjonyin mo 'thungs gyur pa/ /de ltar gzhan la'ang spang bar bya/ /rim 'di las rnams thams cad dang / /nad zad pa la ⑦spyad par bya/ /zhi ba'i snum gyi nyer spyad ni/ /bkru sman btang ba lta bur bya/ /lto snyi zhun mar zhag gsum btung / /lho sra ba yis zhag bdun btung / /yang na ji srid snum par btung / /de phan chad ni goms par 'gyur/ /rlung ni bder rgyu skeme drod 'bar / /bshang ba snum zhing mi sri la/ /snum mi 'dod cing snyoms 'gyur ba//snum legs yin te rtsub go bzlog /snum drags ⑨pa yis skya ba dang / /sna dang kha rkub las 'dzag 'gyur/ /tshad dang mi ldan dus min gnod/ /zas dang spyod lam log pa yis/ /snum chos byed skrang gzhang 'brum dang / /khong rmya ⑩rengs shing sems myos dang / /g.yan pa mdze dang rims skyug gzer/ /lto sbos ⑪mgo 'khor la sogs 'gyur/ /de la bkres skom skyug sman dugs⑫/ /111—230

zas skom sman ni rtsub pa dang / /dar ba chang rnying ①tshod ma dang / /'bru rgod ci ⑦tse khre rgod dang / /sbrang rtsi 'bras gsum pi pi ling / /ba gcin gu gul a ru ra/ /nad dmigs so so ji bzhin du/ /snum las nad gyur bcos thabs yin| /rtsub pa dag ni sgyung byas dang / /shin tu byas dang 'dra ba yin/ /slon ④dro skams sa rjolas byung snum/ /sha khu btung zhing dugs dpyad ⑤bya/ /khrus byed pa 'am sgyug sman gtong / /snum byas zhag gsum gnas par bya/ /nyin zhag gzhan pa gcig cig ni/ /de bskyed pa yis bad kan skyed/ /sha che tshil che bad kan mang / /me yi 'ju drod mi snyoms dang / /snum la goms pa'i snum bya rnams/ /de ni sngon du rtsub chos bya/ /de nas snum byas sbyangs gyur rjon/ /de la snum nad mi 'byung ngo / /snum la goms par gyur pas na⑦/ /dri ma 'thon ⑧par nus pa yin/ /byes pa rgan po la sogs pa/ /snum spang ⑨bar ni mi nus la/ /skye ⑩bar mi byed sbyor ba 'dis/ /'phral du snum ni sbyar bar bya/ /de la mar brngos sha khu dang / /mar ⑩dang brngos pa'i thug ⑫pa'am/ /til che snum bcas bu ram chung / /bcas dang kri ⑫sa ra dang ni/ /'o thug mar mang dro ba'am/ /bu ram zho dang bcas pa 'am/ /thug pa snum ni bzhi pa la / /lnga pa 'bras dang ldan par bya/ /bdun pa de dag 'phral snum bya/ /snum rnams lan tshwa cher btab pa/ /de ni bad kan skyed rtsub min/ /phra ⑫zhing dro la lus khyab byed/ /mdze dang skran ⑫nad gcin snyi la/ /bu ram bcas bza' ⑩'o ma sha/ /til dang ma sha chang dang zho/ /snum bya'i don du mi bya'o/ /'bras gsum pi pi ling gu gul/ /a ru ra la sogs bskol bas/ /de dag snum la ji bzhin du/ /gnod pa med par sbyar bar bya/ /nad kyis 111—231

nyam ①chung gyur pa las②/ /lus drod stobs bskyed nus pa btang / /skyes bu snum la brten ①par byed pa rnams/ /nang gi drod 'bar khong pa dag pa dang / /lus zungs 'phral brta stobs dang mdog bzang ldan/ /dbang brtan rgas sra lo brgya thub par bshad/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcu drug pa'o// //de nas dugs kyi cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /dugs bsro ④bcing dang tha mal pa/ /chu dugs dbye bas rnam pa bzhi/ /bsro ⑤ba gos dang lcags dang ni/ /lag mthil la sogs mer bsros rjobasro/ /bcing ba shu dag sbang ma dang / /thang shing sha ta ⑦put+pa dang / /'bru kun dri rnams ra sna dang / /e raṇ+ḍa'i rtsa shu ⑧dag dang / /snum bag tsha dang dar ba dang / /'o mas sbrus shing tsha cher btab/ /rlung lus ⑨byung ba 'ba' zhig sel/ /bad kan 'dres la bye'u ⑩rug sogs/ /mkhris pa 'dres la shug ⑪sogs kyis/ /glan ⑫pa zhes bya yang dang yang / /dkri ⑫ba snum zhing nus pa dro/ /spu 'jam lpags rul min ④pas dkri/ /ma rnyed rlung 'joms lo ma dang / /dar dang snam bu ras kyis dkri/ /mtshan mo dkris pa nyin par dgol⑫/ /nyin par dkris ⑩pa mtshan mo dgrol/ /tha mal pa ni khur ⑩ba dang / /bong ba gyo mo rdo sa phye/ /gso ma'i lo ma 'bru rnams dang / /lci ril phye spyom phub ma rnams/ /thabs rnams du mas legs bsros pa/ /yul dang dus las dpags te sbyar/ /chu dugs shi kru ⑪ba ra na/ /e raṇ+ḍa dang ka raspru/ /byi'u ⑩rug pa dang ardza ka /shi ri sha dang ba sha ka /'od ma arka ⑪ma la ti/ /ya ba sha ka'i lo ma bkru⑫/ /111—232

shu dag la sogs sman rnams dang / /gsher sa chur gnas sha rnams dang / /rtsa bcu nad dmigs ji bzhin du/ /so so'am lhan cig sbyar nas ni/ /snum ldan chang dang tsha dang ni/ /'o ma chu sogs kyis btsos la/ /bum pa'am spu gu ring po ni/ /bkang la nad kyis nyam thag pa'i/ /lus ni gos kyis dkris nas su/ /ci bde bar ni snum chu blugs/ /lus la rlung nad zhugs gyur pa/ /de nyid kyis 'dir bkang snod du/ /nad pa zhugs te gnas na ni/ /gcin sri gzhang 'brum sogs nad sel/ /rlung med phyi nang snum ①bcas shing / /zas 'ju'i dus su dugs dpyad bya/ /nad dang nad pa yul dus kyi/ /dbang las chung 'bring chen po bya/ /bad kan kyis nyen rtsub dugs ④bya/ /bad kan rlung la ④rtsub snum bya/ /rlung ni ma zhu'i gnas zhugs dang / /bad kan zhu ba'i gnas brten ④la/ /gnas kyi dbang gis rtsub dugs dang / /de bzhin snum sngar ⑤'gro dugs bya/ /sta zur dag dang mig dang snying / /rlig par ⑥nyung ngu'am bya ba min/ /dugs kyis grang tshudang zug gzer bral/ /yan lag mnyen ⑤par gyur pa dang / /dal gyis mnyes la khrus byas la⑨/ /de nas snum gyi cho ga bsten⑩/ /dugs drags ⑪pa yis khrag mkhris 'khrugs/ /skom brgyal skad 'gags yan lag 'jums⑩/ /mgo 'khor tshigs na 6rims 'debs shing / / tshi gu dmar ⑫po tal til snang / /lums kyis sgyugs bro spyobar 'gyur te/ /der ni zhi bya'i sman gyis gso/ /dugs dang thal sman me btsa' dang / /tshad 'khru skyugs spe9bro brgyal nad gso/ /dugs ni phal cher lci dro rno/ /de las gzhan pa zhi byed yin/ /gsher zhing brtan 'khru snum pa dang / /rtsub cing sra ba dugs sman yin/ /'jam dang rtsub dang zhi 'byar ⑩bag /gsher bag de 111—233

ni sel byed yin/ /mdor na phal cher kha ba dang / /bska dang mngar ba de sman yin/ /zhi zhing rtse bcil stobs thob 'gyur/ /ji skad bshad pa'i nad rnams zad/ /bcil drags pags pa rtsa 'khums shing ①/ /'dar snying kha 'gram nad du 'gyur/ / rkang mchu dze+elag pa pags nag 'gyur/ /bcil drags pa yi chand du bshad/ /shin tu sbom dang rtsub pa dang / /nyam chung brgyal bar gyur pa dang / /dugs drags bcos dgos glo rdol stidang / /skem dang chang nad kyis btab dang / /rab rib dmu rdzing shu ba mched/ /mdze nad 'or nad rlung mkhris dang / /'o ma zho dang mar sbrang rtsi/ /'thungs dang bkru sman btang ba dang / /lus nad tshigs ltadang gzhang nad yod/ /khro dang mya ngan 'jigs pas nyen/ /bkres skom mig ser skya rbab dang / /gcin nad mkhris nad zla mtshan 'dzag /sbrum dang bu skyes dugs mi bya/ /nad tshabs che na 'jam por bya/ / lud pa cham ⑥pa dbugs mi bde/ /skyigs ⑦pu lto sbos bshang ④'gags dang / /skad 'gags rlung gi ⑨nad rnams dang / /bad kan be snabs 'khyil zhing lci/ /lus rengs rked pa ⑪ rtsib logs dang / /sgur dang lto nad 'gram nad dang / /rlig nad lhormeskrangs dang da rgan dang / /rtsol dang rlung nad kyis ⑫zug dang / /gcin 'gags thor bu rmen 0bu dang / /khu ba bkag dang rlung 'khyims ④la/ /de yi sman gyi dbye ba yis/ /dugs ni so so ji bzhin bya/ /dugs phan me yis bsro ⑪ min pa/ /rlung nad tshil dang bad kan can/ /rlung med khang par rtsol ba dang / /gos lci ba dang 'jigs pa dang / /dkri dang stobs 'gyed khro ⑫ba dang / /chang mang bkres dang nyi tshan bzhag /nad gang nad 111—234

khrol tsaganas pa'i lus zungs ༄snye/gnas/ /rtsar song rkang lag rus pa'i nang song ba'i—/ /nad de dugs kyis bsrung (— )bar byas nas ni/ /khong du bsdus la sbyang bas dpyis ④dbyung bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas skyugs tso)sman dang bkru sman gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o//bad kan nad dam 'dres pa yi/ /bad kan rgyas la sgyugs — sman gtang / /de bzhin mkhris pa bkru sman bya/ /rims sar tshad 'khru thur du ni/ /mkhris pa khrag 'khru glo gcong dang / /mdze dang gcin nad 'brum thor bu/ /rkang bam /chami dran lud pa can/ /dbugs mi bde snying 'phar 'bras mched/ /nu ma'i nad dang ro stod nad/ /khyad par du ni skyug sman bya/ /sgyug sman mi gtong —8/sbrum khong rtsub/ /bkres dang rtag tu sdug bsngal ba/ /byis pa rgan skem sbom snying na/ /glo skam smras dang nyam /9 chung dang / /rtag tu slon dang mcher pa na/ /rab rib lto na srin bu yod/ /rlung khrag 'dren mar gyen du 'byung / /so na mas gtong skad 'dzer 1 dang / /gcin sri dmu rdzing skran can dang / / slon dka' tsho1drod che gzhang 'brum can/ /rtug skam mgo 'khor rtsib logs sraske/ /rtsib logs zug dang rlung can no/ /de dag dug 'thungs /7 ma zhu dang / /mi 'phrod /7/zas zos ma gtogs so/ /rtag tu slon pa yan chad dang / /phal cher ma zhu'i rims dag dang / /ma zhu ba ni thams cad la'ang / /dud pas bdug pa'i 15las kun spangs 7/ /bkru sman gyis gso skran gzhang 'brum / /'brum bu mig ser gzhogs 1 phyed lci/ /rims rnying dmu rdzing /77 dzi rte5

dbyig dug dang / /sgyugs ①dang mcher nad skya rbab dang / /long nad rab rib sngon por gyur/ /mchi 'dzag zhu ba'i gnas na zug /mngal dang khu ba'i gnas kyi nad/ /khong nad gtogs ②dang srin nad rma/ /dreg nad nam tshong sneyan chad nad/ /gcin sri ④bshang ba 'gags pa dang / /slon bya mdze gcin nad sogs yin/ /khrus mi bya ba rims gsar dang / /drod chung khrag mkhris thur du 'byung ⑤/ /rmas dang gzhang nad tshad pas du'akhru/ /khong du mtshon ⑦lus lto sra dang / /snum ches pa dang skem ches pa'o/ /de nas thun mong dus su ni/ /cho ga bzhin du snum gyis nyen⑧/ /nya dang ma sha til sogs kyisaske/ /nang par slon ⑨bya'i bad kan skyed/ /mtshan mo gnyid log zas legs zhu/ /snga dro'i dang por bkra ⑩shis byas/ /zas ma zos pa'am cung zad snum—/ /thug pa ⑪zhun mar ldan par ⑫btung / /byis pa rgan po ⑫nyams stobs chung / /sman stobs chung ba nad dbang las/ /chang 'o bu ram shing sha khu—/ /nad dmigs ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha dang ldan pa/ /sman tshad lto ba las dpags te/ /sman la sngags ni mngon bzlas ⑫la/ /sgog mar phyin pa'i ⑫bar du blud/ /tshangs pa ⑩skye dgu'i bdag dang tha skar bu/ /drag po dbang po nyi zla sa me rlung / /drang srong rnams kyi ⑩tshogs dang bcas pa dang / /'byung po'i tshogs kyis khyed ni bsrung ⑫bar shog /drang srong rnams kyi bcud kyis len pa dang / /lha rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi lta bu dang / /klu mchog rnams kyi bdud rtsi lta bur ni/ /khyod la sman 'di nye bar gnas gyur cig/oṃ na mo bha ga ba te/ /bhe ṣa bye ⑪gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya⑩/arta te/ saṃ myag saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ hai ṣa bye hai ṣa dz+re ma hā dzhai ṣa dz+re/111—236

rā dza ①sa muṅga te swā hā/ shar du kha bstan 'thung du bzhug /'thungs nas de la sems dmigs te/ /yud tsam bsdad la dang gar ②'khyil/ /mchil ma de nas slon du gzhug /ma gnod ④par ni sor mos sam yang na chu ba 'jam po yis/ /skog ma lce'u chung ma snad bya/ /skyug mi rjobro bar mi drang ngo / /'byung bar bzlog pa slon ⑤par bya/ /pus mo dang mnyam stan la gnas / /de ni slon tshe glolgeganyis dang / /'phral ba dag nas brtenashepar bya//de bzhin lte ba btsir ba dang / /rgyab nas gyen du mnye bar bya/ /de ltar bad kan rno drod ⑧kha/ /mkhris pa mngar dang bsil bas ⑨slon/ /rlung 'dres bad kan snum pa dang / /skyur dang lan tshwa dag gis slon/ /ji srid bad kan rgyun chad pa'am/ /mkhris pa snang ⑩gi bar du skyugs⑪/ /shugs dal pi pi ⑫ling skyu ru⑫/ /yungs kar rgyam tsha chu dag gis/ /yang dang yang ni slon ⑫du gzhug/de ni slon par ma gyur pa'am/ /sdod pa dang bcas slon pa 'am/ /sman ni 'ba' zhig byung gyur na/ /sbyor nyes de ni mchil ma mang / /g.yan pa thor bu rims sogs 'byung / / bder skyugs spyobad kan mkhris pa dang / /rlung ni rim kyis ⑩'byung bar 'gyur/ /sbyor ba legs yin sbyor drags pas/ /dbu ⑩ba tshon can khrag 'drar snang / /slon nas khong rmya spyolus tsha dang / /shog skam ⑪mgo 'khor mig mi mthong / /rlung nad mi bzad ldan gyur ⑥zhing / /srog gi khrag 'byung 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sbyor ba legs pas slon na ni/ /yud tsam ngal gso dud pa gsum/ /gang yang rung bas bdugs phyupa dang / /de'i ⑫'og snum gyi ⑫spyod pa bstan/ /de nas dgongs ka'am ⑥nang par ni/ /bkres tshe chu dron gyis bkru la/ /sā ⑫lu rtsa snar 'bras kyi ⑪ni/ /thug pa la sogs rim 111—237

—bzhin bsten/ /thug pa gar g.yos 3)ma byas pa'i/ /khu ba sha khu gsum dang gnyis dang gcig /mchog dang bar ma tha ma'i sbyong bas sbyang /kye/ /mi yis zas kyi dus su rim bzhin spyad/ /dper na che chung rtswa —dang lci sogs kyis//rnam par sbar na rim gyis 0)mched pa na/ /che zhing brtan la 7)thams cad mched par nus/ /sbyangs pa'i nang me thug sogs kyis de bzhin/ /slon tshad chung dang 'bring dang chen po ni/ /bzhi dang drug dang lan brgyad slon bupar 'dod—/ /de nyid bcu dang nyis ldab sum ldab 'khru/ /bre gang de bzhin nyis peldab bzhi ldab 'gyur/ /skyug sman mthar mkhris bkru sman las byed dang / /bad kan mthar dbyung 'khru ba mchog tu bshad/ /'khru ba gnyis gsum bshang dang bcas ma gtogs(// /'khru ba gzhal te slon la 'thungs ma gtogs⑨/ /de nas slon ⑩pa de la ni/ /slar yang snum dang dugs byas te/—/spe/ /bad kan dus 'das lto shes nas/ /legs par bkru sman gtang bar bya/ /mkhyes pa mang zhing lto snyi la/ /'o mas kyang ni bkru bar byed/ /rlung shas che zhing lto sra na//dur byid sogs kyis kyang bkru dka'/ /bkru sman mkhris la mngar dang bska/ /bad kan la ni kha bas bya7/ /rlung la snum bro 7lan tshwa can/ /mi 'khru na ni chu tshan blud/ /lag pa bsros gepas de yi ni/ /lto ba legs par dugs bya'o/ /ma 'khrus de zhag 7ldang zas zos/ /nyi ma gnyis par be+er yang btung / /lto ba rab sra snum dag ni/ /zhag bcu'i bar du yang btung bas/ /slar yang snum dang 1thodugs kyis ni/ /lus sbyangs nas ni bkru sman gyis/ /sbyor ba legs par brtags pa dang / /sngar gyi nyes pa dran par bya/ /snying dang lto na yi ga 'chus/ /bad kan mkhris pa glongs pa dang / /g.yan pa lus tsha thor 771 238

bu dang / /cham pas 'debs shing bshang rlung 'gags6)/ /sbyor ba nyes pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /sbyor legs ji skad bshad go bzlog /bshang ba ④mkhris pa bad kan rlung / / rim gyis 'khru zhing 'byung ba ①na/ /bad kan mkhris pa med (pechu 'khru/ /skya zhing rnag dang khrag dang bcas gru/ /yang na sha bkrus lta bu 'amaske/ /tshil gyi dum bu 'dra nyid dam/ /gzhang 'byung skom dad che ba dang / /mgo 'khor mig ni phugs su bros/ /bkru sman drags pas ( )'byung ba yin/ /de bzhin skyug sman drags ⑦nad 'byung / /legs par 'khrus pa de la ni/ /dud pas bdug pa ma gtogs ⑧pa'i/ /cho ga sgyug sman dang mtshungs pas/ /de nas slon dang 'dra bar bya/ /zas la rim gyis spyad ⑨nas ni/ /de 'og nar ma'i kha zas bsten/ /sman 'thungs me drod chung ba dang / /ma dag nad kyis rmya ba ⑩dang / /zhu ba'i mtshan ma ma mthong na/ /de ni nyin par smyung ⑪byas la/ /snum dang dugs ⑫dang sman rnams kyis/ /glongs ⑫pa'i nad kyis nyen mi 'gyur④/ /sbyangs dang khrag ni 'byung ba dang / /snum mchog ⑫la sbyar smyung ⑩ba yis/ /me drod zhan pa nyid 'gyur te/ /de bas thug spyosogs rim gyis ⑫spyad—/ /bad kan mkhris pa bri zhing chung / /chang 'thungs rlung dang mkhris pa che—/ /de la thug spyopa mi blud kyi/ /brta ba la sogs rim pa phan/ /skyug sman ma zhu bar nad 'byin/ /bkru sman zhu nas 'byin pa yin/ /de yi phyir na skyug sman dag /zhu ba la ni bsdad mi dgos/ /steng dang 'og tu 'byung rigs pas—/ /gang tshe phyin ci log gyur na/ /de tshe sgyugs ḍa gel rkang par ni/ /chu dron dag gis ⑪blugs par bya/ /lus kyi stod dz+wani chu grang 2steblugs/ /'khru ba la ni de las bzlog /gang zhig nyam 80chung nad mang dang / /nad smin pa 111 239

yis rang nyid ni/ /'khru bar byed la 'khru ba nitshu/ /kha zas byen ②la der 'khrur gzhug /sngar sbyangs pas ni nyam ①chung dang / /nad kyi dkyel chung ④lus zad mi④/ /lto ba rjosra snyi mi shes la/ /sman ni 'jam zhing chung ngu blud/ /de mang spyo'athungs pa mchog yin gyi/ /gzhan du dgos 'a)pa bcas mi rung / /nyam ⑨chung pa yi nad mang pospyo/ /g.yos gyur cung zad cung zad cig /sman ni 'jam pos lan mang zhig /de ni nyung 'gyur zhi bar bya/ /ma btsal de ni yun ring du/ /nyon mongs pa'am gsod par 'gyur/ /me drod chung dang lto sra la/ /thal sman rgyam ⑪tsha mar bcas pas/ /me yi drod ni bskyed nas su/ /rlung dang bad kan bsal bar bya/ /rtsub cing rlung mang lto sra dang ⑫/ /rtag tu rtsol ba'i tshul can dang / /me drod rab tu che la sman/ /mi 'khru bar ni zhu bar 'gyur/ /de la sngar ni 'jam rtsi btang / /de nas snum pa'i bkru sman bya//sman ni rnon po'i reng bu yis/ /bshang ba cung zad dbyung bar bya/ /dri ma legs par 'khrus nas ni/ /snum 'khru ⑫bde bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dug gis phog na ⑫thor bu 'byung ⑫/ /mdze dang 'or nad me dbal dang / /mig ser skya rbab za khus nyen/ /ha cang snum ches sbyang mi bya/ /kun la bkru sman snum bag gtang ⑩/ /snum gyis zhen ⑩la rtsub pa gtang spyo/ /skyug sman la sogs las rnams la/ /slar yang bar skabs bar skabs su/ /snum dang dugs kyi cho ga bya/ /snum rjes la ni stobs bskyed bya/ /lus las nad rnams bsal ba ni/ /gos kyi dri ma 'khru dang mtshungs/ /snum dang dugs dag ma byas par/ /gang zhig sbyang ba'i las byed pa/ /shing skam 'gugs par byed pa ltar/ /de yi lus ni ma rungs 'gyur/ /sbyang ba 111—240

legs par nye bar 7bstan pas ni/ /blo gros gsal zhing dbang po stobs dang ldan/ /lus zungs brtan zhing khong pa'i me drod 'bar/ /na tshod dag kyang ring du 'jog par byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus pa las / mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcwa brgyad pa'o// //de nas mas gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /rlung shas che ba'i nad rnams sam/ /rlung la mas gtong bsngags pa ste/ /de ni gso ba thams cad kyi/ /mchog ste de yang rnam pa gsum/ /bkru kyedrags 'jam rtsi mas gtong gong / /de yis rngu gso bya skran dang ni/ /lto sgos dreg nad mcher pa dang / /'khru ba 'ba' zhig gzer nad dang / /rims rnying bying dang cham pa dang / /khu ④ba rlung dang dri ma 'gags/ /rlig rlugs ⑤rde'u nad zla mtshan 'jig /rlung gi nad ni mi bzad gso/ /bkru ⑥drags mi bya snum drags dang / /glo rdol ⑦shin tu skems ⑤pa dang / /be+e snabs 'khru dang slon bro dang //spyang byas sna sman btang ba dang / /dbugs mi ⑫bde lud cham gzhang 'brum/ /skyigs bu lto sbos me drod chung / /gzhang skrangs ⑩kha zas zos ⑪zin dang / /lto 'gags bu ga chu yod ⑫dang / /mdze can gcin nad sbrang mdog dang / /sbrum ma zla bdun yan chad do/ /bkru ⑫drags bya nyid 'jam rtsi bya/ /khyad par du ni me drod che/ /rtsub dang rlung nad gcig pus nyen/ /'jam rtsi mi bya'ang de nyid do/ /de bzhin skya rbab mig ser dang / /tshil che ⑫cham btab zas ma zos—/ /bshang bar ske'akhru bar byed pa dang / /lto lci lto nad ⑩bad kan can//mchil ma mang dang shin tu sgom/ /lto na srin yod rlung 'khyims dang / /dug 111—241

dag 'thungs dang 'brum bus btab/ /rkang bam ①lkog ma'i lba ba can②/ /de gnyis sbu gu gser ④sogs dang / /shing rus 'od ma las ④byas pa/ /ba lang mjug ⑤'dra bug rdol med/ /'jam zhing drang la kha zlum pa'o/ /lo gcig ma lon rjosor lnga pa⑦/ /lo tshad lo bdun pa yi bar/ /tshad ni sor drug yin par bshad/ /lo bdun pa yi bdun nyid de/ /bcu gnyis pa la sor brgyad bya/ /bcu drug yan chad sor dgu ste/ /nyi shu yan ⑧chad sor bcu gnyis—/ /lo gzhan dag la na tshod dang / /stobs dang lus tshad brtags nas ni/ /tshad ni mngon pa ⑨bskyed par bya/ /rtsa ba rang gi mthe ⑩bong mnyam//rtse mo mthe'u chung tshad du bya/ /lo gcig lon sor nas bzung ste/ /de yis ⑩phyed phyed kyis bskyed bya/ /gang zhig rtsa ba'i bu ga'i tshad/ /sor mo gsum rtse shong ba mchog /muṅga ⑩ma sha sran ma btsos⑫/ /rgya shug 'bras shong ⑫rim bzhin bya/ /rtsa ⑫ba'i bu ga'i tshad kyis ni/ /mthar ni bug pa 'gegs ⑩par bya—/ /lce rtse ⑩rang gi sor gnyis kyis/ /chod par 'gag ⑫pa gnyis pa bya/ / der ni rkyal ⑪bu gdags bya ba⑫/ /ra lug ma ho la sogs pa'i/ /be+eng pa legs mnyes sra ba dang / / dmar btsos bu stsog thag thug med/ /dri nga rtsa ris med srab par/ /sman ni legs par blugs byas la/ /srad bus dam par bcing bar bya/ /be+eng med rkyal pa'i dpung pa 'am/ /byin pa'i pags pa'am ras stug bzang / /ni ru ha tshad dang po ni/ /lo gcig pa la srang gcig mchog /ji srid srang ni bcu gnyis par/ /lo re srang res bskyed par bya/ /bcu gnyis pa nas bcwa brgyad par/ /de yang bdun cu'i bar tshad 'di⑫/ /de phan tshad ⑫srang nyi shu nyid/ /bkru sman drag tshad ji lta ba/ /de yi bzhi cha 111—242

'jam rtsi tshad/ /bkru sman drag bya snum dugs bya/ /sbyang ①byas nas kyang stobs thob pa/ /'jam rtsi gtang 'os par ⑧shes nas/ /thog ma nyid du 'jam rtsi gtang / /dgun dpyid nyin par gtang de las/ /gzhan du mtshan gtang la la 'dod/ /bsku byug khrus bya sngon thang las/ /bzhi gsum phan zhing yang ba dang / /snum dang rtsub ches ma yin bza'/ /khu ba la sogs zos rjes btung / /bcags la bshang gci bsal nas ni/ /mal du bde bar gnas byas la/ / mtho dman ①med par mgo smad de/ /glo g.yon gyis ni phab nas su—/ /rkang pa g.yas pa bkug bunas ni/ /rkang pa g.yon pa brkyang bar bya/ /de nas de la gce'u kha dang / /gzhang sgo snum gyis bsgus nas ni/ /gce 'u lgang pa'i dbugs bton la/ /kha bcings lag pa mi 'dar bar/ /rgyab kyi logs su 'dug nas ni/ /shin tu myur dang bul min dang / /ha cang shugs drag dal min par/ /ran par lan cig khong ⑤na btsir/ /rlung ni lhag par ⑦gnas pas na/ /lhag ma cung zad lus par bya/ /btang nas lus ni gan rkyal bzhag /rkub tshos ⑦lag pas brdab ⑧par bya/ /rting pas mjug tsos brdung bya zhing / /rting pa bteg la lan gsum gseg⑨/ /de nas lus ni brkyangs ⑩nas su/ /sngas ⑪dang bcas pa'i rting par ni/ /khu tshur gyis brdung lus kyang ni/ /snum gyis bskus la mnye bar bya/ /tshor bas nyen pas snum dag ni/ /myur du phyir 'byung mi byed do/ /gal te myur du phyir byung na/ /phan mi byed pas gzhan dag gtang / /me drod che zhing snum byung na/ /dgongs ⑫ka kha zas yang ba sbyin/ /dbyung ⑫ba'i dus kyi dam pa ni/ /thun gsum yin te de phan chad/ / nyin mtshan ④gcig ni bsdad nas su/ /de yi 111—243

'og tu reng bu yis①/ /snum dbyung phyir ni 'bad bya ba'am/ /mas gtong ba ni rnon po bya/ /shin tu rtsub pas ma byung zhing / /snyom ②bag la sogs nad med na/ /btang snyoms su ni gzhag par bya/ /de nas mtshan 'das nang par ni—/ /bca' sga 'u ①su bskol chu 'am/ /yang na chu tshan rjo'aba' zhig btung / /'jam rtsi btang nas nyin gsum mam/ /nyin lnga lon nas slar gtang ba'am/ /ji srid snum ni 'jug ⑤gyur pa'am/ /yang na rlung ni shas che dang / /rtag tu rtsol byed me drod che/ /khong rtsub pa la nyin re gtang / /de ltar snum ni gsum mam bzhirjo/ /snum gyur rtsa sgo sbyang ba'i phyir/ /mas gtong khrus kyis sbyang ba dang / /snum med lus ni snum gyur gtang / /nyi ma gsum mam nyin lnga na/ /tshes grangs bzang zhing dge ba la⑦/ /nyin phyed cung zad yol ba'i tshe/ /gtor ma bkra shis cho ga bya⑧/ /snum bskus dugs bya bshang gci ni/ /bsal zhing shing ⑨tu bkres min la/ /skyes bu'i nad dmigs sman la sogs/ /'bad de shes par byas nas ni/ /sman pa ⑩de la mkhas pa ⑪ni/ /mang dang lhan cig mas gtong sbyar/ /sman gyi srang ni nyi shu dang / /po son cha brgyad lhan cig bskol/ /bskol ba de yi ⑫bzhi cha yis⑫/ /sman mar rlung la rjes su sbyar / /mkhris pa bde bar gnas drug cha/ /bad kan shas che spyobargyad cha gcig /yang na kun la sman gyi ni/ /brgyad cha gcig gam ci nas kyang / /mas gtong ska ⑫be+er mi 'gyur bya/ /bu ram dag ni srang gcig tsam/ /rigs pas sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha sogs/ /lhag ma de kun snod cig blugs/ /bum par chu bskol rlangs ⑩pa yis/ /bsro ⑩zhing gzar bus dkrugs ⑫nas di/ /rkyal pa'i nang blugs mjug mar ni/ /gtong tshe shin tu tsha grang min/ /shin tu 111—244

snum min rtsub pa'ang min/ /shin tu rno min 'jam pa'ang min/ /shin tu ska ①min sla ba'ang min/ /shin tu mang nyung tshad med pa'ang ②/ /tsha che skyur ba'ang de dang 'dra/ /de la mkhas pa gzhan smra ba/ /snum dang sbrang rtsi gnyis so sor/ /srang ni gsum gsum byas nas su/ /rgyam tsha dag ni zho gnyis dang //nad med la btang sman srang gnyis/ /khu ba'i sman ni lhag ma kun/ /srang bcu yongs su sbyar bar bya/ /sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha snum rnams dang / /sman phye snekhu ba'i rim pa ni/ /mas gtong rkyal par bcug byas te/ /'di ni sbyor ba'i cho gar bshad/ /gan rkyal bzhag nas btang ma thag /sngas dhikyis brten te mas gtong la/ /yid ni gzhan du ma yengs pas/ /'khru ba tsog pus gtang bar bya/ /'ong dus dam pa yud tsam ste/ /de las gzhan du 'chi byed yin/ /de la bcos pa'i thabs gyur snum/ /thal sman ba gcin khu skyur sbyar/ /myur bas snum la rno dro ba'i/ / mang gtong ⑤gzhan dag gtang bar bya/ /yang na sman gyi reng bu dag /gtong rjozhing dugs la sogs pa bya/ /rang nyid 'ongs par ⑦gyur na ni/ /mas gtong gnyis pa gtang ba'am/ /lan gsum lan bzhi'i bar du ni⑧/ /ji srid legs par gyur par gtang / /de yis ⑨sbyor sogs bkru sman dang / /'dra bar shes bya sbyor legs na/ /chu dron 'jam pos bkrus nas ni/ /sha khu 'bras chan nyung zad ⑩sbyin/ /mas gtong drag pos nad rnams kyi⑪/ /dri ma bskyod pas byung gyur pa/ /de ni chu dron gyis bkru dang / /kha zas tshul bzhin thos ⑫pas 'byung / /gal te rlung gis nyam ⑫thag na/ /slar yang 'phral du 'jam rtsi gtang ⑫/ /de ni legs dang ma legs dang / /grags pa ⑫snum 'thungs 'drar shes bya/ /gang zhig dus ni 111—245

——— ———————cung zad gnas/ /bshang dang bcas par 'byung 'gyur zhing / /thur du dbugs dang snum lhan cig /'byung 'gyur 'jam rtsi legs pa yin/ /bad kan la ni mas gtong ba'i/ /'jam rtsi gcig gam gsum gtang bya/ /mkhris pa la ni lnga 'am bdun/ /rlung la dgu 'am bcu gcig gtang / /slar yang de la zung min pa/ /mas gtong rjes la bya ba yin/ /bad mkhris rlung la rim bzhin zas/ /yu sha 'o ma sha khu gtang / /rlung 'joms sman ni legs bskol ba—/ /dur byid rgyam tshar bcas par bya/ /snum mngar skyur sha khu dron sbyar/ /mas gtong gcig ni rlung la phan/ /n+ya gro dha hu)sogs sde tshan ②bskol/ /shug sogs ka ra dkar ④dang bcas/ /mngar bsil bu ram shing khu mar/ /'o ma sbrang rtsir bcas mkhris sel/ /dong ga la sogs bskol dhib dang / /dug ⑤mo nyung sogs bcas pa gsum/ /rtsub dang sbrang rtsi ba gcin bcas/ /rno zhing dro kha bad kan sel/ /gsum po 'dus pa'i nad la yang / /gang phyir rim bzhin sel ba yin/ /gsum po de las gzhan pa yin rjo/ /mas gtong gso zhes gzhan mi 'dod/ /gang phyir slar yang sbyin bya ba'i/ /nyes pa bzhi po yod ma yin/ /nad bskyod lpidag par byed pa dang / /zhi bar bya ba'i rim pa yis—/ /mas gtong gsum po nyid brtag ces/ /de skad gzhan dag smra ba yin—/ /nad dang sman sogs stobs las ni/ /'di dag thams cad tshad mas /—gzhal/ /bskru kyi)sman drag btang legs mtshan ma/ /ma mthong bar du 'phro mi bcad ༄/ /dang por snum gcig tha mar lnga/ /bkru sman drag po bcu gnyis te/ /'jam rtsir bcas pa mas gtong (steba'i/ /las ni sum cur bshad pa yin/ /dus tsheni bco lnga 'dir gcig ni/ /thog ma'i snum ste ⑫tha 111 246

— —mar gsum/ /dugs 1dang mas gtong lnga par bshad2/ /mas gtong sbyor 'dir brgyad yin te/ /ni ru ha dang snum gsum dang / /thog ma tha ma gnyis ka'o—/ /'jam rtsi'am bkru sman mas gtong drag /gcig pu lhag par bsten mi bya/ /'jam rtsis nad slongs 5 me drod 'joms/ /ni ru has rlung skyed 'jigs yod/ /de bas snum rjes bkrus drags gtang / /khrus drag btang nas 'jam rtsi bya/ /de ltar rim pas snum sbyang bya/ /mas gtong las ni nyes 7 gsum sel/ /snum gyi tshad ni chung ngu yi8/ /tshad dang de ni mnyam byas pa'i/ /snum tshad 'jam rtsi'i tshad du bshad/9/ /de ni byis rgan lam dang khur—/ /bud med rtsol zhen pas dub / )dang / /rlung nad kyis gzhom me drod chung / /rgyal po phyug po la bde ba/ /yin pas rtag tu bsten par bya/ /nad 'joms yang 1(ba med pa dang / /stobs skyed bshang ba bde bar 'byung / /mas gtong bud med ro smad kyi/ /mngal dang mo mtshan nad rnams la/ /bkrus drags 7gnyis gsum gyis dag par/ /mas gtong gong mas gtang bar bya—/ /de yi gce 'u nad pa yi/ /sor tshad bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /zlum zhing ba lang mjug ma 'dra/ /rtsa ba dbus 7su gag pa gdags/ /rtse mo yungs kar shong ba tsam/ /'jam pa gser la sogs las labyas/ /kun+da sri zhing /7so ma na/ /me tog rtse mo ltar zlum phra/ /de yi rkyal bu 'jam zhing yang / /tshad srang phyed dam gang rigs bya/ /de nas khrus byas zas zos la 'jam rtsi gtong ba'i cho ga bya/ /khri stegs pus lamanyam 'jam pa la/ /drang zhing bde bar 'dug nas ni/ /pho mtshan bteg 7cing drang bar bya/ /sbubs sbyang phyir ni thur ma ni/ /'jam pa rim gyis 1 gzhug par bya/ /de dag pho mtshan dang 777 247

'tsham pa/ /'bras bu'i mthar thug bar gtang ba/ /mi 'dar 'jam rtsi btang ①ltar bya/ /btsir de btang la snum rjes bya/ /'jam rtsi'i rim pa bzhin du bya/ /mas gtong cho ga 'di yis ni/ /gsum mam bzhi yi bar du gtang / /lhag ma 'jam rtsi ji lta bar/ /'di la thams cad sbyar bar bya/ /bud med zla mtshan dus su ni/ /mngal bye ba las ②chags par 'gyur/ /de phyir de tshe gtang bya la①/ /rab na dus min bar yang gtang / /mo mtshan nyams dang gzer ba dang / /mngal khrag rtag tu 'byung gtong ba/ /gce 'u sor bcu rtse mo yirjo/ /bu ga muṅga shong sor bzhi/ /mngal gyi gnas su gtang bar bya/ /sor gnyis gcin 'bab lam du btang / /gcin 'gags pa yi nad rnams la/ /bu mo rnams la sor gcig gtang / /'bring tshad srang ni gcig pa ste/ /bu mo rnams la srang phyed nyid/ /mal du gan rkyal 'dug nas ni—/ /brla ni legs par bskums nas su/ /pus mo bstod de nyin zhag ni/ /gcig la lan gsum lan bzhi gtang / /de ltar mas gtong zhag gsum la/ /snum gyi tshad ni bskyed par bya/ /de nas zhag gsum ngal bso ⑤nas/ /slar yang zhag gsum gtang bar bya/ /skyug sman byas zla ④phyed bkru sman/ /de nas zla byed nas bkrus ⑦drags/ /bkrus drags 'phral la 'jam rtsi gtang / /khrus btang zhag bdun nas 'jam rtsi/ /dper na leb rgan sogs btsos pa'i⑧//gos ni chu las tshos ⑨len ltar/ /de bzhin bangs par byas lus la mas gtong bas ⑩ni nad rnams 'byin/ /lus kyi yan lag nang khrol ⑪dag tu song nad dang / /gnad dang lus stod yan lag kun khyab nad/ /gang zhig yod pa de las skye ba'i rgyu/ /rlung ma gtogs ⑩pa gzhan dag yod ma yin/ /bshang 111—248

dang bad kan mkhris sogs nad sogs pa/ /gang phyir 'thor zhing sdud ①par byed pa yin/ /de ni rab 'phel gyur ④la zhi ba'i phyir/ /'jam rtsi ma gtogs sman gzhan gang yang med/ /de bas gso ba ma lus las ma ①btang / /gso ba'i phyed yin zhes ni la la 'dod/ /de bzhin nad rnying glo bur skyed byed la/ /gtar ga khrag ④dbyung sman nyid 'gyur ba yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas sman sna nas gtong ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /nam tshong yan chad nad rnams la/ /lhag par sna nas btang ba phan⑤/ /sna di klad pa'i sgo yin te/ /des na de nas nad de 'joms/ /bkru sman klad pa'i nad rnams dang / /glong dubag lkog nad mchi ma 'dzag /skrang dang thor bu srin rmen bu/ /mdze snyom ⑦cham pas btab la gtang / /brta ⑧ba rlung las byung gzer dang / /glad ⑨pa phyed nas ⑩skad 'gags dang / /sna dang kha skom ⑪tshig mi thon/ /mig dbye dka' dpung bskyod dka' gtang / /zhi ba mig sngon gdong ⑫pags nad/ /skra yi skyon mig dmar la gtang / /dang po rang sbyor ji lta'i snum/ /sman gyi lde gu sogs bskol dang / /shing mngar rgyam tsha chang rnying sogs / /ci rigs pa ⑫ni bskol ba gtang / /brta ⑫ba 'u su'i khu ba dang / /sha khu khrag dang thang ⑫chu'ang sbyar/ /zhi ba snga ma 'o ma dang / /chu dang bcas par sbyar bar bya/ / tshad chen ⑩dang ni tshad phran ⑩te/ /'di yi snum tshad rnam pa gnyis/ /lde gu la sogs bcir ba yi⑫/ /rno de spyi bo'i bkru sman yin/ /phye ⑪ma bud pa'i bkru sman te/ /sbu gu dusor drug kha gnyis pa/ /nang na sman 111—249

dang bcas pa dag /kha yi dbugs kyis bus te gtang / /des ni mgo nad mang po yang / /phye ma yin pas 'byen par byed/ /mdzub ①mo'i tshigs ni gnyis pa'i bar/ /sgyugs ④pa'i phyir byung gyur pa las/ /thigs pa bcu 'am brgyad dam drug /ji srid 'dzags ①par gyur pa dag /sna nas gtong tshad che 'bring chung / /rim pa de nyid kyis shes bya/ /lde gu la sogs thigs rjopa ni/ /gnyis kyis phri ste gtang bar bya/ /chu dang chang dang sbyar dug mar/ /'thungs pa'am 'thung bar 'dod pa dag /kha zas zos dang mgo bkrus dang / /'khru bar 'dod dang gtar ga byas/ /cham pa shugs 'ongs kyis gzir ⑤dang / /bu btsas lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /sbyang byas mas gtong cho ga byas/ /de bzhin dus min yul rmugs 0la/ /sna sman gtang bar mi bya ste/ /tshabs chen nad sogs ma gtogs so/ /de nas sna nas sman gtang ba/ /bad kan nang par ⑦mkhris nyin phyed/ /rlung can phyi 'bred mtshan mo gtang / /nad med pa la ston ka dang / /dpyid kyi tshe na snga dro gtang / /dgun ni phyed dus so ga'i tshe/ / phyi 'bred ⑧dbyar ni nyi dron bcas/ /glad ⑨pa rlung nad kyis thebs dang / /skyigs bus ()btab dang mgo 'dar dang / /gnye'u rengs skad ni 'gags pa la/ /nyin re nang par dgongs ka gtang / /gzhan la nyin res bar bcad ⑪la/ /nyi ma bdun du de spyad bya/ /rtag tu bya ba'i las byas nas/ /dang por ⑫mgo snum bsku dugs byas⑫/ /rlung med mal du gnas nas ni/ /nam tshong yan chad dugs kyang bya/ /de nas gan rkyal lus drang brkyang ④/ /rkang pa lag pa legs brkyangs ⑫la/ rkang pa cung zad bstod nas su/ /mgo bo yid tsam smad ⑩par bya/ /sna khung gcig ni rab bkag la/ /111—250

rim gyis yongs su blugs bya ba/ /sman ni chu dron gyis bsros ①la/ /sbu gu'am ras bal gyis blugs bya/ /blugs nas rkang mthil phrag pa dang / /lag pa rna ba la sogs mnye/ /rim gyis brdubs ②la glo gnyis su/ /mchil ma dor ba ④de nas ni/ /sman ni zad par 'gyur gyi bar/ /lan gnyis lan gsum snar btang spyad/ /gal te brgyal gyur bsil ba'i chus/ /mgo ma gtogs par gtor bar bya/ /bkru sman 'og tu snum dag ni/ /nad sogs tshul las rjodapags te gtang ⑤/ /sna sman btang mthar gan rkyal du/ /grangs brgyar de las bsdad par bya/ /dud pa brdubs 0la chu dron 'jam/ /gre ba mtshul pa dag phyir bya/ /snum btang legs gyur ⑦dbugs bder rgyu/ /gnyid log sad bde dbang po gsal/ /nyes pas mgo rtsub mi 'gyur ⑧skam/ /sna dang kha skams klad stong snyam/ /snum drags g.yan stidang lci ba nyid/ /mchil mang cham 'debs yi ga 'chus/ /legs bkrus mig gsal yang ba dang / /kha dang skad ni dag par 'gyur/ /bkrus nyen nad ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /bkrus drags khong ni rmya bar 'gyur/ /tshad phran glo rdol rid pa dang / /byes pa rgan po skyid par gnas/ /dus min char 'bab par yang gtang / /de ni cham pas ⑩drag btab dang / /chang 'thungs rna ba 'on pa dang / /klad rgyas srin bu zhugs pa dang / /nad bsdus phyir ni ma phyung la/ /tshad phra ba ni gtang mi bya//nyin mtshan zas zos slon gnyid ⑪nyal/ /mtha' dang bud med lam ngal dub/ /mgo bskus mkhur bkang ⑫dbo ba'i rjes/ /bshang gci mig sman btang rjes dang / /so shing gi rjes dgod pa yin⑫/ /rjes la thigs pa gnyis pa gtang //lnga yis dbang rkyipo'i bu ga dag /gsum gyis rim bzhin ngal ba sel/ /lnga 111—251

yis ①mig ni gsal bar byed/ /so brtan rlung nad zhi bar 'gyur/ /sna sman lo bdun ma lon dang / /brgyad cu 'das la gtang mi bya/ /bcwa brgyad ma lon dud mi bdug / mkhur bkang sdelnga ma lon la min/ /lo bcu ma lon sbyang mi gtang ④/ /bdun cu 'das la 'ang mi bya'o/ /skyes nas rgas pa'i bar du ni/ /tshad phran mas gtong ④lta bur bsngags/ /de ni rtag tu bsten ⑤gyur na—/ /tshad che ba ltar yon tan skyed/ /'di la bdam ༷pa gang yang med/ /gnod las tshad chen ltar 'jigs med/ /sna sman don du til mar nyid/ /rtag tu bsten pa bsngags pa yin/ /mgo ni bad kan gnas yin phyir/ /snum gzhan bde gnas la mi bsngags/ /myur byed ring zhig byed pa dang / /yon tan che dang chung byed pa'i/ /khyad par tshad chen tshad phran ⑦la/ /gal te med par gyur na ni/ /gang zhig spang byas gnod byas pa'i/ /tshad chen dag ni su zhig ston/ /snum dngas btung ba rtag bshad du/ /spyil bu rlung dang tshad par gnas/ /'jam rtsi ⑧tshad chen mas gtong tshad/ /de dang 'dra bar rnam par bstan⑨/ /dza la sgron shing dzi brnyi/ /gla ⑩sgang shing tsha pu shel tse/ /go pi tsan+dan skyer pa'i rtsa/ /shing mngar gla ba a ka ru/ /nye'u shing bil ba puṇ+ḍa rīthotre/ /ut+pal mur ba paṇi gnyis/ /bri thomeha ti gnyis byi dang ga /gartse bha dra sug smel ⑫dang / /ha re rku ka ⑫pad+ma yi/ /ge sar dang ni ba la ste/ /sman ni 'di rnams cha mnyam ⑫la/ /char pa'i chus ni bskol bar bya/ /til mar las ni sman gyi khu/ /bcu 'gyur lhag byas ⑩de la ni/ /til mar chu dang bskol ba bya⑩/ /lan bcu nyid ni bskol nas niske/ /tshos pa yi ni bcu cha la/ /de mnyam ra yi 'o ma blugs/ /snar 111—252

btang til mar yon tan che/ /thigs phran zhes bya 'di bsten bya/ /sna nas btang ba'i sman bsten pas/ /phrag pa mgrin pa dpung mgo ni/ /mkhregs shing mtho la pags mdog gsal/ /dbang brtan ①skra dkar med par 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa ④las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu pa'o// //de nas sman gyi dud pa gtang ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /nam tshong yan chad bad rlung las/ /byung ba'i nad rnams mi skye dang / /skyes pa rnams ni bsal ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pas ④rtag tu dud pa brngub④/ /de ni 'jam dang bar ma rno/ /rlung dang bad rlung bad kan la/ /gtang ngo mkhris khrag gis nyen dang / /bkrus dang dmu rdzing za khu dang / /rab rib spos dang stod rlung nad/ /sgog nad mas gtong byas pa dang / /nya dang chang dang 'o ma zho / /sbrang rtsi mar dang dug 'thungs sogs/ /mgo nad skya rbab nad can ni//mtshan gnyid ⑤ma log la mi gtang / /gal te dud pa cher brngubs na/ /khrag dang mkhris 'phel 'on dang long / /skom dang brgyal dang rmongs par byed/ /der rjoni bsil ba'i cho ga phan/ /bkres sprid glal dang bshang gci bsal⑦/ /bud med bsten dang gtar ga btab/ /dgod ⑧dang so shing bcas pa yi /mthar ni dud pa 'jam po gtang / /dus 'di dag nas ⑨mtshan zas zos/ /sna sman rjes la bar ma brngub/ /gnyid log sna sman mig sman khrus/ /slon pa'i rjes la rnon pos bkru⑩/ /mas gtong gce'u 'drar byas pa yi⑪/ /dud gce'u sbubs gsum drang por bya/ /rtsa ba mtheb ⑫shong rtse mo ni/ /rgya shug 111—253

shong ba'i tshad du bya/ /de yi tshad ni rngub byed pa'i/ /sor ni nyi shu sum cu gnyis—/ /bzhi bcu rno ①dang bar ma dang / /'jam po la ni rim bzhin bya//drang por 'dug cing de la ③sems/ /kha gdangs nas ni lan gsum brngub/ /sna khung re re bkag nas ni/ /snar ni dud pa brngub par bya/ /mgo dang snar gtogs nad bskyod ①pa/ /dang por sna nas brngub par bya/ /bskyod pa'i don du kha nas brngub/ /gre bar gtogs pa de las bzlog /du ba kha gnyis nad slon ④gyi/ /snar slon ⑤mig la gnod par byed/ /du ba rngub dang 'byin pa yis/ /lan ni gsum gsum brngub par bya/ /'jam po nyin gcig lan gcig gtang / /bar ma lan gnyis sbyor ba ni/ /lan gsum lan bzhi gtang bar bya/ /der sman gu gul a ka ru/ /gla sgang rdo dreg sgo ne+e ༷ya/ /spang spos ur shi ⑦ba la ka /shing tsha kon ti ⑧shing mngar dang / /bil rkang e la ba lu ka /pog dkar shri be ta ka dang / /gla ba spra ⑨tshil bya ma ka /pog nag gur gum ma sha dang / /kun tu ru dang nas dang til/ /snum bcas 'bras bu snying po dang / /tshil dang rkang dang zhag dang mar/ /zhi ba pog nag ⑩rgya skyegs dang / /rgun 'brum pad+ma ut+pa laske/ /n+ya go dha dang a shwad tha/ /u dus+thā ⑪ra blag sha dang / /seng phrom shun pa kha ra dang / /shing mngar klu shing shug pa btsod⑫/ /dri las rgya spos ru rta bskol/ /rnon po dzo ti sma ti dang / /skyer pa dang ni rtsa ba bcu/ /ldong ros ba bla rgya skyegs dang / /gi ri gar kar 'bras bu gsum/ /dri yi sman la ro ⑫rno ba'i/ /mgo bo'i ④bkru sman sde tshan no/ /de dag zhag gcig nur ⑫spangs la/ /dud pa'i sman rnams btags ⑩nas ni/ /thur ma sor ni 111—254

bcu gnyis la/ /lan lnga'i bar du byug par bya/ /gdar ①bu mthe bong ②tsam sbom la/ /nas kyi dbyibs dang 'dra bar bya/ /grib mar ④skam zhing khong stong med/ /snum gyis ji bzhin bskus byas la/ /brngub phyir me yis bsregs nas ni/ /dud pa'i gce'u ⑦sbyar bar bya/ /kham phor kha sbyar bu gar ni/ /gce'u sor bcu'am sor brgyad pa/ /bcug pa kha nas dud pa ni / /lud pa can gyis brngub par bya/ /dud pa brngubs la lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /skad 'gags rnag ⑤dang dri mi zhim gdong skya/ /skra skyon rna mig dhi'adzag g.ya' rmongs ⑦bag dang / /snyom ⑧dang skyigs bu cham pa'i nad mi 'byung / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas sman gyi khu bas mkhur ba dgang ⑨ba la sogs pa'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /mkhur ⑩bkang rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /snum dang zhi byed sbyong rma 'tshob/ /de las gsum ni rlung la sogs/ /gsum gtang tha ma rma la phan / /'dir sman ⑪mngar skyur lan tshwa dang / /tsha dang ⑫snum ni bskol ⑫ba yin / /zhi byed kha bska mngar sman bskol/ /sbyong ba kha dang tsha dang skyur/ /rma 'tshob byed pa kha ba dang / /bska ba'i sman ni bskol bar bya/ /de la snum dang 'o ma dang / /sbrang rtsi chu dang tsha ④dang chang / /ba gcin 'bru yi khu ba rnams| /sman ni ji lta ji lta ⑫dang / /lde gur bcas pa bskol ba ni/ /ji tsam bzod pa rnam ⑩par sbyar/ /so brtse ⑩so ni 'gul ba dang / /rlung las gyur pa'i kha nad la/ /dro 'jam tsam mam bsil ba yi/ /til chus mkhur ba 111—255

bkang ba phan/ /rtag tu mkhur ba bkang ste gzhag① /til mar dag gam sha khu bsngags/ /kha drod che tsha ④tshos pa dang / /'phral du rma ni byung ba dang / /dug dang thal sman mes tshig la/ /zhun mar dag gom ④'o mas dgang / / sbrang rtsi ④mkhur bkang byas pas ni/ /kha yi dri ma sbyong byed cing / /kha yi rma ni 'tshob byed yin/ /kha tsha skom dad rab zhi byed/ /ro mi tshor dang dri ma che⑤/ /kha mnam 'bras rtsabs bkang bas sel/ /de nyid cung zad tsha bcas bsel/ /kha skams rjosel ba'i dam pa yin⑦/ /thal sman rnon khus mkhur bkang bas⑧/ /bad kan sogs pa myur du sel/ /chu tshan dro 'jam mkhur bkang bas/ /kha ni yang zhing bde bar byed/ /rlung med nyi tshan bcas par ni/ /phrag pa mjing bar stidugs bya mnye/ /mkhur ba bkang nas gdong pa ni/ /cung zad bteg ste ji srid na/ /bad kan gyis ni kha gang ba'ang ⑩/ /sna mig 'dzag pa'i bar du gzhag⑪ /kha bkang mi spo bzhag mkhur bkang / /gzhan du khar brngub par 'gyur ro/ /khar brngubs pa yis khyad par gso ba ni/ /gnye'u rengs mgo mig rna ⑫nad kha nad dang / /mchil mang gre nad snying ⑫ga sra ba dang / /snying 'phar snyam ⑫dang cham pa yi ga 'chus/ /mkhur bkang bshad pa'i sman rnams kyispyo/ /lde gu sman khu phye ma ste/ /kha mur bya ba rnam gsum yin//de ni bad kan nad la gtang / /gdong bskus ⑫gsum ste nad sel dang / /dug sel kha dog bzang byed pa'o/ /de drong ⑩bad kan rlung la bsngags/ /lhag ma la ni rab bsel ba/ /de yi tshad dpangs ⑫sor bzhi cha/ /sum cha phyed de rnam pa gsum/ /ma bskams bar du de bzhag gi⑪/ /bskams na ⑩pags pa la gnod 'gyur/ /de nas spangs nas bkru bar bya/ /de yi rjes la 111—256

bsku byug bya/ /nyin par gnyid ①log mang smra khro/ /me tshan nyi tshan ②mya ngan spang / /de ni cham pa sna sman gtang / /ma zhu 'gram ①'thams yi ga 'chus/ /mtshan gnyid ④ma log la mi gtang ⑤/ /de ni legs par spyad pa yis/ /dus min skra dkar ngo khabs rjodang / /gnyer ma rab rib mig sngo sel/ /rgya shug snying po ba sha'i ⑦rtsa/ /seng ⑧phrom yungs kar dkar po rnams/ / sing hi'i ⑨rtsa ba til nag dang / /skyer pa'i shun pa rme 'u spyornams/ /'jag rtsa tsan+dan ur ⑪shi ra/ /shir+sha sha ta pus pa ⑫'bras/ /ku mud ut+pal ka la ha/ /drur ba ⑫shing mngar tsan+dan rnams/ /ka li ya ka ur shi ti/ /spang ④spos rgya spos shug pa rnams/ /da lis kun dra puṇ+ḍa rī⑫/ /shing mngar rgya spos a ru ra/ /de ltar tshigs ⑩bcad phyed kyis bshad/ /bsku ⑩ba dgun stod sogs drug sbyar//gdong bsku ba la goms pa rnams/ /mthong ba brtan ⑫par 'gyur ba dang / /gdong ni yongs su mi ⑪rnying la/ /'jam zhing pad+ma 'dra bar 'gyur/ /bsku dang blugs dang ras bal can⑥/ /pags pas g.yogs dang rnam pa bzhi/ /de ni spyi bo'i til mar te/ /phyi bzhin du ni yon tan che/ /de la byugs pa ⑪rtsub pa dang / /g.ya' dang dri ma can la sbyar/ /rlugs ⑫pa glog pa glad gzer dang / /tsha dang rma smin rnags la gtang ⑪/ /ras bal snum can skra 'byi dang / /gza' zhugs mig ni rengs la gtang / /bags ④bcings mgo bo tshor ba med/ /kha yo gnyid ni yar ba dang / /kha dang sna skam rab rib dang / /mi bzad mgo nad dag la sbyar/ /de yi cho ga 'dug pa la/ /khri'u dupus mnyam 'jam pa la⑪/ /lus bkrus bsku zhing dugs ⑦byas la/ /dgongs ka ba 'am ma he yi/ /pags pa mgo bo dang mnyam la/ /rgyar ni sor ni bcu 111—257

—— — byed———byedasdebyed— ——gnyis pa/ /rna ba'i mthar thug bar bcings pa7 / /'phral ba gos kyis dkris pa ni/ /gos sam lan bus bcings 2/byas la/ /ma sha'i lde gus bsku bar bya/ /de nas nad dmigs ci 'dra la/ /snum bskol ba ni dro ke /'jam tsam/ /de ni spyi bo man chad nas/ /skra drung sor gcig nub tsam blugs/ /kha dang sna mtshul phyin par gzhagasnye /de ni rlung sogs nad rnams la/ /stong phrag bcu dang brgyad drug gzhag ) /nad med pa la stong phrag gcig /mar gsar (dze+ephrag pa la sogs mnye/ /de ltar zhag bdun blugs par bya/ /rna ba gang bar blugs te gzhag⑧ /rna ba'i rtsa la mnye bar bya/ /nad rtse zhil gyi bar bya zhing / /rna ba se gol brgya par gzhag /pus mo 4g.yas pa'i lha nga ni/ /lag rtses bskor ba'i bar dang ni/ /mig 'byed 'dzums dang tunyemanyam pa yi/ /yun ni grangs kyi tshad du bshad/ /spyi bo'i ⑩til mar sbyar ba bskus pas 7di/ /skra dkar dmar ser skra 'byi ⑫gza' zhugs dang / /mgo bo'i lhosterlung nad sel zhing dbang po gsal/ /skad gdangs 'gram pa mgo yi stobs skyed byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas sman gyi thigs pa mig tu blugs ⑫pa dang sman gyis mig bsku ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /mig nad dag ni thams cad la/ /dang por sman thigs blugs pas ni/ /zug na g.ya' drud mchi ma 'dzag /mig tsha mig dmar rnams ⑩la phan/ /rlung la dron po bad dro ⑪'jam/ /khrag mkhris la ni de bsil bsngags/ /rlung med gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /lag pa g.yon pas 111 258

————— —— —sde ————zhe——byed— —— ———— — zhe—————byed ———byed —byed—mig phye (la/ /nya phyis nang sbyar ras bal ni/ /bsnyad 2 pa'i thigs pa blugs bya ba/ /sor gnyis tsam spangs las mig grwa/ /thigs ( pa bcu 'am bcu gnyis blugs4/ /de nas gos 'jam dag gis phyi/ /rlung dang bad kan can dag la/ /gos 'jam gzhan ni chu dron la/ /sbangs pas dugs 9ni 'jam po bya—/ /mig sman blugs pa )rab tsha rnos(7/ /na zhing mig dmar rtul bar 'gyur—/ /shin tu grang /sgobs zug pa dang / /'dzums ()mi shes dang na bar 'gyuraske/ /drags 6gepas mig mchu dmar dang drud/ /rtsub (specing mig ni 'byed dkar 'gyur/ /shin tu chung bas nad dkyel ⑫skyed/ /ma pho bas ni thu bar byed/ / bskus legs nad spyortsa sna sul dang / /kha yi sbubs su sman gyis khyab—/ /spyi bor gtogs pa'i nad kyi skeni/ /dri ma dpyis skeni 'byin par byed//de nas lus sbyangs mig sman bsku/ /mig tsam la ni gnas gyur pa/ /cung zad skrangs dang shin tu g.ya'/ /rngu ma chags pas smin shes shing / /cung zad drud dmar mchi ma 'dzag⑩ /mig rngu stug la gtang bar bya/ /bad kan dang ni khrag mkhris dang / /mchog tu rlung gis gzir la bsku⑩/ /mig sman phyi dang rma gso dang / /gsal bar mthong ste rnam pa gsum/ /de la phyi ba'i mig sman ni/ /bska dang smyur dang tsha dang kha/ /rma gso sman ni kha ba ste//gsal sman mngar dang bsil ba yin/ /thur ma sor bcu dbus phra (snyel/ /rtse mo sri zhing tsho6kha 'bus 'dra/ /phyi ba'i thur ma zangs kyi bsngagasatso/ /rma gso lcags nag byas sor tsam/ /bzang po gsal bar byed pa ni/ /gser dang dngul las byas pa bsngags/ /gdar spyobu khu ba phye mas te⑫/ /mig sman rnam gsum nyid du brtag ge /de ni mig nad lci 'bring dang / /yang ba la ni rim 711 259

bzhin sbyar/ /mtshan mo nyal dang nyi ma'i gung / /zos 'thungs nyi ma tsha ba yis—/ /mig gi nad ni 'phel ba dang / /dkyel ①ni skye dang 'khrugs ⑧par 'gyurarka/ /de bas de zhi phyir na dgongs/ /nyi ma sprin bral dus su bsku/ /gzhan dag smra ba nyin par ni/ /mig sman rnon po gtang mi bya/ /bkrus pas nyam 1chung gyur pa'i mig /nyi ma bltas na gnod par 'gyur/ /mtshan mo gnyid ni log pa dang / /zla dus yin pas rtas dhi'agyur te/ /mig ni me yi rang bzhin pas/ /bsil bas gnod med bsten ⑤par 'gyur/ /mig nad bad kan shas che ba'am/ /phyi zhing gsal bar bya ba lasarjo/ /rab tsha min pa'i nyin par yang / /mig sman rnon po blugs par 'dod/ /lcags ni rdo las 'byung ba yin/ /rno ba de nyid las byung yang / /de nyid kyis ni gnod byed nus / /mig gi rang bzhin de dang 'dra/ /dgun tshe mtshan mo mig sman ni/ /rnon po phan pa ma yin te/ /'dzag mi 'gyur bas mig rengs dang / /g.ya' dang mi ⑦gsal la sogs skyed/ /mig sman mi gtang 'jigs dang slonaske/ /khrus btang zan zos shugs kyis nyen/ /khros dang rims btab mig phyir byung ⑨//glad nad mya ngan gnyid ma log /nyi ma ma mthong mgo bkrus dang / /chang 'thungs dud pa brngubs pa dang / /kha zas ma zhu nyi tshan gdungs/ /nyin nyal skom pa la mi gtang / /mig sman rab rno 'jam dang nyung / /mang be+e ska ⑩dang rtsub pa dang / /shin tu bsil dang tsha ba yi/ /mig sman bsku bar mi bya'o/ /des na ⑪mig ni ma phye bar/ /dal gyis nang du khyab par bya/ /mig sman bskus nas mig mchu ⑫ni/ /cung zad bskyod la mig sman ni/ /rnon pos ⑫myur du khyab par 'gyur/ /dbye dang 'dzums ⑨par mi bya'o/ /mig mchu 111—260

gnyis ni bsdam pa dang ①/ /bkru ba dag ni mi bya'osde/ /gang tshe mig sman gyis bskus pa'i/ /sman gyi rtsom pa zhi gyur ①na/ /nad kyi dmigs dang mthun pa yi/ /chu yis de tshe bkru bar bya/ /de nas gos 'jam bcas pa yi mthe bong dang ni mdzub mo gnyis④/ /mig ni ci ran phye ste phyi/ /g.yon pas g.yas pa phyi bar bya/ /gzhan du mig sman blugs pa yis⑤/ /mig mchu rjokhyab pas nad skyed 'gyur/ /sman gyis ⑦g.ya' ba'am rtul gyur na/ /rnon po'i dud pa brngub par bya/ /mig sman rnon pos tsha gyur na/ /slar 'chos mig sman bsil byed gzhug /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa ⑧gsum pa'o// //de nas mig brta ⑨ba'i cho ga dang / mig sman gyi phur ma bsregs ⑩shing btsos pa'i khu ba mig tu ⑪blugs pa'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /mig 'dzums mi shes rengs bag dang / /skam dang rtsub dang snad pa dang / /rlung mkhris nad gyur zhum bag dang / /rdzi ma bye zhing g.yogs par mthong / /dbye dka' rtsa ni brtse ba dang / /mig ni ⑩rtsa 'gyur mi mthong dang / /dmar zhing mchi 'dzag klad phyed na/ /rlung nad kun 'gro ling tog ⑫can/ /mig nad brtse zhing mchi ma 'dzag⑫ /na zhing dmar la mig rngu ⑫chags/ /thun mong ⑩dus su nang par ram/ /dgongs ka gan rkyal nyal nas ni/ /lus dang mgo sbyang rlung med pa'i/ /gnas su brta ⑩ba'i sman gtang ngo / /nas sam ma sha'i rjen zan gyis/ /mig sbubs mtha' bskor mnyam pa ni/ /dpangs su sor gnyis rten spyobyas la/ /nad dmigs ji bzhin sman bskol la/ /zhun mar chu tshan la 111—261

bsros ①te/ /mig ni btsums par blugs ②par bya/ /mtshan mo mi mthong rlung rab rib/ /dbye dka' stsogs la tshil zhun blugs/ /rdzi ma'i ④rtse nub par bkang la/ /de nas bskyod cing dbye ba ni/ /de ni dal gyis byed du gzhug /tshad ④bgrang bya ba ⑤de la ni/ /mig mchu rjomig 'gram dkar nag nad/ /grangs brgya sum brgya lnga brgya dang / /brgya phrag bdun dang brgyad rim bzhin/ /dkrugs ⑦dang rlung la grangs stong ste/ /mkhris pa nad med la drug brgya/ /bad kan la ni lnga brgya gzhag⑧ /de nas mig 'gram 'dzag sgo bya/ /sman mar snod du gzags byas la/ /dud pa brngubs nas nam mkha' dang / /gzugs 'tsher ba ni blta mi bya/ /de ltar rlung la nyin re bya/ /mkhris pa nyin re'i ⑨bar du gcodaspyo/ /bad kan bder gnas gnyis par bcad/ /tshim par 'gyur ⑪gyi bar du gtang / /tshim pas gsal bar mthong nus shing / /bde zhing mig yang dri ma med/ /ma tshim pa las go bzlog yin/ /tshim drags ⑫bad kan nad skyed 'gyur/ /de ni lus kyis snum 'thungs ⑫ltar/ /mi gsal mjong ba nyam ④chung 'gyur/ /de bas lta ba'i rjes la ni/ /mthong ba'i stobs ni skyed byed laspyo/ /sngar bshad pa yi mig nad la/ /phur ma btsos pa sbyar bar bya/ /de ni rlung las snum can te/ /bad kan bcas te phyi ba phan/ /mthong nyams rlung dang mkhris bcas dang / /khrag mkhris bde gnas la gsal byed / /khung nas mthus tshol rlanalgecan gyi/ /tshil dang rkang dang zhag sha rlon/ /'o ma dag dang btags pa dang / /'tsho byed dag dang sbyar ⑩ba'i snum/ /ri dwags bya yi mcher pa sha /mu tig lcags zangs rgyam tsha dung / /rgya mtsho'i lbu ba lig bu mig /ba bla zho ga chur sbyar bya⑫/ /ri dwags bya yi mcher pa 111—262

rkang / /lto tshil rgyu ma snying dang sha /mngar bag mar bcas nu zhor bcas khya//btags pa gsal bar byed pa yin/ /sha dang sman gyi sde gu ni/ /gong bu srang gcig so sor byas/ /e raṇa spyon+ya go pad+ma yi/ /lo /ma snum pos rim bzhin du//dkris la 'byin ④pas byugs nas ⑤ni/ /da ba dgon pa'i lci ba'i me/ /'bar bar yongs su bsreg par bya/ /tshos nas de yi khu ba btsir/ /mig tu brta rjoba'i sman ltar blugs/ /phyi dang snum dang bsal ba la⑦/ /brgya phrag gcig gnyis gsum car ⑧bzhag /dang por dro 'jam phyi bsel blugs/ /de nyid ⑨rjes la dud pa brngub/ /des ⑩ni sbyor ba brta ⑪dang mtshungs/ /brta ⑫dang phur btsos thigs pa blugs⑫/ /sna sman mi bya la mi gtang / /ji srid dus ni sman gtong ba/ /de yi nyis 'gyur 'phrod pa bza'⑫/ /me tog dzā ti ma li ⑩kas/ /mig bcings ⑩mtshan mo gnas par bya/ /sna sman mig sman brta ⑩ba la sogs pas/ /mig mthu ⑫bskyed phyir kun tu 'bad par bya/ /mthong ba nyams na 'gro ba sna tshogs pa'ang / /mun pa'i rang bzhin tshul gcig spyonyid du 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad ⑫pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas cha spyad (spekyi cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /zug rngu rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /lus ni sna tshogs gnod byed pa/ /'byin pa'i thabs su gang gyur pa/ /spyad ⑫yin de bzhin gzhang 'brum dang / /mtshan bar rdol sogs brta 'ab dang / /gtsags ④bu thal sman me btab pa'i/ /yan lag lhag ma bsrung phyir dang / /mas gtong la sogs spyad ma gtogs⑪/ /bum bu ⑪ku ba rā ⑪dang ni/ /'dzam bu'i mchu 8)la sogs spyad yin/ /gang phyir cha spyad cho 111——263

ga bzhin/ /sna tshogs tshul du brdung 0bya ba/ /blo yis rnam dpyad bya ba ni/ /rags rim 2tsam zhig bstan pa yin/ /seng ge kaṅka dom bya rog /ri dwags bya sogs kha 'dra ba'i/ /mchu can cha spyad byas nas ni/ /de yi ming yang gdags par bya/ /phal cher lcags kyi rgyu las ni/ /srid du sor ni bco brgyad pa/ /skam pa 'brel pa'i mtshams su ni/ /sran chung lta bu'i gzer gdab gepa/ /rtsa ba lcags kyu ltar gug pa'i/ /cha spyad bde legs yin zhes bya/ /rtse mo g.yung drung lta bu'o/ /de ni brtan par rus zug pa'i/ /zug rngu 'byin la sbyar bar bya/ /gzer btab rtse mo gyes pa dang ④/ /skam pa yin te sor bcu drug /de ⑤ni pags pa rtsa rgyus shar/ /zhen pa'i zug rngu 'byin la sbyar/ /skam pa sor drug zug rngu phra/ /rdzi ma ma rungs 'byin la sbyar//so phra budrang zhing rtsa ba ni/ /gdu bus brgyan pa mu tsa spyoti/ /des rma gting du zug ④pa dang / /mig mdzer gting du lus la sbyar/ /nya mgo 'dra bar ⑨sor bcu gnyis/ /cha spyad gnyis pa gcig pa bya/ /nya mgo lta bu zhes bshad de—/ /rna khung )zug rngu 'byin la sbyar/ /cha srud sbu gu can khong stong / /rtse mo gcig gam mang po bya/ /des ni bu ga'i zug rngu dang / /nad yod blta dang dbyung ba dang / /bya ba sla bar bya phyir dang / /dgang bar bya ba'i don du bya/ /de yi zheng dang sbom srid tshad/ /bu ga'i tshad las dpag par bya/ /srid du sor bcu sgom ⑪sor lnga/ /gre ba'i zug rngu rtog byed yin/ /rtse mo lnga pa bu ga can—/ /rtse mo bzhi la spyi mdud ⑫bya/ /cha spyad thur ma gnyis pa ni/ /bu ga gsum pa de'i tshad bya/7/ /cha spyad bya ba rang gi dbyibasale/ /sbom dang chu 7yi tshad mnyam pa'i/ /sbu gu de 'dra gzhan dag kyang / /cha spyad shes par 4ga1 11 264

byed du gzhug /rtse mo pad+ma'i snying po 'dra/ /srid du sor ni bcu gnyis pa//bzhi cha khong stong byas sbu gu/ /zug rngu 'byin pa yin par bshad/ /gzhang 'brum cha spyad pa yi ni/ /nu sor 'dra ba sor bzhi pa/ /skyes pa'i sor lngas 'khyud pa ste/ /bud med sor drug gis 'khyud bya/ /nad lta ①ba la bu ga gnyis/ /las la bu ga gcig pa bya/ /dbus kyi bu ga sor gsum pa/ /mthe bong shong ba tsam du bya②/ /de steng rtse mo zlum po ni/ /dpangs su sor ni phyed par ①bya—/ /khar dkrol de 'dra bu ga med/ /cha spyad gzhang 'brum btsir ④la sbyar/ /mtshan bar spyordol la rnam kun tu/ /bu ga yan chad bsal bar bya/ /sna yi shu ba'i 'brum pa la du/ /bu ga gcig pa sor gnyis bya/ / zheng du mdzub ⑦mo'i tshad tsam las/ /mtshan bar ④rdol gyi spyad 'drar bya/ /sor mo bsrung phyir ba so 'am/ /shing gis ⑨shubs ni sor bzhi bya/ /ba yi nu 'dra bu ga gnyis/ /de yis ⑩kha ni dbye bar bya/ /mo mtshan rma brtag ⑪dbus su ni/ /khong stong sor ni bcu drug pa/ /phyogs bzhir gdu bus bcing bar bya/ /rtse mo pad+ma kha zlum 'dra/ /thur ma bzhi ni mnan pa yis⑫/ /rtsa ba bsdams na kha dbye bya/ /cha spyad 'jam rtsi'i ⑫sbubs 'dra la/ /rtsa ba mtheb ⑩shong rtse sran shong / /rtse mo gag ⑫pa med pa la/ /rtsa bar lpags 7'jam rkyal bu bcing / /rma ⑫yi phug ni 'chas pa dang / /rma 6shebakru ba la sbyar bar bya/ /'od ma'i sbu gu'am sgo rtsa ni/ /'dra ba kha gnyis dmu rdzing spyad/ /dud pa 6gems gtong la sogs spyad/ /rang rang gi ni skabs su smras/ /rngabs rwa kha zheng sor gsum pa/ /dpangs ⑫su sor brgyad pa 'am bcu/ /rtse mo'i bu ga yungs kar shong / /legs bkag nu sor dbyibs 'dra bya/ /ku speb srid du sor bcu gnyis/ /khyud skor 8spe111 ——265

sor ni bco brgyad pa/ /kha zlum sor ni gsum mam bzhi/ /nang 'bar yobad kan khrag 'dren byed/ /de bzhin bum pa de 'dra ba/ /glan pas skran yang 'ju bar byed/ /thur ma zhes bya'i cha spyad ④ni/ /las dang dbyibs ni sna tshogs pa/ /ci rigs pa yi tshad ldan bya/ /de la rma tshol las la gnyis/ /srin bu gan du pa ta'i dbyibs/ /bu ga'i nang gi zug rngu 'byin/ /kha ni sran chung phye 2'dra gnyis/ /sor brgyad pa dang dgu pa'i tshad/ /thur ma drug ste de las gnyis/ /sor ni bcu drug bcu gnyis spyopa/ /thal sman btang ba sbrul kha 'dra/ /gnyis po bcu gnyis sor⑥bcu pa/ /bskul spyad kha ni mda' ltong blu)'dra/ /'byen pa'i cha spyad be+egs kyu'i dbyibs/ / thur ma rtse mo (gegug pa ni/ /mngal gyi phur pa zhes bya ste/ /srid du sor brgyad byas pa des/ /bud med mngal du bu shi dbyung / /rde'u 'byen cha srud sbrul mgo yi/ /gdengs ka 'dra la rtse gug pa'o/ /mda' ltong 'dra bar ⑨sor bzhi pa/ /so dbyung ba la sbyar bar bya/ /rtse mo ras bal gyis dkris pa'i/ /phyi bsal ⑩thur ma drug bya 'o/ /gzhang gi nye ring nang la gnyis/ /sor bcu pa dang bcu gnyis pa/ /sna yi sor drug bdun pa gnyis/ /rna ba'i sor brgyad dgu pa gnyis—/ /rna ba bsal la a shwad+ma'i9tre/ /rtse 'am blugs gzar 7kha 'dra bya/ /thur ma 'dzam bu'i thor to 'dra/ /thal sman me btsa' 7so sor gsum/ /phra spyosbom rim bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /rgyu ma'i las la thur ma ni/ /khar ba 'dra zhing dbus zlum la/ /rtsa ba zla ba phyed 'dra bya/ /rgya shug tshi spyogu bkas 'dra ba/ /sna yi thor to 'brum sreg byed/ /sor brgyad pa la rtse mo ljon⑫/ /gsum pa thal sman sman rim la/ /mthe'u chung gung mo srin lag gi/ /sen mo lta bu'i so byas 111—266

pa'o—/ /pho mtshan sbyang dang mig sman stsogs/ /cha spyad rang rang le 'ur bshad/ /nye ba'i cha spyad khab long dang / /thag pa ras dang tho ba dang / / 'bring bu rgyu ① ma lce rta rda④/ /yal ga sren ①mo kha so dang / /dus dang smin dang lag rkang dang 4/ /'jigs dang dga' ba de'i bya ba'i/ /bye brag thabs ni shes pa'o/ /mkhas pas blo yis dbe+ed par bya/ /cha spyad gdung srub dgang dang rgyun 'a srang dag bya dang / /thal sman gdab dang mtshon dbyung bcing dang btsir ba dang / /gzhib ⑥dang smad dang stod phyadang bskyod dang bcag pa dang / /bzlog dang drang por bya ba cha spyad las rnams yin/ /legs par zug cing 'byin par kyebyed pa dang / /gzung bya blangs nas 'byin par byed phyir dang / /yan lag kun la gnod pa med pas na⑨—/ /cha spyad kun gyi mchog ni kaṅka'i mchu/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus ⑩pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas gtar spyad kyi cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /mgar ba mkhas pas cho ga bzhin/ /brdungs pa'i gtar spyad nyi shu drug /spu ni chod par nus pa dag /phal cher sor ni drug par bya/ /gzugs legs so ni legs pa dang / /gzung spyobar bde ba nyid du bya/ /ya yo med cing 'thar ⑫legs pa'irka/ /shin tu rno ba'i be+egs las bya⑫/ /rtse mo shin tu legs brdungs la④/ /da la sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba'i/ /rang ming ⑫rjes mthun gzugs can ni/ /rtag tu nye bar gzhag ⑩par bya/ /rtse mo re re dag la yang / /rang tshod sor phyed gnyis dang bzhi/ /phal cher gnyis dang gsum du bya/ /de gnas ⑩khyad par dag la sbyar/ /de las dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'i rtse/ /mdzub sen nang gi 111—267

—dbyibs 'drar bya/ /de ni rnyil skyes lkog ma yi/ /sha lhag la sogs gzhar bcad shesbyar/ /'phel gtsags burduspu gri'i dbyibs /)lta bu/ /gcod dang dral dang 'byin la sbyar/ /rtse drang skrangs nad mtho ba dang / /zab pa la ④sbyar de las gzhan/ /ltag pa ring zhing rtse gug pa/ /so thung nad tshul ⑤ji bzhin sbyar—/ /ut+pa la dang so gephyed kyis/ /dral ⑦dang de bzhin gcad ④par bya/ /sbrul kha rtse sor phyed rna ba/ /sna yi thor bu dpyad la sbyar/ /rma tshol 'jam po rta bla 1)ba'i/ /mgo bo 'dra gzhal ⑪brtag par bya/ /de las gzhan pa khab rtse 'dra/ /rtse bug spyo)can ni dbug la tu)sbyar/ / ljang pa'i ()lo 'dra 'bigs pa la/ /sha ri'i mchu ④'dra mda' bug ni⑫/ /kha 'dra rtse gsum khrag gzags la/ /'jag rtse a ta'i spyomachu 'dra ba/ /'bras bu sor gnyis khrag 'byin la/ /de 'dra'i so ni nang du lta/ /gtsags ⑩'bras zla ba kham pa 'dra/ /sor ni phyed dang gnyis yod bya/ /rtse mo 'bras dang 'dra ba la/ /sor ni phyed dang gnyis yod dgalhoshe /de ni rtsa lto'i nad la sbyar/ /sta re'i ⑪spangs 'dra ba lang so/ /'dra ba'i gtsags 'bras sor phyed pa/ /de yi yu ba gyen bstan la⑪/ /rus pa'i steng gnas rtsa la gdab/ /zangs ma'i thur ma rtse gnyis pa/ /rtse mo me tog kha 'bus 'dra/ /de yis mthong nyams mig spris dbug 'a /rgya 'dra'i gtsags 9 gyebu bya ba ni/ /sor gdub 'dra las kha 'byung ba/ /gtsags 'bras snyirgyar ni sor phyed pa/ /rig tsopas 'phel gtsags tsolta bu 'am/ /dkyil 'khor lta bu'i rtse 'dra bya/ /de ni mdzub ( namo'i thor to la/ /gdags su rung ba'i rgya 'dra bya/ / srad bus brtod 8la gre ba'i nang / /nad rnams gcad dang dral nyel sbyar/ /gre ba'i sha lhag thor gtsug ka 'dzin/ /lcags kyu'i 8spertse mo legs 177 268

gug bya/ /rus pa gcod pa'i sog le ni/ /srid du sor bcu zhing sor gnyis/ /so rnams phra ①zhing rab tu rno/ /yu ba chang gzung ②legs par bya/ /rma yi chu rgyus skra bcad pa'i/ /chan pa chan pa 'dra bar bya/ /so yo so drang kha gnyis pa'i—/ /sen mo 'dreg srud ①sor dgu pa④/ /zug rngu phra 'byung gcad ⑤pa dang / /dral dang dbug rjodang phyi bar bya/ /zur bzhi pa la sor gcig pa/ /dbyibs ni kun tu gcig 'dra ba/ /so phyi ba yi gtsags spyad de⑦/ /so yi dreg pa phyi bar bya/ /khab ni mgo rlum mig zab ⑧che/ /mkhrang pa gsum bya de las ni/ /sha che ba yi phyogs su ni/ /zur gsum srid du sor gsum pas/ /sha chung ba dang rus tshigs na/ /rma yod pa la srid sor gnyis/ /zhu dang ma zhu'i gnas nad ⑨rma'i/ /khab rtse 'bras dbyibs gzhu ltar sgu⑩/ /srid du sor ni byed dang gsum/ /khab ni bdun dang brgyad kun yang / /zlum po sor ni legs sgom⑪pa/ /khri gcig la btsugs pir ⑫'dra ba/ /brtsan ⑫sngo gdong nad thig le gnag /skra 'byi ba la gtsags ④par bya/ /khab ⑫brgyad zlum po ⑩sor phyed pa/ /gcig tu sbom ⑩la gzar bu 'dra/ /lag pa gnyis kyis btsugs nas ni/ /de yis sna yi khrag dbyung ngo / /rna shal dbug pa'i snyung bu ni/ /yu ti ka ni ⑫kha 'bus 'dra⑪/ /snyung bu sor ni phyed par bya/ /de yi tshad dbug dude yan chad/ /zur bzhi par byas de yis ⑥ni/ /skrangs smin ma smin ngogs la dbugablu /rna drung sha ni stug po dbug /snyung bu kha ni sbom po la/ /sum cha sbu gu yod byas la⑫/ /sor gsum pa yis rna ba dbug /pad+ma chathal sman me btsa' dang / /mching ⑫bu rdo dum sen mo stsogs/ /lcags min gtar spyad phra mo ste/ /de yang de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /cha spyad 'khrul 111—269

'khor stsogs pas kyang / /mkho ba nad kyi dmigs 3dang sbyar/ /'dren dang 'byen dang 'dral dang 'drub/ /dmigs tshol phyi kyebasal zhal zhal gdab/ / gtsags bcad gshegs dbug btsugs 6pa dang / /gzung dze+esreg de yis (9bya ba yin/ /gcad budang dral dang phyi ba'i phyir/ /spyad kyi gtsags sti'abras rtsa ba'i bar/ /mdzub mo gung mo mtheb mo yis/ /ma yengs pa dang legs par gzung / /gtar ga gdab phyir rtse mo'i drung / /mdzub mo dang ni mthe bos gzung ⑧/ /'bras 'dra ba yi yu ba ni/ /chang par bcug ste rtse mos ⑨gdab/ /dbyung don yu ba nas gzung ⑩bya/ /gzhan dag bya ba gang bder bya/ /gtar ⑪spyad sna tshogs dag gi snod/ /gso ras bal snam men dri 'am/ /pags 'jam du gu la las ⑫byas/ /rab tu stug pa zheng sor dgu/ /srid du sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /bal gyis bar bcad spyad bcug la/ /legs par gzhag ste drub ⑫pa dang / /thur mas kha ni brgyu skebar bya/ /srin bu pad pa ⑫bder gnas pa/ /khrag dbyung phyir ni sbyar ⑫bar bya/ /chu nang nya dang sbal stsogs dang / /mi ro'i dri ma mnam ⑩las byung / /dmar dang dkar dang shin tu gnag /mi srun sbom dang 'byil ba dang / /'ja' tshon dang 'dra ro stod bkra/ /spu yod de rnams dug can yinatushe/ /spang bya des ni khrag gzhibs spyon/ /g.ya' rnags kha 'dzag rims mgo 'khor skyed/ /de la dugs khrag mkhris gso bya/ /chu mdog rnam par gsal 6steb dang / /dug med nya lcibs med las byung / /rtsa snar ro stod sngo khra ( stezlum/ /rgyab ni ngur smrig 8ste'adra lus phra/ /lto ni cung zad ser —ba bzang / /de yang legs par ma sgyugs dang / /rtag tu 'thung du bcug pa dag /chu nang zhugs te nub pa ni/ /khrag gis myos pa yin pas 111 270

spangs①—/ /de nas cig shos skyer pa btags/ /chu sbyar ba yi nang du gzhug / kan dzi'am ②dar ba'i nang du gzhug /slar yang chur ni dbugs phyung nas/ /mar ram sa zhag nu zho 'am/ /khrag gi thigs pa bskus 'thung gzhug /'thungs tshe ro stod ④mthor gyur na/ /ras ma dhisrab mos g.yogs ⑤par bya/ /khrag ni bzang ngan 'dres pa las/ / pad pa rjodang por nad khrag ni/ /'thungs te ngang pas ⑦'o ma dang / /'dres chu'i 'o ma len dang mtshungs/ /so yis 'debs pa'am g.ya' gyur na/ /de ni slar dbyung ⑧skyug tu gzhug /rgyam tsha til mar gyis kha bsku/ /phye ma 'jam pos ⑨rgyab tu gtor/ /slar yang zhag bdun bar du ni/ /khrag myos bsrungs spyol 'thung mi gzhug /srin bu pad pa ⑩legs skyugs na/ /sngon bzhin khong grims ⑫brtan par 'gyur/ /drags na dal zhing snyom 'chi ⑫'gyur/ /skyugs ma legs na rengs stsos 'gyur| /bum pa chu dang sa blugs ⑩pa/ /gzhan dang gzhan du gzhag par bya| /kha chu rul bag sbyang phyir bya/ /gzhan du dug dang bcas par 'gyur/ /ma dag pa 'am khrag mang byung ⑫/ /skyer pa bu ram sbrang rtsis bsku⑩/ /lan brgyar dkrugs ⑩mar ras bal gyi⑫/ /ye 'us byugs ⑪la sman bsil bsku/ /nad kyi khrag dang bral gyur ⑩na/ /'phral du rtsa dmar nad med 'gyur/ /ma dag gnas nas bskyod gyur pa/ /rma yi gnas su 'dug pa'i khrag /zhag lon na ni gnag ⑫par 'gyur/ /de bas de ni slar dbyung ngo / /mkhris rgyas khrag gi nad la ni/ /ku ba bum pa sbyar mi bya/ /de gnyis me dang bcas pa yin/ /rlung dang bad kan la sbyar bya/ /bad kan las gyur nad khrag ni/ /ska⑫ bas rngabs rus gzhib ⑫mi bya/ /rlung dang mkhris pa las 111—271

gyur khrag /rngabs rwas gzhibs ①te dbyung bar bya/ /lus kyi gong du srad ②bu 'am/ /ras kyis dam du bcings nas ni/ /chu ba tshigs rus gnad rnams ni/ /dor te 1zhal zhal gdab par bya/ /gyen du dbyung ba'i thabs kyis ni/ /thur du babs ④pa gdab par bya/ /zab ⑤dang nye dang 'phred mi gdab/ /btab pa'i gnas su'ang gdab mi bya/ /zhal zhal bya ba phyogs gcig 'dus/ /rtsa mdud srin bus khrag 'byung 0zhing / /be+em bem por gyur rwa ⑦stsogs gdab/ /nad khrag lus khyab gtar ga gdab/ /khrag nad 'dus pa zhal zhal bya/ /gting na yod pa pad pas dbyung ⑧/ /pags gnas ku bum rngabs rwas ⑨dbyung / /lus khyab khrag la gtar ga nyid/ /rlung stsogs gnas la rngabs rwa dang / /pad pa ku tho)bas rim bzhin dbyung / /khrag phyung ⑪bsil bskus la stsogs pas/ /rlung ni rnam par 'a gas gyur te/ /rma na ()g.ya' zhing skrangs gyur na'ang / /de la zhun mar dron pos bsku/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas gtar ga gdab pa'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /cung zad mngar zhing tsha bro la/ /grang dang tsha min ska ⑫ba min/ /pad+ma lam bu chu gsher ⑩dang / /btsod ⑫dang ri bong khrag ltar dmar/ /dag cing dmar ba ⑩'byung ba ni/ /de nyid kyis ni lus gnas byed/ /de ni phal cher bad mkhris kyi⑩/ /nad kyis 'khrugs spyopas gnod bskyed pas/ /me dbal 'bras dang mcher nad dang / /skran dang me drod bri ⑪dang rims/ /kha dang mig dang mgo nad dang / /111—272

stsos dang skom dang tsha ①bro dang / /mje dang dreg nad mkhris khrag dang / /sgregs pa skyur zhing mgo 'khor byed/ /bsil dro snum dang rtsub stsogs kyis/ /nad gang gsos par gyur pa dag④ /legs par 'chos par ma gyur pa/ /de ni khrag 'khrugs las gyur yin/ /khrag bdo gyur pa de las ①ni/ /gtar ga gdab pas dbyung bar bya/ /de ④yang bcu drug ma lon dang / / bdun cu ⑤'das la khrag mi dbyung / /nyam rjochung dugs drags dugs ma byas/ /rlung gi nad kyis nyen pa dang / /sbrum ma bu btsas zas ⑦ma zhu/ /khrag mkhris lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /tshad 'khru rims dang skyugs skepa dang / /skya rbab yan lag kun skrangs dang / /snum 'thungs pa la sbyor ba dang / /de bzhin las lnga byas la min/ /ma bsdams gtar ga ⑨mi gdab cing / /yon ⑩po'am mi snang la mi gdab/ /tshabs chen nad ni ma gtogs pa/ /grang la tsha char ⑪rlung dus min/ /mgo dang mig gi nad rnams la/ /'phral ⑫ba'i rtsa la ⑫gtar ba 'am| /mig 'gram sna drung rtsa la gdab/ /rna ba'i nad la rna ba'i rtsa/ /sna yi nad la sna rtser ro/ /cham pa sna dang dpral rtsar ④gdab/ /kha nad rnams la lce dang ni/ /mchu dang rkan gyi rtsar ⑫gdab bo/ /nam tshod yan chad rtsa mdud ⑩mgul/ /rna ba mur ⑩'gram spyir gnas gdab/ /smyo byed mig 'gram brang dpral rtsa/ /brjed byed 'gram pa'i mtshams su gdab/ /yang na kun la ⑫smin mtshams gdab/ /'bras dang rtsib logs zug pa la/ /rtsib logs nu ma'i bar rtsa gdab/ /nyin gsum pa la phrag mtshams gdab/ /nyin bzhi pa la ltag pa'i 'og⑩ /'khru ba gzer dang ldan pa la/ /mjug to'i gong ma sor gnyis par/ /khu ba'i mtshan nad pho mtshan rtsa/ /skog ma'i lba ⑪bar brla rtsa 111—273

gdab—/ /gzugs 'khums pus mazil 'og gam ni/ /gong gi sor bzhi pa la gdab/ /'bras kyi phreng ①bar byin pa'i nywa/ /'og tu sor ba gnyis lagadab bo/ /rkub tshos pus mo'i lha nga'i steng / /nad la long skemo'i ltag sor bzhir—/ /rkang tsha 'theng dang sprid pa dang / / rting rdol ④rlung nad mdzer ⑤pa dang / /rkang sor snags ⑥su chad pa la/ /rgya tshigs las gong sor gnyis gdabaske/ /'khums la rkang 'khums lta bur gdab/ /ji skad bshad pa ma mngon na/ /gnad ma gtogs ⑦pa gar nye ba'i/ /phyogs gzhan ⑧dag tu gtar ga gdab/ /de nas lus snum gtar ga yi/ /yo byad kun bsags stobs dang ldan/ /bkra ⑨shis byas shing kha zas ni/ /snum zos khu ba 'thungs pa dang / /me dang nyi tshan gyis dugs byas⑫/ /pus mnyam mtho ba'i stan la 'dug /skra rtsa ras ni 'jam pos bcings⑪/ /pus mo'i lha ngar gru mo btsugs⑫—/ /khu tshur nang du glod ⑫bcug pas/ /mgul pa dam du btsir bar bya/ /so bsdam lud pa lu ba dang / /mkhur ba gnyis ni bud par bya/ /de la ⑩rgyab nas bcir ba dang / /gos kyis dkri zhing mdzub mo ni/ /g.yon ⑩pa sgog mar bcug ⑩nas su/ /nang du legs par gzhug ⑫par bya/ /'di ni spyonang du kha bltas rtsa/ /ma gtogs spyo)bsdam pa'i cho ga yin/ /de 'og sman pa'i mthe bo smyolas/ /gung mo btang (nyebar gyur pa yis/ /rtsa byung mngon la gdab byas nas/ / reg pa'am mthe bos ⑪mnan byas la/ /lag pa g.yon pas bzung ba yi/ /gtsags 3pu sta res dbus su gdab/ /gtsags 6stebu'i kha phyogs mi g.yo gtad/ /de bzhin gdab pa'am btsir ba yis/ /bem rtol 6k+ṣegadab las khrag dbyung ngo / /sna ⑪drung gi ni rtsar ( nagadab pa/ /rtse mo mthe bos 111 — 274
