bteg khya3nas ni/ / gtsags rtse ne+e'abras 'dra gdab par bya/ /lce bteg bzlog ste sos mnan la/ /lce 'og rtsar ge ni gdab par bya/ /nu ma yan chad bsdams nas ni/ /mgul par gnas pa'i rtsar ④ gdab bo/ /lag pa gnyis su rdo bcangs te/ /lag pa pus mor ⑤brten te brkyang / /mchan khung man chad mnyes nas ni/ /gong du bcings la mdo rtsar ⑥gdab/ /lag ngar rtsa ni bder 'dug ste/ /gdab pa'i sor bzhi gong gi ni/ /phyogs su ras kyis dam bcings la/ /mthe po chad par bcug nas ni/ /lag ngar brkyang la gdab par bya/ /rtsib logs rtsa ni dpung pa gnyis/ / thur du dpyangs ⑦te gdab par bya/ /pho mtshan rtsa ni bteg ⑧ste gdab/ /byin rtsa pus mo ma bkug pararka/ /rkang pa legs gzhag ⑨pus mo la/ /'og tu lag pa gnyis kyis ni/ /long mo'i bar du dam babyung ⑩la/ /rkang pa de ⑪steng gnyis pa ni ⑫/ /cung zad bkug ste bzhag pa yis/ /mnan la de nas ()lag pa ltar/ /rtsar (stegadab de ltar ma smos pa'i/ /gzhan dag la yang gdab byas la/ /thabs shes gtsags ⑫spyad de dang des/ /phyogs ni de dang de ru gdab/ /sha che ba yi phyogs su 'debs/ /'bras 'dra 'bras kyi srid tsam gdab/ /rus pa'i steng rtsa sta re 'dras/ /nas kyi phyed tsam gdab par bya/ /legs par btab nas khrag gzags te/ /chings ma brngol nas gzag mi bya/ /gdab ma legs pa dus cung zad/ /nyung zad 'byung ba ⑩til phye gdab/ /gdab drags sgra dang bcas par ni/ /'byung zhing bcad ⑫kyang dka' bar 'gyur/ / dngang dang 'bog 7par 'gyur ba dang / /chings lhod mtshon rtul 'grangs ṣādrags dang / /nyam chung shugs nyen dugs ma byas/ /khrag mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin no/ /111 — 275

byedakhrag ni legs par ma byung na/ /byi kyo)dang tsha gsum skyer pa dang / /rgya spos rgyam tsha khyim dud bcas/ /til mar btags la rma la bsku/ /khrag ni legs byung til mar dang / /rgyam tshar bcas pa dro 'jam bsku/ /le brgan rtsi las tshon (ṭaser ltar/ /dang po nad khrag ske'abyung bar 'gyur/ /legs par byung na rang nyid 'chad/ /khrag bzang byung na'ang dbyung mi bya/ /brgyal 'gyur na ni chings ma dgrol/ /rlung g.yab kyis g.yab slar khrag dbyung / /slar 'bog gyur na nyi ma ni/ /gnyis pa'angarjogasum pa dag la gdab/ /rlung khrag gnag cing dmar la rtsub/ /shugs drag megasal zhing lbu ba can/ /mkhris khrag ser la rtsa gnag mnam/ /sbyin ⑦bag dro zhing tshon can yin/ /bad kan khrag ni 'jam la skya/ /rgyun can 'byar zhing ska ⑦ba yin/ /'dres pa'i mtshan ma 'dres ma yin/ /nyes gsum dri ma rnyog ma can/ /khrag ngan pa ni nyams ⑧che la'ang / /tshad las lhag par dbyung mi bya/ /khrag dbyung drags ⑨na'ang 'chi ba 'am/ /rlung nad mi bzad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de la bsku byug 'o ma khu/ /khrag bcud blud pa sman yin no/ /khrag phyung nas ni chings ma dag /dal gyis bgrol la chu bsil kyis/ /bkrus la til mar gyis byugs pa'i/ /gos 'jam gyis ni rma kha dkri/ / khrag nad yod na phyi 'byed ⑪dam/ /phyi de nyin par slar yang dbyung / /shin tu gnod pa'i khrag zla phyed/ / snum gyis brtas (/tepa'i lus las dbyung / /khrag ngan ⑪cung zad lus 7kyang ni/ /nad ni lhag par mi skyed pas/ /de phyir lhag ma yod gyur yang / /gzhag ④gi shas cher mi dbyung ngo / /lhag ma rngabs rwa stsogs gdab pa'ang 7/ /yang na spyod bsil khrag mkhris bsal/ /sbyang 7dang skam pa'i bye brag ni/ /gso bas de ni dang 117 276

bar bya/ /nad khrag rab rgyas ma gyur pa'am/ /de 'dra'i 3)thabs kyis gso bar bya/ /khrag gi rgyun ni ma chod na/ /gcad thu—pa'i sbyor ba myur du bya/ /seng (ge phrom rma shing pri yang ku/ /ma sha shing mngar yug snam btsag /gyo dum zar ma snag getsha dang / /'o ma can shing shun lo ma/ /btags dupa'i phye ma rma khar gdab/ /shug bustsogs chu grang ⑦sbyar ba blud⑧/ /yang na rtsa btab de gong gi/ /rtsa de nyid la ⑨gtar ga gdab/ /yang na thur ma bsregs pa yis / /rma kha myur du bsreg par bya/ / bcings pa ⑩nyes pas lam log la gnas te/ /nad ni rgyas pas khrag ni 'khrugs 'gyur ba⑪/ /rang gi gnas su slar phyin ma gyur pa/ /de srid zas ⑫dang spyod lam phan pa bsten/ /shin tu tsha grang ma yin yang drod skyed/ /khrag sel byed pa'i bza' dang btung ba phan/ /de tshe lus dang khrag bder mi gnas pas/ /khyad par du ni me las bsrung bar bya//mdog dang dbang po gsal zhing dbang po yul/ /'dod cing zas 'ju shugs kyang bde bar 'ju⑫/ /bde dang ldan zhing stobs rgyas phun sum tshogs/ /mi yi nad khrag dag pa yin par bshad/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las—/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa ⑩bdun pa'o// //de nas zug rngu dbyung ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /zug rngu'i bgrod pa rnam lnga ste/ /yo drang thad ka steng dang 'og / kha gnag skeskrangs dang nad dang bcas/ /yang dang yang du khrag 'dzag la/ /rma 1yi nye 'khor mtho zhing glo9/zhe/ /chu bur lta bu'i thor bu 'byung / /sha ni 'jam 'gyur lus mdor na/ /khong du zug rngu yod shes (shebya/ /khyad par du ni pags pa na(k+ṣe/ /111—277

mtshon lus mdog nyams sra ba dang / /skrangs par 'gyur ro shar ①gnas pa/ /nad dang skrang ②pa lhag par 'phel⑤ / /btsir bar mi bzod smin pa dang / /rma ④yi sgo ni 'drub rjomi shes/ /nya yi ⑥nang zug ⑦shar zug dang / /'dra las skrang bag ④ med pa yin/ /chu ba'i dra ba'i nang lus pa'i/ /chu ba las ni 'byung dka' zhing / /bsgul dka' bskyod tshe rengs shing na/ /rtsa la brten pa rtsa skrang ⑨ 'gyur/ /bu ga'i sbubs gnas srubs kyis ni/ /rang gi las dang yon tan nyams/ /rtsa chen gnas pa'ang ⑩dbugs dang khrag /lbu ba can du 'byung 'gyur zhing / /sgra dang bcas par 'byung ba dang / /snying dang yan lag na bcas 'gyur/ /rus tshigs bog rer ⑪mtshon lus pa/ /rus brtse ⑫tshabs cher na bar 'gyur/ /rus gnas ⑫nad mang skrang bar ④byed/ /tshigs la gnas pa de dang 'dra/ /bskyod par dka' ba dag tu'ang 'gyur/ /nang grol nang yod 'khrugs thupa dang / /lbo ⑩zhing kha zas ngan skyugs gcin/ /rma yi khar ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnad kyi nang du mtshon lus pa/ /gnad zug mtshan nyid las shes byakṛ)/ /pags pa la sogs rang rang giste/ /ji ltar 'dzag las shes par bya/ /skyon med lus kyi rma 'tshob ste/ /de ni gnod pa med par gnas/ /nad 'khrugs snad pa la sogs kyis⑪/ /bslangs rjonas slar yang gnod pa skyed/ /gang yang rung bar pags pa nyams/ /bsku dang mnye dang dugs byas nas/ /mdog dmar na zhing tsha la 'khrugs kye/ /yang na gang du mar gzhag kye 'ju/ /lde gus byugs pa myur du bskams/ /gnas der ⑫zug rngu bcas shes bya/ /shar lus sbyang bar byas pa rngo steyis/ /skem byas lhongs 'gyur bsgul meb dang / /btsan dmar sogs kyis shes par bya/ /nya dang 111—278

rus tshigs nang grol gyi/ /zug rngu'ang de bzhin shes par bya/ /rus pa zug rngus ma rungs 'gyur/ /rus pa bsku dang dugs bya zhing ①/ /mnye dang btsir las shes par bya/ /rus tshigs gnas pa rus 'dra dang / /brkyang dang bskum las shes par bya/ /chu ba rtsa dang rtsa chen sbubs/ /zug rngu mi mnyam sdelam 'gro dang / /shing rta chag pa'i rta ①dang ni/ /ldan par nad pa bskyon ④nas su/ /myur du drangs nas de nas ni/ /bskyod pas ⑤zug rngu shes par bya/ /gnad zug logs rjoshig ma bshad de/ /de rnams sha stsogs la gnas yin/ /spyir ⑦ni zug rngu bcas bskyod pa'i/ /bya bas nad bcas las shes bya/ /mdor na zlum dang gyes pa dang / /zur bzhi pa dang zur gsum pa'i/ /rma yi dbyibs las zug rngu ni/ /mi mngon rnam par shes par bya/ /de rnams dbyung ba'i thabs gyur gnyis/ /phyir ⑧drang ba dang mdun nas drang / /rtse nas drang dang rtsa nas drang / /de las bzlog pas ⑨dbyung bar bya/ /dbyung sla gang na yod dral te/ /de nas thad kar drang bar bya/ /mtshon ni brang dang mchan khung dang / /brla drung rtsib logs zug pa dang / /mdun drang rtse mo mngon gcad ⑩bya / /kha zheng che drang mi bya dang ⑪/ /zug rngur ⑫ma gyur mde'u dang / /mi mngon gnod med pa mi dbyung ⑫/ /de nas lag pas zin gyur ⑩na/ /lag pa gnyis kyis drang bar bya/ /snang gzhan seng ge chu srin dang / /bar gyi karta ti ⑫mchus drang / /mi mngon rma yi dbyibs las ni/ /gal te dbyung bar nus ⑫gyur pa/ /kang ka bring ka ⑩khrung khrung dang / /bya rog sha ra bye'i ⑫mchus drang //pags stsogs la gnas skam ⑪pas drang / /khong stong nang nas nya mgos dbyung //sbu gur gnas pa 'dam bu 'dras/ /lhag ma gzhan gyis ci rigs drang / /111—279

yang na dang po mtshon gyis dral/ /de nas rma yi khrag bsal ba byas la mar gyis ①dugs bya zhing / /bcings te spyod pa bsten ②par bya/ /rtsa dang chu bar mtshon lus pa/ /thur mas bskyod de dbyung bar bya/ /snying gar gnas pa'i zug rngu ni/ /chu grang ④gtor bas sngangs rjobyas la/ /gnas gzhan phyin cing 'phags gyur spyon/ /ci rigs par ni dbyung bar bya/ /rma yi sgo nas dbyung dka' ba/ /gzhan dag la yang de bzhin sbyar/ /rus par zug pa rkang pa rjoni//gnyis kyis mnan la drang bar bya/ /de ltar ma nus stobs che ba'i/ /g.yog gis dam du bzung ste dbyung / /'on kyang ma nus mde'u'i rtsa/ /bkug la gzhu rgyud dam btags la/ /rta srab kyi ⑦ni kha lcags mthar/ /ma yengs pa yis dam btags te/ /yan lag lnga pa skelegs bsdams nas/ /rta ni lcag gis gzhus nas su/ /brdeg ⑨cing mgo bo bteg ⑩nas ni/ /shugs kyis ji bzhin brtod ⑪nas ni/ /de ltar zug rngu dbyung ba 'am/ /yang na shing gi yal gar gdags/ /mde'u rtsa phra bar tho)srad bu dag /btags te zug rngu dbyung bar bya/ /rma skrangs mde'u rtsa mi mngon na⑫/ /skrangs pa legs par btsir nas dbyung / /dong bu tho bas brdungs pa yis/ /mtho zhing snang bar gyur na dbyung / /lam ma yin par 'byung ba gang / /de nyid kyis ni rmar dbyung ⑫bya/ /mde'u zur bcum ste dbyung ba'am/ /dong bu ⑫kha yis dbyung bar bya/ /rna ba med cing rma kha dbye/ /drang 'dug khab long bstan pas dbyung / /zhu ba'i gnas su ⑩zug rngu ni/ /bkru sman nyid kyis dbyung bar bya/ / rlung gnod dugs ⑫dang nu zho dang / /khrag dang chus gnod gzhibs ⑫pas bsal—/ /gre ba'i nang zhugs zug rngu la/ /skud pa gre bar gzhug bya ste/ /111—280

pad+ma'i rtsa bar skud pas gdags/ /pad rtsa zug rngu lhan cig drang / /lcags sreg tsho)mig chur bcug pa yi'/ /lcags thur brtan por byas nas ni/ /rgya skyegs can nam rgya skyegs med/ /rgya skyegs kyis bsgos zug rngu dbyung ( / /skra shad 'dzings pa 'thungs pa dang / /gsher bas tsher ma zug pa gdon/ /'phral du srad bu thogs pa yis/ /slon par bya'o des cig shos/ /kha snar drang bar ma nus na/ /gzhan du thur du mid par bya 4/ /zas kyis brnangs 'a)pa'i zug rngu ni/ /chu btung duphrag par brdegs spyopas gzhug /mig gi rma yi zug rngu phra/ /dar ram bal lam chu yis bsal/ /mi (nyeni chus gang kha sbubs te—/ /sprugs ⑫pa'am brkyang la babyur slon pa'am/ /thal khung brkos ⑩te mi yi ni/ /ske yi ⑪bar du nub par ⑫gzhug /rna ba chus gang lag pa yis/ /mnyes la til mar rgyun blugs ⑫la/ /rna ba thur du bstan nas ni/ /gdab pa'am yang na brngub ⑫par bya/ /rna ba'i nang du 'bu zhugs na/ /rna ba tsha chus bkang ⑫ba 'am/ /tsha chu dro 'jam nyid kyis dgang / /shi nas ⑩'bu ro dbyung thabs bya/ /rgya skyegs can dang gser dngul stsogs/ /'byung khungs las byung yun rings ⑩gnas/ /mtshon ni phal cher lus kyi me6she/ /drod kyis 'ju bar byed pa yin/ /sa dang 'od ma shing rwa ⑪rus/ /so dang skra dang rdo ba'ang 'ju—/ /rwa dang 'od tshal lcags ta la/ /shing ⑩tshal zug rngu ring pos kyang / /phal cher de dag tshes spyo'agyur la/ /khrag dang sha yis tshos par byed/ /zug rngu sha yi gting ⑫du zug /phyogs de tsha ba'am med gyur na/ /de nas de ni snang bya'i phyir/ / mnye dugs sbyangs 6stedang sha dbri blta/ /sman rnon bcings dang zas ⑫skom sbyin/ /mtshon gyis btab cing gtsags /tshapa yis/ /smin par byas 111—281

nas rma dbral dang / /btsal dang bye bas zug rngu dbyung / /zug rngu'i ①gnas dang cha spyad ②kyi/ /tshul ni mang pos ①legs brtags te/ /blo ldan thabs ni de dang des④/ /shes par byas la zug rngu dbyung / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu brgyad pa'o// //de nas gtar ga gdab pa'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /rma ni phal cher dang por ni/ /skrangs dang smin las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bas de nyid gso bya ste/ /de bsil byugs ⑤blugs khrag dbyung dang / /legs par sbyangs pa la sogs pas/ /m+bin par gyur las 'bad de bsrung / /thor bu ma smin skrangs drod chung / /mdog 'dra sra zhing brtan par gnas/ /smin tshe mdog ni 'gyur ba dang / /dmar zhing rkyal bu'i dbyebs ltar 'dug /gas pa lta bu'i nad bcas dang / /yan lag snyom rjozhing glal bcas dang / /lus grugs 'khrugs tsha yi ga 'chus/ /rims 'debs skom dad gnyid med dang / /mar 'khyags bzhag na 'ju ba dang / /rma gtar reg na mi bzod do/ /smin gyur ⑦na ba'i shugs chung zhing / /rnyid cing skya la gnyer ma 'du/ /mtha' ma 'jum zhing dbus su mtho/ /g.ya' dang skrang ba ⑧la sogs chung / /rkyal pa yi ni chu lta bur/ /reg na rnag ni phan tshun rgyu/ /rlung min mi na mkhris min tsha⑨/ /med de bad kan med mi skrang ⑩/ /khrag med dmar bar mi 'gyur te/ /de bas nad khrag dang bcas smin/ /smin pa thal drags khong stong dang / /nad kyis zos pas pags pa srab/ /gnyer ma 'jum zhing mdog gnag la/ /ba spu rnams ni 'bye bar 'gyur/ /bad kan shas che'i skrang ⑪pa ni/ /smin pa gting 111—282

ring khrag gis gang / /de bas smin rtags ①gsal ma yin/ /skrang skepa gang du bsil 'gyur zhing / /pags mdog mi 'gyur nad ①tshabs chung / /rdo ltar reg na sra ba ni/ /mkhas pas the tshom med par de/ /khrag gi ④smin pa zhes bshad bya/ /snying stobs nyam chung byis pa dang / /thor bu smin pa'i tshabs che 'am⑤—/ /gnad dang rus tshigs la sogs par/ /'byung ba ma gtogs gzhan dag 'dral/ /ma byun brtol na rtsa rgyus larjo/ /gnod cing khrag ni mang du 'byung / /nad tshabs rab 'phel rma gyes pa'am/ /rma 'byung thor bu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rnag ni nang du ⑦gnas gyur pa/ /'phel bas rtsa rgyus sha dang ni/ /khrag rnams myur du sreg byed de/ / rtswa skam ⑧la ni me dang mtshungs//gang zhig ma smin brtol ba dang / /gang zhig smin kyang btang snyoms 'jog /khyad par mi shes de dag ni/ /sme sha can 'drar shes par bya/ /ma brtol ba yi dang por ni/ /kha zas phan pa sbyin par bya/ /tshor ba mi bzad bzod 'gyur bas—/ /chang 'thung ba la chang blud bya/ /zas zos pas ni ⑨mi brgyal zhing / /nang du mtshon btab tshor mi 'gyur/ /rum du ⑩bu shi rde'u tshags dang / /kha nad dmu rdzing can ma gtogs/ /de nas yo byad kun bsags te/ /nad pa shar du kha bstan la/ /sman pa mngon (spephyogs bsdams nas ni/ /gnad stsogs ma gtogs gtsags ⑫bus gdab/ /sha shugs ⑫rjes mthun shin tu rno/ / gtsags bu rnag phyin ⑫bar du gdab⑩/ /de ni cig car gdab par bya/ /smin pa chen po yod kyang ni/ /rma zheng ⑫sor gnyis dral bya 'am/ /sor gnyis pa yi zab ⑩sor gsum/ /mdzub mo chu ba sru spyodag gis/ /gnas phyogs ji bzhin brtag pa 'am/ /rma 'tshol ⑪gyis ni legs btsal zhing / /kun tu 111—283

legs par brtag ①par bya/ /gang nas gang du 'gro bar 'gyur④/ /gang du mtho ④ba shes byas la/ /de dang der di rma btod ④de/ /legs phye phug ni med par bya/ /chu ⑤dang zheng du ci nas kyang / /nad ni gnas rjopar mi 'gyur bya/ /sman pa dpa' brtan las la myur/ /mtshon rno mi rtul ⑦mi 'dar la⑧/ /kun tu rmongs par ma gyur pa/ / gtsags bus ⑨'debs pa'i las la bsngags/ /gyen du bcad rtsa 'phral smin rtsa/ /rnyil dang ske ⑩rtsa lto sbos dang / /mchan khung dang ni mig sbubs mchu/ /mkhur tshos brla drung chu so rtsa'o/ /gzhan dag gyen du bcad na ni/ /rtsa dang chu ba'ang ma rungs 'gyur/ /gtsags ⑪bus btab nas nad pa ni/ /tshig snyan chu ni bsil ba yis/ /dbugs phyung nas ni de 'og rma/ /sor mos kun nas btsir ba dang / /bska ba'i chu yis legs bkrus shing ⑫/ /sman chur bcug pa'i gos kyis phyi/ /gu gul yungs kar a ru ra/ /shing kun ka ra rgyam tsha dang / /shu dag nim pa'i lo ma ni/ /mar dang sbyar bas bdug ⑫par bya/ /til gyi lde gu mar sbrang rtsi/ /rang gi sman ni ji lta bas/ /byugs shing de nas rma tshangs gzhug /de nyid kyis ni de g.yogs la/ /mar dang phye sbrus bskus pa ⑫dang / / de'i 'og kog ⑫tse stug po ni/ /gzhag ste shin tu ma yengs pas/ /gos kyis legs par bcing byas te//glo spyodang g.yas dang g.yon dag gam/ /steng dang 'og tu ma song bya/ /rma tshangs kog tse ⑩dkris mar bcas/ /phra zhing sra la gtsang ba la/ /spos kyis bdugs shing spyo'ajam la mnyen⑩/ /kham khum med cing rma la phan/ /bcings nas de'i 'og tu ⑪de/ /gnod pa bzlog phyir bsrung bar bya/ /de rnams la ni gtor ma sbyin/ / lasmi gu ha ⑥a ti gu ha/ /spang spos pra ma tsa ri ni/ /tsha 111—284

tra a ti tsha tra dang / /dur ba shu dag nyungs kar dag① /rtag tu de yi spyi bor btags/ /de nas snum gyi cho gar bshad/ /nyin re'i kun spyod bshad pa ②bstan| /nyin par gnyid ④log rma g.ya' zhing / /kha dmar na dhiskrangs rnag 'khyims 'gyur/ /bud med dran nam ⑤reg pa 'am/ /mthong bas khu ba byung 'gyur rjon/ /ma phrad na 'ang 'khrig dze+epa las/ /byung ba'i skyon ni thob par 'gyuraske/ /kha zas dag ni gang goms las/ /nas dang gro dang drug cu pa/ /sran chung muṅga du ⑧ba ri/ /ni shan nā ga dzi ⑨brnyi/ /la phug gzhon nu brta ka /rgya sne'u dan+d+ra ⑩li ya ka /ka ra ⑪be+e la karko ta/ /ka du ga pal pa to la/ /rgyam tsha se 'bru skyu ru ra/ /chu bskol ba ni bsgrangs ⑫pa dang / /'bras rnying chang dang snum nyung zad/ /zos rjes chu tshan btung ba dang / /skam ⑫sa'i sha ni zos gyur na/ /rma ni myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /dus su ran par bza' ba dang / /phan pa zos na bde 'ju 'gyur/ /ma zhu ba yi rlung la stsogs/ /ldang zhing nad ni stobs can 'gyur/ /de las skrangs dang rnags ④pa dang / /tsha dang sbos par 'gyur ba yin/ /'bru gsar ⑩til dang ma sha dang / /chang dang rlan ⑫can las byung sha /'o ma bu ram shing las gyur/ /skyur dang lan tshwa tsha ba dang / /gzhan gang 'khru ba gcod byed ⑩dang / /tsha dang bsil dang lci ba yang ⑫/ /'bru sar la sogs sde tshan 'di/ /rma dang ldan pa'i nad kun skyed/ /chang ni rno ba tsha rtsub 'gyur/ /rma la myur du gnod ⑪par byed/ /ba la udhi 0ras g.yab cing / /'di ni bskyod par mi bya la/ /drag shul mi gzug 'phrug ⑥mi bya/ /bskyod pa'i tshe na bag bya'o/ /mdza' dang bram ze rgan stsogs kyi⑫/ /gtam ni yid la dga' ba nyanablu/ /nad las thar ba'i re bcas pas/ /rma ni 111—285

myur du 'tsho ①bar 'gyur/ /nyin gsum lon tshe rma yi tshasakye/ /slar yang bkrus sogs las rnams ni/ /snga ma bzhin bya de bzhin du/ /nyin zhag gnyis par mi bya'o/ /tshabs cher na zhing mi 'byar la/ /rma ni yun ring zhig na 'tsho④/ /rma tshangs sam ni lde gus glan 4/ /snum ches rtsub ches dam pa dang / /lhod drags gzhag ⑤nyes mi bya ste/ /snum ches rma ni rid 0par 'gyur/ /rtsub ches sha 'chad shin tu na/ /gas shing khrag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dam dang klod drags gzhag ⑦nyes pas/ /rma yi kha ni 'drud par 'gyur/ /rma ni rnag bcas skrangs shing mtho/ /rgyu bcas rnag phugs 'chas pa dag /rma tshangs ⑧'jam po nang gnas pas/ /rma yi skyon ni dag par byed/ /skrangs pa ha cang ma smin brtolaske/ /smin zhing rnags ⑨par 'gyur ba spyad/ /phan pa'i sman dang zas sbyin ⑩dkri/ /shin tu rmar ⑪mi gnod pas gso/ /snad pa'i rma ni gsar du byung / /ral zhing kha bye 'phral du btsem/ /rmen ⑫bu chen po bkas pa dang / /rna shal ⑫bu ga chad pa'ang btsem/ /mgo dang mig ⑫phugs sna dang mchu/ /mkhur tshos spyorna ba dpung pa brla()/ /mgul pa phrag pa me+eg pa dpyi/ /pho mtshan gzhang dang lto ba stsogs/ /phugs ring ba yi gnas rnams dang / /sha che mi 'gul ma yin dang / /chu so mchan khung la stsogs dang / /sha chung mgul pa'i rma dag dang / /dbugs dbyung zug rngu yod pa dang / /thal sman dug mes ⑩tshig mi btsem/ /btsem pa rus dum khrag skam dang / /rtsa dang spu rnams bsal nas ni/ /sha chad dum bu 'phyang ba dang / /rang gi gnas su glan pa dang spyo/ /rus tshigs bcug cing khrag gzags la/ /skud pa shing shun rgyus pas btsem/ /srubs ⑩/ni nye ba'am ring mi bya/ /blang ba che ba'am chung mi bya//111—286

de nas spro bsring ①byas nas mthar/ /rma ni sbrang rtsi mar sbyar dang / /skyer pa zar ma'i dud pa dang / /'bras bu gsum dang sa la ki/ /seng phrom mngar dang ②snum bcas pas/ /bskus la bcing ①stsogs sngon bzhin bya/ /rma kha khrag ni med 'gyur gang / /de ni cung zad 'brud ④bya ste/ /rma 'byor byed pa khrag yin pas/ /phyung ste legs par drub ⑤par bya/ /de la rjobacings pa yul la stsogs/ /brtags nas ⑦nges par sbyar bar bya/ /bal gos pags pa dar gsum dro/ /zar ma'i ras ni bsil ⑧ba yin/ /dro stigrang ran pa shing bal 'dab⑩—/ /ras bal rgyus pa shing shun yin/ /zangs lcags zha nye ro nye yis/ /bad kan tshil ches rma la glan/ / chag thur shing byang ⑪pags pa dang / /shing shun byug tshal stsogs ⑫pas bcingasatho)/ /dbyibs ni rang min rjes mthun pa'i—/ /bcing ④ba bco lnga rnam bya ste/ /shubs ⑫dang bkra shis lhod par basbung / /mthar chags bcing dang zlum por bcing / /mda' lcags khri dang dam bcing dang / / sgye'u bla re lkog ⑫shal dang / /'ur mthil zung ⑩glan zlum pa dang / /yan lag lnga pa zhes bya sbyar/ /de las gang zhig gang legs sbyor/ /de ni de ru legs par sbyar/ /brla dang mjug tsos mchan khung dang / /chu so spyi bor dam du bcing / /lag ngar spyogadong dang rna ba dang / /rgyab dang rtsib logs mgul pa lto/ /pho mtshan rlig pa ran par bcing /mig dang tshigs su lhod par bcing / /lhod bcings ⑪rma ni bad kan dang / /rlung shas che la ran par bcing / /ran zhing gnas su dam du bcing / /dam zhing ⑥shin tu dam du bcing / /dgun dang de bzhin dpyid kyi tshe/ /zhag ni gsum gsum dag nas dgrol/ /khrag mkhris shas che'i rma dag ni/ /dam 111—287

bcing gnas su ran par basbung / /ran bcing gnas su lhod par bcing / /lhod bcing ①gnas su bcing mi bya/ /de gnyis so ga ston gyi tshe/ /snga dro phyi dro dgrol bar bya/ /ma bcings sha sbrang sbrang bu dang / / lhags pa ser bu ④stsogs pas gnod/ /rma red 'gyur ④zhing der snum dang / /sman ni yun ring gnas mi 'gyur/ /sbyang ba'am 'tsho bar dka' ba dang / /'tshob ④kyang mdog ni mi sdug 'gyur/ /bcings na chag bcing phye mar 'gyur⑤/ /'phres sam 'bur gyur dral gyur rjotam/ /rtsa dang rgyus pa chad ⑦gyur kyang / /rma ni myur du bde bar ⑧'tsho/ /ldang dang nyal ba la sogs pa'i/ /spyod lam kun la gnod pa med/ /rma kha skyes mtho mi mnyam ⑨dang / /sra zhing rab na 'tsho ba dka'aske/ /'jam zhing mnyam la na ba med/ /rma ni myur du dag cing 'tshob/ /rma ni yun ring sha chung dang / /rtsub pas 'byor par ma gyur na/ /nad gzhi dus tshigs ji bzhin du/ /sman dang lo mas dgab ⑩par bya/ /ma rnying ⑪gzhon zhing bu ga med/ /kun nas ⑫legs par khebs ⑫pa dang / /phyis shing mi rtsub lo ma ni/ /'o ma can shing stag ⑫pa dang / /ardzu na dang ka dadza'i⑫/ /lo ma yis ni g.yogs ⑩par bya/ /mdze dang me yis tshig pa dang / /'bus zos gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /byi ba sbrul gyi dug dang ni/ /thal sman rno dang dug gis phog /rma ni bcing bar mi bya zhing / /sha 'drul gzhang khar mi bzad rnags/ /'drul zhing tsha dang na bcas par/ /skrangs skams ⑩me dbal mi bcing ngo / /rma gang legs par ma bsrungs par/ /sbrang ma srin bu 'jug byed de/ /de yis zos pas na ba dang / / skrang dang rnag khrag 'dzag ⑫par byed—/ /der ni bkru dang dag par ni/ /bye'u rug ⑪la sogs sde tshan sbyar/ /111—288

sap+ta paṇi ①ka rañdza/ /arka dang ni nim pa dang / /ra tsha ⑤dang ni shing tsha rnams//ba gcin dang ni btags pa yi/ /sde gu de la bsku ba dang / /thal sman chu ni blugs pas ④phan/ /yang na sha zlon gyis g.yogs la/ /de ni myur du dbyung bar bya/ /'di ni nang na skyon bcas pas/ /myur du 'tshob par mi bya ste—/ /de ni gnod pa'ang chung ngus kyang / /slar zhing 'grams par 'gyur ba yin—/ /'tshob par gyur kyang ma zhu dang / /drag shul bud med bsten stsogs spang / /zla ba drug gam bdun byu bar/ /cho ga 'bad pas rjobasrung bar bya/ /gnas skabs de dang der ni byung gyur tshe/ /nad gzhi la stsogs stobs kyis ⑤rjes 'brangs te/ /phyi ma nas bshad rgya bucher legs brtags la/ /thabs ni de dang de yis 'bad de gso/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas thal sman rnon po dang me btsa' gdab pa'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ / gtsags spyad lcags spyad ⑦rjes 'dra ba/ /mang po kun las thal sman mchog /dka' ba rnams su'ang bcad ④pa 'am/ /dbug pa la stsogs byed par 'gyur/ /gtsags ⑨bus gdab par dka' ba la'ang / /de yis bsgrub spyopar rung ba dang / /shin tu gso dka'i nad rnams la/ /gang zhig btung du'ang (sperung ba yin/ /de ni gzhang 'brum me drod nyams/ /rde'u 'gags sbyar dug skran stsogs btung / /sme ⑫ba sha bkra sna 'thor dang / /phyi rol gzhang 'brum tshor med mje/ /thor bu 'brum phran mtshan bar ⑫rdol/ /rma log stsogs la byug par bya/ /khrag mkhris rlung can nad stobs chung / /111—289

rims dang tshad 'khru snying klad nad/ /skya rbab yi ga 'chus pa dang / /rab rib can la ①slon khrus btang / /lus kun khyab pa'i 'or nad dang / /'jigs dang sbrum ma zla mtshan 'dzag② /pho mtshan mo mtshan skrangs pa dang / /byis pa rgan po zas ma zhu/ /rtsa bo che dang rus tshigs gnad/ /rus pa gzhon nu chu ba rtsa/ /lto bsrubs mgul pa lte ba dang / /sha srab phyogs dang rmig pa dang / /pho mtshan bu ga sen mo phrag /mig mchu ma gtogs mig nad rnams—/ /tsha grang char dang yul rmus tshe/ /gnyi ga 'ang gtang bar mi bya'o/ /mu ka ①ka nag sha mya ka /chu shing ba ri ba tra ka /a shwa kar+ṇa ④'dzam bu'i shing //pa la sha dang a bo ta/ / en+d+ra thrak+ṣa arga ⑤dang / /nagha rjom la mut+ta ka /sring ⑦shing a pa marga dang / /ka ka dza ka tsi tra ka /aldi man+ta til bca' sga⑧/ /rlon shing rtsa ba la stsogs bcas/ /dum bur yongs su gtubs ⑨pa dang / /ko sha ta ka rnam bzhi dang / /nas kyi sog ma gra ma rnams/ /rlung med gnas su bsags nas de/ /rdo leb steng du so sor gzhag /mu ka ka ⑩yi phung po dang //rdo thal rdo ni ⑪bcug par bya/ /de nas til gyi ⑫sdong bus bsreg⑫ /tshig nas me ni shi ba dang / /rdo thal thal ba logs shig dbye/ /thal ba gzhan dag bye gang ste/ / mu ka'i ④thal lhag blangs nas ni/ /so sor phye ste chu dang gcin/ /srang stong dag dang bsres nas bzhu/ /tshags ni bzang pos de btsags la⑫/ /ji srid 'byar bag dmar zhing dwangs/ /rno ⑩bar gyur pa'i bar du ni/ /thal ba'i dwangs ma de blangs la/ /lcags snod bzang por bskol zhing dkrugs⑩/ /de nas 'tshod par byed pa der/ /rdo thal bsregs rdo'i dum bu dang / /nya phyis k+ṣi ra pa ka dang / /dung gi lte ba lcags snod gzhug /me mdog can du 111—290

lan mang bya/ /thal sman cha ni phul gang dang / /me bsad de nyid dang btags la/ /lde gu der ni gzhug par bya/ /khyim bya rma bya bya rgod dang / /kaṅka phug ron rtug pa dang / /bya dang rkang bzhi'i mkhris pa dang / /ba bla ldong ros lan tshwa rnams/ /zhib btags bcug bya de nas ni/ /gzar bus de yang kun tu dkrugs①/ /gang tshe lbu bar bcas par khol/ /chu bur sbom ska ②lde gu 'dra—/ /de tshe phab la grangs pa dang / /lcags snod bcug ste nas nang ②gzhug /'di ni thal sman 'bring po yin/ /'jam po ma btags phar bcug larka/ /gsur ④la slar ni gdon par bya/ /rnon por snga ma bzhin bcug la/ /laṅka liṅka darnyi dang / /shu dag bong ngasnyetsi tra ka / swa rtsi rjoka dang khron bu dang / /shing kun ka raspru'i lo ma/ /ta la'i lo ma kha ru tsha'i/ /phye bcug zhag bdun de gzhag bya/ /rnon po de ni rlung bad kan/ /tshil skyes thor bu tshogs la btang //'di nyid nad tshabs 'bring la 'bring / /'jam po khrag mkhris gzhang 'brum la'o⑦//mthu bskyed phyir ni 'o ma chu/ /thal sman chu ni be+er yang gzhug /shin tu rno min 'jam dang mnyen/ /'byar bag sna rno dkar ba dang / /rtse can bde bar 'jil ba dang / /mi 'dzag byugs na nad mi che/ /thal sman yon tan bcu dang ldan/ /gtsags ⑧bu me btsa'i las kyang byed/ /dkrugs pas gzhibs ⑨pa lta bu dang / /lus ni bcir ba lta bu dang / /nad kyi rjes 'go snyegs ⑩pas na/ /rtsa ba nas ni 'byen par byed/ /⑪las byas nad dang bral nas kyang / /rang nyid nye bar zhi bar 'gyur/ /thal sman gyis ni gso ba'i nad—/ /mtshon bcad brud ⑫pa'am gtar ga bya⑫/ /thal sman thur ma gos kyis ni/ /dkris pa bsgos ⑫te glan nas su/ /grangs brgya'i bar ⑫du bsdad 111—291

nas phyi/ /de la gzhang 'brum bskus gos kyis/ /g.yogs te lag pas dgab par bya/ /mig mchu'i nad la mig mchu bzlog /mig 'bras nag po ras bal gyisarka/ /bkab ste legs par byug par bya/ /thal sman pad lo tsam srab bsku//sna yi bu ga'i thor bu ni/ /nyi ma la bltas 'dug pa la/ /sna rtse legs par btag ①nas ni/ /grangs ni lnga bcu'i bar du gzhag /rna ba'i thor bu la de bzhin—/ /thal sman bskus pa'i 'og tu ni/ /phyis la legs nyes rtogs bya ste//legs tshig mar dang sbrang rtsi bsku/ /'o ma rang skyur zho ga chus/ /dbal bsad de nas mar bcas pa'i/ /mngar dang bsil bas byug par bya/ /bza' btung bad kan bskyed pa dang / /bsrul ba'i phyir ni sbyin par bya/ /gal te rtsa ba brtan gyur pas/ /thal sman gyis bsregs sdemi 'drul na/ /'u su skyur snyigs shing mngar dang / /til gyi lde gus de tshe bsku/ /til gyi lde gu shing mngar bcas/ /mar gyis bskus na rma 'tshob byed/ /smin pa 'dzam bu ltar kun gnag /legs tshos de las go bzlog pa/ /dmar zhing na la g.ya' stsogs byed/ /bsregs nyes yin te de slar bsreg① /bsregs drags khrag ni 'dzag pa dang / /brgyal zhing tsha dang rims stsogs 'gyur/ /gzhang khar bsregs drags khyad par du/ /'gags pa'am shas cher 'byung bar 'gyur/ /khu ba zad par 'gyur ba 'am/ /gzhang kha 'byung bas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /snar drags sna yi mtshul bar ni/ /nyams pa'am yang na yo ba 'am/ /yul ni 'dzin mi nus par 'gyur/ /rna ba stsogs pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /'dir rjoni mchog tu skyur ba blugs⑤/ /shing mngar mar dang til btags byugarjo /rlung dang mkhris pa sel ba dang / /bsil ba'i spyod pa thams cad phan/ /skyur 111—292

ba'i reg pa bsil bas na/ /thal sman de dang 'dres gyur na/ /de yis myur du mngar 'gyur bas①/ /skyur bas tsha ba shin tu 'jil/ /me btsa' thal sman las mchog ste/ / des bsregs pas ni skebe+er mi 'byung / /sman dang thal sman mtshon spyad kyis/ /ma grub par ④yang grub byed yin/ /pags pa sha dang rtsa rgyus dang / /tshigs dang rus stsogs de la gdab/ / sme ba mdze nad glad ④nad dang / /mgo bo'i gzhogs phyed na stsogs la/ /pags bsregs ras bal ba lang so/ /me shel mda' sgyug stsogs me gdab/ /gzhang 'brum rmen ⑤bu mtshan bar rdol ④/ /bu ga rma longs ⑦la stsogs la/ /sha bsreg spra sgetshil mar bsregs dang / /bu ram 'dzam bu'i chu yis bsreg⑨ /pags pa 'jar ⑩dang khrag ma chod/ /thig le gnag stsogs pags nad na/ /de dag nyid kyi rtsa bsreg go/ /bsreg ⑪min thal sman bkag pa dang / /nang na mtshon lus rma chen 'byung / /khrag zags pa dang lto dral ⑫ba'o/ /legs bsreg ⑫mar dang sbrang rtsis (stebasku/ /snum dang bsil spyobs byug par bya/ /legs pa'i mtshan ma khrag mi dbyung ⑩/ /sgra can ⑩chu bur phre'u 'byung / /ta la'i 'bras smin thi ba 'dra/ /na ba chung zhing 'tshob pa (nyebe+e/ /bag med pas bsregs thams cad dang / /bsregs nyes bsregs ni drags pa dang / /ma tshos mtshan nyid dang bcas bzhi/ /ma tshos pags mdog mi sdug tsha(che/ /chu bur 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bsregs nyes chu bur che rab tsha /bsregs drags pas ni sha 'phyang dang / /pags pa 'khums shing rab tu tsha//dud pa 'khyems pa lta bu dang / /rtsa stsogs 'khums shing skom dang brgyal/ /rma yi gting zab 'chi bar 'gyur/ /ma tshos pa ni me phrad ( 7cing / /tsha 11 1 293

ba'i sman ni gtang ①bar bya/ /khrag ska ②shin tu na bar 'gyur/ /zags par gyur na nad tshabs chung / /bsregs nyes bsil dang dro ba'i sman/ /dang por btang na de 'og bsil/ /bsregs legs na ni cu gang ⑦dang / / blag sha rjotsan+dan btsag yug snam⑤/ /sle tres bcas pa mngar rjobacas bsku/ /de 'og mkhris me dbal ltar spyad/ /bsregs drags mkhris pa me dbal gyi/ /cho ga thams cad myur du spyad/ /snum gyis shin tu bsregs drags pa⑦/ /der ni rtsub pa'i cho ga'ang bya/ /snying po gsang ba lta bu ni/ /gnas 'dir rdzogs par byas pa yin/ /'dir don phra ba mdor bshad kyi/ /rgya cher kun tu bstan pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/mdo'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu tham pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mdo'i gnas te gnas dang po rdzogs so// //de nas lus kyi rum du zhugs pa'i gnas dang po bshad par bya'o/ /de yang sngon gyi sgedrang srong chen po rgyun shes kyi bu la stsogs pas 'di skad bshad do/ /khu khrag skyon med par sems can/ /rang las stinyon mongs kyis bskul nas/ /tshogs pas ⑩mngal du chags ⑪'gyur te/ /gtsub shing las di me 'byung ⑫mtshungasarka/ /sa bon bdag nyid 'byung ba che/ /phra ⑫mo sems kyi rjes 'gro dang / /ma yi kha zas dwangs ma las/ /rim gyis mngal du rnam par 'phel/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i zer ④gyi me/ /me shel dang ni phrad gyur pa'i/ /shing la 'gro bar mi snang ste/ /sems can mngal gnas de dang 'dra/ /rgyu yi rjes su 'gro 111—294

bas na/ /'bras bu de dang skal mnyam nyid/ /sems can skye gnas sna tshogs 'dzin—/ /zangs ma la stsogs bzhushedang mtshungs/ /de bas khu ba mang ba las/ /phal cher skyes par skye 'gyur ④la/ /zla mtshan mang bas bud med de/ /de gnyis ①mnyam las ma ning 'gyur/ /khu khrag rlung gis mang du phye/ /ji lta ba rjolas mtshe mar 'gyur/ /skye gnas mi mthun gzugs mi sdug /gnod pa'i dri mas skye bar 'gyur/ /bud med zla ba re re'i ⑤khrag /dwangs ma las byung zhag gsum 'dzag /lo ni bcu gnyis yan chad nas/ /lnga bcu'i bar 'dzag de nas zad/ /bud med lo ni bcu drug lon/ /skyes pa nyi shu lon dang 'dus/ /mngal gnas lam dang khu ba khrag /rlung dang sems ni dag gyur pa'i/ /bu ni stobs dang ldan pa skye/ /de las lo ni ma tshang ba'i/ /nad can tshe thung skal ngan pa'i/ /bu chags pa 'am chags mi 'gyur/ /rlung stsogs rul ༷dang mdud pa can/ /dri ma skyon dang ldan bshad pa'i/ /khu khrag sa bon byed mi nus / /rang gi mtshan mas skyon byung bshad/ /khrag gis ⑦rul zhing bad kan dang / /rlung gis mdud pa can 'drar 'gyur/ /khrag dang mkhris pas ⑧rnag 'dra la/ /rlung dang mkhris pas ⑨zad par 'gyur/ /'di dag gso dka' nyes gsum ldan/ /bshang gci 'dra ba ⑩gsor mi rung / /rlung la sogs pas gnod gyur pa⑪/ /rang gi sman gyis gso bar bya/ / rul la da ta ⑫ka'i me tog /seng ldeng se ⑫'bru ardzu na/ /mar dang bskol ba blud pa 'am/ /a sa na stsogs bskol ba ④blud/ /khu khrag mdud 'dra pa la sha'i/ /thal ba sru sru'i rtsa bas ⑫phan/ /rnag 'dra pa ru sha ka dang / /n+ya gro dha stsogs bskol ba blud/ /khu ba zad la ro tsa'i ⑩dbe+ed/ /bshang 'dra slon khrus shing kun ⑩dang / /pu 111—295

shel tsi tra ka bskol blud/ /zla mtshan mdud 'dra pa tha dang / /tsha gsum dug mo nyung bskol ①blud/ /zla mtshan rul dang rnag 'dra la/ /tsan+dan blud bya phyis bshad pa'i/ /gsang ba'i nad gsor ②bshad kun dang / /'jam rtsir bcas snepa gang yin bya/ /khu ba dkar zhing lci ba dang / /dmar ④dang bska dang mang ba dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi til mar 'dra/ /mngal du legs chags zla mtshan yang / /rgya skyegs khu ba ri bong khrag /'dra zhing bkrus na dag 'gyur bzang / /khu khrag skyon med nad med cing / /phan tshun du ⑤ni chags pa dang / /ro tsa'i snum gyis brtas pa dang / /sbyang ba byas shing 'jam rtsi btang / /mchog tu skyes pa 'o ma mar/ /mngar ba'i sman gyis brta bar bya//bud med til mar sha dag ni/ /mkhris pa skyed pa nye bar spyad/ /bud med nyam chung bzhin ras dang / /nu ma rked pa 'gul rjob dang / /mig dang dku g.yo skyes pa 'dod/ /zla mtshan ldan par shes par bya/ /dper na nyi ma nub pa na/ /pad+ma'i kha ni zum ⑦par 'gyur/ /de bzhin zla mtshan dus 'das pa'i/ /mngal ⑧ni khu ba len mi 'gyur/ /zla ba gcig tu bsags pa'i khrag /rtsa chen gnyis las dus su ni/ /cung zad gnag cing dri bral ba/ /rlung gis mngal gyi ⑨sgo ru 'byen/ /de nas zla mtshan mthong nyid nas/ /zhag gsum bar du sems dge bsam/ /rgyan dang khrus ni spang ba dang / /ku sha'i stan la nyal bar bya/ /nas thug 'o mar btsos ⑩nyung zad/ /blud cing lto sbyang nyams smad ⑪bya—/ /lo ma'am rdza ⑫skyogs legs ⑫par ni/ /bza' zhing 'khrig pa spang bar bya / /de nas zhag ni ⑫bzhi pa la/ /khrus byas gos phreng ⑫dkar zhing gtsang / /pha dang 'dra ba'i bu 'dod cing / /mdun du khyo ni blta bar bya/ /zla mtshan 111—296

zhag ni bcu gnyis dus/ /de las dang po'i zhag gsum dang / /bcu gcig pa smad tshes zung ①la/ /bur 'gyur gzhan du bu mor 'gyur/ /de nas bu phyir slob dpon gyis/ /cho ga cho ga bzhin byas la/ /dmangs ②rigs phyag 'tshal la brtson pas/ /sngags kyis skebya ba med par bya/ /de ltar 'dod spyod don ldan zhing / /yid la 'dod pa'i bu skyed ④'gyur/ /bu 'dod bza' bran dbe+en par ni/ /'dod spyad bya zhes ⑤dam pa smra/ /gzhan du rigs bzang las kyang nirjo/ /bu ngan rigs sreg ⑦me 'drar 'gyur/ /ji lta ba yi bu 'dod pa / /de yi tshul du de yis spyad/ /yul de'i skye bo'i ⑧spyod pa dang / /de yi yo byad la bsam bya/ /las mthar skyes pas zhun mar dang / /'o ma 'bras chan bcas pa bza'/ /skar mkhan lung gis mal khrir ni/ skyes pa dang po rkang ⑨g.yas kyis/ /'dzeg bya bud med g.yon gyis 'dzeg /de yi g.yas logs dag tu ⑩nyal/ /til mar mon sran gre'u sbyar ⑪bza'/ /der ⑩ni sngags kyi tshig brjod bya/ /a hi ra si/ a yu ⑫ra se/ sarba taḥpra tiṣ+ṭha si dha twa dha tu/ bi dha ba twa/ ba ⑫dha du/ braza brtsa sa bha ⑫ba zhes bya'o⑩/ /tshangs pa phur bu khyab 'jug dang / /nyi zla tha skar bu gnyis dang / /legs ldan mdza' bo chu lha rnams/ /bdag la dpa' ba'i bu sprul cig /de nas phan tshun spro bskyed de/ /dga' dang bcas pas gnas par bya/ /bud med der sems gan rkyal gnas/ /yan lag ⑩legs par gnas 'dug bya/ /de ltar nyes pa ⑫rang gnas 'dug /sa bon legs par 'dzin par 'gyur/ /'phral du mngal chags mtshan ma ni/ /mngal du sa bon ⑪'dzin pa dang / /'dod ngoms lci ⑩dang g.yo ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba rjes 'dres dang / /111—297

snying 'phar ba dang snyom ①pa dang / /skom dang rmya dang ba spu ldang / /zla ba dang po mig ②gsal zhag /bdun nas nur nur po ru 'gyur/ /'dir ⑧ni mngal gyi bu skyes rjopa/ /gsal bar ma gyur gong du bya/ /skyes bu byed pa 'di stobs ldan—/ /las kyang zil gyis gnon par nus/ /skar ma rgyal skyes bu yi gzugasarka/ /gser ram dngul lam lcags las byas/ /me mdog 'gyur ⑤bsregs 'o mar bcug /de ni snyim gang blud par bya/ /yang na go ra dan+da rjodang / /a pa marga ⑦dzi ba ka /zangs rtsi ba dang sher+ya kaske /gcig gam gnyis sam gsum zhig gam/ /thams cad chu la btab ⑨pa ni/ /skar ma rgyal la bab tshe blud/ /bri ha ti ⑩ni dkar po'i rtsa/ /'o mar btab pa rang nyid kyis—/ /bu 'dod sna khung g.yas par blugs⑪/ /bu mo 'dod na g.yon par blugs⑫ / /lag sma na'i ⑫rtsa 'o mar sbyar/ /bu skyed gnas pa rab ster byed/ /de bzhin n+ya gro'i myu gu brgyad/ /sbyar ba sna 'am kha nas btung / /'tsho byed kyi ④ni sman sde rnams/ /phyi dang nang nas nye bar sbyar/ /mngal 'dzin yid 'ong phan pa yi/ /khyo ⑫dang 'khor gyis ⑫bsnyen bkur bya/ /mar gsar ⑩zhun mar 'o ma rnams/ /rtag tu de la blud par bya/ /nyal po drags dang rtsol drags dang / /khur dang gos ni lci ba dang / /nyin nyal nub mo gnyid mi log /stan srab tsog pur ⑫'dug pa dang / /mya ngan khro dang 'jigs dang skyo/ /shugs dang sred pa dgag pa dang / /sgyung ⑪ba lam 'gro rno dang tsha/ /lci dang bshang 'gags zan za dang / /gos dmar gyon dang g.yang sa dang / /khron lta sha za chang 'thungs dang / /gan rkyal nyal dang bud med dang / /mi 'dod gang yin de kun spang / /de bzhin gtar ga gdab slon khrus/ /mas gtong 111—298

zla brgyad bar mi bya/ /'di dag gis ni mngal 'jig pa'am/ / dku skams ①pa 'am 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni skyed par byed pas mngal/ /sgur po 'on long mi thung 'gyur/ /mkhris pa can gyis spyi ther ④ser/ /bad kan sha bkra skya rbab 'gyur/ /nad gzhan 'jam zhing bde ba dang / /rnon po ma yin sman gyis gso/ /nur nur po las zla gnyis bar/ /gor gor mer mer nar nar po//de las ⑦pho mo ma ning rim/ /de nas gsal 'gyur mtshan ma ni/ /rid cing dku ④ni byu ba dang / /brgyal skyugs yi ga ⑤'chus pa dang / /glal dang mchil mang snyom bag dang / /sru yi phreng dub gsal ba dang / /skyur la dga' zhing nu ma rgyas/ /nu zhor bcas shing ⑦rtse mo gnag /rkang pa skrangs shing ⑧kha zas tsha/ /sred pa sna tshogs nyid du 'gyur/ /'di yi stisnying ni ma las skyes/ /ma yi snying yang de dang ni/ /'brel pas de phyir sbrum ma ni/ /sred pa dgag par mi bya'o//de la gnod par 'gyur ba 'ang ⑩/ /phan dang bsres te cung zad sbyin/ / sred pa ⑪bkag na mngal gyi bu/ /mi sdug pa 'am 'jig par 'gyur/ /zla ba gsum par de yi lus/ /mgo bo dpyi gnyis dpung pa gnyis/ /yan lag lnga ni gsal dod 'gyur/ /yan lag phra ⑫mo rnams kyang 'byung / /mgo bo sogs dang cha mnyam du/ /bde dang sdug bsngal shes pa 'byung / /mngal gnas lto ba ma yi ni/ /snying gi rtsa dang 'brel pa'i phyir/ /de yis de ni 'phel 'gyur te/ /zhing gi yur ba dag dang mtshungs/ /bzhi par yan lag gsal dod 'gyur/ /lnga par sems ni gsal bar 'gyur/ /drug par chu ba rtsa dang sru/ /sen mo pags pa mdog stobs 'gyur/ /bdun par ⑫dngos po thams cad kyis/ /yan lag kun ni rdzogs par 'gyur/ /mngal gnas nad kyis nyer ⑫gzir na/ /111—299

de tshe snying dang 'brel pa'i phyir/ /g.ya' dang tsha bar byed pa dang / /pags gas rma phran 'byung bar 'gyur/ /der ni mar sar rgya shug chu/ /mngar ba'i sman sde bskol ba phan/ /lan tshwa nyung zhing snum bag can/ /yang zhing mngar ba'i kha zas bza'/ /tsan+dan pu shel ci'i lde gus/ /brang dang nu ma lto la bsku//'bras bu gsum pa'am e ne+e ①ya/ /sha bkra ri bong khrag sbyar bsku/ /ka ra bī ①ra'i lo ma dang / /til mar bskol bas bskus te mnye/ /pa to la dang nim pa btsod / /bye'u 1rug gis kyang bsku bar bya/ /skyer pa shing mngar chu yis ni/ /bkru dang bsku ba bsten par bya/ /zla ba brgyad par ma dang bu/ /thang ④re rim gyis gzi mdangs 'pho/ /de yis de gnyis zhum dgar 'gyur/ /byis mdangs ma la mi gnas pas/ /de tshe btsas na mi 'tsho la/ /bud med the tshom bcas skabs 'gyur/ /'dir ni 'o ma can blud cing / /mngar ba'i sman dang bskol ba yi⑤/ /mar gyi 'jam rtsi gtang bya zhing / /phyis rnying ⑥pa dag bya ba'i ④phyir/ /la phug skam dang rgya shug skyur/ /bska ba dang ni dze+ebaskol ba bsngags—/ /sha ta put+pa'i lde gu ni/ /rgyam tsha til mar 'jam rtsi gtang / /de tshe zhag gcig 'das pa na'ang / /dus su btsas yin de phan chad/ /rlung gis dkur ni bkag gyur na/ /lo yi bar du gnod pa skyed/ /zla dgu lon na snum bcas pa'i/ /'bras chan sha khu blud pa bsngags/ /snum mang nas thug ⑨sbyin pa 'am/ /sngar bshad pa yi 'jam rtsi gtang / /de nyid la bcug ras bal ni/ /mtshan mar rtag tu ༷ gzhug par bya/ /rlung 'joms lo ma bskol ba'i chu/ /bsgrangs ⑪pas nyin re bkrus pa phan/ /zla dgu phan chad lus la ni//snum med par ni mi gzhag go/ /nu zho g.yas pa sngar byung ⑫zhing / /g.yas 111de300

logs la ①ni brten pa dang / /'dri tshig skyes pa'i ming ④can smra/ /dga' zhing rmi lam skyes pa mthong / /dku ①ni g.yas pa mtho rjob dang / /mngal yang kun nas rlum pa dag /bu skye gzhan du bu mor 'gyur/ /gang yang skyes pa phrad 'dod dang / /glu gar rol mo la dga' dang / /dri dang phreng chags bu mor ⑤skye/ /de 'dres rjopas ni ma ning 'gyur/ / dku yi ⑦dbus ni mtho ba yin / /mtshe ma logs gnyis mtho bas na⑧/ /lte ba dma' bar 'dug pa yin/ /dgu pa'i dang po nas brtsams te/ /sa phyogs shis shing yo byad ni/ /phun tshogs ldan par ⑨dge ba'i zhag /de ni btsas khyim zhugs par bya'o/ /der ni bud med btsa' ⑩myong bas/ /bskor te btsa' ba'i dus bar bsdad/ /deng ngam sang ni bu btsas ⑪rtags/ /snyom zhing dku dang mig lhod dub/ /smad du lci zhing yi ga 'chus/ /mchil ma mang ⑫zhing gcin mang 'byung ⑫/ /brla dang rked pa lto dang ⑫rgyab/ /snying dang chu so brla rtsa na/ /mtshan bye ⑫na zhing zug pa dang / /'gul zhing 'dzag par 'gyur ba yin/ /rang dbang med gyur rjes su ni/ /de 'og mngal gyi chu 'dzag 'gyur/ /de nas mngal nas las ⑫byung rtsom/ /bkra shis bsrung ba'i ⑩cho ga byas/ /lag par 'bras bu skyes ming gzhag /legs ⑫bskus chu ni dron mo blugasaspyo/ /mar dang bcas pa'i thug pa blud/ /de 'og sa la mal bcas 'dug /brla gnyis bkug ste gan durkyal gnas/ /yan lag yang nas yang du bsku/ /lte ba man chad mnye bya zhing / /glal dang 'chag pa byed du gzhug⑥ /de ltas mngal gnas thur du 'byung / /de rtags snying ga las ⑫'phos nas/ /mngal gnas lto bar zhugs nas ni/ /chu so'i steng na gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas dbang med nad ldang ste⑫//111—301

myur du khri la gzhag par bya/ /de 'og mngal gnas ①legs bcir nas/ /de yi mtshan ni dbye bar bya/ /dang por dal gyis btsir bya zhing / /btsa' khar drag tu btsir bar bya/ /de nas bu skye'i sgra dang ni/ /chu dang rlung gis dga' ba skyed/ / btsa' ba'i ②nad kyis gzir ba yi/ /srog bral 'dra ①ba slar gso bya④| /mngal du thogs na sbrul nag po'i/ /pags pas mo mtshan bdug par byaske/ / bya khu'i ⑤me tog rtsa ba 'am/ /lcam pa'am yang na bye sha l+yarjo/ /rkang pa'am lag par gdags par bya/ /sha ma dbyung ba'i phyir yang ni/ /de dag nyid bya de nas bteg⑦ /dpung pa gnyis nas bzung ste sprug /rting pas mjug to ⑧rdeg pa dang / /rkub tshos stidam du btsir bar bya/ /skra yis skog ma rkan reg bya/ /snu ha'i 'o ⑩ma spyi bor blugs/ /stag ⑪pa ku ba laṅka li/ /sbrul lpags ru rta yungs kar rnams/ /re re'am gnyis sam ma lus pas⑫/ /mo mtshan byug pa'am bdug ⑫par bya/ /ru rta'am bal bu'i lde gu ni/ /chang dwangs ⑫dang ni blug ⑫par bya/ /ku laṅga 'am bal ba dza⑩/ /chang rnyings ⑩dag la btab ste blud/ /shu ti nyungs ⑫kar zi ra dang / /shi kru tig sna kru trug ⑪tresaske/ /shing kun ru rta ⑫po son cha/ /'o ma ba gcin yungs mar dang / /bskol ba bshang ba'i sgo'am ni/ /mo mtshan nas ni 'jam rtsi btang / /shu ti shu dag ru rta dang / /yungs kar pi pi ling lde gu/ /snum dang lan tshwar bcas pa yi/ /mas gtong sha ma myur du 'byin/ /der thogs ⑥rgyu ni rlung yin te/ /de bcom sha ma myur du 'byung / /yang na lag bkrus sor mo bregs/ /mkhas pa yis ni drangs te dbyung / /sha ma byung na mo mtshan dang / /yan lag til mar gyis byugs mnye/ /mngal nad gzer ni chu so mgo /lto ba gzer la thal 111—302

sman ni/ /rnon po zhib tu btags pa dag /mar ram chu tshan ①sbyar ba blud/ /'u su bskol chu bu ram dang / /tsha gsum dri bzangs ②gsum btab blud/ /de nas byes pa'i nyer spyod kyis④/ /byis pa ma mas ④skyong du gzhug /bu btsas bkres yod til mar dang ⑤/ /mar las tshad chen blud bya ba/ /tsha ba lnga phye ran btab sbyin/ /de 'og bu ram chu dron nam/ /rlung 'joms sman bskol chu blud de/ /des ni rlung nad ldang mi 'gyur/ /khrag ngan dag kyang dag par byed//rim 'di zhag ni gnyis gsum bya/ /snum mi 'phrod la cho ga 'di/ /snum med par ni bsten par bya/ /'thungs nas lho ba til mar dang / /mar bskus nas ni gos kyis dkri/ /zhu nas khrus byas thug pa ni/ /sngar bshad sman dang bskol ba blud/ /zhag gsum phan chad bi da ri/ /la stsogs sman sde'i khu bar bskol—/ /nas rjothug phan zhing snum mang ba'am/ /goms pa'i dbang las 'o thug blud/ /zhag bdun phan chad de la ni/ / rim gyis brta ba'i ⑦cho ga phan//zhag ni bcu gnyis ma lon par/ /sha ni sbyin par mi bya'o/ /mngal du 'phel dang btsas pa'i nad/ /gsher dang khrag 'dzag btsir ba yis/ /nad de gso dka' yin pa'i phyir/ /btsas tshe 'bad de rim gro bya/ /de ltar zla ba phyed dang gnyis/ /kha zas bsdams ④stsogs dang bral nas/ /btsas pa'i ming dang bral ba 'am/ /zla mtshan byung bar gyur bar du'o/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ lus kyi gnas kyi le'u ⑨dang po'o// //de nas lus kyi rum du zhugs pa'i nad kyi bye brag bshad par bya'o/ /sbrum mas spang bar ⑩bya ba dag /bsten pa'am nad kyi dbang las ni/ /zla mtshan 111—303

byung ba'am gzer zhing na/ /phyi nang snum dang bsil thabs bya/ /u ①pad+ma tsan+dan dang / /'o ma can shing shun ②pa yi/ /lde gur ③mar ni bsku ba dang / /ras bal spangs pa bshang sgo dang / /mo mtshan gnyis su them bur gzhug /lan brgyar bkrus pa'i mar gyis ni/ /bsku ba'am bud med de yi lus/ /u ra ④stsogs chu nang gzhug /kha ra sbrang rtsi ku mu ta⑤/ /pad+ma ut+pal ge sar ni//'o ma'i mar sbyar ka she ru/ /sh-iṅga rjota ka sbyin par bya/ / garnya pri yang ku dang ⑦niske/ /chu skyes rnams kyi rtsa ba dang / /u dus+thā ⑧ra gzhon nu dang / /ldan pa'i 'o ma skom du blud/ / sā lu'i stirtsa ba ka ko la/ /pa ⑩la gnyis dang shing mngar dang / /bu ram shing dang bskol ba yi/ /'o ma sā ⑪lu rtsa snar chan⑫/ /sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas pa ni⑫/ /skam sa'i sha khu ldan par bza'④/ /bkru sman ma gtogs khrag mkhris kyi/ /gso dpyad spyobashad pa thams cad bya/ /zla gsum ma tshang bar du ni/ /khrag dgag ⑫phyir ni 'bad par bya/ /be'u snabs ldan pa'ang dgag par bya⑩/ /der ni bsil pan spyortsub pa dang / / smyung dang ⑪gla sgang u dur/ /sle tres 'u su a ra la/ /byi ⑫tsher dang ni papo ta/ /tsan+dan ba la bong ⑫nga dkar/ /bskol ba'i chu ni blud par bya/ /rtsa 'bru las g.yos ⑫zas sbyin dang / /muṅga ④sogs khus be+e'u snabs ni/ /bsal la snum stsogs sngon bzhin gtang / /mngal ni rnam par 'jig gyur ⑫na/ /mngal nang dag par ⑫bya phyir dang / /nad kyis gzir ba mi dran phyir/ /chang rno ci nus btung bar bya/ /de nas rtsa ba lnga po ni/ /chung ngu'i thug pa rtsub de ⑦blud//chang mi 'thungs ⑫la thug pa ni/ /tsha ba lnga dang bskol ba dang / /bil ba la sogs lnga dang bskol/ /til dang rtsa 'bru chan sbyin spyobya/ /zla ba dang mnyam 111—304

nyin zhag rim/ /mngal 'jig pa la thug stsogs sbyin/ /yang zhing snum dang lan tshwa med/ /drod bskyed ldan la phan pa yin/ /nad dang lus zungs ljan ljin ni/ /skam phyir cho ga 'di bya'o/ /de phan chad zas ①snum 'jam rtsi/ /stobs skyed ②drod skyed 'tsho byed sbyin/ /snying por ldan pas cher skyes la/ /mo mtshan nas ni khrag 'dzag pas/ /mngal du skye bar mi ①nus la/ /lto na 'gul dang bcas par gnas/ /de ni so na gnas shes bya/ /des ni lto ba rgyas mi 'gyur/ /mya ngan sgyung dang rtsub sogs samabu/ /yang na mngal nas ⑤khrag 'dzag pas/ /mngal du skye bar mi rjonus la/ /rlung 'khrug skam zhing ⑦bskams gyur pa'i/ /mngal de klu yi lto zhes bya/ /'dir ni lto ba rgyas gyur yang / /'grib cing yun rings ⑧lon na 'phar/ /de gnyis brta dang rlung 'joms sman/ /mngar ba dag dang bskol ba yi/ /mar dang 'o ma tshim sbyin zhing / /skyes ma thag pa'i sha sbyin bya/ /de gnyis kyis ⑨ni tshim bya'i phyir/ /khyogs dang bzhon ⑩par bskyon te bskul⑪/ /sngon po zhes bya mi 'gul ⑫la/ /khra dang ba lang nya sha dang / /sgra sgrogs bya dang rma bya yi⑫/ /sha khu mar ni mang po dang / /mon sran gre'u spyodag dang ni/ /la phug dag gi khu ba blud/ /bil ba gzhon nu ma sha ⑫til/ /phye dang 'o ma sbyar ba blud/ /tshil bcas sha dang sbrang chang sbyin/ /rked pa bsku ba bsten par bya/ /de ni rtag tu dga' ba skyed//de 'dras mngal ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rgyas pa gzhan du lo tshang nas/ /dka' bas btsas pa'am skye mi 'gyur/ /sbrum ma rtug pa 'gags gyur na/ /snum mam mthun pa'i 'jam rtsi yis/ /myur ba kho nar ⑩gso bar bya/ /gzhan du sbrum ma bu btsas 'chi/ /mngal du nad rab bsags pas sam/ /mi mthun 111—305

pa'am gnod gzhan gyis/ /nang du shi na lto grang ①zhing / /rengs dang sbo dang nad tshabs che/ /mngal mi 'gul ③dang mgo 'khor skom/ /dbugs 'byin dka' zhing dub pa dang / /dga' ba med cing mi 'gyur dze+edang / /dbang med nad ni mang po 'byung / /de la chu dron blugs pa dang / /bu ram spang ma lan tshwar bcas/ /btags pas mo mtshan bsku ba dang / /shal ma li dang zar ma yi/ /khu ba mar dang lde gur byas/ /nang du yang dang yang du gzhug /sngags dang sha ma 'byin sbyor bya/ /gal te bu shi ma byung na/ /de nas sman pas 0rgyal po la/ /zhu ⑤la de 'bad myur du dbyung / /shal ma li yi thang chu mar/ /bcas pas lag pa mo mtshan bsku/ /lag pas dbyung nus de nyid kyirjo/ /lus ni legs par mi gnas na/ /gcus ⑦shing bsgyur dang bzlog pa dang / /btsir dang 'degs gzhag ④la stsogs kyis/ /lugs dang mthun par drangs nas ni/ /mngal gyi sgor ni drang por drang / /gang zhig rkang lag mgo bo ni/ /yon por mngal du gnas gyur dang / /rkang pa gcig ni mtshan du 'byung ⑨/ /gnyis pa bshang sgor chud ⑩yon po/ /de ni 'gags pa zhes bya ste/ /mtshon ⑪gyis bcad par 'os pa yin/ /las der ⑩dkyil 'khor sor gdub ⑫can/ /gtsags ⑫bu gnyis ni bsngags pa yin/ /'phel gtsags ⑫rtse mo rno bas ni⑩/ /mngal du gtang bar mi bya'o/ /dang por mgo bo'i thod pa ni/ /phye la ⑩rnam par dbyung bar bya/ /de nas mchan khung brang kos ko/ /rkan gyi phyogs ni gang rung bar/ /gtad de mngal gyi lcags kyu ni/ /brtan po dag gis ⑫mkhas pas drang ⑪/ /mgo bo ma phye mig sbubs dang / /mkhur tshos nas kyang drang bya zhing / /phrag pa thogs na ⑩dpung par bcad/ /lto ba rlung gis sbos 111—306

gyur pa/ /nang grol dbral ①tam rgyu ma ni/ /phyi rol du ni bton te dbyung / /rked par thogs na de bzhin du/ /de yi rus tshigs dbye bar bya/ /rlung gi dbang gis ④yan lag gang / /mngal du thogs pa de dang de/ /dum bur gtubs la legs phyung ste/ /'bad de bud med bsrung bar bya/ /rlung ni rnam par 'khrugs gyur pas①/ /mngal gyi gnas skabs sna tshogs byed/ /de phyir de ni mkhas pa yis/ /gnas skabs dag ni bltas te spyad/ /ma dang lhan cig 'chi 'gyur bas/ /gson po mngal du gcad rjomi bya/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba ⑤dag la ni/ /yud tsam btang snyoms gzhag mi bya/ /mo mtshan 'gags dang nyams pa dang / /gzer nad dbugs kyis nyam ༷thag dang / /sgregs pa mnam dang lus grang ba'i⑦/ /mngal du bu shi bud med spang / /de nas sha ma ma thon na/ /sman pas sngon ⑧bzhin dbyung bar bya/ /de ltar zug rngu phyung nas ni / /chu dron gyis ni bkru bar bya/ /lus la snum gyis byugs ⑨pa dang / /mtshan du ras bal snum can gzhug /des ni mo mtshan 'jam 'gyur zhing / /de yis gzer ⑫ba zhi bar 'gyur/ /la la phud dang bong nga dkar/ /ra sna shing kun sug smel ⑪dang / /tsha ba lnga yi phye ma snum/ /sbyar ba'am lde gu chu bskol blud/ /de bzhin nad rnams 'dzag pa dang / /tshor ba zhi phyir zhag gsum ni/ /pu tse ⑫shel dang bong ⑫nga dkar/ /ba sha ka ⑫yi shun pa dang / /shing kun te dzo ba ti rnams/ /btags pa'i phye ma'am bskol ba blud/ /de nas zhag bdun bar du ni/ /snum nyid nye bar btung bar bya/ /dgongs ka chang ni rnying pa dang / /de bzhin legs sbyar chang btung bya/ /shir+sha ka ku bar bskol sbangs| /ras bal mo mtshan nang du gzhug / bla brnan ⑫gzhan dag gang 111—307

byung ba/ /de la rang gis 6gso bas 1gso/ /rlung 'joms sman ni 'o mar bskol//zhag bcu'i bar du bza' ba phan/ /zhag bcu'i bar du sha khu btung / /de phan chad ni yang zhing phan // /nyung ngu bza' zhing snum bsku dugs/ /ba ④la'i til mar la sogs bsten/ /zla ba bzhi lon phan chad de/ /de ni rim gyis ci bder spyad/ / ba le'i ñdzurtsa ba'i khu ba ni/ /cha ( )drug 'o ma de mnyam dang / /nas dang rgya shug laku laṅga/ /rtsa ba bcu pa'i cha gcig dang / /bskol ba'i cha ni char byas pa'i/ /til mar cha ni bcu bzhi dang / /med ⑧gnyis dang thang shing bcod1pe/ /ram nye ba gnyis tsan+dan dang / /thal tres ru rta dzi ⑩ba ka /rgya tukyespos rgyam tsha zangs rtsi ba/ /gla sgang rdo dreg ⑩shu dag dang / /pur+ṇa ⑫rna ba a ka ru/ /a shwa garnya nye ④shing dang / /k+ṣ-i ra ku shu shing mngar dang / /ba la ra sa shu ti dang / /paṇi ⑫gnyis dang sug smel dang / /shing tsha garnya bha dra ⑫rnams—/ /zhib tu btags pa'i sde gu dang / /til mar me chung la bskol ba/ /rlung nad thams cad sel ba'i mchog /bu btsas byis pa rus pa gnad/ /snad ⑫dang skem la bsngags pa yin/ /rims skran gdon dang byo byed dang / /gcin nad rgyu ma skyes pa sel/ /thang la 'bar gyis mngal gyi 6nyeni/ /nad rnams sel ba'i mchog tu bshad/ /ma ni shi tshe chu sor ni/ /mngal gnas ⑪gal te dkur ④'phar na/ /de ni smyoskye ba'i dus yin pas/ /dbral ( )te byes pa myur du dbyung / / shi ri ka yi ( sa bon dang / /pa ya ④su dang thang shing bzhiske/ /til nag sru sru'i rtsa ba dang / /btsod dang nye'u shing zhes bya bzhi/ / bri sha dang ni pa ya gya/tso/ /ut+pal thal tres pri yang ku/ /byi ketsher thal tres ra sna dang / /pad+ma tsa ri sko rishing mngar dang / /bri ha te gnyis tang pal 8 —111 308

dang / /'o shing myu gu shun pa dmar/ / kṛṣ+ṭa paṇi ba 1la dang / / shi kru 2gze ma sle tres dang / / shring ga sta rga rgun pad rtsa/ /shing mngar kha ra ka she ruske/ /tshigs bcad phyed kyis rdzogs bshad pa'i / /bdun pa 'di dag 'o mar sbyar/ /zla ba bdun la rim bzhin du/ /mngal 'dzag pa la gtang bar bya//ka bid ta 6/dang bil ba dang / / bri ha ti /7 dang bu ram dang / / kaṇ+ḍa ka 8 ri ba to la'i/ /rtsa ba bskol bar byas pa dang / /de bzhin 'o ma sha rnams ni/ /zla ba brgyad pa'i tshe na'ang she/btang / /dgu par )thal tres er ṇa dang /spe/ /pa ya su 7dang shing mngar gtang 7/ /zla ba bcu par pa ya su/7/ /'o ma dang ni bskol ba blud7/ /yang na shing mngar ladong gra dang / /thang shing 'o mar sbyar ba sbyin/ /bud med mngal yidu rlung gis khrag bsgongs te/ /gnas pa de ni mngal chags cha 'dra bas/ /bu chags yin zhes mi mkhas pa dag smra/ /sman kha rno dros khrag ni 'ba' zhig zags/ /blun pos 18mngal gnas 'byung pos zos zhes zer/ /mdangs 'phrog yin phyir de lus mngon sum du/ /'phrog par mi snang ba 'am 'byung po ni/ /gzhung 'dor ma ni btang snyoms 'jog mi byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ lus kyi gnas kyi 1nale'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas lus kyi yan lag gi bye brag bstan pa bshad par bya'o/ /mdor na yan lag rnam drug ste/ /mgo dang khog pa dpung pa gnyis/ /brla gnyis yin te de'i nying lag /mig snying lag pa rkang pa stsogs/ /sgra dang reg bya gzugs ro dri/ /go rims bzhin du nam mkha' rlung / /me chu sa yi yon tan /7/ ‘rterdo)()

yin / /yon tan re res phyi ma skyed/ /de la mkha' las ①lus bu ga /rna ba sgra dang khong stong nyid/ /rlung las ②reg pa lpags ①dbugs 'byin/ /me las mig dang gzugs 'ju nyid/ /chu las lce dang ro dang gsher/ /sa las sna dri rus pa yin/ /'dir ni ma las skyes 'jam khrag /sha dang rkang dang gzhang kha stsogs—/ /pha skyes brtan dang khu chu dang / /rtsa bo che rus skra stsogs ④yin/ /sems las sems byung dbang po rnams/ /skye ⑤gnas sna tshogs rnams kyang 'byung / /goms pa las byung nad med tshe/ /le lo med stobs gzi mdangs yin—/ /dwangs rjom las byung lus skyed ④dang / /gnas dang 'phel dang mi brkam nyid/ /snying stobs can gtsang yod par lta/ /chos dkar la dga' blo gros ldan/ /rdul can mang du smra ba dang / /nga rgyal tshul 'chos khro ⑧phrag dog /mun pa 'jigs dang mi shes dang / /gnyid dang le lo skyo ba'o/ /de ltar 'byung ba'i rang bzhin lus/ /de la khrag skyes lpags ⑨rim bdun/ /'o ma las ni spris ma bzhin/ /smin ⑩pa'i tshe na ⑩'byung bar 'gyur/ /lus zungs gnas ni nang gsher gyi/ /rang gi drod kyis smin pas ⑩na/ /bad kan rgyus pa sha mas g.yogs/ /char bshad shing gi snying po 'dra/ /bdun po de dag gnas bdun te⑫/ /dang por ⑫khrag yin gzhan rim bzhin/ /bad kan ma zhu mkhris zhu ba/ /rlung dang gcin gyi gnas su bshad/ /bud med mngal gnas brgyad pa ste/ /mkhris pa zhu ba'i gnas par gnas/ /'di la nang grol yan lag gnas/ /snying glo mchin mkhris mcher mkhal ma/ /pho ba grod ⑫pa rgyu ma dang / /gnye ma long ka be+eng pa'o/ /srog gi gnas ni rnam bcu ste/ /mgo dang lce yi rtsa ba dang / /lkog ma khrag dang snying lte ba/ /chu so khu chu dngas dang ⑩111—310

gzhang / /lus la rtsa dra chu ba che①/ /re re bcu drug yod par bshad/ /pir 'dra drug dang srubs ②'dra bdun/ /pho mtshan lce dang mgo la brten/ /de dag gtsags bus ④gdab mi rung / /sha yi thag pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rus pa'i tshogs 'dus bcu bzhi yod④/ /mtshams ni dgu phrag gnyis yod la⑤/ /so dang sen mor bcas pa yi/ /rus pa sum brgya drug cu yin/ /thang la 'bar ni rjosum brgyar 'dod/ /tshigs ni nyis brgya rtsa bcur 'dod/ /rgyun shes bus ⑦ni tshigs kyi grangs/ /nyis stong dag ni yod par 'dod/ /rgyus pa dgu brgya skyes pa la/ /sha ni spar tshad lnga brgya yod/ /bud med kyi ni nu ma dang / /mo mtshan la gnas nyi shu lhag /rtsa chen rtsa ba snying la gnas/ /de dag kun gyis lus kun khyab/ /dwangs ma'i bdag nyid mdangs ⑧su 'gyur/ /de ni phra ⑨ba kun dang 'byel/ /rtsa ba sbom zhing rtse rab phra/ /lo ma'i rtsa ltar gyes pa yin/ /gyes pa de las rtsa phran ni/ /bdun brgya ⑩dag tu gyur pa yin/ /de la yan lag re re zhing / / brgyad brgyad ⑪der ni gnas pa yin/ /de la dbug ⑫par mi bya ba/ /rtsa yi dra ba 'dzin zhes ⑫bya/ /nang na gnas pa ⑩gsum po yin/ /rked par bcu drug phrag gnyis te/ /de las brla rtsar gnyis ⑫gnyis dang / / rked pa'i gnad ⑩rnams gnyis gnyis te/ /de brgyad gtsags ⑩bus gdab mi bya—/ /rtsib logs gnyis la rtsa bcu drug /de las gyen 'go zhes bya spang / /rgyab tu rtsa ni nyi shu bzhi/ /sgal tshigs kyi ni ngos gnyis na/ /de las gnyis gnyis gyen 'gro ba/ /mtshon gyis gdab par mi bya'o/ /rgyab bzhin lto na steganas rtsa de⑪/ /pho mtshan steng na gnas pa dang / /spu yi phreng ba'i ⑫ngos gnyis rtsa/ /gnyis gnyis mtshon gyis mi gdab bo/ /brang la gnas pa bzhi 111—311

bcu las/ /bcu bzhi dbug par mi bya ste/ /nu mjing de yi rtsa ba dang / /snying ga dag ni so sor gnyis/ /gnod bral gnad ni gnyis po dang / /mi gsal zhes bya gnyis kyi gnyis/ /mgrin pa ltag pa 'dra ba las/ /sngon po mjing pa ltag pa dang / /'gal ba dang ni ma mo brgyad/ /bcu drug yongs su spang bar bya/ /'gram pa bcu drug de las gnyis①/ /mtshams ni 'brel par byed pa spang / /lce yang 'gram pa dang 'dra stesde/ /'og gi ro tshor byed gnyis dang / /tshig 'byen byed pa gnyis po spang / /sna yi rtsa ni nyi shu bzhi/ /de las ④dri tshor byed gnyis dang / /rkan du 'go ba'i rtsa gnyis spang rjo/ /mig gnyis kyi ni lnga bcu drug /'byed dang 'dzums ⑤pa'i las byed pa/ /gnyis gnyis dang ni mig 'gram gnyis/ /drug po de dag spang bar bya/ /mig dang snar gnas 'phral rjob la/ /brten pa'i rtsa ni drug cu las/ /bzhag pa gcig dang gtsug gi gnyis/ /skra mtshams gnas pa'i rtsa bzhi ste/ /bdun po de dag mtshon gdab spang / /rna bar bcu drug de las 'dir/ /sgra thos byed pa'i rtsa gnyis spang / /de nyid las ni mur 'gram gyi/ /mtshams su 'go ba gnyis po spang / /spyi bor bcu gnyis de las ni/ /gyen 'gro skra mtshams bdag po las/ /so so'i ⑦re re spang bar bya/ /de ltar yan lag re re'i rtsa'i④/ /dbye ba dbug min shes phyir bshad/ /de las ⑨lus la dbug mi rung / /ma lus dgu bcu rtsa brgyad yod/ /dog dang rtsa mdud shin tu phra/ /yo dang tshigs la gnas mi dbug /rtsa ni bdun brgya de rnams las/ /bzhi char khrag ni so sor rgyuske/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan khrag /nad med khrag ni de ltar gnas⑩/ /de ni lus la phan 'dogs te/ /gzhan du gnod pa skyed par 'gyur/ /de la 111—312

gnag dang dmar dang phra/ /skad cig re re gang zhing stongs/ /mgul pa rlung gi ①khrag rtsa yin/ /reg na tsha zhing myur du rgyu/ /mdog sngo ser por 'dug pa ni—/ /mkhris pa'i ⑤khrag rtsa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /dkar snum brtan grang bad kan rtsa/ /'dres pa'i mtshan nyid 'dren ma yin/ /mi mngon mnyam gnas snum pa dang / /mdog dmar khrag rtsa nad med yin/ /rtsa bo che ni nyi shu bzhi/ /lte ba la ni brten pa yin/ /de rnams kyis bskor lte ba ni①/ /'khor lo'i lte ba rtsibs bskor mtshungs/ /des ni steng 'og thad ka rjoru/ /lus 'di rjes su 'dzin pa yin/ /bu ga sna dang rna ba gnyis/ /mig gnyis kha rkub ⑤pho mtshan gyi'o / /bud med nu ma gnyis khrag sgo/ /gsum gyis lhag par gyur pa yin/ /nang gi srog gi gnas gyur pa'i/ /bu ga bcu gsum yod par bshad/ /srog dang lus zungs dri ma chu/ /zas rgyu rjomi mthun bsten pa yin⑦/ /de la ⑧gnod pas nad skyed la/ /skyon med dag pas bde bar byed/ /rang gi lus zungs mdog mnyam zhing ⑨/ /rlum dang sbom dang phra ba yin/ /bu ga'i dbyebs ni ring po ste/ /lo ma'i rtsa 'phros lta bu yin/ /zas dang spyod lam dag gis gang / /nad kyi mthu dang mnyam gyur dang / /gang yang lus zungs mi ()mnyam ste/ /bu ga'i rgyun la gnod byed yin/ /mang du 'byung ngam thospe'agags pa 'am/ /rtsa ni mdud pa chags pa 'am/ /lam gzhan dag tu 'gro ba ni//bu ga'i rgyu ⑫'khrugs mtshan nyid yin/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba phra mo las/ /ring du rgyu bar ⑫byed pa ltar/ / gang gis ④dwangs ma nyer 'phel ba'i/ /lus kyi sgo ni bu ga yin/ /bu ga rnams ni brtol ⑫'gyur na/ /'dar myos lto sbos lkugs ⑩dang rims/ /sla ⑩dang gzer dang bshang gci 'gags/ /yang na 'chi ba 111—313

byedanyid du 'gyur/ /de bas sman pas bu ga brtol/ /re thag bcad de te gso bar bya / /'phral du rma byung cho ga yis/ /'bad de zug rngu dbyung bar bya/ /zas 'ju byed pa mkhris pa ni/ /'ju byed yin zhes sngar bshad do/ /nad dang lus zungs dri ma yi/ /drod yin zhes ni rgyun shes zer/ /de ni zas kyi gnas yin zhing / /'dzin cing (ga'adzin byed ces bshad do/ /de nyid thang la 'bar gzhung gis/ /mkhris pa rdorngo 'dzin pa'i cha ru bshad/ /tshe dang nad med brtson gzi mdangs/ /lus zungs me drod stobs 'phel byed/ /zhu ba'i gnas kyi sgor 'jug gang ④/ /zas kyi lam gyi sgo gtan yin/ /de ni stobs ldan zos pa rnams/ /zhu nas thur du 'dren par byed/ /stobs zhan gyur na ⑤ kha zas ni/ /ma smin nyid du 'byung bar byed/ /'dzin byed stobs ni me drod de—/ /de yang 'dzin byed stobs can yin/ /de bas me drod nyams gyur na/ /'dzin byed nad ni skyed par byed/ /zas gang lus kyi lus zungs mdangs/ /stobs dang kha dog stsogs rgyas byed/ /de rgyu kha zas me drod ni/ /mi 'ju dwangs ma stsogs mi 'gyur/ /zas ni dus su zos gyur pa6)/ /lto bar srog gi ⑦rlung gis drangs/ /skom shegyis gong por 9 rnam par phye/ /snum gyis mnyen par byas pa yin/ /mi mnyam gnas kyis bus nas ni/ /ma zhu'i gnas na gnas smin byed/ /phyi yi snod gnas 'bras chu ltar/ /lto ba'i me yiyis 'ju bar byed/ /dang por 1ṭ+wāṃro drug zas kyang ni/ /mngar ba nyid du gyur nas ni/ /sbu ba can gyur 7bad kan 'gyur/ /zhu ba'i gnas nas 'pho 3 ༄ba na/ /rnam par tsha 7 bas skyur nyid 'gyuraska/ /mkhris gyur la'aphos pa'i rjes la ni/ /me drod kyis skams zhu ba dang / /kha zhing gong bur gyur rlung skyed/ /sa dang chu dang me dang 1 11 314

rlung / /nam mkha' bcas yo)pa'i drod lnga posage/ /rang rang yon tan zas lnga po ge—/ /sa stsogs kyis smin de 'og tu/ /de dag rang rang ji bzhin rgyas/ /smin 'byung yon tan tha dad yin/ /sa ru gtogs pas sa nyid dang / /lhag mas lus gtogs lhag ma rgyas/ /zas de zhu ba'i tshigs ma dang / /dwangs ma zhes bya gnyis su 'gyur/ /de las gezas kyi tshigs ma sla(5/ /gcin 'gyur ska ( ba bshang bar 'gyur/ / dwangs mas lus zungs rang rang gi/ /me drod kyis smin rnam bdun 'gyur/ /spyodwangs ma las khrag de las sha /sha las tshil te de las rus/ /rus rkang de las khu ba yin/ /khu ba las ni mngal gnas 'gyur—/ /lus zungs tshigs ma rim bzhin du/ /bad mkhris bu ga'i dri ma dang / /rngul dang sen mo ba spu ④dang / / mi lpags ⑨bshang snum dwangs ma yin⑩—/ /de ltar lus zungs smin pa las/ /dwangs ma tshigs ma gnyis su 'gyur—/ /lus zungs snum ni gcig la gcig /phan tshun nye bar bsten ⑪pa yin—/ /zas 'ju dwangs ma stsogs rim gyis/ /khu chur gyur pa la ⑫la ni/ /nyin zhag gcig ⑫'dod gzhan dag ni/ /zhag drug kha cig zla gcig 'dod/ /lus kyi zungs ni spyozas kyi rgyun/ /'khor lo lta bur yongs su 'khor/ /ro tsa stsogs pa'i (shemathu yis ni/ /'phral du khu ba la stsogs skyed/ /phal cher sman gzhan nyin zhag ni/ /gcig gis las rnams byed pa yin/ /khyab byed kyis dngas ⑩lus zungs rnams/ /'thor bar byed pa'i las kyis ni/ /cig car rgyun mi 'chad kun tu/ /lus la rtag tu rnam par 'thor/ /gtor tshe bu ga'i skyon gyis ni/ /dwangs ma gang du chags 'gyur 7te/ /der ni gnod pa skyed byed de//ste/ /mkha' la sprin chags char 'bab mtshungs/ /nad kyang ma 111 315

snyoms gyur pa las/ /phyogs gcig 'dus na ldang bar 'gyur/ /de ltar 'byung ba lus zungs me'i/ /las ni yongs su bshad pa yin/ / zas ni dus su zos gyur pa/ /①sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /dwangs ma lus zungs rang rang gis④/ /smin byed kun la zas 'ju ba'i/ /me gni lhag pa yin par 'dodaske/ /de ni rtsa ba de 'phel 'phel/ /zad gyur zad pa'i bdag nyid 'gyuraske/ /de bas rigs pas cho ga bzhin/ /zas skom rigs shing phan pa yinabu—/ /de 'bad pas bsrungs rjoganas gyur na/ /tshe dang stobs ni gnas par 'gyur/ /mnyam gnas rang gnas 'dug na mnyamarjo/ /mnyam lam ⑦gzhan 'gro drod mi snyoms/ /mkhris pa shas che rno bar 'gyur/ /bad kan gyis gnod me drod chung / /me drod mnyam dang mi mnyam rno/ /chung dang de ltar rnam bzhi yin/ /gang zhig zas ni legs zos pa/ /legs par 'ju 'di ⑧mnyam pa yin/ /legs par ma zos myur 'ju ba'am⑨/ /legs zos ring zhing ⑩'ju mi mnyam/ /zas ni legs par ma zos kyang / /myur 'ju me drod rnon ⑩po yin/ /zas ni legs par zos gyur kyang / /ring nas 'ju zhing kha skam ⑫dang / /sbo dang rgyu ma 'khrugs ⑫pa dang / /lci ba me drod chung ba yin/ /me drod nyams na 'chi 'gyur zhing ⑫/ /skyon med na ni yun ring 'tsho/ /ma snyoms nad ni skye 'gyur bas/ /de phyir me drod gtso bo yin/ /lus stobs lhan cig skyes pa dang / /dus skyes rigs pa las byung ⑫gsum/ /de la lus sems las byung ba/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i stobs/ /na tshod dus tshigs las byung ba/ /dus skyes yin te rigs ⑩pa las/ /byung ba spyod lam zas kyis bskyed/ /de bzhin gzi bskyed ⑩sbyor las byung spyo/ /yul phyogs shing 111—316

—— — — — —— ———byed— —————byed —— — ——— —ring 1 chu nyung la 2/ /skam sa nad nyung skyed byed yin/ /rlan can de las bzlog pa yin/ /cha snyoms rtethun mong yin par bshad/ /rkang dang tshil dang zhag dang gcin/ /mkhris pa bad kan phyi sa khrag /dwangs ma chu rnams lus gnas pa'i / /snyim pa re res skyed par byed/ /mdangs 5dang klad rgyas khu chu ni/ /re re'ang rang gi khyor gang yin/ /bud med nu zho snyim do dang / /zla mtshan snyim pa bzhi yod do/ /lus zungs mnyam gnas tshad 'di yin/ /de las 'phel dang zad shes bya/ /khu chu khrag dang sbrum ma'i zas/ /spyod lam mngal gnas dus tshigs las/ /gang zhig nyes pa lhag gyur des/ /rang bzhin rnam pa bdun du bshad/ /khyab dang myur bar byed phyir dang / /stobs ldan pa dang gzhan ldang byed/ /rang dbang can dang nad mang phyir/ /nad las /3/phal cher rlung stobs can/ /de nyid kyis na 8 rlung gis bskyod pa'i mi rnams ni/ /nad kyi bdag nyid rdul can skra bshor (pags pa gas/ /grang lhags mi bzod brtan dran 1blo gros spyod mdza' sred/ /blta dang 'go ba g.yo zhing smra ba shin tu mang / /bad kan nor nyung tshe thung gnyid srab dang / /gcom chung tshig 1(/thogs g.yo zhing skad 'dzer dang / /chad lta mang du za zhing sgeg 7dang bcas/ /glu dang dgod 1gedang rngon las 'thab la dga'/ /mngar skyur kha dang tsha ba'i ro goms sred/ /lus skem / /dbyibs ring 'go tshe sgra dang bcas—/ /mi brtan dbang po mi thul dam pa min/ /bud med mi chags bu mang skye sami 'gyur/ /de yi mig ni rtsub cing rdul gyis gang / /zlum zhing mi mdzes 'chi ba lta bu dang / /phye gdangs gnyid log lta bur snang ba yin/ /de ni shing dang ri 'dzeg mkha' —'phur rmi/ /skal ngan ser sna che zhing khengs pa 777 3/7

dang / /rku zhing byin snying rtsa rings ①bcas pa dang / /khyi dang wa dang rnga mo bya rgod khra/ /byi ba'i mtshan nyid ldan mi ②rlung can yin/ /mkhris pa me 'dra me las byung yin ④phyir/ /mkhris pa rgyas pa skom dang bkres shas che/ /mdog ser lus tsha rkang lag gdong yang dmar/ /skra ser spu nyung dpa' zhing nga rgyal che//phreng ba byug pa rgyan la lhag par dga'/ /spyod bzang gtsang sbra che zhing mnyes gshin larjo/ /'byor dang ⑤rtul phod blo gros stobs dang ldan/ / 'jig rten dgra bo'ang ⑥skyabs 'ongs skyob par byed/ /yid gzhungs tshigs kyi mtshams dang ④sha ni rab tu lhod/ /bud med mi dga' khu ba dang di 'dod pa chung / /gnyer ma'i tshogs dang skra dkar mig sngo'i gnas ⑤gyur la/ /zas ni mngar dang bska dang kha ⑨bsil za bar dga'/ /than pa mi bzod rngul zhing dri nga la/ /bshang gci bza' btung ⑩khro dang phrag dog mang / /rmi lam dong ka ⑪pa la sha'i me tog /glog 'gyu phyogs tshig skar mda' nyi me ⑫mthong / /'di yi lus phra mig ser g.yo ba dang / /rdzi ma srab cing nyung zhing ⑫grang la dga'/ /khro dang chang dang nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /mig ni myur bar dmar por ⑫'gyur ba yin//tshe ni ran cing stobs ni 'bring ba dang / /mkhas shing sdug bsngal dag la ⑫sran chung 'gyur/ /stag dang dred dang spre'u byi la dang / /gnod sbyin rang bzhin ldan pa mkhris can yin/ /bad kan bsil bas bad kan can bsil zhing ⑩/ /rus tshigs mi mngon snum zhing sha rus 'brel/ /bkres skom nyon mongs sdug bsngal than pa bzod/ /blo ldan snying stobs che zhing dam bca' ⑩brtan/ /pri yang ku dang drur ba tho)'dam bu'i mdog /tshon dang gi'u ⑪wang pad+ma gser mdog can/ /lag ngar ring zhing drang ⑫ni yangs la rgyas/ /'phral ⑪ba'i 111—318

dbyes che skra ni mthug ①cing gnag /lus 'jam stoms shing yan lag mdzes pa dang / /mdangs che khu bcud bu tsha g.yog 'khor mang / /chos ldan tshig rtsub nam yang smra mi byed/ /dgra la zhe sdang 'dam rings ⑤khon 'dzin byed/ /glang po'i mchog dregs bcas pa ⑦lta bur 'akro/ /rgya mtsho 'brug dang rdza rnga seng ge yi/ /sgra ldan dran dang brtson 'grus dul bar ldan/ /byis pa'i tshe na'ang ngu dang skom dushas chung / /zas ni kha bska tsha dang dro zhing rtsub/ /nyung ngu zos kyang de ni stobs dang ldan/ /mig gi mtha' dmar snum zhing dkyus ring yangs /dkar nag ⑤rab gsal rdzi ma snyoms dang ldan/ /smra dang khro dhidang bza' btung spyod nga/ nyung / /tshe ring nor mang ring lta ⑦tshig 'jam smra/ /dad cing blo zab lta che bzod dang ldan/ /rang bzhin bzang zhing gnyid che las mtha' ring /byas gzo ⑧drang mkhas skal bzang ngo tshar ⑨ldan/ /bla ma la gus mdza' bshes dag la brten/ /rmi lam pad+ma bya yi phreng ⑩bar bcas/ /chu yi gnas dang sprin yang mthong ba yin⑩/ /tshangs pa drag po dbang po chu lha dang / /nam mkha' lding dang ngang pa glang po mchog /de bzhin seng ge dang ni khyu mchog dang //bad kan can ni rang bzhin 'drar shes bya/ /rang bzhin gnyis dang kun las byung / /gnyis gnyis kun gyi yon tan bskyed/ /gtsang sbra yod par smra stsogs ⑫kyi—/ /yon tan gyis ni de ldan bshad/ /na tshod bcu drug par byis pa/ /de las lus zungs dbang po gzi/ /'phel 'gyur bdun cu'i bar bar ma/ /zad pa phan chad rgan po yin/ /rang rang khru ni phyed dang bzhi/ /lus ni tshe ring bde ba'i snod/ /spu med gnag dang shin tu sgom/ /ring po nyid ni mi mthun bcas/ /smad pa brgyad dang rang nyid ldan/ /gang yin de ni de snod 111—319

min 1 / /skra ni rab tu snye'ajam pa dang / /phra zhing rtsa ba ma 'dres brtan/ /dpral ba mtho zhing mur 'gram 'phyar/ /zla ba kham pa 'ang ba bzang / /rna ba rgyab phyogs rgya che mdzes/ /rna shal che zhing sha yis rgyas/ /mig ni dkar nag 'byes pa dang / /rdzi ma stug cing snyoms pa bzang / /sna yi rtse mo dbugs cher 'byung / /sha rgyas drang zhing snyoms pa bzang / /mchu ni dmar zhing ma 'phyangs ba/ /'gram pa yangs shing mi 'bur bzang / /kha che so yi tshags dudam la/ /snum zhing dkar la 'jam zhing snyoms/ /lce ni dmar zhing yangs la srab / /kosko (snyeche zhing sha yis rgyas/ /mgrin pa thung rjozhing sha rgyas rlum/ / phrag pa mthong 7zhing sha yis rgyas/ /lto ba zlum zhing lte ba ni/ /zab cing mtho la 8g.yas su 'khyil/ /rkang pa lag pa legs gnas shing / /sen mo 'jam zhing mtho la kye1dmar/ /snum zhing kun dmar sha rgyas pa/ /sor mo ring zlum bu ga med/ /rgyab zheng che zheng sgal tshigs nub/ / tshigs mtshams ⑩mi mngon dam pa dang / / tshigs gsang mtho ⑪zhing brtan pa dang / /mdog snum kha dog brtan par gnas/ /rang bzhin gyis 'byung snying stobs brtan/ /phongs pa'i tshe na'ang 7zhum pa med/ /mngal nas brtsams te skend med pa/ /gong nas gong du zhing bzang layi/ /shes dang ye shes rgya cher ni/ /'phel zhing rim gyis dge bar 'gyur/ /de ltar yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /lus ni ston brgya'i bar dag tuge/ /tshe dang dbang phyug 'dod pa yi/ /dngos po thams cad rab tu gnas/ /pags pa khrag stsogs snying stobs bar/ /brgyad po 7phyi ma bzhin du mchog /stobs dang tshad dang shes pa'i phyir/ /lus can rnams kyi snying por bshad/ /snying po kun dang ldan pa yi7/ /mchog tu bkur bar bya bar 171 320

'gyur / /rtsom pa kun la'ang re bcas dang / /bzod ldan blo bzang brtan par 'gyur/ /dregs dang zhum pa med par ni/ /bde dang sdug bsngal bsten gyur pa/ /snying stobs can yin rdul can khengs/ /mun pa can ni de ltar ①min—/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims snying brtse bden/ /tshangs par spyod dang byas pa gzo④/ /byams ldan bcud kyis len bsten④pa/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i sde'o/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/rjo lus kyi gnas kyi ⑤le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas lus kyi gnad kyi bye brag rjobashad par bya'o/ /gnad ni brgya las bdun lhag pa/ /de las bcu gcig brla dang ni/ /de bzhin lag ngar gnyis so sor/ /lto ba la gsum brang la dgu/ /rgyab la bcu bzhi nam tshong ni/yan chad sum cu rtsa bdun yod/ /rkang pa'i mthil nas ⑦gung mo yi/ /thad ka ⑧na ni mthil 'phrog pa'i⑨/ /gnad yod ces ni rnam bshad de/ /de phug gnad ⑩kyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mtheb sor dbus na rgya tshigs te/ /de phug bskyod pa'i gnad ⑪kyis 'chi/ /de gong sor gnyis shes par ⑫bya/ /rkang pa 'khor zhing 'dar bar byed/ /long mo'i tshigs 'og pir mgo ste/ /de bcad skrang dang nad skyed byed/ /byin pa ⑫rkang pa gnyis kyi bar/ /long mo gnad rengs bem ⑩por byed/ /byin pa'i nang na pho zhes pa⑫/ /khrag zad pa yis 'chi bar byed/ /byin pa brla mtshams pus mo ste/ /de phug gson yang 'theng por 'gyur/ /pus gong sor gsum par gnyan gong / /de phug brla rengs skrang bar byed/ / brla nang brla ⑫dbang zhes bya ba/ /de phug khrag zags 111—321

byedabyed—— —byed— ——— —— —brla bskam 1 'gyur/ /brla rtsa mig dmar zhes bya ba/ /khrag zad pas ni gzhogs phyed 'joms/ /brla rtsa 5karmig pa'i bar gyi gnad/ /ljon shing zhes bya ma ning byed/ /de dag brla'i 'o / — dpung de bzhin/ /mkhrig ma 'di 0ni long mor mtshungs/ /gru mo byin 'dra de gnyis phug /zha bo ljon shing 'dra ba ni//mchan khung nang na mchan pekhung 'dzin/ /de phug zha bo nyid du 'gyur/ /long ka'i gnad ni gzhang zhes bya/ /de phug gzhang rlung gis 'phral zhe )gsod/ /be+eng pa gzhu ltar yo ba yi/ /chu so'i gnad ni sha khrag nyung / /dbus na kha cig thur du lta0/ /rked pa'i dbus gnas srog 'phral 'joms/ /rde'u 'byin rma bug gnas ma gtogs/ /de 8)yang ngos gnyis phug ste 6)'dra/ /gcin 'dzag gnas dang gcig tu ⑪phug /rma ni 'tsho bar ⑩shin tu dka'/ /lus kyi zhu dang ma zhu'i gnas/ /dbus na lte ba rtsa kun gyi/ /rten yin de yang 'phral gsod byed/ /ma zhu ba yi gnas sgor gyur/ /'dod chags stsogs gnas snying zhes bya/ /brang dang nu ma lto dbus gnas/ /nu mjing nu ma'i rtsa zhes bya/ /steng 'og sor gnyis nu ma'i gnad/ /de phug bad kan khrag gis ni/ /rim bzhin lto 'gengs 7'jig par byed/ /rengs 7bral brang gi ngos gnyis —na/ /rtsa srubs gnyis po skerlung rgyu ba/ /de phug khong pa khrag gis gang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde bas 'chi/ /rgyab kyi sgal tshigs brang gi bar/ /de gnyis kyi ni ngos gnyis na/ /phrag pa gnyis kyi 'og sken ni/ /mi gsal zhes bya'i gnad gnyis yod/ /de gnyis phug pas khong pa ni/ /khrag khengs rnag skraste 'chi bar 'gyur18 / /sgal tshigs kyi ni ngos gnyis na/ /rked pa'i khyastecha gnyis gnas pa 8 dang / /rkub tshos ḍa /ltag gnas sgal tshigs brten de/ /rked pa can dang gzhon 117 322

nur bshad/ /de snad khrag zad skya rbab dang / /gzugs nyams pas ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rgyab kyi sgal tshigs ngos gnyis kyi/ /rked pa'i mtshams ni gang yin pa/ /ro smad kyi ni rgyab phyogs na/ /khung bu zhes bya'i gnad gnyis yod/ /de snad bskyod pa nyams pa dang / /ro smad tshor ba med par 'gyur/ /gang zhig rtsib logs gnyis dang 'byel/ /sta zur rtse mo gnyis steng gi/ /gnas ni g.yogs par gyur pa dang / /ro smad ①gzhon nu'i rus par gnas/ /de snad ro smad skrangs pa dang ⑤/ /nyam chung 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur/ /rtsib logs gnyis kyi nang dang 'brel/ /rkod pa'i ngos gnyis dbus na gnas/ /thad ka dang gni gyen gnas pa/ /rtsib logs mtshams te rjode phug na/ /khong pa khrag gis gang ba dang / /lus dang bral ba nyid du 'gyur/ /nu ma gnyis kyi thad ka'i ⑤cha/ /rgyab kyi sgal tshigs la brten pa/ /rtsa chen zhes bya rjode phug na/ /khrag zad nas ni 'chi bar 'gyur⑦/ /dpung mgo gnyis dang 'brel pa yi⑧ /sgal tshigs kyi ni ngos gnyis na/ /phrag pa gnyis kyi sog ⑨pa ste/ /de snad bskams ⑩shing tshor bral 'gyur/ /mgrin pa gnyis kyi ngos gnyis rtsa⑪/ /dpung mgo dang ni mgrin pa'i bar/ /phrag pa ⑫phrag pa la brten ⑫gnad/ /de phug lag ngar ⑫bya ba nyams/ /srol gong gi ni ngos gnyis na/ /'gram pa la ni brten pa'i rtsa/ /bzhi ste de la sngon po gnyis/ /gnyis pa'ang ⑫mjing pa'i gnad du bshad/ /de phug skad 'gags mi sdug dang ⑫/ /lce yis ro ni mi tshor 'gyur⑩/ /lkog ma'i sbubs kyi ngos gnyis nas/ /ste ⑫dang snar ni 'gro ba'i rtsa/ /so sor bzhi bzhi yod ma mo/ /de bcad 'phral du srog 'joms so/ /mgo bo ske ⑪mtshams ltag pa ste/ /de phug mgo bo ldem por 111—323

'gyur—/ /rna ba gnyis 'og spyong ba 1na/ /rna rtsa zhes bya 'on par 'gyur/ /sna yi bu ga gnyis dang ni/ / sna yi k+ṣelam 'gro mgrin nang gnas/ /sbrul mgo zhes bya de bcad na/ /dri mi tshor bar byed par 'gyur/ /mig gnyis kyi ni phyi rol mtshams/ /smin ma skyes pa'i mtha' yi sne'og /mig zur smin steng dma' bar gnas/ /'khyil pa phug pas long bar 'gyur/ /rna mchan 'phral ba'i mtha' ④na ni/ /mur 'gram zhes bya dbral pe'achi byed/ /mur 'gram gnyis steng ( skra mtshams na/ /gdeg lapa zhes bya bzhag bya yang / /smin mtshams bar gnas gsum char la'ang / /zug rngu dag ni ma phyung zhing / /smin (kyenas rang nyid byung na le'atsho/ /phyung na 'phral du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /lce mig sna dang rna ba yi/ /bu ga kwa bzhi ni 'dus pa dag /rkan dang sgo ru kha bzhi ⑩/ ste/ /bu ga'i gnad ni de rnams kyi/ /gnad ni sum mdo ris zhes bya/ /de bcad srog ni 'phral du 'dor/ /thod pa yi ni mtshams lnga po⑫/ /thad ka gyen 'gro mtshams kyi mtha'/ /de snad pas ni mgo 'khor dang / /smyo tunyezhing dran pa nyams te spyo'achi/ /spyi bo'i steng na gtsug 'khyil pa'i/ /rtsa dang ldan sbubs lholta 'dus pa na/ /spu 'khyil bdag po zhes bya ba'i/ /gnad kyis srog ni 'jig par byed/ /gang du mnan na shin tu 'gul/ /rab na de gnad yin zhes bya/ /sha rgyus rus pa rtsa chen dang / /rtsa dang tshigs ni 'dus pa ru/ /gnad ces bya ste des na der/ /srog ni lhag par gnas pa yin/ /mang du rnam par bstan mod kyi/ /gnad ni rnam pa drug tu bstanam/ /srog gi gnas su thun mong bas/ /gnad ni gcig tu'ang gnas pa yin/ /shar 7gtogs bcu ste byin lag nywa/3 / /mthil 'phrog nu mjing nu rtsa'o1 / /rus pa'i gnad brgyad mur 'gram dang / /77/ 324

rked ①pa can dang gzhon nu dang / /ro smad dang ni sog ②pa'o/ /rgyus pa'i gnad ni nyi shu gsum/ /gnyan gong zhes bya pir dang ni/ /pir mgo mig zur rgya tshigs dang / /phrag pa gzhag dang chu so yi①/ /rtsa chen gnad ni rnam dgu ste/ /gzhang dang rengs bral rna rtsa dang / /sum mdo rjoris zhes bshad pa'o—/ /rtsa la gnas gnad sum cu bdun/ /rtsa chen gnyis dang ma mo sngo/ /'gram pa mchan khung 'dzin sbrul mgo/ /ljon shing snying dang lte ba dang / /rtsib logs mtshams dang nu ma'i 'og /mi ⑤gsal gzhag dang brla dbang dang / /dmar po zhes bya bzhi po'o/ /tshigs la nyi shu 'khyel pa dang / /mkhrig rjom gnyis dang khung bu dang / /mtshams mtha' gru mo long mo dang / /ltag pa pus mo bdag po'o/ /gzhan dag gzhang sha'i gnad ces zer/ /mchan khung 'dzin ⑦dang ljon shing ni/ /rgyus pa la brten ⑧rna rtsa dang / /sum mdo ⑨ris dang rengs bral dang / /mig 'gram rtsa yi ⑩gnad yin gyi⑪/ /rtsa chen gnas par de ma bshad/ /sha yi gnad bcad khrag rgyun 'dzag /sha bkrus 'drar 'gyur ⑫sla ba dang / /skya zhing dbang po nyams pa dang / /myur du 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur/ /rus ⑫gnas gnad bcad rkang bcas na/ /sla dang bar bar chad cing 'dzag /rgyus pa'i gnad bcad na zhing 'khrug /brkyang bskum mi shes gnod par 'gyur/ /'gro dang stan ⑩gnas nus pa chung / /dbang po nyams pa'am 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rtsa chen gnad bcad lbu ba dang / /sgra bcas 'byung zhing dran nyams 'gyur/ /rtsa yi gnad bcad khrag ska zhing / /rgyun mi 'chad par mang du 'byung / /de zad mgo 'khor dbugs mi bde/ /skom rmongs ⑫skyigs bus 'debs pas 'chi/ /lus ni gra ma lta bus khyab/ /'tshob ⑩111—325
