kyang sgur po'am 'theng sna/por 'gyur/ /tshigs gnad stobs dang spyod pa nyams//lus skem natshigs ni skrang bar — 'gyur/ /lte ba mur 'gram bdag po gzhang / /snyeng dang chu so sum mdo /4/ris/ /ma mo brgyad dang 5bcu dgu po/ /'phral du srog ni gcod par byed/ /de rnams 'phral du mi 'chi yang / /zhag bdun gyis ni nges par 'chi/ /rengs bral mthil 'phrog rtsib logs mtshams/ /rked pa can gzhon mtshams kyi mtha'/ /nu rtsa dbang po chu so'i ⑦gnad/ /rgyab 8tshigs mi gsal rtsa chen dang po)/ /ro smad nu mjing ⑩sum cu gsum/ /zla ba'am zla phyed son (stenas ni/ /dus gzhan du ni 'chi bar byed/ /brdeg ⑫dang gzhag pa zhes bya gsum/ /der ni zug rngu byung 7gyur na/ /rlung gis sha dang tshil dang rkang / /glad ④rgyas rnams ni skems ⑫par byed/ /mtshon phyung ⑩lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /'byung zhing srog ni 'joms par 'gyur/ /sbrul mgo mig zur rna rtsa dang / /sngon po 'gram gnas ltag pa'i gnad/ /phrag pa'am phrag stsogs 'khyil pa dang / /ljon shing brla ⑩dbang khung bu dang / /mig dmar pus mo'i gnad dang bcas/ /mtshan 'dzin pir 'dra gru (shemo'i gnad / /de ltar gnad ni bzhi bcu bzhis1— / /rkang lag 'jas par byed 'gyur ba'am( ste/ /gal te tshabs cher snad gyur 6men/ /des ni srog kyang 'joms par byed/ /pir mgo 'dra dang long mo dang / /mkhrig ma'i 3gnad brgyad nad tshabs skyed ri/ /de las ljon shing mchan khung 'dzin/ /brla dang pir mgo 4lta bu ste/ /bcu gnyis sor gcig gatshad yin no/ /mkhrig ma dang ni long mo dang / /nu ma'i rtsa ba sor gnyis tshad/ /pus mo gru mo sor gsum tshad—/ /gzhang dang chu so lte ba snying / /sngon po mtshams mtha' ma mo dang / /711 326

pir 'dra sum mdo khya)ris 'gram pa/ /gnad ni nyi shu dgu yi (5tshad/ /rang gi lag mthil tshad yin no/ /lhag ma gnad ni lnga bcu drug /sor phyed kyi ni tshad du 'dod/ /gzhan dag gnad de til 'bru ste/ /'bras tsam gyi ni tshad du ①'dod/ /rtsa bzhir ④bshad pa gang yin pa/ /lus kun brtas par byed pa rnams 5/ /de ni gnad la gnas pa yin/ /des na de phug khrag drag 'byung ( //lus zungs rnams ni zad pa'i phyir/ /rlung 'phel spyond ni mi bzad 'debs—/ /rlung gis mkhris pa rgyas par byed/ /mkhris pa rgyas par gyur pas na/ /skom dang mgo 'khor skam dang ⑧myos/ /lus rngul tshigs dbye rtelus lhod dang / /de ni gshin rje'i dbang du 'gro/ /gnad gcod ⑩na ni myur ba ru/ / lus kyi tshigs ni chod 'gyur te/ /⑪tshigs kyi ⑫phyogs su bcad pas na—/ /rtsa ni 'khums par byed pa yin/ /de la srog chags rnams kyi srog /khrag gnas na ni gnas pa yin/ /de bas gnad min legs skephog na/ /nges par 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'ga' zhig sman pa'i yon tan dang / /phyogs gcig tu ni phog pa yis/ /'tsho bar gyur kyang de yi ni/ /dbang po ma tshang nyid du ④'gyur/ /de bas 'bad de gnad du ni/ /thal sman me btsa' la sogs spang / /gnad du phog na chung rka/nyengus kyang / /phal cher shin tu gnod pa yin/ /de bzhin gnad la brten pa'i nad⑫/ /rab tu 'bad pas gso bar bya/ / yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las1/lus kyi gnas kyi khyashele'u bzhi pa'o// //de nas lus kyi /shwe'agyur ba'i bye brag shes par bya ba'i sha /le'u bshad par 711 327

bya'o —/ //3 ji ltar 'bras bu 6me tog dang / /me yi du ba char gyi (pesprin/ /phyis 'byung mtshan ma yin pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'chi ltas las nges 'chi/ /'chi ltas med na mi 'chi la/ /'chi ltas snang na 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /'chi ltas 'chi ltas min peshes pa/ /mi mkhas 'chi ltas med min dushes/ /la la rten dang brten pa po'i/ /khyad par gyis de gnyis su 'dod/ /nad kyi tshul ni mang po las/ /'chi ltas tshul du 'byung bar 'gyuraspyo/ /nad zhi na ni zhi 'gyur la/ /brtan par gnas na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gzugs dang dbang po skad dang mdog /gzugs brnyan bya ba sogs pa tshudang / /dngos po dag ni gzhan la yang / /tha mal pa las rgyu med par/ /gzhan du gyur gang mdor gang ⑨ni/ /'chi ltas yin par de shes bya/ /skra dang ba spu ma bskus par/ /snum gyis bskus ltar gang snang dang / /gang zhig mig ni rab g.yo ⑩dang / /mi 'gyur phyir 'byung ⑪khung bur zhugs/ /yo dang bgrad dang 'jums ⑫pa dang //bcum zhing smin ma smad pa dang / /'khrul dang mthong ba nyams pa dang / /sre mo'i mig ltar lta ⑫ba dang / /thi ba 'dra dang mgal me 'dra/ /mchi ma 'dzag cing rdzi ma 'khrugs/ /sna ni shin tu gdangs pa dang / /zhom dang 'brum ④phran gyis khyab dang / /skrang (nyedang gas dang rnyid pa dang / /gang gi ma mchu 'phyangs ⑩pa dang / /ya mchu gyen la badze+es pa dang / /gnyi ga 'dzam bu smin 'drar snang / /so gnag gseg mar bcas pa dang / /dmar zhing so zho nag nog can/ /glo bur du ni 'byung ba dang / /lce ni yo dang rtag tu 'byin/ / skrang dang skam 7dang lci dang gnag /gos dang rtsub dang tshor ba med/ /mjing pas mgo ni mi theg dang / /rang gi ltag rgyab tushekhur ltar lci/ /'gram 111 — 328

pas ①kha na gnas pa yi/ /kha zas bldad ②par mi nus pa/ /gang zhig rgyu med par yan lag /shin tu lci ba'am ④shin tu yang / /dug dang snad bupa med par ni/ /bu ga rnams las khrag 'byung dang / /gang zhig pho mtshan nub pa dang / /rlig pa rab tu 'phyangs ⑤pa'am/ /de las go log rjogyur pa rnams/ /thams cad 'chi bdag dbang gyur yin/ /gang gi rtsa ris sngon med par⑦/ /zla ba tshes pa lta bu ni/ /'phral ⑧ba'am chu so'i steng na gnas⑨/ /de ni zla drug las mi 'tsho/ /lus can gang gi lus la chu/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bur ni//rgyal tshe chu ni mi chags pa/ /de ni zla ba drug na 'chi/ /spyi bo ⑩du ba'am snum bcas snang / /de ni zla ba gcig na 'chi/ /spyi bo'am smin mtshams gsar du ni—/ /mtshams bye ba 'am gtsug ⑩'khyil snang / /nad med zhag ni drug gis 'chi—/ /nad pa zhag gsum na 'chi 'gyur/ /lce gnag kha ni mnam pa dang / /mig g.yas phugs su bros pa 'am/ /bya ni mgo la babs pa dag /gang yin de ni yongs su spang / /gang zhig khrus tusngebyas byugs pa dang / /lus kun gsher bar gnas bzhin du/ /snying ga ⑫shin tu myur bar bskams/ /de ni zla phyed las mi 'tsho/ /glo bur du ni lus kun ④mdog /cig car tha mal pa las nyams—/ /de bzhin nad ni sogs pa dang / /rtsub dang snum 'gyur 'chi ba yinarka/ / gong gi ⑫sor mo drangs pa dang / /sgra mi 'byung ba de mi 'tsho/ /de bzhin lud pa sprid stsogs la/ /gang zhig sngon med sgra byung ba'am/ /dbugs 'byin thung ba'am ring ba 'am/ /dri mnam ⑩pa 'am dri zhim 'gyur/ /lus ni khrus byas ma byas rung / /mi ma yin pa'i ⑩dri 'byung ba'am/ /gos rma dri ma byung na yang ⑫/ /de ni lo gcig nas 'chi 'gyur/ /gang zhig shig dang sbrang 111—329

ma stsogs/ /dri zhim pas ni 'du ba 'am/ /dri nga bas ni spong 'gyur na/ /de ni lo gcig las mi 'tsho/ /gang zhig rtag tu lus tsha la/ /grang ba nyid du snang ba dang / /bsel ba shin tu tsha bar snang / /rgyu med par ni rngul dang rengs/ /gang zhig grang ba'i chu bur 'byung / /lus grang ba las tsha ba skyes/ /grang ①gdungs than pa la mi dga'/ /de ni gshin rjes dbang 'gyur ②yin/ /gang gi ①snying ga dro gyur la/ /lto ba shin tu grang gyur cing / /bshang rjob 'khru zhing skom dad che/ /de ni ro dang 'dra ba yin/ /bshang dang gci ba mchil snabs sam—/ /kha chu chu ⑤nang nub gyur pa'am/ /mchil ma kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /gang yin pa de zla gcig dhi'achi/ /sa ni nam mkhar mthong ba dang / /nam mkha' sar ni mthong gyur dang / /gzugs med gzugs can lta bu dang / /gzugs can gzugs med ltar gnas mthong / /de bzhin 'od can 'od med mthong / /dkar po gnag dang yod pa med④/ /mig nad med par zla ba ni/ /gzugs mang ra ri med mthong dang / /gnyid ma log par dri za srin⑧/ /yi dwags gzhan yang de 'dra ba'i/ /gzugs mi sdug pa mthong 'gyur ba/ /gang yin de ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gre bdun dang ni nyer gnas pa'i/ /skar ma sgrib med ma mthong dang / /dgu tshigs gung tshugs ⑨ma mthong ba/ /de ni lo gcig mi 'tsho'/ /'brug sgra chu bo'i sgra dang ni/ /gling bu pi wang rnga yi sgra/ /sgra gzhan med kyang thos pa'am/ /yod pa thos par ma gyur dang / /rna ba'i bu ga bkab pa yis⑩/ /'ur 'ur po yi sgra mi thos/ /de bzhin dri dang ro dang reg /gang zhig log par shes pa dang / /yang na yong ye mi tshor dang / /me mar shi ba'i dri mi tshor/ /cho ga bzhin byas nad skyed la⑪/ /cho ga log pas 111—330

byed byed— byed——bde gnas dang / /gang gi lus ni rngul g.yogs 'dra/ /lus la snad pa mi tshor dang / /dka' thub drag dang cho ga ni/ /sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor med pa ru / /dbang po las 'das shes pa skyed sna/ /de rnams 'chi bar shes par bya /skad 'gags dman zhing mi gsal dang / /gang zhig skad ni 'dzer gyur dang / /smra 'dod pa ni de'aphral du ni/ /brjed 'gyur de ni mi 'tsho'o/ /skad gsang shin tu nyam chung 'gyur(kye/ /mdog dang stobs ni nyams pa dang / /rgyu med par ni nad 'phel bar/ /snang ba dag kyang 'chi bar bshad/ /skad gdangs nyams par gyur pa dang / /bdag nyid 'chi bar smra ba dang / /de 'dra'i sgra ni thos pa dag /ring du yongs su spang bar bya/ /lus dbyibs dang ni tshad dang niske/ /mdog gam gzi mdangs gang dag gis/ /gzugs brnyan 'gyur ba rmi lam du/ /mthong na'ang de ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma me long chu stsogs la/ /gang zhig dbyibs dang tshad dang ni/ /lus kyi rnam pa snang gyur pa/ /gzugs brnyan zhes ni de la bshad/ /mdog dang gzi mdangs la brten gang / /lus gtogs 5)gzugs brnyan lta bu yin/ /gang gi gzugs brnyan bcad pa dang / /gyes dang lhag dang 'khrugs rngo pa dang / /mgo med mgo gnyis yon po dang / /mi sdug gzhan du gyur par snang ()/ /mtshan nyid las byung ma yin na/ /de ni tshe zad yin zhes bya/ /gang gi mig gi rgyal mor ni/ /gzugs brnyan snang bar ma gyur dang / /nam mkha' la stsogs lnga po yi/ /gzugs brnyan rnam pa sna tshogs lnga/ /nam mkha' dwangs shing /8/sngo ba dang / /snum bcas mdog dang bcas pa yin/ /rlung las rngul can dmar dang gnag /thal mdog rtsub cing mdog nyams yin/ /me yi dmar zhing dang bar snang / /mdangs ldan /77 33/

blta na sdug pa yin/ /chu skyes bai byur+ya 'drar snang / /dag cing rab snum bde ba yin/ /sa yi brtan ①snum dag pa dang / /mthug ④cing dkar dang sngo bsangs yin/ /rlung ni nad 'chi sdug bsngal skyed/ /gzhan dag bde ba skyed pa yin/ /me yis ①thams cad mdog can te/ /de ni rnam pa bdun du bshad//dmar dang ser dang dkar nag po/ /ljang dang skya dang nag po'o/ /de rnams la ni gang gsal 'gyuradhi/ /snum dang dri ma med de dge/ /dri ma can dang rtsub pa dang / /zhum pa sdug bsngal skyed pa yin/ /mdangs kyis mdog ni zil gyis gnon/ /'od ni kha dog gsal byed yin/ /mdangs kyis nye bar snang ba yin/ /'di ⑤ni ring nas snang ba yin/ /'ga' zhig mdangs dang kha dog gi/ /mtshan ma'i khyad par med min te/ /mi rnams mtshan ma bzang ngan 'byung rjo/ /dus su mdangs la brtan ⑦pa yin/ /gang zhig rkang pa 'drud pa dang / /phrag pa yo bas 'go ba dang / /gang zhig phan zas mang zos kyang / /rtag tu stobs ni nyams 'gyur ⑧na/ /gang zhig nyung zos bshang gci mang / /mang zos bshang gci nyung ba dang / /nyung zos bad kan gyis nyen zhing / /dbugs rings ⑨'byin zhing sa la 'gre/ /gang zhig dbugs rings ⑩phyung nas ni—/ /thung du rngubs te shugs 'byen dang / /thung du dbugs 'byen bsnun pa ltaraspyoske/ /shin tu 'dar bar byed pa yang / /gang zhig lag ngar bskums nas ni/ /mgo bo dka' bas 'debs ⑫pa dang / /gang zhig 'phral ⑫ba las rngul 'dzag /tshigs mtshams lhod par gyur pa dang / /nyams ⑩che ba 'am nyam chung gyur pa gang / /ldang ba'i tshe na mi dran 'gyur/ /gang zhig gan rkyal ⑫nyal nas ni/ /rkang pa rnam par bskyod pa dang / /rtsig pa mal stan la sogs 111—332

pa—/ /gang zhig rtag tu snyes /3pa dang / /rgyu med par dgod myos —tshul gyis/ /mchu la ldags kapar byed pa dang / /ya mchu ldags 2 par byed pa dang / /sgra bcas par yang gang byed dang / /lus mdog nag po ser po dang / /dmar po'i gzugs brnyan snang ba dang / /sman pa sman dang kha zas dang / /bla ma mdza' bshes la sdang gang 5/ /'di dag thams cad gshin rje yi/ /dbang gyur yin par shes par bya/ /gang zhig drod chung sems g.yengs dang / /rtag tu mdangs ngan yid mi bde/ /gang zhig gtor ma bya rog la/ /byin yang za bar mi byed dang / /gang zhig rgyu med yid gzhungs dang / /mdzes shing lus rgyas dpal thob pa'am/ /de las nyams par gyur pa dag /de ni gshin rje'i khyim du 'jug /tha mal par ram nad pa yis dhi/ /gang zhig yon tan skyon rang bzhin/ /snga las gzhan du 'gyur bar snang / /de ni zla drug las mi 'tsho//dad dang tshul khrims dran dang sbyin/ /blo gos stobs ni rgyu med par/ /'di drug las ni ldog gyur pa/ /zla ba drug nas sgo 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'gro dang tshig ni sbyo ba 'dra/ /'dar rmongs zla ba gcig nas (shā'achi/ /sgra phyi ba na tshor ba med—/ /zhag drug nas ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig skog nad med pa ru/ /mid par kha zas mi chud dang / /bran g.yog log par byed gyur pa/ /de ni 'chi ba dang 'drar bshad/ /gang zhig rtag tu gnyid log pa'am/ /gnyid med de yang mi 'tsho'o/ /mchi mas gdong ni khebs pa dang / /rkang pa shin tu rngul ba dang / /mig ni mi sdug par snang ba/ /gshin rje'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur 9 —/ /sngon chad dga' ba'i dngos la gang / /dga' mi 'gyur ba de mi 'tsho—/ /gang zhig 'phral du 'gyur ba yin17/ /mtshan nyid thams cad snang ba 17/ 333

dang / /'phral du ldog par 'gyur ba dag① /de ni mod la 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rims ni stobs dang ldan pa dang / /gting du zhen zhing yun ring dang / bla bcas mgo 'khor dbugs mi bde/ /rid sbung skrangs dang me drod nyams/ /tshig mi gsal zhing thogs pa dang / /mig dmar snying ni gzer ba dang / /snga dro lud pa skam po 'byung / /phyi dro de las gzhan du 'gyur/ /bad kan lud par bcas pa dang / /stobs dang sha ni zad na 'chi/ /khrag dang mkhris pa shin tu dmar/ /yang na gnag pa'am tshon can nam/ /dmar dang ser dang ljang mdog tu/ /khrag gi gzugs ni rab tu snang / /ba sru'i bu ga nas 'dzag dang / /skog ma snying gar gos pa dang / /gos la ma chags dri nga la/ /shugs byung shin tu mang du ②'byung / /rgad ①po skya rbab rims thabs skyugs⑦/ /lud pa skrang ⑤dang tshad 'khru gsod/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde rims skyugasame/ /skom dang tshad ⑦'khru 'or nad dang / /gcong can sbos ⑧dang rtsib logs gzer//khrag skyug phrag pa tsha na 'chi/ /skyug pa shugs dang ldan pa dang / /bshang gci dri yod tshon can dang / /lud pa bshang nag khrag dang bcas/ /dbugs mi bde yun ring na 'chi⑨/ /skom dad nad gzhan gyis nyams smad/ /lce 'byung dran pa stor na 'chi/ /chang nad shin tu grang pas nyen/ /sha zad til mar gdong bskus 'dra/ /gzhang 'brum rkang lag lte ba dang / /bshang sgo rmig pa'i ⑩kha skrangs dang / /snying ga rtsib logs yan lag na/ /slon bro gzhang rnams rims kyis ⑪nyen/ /tshad 'khru mcher pa'i dum bu dang / /sha bkrus pa 'am snum nag dang / /til mar 'o ma mar 'dra yang / /zho dang rkang zhag chang snying ⑫dang / /glad ⑫pa gnag tsha 'dra ba dang / /sha brdungs chu dang sbrang rtsi dang ⑫//111—334

rab dmar gnag dang snum pa dang / / rnag 'dra sla ska /gernag dang bcas/ /lus zungs sna tshogs 'byung ba dang / /bshang ba med pa'am che na ba 'am/ /'byar bag sbrang ma lta bu 'am // /ri mo can dang tshon can dang / /gzhang gi gnyer ma phyir 'byung )dang / /sgra can tharus tshigs gzer ba dang / /bshang sgo bye zhing stobs zad dang / /zas ni ma nyams 'byung ba dang / /skom bcas rims dang skyug pa dang / /lus tsha lto sbos rgyun 'khrus ( )'chi/ /rde'u 'gags rmig pa skrangs pa dang / /gcin 'gags nad kyis nyam pethag gsod/ /gcin snyi skom dad tsha 'brum bcas/ /sha rul tshad pas 'khru ba 'chi/ /thor nad dang ni snying ga rgyab/ /nu ma phrag pa spyi bor byung / /tshigs dang rkang pa lag par gnas/ /gcin sri nad can stobs chung dang / /sha rnams thams cad 'drul ba dang / /skom dad tsha myos rims btab 'chi/ /me dbal gnad khyeni 'gags pa dang / /skyigs bu mgo 'khor dbugs mi bde/ /skran ni rgya cher ⑨kun nas zlum/ /sra zhing rus sbal ltar mtho 4 rtedang / /rtsa mngon rims btab skyugs (tepa dang / /skyigs bu sbos shing ⑫zug gzer bcas /lud pa cham pa snying 'phar dang / /tshad 'khru skrang ⑫dang dbugs mi bde/ /dmu dze+eng bshang nyesgegaci 'gags pa dang / /dbugs mi bde skrang /nyeskyigs bu dang / /rims dang mgo 'khor brgyal slon 'khru/ /nyam chung mi ni gsod 'gyur zhing / /mig skrang ba ⑪dang mchan khung khya dang / /pags pa rul zhing srab pa 1 dang / /bkru sman gyis bkrus lto sbos 1pezhing / /yang dang yang du 'phel ba 'chi/ /skya rbab skrang zhenadang bcas pa dang / /mig dang sen mo ser por snang / /snyoms tsha yi ga 'chus dang slon/ /brgyal dang sto sbos tshad 'khru /11 335

'chi—/ /skrangs nad bla brnan ①sna tshogs ldan/ /skyes pa rkang gnyis dang por skrangs—/ /bud med mgo nas skrangs na ⑤'chi/ /gnyi ga'ang mtshan dang mchan khung skrangs④/ /ri mor bcas 'dzag skyugs ④pa dang / /rims dang tshad 'khru dbugs mi bde/ /skrangs pa'i tha mar rims tshad 'khru⑤/ /de gnyis gnyis duzad mthar skrangs ⑦dang / /lus can nyam chung gyur pa dag /skrangs par gyur na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig skrangs pa rkang par gnas/ /byen pa'i nywar ni phyin pa dang / /dpyi yi bar du gnod gyur pa/ /de ni sman pas spang bar bya/ /gang gi gdong lag rkang pa ⑧ni/ /lhag par skams ⑨par gyur pa 'am/ /lus ma gtogs ⑩'di shas cher skrangs/ /de ni zla ba gcig na 'chirka/ /me dbal lud pa kha dog nyams/ /rims brgyal yan lag bcag snyam sems/ /mgo 'khor kha skams ⑪snying ga na/ /lus snyom tshad pas 'khru ldan spang / /mdze ni yan lag 'drul ba dang / /mig dmar skad no 'gags pa dang / /drod nyams srin bu rnams kyis gtses/ /skom dad tshad pas 'khru ldan 'chi/ /rlung nad pags pas tshor med byed/ /lus 'dar skrang dang nad kyis gzir/ /dreg nad rmongs shing brgyal ba dang / /myos dang gnyid che rims mgo rengs/ /yi ga 'chus dang dbugs mi bde/ /'khums shing chu bur rul pa 'dra/ /mgo nad yid spyo'achus dbugs mi bde/ /rmongs bag 'khru zhing skom mgo 'khor/ /skad 'gags lus zungs me drod zad/ /lus nyam ⑫chung nad kun gsod byed/ /rlung gi nad dang brjed byed dang / /mdze nad khrag dang dmu rdzing gcong / /skran can gcin nad ⑫ldan pa yis⑫/ /sha zad nad tshabs chung yang spang / /sha dang stobs ni shin tu zad/ /nad 111—336

—— byedabyedabyed—— ——————— ——————— —————'phel yi ga 'chus pa dag /nad pa gang la snang 'gyur te/ /zla ba byed dang gnyis na 'chi/ /rlung nad gtun she/'dra 'phel 'gyur zhing / /mi zad 2snying gar gnas pa dag— /skom dad kyis ni yongs gdungs pa/ /'phral du srog ni 'phrog par byed/ /rlung nad nywa ni lhod byed cing / /sna ni yon por 'chus byed pa/ /gang gi 'gram pa zad par snang / /'phral du srog ni 'phrog pa yin/ /rlung nad lte ba gzhang bar song / /yang na brla dbrag gnyis na gnasaske/ /stobs ldan rlung ni nyam ⑤chung ba'i/ /gzhang dang snying gar gnas 6ne+ebyed pa'am/ /dri ma chu so'i ltag lte (peb/ /bkag te ne+e)nad ni skyed pa dang / /chu sor gzer bar byed 'gyur la/ /skom dad 'khru bar byed pa dang / /chu so bshang sgor gnas nas ni/ /rlung ni dbugs mi bde skyed dang / /rtsib ma'i rtse mo 'degs byed cing / /snying gar rlung ni brten pa dang ((ste/ /mig bgrad 'gyur ba med byed pa/ /'phral du srog ni 'phrog par byed/ /'phral du rims dang tsha bas btab/ /skom dad brgyal 9/rtedang stobs zad dang / /tshigs mtshams bral bar gyur pa rnams⑪/ /nye bar 'chi bar 'gyur ba ⑫yin/ /nang par gang gi gdong las ni/ /rngul nas ⑫shas cher 'dzag 'gyur zhing / /khar chags rims kyis gdungs pa spyornams/ /de yang 'tsho bar dka' ba yin/ /gang gi lus la 7'brum phran ni/ /byi ⑩ru'i mdog 'dra skrasnang gyur paspyo/ /byung nas myur du mi snang gyur(6/ /de ni ring por mi thogs 'chi/ /'brum pa sran chung bshus 'dra zhing ( / /de bzhin byi ru'i mdog 'dra ba/ /nang du kha blta tshad 'brum 'dra/ /'brum bus ḍa melus ni 'jig byed yin/ /mig ser gdong ( sheser rgyas pa dang / /mur 'gram gnyis kyi sha zad pa/ /skrag cing lus ni tsha ba 11/ 337

dag /gang yin de ni spang bar bya/ /rgyu med phrugs pa dag las rma/ /'phel zhing mched par byed pa dang / /rlung skyes gang yin na ba med/ /mkhris pa las gyur tsha ba med/ /bad kan las gyur rnag med dang / /gang zhig nad skyed ①zug gzer med/ /phye mas khyab dang rnying par snang / /gang du glo bur dag tu ni/ /rgyal mtshan mdung la sogs gzugs snang / /rma de thams cad spang bar bya/ /mtshan bar rdol na bshang ②gci rlung / /'byung zhing srin bus gtses pa dang / /pus mo phan tshun 'byer ①ba dang / /rkang pa bteg nas rtsang gyur rjodang / /yang dang yang du kha bsgyur ba'i/ /nad pa de ni 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /so yis sen mo'i rtse gcod cing / /sen mos skra 'am rtsa gcod ⑤dang / /sa la shing bus 'dri ba dang / /bong bas bong ba rdeg dhipa dang / /spu ldang gcin ni bska ba dang / /lud pa bskams shing rims kyis 'debs—/ /skad cig dgod cing sgyugs gru len/ /mal la rkang pas rdeg ⑦pa dang / /skad cig re res ⑧bu ga sol/ /nad pa gang yin de mi 'tsho/ /gdong la sme ba ngo khabs dang / /mdzer skyes ⑨so sen thig le chags/ /lto la sna tshogs rtsa snang ba/ /glo bur byung ba de mi 'tsho/ /gyen du dbugs ⑩rtseg drod yal zhing / /brla dbrag gnyis su gzer gyis nyen/ /dpal dang rnam par bral gyur pa/ /blo dang ldan pas yongs su spang / /gang gi nad ni 'phel 'gyur dang / /rang bzhin yongs su nyams pa ni/ /gang la 'phral du 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de ni mod la 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sman pas nad pa gang zhig la/ /sman kyi bya ba byas gyur pa/ /'bad kyang sos par ma gyur na/ /de yi srog ni rnyed par ⑪dka'/ /mkhas shing mang du grub pa dang / /cho ga bzhin du byin 111—338

gyur yang / /sman gyi bya ba ma grub gang / /de la gso ba'i thabs med do/ /gang gis ①sman ni sbyor ba'i tshe/ /rgyu med par ni phyin ci log /mdog dang ro stsogs logs ④gyur na/ /nad med yin yang de mi 'tsho/ /gang gi gnas su shing bcas med⑦/ /rlung med kyang ni shi 'gyur rjodang / /nad pa gang gi ⑤khyim du ni/ /snod ni shin tu mang po dag /chag gam lhung rjobar gyur pa na⑦/ /de yi srog ni rnyed par ⑧dka'/ /mi gang nyam ⑨chung gyur pa yang / /glo bur sos ⑩par snang gyur pa/ /de yi srog kyang ma nges pa/ /yin par rgyun shes bus bshad do / /⑪nye du mdza' bo rnams kyis ni/ /dris kyang mnyan ⑫par mi bya la⑫/ /sman pas smra bar mi bya zhing / /de yi gso ba'ang khas mi blang / /gshin rje'i pho nya sha za stsogs/ /gzhan gyis nye bar bsten ⑩pa gang / /sman gyis ⑫stobs ni 'joms pas na/ /de phyir de ni ⑩yongs su spang / /tshe yi rig byed 'bras bu kun/ /tshe shes pa la gnas pa yin/ /de bas 'chi ltas gnas pa kun/ /sman pas 'bad de shes par bya/ /tshe dang bsod nams ⑩gnyi ga zad / /de gnyis zad par ma gyur yang / /ya nga ba ni ma spangs pas/ /srog chags rnams ni 'chi bar bshad / /⑫yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ lus kyi gnas kyi ⑪le'u lnga pa'o// //de nas lus kyi gnas kyi pho nya la stsogs pa bshad par bya'o/ /ya mtshan can dang dge sbyong dang / /rigs mthun las ni 'grub par bshad/ /de las go bzlog pho nya ni/ /las ni 'grub min ⑪rtags su bshad/ /dman dang 'jigs rengs sngangs ⑥pa dang / /rtsub dang bkra mi shis smra dang / /mtshon 111—339

— ————— —— ——— —byedacha dbyug thogs mgo reg dang / /ma ning sma ra ral 7/pa can/ /bkra mi shis pa'i ming dang ldan/ /sdig snelas bud med dri ma can/ /mang po nad pa mi sdug dang / /phreng ba byug pa dmar pos brgyan/ /til mar 'dam bskus gos rnying dang / /mdog ngan rlan can gos gcig gon/ /bong bu rnga mo ma he zhon//shing dang bong ba nyed pa dang / /ring nas 'bod pa'i pho nya 'ongs/ /sman pas yongs su spang bar bya/ /bkra mi shis pa sems dang smra/ /gcer bu gcod dang 'jig rngo )pa dang / /mtshun gtor me la bsreg 9 )pa dang / /'chi ba rnams la ster ba dang / /sar nyal skra bshig skud pa dang / /ngu dang ma bsdams gnas skabs su/ /sman pa gnas tshe pho nya 'ongs/ /mi ni 'chi bar ston pa yin/ /nad dang mtshan nyid mtshungs pa yi/ /yul lam dus su sman pa gnas/ /bang chen 'bod du 'ongs mthong na/ /nad pa de ni gso mi bya/ /lte ba kha dang sna reg dang / /skra dang spu dang sen mo so/ /mtshan rgyab nu ma mgrin pa dang / /lto dang srin lag dag dang ni/ /ras bal phub ma zha nye rtsa/ / rus pa gtun brdung phyags khrum rdo/ /zhabs (pe ma gos kyi mtha' ma dang / /thal ba sol ba kha tshar sogs(be/ /thag pa gtun dang zhags pa srang / /gzhan yang thog gi zhags 8ne+epa thogs/ /pho nya de 'dra sngon du mthong / /'chi ba dag tu ston pa yin/ /de bzhin mtshan phyed nyi ma'i gung / /thun mtshams dang ni dus tshigs dang / /tshes drug tshes bzhi tshes dgu dang / /sgra gcan mjug rings 'char dus stsogs/ /bra nye smin drug skag chu stod/ /gre dang khrums stod snrubs 9dang ni/ /gong du pho nya nad pa yi/ /mtshan nyid la ni brten pa'i tshig /mi dge smra dang mi shis mthong / /der 11 ni sman pa 'gro mi bya/ /777 340

dbang po ma tshang mi ro 'am/ /mi rus kyis ni brgyan pa 'am/ /chad dang tshig dang nyams chag dang / /de yi tshig tu smra ba 'am/ /ro ni tsha dang drag pa 'am/ /dri ni shas cher rul pa 'am/ /reg bya ①rgya cher mi bzad dang / /gang yang de 'dra gzhan dag ni/ /de kun mdun du smra ba 'am/ /yang na de skad smra ba'i tshe/ /pho nya 'ongs par mthong na ni/ /nad pa de ni gso mi bya/ /kyi hud kyi hud cho nges 'debs/ /'o dod ②dmod mo 'gyel ①sprid sgra/ /gos dang gdugs dang lham 'jig ④dang / /sdug bsngal ba dag mthong ba dang / /shing chen rgyal mtshan gang ba'i snod/ /chu nang nub par mthong ba dag /gsod ⑤stsogs yid du mi 'ong smra/ /thal ba phyag dar gyis gtor dang / /byi la sram dang sbrul dang ni/ /spre'us lam ni bcad pa dang / /'bar ba'i phyogs su ri dwags bya/ / gdug pa sgra ni sgogs rjopa dang / /'bru gnag ⑦bu ram dar ba dang / /lan tshwa chang rnying pags pa dang / /yungs kar zhag dang 'bru mar dang / /rtswa dang 'dam bu bud shing dang / /ma ning mi srun sme sha can/ /rgya dag dang ni rnyi ⑧rnams dang / /slon dang bshang ba gtong ba dang / /rnag dang mtshan ma ngan pa mthong / /snying po med dang 'khrig pa spyod/ /ras bal stsogs dang dgra bo mthong / /mal stan dang ni khyogs la stsogs/ /kha sbub ⑨tu ni gnas par mthong / /nad pa dag dang gzhan dag dang / /snod stsogs ngan mthong mi shes so/ /skyes pa'i ming can bya g.yon nas/ /bud med ming can g.yas 'dug bzang / /bya dang ri dwags g.yas skor ⑩bzang / /khyi dang wa ni de lta ⑪min—/ /ri dwags rnams ni zung min shis⑫/ /tsa sha bya rgod khaspru ri/ /ne+e'u le ⑫dang rma bya rnams/ /mthong ba rtag tu shis pa yin/ /'ug pa byi la sbrul 111—341

mthong ba/ /rnam pa kun tu shis ma yin/ /go da dang ni ri bong sbrul/ /dza ba 3 ka ni ming thos dge/ /mthong dang sgra sgrogs de lta /gemin/ /dred dang spre'u de las bzlog /'phral rko ba'i phyogs su 'ja' tshon mthong / /mi shis rgyab tu mthong na shis/ /me yis gang ba'i snod dag ni/ /chag dang khong stong gnas pa dang / /nad pa 'chi 'gyur khyim du ni/ /sman pa 'jug par byed pa'i tshe/ /zho stsogs bkra shis 'og nas bshad/ /gang ba'i snod phyir byung mthong dang / /pho nya la stsogs mi shis mthong / /de lta'i nad pa spang bar bya/ /de las gzhan par snying rje'i ④rgyud/ /dag pas 'bad de gso bar bya/ /zho 'bru bu ram shing dang khre/ /sbrang rtsi zhun mar pri yang ku/ /nas ⑤thug dngul rdo bum pa dang / /dril bu mar me chu skyes dang / / drur pa rjonya dang sha rlon dang / /'bras yos 'bras bu kha zas dang / /bum pa rin po che yis gang / /bu mo gzhon dang shing rta dang / /mi ni mgo 'phang mtho ba ladang / /lha rnams dang ni rgyal po dang / /gos dkar gon ⑧dang me tog dkar/ /khyem dang rnga yab rta dkar mthong / /dam pa bram ze gtsug tor dung (7/ /rta babs dang ni g.yung 6 )drung dang / /sa ni brkos par 4spegyur pa dang / /me ni rab tu 'bar ba dang / /bza' btung yid du 'ong ba dang / /mi yis shing rta legs gang dang / /ba ni be'u dang bcas pa dang / / rgod ma bud med bu btsas dang / /7shang shang te'u sha bkra dang / /ngang pa khu byug rma bya dang / /sa ra sa ni sgra snyan sgogs⑫/ /de bzhin phyugs gcig btags pa dang / /gdu bu me long yungs kar dang / /gi wang rnams ni mthong ba dang / /byug pa gedri zhim gyis byugs 7dang / /khu ba dkar zhing mngar ba dang / /khyu mchog de bzhin 111 342

ba lang rnams/ /rjes su mthun pa'i sgra sgogs dang / /ri dwags bya dang mi rnams ni/ /yid 'ong sgra snyan smra ba yi①/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng / /mngon par stod par ④byed pa dang / /rdza rnga dung dang rnga bo che/ /sgra dang bkra shis sgra sgrogs pa/ /bram ze rig byed 'don pa dang / /bde ba'i rlung ni rjes mthun rgyu/ /lam dang khyim du 'jug tshe yod/ /nad sos mtshan nyid yin shes bya/ /de ltar pho nya dge bshad nas/ /de 'og rmi lam bshad bya steske/ /rmi lam shi ba'i mi rnams dang / /lhan cig chang 'thungs khyis ④drangs gang / /mi de rim gyis ④gzugs can gyi/ /'chi bdag gis ni myur khyer ⑤'gyuraske/ /lus dang gos dang phreng ba dmar/ /bud med rgod pas drangs rmis rjogang / /de ni khrag mkhris dag gis 'chi/ /ma he rta phag bong bu dang / /rnga mo zhon te lho phyogs 'gro/ /de ni gcong chen nad kyis 'chi/ /lcug ma tsher can 'od ma 'am/ /ta la snying gar ⑦skyes pa rmi/ /gang yin de ni skran gyis 'chi—/ /gang zhig me ni mi 'bar la/ /sbyin sreg byed cing mar gyis bskus/ /gcer bur 'dug dang pad+ma ni/ /snying gar byung rmis ⑧mdze yis 'chi/ /gang zhig sme ⑨sha can lhan cig /snum mang 'thungs par ⑩rmi ba de/ /gcin nad kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sren po lhan cig gar byed cing / /chu la byeng rmi smyo ⑪byed 'dzin/ /ra ro gar byed shi ba yi/ /mis khyer rmi ba brjed ⑫byed 'dzin/ /bong bu rnga mo byi la spre'u/ /seṅge stag dang khā dag dang / /wa 'am mi ro la zhon rmis—/ /de ni 'chi bdag khar song yin/ /snum khur sha khu le zos rmis/ /sad nas de 'dra slon gyur pa/ /gang yin de ni 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /nyi zla gzas zin rmis mig na/ /nyi ma zla ba lhung ba yi/ /rmi lam mthong na long bar 'gyur/ /111—343

spyi bor 'od ma'i lcug stsogs skyes/ /de bzhin bya rog tshang 'cha' dang / /mgo bo chad par rmis pa dang / /khwa dang bya rog sogs ①kyis bskor/ /de bzhin yi dwags sha za mo/ /byad ma sme ④sha can gyis bskor/ /'od ma'i tshal dang tsher ma dang / /rtswa yi tshang tshing nang du tshud/ /g.yang sar lhung dang dur khrod nyal/ /phyag dar thal ba'i nang du ldung / /chu dang 'dam la stsogs par nubaske/ /chu rgyun gyis ni myur du khyer/ /glu gar dang ni rol mo dang ④/ /gos dang phreng ba dmar po 'chang / /lus 'phel na tshod rgas ④pa dang / /bag ma len zhing kha spu 'dreg /zas btsos snum za chang 'thung dang / /skyugs ⑤dang 'khru ba rmi ba dang / /lcags dang gser dag rnyed pa dang / / btsong dang rtsod las pham dupa dang / /mchil lham gnyis ni stor ba dang / /rkang pags ⑦lhung ba rmi ba dang / /shin tu dga' dang rab khros pa'i/ /shi ba'i gnyen gyis spyos pa dang / /mar me gza' dang skar ma dang / /so mig lha'i gzugs rnams ni/ /lhung ba'am 'jig pa rmis pa 'am/ /ri bo ral par gyur pa dang // nags tshal 'bar ⑧ba'i nang dang ni/ /sdig can khyim du 'jug pa dang / /ro bsregs pa ⑨dang mun par zhugs/ /ma yi mngal du zhugs pa dang / /brag dang khang pa sar ⑩lhung dang / /de bzhin nya yis mid pa dang / /chos gos gon ⑩pa'i mi srun dang / /gcer bu dbyug pa thogs pa ⑫dang / /mig dmar kha dog gnag ⑫pa ni/ /mthong na spyonam yang shis ma yin/ /bud med sdig can gdong gnag dang / /skra dang sen mo nu ma ring / /gos dang phreng ba dmar po thogs/ /rmis pa dus mtshan yin par 'dod/ /nad ni stobs dang ldan pa yis/ /yid 'jug bu ga bkag spyopa'i phyir/ /mi bzad rmi lam mthong 111—344

'gyur 6te/ /nad pa 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /nad med the tshom bcas gyur zhing / /'ga' zhig thar par 'gyur ba yin/ /mthong dang thos dang nyams myong dang / /gsol ba btab dang brtags pa dang / /'byung bar 'gyur dedang nad las byung ①/ /rmi lam rnam pa bdun du bshad/ /de las dang po'i lnga po dang / /rang gi rang bzhin nyin mo brjed/ /shin tu ring thung 'bras bu med—/ /mecha 'dres pa yi rang bzhin can/ /mtshan stod rmi lam 'bras bu ring / /mthong ba chung ngu byed pa yin/ /nang par mthong dang gnyid ma log /mi mthun gtam gyis bar ma chod/ /de yi nyin par 'bras chen 'gyur/ /sbyin dang sbyin sreg la stsogs kyis/ /rmi lam 'bras bu chung bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig rmi lam ngan mthong nas/ /slar yang gnas skabs de nyid du/ /rmi lam bzang po mthong gyur na/ /'bras bu bzang po nyid thob 'gyur/ /lha dang bram ze khyu mchog dang / /ba lang rgyal po mdza' bshes (snyegason/ /skyes bu dam pa grags ldan dang / /me 'bar ba dang dngas pa'i nyamatsho/ /bu mo khye'u ser ba dang / /gos dkar gon ⑦zhing mdangs dang ldan/ /skyes bu za dang (shelus 'bar dang / /khrag gis lus kun byugs pa dag /gang gis mthong bar gyur pa dang / /gdugs dang sha rlon me long dug /sna tsa)ma dkar pos gos pa dang spyo/ /mi gtsang gis byugs 'bras bu rnyed/ /ri bo khang bzangs dzispe'abras bcas shing / /'dzeg dang seng ge glang chen mi/ /rta dang ba lang dag la zhon/ /chu bo mtsho bran rgya mtsho rgal⑫/ /shar dang byang du 'gro ba dang / /bgrod min 'go dang shi ba dang / /nyam nga las thar lha rnams dang / /pha mas mngon par bstod pa dang / /ngu dang ldung las ldang ba dang / /dgra bo pham ⑫par byas pa dag /111 345

gang rmis tshe ring nad med dang / /nor mang po ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /de bzhin nad pa'i g.yog 'khor ni/ /bkra shis cho ga phun sum tshogs/ /dad ldan rjes su mthun pa dang / /nor mang bsdus par gyur pa dang / /snying stobs mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing / /sman pa bram ze stsogs la gus/ /gso dpyad rnams la skyo ba med/ /de ni nad med 'gyur ①mtshan nyid/ /rtag tu shis pa sdud ②pa dang / /bkra mi shis pa rnam par spang sne/ /'di dag de ④nyid mthong ba yi/ /drang srong rnams kyis shis par bshad/ /de ltar 'di ni skye dang 'chi/ /mtshan nyid gang phyir bshad pas na/ /de phyir lus kyi gnas yin pas/ /'di ni lus kyi gnas su bshad / /⑤yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ lus kyi gnas kyi le'u drug pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ lus kyi gnas te gnas gnyis pa rdzogs so// //de nas nad thams cad kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /de yang rgyun shes kyi bu la stsogs pa drang srong chen po dhirnams kyis 'di skad ces bshad do/ /nad dang sdig pa rims gnod byed/ /'gyur byed sdug bsngal ma zhu'i skyon/ /zad byed 'tsho dka' mkhun gnod ⑦skyed/ /ming gi rnam grangs sgras skebashad do/ /nad gzhi sngar byung ⑨tshul dang ni/ /de bzhin tshul phyed goms byed dang / /dkyel gyur ⑩shes par byed pa ⑪ste/ /nad ni rnam pa lngar shes bya/ /gzhi dang rgyu dang ⑫skye mched dang / /rkyen dang slong bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /rnam grangs kyis ni nad gzhi bshad/ /gang gis sngar byung tshul shes pas/ /nad ni 'byung bar 111—346

'dod gyur la/ /bye brag phyed par ma gyur pa/ /nad kyi tshul ni ji bzhin par//chung phyir mtshan nyid mi gsal ba'o/ /de nyid gsal ba nyid gyur pa/ /tshul phyed pa zhes bya bar bshad/ /dbyibs dang gsal mngon rtags dang ni/ /mtshan nyid mtshan ma rnams yin no/ /rgyu dang nad dang 0mi mthun zhing / /mi mthun pa yi don byed pa'i/ /sman dang zas dang spyod lam rnams/ /nyer 'bar bsgyur bas bde 'gyur ba/ / nyams brtas (kyebyed par shes bya ste/ /de ni goms pa zhes byar bshad/ /de las bzlog pa'i ma goms nad/ /mi 'phrod nad ces bya ba'o/ /gang gis ④nad ni dkyel gyur pas/ /ji bzhin rjes su 'phel 'gyur zhing / /nad rnams rdzogs shing mngon gyur pa/ /skyes shing 'ongs pa ⑤dkyel gyur yin/ /de ni grangs )brtag gtso bo dang / /stobs dang dus kyis phye ba yin/ /grangs ni ji ltar 'di nyid las/ /rim ni brgyad du bshad pa yin/ /nad rnams spyir ni bsdus pa las⑦/ /cha shas dbye ba brtag pa yin/ /rang dbang gzhan dbang gnyis las ni/ /nad rnams gtso bor bshad pa yin/ /rgyu stsogs ma lus phyogs gcig las/ /stobs ni che chung shes par bya/ /nyin mtshan dus dang zas zos chas/ /nyes pa ji bzhin nad kyi dus/ /de ltar nad gzhi'i don bshad nas/ /de ni rgyas par bshad par bya//nad rnams kun gyi nad gzhi ni/ /nad ni 'khrugs par gyur pa yin/ /de ni gnod 'gyur sna tshogs pa/ /bsten 8pas ldang bar 'gyur bar bshad/ /gsum po'i 6sbyor ba rnam pa gsum/ /gnod 'gyur sngar ni bshad pa yin/ /kha dang tsha dang bska chung zad/ /rtsub dang bcud med sra ba dang / /bkag dang nan gyis btsir ba dang / /mtshan mo mi nyal skad cher smra/ / sbyangs pa'i /11111 347

sbyor drags mya ngan 'jigs/ /sems las drag shul bud med drags/ /so ga nyin mtshan zas zhu'i rjes/ /rlung gi nad ni ldang bar 'gyur/ /mkhris pa tsha dang skyur dang rno/ /lan tshwa bro dang lus tsha dang / /ston ka nyin ①phyed mtshan phyed dang / /tsha ba'i dus su ldang bar 'gyur/ /mngar skyur lan tshwa snum pa dang / /lci dang bad kan skyed ②bsil dang / /'dug dang bde dang gnyid ma zhu—/ /nyin par gnyid log brtas drags ④dang / /slon stsogs sbyor ba nyes pa dang / /zos ma thag dang dpyid kyi dus/ /snga dro mtshan stod bad kan ldang / /'dres pa las ni ldan pa yin/ /thams cad bsten pas 'dus par 'gyuraske/ /de bzhin gzhan yang 'dren mar zos/ /ma zhu ma stoms mi 'phrod dang / /lhag par zos pa la stsogs dang / /chang dang btung ba nyes pa dang / /tshod ma skam dang la phug rjen/ /til tshigs sa zhag so ba'i chang / /sha rul sha skam sha rid rnams/ /de dang de yis nyes gsum skyed/ /de bzhin kha zas spos pa dang / /dus tshigs log pa bdun gyi rlung / /gdon zhugs dug dang dbyig dug zos/ /be'u snabs nad 'khrugs ri rtsar gnas/ /btsas skar la ni gza' zhugs dang / /log par sbyor ba sna tshogs dang / /sdig pa'i las la brten rjopa dang / /bud med bu btsas log par byung / /gso ba log par byas las ldang / /de ltar so so'i nad ldang bas/ /nad kyi gnas su 'gro byed pa/ /rtsa sbubs rjornams su phyin pa dang / /nad rnams lus la myur du skyed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u dang po'o// //111—348

de nas rims nad ①kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /rims ni nad bdag sdig can dang / /'chi bdag mdangs za 'chi byed yin/ /khros pas myur ba'i mchod sbyin brlag /drag po dpral ba'i mig las byung / /skye dang 'chi tshe rmongs byed pa/ /mi 'phrod sna tshogs bsten ②las byung / /mi bzad ming ni sna tshogs pas/ /skye gnas du ma rnams la gnas/ /de ni nad rnams so sor 'dres—/ /'dus dang glo bur las brgyad 'gyur④/ /de la nad rnams rang rang ni/ /rgyu las 'khrugs te ldang ba yis/ /ma zhu'i gnas su zhugs gyur pa/ /lhan cig gnas nas rtsa sgo bkag /zhu ba'i gnas nas me drod ni/ /phyi rol du ni 'byin par byed/ /de dang lhan sbug mngon khyab nas/ /lus kun tsha bar byed pa yin/ /yan lag shin tu tsha byed pas/ /rims ni de yis skyed par byed/ /rtsa sgo bkag pas de 'og tu/ /rngul ni mang du mi 'byung ngo / /de yi ④sngon tshul sgyid zhan dang / /nyams mi dga' zhing lus phyi la/ / ro mi ⑤tshor zhing yi ga 'chus/ /glal 'byung mig 'khrugs dumachi mar bcas/ /yan lag na zhing 'ju stobs chung / /nyam ⑦chung gnyid ni che ba dang / /sru ldang bya rmyang ⑧byed 'dod dang / /byen pa'i nywa na lus snyom dang / /phan par bstan pa mi bzod khro/ /skyur ⑨dang tsha dang drod la sred⑩/ /kha zas mngar ba ⑪la mi dga' / /byis pa la sdang skom dad che/ /sgra me grang lhags rlung dang chu/ /grib ma nyin ⑫mtshan rgyu med par/ /dga' dang mi dga' dag tu byed/ /de rjes rims ni gsal bar 'gyur/ /rims thebs 'byang ⑫nye'i tshe nad tshabs⑫/ /chung zhing tsha ba mi snyoms la/ /yan lag de dang der 'pho zhing / /na ba de dang der g.yo ⑫'gyur/ /rkang pa be+ems po rengs pa dang / /byen snying na 111—349

zhing ngal ba dang / /tshigs rnams bye ba lta bur sems①/ /brla dang rked pa na ba dang / /rgyab ni brdungs pa ltar sems dang / /lto ba btsir ba snyam sems dang / /rus pa bcad ④pa snyam pa dang / /rtsib ma lhag par na ba dang //snying ni btsir snyam sems shing zug /brang du btsugs pa lta bur gzer/ /phrag pa brdungs snyam dpung pa ni/ /bcom snyam sems shing sgrog rus na/ /'gram pas kha zas bldad ④mi nus/ /glal 'byung rna ba sgra dang bcas/ /mur 'gram zug cing mgo bo na/ /lce yis ro ni mi tshor ramadu/ /yang na kha bska bro bar 'gyur/ /dri ma rnams ni sri ba ⑤dang / /lpags rjomig kha dang sen mo dang / /bshang sogs rtsub ⑦cing dmar ba dang / /mchil mang ⑧yi ga 'chus sred ⑨chung / /zas mi 'ju zhing rngul mi 'byung / /gnyid yar mchu dang gre ba skam—/ /skom dad che zhing lud pa skam⑩/ /lud pa lu zhing skyugs pa skam⑪/ /sems zhum lus kyi ba spu ldang / /pags pa so dag brtse ()ba dang / /rkang (gelag 'dar zhing sprid pa thogs/ /mgo 'khor tshig ni bla ④ba dang / /drod bag la dga' bya rmyang skebyed/ /rlung gi rims su shes par bya/ /lus kun cig car khyab pa dang / /bla ⑫zhing kha'i ro kha ba dang / /bsil 'dod kha snar thor bu 'byung / /mgo 'khor brgyal myos snying mi dga'/ /bshang sla mkhris pa slon ⑩pa dang / /mchil ma khrag bcas sgregs pa sgyuraspyo/ /thor bu dmar po 'byung ba dang / /pags pa la stsogs ser rtsa sngo/ /rngul 'byung dbugs ni mnam pa dang / /skom dad rab che mkhris pa'i rims/ /lhag par yi ga 'chus shing rmongs—/ /bu ga 'gags shing /tsu6rims shugs dal/ /mchil mang kha nang mngar ḍa ba bro/ /dang ga lci zhing ( sgodabugs mi bde/ /cham btab snying na skyug 111 350

byed—— byed — byedapa 'byung / /lud pa lus rengs lpags stsogs 1skya/ /yan lag thor bu grang mo 'byung / /snyom zhing lus 'dar bad kan rims/ /rang gi dus su thams cad ni/ /'byung zhing 'phel ba nyid 'gyur snye)ba/ /nad gzhir bshad pa'i mi mthun bsten/ /bsgyur bas bde bar byed pa yin/ /rang rang mtshan ma 'dres pa ni/ /ldan pa'i rims yin gzhan yang ni/ /mgo na brgyal slon lus tsha rmongs bag 'gyur/ /gre ba kha skam 1mi dga' rus tshigs na/ /gnyid mid ( mgo 'khor spu ldang skom dad che/ /kha glal tshig mang tsorlung mkhris 'dres pa'i rimasaske/ /tsha med yi ga ( —'chus shing klad tshigs na/ /cham pa lud pa dbugs mi bde bshang sri/ /khong bsil rmongs 7bag rab rib mgo 'khor rmya(kye//bad kan rlung 'dres rims kyi mtshan ma yin/ /lus sgo rngul rengs dang tsha bsil sor mi gnas/ /skom dad lud pa bad kan mkhris bag 'byung / /rmongs bag rmya ⑪dang kha bro khar 6nyedri chags/ /bad kan mkhris pa 'dres pa'i rims kyi rtags/ /kun nas 'byung ba rtags kun ldan/ /'dir yang thang ri ⑪tsha ba ldang / /de bzhin grang nyenyedang nyin mo ni/ /gnyid che mtshan mo gnyid med byung skeb 'am/ /rtag par gnyid 'ong ba 'am yang na 7yar/ /rngul cher 'byung ba'am 7rngul mi 'byung / /glu dang gar dang dgod 7stsogs pa/ /spyod pa ngan pa la 'jug cing / /mig dmar mchi ma 'dzag dang bcas/ /zhum zhing rdzi 1shem 'khrugs par snang / /byin snying rtsib logs /1—na ba dang / /mgo bo rus tshigs na mgo 'khor/ /rna ba sgra dang nad dang bcas/ /mgul pa gra mas gang snyam sems/ /lce rtsub kun nas bsregs ltar snang / /lus lci tshigs ni 'bye snyam sems/ /mchil mar khrag mkhris bad kan 'byung / /mgo bo g.yo 7/1 35/

—byedabyed—————byed— —— —byed——————zhing skom dad che/ /thor bu 'brum phran mtha' 'khor la/) / /dmar zhing gnag pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /snying na bshang gci sri ba 'am/ /yang na nyung ba'am rab mang 'byung / /kha nang snum zhing nyams stobs chung / /gcom /na chung 'gyur zhing bla sneb dang / /nad smin dga' zhing rmugs pa dang / /rgyun tu gre ba 'dzer ba ni/ /'dus pa'i rims te mngon rmugs byed/ /de ni mdangs 'phrog ces kyang bshad/ /nad kyis bkag cing me drod nyams/ /mtshan ma thams cad rdzogs gyur pa④/ /gsor mi rung te (pede las gzhan/ /gso dka' 'am dbang po ma tshang 'gyur/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa las byung ba/ /gang du mkhyes pa logs shig gnas/ /pags pa'am nang gol tsha ba dag /'debs pa'am tsha ba snga phyis (6)'byung / /de bzhin bad kan rlung grang ba/ /de gnyid tsha snga 7gso dka' yin/ / grang snga der lani mkhris pa yis/ /bad kan gsher ba skam (ḍa7pa dang / /grang ba zhi byas kha skyur brgyal/ /myos dang skom dad skye ⑫bar 'gyur/ /tsha ba snga ma ⑪de rjes la/ /rmugs slon mchil mang khong 7snyom 'gyur/ /glo bur drag shul las byung dang / /mngon zin byad byas dmod byung mabazhi/ /de la smas bcad mes sketshig stsogs/ /ngal ba drag shul las byung yin/ /de ni phal cher rlung nad kyis/ /khrag ni gnod cing 'khrugs byas pas/ /na bcas mdog nyams skrang 7dang bcas/ /zug gzer bcas pa'i rims skyed 'gyur/ /gdon zhugs sman gyi dri dang dug /khros 'jigs mya ngan gdon /7las byung / /mngon par zin las byung rims yin/ /'dir gdon rgyu med dgod 7cing ngu / /sman gyi dri bskyed 1 brgyal ba dang / /m+bid pa glad /1 nad skrangs par 'gyur/ /dug las brgyal dang tshad par 'khru/ /771 352

mdog nag lus tsha ①snying nad 'byung ②/ /khros pas ①lus 'dar glad dund 'gyur / /mya ngan 'jigs las bla ⑤bar 'gyur/ /'dod las mgo 'khor yid 'chus tsha/ /ngo tsha gnyid blo brtan nyams 'gyur/ /gdon la sogs pa du'adus pa'i rims/ / 'jig tshogs gsum ni ⑦rlung gi rims/ /khro las mkhris pa ldang bar 'gyur/ /dmod pa byad ⑧byas las byung gang / /'dus pa'i rims ni mi bzad pa/ /de ni shin tu bzod dkar bshad/ /de la byad byas sngags kyis ni/ /sbyin sreg byas pa bzhin du byas⑨/ /thog mar sems 'bab de 'og lus/ /de nas thor bu mgo 'khor skom/ /tsha bcas brgyal ⑩bas zin gyur pa'i⑩/ /rims ni nyin re bzhin du 'phel/ /de ltar rims ni brgyad du bcas⑫/ /de dag mdor na rnam ⑫gnyis te/ /lus dang sems kyi rims dang ni/ /grang dang tsha dang ④phyi nang gnas/ /rang bzhin dang ni gyur pa dang / /gsor rung gsor mi rung ba dang / /smin dang ma smin zhes bya'o/ /lus rims thog mar lus tsha byed/ /sems kyi dang por ⑫snying tsha 'gyur/ /rlung dang bad kan cig car ni/ /'byung tshe grang ba'i rims su 'gyur/ /mkhris pa dang ldan tsha ba ste/ /'dres pas ⑩'dres pa'o nad gnas pa/ /rims nad dkyel ni bskyed 'gyur nas/ /nang na na ⑩zhing bshang gci sri/ /phyi rol rims ni tsha ba dang / /phyi rol gnas pa gso bar sla/ /dbyar dang ston dang dpyid dus su/ /rlung stsogs rim ⑫'byung rang bzhin rims/ /gzhan du gyur pa de gso dka'/ /phal cher rlung ni rang bzhin rims/ /yin yang gso bar dka' ba yin/ /dbyar dus rlung nad ldang 'gyur na/ /mkhris pa bad kan ldan rims 'gyur/ /ston ka mkhris pas spyond slong ste/ /bad 111—353

— — — ——————————— —byed—— — ——— — ——— ————————kan de yi grogs byed 'gyur/ /der ni smyung 1ba byas gyur kyang / /gnod par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /bad kan dpyid ldang de yang ni/ /de rjes rlung dang mkhris pa 'byung / /nyams stobs che zhing nad tshabs 2pechung / / bla brnan — med rims gso bar sla/ /rnam 4kun 'gyur ba zhes bya bar/ /gsor mi rung ba sngar bshad do/ /rims kyi 5nad tshabs che zhing tsha/ /khong rmya nyam chung gcin mang dang / /bshang sri 7/kha zas mi 'ju la/ /bkres chung ma smin rims mtshan nyid/ /rims shugs stobs che skom dad che/ /bla zhing mgo 'khor dbugs mi bde/ /bshang gci bder 'byung nad bskyod pa/ /smin par 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma yin/ /ma smin go bzlog mtshan nyid dang / /zhag bdun smyung byas las 8smin bshad/ /rims ni nad kyi dus dang ni/ /stobs chung che las rnam shelngar bshad/ /phal cher 'dus par gyur pa yi/ /rims su mang du 'gyur bar bshad/ /rgyun dang rtag pa nyin gcig pa/ /nyin gsum pa dang nyin bzhi pa'o/ /lus zungs bshang gci rgyu ba yi/ /bu ga nad kyis khyab byas pas/ ri/ /lus kun tsha bar gyur nas ni/ /gnod bya 6spestsogs dang mnyam par 'phel/ /stobs che lus lci rkang lag rengs/ /khyad par du ni dwangs mar gnas—/ /gnyen pos bcos dka' bzod par dka'/ /rgyun gyi rims su 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi drod kyis 7dri ma dang / /lus zungs myur du zad par byed—/ /de 'og rnam kun lus zungs 7stsogs/ /dag pa'am ma dag rims kyis ni/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan zhag /bdun nam bcu 'am bcu gnyis gnas/ /phal cher mtshams las mi 'da' bar/ /'tsho ba'am 'chi ba dag tu byed/ /de skad me bzhin 'jug gis bshad/ /ljang sngon gyis ni bshad /77 354

pa'i gzhung / /bdun pa nyis bldab ①gyur pa yin/ /de bzhin dgu dang bcu gcig bldab②/ /'di ni nad gzhi gsum gyis ①tshigs/ /'tsho dang 'chi bar byed pa yin/ /rims dus dag dang ma dag las/ /yun rings dus su dhiganas pa yin/ /nad rtse zhil ba nyam chung dang / /kha zas mi 'phrod stsogs bsten pas/ /nad dkyel chung yang gnod bya ⑤stsogs/ /brten te stobs che nyid gyur las/ /gnyen por bcas shing 'phel 'bri duganas/ /mi bzad pa ni nyid du 'gyur/ /de rnams kyis ⑦ni nad kyi stobs/ /rang gi dus su rims stobs skyed⑧/ /slar yang de dag bcos thabs kyis/ /stobs che chung las ldog par byed/ /nad zad rims ni phrar ⑨gyur pa/ /bcud la sogs pa nyid la thim/ /thim pas lus rid sha mdog nyams⑨/ /rmongs bag la sogs de yis skyed⑪/ /nye zhing kha ni bye ba'i phyir/ /dwangs ma rgyu ba'i rtsa sgo las/ /lus ⑫kun myur du khyab pa ni/ /nad kyis skye bar byed pa yin/ /des na rgyun tu rtag rims 'gyur⑫/ /de las bzlog pa tshul mi 'dra/ /mi snyems rtsol ba mi mnyam pa⑫/ /bya ba'i dus min ⑫mnyam yun ring / / de ni nyin mtshan lan gnyis ldang / /gzhan dag nyin re lan re yin/ /⑩phal cher nad ni khrag la brten—/ /rtag pa'i rims ni byed par 'gyur/ /de yang nyin mtshan lan gnyis ldang / /nyin gcig nyin re lan re ldang / /de ni sha yi rtsa la brten/ /gsum pa tshil gyi rtsa la gnas/ /mkhris pa rlung gnyis spyi nas 'dzin/ /bad kan mkhris gyur ⑩sum mdo na/ /rlung dang bad kan rgyab nas 'dzin/ /de ni zhag gcig gis chod yin/ /nyin bzhi pa'i ⑫rims nad tshil dang / /rkang dang rus pa'i nad na gnas/ /gzhan dag tshil nyid la gnas zer/ /de yi 111—355

nus pa bstan pa ni/ /bad kan gyis ni byen gnyis na/ /rlung gis glad ①pa na bar byed/ /rus rkang gnyis kar zhugs pa yin②/ /nyin bzhi pa ni go bzlog pa'o/ /nyin gsum pas ni nyin gnyis na/ /nyin cig ①na bar mi byed do / /nad rnams kyi ni stobs che chung / /zas dang spyod pa las 'byung ④zhing //de bzhin rims rnams 'byung ba ni/ /yid dang las las skye bar 'gyur/ /nad kyis lus zungs dkrugs gyur pa/ /nad sos nyi tshe zhu bar 'gyur/ /de tshe nad pa dbugs drag rngul/ /mkhun ⑤zhing slon byed 'gre dhib dang / /lus 'dar tshig mang tsha ba dang / /lus grang ⑦bzhin mdog nyams pa dang / /dran stor rims kyi ⑧shugs kyis gzir/ /khros pa'i tshul gyis lta ba dang / /bshang ba nad dang sgrar ⑨bcas pa/ /sla ba shugs drag 'byung ba yin/ /lus ni yang zhing rmya dang rmongs bag tsha ba med/ /kha na thor bu 'byung dang dbang po brtas shing bde/ /yid ni sor gnas rngul sprid bder 'byung yi ga 'byed/ /mgo bo g.ya' ba rims nad 'byang ba'i mtshan ma yin / /⑩yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas khrag dang mkhris pa ⑪dang lud pa'i nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /rab dro rab rno tsha dang sgyur/ /lan tshwa la sogs tsha ba dang / /khro rgod ut+pa la ⑫yi zas/ /de bcas shin tu bsten drags dang / /mkhris pa can gyi ⑫mkhris nad ni/ /gsher dang khrag rgyas nad du 'gyur/ /de ni phan tshun 'dres gyur pas / /lus kun khyab par byed par 'gyur/ /mkhris pa khrag las gyur pa dang / /'dres dang gnod bya las dang gcig /mdog dang dri ni rjes mthun 111—356

pas—/ /khrag gi ming du bstan pa yin/ /de ni khrag gnas mchin pa dang / /mcher pa las ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mgo bo lci zhing yi ga 'chus/ /bsil 'dod sgregs ①pa dud can sgyur/ /skyug cing sgyugs mdog btsog (gepar snang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde mgo 'khor/ /khong snyom — /khrag dmar nya dri bro/ /kha dri mi zhim skad 'gags la/ /mig la stsogs pa'i kha dog ni/ /dmar dang ljang dang ser por snang / /rmi lam du yang kha dog de/ /'dir ni mthong bar 'gyur ba yin/ /stod ④du sna mig rna ba kha/ /smad du bshang sgo pho mo'i mtshan/ /ba spu'i bu ga kun las kyang / /khrag rab rgyas pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /stod kyi bad kan yin gso be+e/ /de ni bkru sman btang bas gso/ /sman mang yod cing mkhris pa yi/ /sman gyi mchog ni bkru sman yin/ /zla la yod pa'i bad kan yang / /der ni de yis sbyangs byas 'gyur/ /de la sman ni mngar dang bska—/ /bad kan dag la phan pa la/ /gang gtogs ⑤ngang gis bad kan sel/ /kha dang bska ba smos ci dgos/ /thur du 'byung ba'i rlung yin phyir/ /de ni skyug sman btang bas gso/ /mkhris pa'i sman ni nyung ba yin/ /skyug sman mkhris pa'i sman mchog yin/ /zla ke la yod pa'i rlung nad kyang / /de ni de yis zhi mi 'gyur/ /de la ro ni mngar bskol geb/ /'ba' zhig phan par 'gyur ba yin/ /bad kan rlung ni 'dres pa'i nad/ /gnyi gar 'byung ba gso dka' ste/ /bzlog pa'i thabs ni med phyir dang / /sman yang yod pa ma yin no—/ /'di las bzlog par bya ba'i thabs/ / sbyang ba'ang (8yod pa ma yin te/ /sbyangs pas bzlog par bya ba dag /sman pas khrag mkhris gso ba yin/ / mkhris pa (nye bar zhi ba yang / /'di las 7yong ye yod ma yin/ /'dres par 111 ——357

gyur pa'i nad la ni/ /thams cad sel ba'i ①zhi bya phan/ /de la nad dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /gtar ga btab ste brtag par bya/ /④bla brnan byung ③bar gyur pa dag /'gyur bar shes las rtogs par bya/ /④de la lud pa myur ⑤gnod byed/ /de phyir de nyid bshad par bya/ /lud pa rlung mkhris bad kan dang / / glo rdol glo gcong la lngar rjobashad/ /thams cad ma gsos zad byed 'gyur—/ /phyi ma bzhin du stobs chen yin/ /de rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rtags/ /gre ba g.ya' zhing yi ga 'chus/ /gre nang gra mas gang snyam sems//de la thur rgyu'i rlung gnod 'gyur/ /stod du song ste brang du phyin/ /de tshe mgul pa'i nad du zhen/ /mgo ba'i rtsa rnams bkang nas ni/ /de nas yan lag 'degs pa ltar/ /g.yengs byed mig rdol ⑦tsam du na/ /rgyab brang rtsib logs na zhing zug /kha ru 'byung zhing rgyu ba ni/ /lud ⑧pa snod chag 'dra'i ⑨sgra 'byung / /nad gzhi'i ⑩dbye bas nad kyang ni/ /tha dad shugs dang bcas pa yin/ /nad gang sgra ni mi snyoms ⑪pa'i/ /de las lud pa 'byung ba yin/ /rlung nad skyes pa rlung 'khrugs pa/ /brang dang gre ba kha skam zhing ⑫/ /snying brang rtsib logs klad pa gzer/ /rmongs ⑫bag khong 'khrugs skad 'gags shing / /lud pa skam ④po 'byung byed cing / /na ba'i shugs drag sgra cher 'byung / /lus kun brtse bcas ⑫bad kan skam/ /'thon ⑩par dka' zhing nyung ngu 'byung //mkhris pas mig dang bad kan ser/ /kha nang kha zhing rims mgo 'khor/ /khrag mkhris slon zhing skom dad che/ /skad 'gags dud 'dra skyur ba dang / /lud pa'i shugs kyi rgyun 'byung ba/ /skar mda' 'phro ba lta bur snang / /bad kan las brang nad ⑩tshabs chung / /mgo lci snying ga gang snyam sems/ /gre bar 111—358

— — — — — byed—bskus 'dra snyom 1 par byed/ /cham 'debs zas skyug yi ga 'chus/ /spu rtse lud pa skam na pa dang / /snum zhing dkar ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /stobs 'gyed la sogs drag shul rnams/ /mi nus bzhin byas de dang des/ /rlung gis brang nang glo dral la/ /mkhris pa rjes 'brangs dkyel gyur pa/ /'khrugs te lud pa lu bar byed/ /de ni bad kan khrag bcas dang / /ser zhing gnag la skam 5)pa dang / /ril ril por mnam mang du 'byung / /'byung tshe gre ba na ba dang / /brang ni dral —ba snyam du sems/ /khab ni rnon pos phug snyam sems/ /gzer gyis 'debs par byed pa dang / /tshigs 'bye rims dang dbugs mi bde/ /skad 'gags lus 'dar skom dad che/ /phug ron lta bur mkhun she'abyin to/ /rtsib logs gzer 'gyur de nas ni/ / rim gyis ⑨stobs dang me drod dang / /nus pa nyams ni 'bri bar 'gyur/ /zad 1byed kyis gcin khrag dang bcas/ /rgyab dang rkang pa na bar bla7'gyur/ /gtso bo 6sperlung ni 'khrugs pa yis/ /lus zungs zad byed nad rgyal po1snye/ /glo gcong gi 6geni gnas byed cing / /lud pa lu zhing bad kan 'byung / /rnag 'dra (shemanam zhing ser ba dang / /rul 10zhing rtsa sngo dmar ba dang / /rtsib logs bton pa ltar sems shing / /snying ni ldung ba snyam du byed/ /rgyu med dro dang grang ba 'dod/ /zas mang za zhing nyams stobs zad/ /bzhin ni sgrum zhing dang bar snang / /mig ni mdang ldan blta 1 sdug 'gyur/ /de nas de las /1 zad byed 'gyur1ge/ /thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de ltar glo rdol ṇa —las byung lud/ /nyam chung lus ni 'jig 1byed de/ /stobs ldan gso ba brtsam dedu rung / /glo gcong las byung de dang 'dra/ //// 35 9

de gnyis gsar byung ①mgon ldan 'grub/ /nad gzhi tha dad gsum gsor rung / /gnyis 'dres kun kyang rgan po ni/ /na tshod zad btab 'tsho ba tsam—/ /lud pa yal bar bor ba las/ /dbugs mi bde dang zad byed slon—/ /skad 'gags la sogs nad 'byung 'gyur/ /de phyir de ni myur du gso / /sneyan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas dbugs mi bde ba dang skyigs bus btab pa'i nad gzhi bshad par bya'oske/ /lud pa 'phel ba'am sngar nad gzhi/ /'khrugs las ①dbugs mi bde 'byung 'gyur/ /ma zhu tshad 'khru slon dug 'thungs/ /skya rbab rims btab las kyang 'byung / /phran tshegs mun can chad pa dang / /chen po gyen 'byung rnam pa lnga/ /bad kan gyis ni rgyu lam bkag /rlung ni sna tshogs khyab par gnas/ /srog dang zas skom rgyu ba'i lam/ /sbu gu nad kyis bkag pas na//ma zhu'i gnas nas 'byung ba'i dbugs/ /brang gnas dbugs mi bde bar byed//de yi sngon rjotshul snying rtsib logs/ /gzer zhing srog rlung mi mthun rgyu/ /sbos dang mur 'gram na ba yin/ /des ni drag shul 'grangs ⑤drags pas/ /bskyod pa'i rngam pa phran tshegs 'gyur/ /de ni rang nyid zhi bar 'gyur/ /rlung gis rtsa sbubs logs rgyu byed/ /bad kan slongs par gyur nas ni/ /klad pa rjomagul ba'i nang song ste/ /brang dang rtsib logs na bar byed/ /lud pa ⑦ngar sgra 'dzer mi dran/ /cham pa mi bzad yi ga 'chus/ /mi bzad shugs ni skyed byed cing / /dbugs mi bde ba de'i ⑧shugs kyis/ /srog la gnod 'gyur 111—360

lud pa'i mthar/ /skad cig bde bar ①byed pa yin/ /nyal tshe shin tu mi bde la| /'dug na cung zad bde bar 'gyur/ /mig gdangs 'phral ⑤ba'i phyogs nas ni/ /rngul 'dzag shin tu na bas nyen/ /kha skam dbugs ni bstud ④mar 'byung / /dro ba 'dod cing 'dar dang bcas/ /char 'bab rjograng dang ser bus phog /bad kan bskyed pas rnam par 'phel/ /mun can de ni 'tsho bya tsam⑤/ /nyams ldan gsar du btab gso sla/ /rims dang brgyal las byung grang ba'i/ /sman gyis zhi ste durab mun can/ /dbugs 'chad dbugs 'byin rgyun chad pa'i/ /gnad ⑦gcod nad kyis gzir bar byed/ /rngul bcas brgyal dang spos dang bcas/ /lgang pa tsha zhing gcin 'gags ⑧byed/ /mig mi sdug cing thur du lta⑨/ /mig gcig dmar zhing dran pa stor/ /kha skam ⑩smre zhing skad gdangs ⑪dma'/ /gzim dngas nyams shing sems bral ba'o/ /chen po nga ro cher 'byung zhing / /sgra che sdur pa drag pa dang / /bskyod pa bzhin du 'byung 'gyur zhing / /khyu mchog rgyags pa'i nga ro 'dra/ /shes dang rnam ⑩shes rab nyams shing / /mig 'khrul ⑫bzhin ni 'gyur ba dang / /ro stod zhum par 'gyur ba dang / /bshang gci 'gags shing skad gsang nyams/ /mgul skam ⑫yang dang yang mi dran/ /rna ba mur 'gram klad pa ⑫na/ /gyen 'byung dbugs ni ring du 'byin/ /slar ni thur du rngub mi nus/ /bad kan gyis kha rtsa sgo 'gags⑩/ /rlung ni 'khrugs pas gzir 'gyur ba⑩/ /gyen du blta zhing 'khrul byed pas/ /mig ni kun tu lta byed pa/ /gnad ()rnams 'chad par byed bzhin du/ /skad 'gags smre sngags 'don par byed/ /'di dag ma tshang gsor rung la/ /tshang na nges par srog ⑪'phrog byed/ /111—361

dbugs mi bde rgyu sngon tshul dang / /grangs dang rang bzhin rten gcig ①yin/ /skyigs bu zas byung /snyephran tshegs dang / /zung dang chen por 'byung ba dang / / za ba dag dang rnam pa lnga/ /de la rlung gis ring ④zos dang / /rtsub tsha sra dang ma goms pa'i/ /zas dang skom gyis btsir gyur pa'i/ /rlung gis ⑤skyigs bu nad med dang ( )/ /sgra mi grag ⑦cing sprid 'byung ste/ /gang zhig goms pa'i zas skom gyis/ /zhi 'gyur skyigs bu zas byung 5yin/ /drag shul gyis rlung cung zad bskyod/ /skyigs bu phra mo 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nam tshong rtsa ba nas 'byung byed/ /de ni shul spyo dal 'jam pa yin/ /rtsol ba drag po tu )'phel 'gyur la/ /zas zos tsam gyis dal bar 'gyur/ /zung 'byung ⑪tshigs ni ring ba la/ /gang zhig zas las 'byung 'gyur ba⑫/ /'ju bar nye ba'i ⑫tshe na 'debs/ /zas zhu zin nas 'phel 'gyur ba'o/ /mgo dang mgul pa 'dar byed cing / /sgo dang spyoshin tu skom spyodad skyed/ /bla ⑩dang slon dang tshad par 'khru/ /mig gdangs glal ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /skyigs bu zung 'byung shugs drag la/ /zhu dang bcas par de shes bya/ /skyigs bu chen po 'byung ba'i tshul/ /smin ma mur 'gram gnyis rengs shing / /mig nas spyomachi 'dzag har bar ltatsho5/ /lus rengs tshig ni thogs byed cing / /dran dang 'du shes 'khrul par byed/ / mid pa'am //7)sbubs ni 'gags byed cing / /gnad kyi tshogs ni ḍa 7skyod par byed/ /rgyab sgu 0lus ni khong skem byed/ /rtsa ba che ( nyezhing sgra che la/ /nad tshabs che zhing stobs cher 'byung ḍa she/ /zhu ba'i gnas sam lte 'og nas / /snga ma 'dra bar gang zhig 'byung / /de 'dra'i tshul ni bstud mar 'byung / /glal dang rkang lag bya rmyang byed/ /brag ca zab 'byung zab mo'o / /de rnams 111 362

las ni dang po yi/ /gnyis po gso bar bya ba yin/ /tha ma ①gnyis dang zung 'byung ba/ /mtshan nyid kun rdzogs shugs drag spang / /'di dag thams cad yun rings ②bsags/ /rgad ①po bud med kyis dub dang / /nad kyis nyam chung zas bcad pa/ /glo rdol rjond can spang bar bya/ /nad kun gyis 'chi byed mod kyi/ /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba ltar/ /nad gzhan myur du gsod mi byed/ /'di dag 'chi tshe nges 'byung 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las / nad gzhi'i ⑤gnas kyi le'u bzhi pa'o// //de nas glo gcong chen po zad byed kyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /nad ni du ma rjes 'brang zhing / /nad mang sngon du 'gro 'gyur la/ /rgyal po zad byed skem dubyed dang / /nad kyi rgyal po zhes kyang bshad/ /rgyu skar rnams dang bram ze yi/ /rgyal po'i gcong du sngon gyur cing ⑦/ /gang yang nad kyi rgyal por 'gyur| /de phyir gnod pa'i rgyal por bshad/ /lus dang sman ni zad byed cing / /zad las 'byung ⑧bas zad byed yin/ /dwangs ⑨stsogs skems pas skem byed yin/ /de rnams de las tukyegasal bas rgyal/ /drag shul bsten ⑪dang shugs bkag dang / /khu chu dwangs ma snum zad dang / /zas skom cho ga dang bral bsten/ /bzhi po 'di dag de yi rgyu/ /de yis rlung dang mkhris pa dang / /bad kan bslangs nas thams cad du/ /lus kyi tshigs kun la zhugs te / /de yis rtsa sgo la gnod cing / /bu ga'i sgo ni bkag pa 'am⑫/ /yang na shin tu kha bye 'gyur/ /stod smad thad kar gnas nas ni/ /rang gi nad ni ji bzhin skyed/ /de 'byung 'gyur ba'i sngon tshul ni/ /cham 'debs sprud pa 111—363

byed—————— —— ——byed ——— —byedabyed——shin tu mang / /mchil ma kha nas 7)ro mngar bro/ /lus dang me drod nyam chung byed—/ /gzhong snod zas skom la sogs ni/ /gtsang yang mi gtsang nyid du mthong / /phal cher zas dang skom stsogs larte/ /sbrang ma skra dang rtsa —)stsogs 'bab—/ /snying 'phar slon bro yi ga 'chus/ /kha zas zos kyang nyams stobs zad / /lag par lta zhing rkang 4gdong skrang / /mig ni shin tu dkar por snang / /lag ngar dag ni 'jal bar 'dod/ /lus la 'jigs su rung bar mthong / /bud med chang dang sha la dga'/ /smod dang klad pa 'gebs 5/par byed—/ /skra dang sen mo shin tu 'phel/ /rmi lam du ni phye ma leb/ / rtsangs pa ( sasdig sbrul gcan gzan 3spre'u/ /bya rnams kyis ni gtses par mthong /skra rus phub ma thal stsogs kyi/ /phung po la ni 'dzegs sapa dang / /yul dang grong ni stong /9pa dang / /chu klung skams yipar rmi lam mthong / /skar mda' ri bo ltung ba dang / /ljon shing rnams ni 'bar ba rmi/ /stod du gnas na cham pas 'debs/ /lud pa lu zhing dbugs mi bde/ /phrag pa spyi bo na ba dang / /skad 'gags yi ga 'chus par 'gyur/ /smad gnas bshang be+e rtug skem byed/ /nang grol nang gnas 9/speslon par byed/ /thad kar gnas pas rtsib logs zug /tshigs la gnas na rims su 'gyur/ /de ltar nad tshul bcu gcig ni/ /gcong chen ldan las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de rnams kyi ni bla brnan 7dag /skad 'gags brang du na ba dang / /kha glal lus grugs mchil snabs mang / /drod nyams kha mnam yin shes bya/ /de la rlung gyur klad 7pa dang / /rtsib logs zug sha yan lag na/ /skad 'gags mgul pa subs par 'gyur/ /mkhris rgyas rkang 1 lag phrag pa tsha/ /tshad 'khru khrag tu slon 15pa dang / /kha 711 364

mnam rims 'debs myos par 'gyur/ /bad kan las gyur yi ga 'chus/ /slon lud lus dang yan lag lci/ /mchil snabs mang zhing cham pas ①'debs/ /dbugs mi bde skad 'gags drod nyams/ /nad kyi ④me drod nyam chung bas/ /'byar bcas bad kan rgyas gyur nas/ /rtsa sbubs sgo ni 'gags pa dang / /lus zungs drod ni chung 'gyur bas/ /dngas ma rang gi gnas su ni/ /ma zhu bla brnan ④de dang de/ /skyed cing sha stsogs mi 'gyur la/ /khrag ni gyen du 'byung bar byed/ /khong pa nyid du zas 'ju bas/ /dngas mar 'gyur bar mi byed cing ④/ /phal cher dri ma nyid 'gyur gyi/ /lus zungs 'phel bar mi byed do—/ /dngas ma khrag tu mi 'gyur na⑤/ /shar 'gyur ba lta smos ci dgos/ /zad 0byed can ni bshang 'phel ba/ /'ba' zhig gis ni gnas par byed/ /mtshan ma chung yang nyam chung zhing / /nad kyis ⑦sman gyi stobs mi bzod/ /spang bya de las gzhan pa ni/ /thams cad ldan yang gso bar bya/ /nad ni sna re ⑧'dus pa dang / /zad ⑨byed tshil las gyur pa drug /skad 'gags kyi ni dbye ⑩ba yin/ /de las ⑩rlung g.yo nyam chung rtsub/ /gre ba gra mas gang snyam byed—/ /de la snum dro 'o ma phan/ /mkhris pa las gyur rkan sgog tsha/ /skam zhing smra ⑫bar mi nus 'gyur/ /bad kan mgul pa byugs snyam byed/ /skad kyi gsang dma' ngar ngar 'dzer/ /thogs bcas 'gyur ro thams cad kyi/ /mtshan ma thams cad ldan pa yin/ /zad ⑫byed las ni drud snyam byed/ /du bas bdugs ltar shin tu na/ /tshil gyur ⑫bad kan bdag nyid can/ / tshig gi ⑫brda sprod mi nus 'gyur/ /'dir ni 'dus dang tha mar ⑩spang / /yi ga 'chus pa'i nad rnams ni/ /lce snying gnas pa so so dang / /'dus pa dang ni 111—365

yid kyi ni/ /gdung ba las gyur lnga pa yin/ /kha ni bska dang kha mngar bro/ /rlung stsogs gsum dang rim ①bzhin sbyar/ /kun las gyur pa ro bro med/ /mya ngan khro stsogs nad ji bzhin/ /slon bro nad gzhi sna ⑤re kun/ /mi sdug yul las byung —lnga pa/ /'di dag stod du rgyu ba'i rlung / /'khrugs pas nad rjoni thams cad phul/ /de rnams babe+engs na (snyekha tsha bro/ /mchil mang ④yi ga 'chus sngon byung ga/ /rlung gyur ⑧lte ba rgyab tu zug /rtsib logs na zhing zas slon nas/ /cung zad 'byung zhing chad pa dang / /ro bska lbu ba can du skyugasasti/ /sgregs pa'i sgra bcas mdog gnag la/ /sla zhing 'byung dka' sgra dang bcas/ /lud pa kha skam glad ⑩snying na/ /skad 'gags pa dang khong snyom ⑩bcas /mkhris gyur ⑫thal chu 'dra ba la/ /dud kha ljang ⑫sngon mdog ser skyug /khrag bcas ro sgyur tsha zhing bro④/ /skom dad brgyal tsha brdungs ⑫bcas yin/ /bad kan las byung snum bska ⑩bsil/ /nal nal bor 'dug dra ba ⑩ris/ /ro mngar lan tshwa bro tshabs che/ /chags shing ba spu brtse ⑫bar byed/ /gdong skrang ⑪kha nang mngar ba ( stebro/ /snyom zhing snying na lud pa can/ /gsum char las byung rtags kun ldan/ /'chi ltas las bshad gang de spang ⑪/ /rul dang mi gtsang btsog pa dang / /sgyugs 8shebro mthong dang thos stsogs kyis/ /yid gdung ⑫snying la phog gyur (steslon/ /mi sdug yul las byung ba yin/ /yid mi bde skom srin be'u snabs/ /rlung stsogs nyid la gnas par brtag /gzer dang 'phar dang snying na ba/ /bye brag tu ni srin bu'i nad/ /srin bu'i tsosnying nad mtshan ma las/ /de be+e shes par bya ba yin/ /snying nad nad ni re re 'dus/ /srin bu las gyur rnam lngar bshad/ /rlung gis shin tu zug cing na/ /gas dang gshags tsopa 111 —366

snyam du sems/ /bcom snyam sems shing skam la rengs/ /snying ga ①stong snyam zag par byed/ /rgyu med zhum zhing mi dga' la/ /'jigs shing dgra ni mi bzod cing ⑦/ /'phar zhing 'gre la gcus ④snyam byed/ /rmongs bag dbugs thung gnyid chung 'gyur/ /mkhris gyur snyom ④dang mgo 'khor brgyal/ /tsha rngul snying ga skyur lus snyom/ /mkhris pa skyur ba slon par byed/ /dud pa khar song ⑤ser rims 'debs/ /bad kan las byung snying ga rengs/ /khong na rdo bcug lta bur lci/ /drod nyams mchil mang lud pa lu/ /gnyid che snyom rjorims yi ga 'chus/ /nyes gsum mtshan nyid thams cad ldan/ /srin bus mig ni gnag pa dang / /mun par zhugs snyom ⑦byed snying 'phar/ /lus skam ⑧g.ya' zhing bad kan 'dzag /'di ni rtag tu sog le yis/ /snying la 'drud pa lta bur sems/ /mi bzad nad des myur gsod stipas/ /de ni rings par gso bar bya/ /skom dad rlung mkhris bad kan dang / /'dus pa dngas ma zad pa dang / /nad 'dres pa las drug tu 'gyur/ /de ltar gyur pa thams cad la/ /rlung mkhris gnyis ni rgyu yin te/ /de 'khrugs lus zungs bsil ba ni—/ /skams nas ldang bar 'gyur ba yin/ /lus kun 'dar zhing mgo 'khor tsha/ /skom dad khong tsha rmongs par byed/ /lce drud mgul pa glo ba dang / /skom dad skom 'thungs (rtergyu ba'i rtsa/ /skom pas skom dad skye bar 'gyuraske/ /de rnams kyi ni spyi'i mtshan nyid/ /kha skam skom gyis mi ngoms dang / /zas la mi dga' skad 'gags dang / /gre ba lce mchu rtsub mor 'gyur/ /byu 'byin byed cing khong snyom ⑪la/ /bla zhing sems ni myos pa dang / /de bzhin skom gdung ⑫nad du 'gyur/ /lus skams rmya zhing 'on pa dang / /rmongs bag 111—367

mgo 'khor snying nad de/ /'di lta bu yi nad rnams ni/ /skom pas gdungs las skye bar 'gyur/ /rlung 'gyur khong rmya nyam chung la/ /mur 'gram zug cing klad pa 'khor/ /sna lces dri dang ro mi tshor/ /'on zhing gnyid med nyams stobs zad/ /chu grang 'thungs na skom 'phel 'gyur/ /mkhris pa kha nang ro kha brgyal / /mngar ①por mthong zhing rtag par ni/ /kha skam khong tsha dbugs mnam pa'o/ /bad kan ldang bas ④skom rgyu'i rtsa/ /bkag pas rlung ni 'khrugs gyur nas/ /de tshe de yis bad kan ni/ /'dam bzhin de yis skem ①par byed/ /mgul pa gra mas gang snyam sems/ /gnyid che kha nang mngar bar ④broske/ /lto ba mgo bo tshor ba chung / /rmongs bag slon gyur yi ga 'chus/ /lus skam 5kha zas mi 'ju'o bu/ /kun las gyur pa rtags kun ldan/ /be'u ⑦snabs las gyur kha zas ni/ /mid dka' rlung mkhris las gyur yin/ /tsha bas ngal bas 'phral du na/ /chu grang bsten gyur skom dad che/ /khong par tsha ba bsdus pa yis/ / skom dad ④de ni mkhris skyes yin/ /gang yang chang drags me drod rno/ /snum zos skyes pa'ang ⑨mkhris 'byung yin/ /snum zhing skyur dang lan bo'i bag /zos pas bad kan las skyes 'gyur/ /zad ⑫byed las ni skom dad 'gyur/ /dngas ma zad dang mtshan nyid 'dra/ /khong skam gcin nad rims nad stsogs/ /yun rings nad di rims skom nad / /gang zhig skom dang mi bzad skyes/ /de ni 'dres las 'byung bar bshad / /1ṭ+wāṃyan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u lnga pa'o7// //111—368

de nas chang nad kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o①/ /rno dang drod che rtsub phra skyur / /nyal po 'dod myur byed dang yang / /gsal dang dang bar byed par bshadarka/ /mdangs ni 'di las go bzlog yin/ /dug kyang rno stsogs yin mod kyis④/ /sems la gnod par byed pa yin①/ /nus pas 'chi bar byed pas ④na/ /dug ni lhag par mthu che'o⑤/ /chang ni rno stsogs yon tan gyirjo/ /mdangs kyi yon tan rtul ⑦la stsogs/ /bcu po bcu yis 'khrugs byas nas/ /sems ni sgyur bar byed pa yin/ /ra ro dang po gnyis pa yis/ /bag med pa yi gnas la gnas/ /rnam rtog ngan bcom rmongs pa rnams/ /bde ba yin snyam sems par 'gyur/ /'bring dang chen po bar gyi tshe/ /rngul dang mun pa'i rang bzhin can/ /glang chen lcags kyu med pa ltar/ /rmongs pas mi bya ci yang med//'di ni kha na ma tho'i gnas/ /'di ni tshul khrims 'chal pa'i gzhi/ /'di gcig ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i lam/ /mang po ston par byed pa yin/ /ra ro gsum pa'i tshe na ni/ /sems med par ni ro ltar nyal/ /nyes pa'i bdag nyid shi ba las/ /shin tu ma rungs gnas skabs 'thob/ /chos dang chos min bde dang sdug /don dang don min phan dang gnod/ /gang la chags pa ⑧mi shes pa/ /de la ⑨mkhas pas ji ltar bsten/ /chang las myos 'jigs mya ngan dang / /khro dang srog dang bral ba nas⑩/ /smyo byed myos dang brgyal bar bcas⑪//brjed byed bcas pa ⑫kun song nad/ /gang du dran pa nyams gcig ⑫yod/ /der ni mi dge thams cad 'byung / /mi 'phrod zas ni zos pas kyang / /nad dam yang na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /chang ni sde tshan gsum blo ldan④/ /ngo tsha stsogs kyang 'jig ⑫par byed/ /nyams stobs ldan dang zas zos dang / /zas cher 111—369

za dang snum bag za/ /snying stobs lang tshor ①ldan pa dang ②/ /rtag tu chang 'thungs bu de'i rigs skyes/ /tshil dang bad kan shas che la/ /rlung dang mkhris pa rjoshas chung dang / /me drod che zhing brtan ⑤pa rnams/ /shas cher ra ror mi 'gyur ro/ /de las bzlog pa chang dad can/ /khros dang chang rtsub skyur shas che/ /ma zhur bcas dang mang du'athungs pa/ /gang yin shas cher ra ror 'gyur/ /rlung mkhris bad kan kun las byung ⑦/ /chang nad rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ro/ /kun kyang kun las skyes mod kyi/ /shas che ba las ming du btags—/ /de rnams kyi ni spyi mtshan nyid/ /rmongs dang snying ni na ba dang / /'khru zhing rtag tu skom dad che/ /tsha grang rims 'debs yi ga 'chus/ /mgo bo rtsib rus na dang 'dar/ /gnad 'jig ltag pa na ba dang / /brla rengs rab rib khyer ba dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde gnyid med/ /rngul cher 'byung zhing bshang ba 'gags/ / skrang zhing ⑧sems ni 'khrul pa dang / /bla stizhing slon par byed pa dang / /mgo 'khor rmi lam ngan ⑫mthong ba'o/ /rlung gyur khyad par gnyid mi 'ong / /dbugs mi bde zhing klad na 'dar/ /rmi lam du ni 'phyan zhing 'phur/ /gshin po rnams dang gtam smra rmi/ /mkhris pas ⑪lus tsha skad 'gags dang / /rmongs bag tshad ⑫'khru skom mgo 'khor/ /lus mdog ljang dang ser ba dang / /mig dang mkhur tshos dmar bar 'gyur/ /bad kan gyis slon snying na dang / /gnyid che grang 'dar yan lag lci/ /kun skyes mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /chang spangs pa las 'phral du ni/ /mang du 'thungs sam ⑫ma goms 'thungs⑫/ /de las 'joms dang lus skam nad/ /rlung las sdug bsngal ldan pa 'byung / / nyam chung ba la ⑫mchog tu 'byung / /111—370

byedabyed byedabyed —'joms pas bad kan mchil ma mang / /skog ma skams shing gnyid rab che/ /sgra drag mi bzod glong bag 'gyur/ / lud skam 3yan lag mgo rab na/ /snying nad 2/mgul nad rmongs bag dang / /lud pa skom dad slon rims 'debs//gang zhig chang rnams spangs pas ni/ /dbang po thul zhing brtags te byed/ /nam yang de la lus sems kyi/ /skyon rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rdul dang mun pa mi 'phrod zas/ /mchog tu bsten las nad gsum 'byung / /dwangs ma khrag dang sems rgyu ba'i/ /rtsa sbubs bkag pa las byung ba/ /myos dang brgyal dang kun song nad④/ /phyi ma bzhin du stobs rab che/ /'dir myos nad sna re re kun/ /khrag chang dug rnams las kyang 'byung / /rlung las gtam la 5)chags pa dang / /mang smra nyung smra spyod pa 'khrul/ /lus ni rtsub gnag dmar ba yi/ /myos pa rlung las skyes pa yin/ /mkhris pa las khro dmar ba dang / /ser por snang zhing rtsod la dga'/ /bad kan tshig nyung 'brel smra skya/ /sems las che zhing le lo che/ /'dus pa mtshan nyid kun dang ldan—/ /khrag las mig dang yan lag rengs/ /mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa yin / /chang gis yan lag skad bskyod 7/'gyur/ /dug gis 'dar zhing gnyid rab che/ /de ni kun las myos tshabs che/ /khrag stsogs pa yis rlung stsogs pa'i/ /mtshan nyid lhag par shes par bya/ /brgyal ba rlung gi bdag nyid can/ /nam mkha' dmar sngo gnag par ni/ /mthong zhing mun par zhugs snyam sems/ /myur du sangs par byed pa dang / /snying na 'dar zhing mgo 'khor la/ /skem zhing bzhin mdog dmar nag 'gyur/ /mkhris pas dmar ba'am ser por ni/ /nam mkha' mthong zhing mun 'thibs byed/ /

——— ——— — — —— ————————— — ————— ————— —sangs nas rdul dang bcas pa dang / /tsha skom gdungs pas nyen pa dang / /'khru zhing kha dog ser dang dmar/ /mig dmar ser bar snang bar 'gyur/ /bad kan gyis ni sprin lta bur/ /nam mkha' mthong zhing mun 'thibs byed/ /rings 1nas sangs par (2 'gyur ba dang / /snying na bcas pas mchil ma mang //pags pa rlon pas g.yogs pa bzhin/ /yan lag lci zhing tshor ba chung / /nyes pa gsum gyi ( mtshan kun ldan/ /brjed byed gnyis pa lta bu ste/ /myur du 'gyel zhing brgyal 'gyur la(pe/ /'jigs rung spyod pa med pa yin/ /lus can myos dang brgyal ba yis( // /nad la shugs yod (pegyur kyang ni/ /rang nyid zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /kun zhugs sman med par mi zhi/ /nad ni shin tu stobs che la/ /'dus pa las gyur kun zhugs pa/ /srog gi gnas lal brten pa yis/ /lus dang ngag yid kyipespyod pa 'phrog /de yis skyes bu ro dang ni—/ /shing dang rtsig pa 1'dra bar byed/ /rings par gso bar ma byas na/ /myur du 'chi bar byed pa yin/ /mtsho zab chu srin mang po can/ /chu 'jing 'jug ngogs med par ni/ /kun zhugs pa ni (stenub byed la⑩/ /mi ni myur du gdon 1 par bya/ /rigs pas brten dang bral ba'i chang 'thungs pas/ /myos dregs sakhro dang bral ba'i rang bzhin can/ /rang gi dgra bos yongs su 'khyud 'gyur 7zhing / /rigs dang mi rigs mnyam par byed par 'gyur/ /stobs dang dus dang yul dang goms pa dang / /rang bzhin grogs dang na tshod nad rnams ni3 / /legs brtags de dang rjes mthun gang zhig 'thung / /de ni bdud rtsi 'thungs 7dang mtshungs pa yin / /1sheyan lag brgyad pa'i snying po basbus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u drug pa'o// //

de nas gzhang 'brum kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /dgra ltar srog chags rnams kyi tshe/ /gzhang 'brum 'byung bas gsod byed pas/ /de phyir bshang ba'i lam 'gegs pas①/ /gzhang 'brum zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /nad kyis be+egs tshil ①sha rnams ni/ /gnod byas ①dbyebs ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /sha yi myu gu gzhang stsogs su/ /skyes de ④gzhang 'brum yin par bshad/ /lhan cig skyes dang phyis 'byung dang / /skam dang khrag tu 'dzag pa yi/ /dbye bas mdor na rnam gnyis yin/ /gzhang ni rgyu ma sbom por brten/ /sor ni phyed dang lnga yod do⑤/ /gnyer gsum sor ni phyed dang gnyis/ /rim pa de yi nang ma ni/ /phyir 'phul bar ma sel ba yin/ /de yi phyi rol 'dzum dhipa yin/ /de yi phyi rol sor gcig ⑦kha/ /nas ni phyed skedang gnyis kyi tshad/ /de phan chad ni spu skye 'gyur/ /de la lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu/ /gnyer ma'i sa bon gnod 'gyur nyid/ /gzhang 'brum sa bon gnod pa yang / /pha mas mi 'phrod ⑨zos pa dang / /sngon las de gnyis dang 'dus pa/ /'khrugs pa las gyur de dag ni/ /gsor mi rung ba nyid du bshad/ /rigs 'byung nad kun de dang 'dra—/ /lhan cig skyes pa khyad par du/ /rtsub cing brta bar ⑩dka' ba dang //nang du kha bltas dkar ba dang / /bla brnan ⑪mi bzod can gso dka'/ /cig shos drug ste nad tha dad/ /'dres dang 'dus pa khrag las 'byung ⑫/ /rlung dang bad kan gnyis las skam/ /khrag dang mkhris pa las rlan can/ /nad rnams ldang rgyu sngar ⑫bshad pa/ /'khrugs pa ④de yis khong pa yi/ /me drod nyams shing bshang ba 'phel/ /gzhan yang nyal po rab drags dang / /111—373

gzhon pas khong dkrugs stan dag ni/ /ma snyoms sra dang tsog pur 'dug /'jam rtsi'i gce'u sa dang ni/ / rdo dang gos ①kyis drud pa dang / /shin tu grang ba'i chus bkrus dang / /rtag tu 'khru bar byed pa dang / /bshang dang gci dang 'phyen ②gyi shugs/ /bkag dang nan gyis btsir ba dang / /rims dang skran dang tshad par 'khru/ /'or nad skya rbab be snabs kyis/ /skems snebyas gnod par 'gyur ba yi/ /spyod pa bsten las 'byung bar ④'gyur/ /bud med zla grangs ma tshang 'phyil/ /zla ba rdzogs pas gzir las 'byung ⑤/ /de 'dra dag rjodang gzhan yang rlung / /thur sel dze+e'akhrugs pas dri ma ni/ /gzhang gi gnyer mar de gzhag pas/ /de ni mi mngon gyur pas ⑧gnas/ /gzhang 'brum 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi sngon tshul me drod nyams/ /brla ni rengs shing na ba dang / /byin pa'i nywa na mgo 'khor zhing / /yan lag na zhing mig gnyis skrang / /bshang ba 'khru ba'am yang ni ⑨sri/ /rlung chen nang nas ⑩'khyil ba dang / /phal cher lte ba'i 'og nas ⑩rgyu/ /nad bcas bcad pa lta bur sems/ / dka' bar ⑫'byung zhing sgra can ⑫'byung / /rgyu ma krul krul zer zhing sbos(ste/ /skem zhing gregs pa mang du 'byung / /gcin mang bshang nyung yi ga 'chus/ /sgregs pa dud 'drar skyur ba 'byung / /mgo dang brang dang rgyab tu gzer/ /snyom zhing kha dog nyams pa dang / /glong ⑫bag dbang po nyam chung la⑩/ /khro zhing bsnyen bkur dka' ⑩ba dang / /ma zhu skem nad skya rbab dang / /dmu rdzing rnams la som nyi skyes⑫/ /gzhang 'brum skye bar ⑪gyur pa la/ /'di dag nyid ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de yis 'og gi lam bkag pas/ /thur du sel ba'i rlang log ⑪ste/ /lus dang dbang po kun 111—374

gnas pa'i/ /rlung gzhan thams cad 'khrug 3par byed/ /de bzhin bshang gci mkhris pa dang / /bad kan lus zungs rten 1bcas pa/ / 'khrugs shing ( me drod nyams par byed/ /de nas gzhang 'brum nad can la/ /phal cher thams cad nyer 'byung ba/ /skem ④zhing mchog tu bskyod mi nus/ /stobs zad khong rmya bzhin mdangs nyams/ /lus 5)lhod snying po med 'gyur zhing / /'bus zos pa yi shing 'dra la/ /bla brnan ( )ma lus dag gis 'debs/ /ji skad bshad pa'i gnad gzir gzhing / /lud pa skam dang skad 'gags dang / /kha ro mi tshor cham 'debs 2sbo/ /sgyid sgyur rka ‘stelag na zhing slon/ /sprid pa skrang ⑩dang rims nad dang / /khu ba zad cing rab rib slon/ /rde'u chags nad kyis gzir ⑪ba dang / /skad 'gags zhum la sems khong chud/ /mchil ma mang 'dor yi ga 'chus/ /rus tshigs kun dang snying lte ba/ /gzhang dang sna rtsa gzir ⑫dang bcas/ /gzhang nang 'bru ni ma smin btsos/ /khu ba lta bu'i sbyin bag 'dzag /rtug skam sbyin pa'am /7sla bar 'gyur ⑩/ /smin dang ma smin bar bar 'khru/ /skya zhing ser dang sngon po yi/ /khrag ni sbyin bag 'khru ⑩bar 'gyuraske/ /gzhang 'brum rlung shas che las gyur/ /skam zhing tseg tseg tsha ba dang / /rnyid cing dmar nag rengs pa dang / /mi snyoms rtsub cing sra ba dang / /phan tshun mi 'dra yo ba dang / /rtse mo rno zhing gas pa dang / /bim pa rgya shug khardzu ra/ /ras bal sa bon dang 'dra zhing / /la la ka tam me tog 'dra/ /la la yungs kar lta bur skyesayi/ /mgo dang phrag pa rtsib logs brla/ /chu so dag tu lhag par na/ /sprud pa sgregs 1 pa bshang ba sri/ /snying 'phar yi ga 'chus pa ⑩skyed/ /lud dbugs mi bde me drod nyams/ /rna ba sgra bcas mgo

'khor byed/ /des nyes rtug skam nyung ngu ni/ /sgra bcas ska ①be+e 'dren ma dang / /na zhing sbra ②ba 'byar bag can/ /rtug skam tshul gyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /pags pa sen ①mo bshang gci dang / /mig dang gdong ni gnag par 'gyur/ /skran dang mcher pa dmu rdzing dang / /gtun rjo'adra de nyid las 'byung ⑤'gyur/ /mkhyes shas che las rtse mo ni/ /sngo zhing dmar ser dkar bar snang / /phra rjozhing dri mnam khrag sla 'dzag /srab cing 'jam la lhod pa yin/ /mcher pa'i dum bu ne+e tso'i ⑦lce/ /srin bu pad pa'i ⑧mchu 'drar snang / /tsha zhing gnag ⑨la rims dang rngul/ /skom dad yi ga 'chus rmongs skyed/ /bshang dro sla zhing sngo la tsha/ /ser zhing dmar bar 'khru bar 'gyur/ /nas rul nang 'dra pags pa dang / /sen stsogs sngo ser ljang bar 'gyur/ /bad kan shas che rtsa ba sbom//mthug cing nad kyi shugs dal dkar/ /skrang zhing rgyas la snum pa dang / /'greng zhing snum la phyi zhing brtan/ /'byar bag tshor ba chung zhing 'jam/ /g.ya' zhing reg na dga' bar byed/ /ka ri ra pa na sa yi/ /rus pa ba yi nu sor 'dra/ /chu sor zug cing sbo ⑩gzhang na/ /lte ba be+eng pa bcad snyam sems//lud pa dbugs mi bde snying na/ /mchil mang ⑪cham 'debs yi ga 'chus/ /gcin sri mgo bo tshor ba med/ /grang ba'i rims ni skyed par byed/ /kha chu 'dzag cing me drod nyams/ /slon zhing ma zhu'i nad kun skyed/ /bshang ba tshil 'dra bad kan mang / /'khru dang bcas par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'dzag par mi byed rdol mi byed/ /pags pa la sogs snum zhing dkar/ /'dres las mtshan nyid 'dres pa ⑫yin/ /'dus pa mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /khrag shas che las gzhang 'brum ni/ /mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid 'dra ba la/ /n+ya gro dha ⑫111—376
