yi myu gu 'dra/ /bye ①ru 'ol ma se mdog 'dra/ /shin tu tsha bro na ba dang / /bshang ba shugs kyis rab babyung las/ /'phral du khrag ni 'byung ba dang / /de nyid shin tu 'dzag par 'gyur/ /sbal pa 'dra zhing khrag zad las/ /byung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen 'gyura'/ /mdog stobs spro ba nyams pa dang / /mdangs 'phrog dbang po zhan par 'gyur/ /muṅga miko dra ba'i phye ma/ /tsa ④na ka ri ra stsogs pa/ /rtsub dang bshang ba sri bas rlung / /rang gnas 'khrugs pa stobs ldan pas/ /thur du rgyu ba'i bu ga ni/ /bkag ste smad du rab skams nasaske/ /bshang ba gci ba 'phyen rnams ni/ /'gags pas nad ni mi bzad skyed—/ /de yis khong pa rgyab rtsib logs/ /snying gar nad ni shin tu skyed/ /lto sbos gsus pa na ba dang / /snying gcus ⑤rgyu ma bcad snyam sems/ /chu sor shin tu zug pa dang / / mkhur bar skrang pa bu'abyung bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni gyen du ⑦song gyur na/ /de las slon rims yi ga 'chus/ /snying nad be'u snabs ma zhu dang / /gcin sri bshang ba 'khru ba dang / /'on (/stedang rab rib dbugs mi bde/ /mgo na lud pa cham pas ⑨'debs/ /yid kyis 'gyur ba skom dang khrag /mkhris pa skran dang dmu sprung ( kastsogs/ /rlung gi nad gtogs ⑪de dang de/ /shin tu mi bzad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gzhang 'brum gyen du 'khyel gyur pa/ /'di ni mchog tu gnod byed yin/ /rlung shas che ba'i khong par ni/ /de med par yang 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lhan cig skyes dang nad gsum ldan/ /phugs ma'i gnyer mar gang gnas pa/ /de dag gsor mi rung ba yin/ /me drod stobs che stsogs kyis 'tsho/ /'dres las gyur dang gnyer ma ni/ /bar mar gnas pa gang yin pa/ /lo gcig yan chad lon 111 377

gyur pa①/ /de dag gso dka' yin par bshad/ /phyi rol gnyer mar byung ba dang / /nad gcig shas che las byung dang / /skyes nas ring po ma lon gang / /gzhang 'brum de ni gso ba sla/ /pho mtshan stsogs kyi 'og nas ni/ /rang rang skabs ①bshad lte bar skyes/ /rta bla ba yi kha 'dra zhing / /'byar bag can la 'jam pa yin/ /①khyab byed kyis ni bad kan bsdus/ /pags pa'i phyi rol thor bur byed/ /mdzer rjopa 'dra zhing rtsub par gnas/ /pags pa'i mdzer ⑤pa yin par shes/ /rlung gis zug cing rtsub par 'gyur/ /mkhris pas gnag la dmar rtsar 'gyur/ /bad kan gyis de snum nyid dang / /rmen bu'i rjomadog dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /blo dang ldan pas myur bar ni/ /'bad de gzhang 'brum gso bar byed/ /de yis gzhang ni myur 'gags nas/ /dmu rdzing nad ni skye bar 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bdun pa'o// //de nas tshad pas ⑦'khru ba dang pho ba'i nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /nad gzhi sna re kun dang ni/ /'jigs dang mya ngan las gyur pa'i/ /tshad pas ⑧'khru ba rnam drug yin/ /de ni chu 'thungs drags pa dang / /sha rid sha skam ma goms pa'i/ /til gyi khu ba ma smin 'bru/ /chang rtsub kha zas tshod ma zin/ /gzhang 'brum snum bag drags pa dang / /'bu dang shugs ni bkag las 'byungalge//de 'dras rlung ni 'khrugs pa yis/ /chu khams thur du bskyod gyur la/ /de nyid kyis ni me drod nyams/ /de 'og khong pa khyab nas ni/ /bshang ba sla ba nyid du byed/ /de ltar tshad 'khru 'byung bar bshad/ /de yi 'byung 'gyur 111—378

byed byedabyed——— —— — ———— —— ——— — ——mtshan ma ni/ /bshang lam snying ga lto /1bar zug /lus snyom bshang ba sri ba dang / /sbo zhing kha zas mi 'ju ba'o/ /de las rlung gyur bshang chur bcas/ /nyung zhig (2)'byung zhing gzer sgra bcas/ /'gag cing 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang //rtsub sla dbu bar bcas pa 'am/ /gong bu yang dang yang du 'byung / /de bzhin bu ram tshig pa 'drapa)/ /sbyin bag bcas shing bcad snyam sems/ /kha skam 5gzhang ni snad pa dang / /spu langs pa dang 'khru ba yin/ /mkhris pas ser zhing gnag pa dang / /sngo zhing du ( nyeba'i mdog 'dra la/ /khrag bcas shin tu dri mnam pa/ /skom dad brgyal tsha rdul dang bcas/ /gzer bcas ⑦gzhang kha tsha dang bcas/ /gzhang khar thor bu 'byung ba yin/ /bad kan las gyur ska (9ba dang / /'byar bag dkar zhing nal nal po/ /snum zhing be'u snabs bad kan bcas/ /rgyun du 'khru zhing lci la mnam/ /ska (zhing nad rjes 'brang ba dang / /gnyid che khong snyom yi ga 'chus/ /nyung zad nyung zad 'khru dang bcas/ /ba spu brtse ( —)zhing glong bcas dang / /chu so lto ba gzhang kha lci/ / bshang yang tuspebashang ba ma btang snyam/ /kun skyes mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /'jigs pas sems ni 'khrugs gyur pa7/ /rlung gis mkhris bcas bshang ba ni/ /sla byed de nas 'khru ba ni/ /tsha zhing sla la 'phyo ba dang / /mtshan ma rlung mkhris las byung 'dra/ /mya ngan las byung de dang 'dra/ /mdor na tshad 'khru rnam gnyis te/ /ma zhur bcas dang ma zhu med/ /khrag bcas khrag med de las 7ni/ /dang po bshang gci chur 'bying 'gyur/ /dri mnam lto ni sbo ba dang / / mkhregs shing /ngamachil snabs shin tu mang / /smin pa de las bzlog pa yin/ /bad kan smin pa'ang chu nang 'bying / /gang zhig tshad 'khru 'bad pa ni/ //// 37 9

med des pho ba'i nad du 'gyur/ /me drod nyams par byed pa yi/ /zas bsten pa yis me drod nyams/ /gang zhig zhu nas bshang ba ni/ /be+e'u ①snabs bcas dang be'u ②snabs med/ /'khru ba de ni tshad 'khru ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni myur gsod byed/ /ma zhu kha zas ma zhu dang / /zhu ba smin pa'ang mi 'khru 'gyur—/ /rgyu med yang dang yang sri ba'am④/ /rgyu med yang yang be+e bar 'byung / /pho bar ma zhu stsogs shing 'khru/ /yun ring na bar byed pa yin/ /de ni nad sna re re 'dus/ /las byung rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /de yi sngon tshul snyom pa dang / ring nas 'ju zhing skyur bag 'byung / /mchil mang ④kha yis ro mi tshor/ /rmya snyom skom zhing yi ga 'chus/ /sto sbo slon ni bro ba dang / /rna ba rgyu ma sgra dang bcas/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid skem pa dang / /du ba mun dang rims kyis 'debs/ /brgyal zhing mgo na bshang ba 'gags⑤/ /rkang pa lag pa skrangs par 'gyur/ /de la rlung la rkan bskams zhing / /rab rib rna bar sgra 'byung dang / /rtsib logs brla dang chu sor na/ / bshang ba yang dang yang du 'byung / /0yang yang sbo zhing gsud pa dang / /ro rnams kun la brkam ⑦pa dang / /bkres skom rgyu ma bcad snyam sems/ /zas zhu nas ni sbo ba dang / /zas zos nas ni bde bar 'gyur/ /rlung gi snying nad skran gzhang 'brum/ /mcher pa skya rbab 'byung bar dogs/ /bshang ba 'byung dka' ska ⑧slar 'byung / /de yang be+e snabs sgra can 'byung / /⑨gzhang na lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /mkhris pa sngo zhing ser ba dang / /ser po sla bag 'khru bar 'gyur/ /mnam zhing sgregs ⑩skyur snying sgog tsha/ /yi ga 'chus shing skom dad che/ /bad kan las gyur 'ju dka' zhing / /zas slon ⑩yi ge 'chus pa dang / /khar chags 111—380

mchil ma mang ba dang / /lud pa snying nad ①cham pas 'debs/ /snying ga mer mer por sems shing / /lto ba tshor ba chung zhing byu/ /sgregs pa dri mnam mngar 'byung snyom/ /bud med mi ⑤dga' me drod chung / /be+e'u ①snabs bad kan 'dres par 'khru/ /bshang ba lci bar rjo'abyung bar 'gyur/ /rid pa min yang nyams stobs chung / /kun skyes mtshan nyid 'dren mar ldan/ /ma snyoms la sogs me drod gsum/ /yan lag char phye ⑤gang bshad pa/ /de yang pho ba'i nad du 'gyur/ /snyoms pa bde gnas rgyu yin no/ /rlung nad rde'u nad rjomaje nad dang //gcin snyi dmu rdzing mtshan bar rdol/ /gzhang 'brum pho nad ces bya brgyad/ /nad chen gso bar dka' ba yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nas gcin 'gags pa'i nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /lgang pa lgang pa'i mgo pho mtshan/ /rked pa rlig pa gzhang kha ni/ /gzhang kha'i rus par brten gyur zhing / /gcig tu 'brel pa yin par bshad/ /be+eng pa kha ni thur bltas kyang / /gcin 'dzag pa yi rtsa sgo nas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'dzag pa yis—/ /ngos gnyis nas ⑦ni phre'us 'gengs/ /zhugs pa gang yin de yis ni//gcin 'gags pa dang gcin snyi ba'i/ /gso dka' gnad la brten pa'i nad/ /nyi shu skyed par byed pa yin/ /lgang pa chu so pho mtshan na/ /cung zad yang dang yang du 'byung / /sri ba rlung las gyur pa yin/ /mkhris pa las gyur ser tsha sgen| /mdog dmar bad kan las gyur pa/ /lgang pa pho mtshan lci zhing skrangs//'byaralgebag dal gyis 'byung zhing thogs/ /nad kun las byung mtshan kun ldan//111—381

gang tshe rlung gis ldang ba'i kha/ /bkag pa de tshe gcin mkhris pa/ /bad kan khu chur bcas pa ni/ /rim gyis bskams par byas pa las/ /mi bzad rde'u chags 'gyur te/ /ba lang mkhris par gi wang ltar/ /thams cad bad kan la brten 'gyur/ /'di yi sngon tshul mtshan nyid ni/ /lgang pa sbo zhing de yi ni/ /nye 'khor kun du rab tu na/ /gcin yang lhag par dbre bro zhing / /gcin 'gags rims 'debs yi ga 'chus/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid lte ba dang / /be+eng mgo lgang pa'i srubs na zhing / /de yis gcin 'byung sgo bkag pas/ /gcin gyi rgyun tshoni 'chad cing 'byung / /de byung zin nas bde bar byed/ /be+e zhing ba lang tshil 'dra la/ /de bskyod pa yis khrag tu 'gyur/ /drag shul spyod pas rab tu na/ /de la rlung gyur sneshin tu na/ /so 'thams sdom zhing 9lus 'dar la / /pho mtshan nyed cing lte ba 'tshir/ /rgyun du na zhing 'khun par byed/ /bshang ba 'phyen dang bcas par 'byung / /gcin gyi thigs pa yang yang 'ong 0//rde'u gnag cing rtsub pa dang / /chu sor tsher mas gang snyam byed/ /mkhris pas 5 lgang pa tsha ba dang / /btsos pa snyam byed rab tu dro/ /go bye'i 'bras bu'i dbyibs 'dra la/ /rde'u mdog dmar zhing )ser la gnag /bad kan gyis bsil lci ba dang / /lgang pa'i nang du zug cing na/ /rde'u che zhing 'jam pa la/ /sbrang rtsi'i mdog gam yang na dkar/ /'di dag byis pa rnams la ni/ /phal cher 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gnas dang sha ni chung ba'i phyir/ / bzung dang dbyung 7 ba bde ba yin/ /mi chen khu ba las byung rde'u/ /khu ba bkag las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnas las 'phos pa phyir ma byung / /rlig par gnas pa rlung gis ni/ /bskams nas nye bar bsdus gyur pa/ /de ni khu 111 382

ba rde'u chags yin/ /lgang par gcin ni sri byed cing / /tsha zhing skrang bar ①byed pa yin/ /de ni skyes ma thag tu ni/ /khu ba zhu ste sla bar 'gyur/ /phyogs der mnan na zhu bar byed/ /rde'u gseg ma lta bur gnas/ /rlung gis phye mar bshig gyur pa/ /de 'dir tshul bzhin 'byung zhes bya/ /gcin dang lhan cig phyir 'byung 'gyur/ /lugs bzhin mi 'byung rde'ur ②chags/ /gcin ni bkag par byas gyur pas/ /rlung gis be+eng pa'i kha bkag nas/ /gcin 'gags na zhing g.ya' bar 'gyur/ /lan 'ga' rang gnas las spangs gnas//lgang pa rgyas te kha che ④zhing / /mngal 'dra sbom zhing log par 'dug /der ni na zhing tsha bar byed/ /'phar zhing gcus pa snyam du sems/ /thigs pa tsam du 'dzag pa dang / /lgang btsir rgyun ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rnam pa gnyis po 'di dag ni/ /rlung gi ⑤lgang pa'i nad ces bya/ /gso dka' gnyis pa rlung gi yin/ /mthu chen shin tu gso dka' yin/ /bshang lam de duni lgang pa yi/ /bar na rlung ni brten gyur pa/ /gtun 'dra sra zhing mtho ba dang / /mi 'gyur gnas byed mdud pa can/ /rlung nad gtun 'dra de sbos bcas/ /bshang gci 'phyen ni 'gags byed yin/ /log rgyu 'khyel bar byed ⑦pa yi/ /rlung gis chu sor mi bzad gzer④/ /gcin las zhugs te 'khyil byed cing / /rengs byed lci zhing gcus snyam byed/ /gcin ni nyung shas nyung shas 'byung / /yang na bshang gci gtong tshe 'byung / /'di ni rlung nad ⑨'khyil pa yin/ /gcin ni yun rings bkag gyur pa/ /sri zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ /gcin thon nas ni nad tshabs 'bri/ /gcin bkag pa yis gnod gyur pa/ /gang tshe rlung gis bzlog gyur pa/ /lte ba'i 'og nas lte ba'i bar/ /gcin gyis gang 'gyur 111—383

de yi tshe/ /rab tu na zhing sbos pa ①dang / /zas mi 'ju zhing dri ma 'gags/ /de ni ltor gcin 'gags zhes bya/ gcin 'byung bu ga 'chus pa 'am/ /rlung gis bkag ②nas gcin nyung 'byung / /lgang pa mtshan sbubs nor bu ni/ /gnas nas de 'og rim gyis 'dzag /nad ⑦bcas pa 'am nad med pa/ /gcin ni chad dang bcas par 'byung / /lhag ma lus te mtshan byu yin/ /rjol— ldang— sgo kha nang ⑤rlum zhing sra/ /cung zhig 'phral du 'byung 'gyur na/ /—gcin stsogs rde'u lta bu nime/ /gcin gyi mdud par de bshad do/ /gcin snyoms pa las nyal po byas/ /rlung gis khu ba bskyod gyur pa/ /gnas las bskyod cing ⑦gcin btang tshe/ /sngon nam phyi nas thal ⑧chu dang / /mdog 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /khu ba 'dres par de bshad do/ /rtsub cing skem 6)la rlung gis ni/ /gang tshe rtug skam nad gyur pa/ /gcin 'byung bu gar song nas ni/ /bshang ba dang 'dres de yi tshe/ /gcin ni bshang ba'i dri can 'byung / /bshang ba 'gags par de ⑩bshad do/ /mkhris pa drag shul kha zas ni—/ /rno tsha nyi tshan la sogs kyis/ /'phel zhing rlung ni zhugs gyur pa/ /lgang pa'i nye 'khor tsha zhing na/ /gcin ni ser por ⑪'gyur ba 'am yang na khrag bcas khrag nyid 'byung / /tsha zhing sri la yang yang 'byung / /de ni tsha rlung zhes byar bshad/ /rtsub cing lus ni rmya ba yi/ /be+eng par gnas pa'i mkhris pa rlung / /gcin zad tsha dang na bar bcas/ /bskyed pa de yang de skad bshad/ /bad kan mkhris pa gnyi ga la/ /rlung gis bskyod par gyur na ni/ /de tshe gcin sri ser ba dang / /dmar zhing dkar la ska ⑫ba 'byung / /de ni tsha bcas gi wang ngam/ /dung gi phye ma'i mdog 'dra 'am⑫/ /yang na skam zhing mdog kun 111—384

———byedabyed—byed — —byed—byed—— — —— byedaldan—/ /de ni gcin nyams nad du bshad/ /de ltar gcin 'gags 1las byung ba'i—/ /mtshan nyid rgya cher bshad nas ni/ /de 'og gcin snyi las byung ba'i/ /nad gzhi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las—/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u dgu pa'o// //de nas gcin snyi ba za khu'i /5nad dmigs bshad par bya'o/ /gcin snyi'i nad ni nyi shu ste/ /de las )bad kan las gyur bcu/ /mkhris pa las ( drug rlung gyur bzhi/ /de rnams tshil gcin bad kan skyed/ /zas dang skom gyi tshul las ni/ /phal cher de dag 'byung bar byed/ /mngar dang sgyur dang lan tshwa dang / /lci zhing 'byil la /5/bsil ba dang / /'bru mar chang dang gsher ba'i sha /dar ( ba bu ram bu ram shing / /gnas gcig stan gcig la rtag gnas—/ /mal stan cho 7gar mi ldan la/ /brten nas gcin snyi'i /8nad skyed byed—/ /bad kan 'khrugs las lgang pa'i gcin/ /snyi 'gyur lus gsher rngul tshil dang / /sha glongs (rtelgang par brten cing 6 snyi/ /mkhris pas khrag kyang zad byas nas/ /bad kan stsogs zad gcin gnas bskyed/ /rlung 'khrugs pa dang de zad las/ /lus zungs be+eng par 'khrus te bskyed/ /de byung gso bya 'tsho tsam dang / /spang bya gcin nad rnam gsum 'gyur/ /mdor na mi mthun bya ba dang/ /nad dmigs chen po nyid kyis 'byung / /de rnams kyi ni spyi'i mtshan nyid/ /gcin ni rnyog ma can 11du 'byung / /gnod dang gnod bya khyad med kyang / /de dus 7khyad par nyid dang ni/ /gabyun gyi mdog stsogs dbye ba yis/ /gcin snyi'i dbye ba brtag par bya/ /dang zhing mang la dkar 777 385

zhing bsel/ /dri nga med cing chu 'dra ba①/ /gcin snyi chu yi za khu yin/ /cung zad rnyog can sbyin ⑤bag can/ /bu ram shing khu lta bur mngar/ /za khu bu ram shing khu yin/ /zhag lon na ni ska ①bar 'gyur/ /za khu gar po zhes bya'oske/ /steng na ④dwangs ma 'og na ska⑤/ /chang 'dra chang gi za khu yin/ /ba sru ④ldang zhing 'bras btags sti'adra/ /dkar zhing mang 'byung 'bras phye 'dra⑧/ /khu chu 'dra ba'am khu ba 'dres/ /khu ba 'dra ba'i za khu yin/ /gcin ni bye tshigs ⑨dri ma can/ /bye ma'i za khu zhes bya'o/ /gcin snyi mang du 'byung zhing bsil—/ /mngar ba de bsil za khu yin/ /dal gyis nyung zad nyung zad 'byung / /bags kyis 'byung ba'i za khu yin/ /kha chu 'dra ba'i nal nal po/ /'byil bag kha chu'i za khu yin/ /dri ro kha dog reg bya ni/ /nas tshig 'khus ⑩'dra nas tshig can/ /za khu sngon bo kha dog sngo⑪/ /za khu nag po snag ⑫tsha 'dra//gcin snyi tsha zhing mdog ser ba/ /de ni skyer pa 'dra ba yin/ /mnam zhing btsod kyi khu ba 'dra/ /btsod kyi za khu zhes bya'o/ /dri nga tsha zhing lan tshwar bcas—/ /khrag 'dra khrag gi za khu yin/ /zhag gi za khu zhag dang 'dres/ /zhag nyid gcin du 'byung ba yin/ /rkang 'dres pa 'am rkang nyid ni/ /yang dang yang 'byung rkang za khu/ /glang chen spyos ltar rgyun du ni/ /gcin shugs dal bar 'byung 'gyur la/ /chu ser bcas shing rnyog bcas 'byung / /glang chen za khu zhes bya'o/ /sbrang rtsi'i za khu sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /de ni rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur—/ /lus zungs zad pas rlung 'khrugs pa'am/ /nad kyis rtsa srubs bkag ste 'byung / /nad kyis bkag pa'i mtshan ma dag /de ni rgyu med par 'byung zhing / /skad cig zad stong ⑫gang 'gyur ba/ /gso bar dka' ba nyid 111—386

du 'gyur/ /thams cad dus su ①ma bcos na/ /sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i za khur 'gyur / /gang zhig thams cad mngar 'gyur bas⑤/ /phal cher sbrang rtsi'i za khu yin/ /sbrang rtsi'i za khu zhes bya kun/ /mngar ba las ni bshad pa yin/ /zas mi 'ju zhing yi ga 'chus/ /slon lud gnyid che cham pas 'debs/ /bad kan las byung za khu la/ /bla brnan ①de dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /pho mtshan lgang par zug pa dang / /rlig 'bras bye zhing rims kyis 'debs/ /tsha skyur skom dad brgyal dang 'khru/ /mkhris pa las gyur bla brnan rjoyin/ /rlung las skyes pa'i snying 'phar ⑤zhing / /lus 'dar snying na zas la brkam/ /gzer zhing gnyid med skem pa dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba 'byung / /kham phor rus sbal 'dra ba can/ / sgu bo rjome dbal phra mo dang / /sran chung 'dra dang nyungs kar ⑦'dra/ /bu bcas 'byung dang bi da ⑧ri/ /khong 'bras zhes bya'i 'bras 'brum bcu/ /gcin nad ma bcos pa las 'byung / /tshigs dang gnad dang sha che ba'i/ /srog gi gnas su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mtha' ma mtho zhing dbus ma dma'⑨/ /gnag cing rnag dang nad bcas la/ /dbyibs dang tshad ni kham phor 'dra/ /thor bu kham phor zhes bya'o/ /nang du zug cing na byed la/ /nye 'khor dag tu cher mched cing ⑩/ /'jam zhing rus sbal rgyab 'dra ba'i/ /'bras nad rus sbal can zhes bya/ /sra zhing rtsa yi dra ba can/ /snum zhing 'dzag la khyon che ba/ /na zhing nang ⑪zug bu ga ni/ /phra mor ldan pa dra ba can/ /nang du zug cing na la rnags⑩/ /rgyab bam lto ba dag tu ni/ /thor bu chen po kha dog gnag /sgu ⑫bor 'dug pas sgu ④bor bshad/ /skyes ma thag tu pags pa tsha/ /shin tu na byed me dbal te/ /dmar zhing gnag la 111—387

—————— — ——zhe—— ——byed— ——— ————— — ——byed—byed———gas pa dang / /tsha zhing rmugs byed me dbal phra1 / /sran chung 'dra ba'i tshad dang dbyibs/ /mnyam pas sran chung can yin no/ /tshad dang dbyibs ni nyungs kar 'dra/ /myur du smin zhing nad tshabs che/ /yungs kar 'dra ba'i 'brum phran gyis/ /yongs su bskor bas chu bur 2 can/ /bu bcas che zhing mang ba la/ /rab phra'i 'brum bus khyab gyur pa'o / /ldum bu bi da ri ltar ldum—/ /sra ba bi da ri zhes bya/ /khong 'bras gzhan du bshad pa yin/ /de la dang po'i 'bras nad gsum/ /bu bcas dang ni bi da ri/ /tshil chen las byung brnag /dka' yin/ /gzhan dag mkhris pa shas che zhing / /tshil chung 5 las byung brnag ( )nus 'gyur/ /de rnams nad shas ji ltar che'i/ /gcin snyi ba yi dbang las 7'byung / /'di dag za khu med par ni/ /gnod gyur 2)tshil las 'byung 'gyur te/ /ji srid dngos po (9)mi snang ba/ /de srid shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /kha dog ljang ba'am dmar ba'i gcin/ /za khu'i sngon tshul med pa yisake —/ /gcin 'byung gang de za khu min/ /de ni khrag mkhris yin zhes bya/ /lus rngul yan lag mnam zhing lhod pa dang / /stan dang mal dang gnyid kyi bde la chags/ /snying mig rna ba kha lce byugs snyam byed/ /lus sgom skra dang sen mo ring ba dang / /bsil bag la dga' gre ba rkan bskams shing / /kha nang ro mngar rkang mthil tsho1lag mthil tsha/ /gang du gcis 7par grog ma nyeshe'adu 'gyur ba / /gcin nad 3 za khu'i tshogs ni phyis 'byung tshul/ /za khu sbrang rtsi'i 1 mdog 'dra 'byel ba dang / /sbrang rtsi'i laro 'dra ba la gnyis su rtog /lus brtas bad kan can gyi za khu 'am/ /nyes pa zad pas rlung gi bdag can yin/ /sngon tshul bcas pa'i bad mkhris za 7khu dang / /gang yang rim gyis 18 rlung nad 717 388

za khur 'gyur/ /mkhris pa las gyur gang yin gso bar ①dka'/ /gal te tshil nad shas chung gyur ②gso sla/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcu pa'o// //de nas khong 'bras dang rgyu rlugs dang skran gyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /kha zas khengs ①bu rab tsha dang / /rtsub dang skam dang tsha 'gyur zos/ /nyal ba'i spyod pa mi bde bas④/ /khrag nad skyed ⑤'gyur de dang des/ /pags pa sha tshil rus pa dang / /khrag dang chu ba chu ba che/ /phyi dang nang du skrangs gyur paXrka/ /rtsa ba che zhing nad tshabs che/ /zlum po'am 'jong bar gnas pa gang //khong 'bras de ni rnam pa drug /nad dmigs sna ⑦re 'dus pa dang / /khrag dang smas ⑧pa las byung ba'o/ /'dir phyi'i yan lag de dang der/ /rab na mdud pa 'dra la mtho/ /nang gi shin tu mi bzad cing / /gting ring skran ⑨ltar sra ba yin/ /grog ⑫mkhar lta bur mtho ba dang / /me dang mtshon ltar myur gsod byed/ /lte ba chu so mchin mcher ⑪pa/ /glo dang snying lto brla rtsa dang / /mkhal ma gnyis sam gzhang du'ang 'byung / /de la ⑫rlung gyur nad tshabs drag /dmar nag ring zhig lon nas ni/ /'byung zhing smin pa dbyebs mi snyoms/ /ran zhing mgo 'khor sbos pa ⑫dang / /g.yo zhing 'pho la sgra dang bcas/ /mkhris gyur spyozangs ltar dmar rtsa gnag /skom dad tsha rims rmongs bag skyed/ /ldang zhing smin pa myur ba yin/ /bad kan las skya g.ya' dang bcas/ /slon zhing bsil la sla ba dang / /glal zhing byu la yi ga 'chusaske/ /'byung zhing smin pa yun ring thogs/ /'dus pa las gyur 'dren 111—389

ma yin/ /'dir ni phyi nang gnyis mtshan nyid/ /don gyi dbang las shes par bya—/ /'brum bu nag pos khebs shing gnag /rab tsha na zhing rims kyis 'debasarka/ /mkhris pa'i rtags ldan phyi 'am ①nang / /khrag gyur ②bud med nyid la 'byung / /mtshon la stsogs pas smas ④pa yis/ /rma byung ④mi 'phrod bsten pa las/ /rma kha'i ⑤tsha ba rlung gis phul/ /khrag bcas mkhris pa 'byung bar byed/ /khong 'bras bla brnan rjond mang zhing / /khrag mkhris mtshan nyid can dag byed/ /bla brnan dze+ede yi dbye ba yang / /gnas kyi dbye ba las bshad do/ /lte ⑧bar byung na skyigs bu ste/ /chu sor gcin 'gags rnag tu 'gyuraske/ /mcher pa dbugs mi bde mchin par/ /dbugs 'byung 'gag skom mgo 'khor 'gyur/ /glo bar ⑨byung na lkog nad 'gyur/ /snying byung ⑩yan lag kun gzir snyam/ /rab rmongs mun sros ⑪snyam du byed/ /snying 'phar na bar 'gyur ba ⑫yin/ /lto ba rtsib logs phrag pa'i bar/ /na zhing lto sbos 'byung bar 'gyur/ /chu so mdoms ⑫bar byung brla na/ /mkhal mar byung na rked pa rgyab/ /rtsib logs su ni na bar 'gyur/ /gzhang du rlung ni thur 'byung 'gags④/ /zhu dang ma zhu phyed nyid zhu⑫/ /de dag 'or nad lta bur bshad—/ /lte ba yan chad smin khar ⑩'dzag /lte ba man chad gzhang du 'dzag /lte bar gnas pa gnyi ⑩gar 'dzag /khong 'bras kyi ni nad dmigs rnams/ /'dzag las rma ltar shes par bya/ /de las 'dus pa las gyur dang / /snying dang lte ba chu sor gnas/ /phyi ⑫'am nang du bye ba ⑪'am/ /smin te kha nas 'dzag pa ni/ /nyam chung bla brnan ⑪ldan pa spang / /de bzhin bud med bu btsas pa'am/ /sbrum ma'am nu zho yod pa dang / /nu zho med pa'i nu ma yi/ /111—390

rtsa sgo kha byer ①phyin gyur nas/ /phyi yi khong 'bras mtshan nyid can/ / skrang zhing ④sra ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bu mo rnams kyi nu rtsa'i sgokye/ /phra bas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rlung ni rgyu lam 'gags pas 'khrugs/ /skrang sgodang gzer ni skyed cing rgyu/ /chu so rlig par phyin pa dang / /rmig par rgyu ba'i rtsa dag ni/ /bcir nas rlig pa pags pa dag /'phel zhing rmig rlugs nyid du phyed—/ /nad khrag gcin tshil rgyu ma las/ /me+eg rlugs de ni rnam bdun 'gyur—/ /rgyu ma gcin skyes pa 'am ⑤rlung / /rgyu ma'i dbye ba 'ba' zhig gzhanaske/ /rlung gyur ⑥rkyal pa gang 'dra zhing / /reg na rtsub cing rgyu med na/ /mkhris gyur u dus+thā ④ra yi/ /'bras bu smin 'dra tsha dro 'drul/ /bad kan las bsil lci zhing snum/ /g.ya' zhing sra la nad tshabs chung / /khrag gyur gnag cing 'brum bus khyab/ /mkhris pa'i rlig rlugs mtshan nyid ldan/ /tshil gyur ⑧rlig rlugs bad kan 'dra/ /'jam zhing ta la'i 'bras bur mtshungs/ / gcin gnag pa la brten pa ⑨rnams/ /gcin las 'byung bar de 'gyur te/ / rkyal pa chu ⑩yis gang ba ltar/ /g.yo 'gyur nad lhostedang bcas shing 'jam/ /gcin 'gags pa dang rlig pa yi/ /'og tu skrang par ⑫byed par 'gyur/ /rlung 'khrugs pa yi khyanyezas dang ni/ /chu grang la nyepeni rkyal ba dang / /shugs bkag babyur dang khur spyodang lam/ /yan lag log par 'chus pa dang / /rlung 'khrugs pa ni gzhan gyis kyang / /gang tshe rgyu ma phra mo'i ⑩cha/ /rlung gis log par phul 'gyur ⑫te/ / rang gi gnas /—shenas thur du bskyod/ /chu so'i tshigs su phyin pa dang / /de tshe mdud pa ltar glo tuge'agyur/ /yal bar bor na rlig pa cher skye zhing / /sbo shing na la rengs par rlung gis byed/ /rab tu 111 —391

gzir zhing nang na sgra dang bcas/ /gang bar byed cing bcug kyang be+er 'byung byed①—/ /rgyu rlugs 'di ni gso dka' ste/ /rlung gi rlig rlugs 'dra ba yin/ /rtsub cing gnag la dmar ba'i rtsa④/ /phra mo'i ①dra bas khebs pa yin/ /skran brgyad nad ni so so rjodang / /'dres dang 'dus pa las gyur dang / /zla mtshan gyi ni nyes pa yis/ /brgyad pa bud med rnams la 'byung / /rims dang slon dang tshad 'khru stsogs/ /skyug sman stsogs dang las rnams kyis/ /skem gyur rlung skyes zas za dang / /bkres te chu grang 'thungs gyur pa'am/ /skom 'thungs rjes la gang zhig ni/ /rkyal dang mchong ba la sogs pa/ /bsten ⑤pas lus ni dkrugs byas dang / /slon mi bro yang skyugs pa dang / /rlung la sogs pa 'byung ba yi/ /shugs bkag pa 'am babyung ba 'amadu/ /snum dang dugs ni ma bsten par/ /sbyang ba'i las ni byas pa dang ⑦/ /sbyangs zin ⑧myur du tsha ba dang / /bad kan skyed pa'i zas skom spyad⑨/ /rlung rgyas pa yi nad rnams ni/ /so so'am 'dres pa'am 'khrugs gyur pa'am/ /kun nas khrag dang bcas 'khrugs ⑩pas/ /sbubs can la ni brten gyur nas/ /steng 'og lam ni bkag nas su/ /gzer sngon 'gro zhing reg tu rung / /shin tu mtho zhing mdud pa'i gzugs/ /skran ni skyed par 'gyur ba yin/ /skem pas bad kan mkhris bshang ba'i/ /rgyun srang 'gags par gyur pa ⑪yis/ /rlung ni khong ⑫par gnas bcas pa()/ /rtsub pas sra bar gyur pa yin/ /rang gnas ldang 'gyur rang dbang can/ /gzhan gnas la brten gzhan dbang can//gong por gyur pas gzugs med kyang / /gzugs can ltar gnas skran zhes bya//chu so lte ba snying ga dang / /rtsib logs la ni gnas pa yin/ /rlung las mjing ④111—392

pa klad pa ①gzer/ /rims 'debs mcher na rgyu ma 'khrug /bshang sri khab kyis gtsags ②snyam na/ /dbugs 'byin yang dang yang mi phyin/ /lus rengs kha ni skam pa dang / /skem zhing me drod mi snyoms la/ /pags stsogs gnag cing rtsub pa dang / rlung skran g.yo ba ④yin pa'i phyir/ /dbyebs ni brtag rjopar mi mngon zhing / /gnas 'phel 'bri dang na ba dang / /grog mas khyab pa lta bur ni/ /skran ni 'gul zhing zug pa yin/ /mkhris las tsha zhing gregs skyur brgyal/ /'khru zhing lus rngul skom ⑤rims 'debs/ /pags pa la sogs ser por snang / /skran ni reg par mi bzod dang / /tsha zhing 'bar la dro ba dang / /rang gi gnas ni sreg snyam byed/ /bad kan slon dhibag yi ga 'chus/ /me drod nyams shing grang rims 'debs/ /chom ⑦pa khong snyom dang ga lci/ /lud pa lu zhing pags stsogs dkar/ /skran phugs ring zhing sra ba dang / /lci zhing rang gnas brten ⑤nad chung / /phal cher rang gnas 'dug pa dang / /rang gi dus su nad skyed byed/ /gnyis las byung ba'i skran gsum po/ /mtshan nyid 'dren mar ldan pa yin/ /kun skyes mi bzad na zhing tsha/ /myur smin ⑨sra mtho de gso dka'/ /khrag gi skran ni gang yin pa/ /de ni bud med nyid la ⑩'byung / /zla mtshan dus sam bu gsar btsas/ /yang na mngal gyi nad can gyis⑪—/ /bud med rlung skyed bsten gyur pas/ /rlung ni 'khrugs par gyur pa las—/ /zla re 'byung bar byed pa yis⑫/ /zla mtshan mngal du bkag pas ⑫ni//de ni mngal chags 'drar snang zhing / /mtshan ma gsal bar ston byed de/ /snying 'phar nu 'dzag yid mi bde/ /skem spyopa la stsogs tshul du snang / /de nas rim gyis rlung 'dres dang ske/ /mkhris pa yi ⑫ni rgyu yis na/ /rlung dang 111—393

mkhris pa las byung ba'i/ /skran ni khrag de skyed byed yin/ /na zhing sra la tsha zhing 'khru/ /skom dad rims stsogs bla brnan ①'byung / /nad kyi khrag la brten pas na/ /mngal gnas dag tu lhag par gzer/ /mngal nas dri nga 'dzag pa dang / /na zhing 'phar la zug par byed/ /mngal chags 'dra yang yan lag med/ /'on kyang skran ni 'gul gzer ldan/ /de nyid der ni gong por gnas/ /lan 'ga' 'gul bar byed pa yin/ /'di ni ltor 'phel mi byed kyi/ /skran nyid (kye'aphel bar byed pa yin/ /rang gi nad gzhi la brten pas—/ /des der skran nad thams cad skyed/ /yun rings ④nas ni smin 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na ma smin khong 'bras kyang / /nad khrag la ni brten pa'i phyir/ /shin tu myur bar smin par 'gyur⑦/ /de phyir myur du tsha 'gyur bas / /khong 'bras zhes ni de la bshad/ /nang gnas rjoskran ni chu so dang / /lto ba mchin pa snying na zhing / /me drod mdog nyams nyams stobs 'bri/ /shugs ni 'gag ( stepar 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi rol de las bzlog pa ste/ /khong pa'i yan lag nad ⑦tshabs chung / /phyogs de'i ④mdog ni nyams pa dang / /phyi rol du ni mthong ⑨zhing 'phags/ /lto spo lhag par mi bzad na/ /rgyu ma'i ⑩sgra bcas mi bzad na/ / sbo bcas ⑪lto ba na ba dang / /rlung gi nad kyis steng 'og bkag /de ni hen kyi zhes byar bshad/ /sra zhing gtun 'dra mdud pa can/ /gtun 'dra gyen du mtho bar gnas/ /hen gyi mtshan ldan gtun bu ni/ /'phred gnas de dang tshul 'dra yin/ /zhu ba'i gnas nas gzhang pho mtshan/ /rlung ni mi bzad na zhing rgyu/ /thur du zug pa yin par bshad / /de las bzlog pa gyen du zug pa'o/ /sgregs pa mang zhing bshang 111 ——394

ba 'gags pa dang / /'grangs ①za mi nus rgyu ma sgra dang bcas/ /sbo zhing ten langs kha zas 'ju mi nus/ /skran ni nyer 'byung mtshan ma yin par bshad| /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas dmu rdzing gi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /nad kun me drod nyams las skye/ /lhag par dmu rdzing nad skye zhing / /ma zhu dri ma can gyi zas/ /dri ma stsogs las ②skye bar 'gyur/ /nad kyis chu ni rgyu ba'i rtsa/ /steng dang 'og tu bkag nas ni/ /srog dang thur sel ①la gnod de/ /pags pa rjosha yi bar gnas nad⑤/ /lto ba bkang ste dmu rdzing skyed/ /de yang rnam ༷pa brgyad 'gyur te/ /nad gzhi tha dad 'dus mcher ⑦pa/ /dri ma 'gags dang rgyu rdol dang ⑧/ /des gzir rkan dang mchu bskams shing / /rkang pa lag pa gsus pa skrang / /spyod pa kha zas nyams stobs 'bri/ /skem zhing gsus pa cher skyes la/ /mi ni yi dwags gzugs can 'gyur/ /de ni 'byung 'gyur mtshan ma dag /bkres pa med cing zas kun ni/ /ring nas tsha zhing skyur bcas 'ju/ /'ju dang mi 'ju mi shes la/ /'grangs ⑨par za yang mi nus shing / /stobs ni rtag tu zad par 'gyur/ /cung zad bskyod kyang dbugs mi bde/ /bshang ba 'phel zhing 'gags ⑩par byed/ /rkang pa gnyis su cung zad skrang / /chu sor na zhing zas yang ba/ /cung zad zos kyang gsus pa rgyas/ /rtsa rgyas lto ba'i gnyer ma 'jig /dmu rdzing nad ni thams cad la/ /snyom zhing nyam ⑪chung 'gyur ba dang / /dri ma sri zhing me drod chung / /tsha zhing skrang ⑫la gsus pa sbo/ /111—395

mjug tu chu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /thams cad chu med bar du smug /skrang ①med khur ltar lci ma ⑤yin/ /rtsa dra'i ①skar khung ris kyis khebs/ /rtag tu sgra ni 'ur 'ur zer/ /rlung gis lte ba rgyu mar zhugs④/ /shugs skyed ⑤na ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /snying ga lte ba rked pa dang / /gzhang dang chu so rjon bar byedaske/ /rlung ni sgra dang bcas par rgyu/ /bshang ⑦ba 'gag cing gci ba nyung //me drod chung ⑧min skam pa min/ /khar ni ro bro med pa yin/ /de la rlung gi dmu dze+eng ni/ /rkang lag rmig pa lto ba skrang / /lto ba rtsib logs rkad ⑨rgyab na//tshigs rnams bye ⑩ba snyam du sems/ /lud pa skams shing yan lag snyom⑪/ /ro smad lci zhing bshang gci 'gag /pags pa la stsogs gnag la sgrug /glo bur du ni 'phel zhing 'bri/ /gsus par ⑫zug cing na ba dang / /rtsa bran nag pos khyab cing rgyas/ /brdabs na rkyal pa ⑫dbugs kyis ni/ /gang ba lta bu'i sgra dang ldan④/ /'dir rlung nad dang sgrar bcas pas⑫/ /thams cad du ni rgyu bar byed/ /mkhris pa'i dmu rdzing rims 'debs rgyas⑩/ /lus tsha skom dad kha ro kha/ /mgo 'khor tshad 'khru pags pa stsogs/ /ser zhing gsus pa'i mdog rtsa sngo/ /rtsa ni dmar sar ⑩dag gis khyab/ /rdul dang tsha bar bcas pas sregatho) /dad 'byung reg na 'jam pa dang / /myur du smin zhing nyer gdung 'gyur/ /bad kan dmu rdzing lhu tshigs na/ /tshor ba med cing skrangs la phyi/ /gnyid che slon zhing yi ga 'chus/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde pags stsogasaske/ /sra ⑪zhing lto ba mkhrang la snum/ /rtsa yi ri mos khyab cing che ring nas 'phel zhing sra ba dang / /reg na grang zhing gsus pa lci/ /nad gsum 'khrugs pa de dang de/ /bud med kyis byin dri ma rdul/ /dbyig ⑥dug dug 111—396

stsogs kyis gnod 'gyur/ /khrag bcas dri ma bsags ①pa ni/ /ltor song gnod pa skyed byed deske/ /kha skom mgo 'khor brgyal bcas pa'i/ /rtags gsum ldan pa'i dmu rdzing skyed/ /myur du smin zhing mi bzad na/ /de ni grang dang rlung dang char/ /phrad pas shin tu gnod par 'gyur/ /mang du zos pas bskyod pa dang / /bzhon pa drag stitu 'gro ba dang / /las lam nyal po drags pas dub/ /skyug rjosman drags dang nad kyis skem/ /g.yon logs ⑤gnas pa'i mcher pa ni/ /gnas las 'phos te 'phel ba dang / /yang na dngas ma stsogs pas khrag /rgyas byas de ni 'phel gyur dang rjo/ /de nas ⑦gtun bu bzhin rab sra/ /de nas rus sbal rgyab 'dra bar/ / rim gyis 'phel bar 'gyur ⑧nas ni/ /lto bar dmu rdzing chags par byed/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde skom dad/ /kha yis ro ni mi tshor zhing / /lci ⑨zhing na la rims kyis 'debasaske/ /sha mdeg ⑩skya zhing mi sdug ⑩la/ /brgyal zhing slon par byed pa dang / /tsha zhing myos dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rtsa mdog dmar ba'am mi sdug pa'am| /sngo zhing ser la ri mor bcas/ /de la rim gyis ⑫nad rnams ni/ /bshang 'gags nad tu)dang lto sbos dang / /rmongs bag skom tsha rims kyis 'debs—/ /lus lci lto sra ④yi ga 'chus/ /mcher pa lta bur mchin g.yas logs—/ /gnas 'phos dmu rdzing skyed ces bya/ /bya sgro spu dang bcas pa'i zas—/ /zos pas bshang lam gnas 'gags te/ /gzhang 'brum dang ni rtug skam dang / /rgyu mar chags pa'i zas kyis kyang / /thur du sel ba'i rlung 'khrugs te/ /bshang bas ⑫bad mkhris bkag nas ni/ /lto bar dmu rdzing chags par byed/ /des ni tsha skom rims sprid 'byung / /lud pa dbugs mi 111—397

bde brla na/ /klad ①snying lte ba gzhang kha na/ /dri ma 'gags slon yi ga 'chus—/ /lto bar rlung ni 'khyims par byed/ /brtan zhing rtsa ni sngo la smug /rtsa ris snang ba'am mi snang 'gyur/ /phal cher lte ba'i 'og tu ni/ /ba lang mjug 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rus stsogs zug rngur bcas pa'i zas /zos sam shin tu drag ④zos pa/ /rgyu ma rdol lam gas gyur ①nas/ /bu ga de nas ma zhu bar/ /phyir 'dzag bshang lam las 'byung dhizhing / /bshang bcas nyung shas nyung shas ni/ /sha rul lta bur mnam pa ni/ /sbyin bag dmar ser 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lhag ma yis ni lto ba 'gengs/ /dmu rdzing mi bzad skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni lte ba man chad rgyas/ /chus gang lta bur myur du 'gyur/ /nad kyi tshul ni shas cher ldan/ /dbugs mi bde skom mgo 'khor khyab/ /rgyu rdol dmu rdzing zhes bshad de/ /gzhan dag rgyu ma 'dzag ces zer/ /snum 'thungs la sogs byas nas ni/ /'phral du chu grang 'thungs pa'am/ /me drod bri ba'am ha cang ni/ /skom pas chu 'thung drags pa'am⑦/ /rlung dang bad kan 'khrugs chur 'dres/ /chu yi lam ni bkag gyur pas/ /de nyid gnas der 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de 'og dmu rdzing gyur pa yin/ /de nas dmu rdzing de las ni/ /skom dad rkub tu chu 'dzag bcas/ /dbugs mi bde lud yi ga 'chus—/ /sna tshogs mdog ldan rtsa yis khyab/ /rkyal pa chus gang reg pa 'dra//bskyod na sgra grag 3 lus 'dar la/ /dmu rdzing chen pos spyoche zhing snum/ /brtan zhing de ni lte ba zlum/ /thams cad yal bar bor na ⑧ni/ /nad ni rang gnas las 'phos te/ /smin pas be+e zhing zag 6ste'agyur ba/ /tshigs dang rtsa sgo las kyang 'dzag /phyi yi rtsa sgo nas rngul 'byung / /'gags nas ⑩thad 111 —398

kar 'khyel zhing gnas/ /chu de nyid ni 'phel 'gyur zhing / /sbyin ①bag gyur na de tshe ni/ /lto ba phyi zhing sra la zlum/ /brdabs ⑤na sgra ni mi 'byung zhing / /mdog 'jam rtsa ris mi snang la/ /lto ba dang ni rgyab tu 'gro/ /de rjes chu yi dmu rdzing skye/ /lto ba 'phel zhing de las lhag /rtsa nub gyur pa'i dmu chu ni/ /dmu rdzing bshad pa'i mtshan nyid ldan/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan mcher/ /'dus pa'i chu yi dmu rdzing rnams/ /phyi ma bzhin du gso ba dka'/ /gzhan dag phal cher zla phyed gsod/ /thams cad chur gyur 'chi ltas le'u/ /las bshad bla brnan ①ldan pa'ang gsod/ /skyes nas dmu rdzing gyur pa dag /phal cher gso bar dka' bar bshad/ /stobs ldan chur ni ma gyur zhing / /gsar du byung rjob 'bad pas gso/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las—/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas skya rbab dang 'or nad dang me dbal gyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o//ji skad bshad pa'i nad 'khrugs pas⑤/ /mkhris pa lhag par ldang 'gyur la/ /de la rlung ni stobs che bas/ /snying la gnas pa'i mkhris pa ni/ /gtor te rjortsa chen bcu'i nang bkram⑦/ /lus kun la ni khyab gyur pas/ /bad kan pags pa sha khrag la/ /gnod byas bar du gnas nas ni/ /sha dang pags pa de dag las/ /pags mdog tha dad dkar ba dang / /ser zhing ljang sngon byed par 'gyur/ /de las skya ba'i shas che bas/ /de phyir skya rbab nad ces bshad—/ /nad des ⑧lus ni lci ba dang / /lus zungs rnams ni lhod pa dang //mdangs kyi yon tan zad gyur zhing ⑨/ /de las khrag dang tshil chung ste/ /111—399

snying po med cing dbang po lhod/ /yan lag brdungs pa snyam byed cing / /snying ni zag ①pa snyam du sems/ /mig phugs skrang zhing nyams la na②/ /mchil mang skad gsang dma' ba dang / /zas ①mi 'dod cing grang mi bzod/ /spu 'byi me drod nyams pa dang / /ro smad 'bying duzhing rims kyis 'debs/ /dbugs mi bde zhing rna sgra 'bod/ /mgo 'khor ngal ⑤bar byed pa yin/ /de ni nad gzhi tha dad 'dus/ /sa zhag zos las rnam rjolngar 'gyur/ /'di yi sngon tshul snying 'phar zhing / /pags pa rtsub par gyur pa dang / /yi ga 'chus shing gcin mdog ser/ /rngul med khong pa'i me drod chung / /lus rmya ngal bar byed pa yin/ /de la rlung gyur lus na zug /rtsa sen mig dang bshang gci rnams/ /mdog nag ⑦rtsub la 'dar ba dang / /skrang sgo kha yis ro mi tshor/ /rtug skam rtsib logs klad pa na/ /mkhris skelas rtsa dang stisen mo stsogs/ /ljang sngon rims 'debs mun 'thibs byed/ /skom dang rngul brgyal bsil ba 'dod—/ /lus mnam kha nang kha ba dang / /'khru zhing sgregs pa skyur la tsha/ /bad kan rtsa stsogs dkar ba dang / / glongs shing ⑩kha nang lan tshwa bro/ /ba sru ldang zhing skad 'gags la/ /lud pa lu zhing slon par byed/ /'dus gyur ⑪mtshan ma 'dres brnag ⑩dka'/ /sa zhag bska ⑫bas rlung skyed la/ /tsha bro mkhris pa mngar ④bad kan/ /dngas ma la sogs gnod 'gyur zhing / /rtsub pas zas zos rtsub gyur nas/ /zhu bas rtsa sbubs 'gags byas te/ /snga ma bzhin du skya rbab skyed/ /de nas lte ba rkang pa dang / /kha dang pho mtshan skrang ⑫par byed/ /bshang ba srin bu dang bcas ⑩'khru/ /bad kan khrag dang bcas pa ⑩'byung / /gang zhig skya rbab nad kyis btab/ /de yis mkhris skyed zas 111—400

zos pas/ /khong pa yan lag gnas mkhris gnas/ /bshang khrag bsregs te mig ser skyed/ /des ni mig dang pags pa gdong / /bshang gci sen mo kha dog ser/ /lus tsha skom dad zas mi 'ju/ /sbal 'dra dbang po nyam chung 'gyur—/ /de ni mkhris pa'i shas che na/ /skya rbab nad med par de 'byung / /yal bar bor na cher skrangs te/ /gso dka' mig ser 'or thabs yin/ /ha li ①sa ni ljang nag ser/ /rlung mkhris mgo 'khor skom dad che/ /bud med la dga' rims chung 'debs/ /khong rmya me drod nyams stobs 'bri/ /ha li ②sa ka khrag ngan 'gyur①/ /chu ser can zhes bya ba yin/ /de rnams kyi ni bla brnan ④sngar/ /'or nad gtso bo yin par bshad/ /de phyir de nyid bshad par bya'o/ /rlung 'khrugs gyur pas bad kan dang / /khrag dang mkhris pa phyi rol rtsar/ /'phros byas de yang rgyun srang 'gags/ /pags pa sha la gnas gyur ⑤te/ /'or nad mthong zhing skrang mepar byed/ /de bas thams cad 'dus gyur bshad/ /rgyu rnams kyi ni bye brag las/ /gzugs dbye dgu yi bdag nyid can / /nad gzhi tha dad gnyis dang kun/ /snad dang dug gis phog las 'byung / /yang na rang dang glo bur gnyis/ /yan lag kun skrang ⑦phyogs gcig gnyis/ /khyab dang mtho dang mdud pa yi/ /dbyibs kyi dbye bas gsum du 'dod/ /'or nad kyi ni spyi yi rgyu/ /nad las skyes pa khyad par nyid//nad las sgyung stsogs kyis nyam ⑧chung / /myur du lhag par zos stilas 'byung / /de nas gzhan yang lci ba dang / /skyur dang snum bsil lan tshwa dang / /thal sman rnon po tsha ba dang / /mya ngan chu gnyid drags dang yar/ /sa zos sha phyi sha skam dang / /ma zhu ngal dang bud med drags/ /rkang gis ⑩lam du 'gro 111—401

ba 'am/ /bzhon pas drag tu bskyod 'gyur yin/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde tshad 'khru/ /gzhang 'brum lto ba'i nad dang ni/ /mngal nas khrag zag ①rims kyis btab/ /gsud dang chu ser slon nyes dang / /sbrum ma dang ni me dbal gyi/ /nad dang skya rbab dag gis btab/ /gzhan ②yang log par gsos gyur pa'i/ /nad de brang du gnas na ni/ /stod skrang ④chu sor gnas smad skrang / /dbus ④na gnas pa rab tu skrang / /yan lag kun khyab thams cad skrang / /nying lag la brten de skrang ⑤byed/ /de yi sngon tshul rtsa rnams tsha/ /yan lag snyom ༷par byed pa yin/ /rlung las skrang mepa 'pho zhing rtsub/ / spu rtsub ⑧smug cing gnag pa dang / /pags 'khums 'dar brtse reg na na⑨/ /na zhing zug pa be+em bem ⑩po/ /myur bar ldang zhing myur du zhi ⑪/ /skrangs pa mnan na dma' bar 'gyur/ /snum dang dro bas mnyes ⑫na zhi/ /mtshan mo ⑫chung zhing nyin mo che/ /pags pa yungs gar lde gu yis/ /bskus ltar tsha ba tsag tsag byed/ /mkhris pa rtsa ser dmar la gnag /spu ni dmar ser gyur pa dang / /myur du ldang dang zhi mi 'gyur/ /dang por dbus su byung dang srab//skom bcas tsha zhing rims 'debs rngul/ /mnam zhing 'drul la snum (stemago 'khor—/ /bsil bag 'dod cing thur du 'khru/ /dri mnam reg na mi bzod 'jamarka/ /bad kan g.ya' spu pags pa dkar/ /mkhrang zhing bsil la lci ba dang / /snum zhing 'jam la brten spyozhing 'thas/ /gnyid che slon zhing me drod nyams—/ /mnan na mi 'bying ()ldang dka' zhing / /zhi dka' ⑩mtshan mo skrangs ⑫tshabs che/ /'od ma gtsags bu stsogs dral ⑪yang / /khrag mi 'byung bar spyin bag 'dzag /dro dang reg pa la mngon dga'/ /gnyis 'byung 111—402

gsum po rang ji bzhin/ /rgyu dang mtshan ma 'dren ma yin/ /'dus pa kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /mtshon las stsogs pas nad ①gyur zhing / /bcad dam dbral lam smas ②la stsogs/ /kha ba me dang rgya mtsho'i rlung / /bse rtsi ka pi ka ④chu yi/ /khu ba gra ma stsogs reg pas/ /skrang rjopa mched par 'gyur ba yin/ /shin tu tsha zhing dmar bar snang / /phal cher mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /dug skyes srog chags dug can ni/ /lus la song dang gcin gyis phog /srog chags dug med pa yi yang / /so dang mche ba sen mos zug /gcin rtug khu bas smos pa dang / /dri ma can gyi ⑤gos kyis reg /dug shing rlung la reg pa dang / /dbyeg dug phye mas reg las byung / /mnyen zhing g.yo la 'phyang ba dang / /myur gsod tsha zhing na bar byed/ /'or nad gsar byung bla brnan 0med/ /gso sla gso spyodaka' sngar bshad zin/ /me dbal nad dang snad pa'i bar/ /gnod pa 'or nad mtshungs pa yin/ /de ni phyi nang gnyi ga ste/ /gsum na gnas pa yin par bshad/ /phyi ma bzhin du gso bar dka'/ /de la nad ni ji bzhin du/ /'khrugs pa'i rgyu yis ldang gyur la/ /khyad par du ni tsha ba yis/ /lus la myur du mched par byed/ /de yang nang gnas nang du mched/ / phyir gnas ⑧phyir mched gnyi gar gnas/ /gnyi gar mched par byed pa yin/ /de la nang na gnas pa ni/ /gnad rnams tsha gdung myos par byed/ /bu ga rnams la gnod pa dang / /skom dad rab che gcin nad stsogs/ /mi snyoms par ni 'byung ba dang / /me drod myur ⑨nyams las shes bya/ /phyi rol de las bzlog pa yin/ /de la rlung gyur me dbal ni/ /rlung gi rims dang nad thabs 'dra/ /skrang zhing 'gul la ⑩zug 111—403

pa dang / /yan lag snyom zhing ba spu brtse①/ /mkhris gyur ⑦myur du mched cing 'gro—/ /mkhris rims rtags ldan shin tu dmar/ /bad kan las g.ya' reg na 'jam/ /bad kan las byung rims 'dar na/ /me dbal stsogs kun yal bar bor/ /rang gi nad tshul bsags gyur na/ /de ni smin rdol rang rang gi/ /me dbal rma yi mtshan nyid 'dzin/ /rlung mkhris la ni rims 'debs slon/ /brgyal zhing tshad 'khru skom mgo 'khor/ /rus tshigs chag snyam me drod nyams/ /mun zhugs snyam sems yi ga 'chus/ /yan lag thams cad me mdag ni/ /'bar bas khyab pa lta bur tsha/ /phyogs ni gang dang gang du mched/ /khyab pas ①yan lag de dang de/ /me mdag zhi ba ltar gnag pa'am/ /sngo ba'am dmar bas khyab byed la/ /mes bubasregs lta bur chu bur 'byung / /myur du mched cing khyab par byed/ /gnad kyi rjes 'jug me dbal ni/ /de nas stobs rab skyes pa'i rlung / /yan lag na zhing dran pa stor/ /gnyid yar dbugs kyi rngam pa drag /skyigs bus 'debs shing 'di lta bu'i/ /gnas skabs des ni thob par 'gyur/ /sa dang mal khri stan stsogs la⑤/ /gang du'ang bde ba mi 'thob cing / /'gre zhing sdug bsngal myong ba dang / /lus sems ngal las byung ba yisarjo/ /gnyid kyi rmongs bag sad dka' ba/ /de ni mi 'dra'i me dbal yin/ /bad kan gyis ni bkag pa'i rlung / /bad kan de rdol ④mang du phye/ /khrag 'phel ba yis khrag brtol ⑧te/ /pags pa chu ba sha la gnas/ /gnod byas ⑨thor bu phra zhing rim⑩/ /zlum zhing sbom la sra ba yi/ /mdzer thotrepa'i phreng ba chags byed cing / /mdog dmar rab na rims kyis 'debs—/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde tshad 'khru/ /kha skam skyigs bu slon mgo 111—404

'khor / /rmongs bag mdog nyams brgyal dang lus/ /yan lag na zhing me drod nyams/ /de ltar mdzer ①pa'i me dbal ni④/ /bad kan rlung 'khrugs las gyur yin/ /bad kan mkhris las ④rims 'debs rengs/ /gnyid che slon bag klad pa na/ /yan lag na zhing bya rmyang rjo'adod/ /bla ⑤zhing mgo 'khor yi ga 'chus/ /rtsub cing drod nyams rus chag snyam/ /skom zhing dbang po mi gsal lci/ /be snabs 'khru zhing dang ga bu'akhyel/ /de ni rtsa sbubs rnams su 'go/ /phal cher ma zhu ⑦gnas na zhugs/ /phyogs gcig tu ni rab mi na/ /thor bu ser po dmar po dang / /dkar pos phyogs kun gang bar byed/ /nor bu ltar snang gnag cing snum/ /dri ma can la skrang zhing lci/ /rnag ⑧pa'i zabs che ⑨rab tu tsha/ /reg na 'jig cing rnag ⑩pa dang / /'dam ltar sha ni zhig gyur cing ⑩/ /rtsa rgyus gsal bar snang ba yin/ /mi yi ro ltar mnam ⑫me dbal/ /de ni 'dam 'dra zhes byar bshad/ /kun skyes mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /lus ⑫zungs kun la rab khyab byed/ /phyi yi rgyu yi smas ⑫las 'khrugs| /khrag bcas mkhris pa skyed spyobyed de/ /me dbal du ni rlung gis byed—/ /rgya sran ku lat+tha ⑩'dra ba'i/ /'brum bus khyab skrang ⑩rims 'debs na⑫—/ /shin tu tsha la dmar zhing sngo/ /nad dmigs tha dad las gyur gsum/ /gnyis gyur bla brnan ⑪med gso be+e/ /rma dang 'dus pa las 'byung stsodang / /thams cad gnad ni khyab pa dang / /rtsa dang chu ba sha 'drul ⑪dang / /mi ro'i dri 'dra rul gso dka'/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gsum pa'o// //111—405

de nas mdze nad dang sha bkra dang gzi gu dang srin bu'i nad gzhi bshad par bya'o—/ /kha zas spyod lam log pa dang / /khyad par du ni mi 'phrod bsten/ /dam pa smod dang srog gcod dang / /gzhan kyi nor 'phrog stsogs bsten dang / /sdig pa'i las ni 'phral byas dang / /sngon chad byas pas nad bslangs ①nas/ /rtsa la thad kar gram nas ni/ /sha dang pags pa chu ser khrag /gnod byas sla bar gyur nas ni/ /de nas phyir ni 'byung 'gyur te/ /pags pa'i mdog ni mi sdug byed/ /mi bzad de ni mdze ru bshad/ /gang phyir dus las yal bar boraske/ /de ni lus kun ma rungs 'gyur/ /lus zungs sdel zhugs nad du khyabaske/ /thams cad 'drul bar byed par 'gyur/ /rngul ①bcas rul zhing mnam dhipa dang / /srin bu phra mo mi bzad skyed/ /spu lpags ⑤chu ba rtsa chen dang / /rus pa snyi ba rim dubazhin za/ /de bas sha bkra phyi rol te/ /mje las gzhan ni yin par bshad/ /nad gzhi tha dad 'dres pa dang / /'dus gyur mdze nad rnam pa bdun/ /kun kyang nyes gsum las byung yang / /de las lhag pa las ming 'dogs/ /rlung gi mje ni thod pa 'dra/ /mkhris gyur u dus+thā ⑦ra ste/ /bad kan las gyur zlum glang shu/ /rlung mkhris las skyes ri sh+ya'i ⑧lce/ /bad rlung las byung pags pa gcig⑨ /'brum phran dang ni sha bkra dang / /'bras byer chu ser zhig po'o⑩/ /bad kan mkhris pa las byung ba//shu ba rma kha brgya ⑪pa dang / /pad+ma dkar po 'brum bur bcas/ /g.yan pa pags pa myags pa'o/ /'dus pa las gyur 'ol ma se/ /dang po'i gsum dang shu ba dang / /'ol ma se dang pad+ma dkar/ /ri sh+ya'i lce zhes bya ba ⑫ste/ /'di bdun mdze nad chen po yin/ /mdze nad sngar byung ⑫mtshan ma ni/ /shin 111—406

tu 'jam pa'am reg na rtsub/ /rngul 'byung mi 'byung mdog mi sdug /lus tsha g.ya' zhing pags tshor med/ /thor bu phra'u ①mtho ba dang / /rma ni lhag par gzer ba dang / /myur du 'byung zhing ring du gnas/ / 'tshobs pa ④dag kyang rtsub par 'gyur④/ /rgyu chung gis kyang nad cher ldang / /ba spu brtse dhizhing khrag mdog gnag /thod pa lta bu gnag cing smug /rtsub sra tshor ba chung la srab/ /khyab cing mtha' ma mi mnyam la/ /ba spu langs pas khyab par byed—/ /shin tu zug cing g.ya' ba chung / /myur du khyab byed jod pa 'dra/ /u dus+thā ⑤ra smin pa ltar/ /pags spu sgrug rtsa dkar bas khyab/ /shas cher mthug rjodang shas cher 'drul/ /tsha ba'i nad dang khrag shas cher⑦/ /myur du smin cing 'drul bar byed/ /'bu can u duswā ⑧ra yin/ /brtan zhing 'thas la phyi zhing 'jam/ /dkar dmar myur du mi mched la/ /phan tshun 'dab ⑨'brel shu ba slon⑩/ /g.ya' zhing rnag che 'bus gang la/ /mtha' ma 'jam zhing ser por snang / /gor gor por ⑪gnas zlum po yin/ /g.ya' zhing phra ⑫tsag gnag pa dang / /chu ser mang ba glang shu yin/ /rtsub cing srab la mtha' ma dmar/ /nad na gnag cing mtho ba dang / /zug cing tsha la na zhing rnags⑫/ /'brum bu rtsub pos khyab pa dang / /ri sh+ya'i lce ni dbyibs 'dra ba/ /'bu mang ri sh+ya'i lce 'drar bshad/ /glang po'i lpags 'dra reg rtsub lpags④/ /gcig pur bshad la gzhi che ba⑫/ /rngul mi 'byung zhing nya lpags 'dra/ /'brum bu phra mo thug thug po/ /reg na rtsub dang ldan pa dang / /g.ya' zhing sra la gnag ⑩pa yin/ /sha bkra nang rtsub phyi rol 'jam/ /phrugs na glog ⑩pa 'byung ba dang / /reg na 'jam zhing srab pa ⑫la/ /ku ba'i me tog ltar dmar dkar⑩/ /phal 111—407

cher ro stod dag tu 'byung / /rmen bu dmar po g.ya' dang ldan/ /khyab par byed pa'i ①'bras zhes bya/ /rkang pa lag pa ②gas pa dang / /mi bzad na zhing g.ya' ④tshabs chung / /rkang lag zhig pa zhes bya'o/ /thor bu dmar pos khyab pa dang / /ring du mched cing drur rjob 'dra/ /pags pa zar ma'i me tog 'dra / /g.ya' zhing brtan par gnas pa dang / /zlum por byung ba ⑤shu ba yin/ /rtsa ba sbom zhing tsha bcas na/ /dmar zhing sgrug la rma kha mang / / rnag cing 0'bu mang kha brgya pa/ /phal cher kun tu skye ba yin/ /mtha' ma dmar zhing dbus na dkar/ /g.ya' tsha na dang bcas pa dang / /mtho zhing ri mo brtan pas khyab/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar rgyas shing / /stug cing chu ser khrag mang la//phal cher myur rdol ④pad dkar yin/ /pags pa srab pa'i 'brum bu dkar/ /dmar bas gang ba 'brum bu yin/ / g.ya' ba'i ⑧nad ni g.ya' ba dang / /'drul zhing lhag par na ba dang / /'brum pa phra stinag mang po ni/ /phal cher rkub lag gru mor 'byung / /thor bu bcas shing reg mi bzod/ /g.ya' zhing dro tsha na dang bcas/ /dmar la pags pa myags pa yin/ /'ol ma se ni rab tsha na/ /stod ni dmar zhing gnag pa ste/ /'ol ma se yi 'bras bu 'dra/ /mdze yi mtshan ma kun dang ldan/ /de bas kha dog du mar 'gyur/ /mdze nad nad gzhi shas che ba/ /nad dbye shes las bshad pa yi/ /mtshan ma las kyis bstan pa yi/ /nad kun rgyas pa las byung dang / /gang yang 'chi ltas las bshad dang / /rus rkang khu chu la gnas spang ⑩/ /tshil la gnas pa 'tsho ba tsamaske/ /mkhris 'dres sha khrag gnas gso dka'/ /rlung dang bad kan las gyur dang / /pags gnas nad gcig gyur gso sla/ /de la pags par gnas 111—408

pa'i mdze/ /zug cing rtsub la mdog mi sdug /khrag gnas rngul 'byung gnyid che sgrang ①/ /sha la gnas pa rkang pa dang / /lag par 'brum bu 'byung ba dang //tshigs gnas lhag par tshigs 'drul skem/ /rkang pa 'jas ④'gyur tshil gnas pa / /yan lag zhig ④par byed par 'gyur/ /rus pa rkang gnas sna zhom buzhing / /mig dmar skad ni 'gags ⑤pa dang / /rma la 'bu zhugs khu bar gnas / /bu dang chung mar bcas la 'byung / /khrag stsogs la ni rim rjobazhin du/ /mtshan ma thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gzi gu mje dang gcig ⑦las 'byung / /de ni sha bkra chu dang ni/ /yongs su 'dzag pa zhes byar bshad/ /nad gzhi gsum la brten zhing ⑧'byung / /rlung las rtsub cing smug pa yin/ /mkhris gyur ⑨pad+ma'i 'dab ltar dmar/ /tsha zhing ba spu 'byi bar byed/ /bad kan las skya stug cing lci/ /g.ya' bcas rim ⑩bzhin khrag dang ni/ /sha dang tshil la brten par bshad/ /'di dag mdog ni gnyi ga yin//de ni phyi ma bzhin gso dka'/ /spu dkar ma yin srab pa dang / /phan tshun ma 'dres gsar du byung ⑪/ /mes ma bsregs pa gso bar be+e/ /de las gzhan pa gso dka' yin/ /mdoms ⑫dang lag mthil mchur byung ⑫ba/ /gsar du byung (steyang gso bar dka'/ /nad rnams phal cher zas dang ni/ /mal gcig reg stsogs la brten las⑫/ /thams cad 'go ⑩ste mig nad dang / /mje nad lhag par 'gos pa ⑩yin/ /sha spyobakra gzi gu'i nad bshad nas/ /da ni srin bu'i nad bshad bya⑩/ /phyi dang nang gi dbye ba yis/ /srin bu rnam pa gnyis su bshad/ /phyi yi dri mas ⑥bad kan khrag /bshang skyes dbye bas rnam bzhi yin/ /ming las rnam pa nyi shur 'gyur/ /de la ⑪phyi yi khrag las 111—409

byung / /tshad dbyebs mdog ni til 'bru 'dra/ /skra dang gos la brten pa yin//phra zhing rkang pa mang la ming / /shig dang sro ma zhes bya'o/ /gnyi gas thor bu 'brum bu dang / /g.yan pa dag ni skyed par 'gyur/ /nang gi mdze ①dang rgyu gcig ste/ /de las bad kan las mang skye/ /zas mngar bu ram 'o ma dang / /tsha sdedang 'bras sar chan la dga'/ /mi gtsang byung bcas bshang lam snenas/ /lo ma 'dab ma la stsogs dga'arjo/ /bad kan ma zhu'i gnas su 'byung ⑤/ /skyes nas kun du 'gro ba yin/ /la la 'byeng ba 'dra ba yin/ /la la srin bu khol rjom 'dra/ /kha cig myu spyogu 'bus pa 'dra/ /phra zhing ring la chung ba dang / /dkar zhing dmar bar snang ba yin/ /de yi ming ni rnam bdun te/ /rgyu ma zad dang lto nang 'khyil/ /snying za ya mtshan chen po dang / /mi mngon rgyu dang 'jag ma 'dra/ /dri zhim zhes bya de rnams ni/ /snying 'phar ⑧kha chu 'dzag pa dang / /zas mi 'ju zhing yi ga 'chus/ /brgyal zhing mi dran rims 'debs slon—/ /skom ⑨zhing sprid pa cham pas 'debs/ /khrag rgyu ba yi rtsa nang nas/ /khrag las byung ba'i sren bu phra⑩/ /zlum zhing rkang med zangs ltar dmar/ /phra zhing la lar bltar ⑪mi snang / /skra rtsa za zhing spu 'byi ⑫byed/ /sru gling u dus+thā ⑫ra 'dra/ /zhags pa bcas dang thong ka ste/ /drug po de dag mje las gcig /zhu ba'i gnas su mi gtsang skyes/ /'phel ⑫nas thur du rgyu bar byed/ /de ni cher 'phel gyur pa (nyen/ /gang tshe ma zhu'i gnas su zhugs/ /de tshe sgregs ⑩pa dbugs 'byung ba/ /phyi sa lta bur mnam par 'gyur/ /zlum zhing lus phra sbom po dang / /sgrug dang ser dang dkar dang gnag /srin bu de ming rnam lnga ste/ /kham gyi zas dang dal gyis 'gro/ /myong ⑩bar byed dang brkam 111—410

pa dang / /lus la gnod byed ces bya'o/ /des 'khru gzer dang rtug skam byed//skem zhing mdog ni skya ba dang / /ba spu ldang ①zhing me drod nyams/ /lci g.ya' gzhang ni phyir 'byung byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas kyi ④le'u bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas rlung nad kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /rlung ni phan dang gnod byed la/ /'di ni sna tshogs rgyu gcig pu/ /khyad par du ni lus kyi ni/ /nad dang nad med rgyu gcig pu/ /de ni kun byed kun bdag nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs can skye dgu'i bdag /'byin byed 'dzin byed khyab 'jug gtso/ /snyud byed 'chi bdag gshin rjer 'gyur/ /de bas de ldang mi 'gyur bar/ /rtag tu 'bad pa nyid du gyis//de yis ①tha mal gzhan gyur las/ /nad kyi bye brag shes par bshad/ /bsdus dang rgyas pa de'i ⑦ming gnas/ /rgyu ba'i lam ni re re lnga/ /nad tshul shes par bshad pa yin/ /'dir ni nad kyi ⑤rnam gyur pa/ /de yi dbye ba nad gzhi dang / /mtshan nyid bcas pa nyid du bshad/ /grangs med kyang ni brgyad cu yi/ /grangs su sngar ④ni bshad pa yin/ /lus zungs zad ⑦byed bsten drags pas/ /rlung ni 'khrugs par byed 'gyur te/ /spu gu stong par rgyu gyur pa/ /de nyid ⑧shin tu 'gengs par byed/ /nad gzhan gyis ni gang ba der/ /khebs pas mthu can nyid du 'gyur/ /de la zhu ba'i gnas su zhugs/ /gzer dang rgyu ma sgra bcas sgo/ /bshang 'gags rde'u nad gzhang 'brum skye/ /rgyab dang rked pa mjug mdor ⑨na/ /ro smad kyi ni phyogs de ru/ /mi bzad gnod pa de de skyed/ /ma zhu'i gnas zhugs skom dad slon/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde gsud nad/ /sgog ma 'gags shing 111—411

sgregs ①mang na/ /lte ba yan chad skyed par byed/ /rna ba stsogs zhugs dbang por gnod/ /pags zhugs gas shing rtsub par byed/ /khrag zhugs gnyid stug mi bzad na/ /tsha zhing dmar la mdog mi sdug /thor 'byung kha zas sra bar gnasaske/ /yi ga 'chus skom ④mgo 'khor na①/ /sha tshil la gnas rmen bu dang / /rab tu zug cing lus rtsub la/ /lus lci rab na rengs pa dang / /khu tshur dbyig rjopas phog snyam byed/ /rus gnas brla dang rus tshigs na/ /mi bzad gzer zhing nyams stobs zad/ /rkang gnas rus pa khong stong zhing / /gnyid med rtag tu na ba yin/ /khu bar gnas pa myur 'byung la⑤/ /'gags pa'am mdog 'gyur nyid du 'gyur/ /mngal gyi khu bar gnas de bzhin/ /rtsa rnams stong zhing rjosbo bar 'gyur/ /chu bar gnas pa gzugs 'jas ⑦dang / /sgur ⑧dang da rgan nad du 'gyur/ /tshigs la gnas pa'i rlung skrang ⑨pa/ /rkyal pa rlung gis gang reg 'dra/ /brkyang dang bskum par byed pa yis⑩ /bskyod pa na tutredang bcas par 'gyur/ /yan lag kun la brten pa ni/ / zug chag ⑫snyam sems 'gul ⑫ba dang / /rengs dang tshor ba med pa dang / /tshigs 'khums 'dar bar byed par 'gyur/ /gang tshe rtsa chen kun la gnas/ /yang dang yang du 'khrugs gyur pa/ /de tshe yan lag la 'jug ④pas/ /nad ni lus la 'jug ces bya/ /ro smad du ni 'gag ⑫pa'i rlung / /gyen du song ste snying gar gnas/ /snying ga'i sbu gur zhugs nas ni/ /mgo bo ⑩yan lag bcas par zug /lus ni kun du zhugs gyur nas/ /de ni gzhu ltar sgu ⑩bor byed/ /dbugs 'byin dka' zhing mig rengs har/ /lhod cing 'dzums par byed 'gyur la/ /de nas phug ron lta bur 'khun/ /dran pa med de 111—412

gzhan dbang can/ /de nyid a ba ta nar bshad/ /rlung gis snying ni btang gyur ①na/ /skad cig tsam du bde la reg /slar zhugs na ni na bar byed/ /de ni mngal 'jig las byung ④dang / /khrag ni lhag par 'dzag gyur dang / /snad pa dag las byung gyur pa/ /shin tu gso bar dka' bar 'gyur/ /mjing pa rengs pa'i rlung zhugs shing / /gang tshe rtsa chen la gnas pa/ /lus kun khyab par gyur pa na/ /de tshe nam tshong 'gugs par byed/ /lus ni gzhu ltar nang du gug /mig rengs shugs ni 'byin par byed/ /glal 'byung so ni 'cha' ba dang / /bad kan skyugs ①par byed par 'gyur/ /rtsib logs zug cing tshig mi 'thon0/ /'gram pa rgyab dang mgo bo na/ /'di ni nang du gug ces bya/ /phyi yi de dang 'dra ba la/ /lus ni phyir dgyed ⑤byed pa dang / /mgo bo rgyab tu 'dren byed cing / /de la brang ni shin tu 'bur/ /gnya' ba bcom pa ltar na zhing / /so dang kha ni mdog mi sdug /rngul zhing lus ni lhod par byed/ /phyir dgyed bugazhu rengs zhes bya zhing / /de la shugs drag ces kyang bshad/ /gnad la gnas pa'i rmar zhugs te/ /rlung gis bskyod par gyur pa dang / /rkang pa nas ni mgo bo'i bar/ /lus la nad kyis khyab byed pa/ /skam zhing lus ni skya gyur pa/ /rma yi da rgan de spang bya/ /lus la 'jug pa'i ⑦rlung kun ni/ /shugs dang bral nas ⑦bde bar 'gyur/ /lce ni brud ⑨drags skam zos gnod/ /'gram pa'i rtsa bar gnas rlung 'khrugs/ /'gram pa gnyis ni bskyod byas nas/ /kha ni gdangs par byed pa'am/ /yang na 'dzums par byed par 'gyur/ /'gram pa nyams par byed pa des/ /za dang smra ba dka' bar 'gyur/ /smra bar byed pa'i rtsa gnas rlung / /lce ni 111—413

ldibs par byed 'gyur zhing / /bye ldibs des ni bza' btung dang / /smra ba la sogs mi nus 'gyur/ /mgo bos khur ni khyen ba dang / /dgod ①drags mang du smra ba dang / /sngangs dang gcus te dz+red pa gtong / /gzhu sra 'dren par byed pa dang / /sngas ④ni mi mnyam la nyal dang / /sra ba 'cha' bar byed pa dang / / rlung skyed pa ni de dang des/ /①rlung 'phel ro stod la zhugs nas/ /gdong gi rjogazhogs phyed yon por byed/ /smra ba dgod dang lta ba'ang yo/ /de nas de yi mgo 'gul zhing / /tshig mi phyin la mig rengs shing / /so 'gul skad ni 'gags pa dang / /sgra mi thos shing sprud pa thogs/ /dri mi tshor zhing dran nyams rmongs/ /gnyid log pa na dngang ⑤bar 'gyur/ /mchil ma g.yon du 'dor rjob dang / /mig gcig 'dzums par 'gyur ba dang / /nam tshong yan chad mi bzad na/ /gzhogs phyed dag gam ro smad na/ /la las ⑦de gzhogs phyed nad ⑧bshad/ /gzhan dag phyogs gcig gug ⑨ces zer/ /rlung ni khrag la brten gyur te/ /spyi bo 'dzin pa'i rtsar zhugs pa/ /rtsub cing nad bcas mdog gnag byed/ /rtsa 'dzin de ni gsor mi rung / /rlung gis de la gzhogs phyed bzung / /rtsa dang rgyus pa bskams byas nas/ /gzhogs phyed gang yang rung la gnod/ /tshigs kyi dz+rel ⑩mtshams lhod par byed/ /de yis ⑪lus phyed thams cad ni/ /las sbyor mi nus tshor ba med/ /de ni phyogs gcig nad ces zer/ /gzhan dag phyogs gcig bskams par ⑫'chad/ /lus kun rlung nad de dang 'dra/ /yan lag kun la brten pa yin/ /rlung nad nyi tshes gzhogs phyed bskams/ /shin tu gso dka' yin par bshad/ /gzhan dang 'dres pa'ang gso dka' yin/ / zad byed rgyu ⑫can spang bar bya④//111—414

ma zhu bad kan ldan pa yis/ /rgyun srang bkag ste lus rengs pas/ /brkyang bskum kun las nyams 'gyur ba/ /shing 'dra shing ltar rengs pa yin/ /phrag pa'i rtsa bar zhugs pa'i rlung / /der ①gnas rtsa ni 'khums byas te/ /dpung pa bskyod par mi nus byed/ /dpung pa 'jas pa'i rlung nad yin/ /gang zhig lag mthil sor mor 'brel/ /chu ba rgyab tu 'khums byed cing / /lag ngar bya ba nyams byed pa/ /rlung de bi sha tse ④ru bshad/ /gang tshe rlung ni rked par gnas—/ /brla yi chu ba'i nang du zhugs/ /de tshe mi de 'theng ①por 'gyur/ /brla gnyis la zhugs 'phye bor 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'gro bar rtsom rjopa na/ /lus 'dar 'theng ⑤po ltar 'gro ba/ /tshigs kyi stel mtshams lhod gyur pa/ /de ni sran ma'i 'theng rjopor bshad/ /kha zas dro grang skam rlon 'dres/ /lci dang snum ches bsten pa dang / /zhu dang ma zhu mi bdes bskyod/ /nyin nyal mtshan gnyid ma log pas/ /ma zhu shin tu stsogs 'gyur te/ /gal te brla nang zhugs gyur ⑦na/ /bad kan tshil dang rlung bcas pa/ /nad gzhan zil gyis mnan nas ni/ /brla rus nang du gang byas te/ /bad kan gyis te rengs gyur la/ /de tshe de yis brla rengs byed/ /'degs mi nus grang ⑧tshor ba med/ /gzhan gyi ⑨yin snyam sems shing lci/ /mi bzad par ni 'gro ba nyams—/ /sems khong ⑩chud cing yan lag na/ /snyom ⑪slon rims 'debs yi ga 'chus/ /rkang pa sgyid zhan 'degs pa dka'/ /bem be+em por 'dug ldan pa yin/ /de ni bla ⑫rengs nad ces bshad/ /gzhan dag phyug po'i rlung zhes zer/ / rlung dang ⑫khrag las skyes pa'i ④skrang / /pus mo'i steng byung nad tshabs che/ /ce spyang mgo ltar sbom gyur pa/ /ce spyang mgo 'dra yin zhes 111—415

bya—/ /rkang pa na zhing mi mnyam 'dor/ /ngal ba las ①ni gang tshe rlung / /long mor gnas te nad skyed pa/ /de ni rlung nad tsher mar bshad/ /rting pa sor mor 'brel pa yi/ /chu bar rlung gis gnod gyur snegang / /brla nas ①'jug par byed pa de/ /gzugs 'khums zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /bi sha tsi dang gzugs 'khums bshad/ /mi bzad na ba kha lir bshad/ /gang gi rkang pa brtsi 'gyur dhizhing / /bem bem por ni gyur pa dag /bad kan rlung 'khrugs las gyur pa/ /rkang pa brtse ⑤bar de bshad do/ /mkhris pa khrag dang bcas pa'i rlung / /rkang pa gnyis su tsha byed cing / /khyad par du ni 'gro tshe tsha//de ni rkang tsha zhes byar bshad/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/nad gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcwa lnga pa'o// //de nas dreg nad kyi nad gzhi bshad par bya'o/ /khrag ni 'khrugs par byed pa'i zas/ /tsha ba dang ni mi 'phrod padu/ /bsten dang sbyor ba log pa dang / /nyin nyal mtshan gnyid ma log dang / /nyal bo drags dang skyid par gnasaske/ /'chags ⑦pa'i spyod pa ma bsten dang / /snad dang sbyang ba ma byas pasaske/ /mi yi khrag ni 'khrugs 'gyur zhing / /rlung skyed zos pas rlung nad ni/ /'phel bas 'khrugs te lam gzhan zhugs/ /de bzhin khrag kyang lam 'gags la//dang por gnod par 'gyur ba yin/ /de ni phyug po'i rlung nad dang / /'theng ⑧nad stobs 'jig rlung khrag 'dres/ /ming du de ni rnam par bshad/ /de yang dang por rkang par rgyu/ /mchog tu bzhon sogs mchongs las byung ⑨//de yi 'byung 'gyur mtshan nyid ni/ /mdze ni 'byung 'gyur mtshan mar mtshungs/ /111—416

de bzhin lus nyams yan lag lhod/ /pus mo byin pa brla rked pa/ /lag pa rkang pa'i ①tshigs rnams su/ /g.ya' zhing 'gul dang na ba dang / /chag snyam ⑤sems shing tshor med phyi/ /yang dang yang du ldang ba dang / /be+er yang zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rkang pa gnyis kyi rtsa bar gnas/ /lan 'ga' lag pa dag tu ④gnas/ /byi ba'i dug ni ldang ba ltar/ /lus kun la ni khyab par 'gyur/ /thog mar pags pa khrag la gnas/ /byung ba rtogs par bla zhes bya/ /de nas rim kyis ④lus zungs kun/ /khyab ste rtogs par dka' zhes bya/ /rtogs sla pags g.ya' la sogs ldan/ /zangs ltar dmar dang sngo ba dang / /bya rmyang ⑤bcas shing rab dro rjotsha/ / rtogs dka' sngar ⑦bas lhag par na/ /skrang ⑧zhing mkhrang la tshos par byed/ /gzhang dang tshigs dang rus pa rkang / /bcad snyam sems shing nang du rgyu/ /shugs dang ldan tshe sgur po dang / /zha bo ⑨'theng por byed 'gyur la/ /lus ni kun du rgyu ba yin/ /de la rlung shas che gyur na⑩/ /gzer 'gul zug pa'i shas che zhing / / skrang ba ⑩rtsub cing gnag pa dang / /sngo zhing 'phel zhing 'bri bar 'gyur/ /rtsa chen sor mo'i tshigs rnams ni/ /'khums shing lus bcum bzhin du na/ /grang la mi dga' reg na bde—/ /rengs shing 'dar la tshor ba med/ /khrag shas che skrang rab tu zug /dmar zhing tsha ba tseg tseg ⑫byed/ /snum dang rtsub pas zhi mi 'gyur/ /g.ya' dang 'drul bar ldan pa yin/ /mkhris gyur ⑫tsha zhing rmongs bag dang / /rngul zhing brgyal myos skom dad che/ /reg mi bzod cing na la dmar/ /skrang zhing smin la shin tu bro④/ /bad kan gyis 'gul mi shes lci/ /tshor med snum zhing grang ⑫ba dang / /g.ya' zhing cung zad na ba yin/ /'dres pa'i ⑩mtshan nyid 111—417

'dren ma ①yin/ /nad gcig las byung gsar gso sla/ /nad gnyis las byung 'tsho ba tsam/ /'dus pa las byung chu ser 'dzag /rengs dang thor bu 'phyang ba spang ④/ /rlung ni yan lag tshigs gnas pa/ /khrag gi lam la myur gnod byed/ /de gnyis phan tshun 'dres gyur pa'i/ /nad kyis srog ni 'phrog par byed/ /lnga yi bdag nyid can rlung las/ /srog rtsub drag shul smyung ba dang / /'grangs ①drags snad dang lam gyis dub/ /shugs bkag nan gyis bcing ba yis/ /'khrugs nas rjomig la sogs pa la/ /nye bar gnod pa skyed byed cing / /cham pa nyam thag skom lud pa/ /dbugs mi bde sogs nad mang skyed/ /stod rgyu sprid pa sgregs ⑤pa dang / /skyugs rjopa gnyid ni bkag pa dang / /khur lci 'degs dang drag tu ngu / /dgod ⑦drags sogs kyis nad 'khrugs te/ /mgul pa 'gags shing sems nyams la/ /cham 'debs slon zhing yi ga 'chus/ /mgul par lba ba sogs skyed cing / /nam 'tshong yan chad ⑧brten nad skyed/ /khyab byed 'gro dang 'dug drags dang / /rtsed mo drags dang mi bzod ⑨spyod/ /kha zas mi mthun rtsub 'jigs dga'/ /yi mug sogs kyis 'khrugs ⑩par 'gyur/ /khu ba stobs dang spro ba nyams/ /skrang 7dang sems g.yengs rims kyis 'debs/ /yan lag kun la ⑫zug pa dang / /spu brtse ⑫yan lag tshor ba med/ /mdze dang me dbal gzhan yang ni/ /lus kun khyab pa'i nad skyed 'gyur/ /mnyam gnas 'du ba ma snyoms dang / /grang dang 'dren ma'i zas zos dang / /dus min gnyid log mtshan mo ni/ /gnyid ma log la sogs kyis 'khrugs/ /gzer dang skran dang pho nad sogs/ /zhu dang ma zhur gnas nad skyed/ /thur sel zas ni rtsub dang ⑫lci/ /shugs 111—418

bkag pa dang mi srun bzhon/ /khyogs dang bzhon dang stan gnas dang / /'gro ba bsten ni drags pa yis/ /'khrugs nas gso bar dka' ①ba'i nad/ /zhu ba'i gnas la brten pa skyed/ /gcin dang khu chu'i nad gzhang 'brum/ /gzhang 'byung ⑧la sogs mang po skyed/ /rlung kun ma zhur ldan pa ni/ /snyom dang 'gul mi shes khong lci/ /snum dang sgyid zhan yi ga 'chus/ /grang skran me drod nyams byed cing / /tsha dang rtsub pa mngon 'dod cing / /de zos bde 'gyur las shes bya/ /ma zhu ba dang mi ldan pa/ /snyom sogs go ni bzlog pa yin—/ /de nas rlung gis ④'dres pa yi④/ /dbye ba mang por shes ⑤par bya/ /mkhris pas 0'dres rtags tsha ba dang / /skom gzer mgo 'khor mun 'thibs byed—/ /tsha dro ⑦sgyur dang lan tshwa bro/ /tsha zhing grang ba 'dod pa yin/ /bsil zhing khong lci gzer ba dang / /tsha ba ⑧sogs zos ⑨smyung ba dang / /rtsol dang rtsub pas lhag par bde/ /drod ⑩'dod bad kan ldan pa yin/ /khrag bcas tsha zhing na dang bcas/ /pags pa'i sha nad shin tu zug /skrang pa mdog dmar 'gyur ba dang / /thig le dmar po 'byung ba yin/ /sha dang 'dres pa mkhrang ba dang / /mdog 'gyur 'brum bu phra mo 'byung / /spu brtse ⑪lus la grog ma ni/ /rgyu ba snyam du sems par 'gyur/ /tshil dang 'dres pa gso dka' dang ⑫/ /g.yo zhing snum la 'jam grang ⑫bar/ /lus la skrang zhing yi ga 'chus/ /de ni phyug po'i rlung nad yin/ /rus pa dang ldan reg na tsha/ /btsir na mngon par dga' ba dang / /khab kyis rab tu gtsags ⑫snyam byed/ /yan lag na zhing zug pa yin/ /rkang dang ldan la lus sgu ⑫zhing / /glal mang dkris pa snyam du sems/ /rab tu na la lag gnyis kyis/ /btsir na bde 111—419

bar 'gyur ba yin/ /khu ba dang 'dres drag tu 'byung / /yang na mi 'byung 'bras bu med/ /zas 'dres khong par ma zhu na/ /zhu nas nad de bde bar 'gyur—/ /gcin dang rlung 'dres lgang pa sbo/ /gcin ni 'gags par byed par 'gyur/ /bshang 'dres thur du 'byung ba ①'gag /rang gi gnas su yongs su gcod/ /snum zos myur du 'ju bar 'gyur/ /zas zos lto ni sbos pa dang / /zas kyis bshang ba phul nas ni/ /na zhing skom po rnyog can 'byung / /rlung ni lus zungs ②kun dang 'dres/ /brla dang chu so rgyab tu na/ /rlung ni log snyesong mi bde zhing / /snying ni rab tu na bar byed/ /srog dang mkhris pa 'dres gyur 'khrugs/ /mgo 'khor brgyal dang lus tsha 'gyur/ /legs par ma zhu slon par byed/ /stod rgyu mgo 'khor sogs pa dang / /nang du tsha zhing stobs zad 'gyur/ /khyab byed rmongs bag lus kun ni/ /tsha zhing ngal la lus spyod 'gags/ /lus tsha nad dang bcas pa yin/ /mnyam gnas drod kyis gnod ④rngul che/ /mi dga' skom dad tsha bcas 'gyur/ /thur du sel bas dri ma ni/ /kha dog ser por 'byung ba dang / /zla mtshan cher 'phel mo mtshan dang / /pho mtshan rkub tu tsha bar 'gyur/ /srog ni bad kan 'dres gyur pa/ /lus lhod skom dad yi ga 'chus/ /mchil mang sgregs ⑤pa sprud mang slon/ /dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub thogs pa yin/ /stod rgyu lus ni lci ba dang / /tshig thogs skad 'gags yi ga 'chus/ /stobs dang kha dog nyams par byed/ /khyab byed rus tshigs ④rengs pa dang / /yan lag thams cad lci ba dang / /'gros ni shin tu 'khyor ba yin/ /mnyam gnas yan lag grang ⑦byed cing / /rngul mi 'byung zhing drod chung 'gyur/ /thur sel bshang dang gci ⑧ba ni/ /111—420

bad kan bcas par ①'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar rlung ni gzhan 'brel ba/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis yin zhes bya/ /de bzhin srog la sogs pa'i rlung / /phan tshun rim bzhin 'dres gyur pa/ /kun kyang 'khrugs par gyur pa de/ /nyi shur 'gyur ba yin zhes bya/ /srog dang stod rgyu lhan cig 'khrugs/ /dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub dka' ba dang / /cham 'debs mgo bo na bar byed/ /snying na kha ni skam par 'gyur/ /stod rgyu'i rlung ni srog dang 'dres/ /mdog dang gzi mdangs stobs zad byed/ /phyogs 'dis 'gres ②pa lhag ma rnams/ /sman pas nye bar sbyar bar bya/ /rlung ni gnas dang 'phel dang 'bri/ /las ⑦rnams legs par brtag par bya'o/ /srog la sogs pa lnga po nirjo/ /'khrugs pas ⑤phan tshun 'dres pa yin/ /mkhris pa la sogs bcu gnyis dang / /'dres par 'gyur dhite 'dren ma yin/ /mkhris pa sogs las ⑦'dres de bzhin//'dren ma ⑧rnam pa du ma yin/ /rab dang rab mchog brtags pa yis⑨ /'dres pa grangs med 'gyur ba yin/ /de ni rang gi mtshan nyid dang / /rim gyis bde bar 'gyur ba las/ /rtogs dka' yin te yang yang brtag /ma yengs pas ni shes par bya/ /khyad par srog ni 'tsho ba yin/ /stod du rgyu ba stobs zhes brjod/ /de gnyis gnod par gyur pa las⑩/ /tshe dang stobs ni zad par 'gyur/ /rlung ni 'dres pa ma shes pa'am/ /shes kyang lo gcig lon pa ni/ /'bad kyang gso dka' yin pa 'am/ /gso ba'i thabs ni med pa yin—/ /'dres nad yal bar bor na ni/ /khong 'bras mcher pa snying nad dang / /skran dang me drod nyams la sogs/ / bla brnan ⑪de las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad 111—421

gzhi'i gnas kyi le'u bcu drug pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ nad gzhi'i gnas te gnas gsum pa rdzogs so// //de nas rims nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis 'di skad ces bshad do/ /gang phyir ma zhu gnas ma zhuske/ /rgyun srang bkag ste me drod nyams/ /rim gyis nyes pa skyed byed pas/ /sngon tshul byung ①dang rims sogs la'ang / /de phyir sgyung ba bya ②dgos la/ /stobs ni 'bad pas bsrung bar bya/ /stobs ni nad med pa yi gnas/ /bya ba'i rims ni nad med don/ /sgyung byas snend ni nyam rjosmad cing / /me drod skyed dang khong yang 'gyur/ /bde zhing bkres skom yi ga 'bye/ /zas 'ju stobs dang mdangs skyed 'gyur/ /de la phal cher bad kan nad/ / bslangs dang g.yos par rjogyur pa dang / /dang gar bu'akhyil bcas mchil ma mang / /zas la mi dga' lud pa gsud/ /zos ma thag tu rims 'debs pa/ /khyad par du ni ma zhur 'gyur/ /skyug sman btang 'os skyug sman bsngags/ /de las ④gzhan du byas na ni/ /dbugs mi bde dang tshad 'khru rmongs/ /snying nad mi bzad rims kyis 'debs/ /po son pi pi ling bcas pa/ /dug mo nyung ngam shing mngar ni/ /chu dron sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'am/ /yang na rgyam tshar ldan pa ⑧blud—/ /kar ⑨ka ta 'am pa to la/ /nim pa sba'i lo ma'i chu 'am/ /'bras yos kyi ni skyo ma 'am/ /bu ram shing khu'am chang sbyar btung / /nyams stobs dus ⑩kyi dbye shes pas/ /cho ga'i gnas las bshad pa yi/ /skyug sman dag ni 111—422

rab tu btang / /skyug sman gyi ni sbyor ba dag /byas par gyur tam ma byas kyang / /rims nad can la rnam sbyang bya/ /nad ni bskyod par gyur pa dag /smin dang zhi bar bya phyir bya/ /thal bas g.yogs pa'i me bzhin du/ /ma zhus khebs zas 'ju mi 'gyur/ /de bas nyes pa smin bya'i phyir/ /rims dang ldan la sgyung ba bya/ /rlung dang bad kan rims skom dang / /chu tshan nyung shas nyung shas btung / /des ni bad kan zhu gyur nas/ /skom dad myur du sel bar byed/ /me drod skyed cing bu ga'i rgyun/ /'jam par byas nas sbyong bar byedarka/ /zhen pa'i rlung mkhris rngul dang ni/ /bshang gci bde bar 'byin par byed/ /gnyid rmongs yi ga 'chus pa sel/ /srog ni 'dzin par byed pa yinaske/ /chu grang de las bzlog pa ste/ /nad kyi tshogs ni 'phel byed yin/ /chu tshan yon tan de 'dra yang / /gcig tu mkhris pas ①ldan rims dang / /mkhris shas che dang phyogs gcig tsha/ /kun tsha rmongs bag tshad par 'khru/ / chang dub ⑤las byung so ga dang / /gcong skems snekhrag mkhris can mi blud/ /de la gla sgang tsan+dan dang / /bca' sga par pa ta dang ni/ /pu shel tsi dang ba le rjoka /bskol chu bsgrangs blud rims skom sel/ /mkhris pa med par tsha mi 'byung / /tsha ba med par rims yod min/ /de bas mkhris pa la gnod spang ⑤/ /mkhris shas che bas lhag par spang / /khrus dang bsku dang byug pa dang / /snyung ba lhag ma'ang spang bar bya/ /ma zhu rjogazer 'joms sman lta bur—/ /ma zhu ⑦rims ni mi bzad la/ /sman btung mi bya de yis ni/ /lhag par ma zhu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lto ba ma zhus khyab pa la/ /'o ma sbrul la blud dang mtshungs/ /rlung dang ⑧bad kan bdag nyid der/ /lkog nad cham pa 111—423

dbugs mi bde/ /byin pa tshigs rus gzer gyur la/ /rngul 'byung ba ni rab bsngags te/ /rngul dang bshang gci 'phyen bder 'byung / /me drod skyed cing zas 'ju byed/ /snum 'thung sticho gar bshad pa ni/ /rnam pa kun du spyad ②par bya/ /sgyung dang dugs bya dus dang ni/ /nas thug tig ta'i khu ba rnams/ /dri ma rnams ni smin byed pa/ /rim mam ④gnas skabs ji bzhin sbyinarjo/ /rlung nad nyi tshe zad byed dang / /glo bur ba dang rims rnying la/ /sgyung ba mi bya de la ni/ /nyams mi smad pa'i zhi bya phan/ /de la ma zhu'i rims ldan tshul/ /nyams smad mi byar shes par bya/ /gso ba'i thabs ni gnyis shes las/ /brtags ⑤te smyung ba bya ba yin/ /smyung byas mtshan mar ldan pa ni/ /de la thug sla rjol sogs blud/ /rang gis ⑦sman dang ji bzhin bskol/ /dang por thug sla la sogs sbyin/ /zhag ⑧drug bar du'am ⑨gang tshe rims/ /rtse zhil gyur pa'i bar du sbyin/ /de yis shing gis ⑩me bzhin du/ /de yi ⑪me drod 'phel bar byed/ /dang po ⑫'bras yos thug 'ju sla/ /bca' sga pi pi ling dang bcas—/ /'u su rgyam tshar bcas pa sbyin/ /skyur 'dod se'u 'bru ⑫bcas pa btung / /'khru ba'am mkhris pa mang ba thostel/ /sbrang rtsi bca' sga btab bsgrangs blud/ /chu so rtsib logs glad spyopa gzer/ /gze ma bya kri bskol ba blud—/ /rims 'khrur kṛṇ+ḍa paṇi ⑩dang / /ba la bil ba bca' sga dang / /ut+pal 'u su bskol rims 'khrur/ /thug skyur smin dang drod bskyed yin/ /skyigs bu lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /gzer can rtsa ba chung ngu lnga/ /bad kan gyis nyen nas thug ni/ /rtsa ba chen po lnga pa sbyin/ /rtug pa 'gags la nad bcas pa/ /pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra/ /btab pa'i nas thug mar dang brngos//111—424

dri ma nad ni bde 'byung byed/ /lto bar rtug 'gags nad bcas la/ /dbyi mo ①pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /rgun 'brum snedong ga skyu ru ra/ /khong pa bcad ①pa snyam byed la/ /rgya shug da trig sa la par/ /kṛṣ+ṭa ④paṇi bil ba blud/ /rngul med gnyid med skom pas nyen/ /kha ra dong gra ⑤sgyu ru ra'o/ /rgya shug kha ra rgun 'brum dang / /thal tres gla sgang tsan+dan ni/ /skom dang slon dang bcas pa blud/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa rims 'joms yin/ /de dag thug pa'i sman yin te/ /sha khu yu sha sogs pa'ang sbyar/ /chang las byung dang chang rgyun bsten—/ /bad kan mkhris pa'i gnas zhugs nasarjo/ /de gnyis shas che'am so ga 'am/ /skom dang slon dang tshad pas nyen/ /khrag ni stod du 'byung ba ste//de la thug pa mi blud kyi/ /'bras phye'i skyo ma rims 'joms pa'i⑦/ /'bras bu'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang / /kha ra dkar bcas blud par bya/ /de nas skyo ⑧ma zhu nas ni/ /bkres na nas thug 'bras brngos pa'i/ /'bras chan dag ni bza' bya zhing / /sha khu sla ba'i khu ba 'am⑨/ /muṅga 'ur pa'i khu bcas bza' ⑩de ltar zhag drug 'di bzlas te/ /nyams stobs nad ni bsrung bar bya/ /de nas sgyung ba la sogs pas/ /smin pa'i nad ni lhag ma rnams/ /smin pa'am yang na zhi bya'i phyir/ /sman khu'i ⑪sbyor ba'i bya ba bsngags/ /mkhris la mchog tu kha ba ste/ /bad kan la ni tsha ba blud/ /bad kan mkhris pa sel byed kyang / /bska ba bsngags pa ma yin te/ /rims gsar dri ma 'gags byed pas/ /bska bas mi bzad rims skyed cing / /dang ga 'khyil dang yi ga 'chus/ /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde yang skyed/ /la la zhag bdun nas sman gtong / /gzhan dag zhag ni bcu lon nas/ /kha cig zas yang zos nas gtong / /111—425

ma zhu shas che la mi gtang / /gang phyir mi bzad rims nyen la/ /nad kyi shugs ni 'byung 'gyur ba①/ /ma smin pa la sman gyis ②ni/ /rims ni slar 'phel byed pa 'am/ /nad ni shin tu sogs pa yis④/ /snyom dang rmongs bag skyed par byed/ /gang tshe rims rtse zhil lus yang / /dri ma la sogs g.yos gyur pa/ /rims btab yun ring ma lon yang / /de tshe sman ni sbyin par bya/ /gla sgang par pa tar bcas pa'am/ /bca' sga'am yang na bye rjotsher ba—/ /bskol ba bsgrangs ⑤pa'i khu ba blud/ /pa ta pu shel pa la ka /blud pa'am de bzhin du nim parjo/ /sle tres gla sgang dong gra rnams/ /'di ni ci rigs par blud bya/ /nad smin byed pa'i sman khu ba/ /rims dang skom dad yi ga 'chus/ /khas ro mi tshor ma zhu 'joms/ /dug mo nyung dang pa to la'i/ /lo ma dang ni pu tse ⑦shel/ /pa tol gla ⑧sgang thal tres dang / /pa ta dang ni pu tse ⑨shel/ /pa tol nim pa ⑩'bras bu gsum/ /rgun 'brum gla sgang dug mo nyung / /ki ra tig ta sle tres dang / /bca' sga dang ni tsan+dan dkar/ /sle tres gla sgang sgyu ru sbrang / /tshigs bcad phyed kyis rdzogs byas pa/ /lnga po 'di dag rtag rims sogs/ /lnga po zhi bar byed par 'dod/ /rlung gi rims la byi ⑪tsher ba/ /bca' sga ske tres gla sgang phan/ /yang na pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /sle tres dang ni bca' sga 'am/ /rtsa ⑩ba lnga pa chung ngu phan/ /mkhris rims gla sgang dug ⑫mo nyung / /pu tse shel ni sbrang rtsir bcas/ /de bzhin gla sgang par pa ta/ / byi tsher ④rtsa mkhris bcas pa phan/ /bad kan dug mo nyung sogs sde⑫/ /yang na ba sha ka gla sgang / /bca' sga byi ⑫tsher bskol ba phan/ /pi pi ling rtsa a ru ra/ /dong ga gla sgang pu tse ⑩shel/ /bad kan rlung 'dres bshang 'gags 171—426

pas—/ /na ba smin zhing drod skyed byed/ /rlung mkhris las gyur rims la ni/ /rgun 'brum shing mngar ma du ka /seng phrom tang pal thal tres dang / /gla sgang skyu ru ba lesheka /pad+ma ge sar shug pa dang / /pad rtsa tsan+dan a ②ra//ba ru sha ka ut+pal sngo/ /rgun sogs skyo ma'am bskol bsgrangs pa/ /me tog dzā ti'i dris bsgos te/ /kha ra 'bras yos sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /rlung mkhris rims ni 'joms byed cing / /chang nad slon brgyal tsha mgo 'khor/ /ngal dang stod kyi khrag mkhris nad/ /skom dang mig ser dag kyang sel/ /pu tshe ①shel btags snod sar pa/ /gtsang ma dag tu bskol nas ni/ /btsir ba'i khu ba mar dang sbyar / /khu ba des ni rims tshad dhisel/ /bad kan rlung 'dres shu dag dang //pu tse ⑤shel dang pa ta dang / /dong ga dug mo nyung bskol phan/ /yang na sle tres bskol ba yi/ /khu bar pi pi ling gi ni/ /phye ma btab ste 'thungs na phan//bya kri bca' sga sle tres bskol/ /pi pi ling gi phye mar bcas/ /bad kan rlung rims dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa cham pa gzer 'joms byed/ /gla sgang 'u su a ru ra/ /bca' sga skra dulo pu ti ka /shu dag ga bra kad pha ⑦la/ /thang shing shing kun sbrang rtsir bcas/ /rlung dang bad rims mchil ma mang / /lto dang snying ga rtsib ⑧logs na/ /skog nad kha ni skrangs pa dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde rnams sel/ /dong ga sogs te sbrang rtsir bcas/ /bad kan mkhris 'gyur rims 'joms so/ /de bzhin pu tse ⑦shel dang ni/ /ba sha ka dang pu shel tse/ /kyi ⑩lce ba dang 'bras bu gsum/ /sle tres dang ni pa to la/ /bong nga dkar po nim pa dang / /mur ba byi tsher ba yang phan/ /'dus pa'i rims la bya kri dang / /thang shing skyer pa gla sgang dang / /pa to lo ma nim pa'i 111—427
