shun—/ /'bras gsum pu tse ①shel yang phan/ /rlung dang bad kan shas che'i rims—/ /lud dbugs mi bde rtsib logs zug /dong gra puṣ+kar spru la dang //khre tres kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑤ri phan/ /rgun 'brum ma du ka'i me tog /ba ru sha ka kyi ②lce ba/ /pu shel tse dang pu tse shel④/ /'bras bu gsum dang tang pal bcas//bskol te bsgrangs par gyur pa yi/ /khu ba de ni des 'thungs na/ /rims ni thams cad sel bar byed/ /dzā ti gla sgang sgyu ru ra/ /byi tsher ba bskol de 'drar phan/ /bshang 'gags rgun 'brum pu tse shel/ /kyi ⑤lce bu ram 'bras bu gsum/ /sman zhu nas ni thug pa sogs/ /spyad bya bad kan can gyis min/ /bad kan gyis brlan lus la ni/ /rngul la char bab 'phel rjob ltar / /thug pa yis ni bad kan skyed/ /de phyir thog ma nyid du yang / /yu sha rgya sran tsa na ka /sran ma sogs byas yang ba dang / /rtsub cing ro kha ldan yid 'ong / /yi ga 'byed byed g.yos legs sbyin/ / sā lu rtsa ⑦snar sogs 'bru rnying / /drug cu pa yang rims la phan/ /bad kan shas cher de bzhin nas/ /phub ma med byas chag tshe'i skechan/ /nad ⑨dang lus zungs sogs stobs las/ /rims sel sman khur btsos 'bras chan/ /lan gnyis lan gsum btsags nas ni/ /ci rigs par ni sbyin par bya/ /muṅga sogs dang ku lad+ma'i/ /yu sha yang bas ⑩rims nad 'joms/ /tshod ma ka ra be la dang / /kar ko ta dang la phug gzhon/ / par pa ⑪ta dang ba sha ⑫ka /nim pa'i me tog pa to la'i/ /'bras bu dang ni lo ma las/ /legs par g.yos pa'i tshod ma bsngags/ /shin tu yang ba'i sha dang ni/ /skam sa'i srog chags sha khu ni/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑫ri pa ru sha /aghi man+d+ra rgun 'brum ⑫dang / /111—428

sgyu ru ra dang se 'bru dang / /pi pi ling dang bca' sga dang / /'u su zi ra rgyam tshar bcas/ /phal cher kha ra sbrang rtsi cher/ /ldan pa'i ①g.yos byas ma byas pa / /mi skyur dar ba bskol ba dang / /yi gar 'ong zhing be+e ba dang / /legs par bskol ba'i tshod ma phan/ /de ni btung ba'i phyir yang sbyin/ /chu bskol bsgrangs par gyur pa dang / /goms par gyur pa'i dbang las ni/ /chang yang blud par bya ba yin/ /rims dang bcas pa'am rims bral la/ /dgongs ②ka kha zas yang ba sbyin/ /de tshe bad kan me drod 'phel/ /khong pa'i me drod stobs dang ldan/ /yang na yul goms dbang las ni/ /ci rigs su yang sbyin par bya/ /me drod chung la snesngar zos na/ /zas ma zhu bar gzir bar 'gyur—/ /sman bskol khu ba phan zas kyis/ /zhag bcu'i bar du smyung ba bya/ /bad kan bri nas rlung mkhris ni/ /shas che'i rims la zhun mar sbyin/ /nad smin pa la bdud rtsi yin/ /gzhan du de ni dug dang mtshungs/ /zhag bcu 'das par gyur kyang ni/ /rims kyis bla brnan bu'aphel bar byed/ /de la sgyung ba la sogs rims⑤/ /bad kan zad kyi bar du bya/ /lus dang lus zungs stobs zhan pas/ /rims rnying du yang 'gyur ba yin/ /me drod rtsub pas rims skyed byed/ /me drod rtsub par gyur pa ladhi/ /skyugs sman dugs dang dus dang chu/ /bskol dang kha zas spangs pa yis/ /rlung gi khams ni grogs gyur pas/ /gang zhig stobs chen gyur pa la/ /de yi zhi byed zhun mar te—/ /khang pa 'bar la chu blugs mtshungs/ /rlung mkhris sel ba'i mchog tu niske/ /sbyor ba'i dbang las gyur pas ④na/ /de phyir rang gi sman dang ni/ /ji bzhin bskol ba de la sbyin/ /rims dro ⑧mi mthun pas sel la/ /bsil 111—429

bas mkhyes pa'ang sel bar byed/ /snum pas rlung sel ①bad kan mar/ /mtshungs kyang ②sbyor dang g.yos pas sel/ /sngar gyi sman khu mar bcas pa/ /thams cad nad dmigs ji bzhin gtang / /'bras bu gsum dang nim pa'i ④shunaske/ /shing mngar bri ④ha ti gnyis dang / /sran chung 'o mar bcas bskol laske/ /mar ldan rims dang lud pa 'joms/ /pi pi ling dang tig ta dug mo nyung ⑤/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka rjori pu tse shel thal tres/ /ta ma la ka skyu ru ra bil ba/ /gla sgang tsan+dan kyi ⑦lce pu shel tse/ /rgun 'brum bong nga sa la paṇi dang / /bskol ba'i mar gyis rims kyi nad dang ni/ /me drod mi snyoms ha li sa ka dang //yi ga 'chus dang mi bzad tsha ba dang / /snyom ⑧pa'i nad dang rtsib logs na ba dang / /mgo nad slon ni myur du 'joms par byed/ /dur byed ma gtogs seng phrom sogs bskol mar/ /rlung las gyur pa'i rims la bsngags pa yin/ /mkhris pa'i rims la pu tse ⑨shel dug mar/ /kyi ⑩lce bar bskol sman mar gang yin phan/ / bye dang ga ⑪dang dbyi mong kha ru tsha/ /pa ta tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka /lce myang tsha dang nas tshig 'khus thal ba/ /'di rnams cha ni srang rer ⑩byas pa dang / /mar dang 'o ma cha ni mnyam byas pa/ /bre gang bskol bas ⑫bad kan rims rnying 'joms/ /sle tres khu ba lde gu dang / /ba sha ka dang 'bras bu gsum/ /rgun 'brum dang ni ba la dang / /bskol ba'i sman mar rims nad 'joms/ /mar zhu nas ni sha 'jam khu/ /kha zas bcas pa bza' bar bya/ /des ④ni stobs rab skyed byed cing ⑫/ /nad ni shin tu zad byed yin/ /ka ra be+e la sogs khu dang / /muṅga bad kan mkhris 'joms pas/ /phal cher rlung shas che rims la⑩/ /gzer dang bshang ba 'gags pa ni/ /711—430

skyed cing rims ni 'phel bar byed/ /de phyir de ni bsngags ma yin/ /gal te de ltar byas kyang ni/ /rims ni zhi bar ma gyur na/ /sbyang 'os la ni sbyang bar bya—/ /de la skyugs sman sngar ①bshad pa/ /ma zhu bar ni gnas nad la/ /stobs can stobs ni bsrungs ②te btang / /smin zhing nad ni lhod gyur pa'am//chang dang dug las byung rims la/ /sha ma dur byed 'bras bu gsum/ /pi pi ling dang ge sar dang / /yang na tsha ba gsum sogs sman/ /kha ra sbrang rtsir snebacas pa sbyin/ /rjorgun 'brum skyu ru ra'i khu ba⑤/ /a ru ra ni rgun chur bcas//dong ga rjo'o mar bcas pa 'am/ /rgun chu dang ni bcas pa blud/ /'bras bu gsum mam kyi ⑦lce ba/ /'o ma rims dang ldan pas btung / / bkru sman ⑧btang ba'i skabs su yang / /thug sla la sogs rim bzhin blud/ /rim gyis di ma glongs ⑨g.yos tshe/ /de la rtag tu dgag mi bya/ /nad ni khong par gnas snyeg ⑩nas/ /smin kyang gnod pa skyed par byed⑪/ /shin tu tshabs cher byung gyur na/ /smin nas gcad ⑫par bya ba yin/ /ma smin bkag pa'i nyes pa ni—/ /nad bcos thabs su bshad pa yin/ /gang zhig rmongs pas ma smin pa'i⑫—/ /rims la nad 'byin sman gtong ba④/ /de ni sbrul nag gnyid log larka/ /lag pa'i rtse mos spyoreg dang mtshungs/ /rims zad pa la slon sman dang / /bkru sman phan pa ma yin te/ /de la 'o ma dag gi ni/ /mas gtong bas ni nad bsal bya⑩/ /'o ma la goms bad kan zad/ /lus tsha skom dad gnyis yod na⑩/ /rlung dang mkhris pas nyen pa ni/ /tshad par 'khru yang 'o ma phan—/ /de lus smyung bas gdungs pa dag /mes tshig pa yi nags la ni/ /char chu 'bab pas skyed pa ltar/ /rims ni myur du sel bar byed/ /de bas 111—431

'o ma sbyar te bskol/ /dro ba'am bsgrangs pa bzhos ma thag /dus kyi dbye ba shes te sbyin/ /de las gzhan du rims can gsod/ /'o ma bca' sga 'bra gor bcas/ /rgun 'brum kha ra mar ldan par/ /bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi btab/ /skom dad lus tsha rims 'joms byed/ /de bzhin pa la rgun shing mngar/ /tsan+dan thal tres pi pi ling / /'o ma'i bzhi 'gyur chu bskol ba'am—/ /pi pi ling dang bskol ba ni/ / rims kyis ①btab pas 'thungs na ①ni/ /klad ①gzer lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /rtsib logs gzer rims rnying ④las thar/ /rtsa ba lnga bskol de dang 'dra/ /e raṇ+ḍa rtsa bskol ba 'am/ /bil ba gzhon nu dang dhibaskol ba'am/ /bzhos ma thag gi 'o ma 'thungs/ /rlung gi rims kyis phyi sa 'gags/ /khrag bcas sbyin bag tshad rjo'akhru dang / /skom dad gzer bcas 'khru las thar/ /bca' sga ba la bya kri ⑦dang / /gze ma bu ram 'o mar btsos/ /bskol 'thungs skrangs ⑧bshang gcin dang 'phyen⑨/ /'gags dang rims dang lud pa 'joms/ /bri — ba la ()bil ba dang / / bar sha bhu (nyudang bskol ba yis/ /rims kyi skrangs ⑫nad sel ba yin/ /shing sha pa yi snying po dang / /'o ma dag tu bskol ba ni/ /rims ni ⑫myur du 'joms byed yin/ /nad smin zhu ba'i gnad spyosong la/ /mas gtong drag pos me stobs 7skyed/ /rims bral sems dga' yi ga 'byed/ /myur du skyed par byed pa yin/ /bkru sman mkhris pa'am ⑩bad mkhris 'dres/ /mkhris pa'i gnas su zhugs pa sel/ /'jam rtsis nad ni sum ⑫char dag /zhu ba'i nad ⑫la brten pa sel/ /'o mas bad kan mkhris pa dag /mjug to rgyab dang rked pa na/ /me drod che la rtug 'gags pa/ /'jam rtsi mas gtong sbyar 111—432

bar bya/ /nim pa pa to la'i lo ma/ /pu tse ①shel dang dong ga dang / /sbi ⑤ra ba la po son cha/ /gze ma pu shel ba la ka /'o ma'am ①chur ni bskol ba dgarjo /'o ma lhag ma lus pa la/ /gla sgang shing mngar po son cha/ /pi pi ling dang dug mo nyung / /mar dang sbrang rtsi rjobasres pa yi du/ /'jam rtsi btang na rims 'joms so/ /paṇi ⑦bzhi dang shing mngar dang / /po son cha dang pu shel tse⑧/ /dong ga rnams ni bskol ba ru/ /shing mngar sha ⑨ta put+pa dang / /pri yabyu dang po son cha/ /gla sgang sde gur byas pa la/ /bu ram mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas/ /'jam rtsis ⑩rims ni sel byed yin/ /dzi ⑪brnyi dang po son cha⑫—/ /me da shing mngar pi pi ling / /shu dag ridhi spyor sna dang / /ba la dang ni bil ba dang / /shu ti dang ni nye shing rnams④/ /mar dang til mar 'o ma dang / /chu dang btags te lhan cig bskol/ /snum ni nad dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /'jam rtsi spyorims la gtang bar bya/ /gang yang cho ga grub pa las—/ /rims sel bar ni bshad pa yi/ /'jam rtsi dag kyang gtang bar bya//sna yi bkru sman rims rnying ⑩la/ /btang na yi ga 'byed byed cing / /mgo ni lci zhing bad kan che/ /sel zhing dbang po gsal byed la/ /snum gyi sna sman mgo stong snyam/ /lus tsha mkhris pa sel byed yin/ /dud brngub mkhur bkang mkhur ba spo/ /nad dmigs ji bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /cham pa khas ro mi tshor dang / /mgo nad lkog nad sel byed yin/ /yi ga 'chus la kha lung gi/ /ge sar mar dang rgyam tshar bcas⑫/ /yang na rgun 'brum skyu ru ra/ /kha ra'i lde gu mkhur bar bcang / /rims rnying pags pa la brten la/ /reg na ji ltar bde 'gyur ba'i/ /sman bsil dro ba la sbyar ba'i/ /bsku byug chu 111—433

blugs ①la sogs bya/ /mig sman dud pa'i spyor ba'ang bya/ /glo bur byung la ②de de bzhin/ /tsha la lan stong bkrus pa yi/ /mar gyis bsku ba spyad par bya/ /mdo gnas las ①bshad sman gyi sde/ /mngar dang skyur dang bska ba dang / /drur ba la sogs rlung mkhris 'joms/ /sgyug sman la sogs sde tshan bshad/ /nus pa bsil zhing reg na grang / /bskol dang lde gur byas pa dang / /til mar 'o mar bcas dhibaskol ba/ /bskus na 'phral du tsha rims sel /mgo dang lus kyang de nyid ni/ /cung zad rtsing bar btags pas bsku/ /de bskol chu ni blugs ⑤pa dang / /lus 'bying bul yang sbyar bar bya/ /skyur rtsabs chu dang 'o ma tsha/ /mar la sogs pa'ang de bzhin sbyar/ / bil rkang kha ④lung a mra dang / /se'u 'bru seng phrom bi da ri/ /rgya shug lo ma las byung ba'am⑧/ /lung tang gi ⑨ni dbu ba yis/ /lus bskus tsha na rmongs bag dang / /slon dang skom dad zhi bar byed/ /gang zhig nad gso'i thabs su bshad/ /mkhris pa sel ba'i rim pa ste/ /bsten par byas na myur du ni/ /tsha dang bcas pa'i rims sel 'gyur/ /nus pa dro zhing reg na dro/ /rgya spos gur gum ⑩a ka ru/ /ru rta rdo dreg sto ne+e ya/ /sa ra la dang thang shing dang / /chu srin sen mo ra sna dang / /gu gul shu dag lca ⑪ba dang / /sug smel gnyis dang tsa ⑫rong dang / /tsan+dan sib dang byi'u ⑫rug pa/ / shi kru ⑫spang spos bya ma ka /yungs kar rtsa ba bcu pa dang / /sle ⑫tres e raṇ+ḍa gnyis dang / /ba ru ⑫ra dang ro hi sha /ta ma la yi lo ma dang / /pu ⑩ti ka dang sa la ki /'u su a za mo ta dang / /shu ti ma sha ku laṅgaspyo/ /tsi tra ka dang pra ki r+ya⑪/ na ku ⑥la ni rnam gnyis dang //gzhan yang de 'dra'i bsil ba'i sman/ /bskol dang sde gur byas nas ni/ /111—434

chang dang skyur rtsabs la sogs sbyar/ /til mar bskol ba grang ①rims sbyar/ /de dro 'jam gyis bsku ba dang / /zhib tu btags pas ②byug par bya/ /cung ①zad dro bas blugs ④pa dang / /lus 'bying ⑤bar yang bya ba yin/ /tshwa dang ba gcin zho ga rjochu/ /'ba' zhig gis kyang de bzhin bya/ /dong ga la sogs sde yis kyang / /btung dang bsku dang byug par bya/ /bdug pa a ka ru las byung / /'og nas bshad pa'i rims la sbyar/ /dugs ni mes byas mes ma byas/ /dugs kyi sman dang kha zas bsten/ /khang sbrum ⑦sa phug tu nyal zhing / /la ba dre'u rngog re'u snam bgo/ /du ba med pa'i mdag mas gang / /zhugs shing dag ni bsten skepa dang / /chang ni tsha ba gsum bcas dang / /dar ba rgya sran ku laṅga⑨/ /'bru dang ko tra ⑫ba dag kyang / /'dar ba'i rims can de la sbyin//grang ba'i rims nad can de la/ /chung ma nu ma rgyas pa dang / /rgyan gyis brgyan te bzhag pa dang / /lang tshos rgyags shing chang gis myos/ /bud med kyis de 'khyud ⑪par bya/ /grang dang bral bar shes nas ni/ /de nas de slar bsal bar bya/ /nad gcig ⑫'phel bar 'gyur ba ⑫dang / /'grib pa'am ldang bar gyur pa 'am/ /mnyam gnas nad ni bad kan gyi/ /gnas kyi rim ⑫pas bsal bar bya/ /'dus pa'i rims kyi mtha' mar ni/ /gang gi rna ba'i rtsa ba ru/ /mi bzad skrang pa ⑫byung gyur na/ /'ga' zhig thar par 'gyur ba yin / /de ni gtar gas ⑩dbyung ba dang / /zhun mar blud pas myur bsal te/ /bad mkhris sel ba'i sman bsku dang / /sna sman mkhur ba bkang bas gso/ /gang gi rims ni bsil drod dang / /snum rtsub sogs kyis zhi mi 'gyur| /yan lag zhen pa de rims ⑩bzhin/ /lag ngar las khrag myur du 111—435

dbyung / /cho ga 'di ni mi bzad pa'i①/ /rims la'ang nad dmigs ji bzhin bya/ /rlung sogs rim gyis ④cha phye la/ /phyis bshad gang yin dag kyang bya—/ /pa to la dang pu tse shel/ /gla sgang shing mngar a ru ra/ /gnyis sam gsum mam lnga bskol ba/ /mi bzad rims ni 'joms byed yin/ /'bras bu gsum dang a ru ra/ /sle tres pi pi ling so sor/ /cho ga de dang sbyar ba 'am/ /go bye ①bu ram bcas pa sbyin/ /rims kyis thebs pa'i nyin zhag la/ /nyams smad pa 'am nyams brta bya/ /nang par til mar sgog skya rjobacas/ /bza' 'am yang na mar rnying ngam/ /de bzhin zho dang 'o ma sbyin/ /zhun mar srang drug pa dang ni/ /dge ba chen po'am ba'i rnam lnga/ /tig ta'ang dugs ⑤dang bskol te sbyin/ /'bras bu gsum dang rgya shug dang / /aghi man+d+ra rjobaskol ba ru//zho dang bskol ba'i mar dag tu/ /seng phrom shun wags ⑦lde gu btab/ /mi bzad rims ni 'joms pa'i mchog /'bru chang dang ni chang rnying rnoske/ /rma bya gong mo sreg khyim bya/ /rlan can sha ni drod skyed pa/ /zas bcas dag ni ci 'dod par/ /bsten la de bzhin gnyid log pa'am/ /yang na be+er ni skyug tu gzhug /yang na zhun mar tshad chen po/ /blud de slar yang skyug tu ⑨gzhug /a dza garnya ⑩ni li ni/ /dur byed dang ni pu tse shel/ /rims kyis 'debs tshe snum dang dugs/ /legs par byas te ⑪blud par bya/ /ldong ros rgyam tsha pi pi ling / /til mar dang sbyar mig sman gzhug /shing kun stag tshil cha mnyam bya⑫/ /rgyam tshar bcas pa'i sna sman bya/ /de bzhin mar rnying seng ge'i tshil / /rgyam tsha dag dang sbyar te gtang / /pa la ka sa nim ⑫pa'i lo shu dag ru rta a ru ra/ /yungs kar nas bcas mar sbyar ba'i/ /bdug pa'am 111—436

byi la'i rtug pas bdug /gu gul shu dag bya ma ka /sardza ra sa nim ①pa dang / /arka skedang ni a ru ra/ /thang shing bcas pa'i spos sbyar ba/ /'di ni gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i/ /bdug pa yin te rims kun sel/ /spos ①bdug sna sman gtang bya ba/ /sems kyis bsgyur bar gang bshad dang / /'phags pa la brten sman gyis ni/ /rims nad thams cad sel bar byed/ /mchog tu phal cher mi bzad rims/ /de ni glo bur 'ong rjes 'brel/ /mi bzad rims zhir ma gyur na/ /rang gi gtar ga ji bzhin gdab/ /dwangs ma la gnas thams cad la/ /sgyug sman gtang dang smyung ba bya/ /khrag la gnas pa sman chu blugs/ /bsku dang byug dang gtar ga bya/ /shar gnas bkru sman rnon po bya/ /tshil gnas tshil ni dbri bar bya/ /rus par gnas la rlung zhi ba'i//bsku dang dugs dang mnye ba bya/ /rims der rlung nad zhi bya dang / /khyad par du ni 'jam rtsi bya/ /ma 'dres rlung dang me dbal rjodang / /'brum bus gnod 'gyur rims la ni/ /zhun mar blud cing ⑤tsan+dan byugarjo /sman chu blugs shing sha khu sbyin/ /rang gi dpyad ni ji skad bshad/ /gtar ga la sogs dag gis gso/ /gdon byung 'byung po'i rig par bshad/ /gtor ma sngags la sogs pas gso/ /sman dri las byung mkhris pa ni/ /zhi bya dug skyes dug gis gso/ /'dod don ji ltar yid 'thad dang / /nad ni ji ltar zhi 'gyur ba/ /phan dang mi phan la mkhas pas/ /khros sogs las byung rims bsal bya/ /khros byung 'dod pas zhi bar 'gyur/ / 'dod byung khros pas zhi bar 'gyur/ /⑦mya ngan 'jigs byung ⑧de gnyis kyis/ /'jigs ⑨dang mya ngan byung cig shos/ /dmod pa mngon spyod sngags las byung / /'phags pa'i 111—437

don la brten pas zhi/ /rims de thog mar ①ma 'dres la/ /de 'og dri mas khyab par byed/ /de bas nad dang rjes mthun par/ /de la kha zas la sogs sbyar / /rlung stsogs rgyu la ma brten par/ /rims ni rjes 'brel gnas mi byedarka/ /rims kyi dus dran byung de la/ /yid 'phrog yul gyis brjed par bya//snying rjes brlan zhing sems dag pa⑤/ /rims kun 'joms par byed pa yin/ /nyams stobs rdzogs par 'gyur gyi bar/ /rtsol dang khrus dang nyal po dang / /zas lci ma goms tsha byed dang / /gang gzhan rims skyed byed pa spang / /rims bral ④gyur kyang 'phral du ni/ /zas kun bsten par mi bya ste/ /rims ni myur du ldog byed nas/ /nyam chung mi ni myur gsod byed/ /gang phyir myur du gsod 'gyur bas/ /de phyir de ni khyad par du/ /gnas skabs de dang de dag tu/ /sman dpyad de dang de dag bya/ /sman dang nor bu sngags dang bcas pa dang / /dam pa bla ma bram ze dkon mchog mchod/ /yid ni dga' bar byed pa'i yul bsten pas/ /khyab 'jug gis byas ma rungs rims kyang 'joms/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u dang po'o// //de nas khrag mkhris gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /khrag mkhris bde ba'i dus su 'byung / /stobs ldan stod 'byung ④shugs dal la/ /nyes gcig las byung gsar du btab/ / bla brnan ⑤med pa gso bar bya/ /khrag gang nad gzhi gnyis las skyesarjo/ /zhi zhing zhi zhing slar ⑦ldang dang / /lam nas lam gzhan 'gro ba gang / /thur du 'byung ba gso ba tsam/ /shas cher 'byung 111—438

zhing me drod nyams/ /nyes gsum lam ①gnyis las byung spang ②/ /nad gzhi zas dang ①gnas dang ni/ /nad kyi gogs dang stobs dag dang / /yul dang dus kyi gnas skabs sogs/ /shes bya dang por smyung ba'am brta/ /de bzhin sbyang dang zhi bya bas/ /khrag dang mkhris pa gso bar bya/ /brta ba las byung stobs ldan pa/ /nad gzhi mang po las byung ba/ /gyen 'byung bkru sman gtong bas gso/ /thur 'byung skyug sman gyis gso rjobya/ /sgyung ba brta bya la ltos bya/ /stod du 'byung ba kha ba dang / /bska ba'i sman khu ⑤smyung ba dang / /yan lag drug sman bca' sga med/ /'thungs na zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /thur du 'byung ba'i khrag mkhris la/ /sman khu mngar bas brta dhibar bya/ /stod 'byung dang por skyo ma ⑦blud/ /smad 'byung dang por thug pa ⑧blud/ /stobs ldan za nus ma dag khrag /byung yang mi dgag des ⑨nad skyed/ /de ni gzhan du me lta bur/ /myur gsod byed pas gcad par bya/ /dur byed pri yang chu bskol dang / /lde gu kha rar bcas pa dag /cho ga bzhin du de la ni/ /zho gnyis tsam du bldag ⑩par bya/ /dur byid pri yang 'bras bu gsum/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi pi pi ling / /sbrus pa 'dus byung stod du byung / /khrag rims 'or nad sel byed yin/ /de bzhin dur byid kha rar mnyam/ /pi pi ling ni bzhi char bcas//skyug sman phyir ni po son cha/ /kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas skyo ma'am/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi po son cha/ /chur bcas pa'am shing mngar chu/ /'o ma'am ⑪bu ram shing khu blud—/ / sbyangs pa'i ⑫rjes la cho ga ni/ /thug sla la sogs ji bzhin du/ /blud cing stobs ni bsrung bar bya/ /skyo ma rims skabs bshad rgun sogs/ /yang na mkhris 'joms 'bras bur sbyar/ /sbrang rtsi 'bra ⑫go rgun 'brum ⑫dang / /111—439

pa ru sha ka ka ra'i chu/ /snying po lnga yi skyo ma ni/ /'bras yos phye ni mar bcas sbyinarka/ /me drod chung zhing skyur la dga'/ /se 'bru skyu ru ra skyur ba/ /pad+ma ut+pal ge sar dang / /kriṇ+ḍa ①paṇi pri yad+ku/ /pu shel tse dang seng phrom dkar/ /bca' sga dang ni tsan+dan dmar⑤/ /byi tsher da ta ka'i ①me tog /ba la ka dang bil ba'i rkang / / tshigs bcad rjophyed bshad thug pa blud/ /rtsa mkhris gla sgang pu shel tse/ /sran chung kṛṇ+ḍa pa ṇir ⑤sbyar/ /muṅga garnya rjobi da ri/ / ha re rku ④ka ba la mar/ /tshig ⑧rkang gcig gis bshad pa blud/ /nus pa bsil ba de rnams ni/ /skam sa'i srog chags sha dag dang / /chur ni so sor bskol ba yi/ /khu bar nas ⑨thug sbyar ba bsgrangs/ /kha ra sbrang rtsir sbyar ba blud—/ /de bzhin du ni sha khu dang / /cung zad skyur dang skyur min pa/ /mar brngos kha ra bcas pa sbyin/ /zas kyi ⑩tshul ni shes pa ru/ /yang dang bsil bar gang bshad pa'i/ /gra ma gang bu can 'bru dang / /tshod ma khrag la bsngags pa yin/ /sngar bshad pa yi chu dag gam/ /rtsa ba chung ngu lnga bskol te//bsgrangs pa'am sbrang rtsi'i chu 'am ni/ /'bras bu mnyes pa'i chu blud bya/ /bshang 'gags rgya sne'u ⑪ri bong sha /rlung shas che la sreg pa'i sha /u dum bā ⑫ra'i khu ba ni/ /bskol ba blud na bsngags pa yin/ /de bzhin blag sha ⑫rma bya'i sha /n+ya gro dha ④dang khyim bya'i sha /khrag mkhris kyi di nad gzhi ni/ /gang ci'ang rung ba de spang bya/ /ba sha ka'i ⑫khu pri yang ku/ /sa nag dang ni skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /seng phrom dang ni sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /'thungs na khrag dang mkhris pa 'jomasarka/ /yang na ba sha ka yi ni/ /khu ba kha ra sbrang rtsi dang / /bcas par 'thungs pa de bzhin te/ /ba sha ka ni 'ba' zhig dang / /bskol bas khrag ni 111—440

myur sel ①te/ /de ni 'di yi sman mchog yin/ /pa to la dang ma la ti/ /nim pa shug pa tsan+dan gnyis/ /seng phrom ba sha tan tu li/ /sa nag ma da yan ti ka /nye ⑤shing dang ni thal tres dang / /ra mnye ba gnyis shing mngar rnams/ /bskol ba gsum po kha ra dang / /sbrang rtsir bcas pas ①khrag mkhris 'joms/ /rgya skyegs shing kun ④bskol ba ni/ /legs bsgrangs ka ⑤ra btab pa phan/ /yang na sbrang rtsi mar bcas pa'am/ /lci ba rta sbangs babyur khu 'thung / /khrag nad mdud pa can 'drar 'byung rjo/ /phug ron rtug pa sbrang rtsi phan/ /khrag ni shas cher byung gyur na/ /skom sa'i srog chags khrag dang ni/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'am ra yi ni/ /mchin pa mkhris bcas rlon pa bza'/ /tsan+dan gla sgang pu shel tse⑦/ /'bras yos muṅga ⑧pi pi ling / /nas ni ba la'i chur sbangs pa/ /khu ba khrag mkhris sel byed yin/ /tsan+dan pad+ma pu shel tse⑨/ /khu bar bong pa bsregs bcug la⑩/ /rab bsgrangs kha ra ⑪sbrang rtsir bcas⑫/ /khrag ni shas cher 'byung ba sel/ /bu ram shing ni chu mang sbangs/ /rdza bum gsar par de bzhag nas⑫/ /mtshan mo phyi rol dbe+en par gzhag /nang par chu ni btsags nas su/ /sbrang rtsi btab nas pad+ma ni/ /kha phye'i phreng rgyan ⑫chu de 'drarka/ /gang yang mkhris pa'i rims skabs bshad/ /sman khu de yang blud par bya/ /sman khu sna tshogs 'di yis ni/ /me drod skyed ⑫pas bad kan zad/ /gal te khrag mkhris ma ⑩zhi na/ /de la rlung shas cher phan pa'i/ /ra yi 'o ma bskol ba blud/ /de bzhin ba yi 'o ma ni/ /lnga 'gyur chu bskol gdusalgepa blud/ /rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu dang / /sbrang rtsi kha ra bskol ba'ang rung / /rgun 'brum bca' sga dzi spyob ka /ba la gze ma zangs rtsi ba/ /re re 'o mar ⑪bskol ba 111—441

'amarka/ /'o ma kha ra mar bskol phan/ /gze ma nye'u shing bskol ba'am/ /de bzhin 'dab bzhi 'o mar bskol/ /khrag ni nad bcas myur du sel①/ /mchog tu mtshan nas 'byung la phan/ /rkub las byung la khyad par du/ /mo tsa ra sa blud na phan/ /n+ya gro dha yi myu gu 'am/ /'dab ma gzhon pa'am bca' sga dang / /a ⑤ra dang ut+pal phan/ /khrag gi tshad 'khru gzhang 'brum gyi/ /gso ba dag kyang 'dir sbyar bya/ /sman khu 'o ma 'thungs nas ni/ /bza' ba'ang ①'o ma nyid dang bza'/ /sman khu'i sbyor ba 'di dag nyidarjo/ /bskol ba'i mar ni blud par bya/ /ba sha ka rtsa rtser bcas brdungs/ /chu ni brgyad 'gyur nang du ni/ /bskol te brgyad cha lus gyur pa/ /de dang ⑤mar ni btso bar bya/ /de yi me tog nang bcug bsgrangasarjo/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pas ⑦khrag mkhris dang / /mkhris skran rims dang dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa snying nad mig ser dang / /rab rib mgo 'khor me dbal dang / /skad 'gags pa ni 'joms par byed/ /pa la sha ⑧yi myu gu'i khur⑨/ /de bcug mar ni bskol ba dag /sbrang rtsir bcas pas ⑩khrag nad sel/ /kyi ⑪lce ba yang de bzhin no/ /khrag ni spyi ⑫bag bad kan bcas/ /mdud par chags nad ⑫mgul bar byung / /ut+pal sdong bu ④bsregs thal ba/ /zhun mar sbrang rtsir bcas pa bldag⑩ /pad+ma ut+pal ge sar dang / /pri yang ⑪ku dang ma du ka /re re'i sbyor ba de bzhin bya/ /khrag ni bshang ba'i lam las ni/ /'byung bar byed la ⑩khyad par duske/ /'jam rtsi btang ba bsngags pa yin/ /sna nas nad can khrag byung na/ /sna sman btang zhing blugs ⑫par bya/ /sngar bshad sman khu'i sbyor ba dang / /'o ma bu ram shing khu blugs/ /'o ma sogs chu kha rar bcas/ /yang na chu 111—442

ni 'ba' zhig phan/ /se 'bru'i ①me tog khu ba 'am/ /a mra'i rus pa drur ba sdephan/ /bsil sman sde tshan gtogs pa dag /bsku dang byug la sogs las sbyar/ /mkhris pa'i rims sel bshad pa gang / /phyi nang las btung sman de dang / /glo rdol ④bar ni gang phan pa/ /de yang khrag dang mkhris par phan / /rjoyan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u gnyis pa'o// //de nas lud pa gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /lud pa ma 'dres rlung las byung / /dang por snum gyis gso bya zhing / /sha khu thug pa yu sha sogs/ /rlung 'joms sman bskol snum pa dang / /dud bdugs ⑤lde gu bsku dang dugs/ /chu blugs lus bcing dag gis gso/ /bshang rlung 'gags la 'jam rtsis gso/ /mkhris bcas zhun mar 'o ma ni/ /zas kyi rjosngon btang bad kan bcas/ /snum bcas bkru sman btang bas gso/ /sle tres gaṇ+ḍa ka ⑦ri gnyis/ /re re srang sum cu'i khu bar/ /mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis bskol/ /rlung gi lud sel me drod skyed/ /k+ṣa ra ra sna shu dag dang / /shing kun pa ta shing mngar dang / /'u su zho gnyis mar bre gang / /tsha ba lnga dang bcas pa dang / /rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu bar bskol/ /'thungs rjes thug pa blud gyur na/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde bcas snying / /rtsib ④logs pho ba'i ⑨skran nad sel/ /ra sna nye'u shing rtsa ba bcu/ /srang ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /rgya sran rgya shug nas dag ni/ /ra sha srang ni lnga bcu dang / /chu srang lnga brgya bcu gnyis bskol/ /de dang mar ni bre ⑩bzhi bskol/ /'o ma mar mnyam dzi ⑪brnyi/ /la sogs srang 111—443

char byas te brtag /rlung gi nad la blud pa dang / /snar btang 'jam rtsi'i ①mas gtong sbyar/ /lud pa rnam lnga mgo 'dar dang / /mo mtshan chu so ②na ba dang / /lud kun lus ni phyogs gcig nad/ /mchin bcas stod kyi rlung nad sel—/ /bi da ri sogs sde tshan ①bskol/ /lde gu mar bskol lud pa 'joms/ /shing mngar a shwa ka'i sa bon/ / byi dang ga dang skyer ④khaṇ+ḍa/ /shug pa kha ru tsha mar bskol/ /yang na de phye mar dang sbrus⑤/ /lde gu byin la ra yi ni/ /'o ma blud na lud pa sel/ /dong ga ra sna byi dang garjo /shing kun rgyam tsha pi pi ling / /bar gyi k+ṣa ⑦ra de'i phye ma'am/ /mar dang ran tsam blud gyur na/ /rlung gyur bad kan bcas lud pa/ /dbugs mi bde dang skyigs bu dang / /me drod chung ba sel bar byed/ /byi tsher ba dang bca' sga dang / / zur ba ⑧rgun 'brum kha ra dkar/ /kar ka ⑨ta yi sring gi ni/ /til mar dang ni lde gur sbyar/ /rlung las gyur pa'i lud pa sel/ /bye tsher gla sgang pi pi ling / /bar gyi zur pa kar ka ti/ /bu ram rnying ⑩dang til mar dang / /lde gur byas pa bldag (kyepar bya/ /bca' sga pi pi ling de bzhin/ /kar ka ta sring de bzhin no/ /chu dron dag dang pi pi ling / /lce myang tsha dang bcas pa ⑫blud/ /bca' sga ka ra zho ga ⑫chu'am/ /pi pi ling phye zhor btab blud/ /rgya shug tshi ⑫gu chang ngam ⑫zho/ /zho ga chu dang sbyar ba blud/ /yang na pi pi ling lde gu/ /mar brngos rgyam tshar bcas pa'ang phan/ /lud pa cham bcas dud pa ni/ /snum bcas cho gas bdug ⑩pa dang / /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde dud brngub/ /'o ma sha khu bcas pa bza'/ /gong chu rlan ⑩can srog chags sha /sā ⑫lu nas gro drug cu pa'am/ /ma spyosha ad ma kub ta yi/ /yu sha dag dang zos na phan/ /111—444

la la phud dang pi pi ling / /byi ①la rkang dong ga sdetsi tra ka /ra sna zi ra pa la sha /kṛṇ+ḍa ④paṇi zur ba dang / /ma nu bskol bar 0snum skyur dang / /lan tshwar bcas thug rlung gyur ⑤blud/ /rked pa lto snying rtsib logs na/ /dbugs mi bde dang skyigs bu sel/ /rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu bar ni/ /tsha ba lnga dang bu ram bcas/ /til dang bcas pa'i thug pa blud/ /yang na 'o thug rgyam tshar bcas/ /nya dang khyim bya phag rgod sha /mar dang rgyam tshar bcas pa'ang rjophan/ /tshod ma rgya sde'u pa ya si④/ /ni shan na ga lud pa 'joms/ /ka ṇ+ḍa ka ⑧ri'i lo 'bras dang / /la phug gzhon nu skam po'ang phan/ /til mar sogs snum 'o ma dang / /bu ram bu ram shing khu'i zas/ /zho ga chu zho rang sgyur chang / /'bras bu skyur chu blud pa phan/ /mkhyes pa'i lud ⑨pa bad kan bcas/ /zhun mar gyis ni skyug sman phan/ /de bzhin po son cha tang pal⑩//ma du ka ni bskol chus sam/ /shing mngar po son cha'i lde gu/ /bi da bu ram shing khur sbyar/ /mkhris lud bad kan shas chung la/ /dur byid mngar ba'i sman sbyar gtang / /bad kan shas cher ⑪kha ba'i sman/ /sgyug sman phyir ni gtang bar bya/ /nad sbyangs nas ni thug pa sogs/ /bsil dang mngar dang snum pa spyad/ /bad kan shas cher kha ba dang / /rtsub pa dang sbyar grang thug blud—/ /mkhris gyur kha ra skyu ru ra/ /rgun 'brum ut+pal tsan+dan dkar/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin/ /bad kan bcas la na le sham⑫/ /gla sgang dang ni bcas pa sbyin/ /rlung can ⑫la ni mar bcas phan/ /rgun 'brum lnga bcu ④pi pi ling / /sum cu kha ra srang gcig sbyar/ /sbrang rtsi'am ba yi lci ba 'am—/ /be'u gzhon lci khur lde gur sbyar/ /shing tsha sug grel tsha ba gsum/ /111—445

rgun 'brum pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /ma nu 'bras yos gla sgang dang / /zur pa dkar dang ra sna ①dang / /sgyu ru ra dang ba ru ra/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi zhun mar sbyar/ /lde gus kyesnying nad lud pa sel④/ /mngar ba'i sman dang srog chags ni/ /skam sa'i sha dang nas dang ni/ /khre dang khre rgod muṅga sogs/ /yu sha dang ni tshod ma dang / /kha ba tshad ldan sbyar lde gu/ /kha ba dang ni sbrang rtsir bcas/ /bad kan shas che'i nad la phan/ /bad kan shas chung sā rjolu dang / /drug cu pa'i chan sha khu phan/ /btung bar kha ra'am rgun chu 'am/ /bu ram shing khya'am 5 'o ma blud/ /mkhris pa'i lud par ra mnye ba/ /bri ha ti dhiganyis me da gnyis—/ /ba tsa 7ka dang li dong gra/ /sha khu dang ni 'o ma 'am/ /thug pa'am yu shar ④sbyar te blud/ /rgun 'brum dang ni pi pi ling rtsa ⑨yi rtsa ba lngar bshad dang / /chur ⑩bskol ba yi khu ba dang / /de dang 'o ma bskol te bsgrangs—/ /sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas pa blud/ /yang na de yis thug pa bskol/ /legs bskol sbrang rtsir bcas pa sbyin/ /zur pa dang ni ba le ⑪ka /kha ra bca' sga bri ha ti(/she/ /btags pa'i khu ba ras kyis btsags/ /mar dang bsres te blud par bya/ /kha ra dang ni dzi ba ka /muṅga ma sha ⑫paṇi dang / /bye tsher ba ni sde gur sbyar④/ /mar dang 'o ma brgyad 'gyur bskol/ /de btung bza' dang bldag tshupa dang / /sbyar bas mkhris pa'i lud pa sel/ /'di dag phye ma'i lde gu ⑩'am/ /bskol ba'i khu ba blud par ⑩bya/ /bad kan lud can gyis dang por/ /thang shing bsregs nas gzags pa'i snum/ /ba sha ka dang nas tshig 'khus4)/ /thal ba'i phye ma btab pa btang / /snum bcas spyobakru sman gyis ( )steng dang / /'og dang spyi bor ci rigs par/ /nyams stobs ldan 111—446

bkru sman rno gtang / /thug pa sogs kyang 'di la blud/ /nas dang muṅga rgya sran zas/ /rtsub dro na le sham gyis tsha/ /ka sa marda brda ka /bya kri ya bak+ṣa ra dang / /pi pi ling dang bcas pa sbyin/ /skam sa khung gnas sha khu snum/ /til dang yungs kar bil ba'i snum/ /sbyar ba'i thug pa sbyin par bya/ /skom na rtsa ba bcu bskol chu/ /chu tshan chang mang sbrang chu ①blud/ /dong ga ma nu'i rtsa ba dang / /pa to la yi rtsa bar bcas/ /nub gcig chur sbangs sbrang rtsi btab//zas dus gsum mam nang par blud/ /pi pi ling dang de rtsa ba/ /bca' sga dang ni ba ru ra/ /rma bya khyim bya'i mjug sgro ni/ /snag ②tshar byas dang nas tshig thal/ /bi sha gla sgang pi pi ling / /dur byid sbrang rtsir sbyar ba ste/ /tshigs bcad phyed kyis rdzogs lde gu/ /gsum po bad kan lud pa sel/ /sbrang rtsi na le sham sbyar bldag④ /a ka ru sbrang rtsi nyid kyis/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri brta ka /bring ga ra dza' rjokhu ba dang / /ka sa marda rta sbangs bcir/ /khu ba bye rug ⑤nag po'i khu/ /sbrang rtsi so sor sbyar ba ldag rjo /thang shing zur pa ra sna dang / /byi tsher kar ka ta sring gi /gla sgang bca' sga pi pi ling / /kha ra a ru skyu ru ra / /'bras yos kha ra dkar po dang / /skyu ru ra yi pags ⑦pa rnams/ /sbrang rtsi til mar sbyar lde gu/ /gsum po rlung 'dres bad kan sel/ /se'u 'bru srang gnyis bu ram ni/ /srang brgyad tsha ba gsum srang res/ /skad snyan drod skyed yi ga 'byed/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde cham sel/ /bu ram ya bak+ṣa ra dang / /na le sham dang pi pi ling / /se'u 'bru rim gyis srang gnyis dang / /zho re srang byed tshad du sbyar/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel/ /rims kyi ⑧skabs bshad a ru ra/ /sogs dang kar ka ta sring gi/ /bskol ⑨ba'i khu ba 111—447

blud par bya/ /yang na dur byed la la phud/ /gla sgang ma nu bi sha la/ /pi pi ling bcas ba gcin nam/ /chur bskol ba gasbun lud pa sel/ /pi pi ling ni til mar brngos/ /lde gu zho gnyis kha rar bcas/ /rgya sran bskol ba'i khu bar sbyar/ /blud ①na bad kan lud pa 'joms/ /rtsa ba bcu khu bre bzhi dang / /mar bre gang dang ma nu dang / /zur pa bil ba bye'u rug pa/ /shing kun tsha gsum zho gnyis bskol/ /blud pa'i rjes la thug pa btung / /de kun bad kan rlung nad 'joms/ /nir gun thi lo bskol ba'i khu/ /mar bskol lud pa 'joms byed yin/ / byi dang ga ②yi khu ba'i nang / /tsha ba gsum bcug mar bskol phan/ /ba spru ba gnyis byi'u ⑪rug pa/ /ka sa mar da rjosle tres dang / /pa to la dang bri ha ti/ /pha nid dza ga'i khu ba ni/ /'o ma mar dang bcas pa la/ /tsha ba gsum dang legs bskol 'thungs/ /lud pa'i rims drag zad byed dang / /gzhang 'brum nad kyi 'jigs pa med/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑤ri'i rtsa ba dang / /'bras bu lo mar bcas pa yi/ /khu ba bye bzhi'i tshad la ni/ /mar bre gang dang ba la dudang / /tsha ba gsum dang bye dang ga⑦ /shu dag dang ni se'u 'bru dang / /kha ru tsha dang nas tshig thal/ /pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / /skyu ru ra dang ma nu dang //bri shi ba dang bri ha ti④/ /a ru ra dang ya ba ti⑨/ /kru trug tres dang rgun 'brum dang / /dbyi mong byi ⑩tsher bar sha bu⑪/ /star bu karka ta sring ⑫gi/ /ta ma la gi ga bra'i rtsa/ /ra sna gze ma'i lde gu dang / /bskol ba'i mar des lud kun dang / /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde la'ang phan/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑫ri'i sman mar 'di/ /bad kan nad ni sel byed yin/ /bya kri srang brgyad ⑫brdungs chu srang / /nyis stong bzhi bcu brgyad nang bskol/ /btsags par tsha ba 111—448

gsum ra sna/ /sle tres kru trug phye ma dang / / ka rka ①ta sring ga bra'i rtsa/ /gla sgang pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /byi tsher ba rnams srang phyed phyed/ /zhun mar srang ni bcu drug dang / /ka ④ra dkar po srang bzhi bcu/ /slar yang de ni bskol bya ba—/ /gzar bu la chags bsgrangs nas ni/ /pi pi ling dang smig ④rkang dang //sbrang rtsi rnying pa dag las ni/ /srang ni brgyad brgyad gzhug par bya/ /lde gu 'dis ni snying nad skran/ /gzhang 'brum lud dbugs mi bde sel/ /bad kan zhi ba dud pa brngub/ /shas cher sbyangs pa'i dud pa brngubabu/ /ldong ros ba bla shing mngar dang / /spang spos gla sgang i gu da'i/ /shun lpags du ba lud 'joms pa'i/ /cho gas dud pa brngubs nas ni/ /mchil mang mthar ni bu ram bcas/ /'o ma 'thungs pa'i dud rngubs des/ /rlung dang bad kan shas che ba'i/ /lud pa rnying pa'ang ⑤myur du sel/ /bad kan lud pa mun zhugs snyam—/ /gal te mkhris pa rjes 'brel la/ /der ni gnas skabs ji bzhin du//mkhris pa'i lud gso'i sbyor ba bya/ /rlung ni bad kan 'byel pa la/ /bad kan bsal ba'i bya ba bya/ /mkhris pa dang 'brel rjorlung bad kan/ /lud par mkhris pa bsal bar bya/ /rlung dang bad kan bdag nyid skam/ /gsher la ⑦snum dang rtsub chos bya/ /lud pa bad kan las gyur pa/ /mkhris par bcas pa kha bas gso/ /glo nad 'grams la 'phral du ni/ /rgya skyegs sbrang rtsi'i 'o ma blud/ /zhu nas sā ⑧lu'i 'bras chan ni/ /'o ma kha rar bcas pa bza' / /rtsib logs chu so na bcas te/ /mkhris drod shas chung chang sbyar btung / /bshang 'khru ⑨gla sgang bong ⑩nga dkar/ /pa ta dug mo nyung bcas btung / /rgya skyegs zhun mar sbrang rtsi ⑪dang / /'tsho byed sde tshan ka ra dkar//111—449

smig ①rkang kha ra mnyam 'o mar/ /bskol ba me drod che la blud/ /bu ram shing dang pad+ma'i tshigs/ /pad+ma ge sar tsan+dan dmar④/ /'o mar bskol ba sbrang rtsir bcas/ /glo 'grams 'byor par bya phyir blud/ /nas rjen phye ni 'o ma ru/ /btsos te mar dang sbyar ba 'am/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi 'o ma phye'i④/ /skyo ma rims tshad ldan la blud/ /lud pa can la sman mngar dang / /bskol ba'i zhun mar blud par bya/ /yang na bu ram chu bskol bsgrangs/ /sbrang rtsi na le sham btab blud//yang na skyu ru ra'i phye ma/ /'o mar bskol ba mar btab blud/ /yang na bcud kyis bulen cho gas/ /pi pi ling yang sbyin par bya/ /lud pa ⑤rus tshigs gzer ba la/ /rgun 'brum shing mngar ma du ka /smig rjorkang ba la pi pi leng /zhun mar sbrang ⑦rtsir bcas pa sbyin/ /dri sna gsum ni zho re dang / /pi pi ling srang phyed kha ra/ /rgun 'brum 'bra go ma du ka /srang re zhib tu btags nas ni/ /sbrang rtsis ri lur byas pa ④yis/ /ro tsa byed cing khrag mkhris dang //lud pa dbugs mi bde slon bro/ /brgyal myos skyigs bu mgo 'khor dang / / glo rdol 1)skad ni 'gags pa dang / / mchil ma ⑩lus skem rlung 'khyil dang / /mchil mar khrag 'byung rtsib logs na/ /snying nad skom dang rims nad 4tre'ajoms—/ /bar sha bu dang kha ra dkar/ /sā ⑫lu rtsa snar btags pa'i phye/ /rgun chu 'o ma mar du bskol/ /mchil ma khrag tu 'byung la blud/ /shing mngar dang ni ma du ka /tan du li ya 'or btsos phan/ /khrag ni gang tshe drag tu 'byung / /de btsos pa yi sman bsten bya/ /rlung 'khyil pa la ra tshil ni/ /chang brngos rgyam tshar bcas pa sbyin/ / skems shing nyam chung glo ⑫'grams dang //gnyid chung me drod che ba la/ /'o ma bskol ba'i spris mar chags/ /kha ra sbrang 111—450

rtsi mar bcas sbyin/ /ka ra dkar dang nas dang gro/ /'tsho byed zangs rtsi sbrang rtsir bcas/ /yang na 'o mar bskol te blud/ /glo 'grams nyam ①chung rid la sbyin/ /sha za'i sha yi khu ba ni/ /mar dang brngos pa'i pi pi ling / /sbrang rtsir bcas pa de la blud/ /sha dang khrag ni 'phel byed yin/ /u dus+thā ④ra n+ya gro dha/ /a shwat+tha dang blag sha ①dang / /sā la'i shing dang pri yang ku/ /ta la'i rtse mo 'dzam bu'i shun/ /pi pi ling ④dang shug par bcas/ /a shwa ka ⑤nar bcas pa ni/ /'o mar bskol ba las byung ba'i/ /mar dang 'bras chan bza' ba ni/ /glo rjo'agrams khu ba nyams stobs dang / /dbang po'i nus pa zad la sbyin/ /rlung mkhris kyis nyen yan lag zhig⑦ /na la mar des bskus pa bsngags/ /rlung nad kyis ni nyen pa la/ /rlung 'joms sman bskol til mar bsku/ /'tsho ⑧byed sde tshan zhun mar ni/ /snying dang rtsib logs na la blud—/ /yang na rlung ⑨nad 'joms pa dang / /khrag mkhris sel ba gang yin byarka/ /shing mngar nā ga pa la gnyis/ /'o ma dang mnyam ⑩mar bskol bar/ /ba ya gye ⑪dang pi pi ling / /smig ⑫rkang lde gu bskol bas ⑫ni/ /glo 'grams pa yi nad la phan/ /'tsho byed sde tshan bca' sga dang / /nye'u shing pa dang ra mnye ba—/ /ba spru ⑫ba gnyis pa ⑫la dang / /ga bra'i rtsa ba kha sral phre'u⑩/ /ri di zur pa ka ma la/ /shring ⑩ga da ka ka spyoya su/ /rtsa ba lnga ni chung ngu dang / /rgun 'brum star ga'i 'bras bu sogs/ /mngar shing snum la stobs skyed pa⑪/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis btags lde gu/ /de nang ⑫zhun mar bre gang bskol/ /'o ma ra sha ⑥sgyu ru ra/ /bi da ri dang bu ram shing / /khu ba ra sha'i khu bar bcas/ /bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi ni/ /bre phyed kha ra srang lnga bcu/ /na le sham 111—451

dang sug ①smel dang / /shing tsha garnya bha dra dang / /na sdeg ge sar srang phyed phyed—/ /phye mar btags te bcug nas ni/ /'ju stobs rjes mthun tshad du blud—/ /'di ni bdud rtsi'i ①sman mar te/ /mi rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi yin/ /bdud rtsi 'di ni zos nas su/ /'o ma sha khu ldan zos na/ /khu chu nyams dang glo 'grams dang / /nyams stobs zad pa'i gso ba yin/ /bud med la gdu rjolus skem dang / /mdog skad nyams la gtang bar bya/ /lud pa dang ni skyigs bu rims/ /dbugs mi bde dang lus ⑤cha dang / /skom dad khrag mkhris sel byed cing / /bu skyed byed byung slon 0dang brgyal/ /mngal nad gcin nad 'joms byed yin/ /gze ma btsod dang pu shel tse⑦/ /ba la tang pal bu ti ka / kṛṇ+ḍa paṇi drur ba'i rtsa⑧/ /thal tres ste ra pa la sha⑨ /de rnams srang re bskol ba yi/ /'o ma sman khu'i bzhi 'gyur la/ /kha sral phre'u dzi ⑪badhi/ /me da gnyis dang zangs rtsi ba/ /dzi ⑪ba ka dang nye'u shing dang ⑫//ri di rgun 'brum sha kha ⑫ra/ /sra ba dang ni pad+ma'i rtsa/ /mar ni bre gang bskol ba yis/ /rlung mkhris snying 'dzag gzer nad sel/ /gcin sri ba dang gcin snyi baspyo/ /gzhang 'brum lud pa lus skem dang / /zad byed rims ni sel byed cing / /gzhu 'dren bud med chang dang lam/ /khur dub stobs dang sha zad skyedaske/ /shing mngar srang brgyad rgun 'brum ni/ /bre gang bskol bar mar btsos la/ /pi pi ling srang brgyad lde gu/ /bre gang bskol ba ⑫bsgrangs nas ni//kha ra sbrang rtsi re re zhing / /srang brgyad dang ni bsres pa la/ /nas ⑫phye mnyam sbyor ⑩zos pa yis/ /de ni glo 'grams zad byed dang / /khrag gi skran la phan pa yin/ /skyu ru ra spyodang bi da ri/ /bu ram shing khu 'tsho byed kyispyo/ /111—452

sde tshan bskol ba'i khu ba mar/ /ba dang ra yi 'o ma las/ /bre ni re re btso bar bya/ /bskol btsags kha ra sbrang rtsi ①ni/ /bre re der ni gzhug par bya/ /de ni zad byed brjed byed dang / /khrag dang mkhris pa lud pa dang / /lus skem pa ni sel byed cing / /rgas sra tshe ni ring ba dang / /sha dang khu chu stobs skyed byed/ /mkhris pa shas ches mar bldag ②bya/ /rlung shas che bas btung bar bya/ /bldags ④pas mkhris pa zhi byed kyisarjo/ /nyung bas rlung ni 'joms mi nus/ /'thungs na rlung ni gnon byed byung / /me drod nang du sdud par byed/ / skems shing ⑤lus kyi sha zad pas/ /sman mar bshad pa 'di dag nyid/ /smig rkang 'bras yos pi pi ling / /phye ma sde gur byas la sbyin/ /zhun mar bu ram sbrang rtsi'i cha/ /bcug ste byin la 'o ma blud/ /ro tsa brtson dang lus rgyas stobs/ /'di yis dumyur du skyed par 'gyur/ /bum sha shun lpags sa bon bsal/ /srang brgyad ⑦rlangs par btsos nas ni/ /zhun mar bre gang nang gzhug dkrugs④/ /sbrang rtsi'i mdog 'drar gyur pa dang / /hwags ni srang brgyad ⑨pi pi ling / /bca' sga zi ra srang gnyis dang / /dri sna gsum dang 'u su dang / /na le sham ni re re zhing / /srang ni phyed phyed tshad bcug la⑩/ /phab ste bsgrangs par gyur pa dang / /sbrang rtsi mar gyi phyed bcug la/ /gzar bus ⑩dkrugs te bzhag gyur pa/ /lud pa skyigs bu yi ga 'chus/ /dbugs mi bde dang khrag mkhris dang / /glo 'grams zad ⑫byed 'joms par byed/ /glo 'grams pa ni 'byor byed cing / /blo dang dran pa stobs rab skyed/ / ku sman da ⑫yi bcud kyis len/ /yid du 'ong ba dam pa 'di/ /tha skar bu gnyis kyis bshad yin/ / nā ga pa ④la'i rtsa ba ni/ /zho gcig sogs kyis 111—453

bskyed srang gcig /'o mar bcas pa zla gcig btung / /'o ma spyad ①cing zas mi bza'/ /sbyor 'dis ②tshe ni 'phel byed cing / /stobs skyed kha dog bzang byed mchog /man du ka paṇi ④shing mngar/ /bca' sga'i spyor ba'ang 'di yin no/ /nā ga pa la srang brgya ni/ /chu srang lnga brgya rjortsa bcu gnyis/ /nang du bskol te bzhi cha lus/ /sman khu de dang cha mnyam pa'i/ /'o ma mar dang bskol bar bya/ /ba ⑤la a ti ba dul dang / /shing mngar pur+ṇa ⑦rna ba dang / /stag tsher ⑧ba dang tang pal dang / /pi la ya dang kha sral phre'u/ /a shwa gan+dha ⑨kha ra dkar/ /nye ⑩shing me da rnam gnyis dang / /gze ma ram nye ba gnyis dang / /pa ya su ⑪dang zi ra gnyis/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba sdong bu dang / / 'bra go sring ⑫ga ta ka dang / /ke ⑫she ru ka srang phyed phyed/ /nā ga pa la'i sman mar 'dis④/ /khrag mkhris glo rdol ⑫zad byed dang / /skom dad mgo 'khor sel byed cing / /stobs ni skyed par byed pa'i mchog /mdog sdug mdangs bzang tshe 'phel zhing / /skra dkar gnyer ma 'jig par byed/ /zla ba drug gi bar bsten na/ /rgan po'ang gzhon nu nyid du 'gyur/ /cho ga 'dis ni drod skyed cing / /me drod bri ba skyed 'ju byed/ /gcong chen bshad pa'ang glo rdol ⑩bsngags/ /'khru na ⑩gcod par byed par ⑫phan/ /rtsa ba bcu pa kha sral phre'u/ / shang ka ⑪put+pa zur pa dang/ /pa la ha ste ⑥pi pi ling / /a pa marga kru trug ⑥tres/ /ga bra pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /ma nu srang ni gnyis gnyis dang / /nas srang drug cu rtsa bzhi dag /a ru ra ni srang brgya dag /chu srang drug brgya bzhi bcus bskol/ /nas tshos pa dang sman khu de/ /btsags la a ru ra brgya der/ /bu ram srang brgya bcug la bskol/ /mar dang til mar 111—454

pi pi ling / /phye ma srang ni brgyad po dag①/ /bskol te bsgrangs nas sbrang rtsir gzhug /rtag tu a ru ra gnyis bcas/ /lde gu bcud len 'di zos na//'dis ②ni skra dkar gnyer ma med/ /tshe ring mdog stobs 'phel bar byed/ /lud lnga zad ①byed dbugs mi bde/ /skyigs bur bcas pa'i mi bzad rims/ /gcin snyi ba yi nad dang ni/ /gzhang 'brum skran dang snying nad dang / /cham pa yi ga 'chus pa sel/ /bcud kyis ④len mchog dpal yon can/ /'di ni drang srong ṛ ⑤ṣis bshad/ /rtsa ba bcu pa ba la dang / /mur ba ser po rnam gnyis rjodang / /pi pi ling ni rnam gnyis dang / /pa tha a shwa garnya dang / /a pa marga kha sral phre'u/ /sle tres dan ti bong nga dkar/ /bil ba gzhon nu dur byid dang / /tsi tra ka rtsa lo mar bcas/ /pa ya gya ⑦dang dug mo nyung / /spang spos bi za ⑧ka'i snying po/ /me tog bcas dang rkang mar dang / /go bye byi dang ga ⑨ta dang / /nye'u shing bu ti ka rañdza/ /dong ga so ma ra dza dang / /sa ha ra dza shi ⑩kru dang / /nim pa'i shun lpags bu ram shing / /phra mo'i khu ba srang re dang / /a ru ra stong chig brgya dang / /nas srang nyis brgya lnga bcu drug/chu ni brgyad 'gyur nang du bskol/ /nas tshos pa dang phog nas ni/ /btsags nas a ru ra bcas der/ /bu ram rnying pa srang brgyad ⑩gzhug /til mar zhun mar skyu ru'i khu⑫/ /bre re bcug nas de rjes yang / /me chung la ni btsos nas su/ /gzar bur ⑫chags nas thab las dbab/ /bsgrangs nas sbrang rtsi bre do dang / /pi pi ling ni phul gang gzhug /dri sna gsum ni phyer btags pa—/ /srang gsum bcug nas de 'og tu/ /rdza snod rnying bcug 'bru nang du/ /bcug ste zla ba gcig gzhag bya/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du bza'/ /gnas 111—455

'jog gis bshad bcud len 'di①/ /sngon las ④yon tan lhag par che/ /nad med kyis bza' dgag pa med/ /dus kun du yang bsngags pa yin/ /rgyam tsha bca' sga srang re dang / /kha ru tsha ni srang gnyis dang / /da trig se'u 'bru ardza ka /de dag srang ni bzhi bzhi dang / /na le sham gcig go snyod gnyis—/ /'u su'i 'bras bu srang bzhi dang / /tshad 'di las ni phye mar byas/ /zas dang skom la btab ste sbyin/ /des ④ni yi ga 'byed pa dang / /me drod skyed cing nyams stobs skyed/ /rtsib logs na dang dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa lu ba'i nad sel byed/ /'u su zho gnyis go snyod dang / /la la phud la rjozhe bzhi bzhiske/ /se ⑤'bru dang ni da trig dgarjo /de yi nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur bya/ /kha ru tsha ni srang gcig dang / /bca' sga zho gnyis bil ba'i rkang / /srang lnga dang ni sbyar ba la/ /kha ra srang ni bcu drug gzhug /ro drug pa ⑦'di bza' ba dang / /btung ba snga ma bzhin du sbyin/ /gcong chen las ⑧bshad cho ga gang / /gnas skabs ji bzhin glo rdol ⑨phan/ /glo rdol ⑩nad ni byang gyur nasarka/ /bad kan skyes nas mgo bo brang / /na ba'i lud pa can gang yin/ /de la dud pa 'di brngub bya/ /me da gnyis dang ba la gnyis/ /shing mngar gso ma'i shun lpags ni/ /lde gur byas la reng bur ni/ /byas te dud pa brngub par bya/ /de rjes 'tsho byed sman mar btung / /ldong ros dang ni ba la sha /a za garnya cu gang ⑪dang / /dong gra las kyang de bzhin bya/ /de rjes kha ra bu ram dang / /bu ram shing khu btung bar blud/ /ldong ros dang ni n+ya gro dha'i/ /myu gu rlon pa cha snyoms spyobatags/ /zhun mar dang sbyar dud pa brngubarka/ /de 'og sreg pa'i sha khu btung / /glo rdol ⑫las byung lud pa la/ /111—456

thog mar stobs dang me drod skyed/ /nad gzhi mang la snum bcas pa'i /bkru sman 'jam po gtang bar bya/ /dong ga dang ni dur byid gnyis/ /rgun 'bru'i ①chu dang sbyar ba dang / /seng phrom bskol ba'i khu ba dang / /bi da ri ②yi khu bar sbyar/ /zhun mar la btsos ci rigs sbyin/ /lus zad pa la sbyar bar bya/ /mkhris pa bad kan lus zungs rnams/ /zad pa'i zad byed lud pa can/ /mar dang karka ta sring gi/ /'o ma ba la gnyis bskol blud/ /bi da ri 'am ka tam pa/ /ta la'i 'bras bu bskol ba yi/ /mar dang 'o ma gcin nad ni/ /mdog 'gyur sri bar byed la blud/ /pho mtshan rkub dang chu so dang / /brla dbrag mjug to skrang zhing ①na/ /mar gyi nying khu yang ba 'am/ /til mar bsres pa'i 'jam rtsi gtang / /skam sa'i srog chags sha dang ni/ /byi'u rjosogs dang ni khung na gnas/ /de bzhin mthu rtsal gyis zas tshol/ /sha za'i sha yang rim ⑤bzhin sbyin/ /dro bas bad kan 'jig byed la/ /rtsa sbubs rnams ni dag byed cing / /dwangs ma legs par rgyu byed las/ /lus ni rgyas par byed par 'gyur/ /dbyi mo bar rjogyi 'bras bu gsum/ /rtsa ba bcu dang tsi tra ka /rgya sran pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /ba ta rgya shug nas chur bskol/ /li dong gra dang byi tsher ⑦ba/ /zur pa ma nu pi pi ling / /karka ta yi sring gi btags/ /mnyam pa'i zhun mar dag dang bskol/ /bskol ba'i mar 'di k+ṣa ra ⑧gnyis/ /lan tshwa ⑨lnga ni btags te gzhug /de las ran par 'thungs na ⑫ni/ /zad byed lud pas nyen pa sel/ /ka sa mar da ⑩a ru ra/ /gla sgang pa ta kad ⑫pa la / /dong gra pi pi ling tang pal/ /pu tse shel tshad zho gnyis gnyis/ /mar ni bre gang 'o ma dang / /rgun chu bre bzhi'i nang du bskol/ /zad byed 111—457

rims dang mchin pa'i nad/ /lud pa kun sel dge ba yin/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ①ri ba sha ka /sle tres rtsa ba 'bras bu dang / /myu gu lo mar bcas pa rnams/ /bskol ba'i khu ba mar du btsos/ /lud pa'i rims kyis btab pa dang / /yi ga 'chus pa'i nad rnams sel/ /se 'bru'i khu ba nyis 'gyur ram/ /tsha gsum ldan par bskol ④ba'ang phan/ /ya bak+ṣa ra mar dang sbyar/ /zas zos pa yi 'og tu blud/ /pi pi ling dang bu ram bskol/ /ra yi 'o ma mar bcas phan/ /'di ni me drod sbyar phyir te①/ /zad byed lus ④can gyis mar btung / /nad kyis 'gags pa'i mid pa brang / /rtsa sbubs rnams ni ⑤dag par byed/ /nas ni bre gang btsos pa ru/ /rnam par rgyal ba nyi shu btsorjo/ /tshos nas de phyung ⑦mnyes nas der/ /bu ram rnying pa srang drug dang / /pi pi ling ni srang gnyis dang / /ldong ros zho gnyis skyer khaṇ+ḍa⑧/ /zho gcig tshad ni bcug nas ni/ /slar yang bskol ba'i lde gu des⑨/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde sel byed/ /reg 'jam sgro rtsa bsregs nas ni/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar/ /yang na rma bya'i rkang pa bsregs/ /mar dang sbrang rtsir sbyar ba yi/ /lde gu zos na lud pa dang / /dbugs mi bde ba sel bar byed/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi ⑩thal ba ni/ /til mar tsha gsum bu ram bcas/ /lde gu'am bye'u ⑪rug e raṇ+ḍa'i/ /lo ma'i thal ba de bzhin bya/ /tsha ba gsum gyi phye ma ni/ /bu ram rnying pa mar sbyar phan//shug pa tsha gsum 'bras bu gsum/ / byi dang ga ⑫dang thang shing dang / /ba la ra sna'i ⑫phye ma kun/ /de dang mnyam pa'i kha rar sbyar/ /yang na sbrang rtsi mar dang sbyar/ /sde gu lud pa sel byed mchog /de bzhin na le sham gyi bye/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas/ /a ru ra dang bca' sga ni/ /bu ram dang ni 111—458

bcas pa yi/ / ri lu ①khar ni bzhag gyur na/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde kun selaske/ /yang na ba ru ra 'ba' zhig /lud pa sel bar byed pa yin/ /seng phrom a mra kha ra dang / /bcas pa'i lde gu mar dang brngos/ /thug pa zan dron nang du btab④/ /slon bro skom dang lud pa dang / /ma zhu tshad 'khru sel bar byed/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i snekhu bar bskol/ /muṅga'i ④khu bar legs g.yos pa⑤—/ /skyu ru ra ser se'u rjo'abrur bcas/ /lud pa kun gyi sman gyur yin/ /rlung 'joms sman bskol 'o ma 'am/ /mchu yis zas tshol khron rko dang / /khung na gnas pa'i sha khu ni/ /zad byed lud pa can la sbyin/ /glo rdol dze+egyis dud brngubs la gang / /btung bar bcas pa bsten pa yang / /zad byed lud par de gtang bya/ /gang yang gcong chen skabs su bshad/ /stobs skyed me drod skyed pa dang / /rtsa rgyun sbyong bar byed pa'i sman/ /rnam grangs zad byed lud can la/ /stobs skyed thams cad bsngags pa yin/ /gang phyir 'dus pa las byung ba'i/ /zad byed lud pa mi bzad pas/ /de phyir nad stobs ji bzhin du/ /'dus pa'i nad la phan pas gso/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas skyigs bu dang dbugs mi bde ba gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /gang phyir skyigs bu dbugs mi bde/ /rgyu sogs mtshungs ⑧pas de yi phyir/ /gso ba'ang gcig ste des nyen ⑨la/ /thog mar dugs kyi ⑩nyer dpyad bya/ /snum dang lan tshwa til mar byug /de yis bad kan bu gar 'gags/ /shin tu zhen pa zhu nas ni/ /khong par gnas pa legs par 'byen/ /bu ga'i rgyun 111—459

srang mnyen gyur cing / /rlung ni lugs dang mthun par rgyu/ /'jam zhing rlan gyur zas snum dang / /rlan can shar bcas sbyin pa 'am/ /yang na zho yi spris ma sbyin/ /de nas de la rlon ①'jam btang / /mchog tu lud pa rnying ④nad dang / /skad 'gags pa la sgyug sman sbyin/ /rgyam tsha sbrang rtsi pi pi ling / /sbyar ba'am rlung la phan pa gtang / /bad kan gyis ④ni gnod byas ④pa/ /gsal ⑤na bde ba thob 'gyur la/ /bu ga rnam par dag gyur menas/ /rlung ni gnod pa med par rgyu/ /lto sbos rtug 'gags mun 'thibs byed/ /ma du lung ga star bu dang / /shid+kun pi lu kha ru tsha/ /ldan zas byen na bde bar 'byung / /rgyam tshar bcas pa'i 'bras bu skyur/ /cung zad dro ba'i bkru sman gtang / /'di dag bad kan gyis lam bkag /srog gi rlung ni 'khrugs las byung / /de bas de lam bsal bya'i phyir/ /steng dang 'og tu sbyang byas phan/ /ji ltar 'bag ⑦par gyur pa'i chu/ /shin tu 'khyil zhing 'phel ba ltar/ /de bzhin rlung ni 'khyil gyur pa'i/ /de lam legs par sbyang bar bya/ /sbyang ba byas kyang ma dag pa'i/ /zhen pa'i dri ma du bas bsal/ /yung ba'i lo ma e raṇ+ḍa'i//rtsa ba rgya skyegs ldong ros dang / /thang shing ba la spang spos bcas/ /btags te reng bu ⑧nyid du bya/ /de ni mar bskus dud pa rngub/ /yang na mar sbrus nas bsregs rngubasti/ /spra tshil sra rtsi ⑩pog dag gam/ /a ka ru bzang mar sbyar rngub⑪/ /de bzhin tsan+dan glang rwa ⑫'am/ /sru 'am rgyus pa'i dud pa rngub/ /btsod ⑫dang go da ku rang ga /dgo ba lpags mig ra yi'am/ /yang na gu gul ldong ros sam/ /yang na sā ④la'i thang chu nyid/ /mo rtsa gu gul a ga ru/ /shug pa mar dang bcas dud rngub/ /dugs byar mi rung btang snyoms gzhag /111—460

brang dang mid pa zhom pa la/ /bshol du med na 'jam dugs bya/ /kha ra dkar po'i 'o mas sam/ /dro 'jam tsam gyis dugs bya zhing / /dkri dang ldan par bya ba'i dugs/ /dugs kyi le'ur bshad dugs bya/ /ma zhur de gso'i cho ga spyad/ /sbyor drags rlung shas cher ①gyur na/ /rlung nad bsal ba'i sbyor ba bya//sha khu snum sogs rab tsha sbyinasde/ /bsku ba dag gis zhi bar bya/ /bad kan ma slong dugs mi bya/ /nyam ①chung ba la sbyang byas pas/ /rlung gi gnas rnyed gnas ④rnams ni/ /skam par byas nas srog 'phrog byed/ /de bas sman khu snum dang ni/ /lde gu stsogs kyis de zhir ⑤bya/ /skem zhing glo rdol dhitshad 'khru dang / /khrag mkhris tsha ba las byung ba'i/ /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba la/ /mngar snum bsil stsogs dag gis gso/ /ku lat+tha dang rtsa ba bcu/ /bskol ba'i skam sa'i sha khu phan/ / shi kru par ta ⑦ka dang ni/ /ka sa mar da ⑧ba sha ka /la phug lo ma'i khu ba dang / /nim pa'i myu gu las byung dang / /kha lung bri ha ti khu ⑨phan/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑩ri byi tsher ba/ /bil ba'i rkang dang gze ma dang //sle tres kar ka ta sring gi /tsi tra ka dang ku laṅga/ /chur bskol ba yi yu sha bya//yang na ra sna rtsa chung lnga/ /muṅga tsi tra kar bcas blud/ /tsi tra go snyod kha ru tsha/ /kar ka ta sring ⑪thug pa phan/ /yang na rtsa ba bcu sbyar ba'i/ /thug pa blud na lud pa dang / /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde nad sel/ /rtsa ba bcu pa ra sna dang //zur pa ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / /bil ba gnyis dang ma nu dang / /kar ka ta sring pi pi ling / /lca ⑫ba sle tres bca' sga ni/ /bskol ba'i khu ba blud zhu nas/ /de nyid dang btsos thug pa blud/ /sā ⑫lu drug cu pa dang gro/ /nas dang muṅga rgya sran zos/ /lud pa snying nad rtsib logs zug /skyigs bu dbugs mi 111—461

bde ba sel/ /yang na arga'i myu gu yi/ /'o ma dang sbrus ①nas kyi zan/ /sbrang rtsi dang bcas rtsa bcu sogs/ /bskol ba'i khu bar sbyar ba blud/ /zas ni k+ṣa ra shing kun mar/ /kha ru tsha dang se'u sbyar za②/ /ma nu zur pa tsha ba gsumaske/ /star bu kha lung sbyar ba sbyin/ /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde skom dang / /rtsa ba bcu bskol khu ba 'am/ /yang na thang shing bskol khu 'am⑧/ /chang gi dwangs ma blud par bya/ /pi pi ling dang de'i ④rtsa ba/ /a ru ra dang byi dang ga⑤/tsi tra ka rnams lde gur sbyar/ /mar snod bskus te bskams pa ru/ /snod du dar ba zla gcig gzhag /de 'thungs me yi drod skyed cing / /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel/ /pa ta mur pa thang shing dang / /sa ra la dang chang dwangs ma/ /nub gcig bzhag ste lan tshwa btab/ /de las khyer gang blud par bya—/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba bca' sga'i phye'am/ /ya bak+ṣa ra na le sham/ /bcas phye chu tshan blugs rjopa phan/ /ba spri ⑦ka ni bskol ba'i chu/ /btags pa lde gur byas bsres blud/ /sab ta paṇi'i khya ba 'am/ /shri sha yi di me tog ni/ /pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /bad kan mkhris pa 'dres gyur pa'i/ /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde ba sel/ /cu gang pi pi ling dang ni/ /'bras dang bca' sga mar dag las/ /khu ba mkhris pa las gyur sel/ /rlung dang ldan la reg 'jam sha /ri bong sha dang pi pi ling / /mar dang sha spya ④ka yi khrag /lcam pa'i khu ba tsha ba gsum/ /mar dang 'o mar sbyar ba dang / /'bras chan zos la 'o ma blud/ /rlung mkhris 'dres pa las gyur sel/ /ra yi 'o ma bzhi 'gyur gyis⑨—/ /chu bskol bu ram dong gra ⑩btab/ /pi pi ling rtsa shing mngar dang / /bu ram lca thotreb rta sbangs khu/ /sbrang rtsi mar sbyar zos gyur na/ /skyigs bu 111—462

dbugs mi bde ba sel/ /rta dang glang po ba lang phag /rnga mong bong bu lug dang ra/ /gang yang rung ba'i rtug bcir khu/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba bldags na phan/ /bad kan shas cher btung ba blud/ /rkang bzhi pa yi lpags ①rus spu//rmig pa bsregs la snag ②tshar byas/ /a shwa garnya'i lde gu ni/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bad kan shas/ /che ba'i dbugs mi bde ba sel/ /zur pa ma nu skyu ru ra'am / /ma nu pi pi ling bcas phan/ /yug snam pi pi ling bcas pa'am/ /ka bid ta ①yi khu ba 'am/ / bil ba'i ④rkang khu skyu ru ra/ /pi pi ling dang rgyam tshar bcas⑤/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi a ru ra'am/ /tsha ba gnyis dang kha ru rjotsha//rgya shug 'bras yos sbrang rtsi dang / /rgun 'bru ⑦pi pi ling dong gra/ /bu ram rgun 'bru yung ⑧ra sna/ /pi pi ling dang na le sham/ /til mar dang ni sbyar ba phanarka/ /lde gu ⑨sman gyi phye ma yang / /sha khu chu dron tsha stsogs btung / /dzi ⑫ban ti dang gla sgang dang / /bye'u ⑪rug pa dang shing tsha dang / /sug spel gnyis dang ma nu dang / / lca ba ta ma ma li ka⑫ /a ru ra dang ga bra'i rtsa/ /dong ga ⑫dang ni ba la ka /zur pa kar ka ta ④sring gi /nā ga ge sar pi pi ling / /tsa rong ⑫ci rigs sbyar nas ni/ /phye ma nyis 'gyur kha rar bcas/ /rtsib logs nad ⑩rims lud pa sel/ /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde 'joms mchog /dong ga ⑩bu ram cha mnyam pa/ /bza' ba'am sna nas btang sman bya/ /yang na sgog skya'am kun dong ngam/ /gri ⑫dza na yi rtsa bas bya/ /tsan+dan gyi ni khu ba dang / /bud med nu zho snar blugs bya/ /sbrang ma'i rtug pa nu zhor sbyar/ /rgya skyegs khu ba dang sbyar blugs⑪/ /rgyam tsha zhun mar dang bcas pa/ /nu zho mar dang bskol ba 'am/ /mngar ba'i sman dang lde gur byas/ /de btung ba 111—463

'am sna nas gtang / /kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas pa ni/ /grang dro res kyis blugs ①pa 'am/ /de bzhin 'o ma bskol ba ni/ /sman gyi phye ma ②mar sbyar blugs/ /pi pi ling dang kha ru tsha/ /ya bak+ṣa ra sle tres dang / /shing kun tso ra bye'u rug paske/ /mar dang zho ga ②chur sbyar zhing / /rtsa bcu'i khu bar bskol ba blud/ /yang na 'tsho byed bskol ba'i khu/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa dhiblud par bya/ /te dzo ba ti a ru ra/ /pi pi ling dang pu tse shel/ /ru rta ma nu ⑤bu ti ka /tsi tra ka dang pa la sharjo /zur pa lan tshwa rnam ⑦gnyis dang / /dzi ⑧ban ti dang bil ba'i rkang / /shu dag bal ⑨bu'i lo ma rnams/ /de dag zho ni gnyis gnyis bskol—/ /shing kun zho phyed mar bye gang / /bskol ba de ni 'thungs gyur na/ /rkang lag la ni zhen pa'i rlung / /gzhang 'brum dang ni pho ba'i nad/ /skyigs bu snying nad rtsib logs zug /myur du sel bar byed pa yin/ /zhun mar cha phyed bcas pa yi/ /ya bak+ṣa ra rgyam tsha sbyin/ /thang la 'bar gyi'am dug gi mar/ /zho can ha bu sha'i mar blud/ /chu grang glo bur blugs ⑩pa dang / /sngangs dang sprugs dang 'jigs pa dang / /dga' dang phrag dog dbugs bsdams dang / /gnod pa'i 'bu yi ⑪sos btab dang / /gang yang bad kan rlung 'joms sman/ /dro zhing rlung ni bde rgyu bsten/ /gang yang phal cher rlung gi nad/ /lhag par 'joms par byed pas spyad/ /thams cad la ni brta byas pas/ /tshabs chung gso bar sla ba yin/ /lhag par nyams smad pa yis ni/ /zhi ba'i thabs su 'gyur ma yin/ /de bas zhi ba brta ba'i thabs—/ /mang ⑫po de la spyad par bya/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde gcong slon/ /skyigs bu'i sman ni phan tshun 'dre/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/111—464

gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u bzhi pa'o// //de nas gcong chen po gso ba'i thabs kyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /stobs ldan nad ni mang gyur la/ /snum chos dugs byas sbyang ba ni/ /snum med ma yin nyam ①smod min/ /steng 'og gi ni sbyang bar bya/ /'o ma po son char bcas pa'am/ /sha khu mngar dang ldan pa 'amasde/ /zhun mar btab pa'i nas gathug ni/ /skyug sman bskol bas slon du gzhug /sha ma dur byid dong grar ④bcas—/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi mar dang ni/ /bcas pa'i 'o ma 'am skyo ma'am/ /rgun 'bru tang rjopal bi da ri/ /yang na sha khur ldan pa yirjo/ /bkru sman 'jam po gtang bar bya/ /lto sbyang ba ④la brta ba dang / /drod skyed cho ga spyad par bya/ /zas skom yi gar 'ong ba dang / /rlung 'joms byed cing yang ba sbyin/ /shā ⑧lu drug cu pa dang gro/ /nas dang muṅga lo gcig lon/ /ra yi 'o ma mar dang shasha za'i sha ni zad ⑨byed 'joms/ /bya rog 'ug pa spyang ki gzig /ba lang rta dang ne+e le sbrul/ /bya rgod rnga mo bang ⑩bu khra'i/ /sha ni sgyu ⑪yis byin na phan//shes na de las smod pas na/ /slon zhing mdangs dang stobs mi 'gyur/ /bad mkhris ri dwags la sogs sha /rlung la mthu rtsal gzan tshol sha / tsho khur spyosbyar zhing phan pa dang / /sha khu ⑫sogs la'ang sbyar bar bya/ /yungs mar dag dang brngos ⑫pa 'am/ /yang na ci rigs mar dang brngos8/ /khu bar ldan zhing mnyen la snum/ /spod la sogs dang legs g.yos sbyin/ /de bzhin la phug rgya sran las/ /g.yos pa'i yu shar sbyar bar bya/ /pi pi ling bcas nas dang bcasaske/ /rgya sran bcas shing dong grar bcas/ /se'u 'bru skyu ru ra dang bcas//111—465

ra sha'i khu ba snum bcas ①blud/ /des ni cham pa la sogs pa/ /gnod pa drug ni sel bar 'gyur/ /mkhris pa sogs las khyad par du/ /chang rnying rtsa sbubs sbyong byed pa/ /ngoms pa nyid du blud par bya/ /rgan chang chang rnying chang dwangs blud/ /rtsa ba chung ngu lngar bskol ba'am/ /ta ma la ka chur bskol ba'am—/ /paṇi ②bzhi dang bskol ba 'am/ /'u su bca' sga ④bskol ba blud/ /de dang bukha zas gtsang ba dag /'bad pas btsos pa ⑤rjes mthun yin/ /rtsa ba bcu dang 'o ma 'am/ /sha khu'i nang du btso bar rjobya/ /ba la btab pa'i mar sbyar ba'am/ /sha za'i sha khur btsos pa sbyin/ /'o ma bcu 'gyur dag dang ni/ /mar bskol sbrang rtsir bcas pa'ang phan/ /dzi ⑦ban ti dang shing mngar dang / /rgun 'bru khrudug mo nyung 'bras bu/ /ma nu zur pa pi pi ling / /bya kri ⑨gze ma ba la dang / /ta ma la ki ut+pal sngo/ /kyi ⑩lce ba dang byi tsher ba//sde gur byas dang mar bskol ba/ /gcong chen sel ba'i dam pa yin/ /'bra ⑪go rgun 'brum ma du ka /pa ru sha dang pi pi ling / /mar dang bskol bas skad 'gags dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde rims 'joms/ /rtsa bcu 'o mar bskol ⑫ba las/ /byung ba'i mar gsar ⑫gang yin de/ /pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir bcas/ /skad 'gags sel ba'i dam pa yin/ /mgo brang rtsib logs gzer 'joms shing / /lud pa dbugs mi bde rims sel/ /rtsa ba lnga pa lngar bskol ba'i/ /'o ma las byung mar gang yin/ /rtsa ba lnga pa lnga yi ni/ /khu ba 'o ma'i bzhi 'gyur la/ /bskol ba yi ni mar 'di yis/ /zad ④byed kyi ni stobs bdun 'joms/ /ya bak+ṣa ra tsha ba lnga/ /srang drug dang ni btsos pa'i mar—/ /bre gang 'o ma cha mnyam byas/ /de yis bu ga dag byed cing / /skran 111—466

dang dmu rdzing mcher pa dang / /pho nad skya rbab cham pa dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde drod nyams/ /skrang ①dang stod ②kyi rlung nad 'joms/ /ra sna ba la gze ma dang / / ti ra ba ra sha khu'i chur/ /dzi ①ban ti dang pi pi ling / /'o bcas gcong chen 'joms pa'i mchog /a shwa garnya 'o mar bskol/ /las byung mar 'o kha rar bcas/ /spyi yi sha ni srang brgya dag /chu bre sum cu gnyis na rjobaskol/ /de yi brgyad cha lus pa ru/ /'tsho byed bcu ni srang re gzhug /zhun mar bre gang bcas bskol ba/ /sha yi sman mar 'di blud pa'am—/ /sha khu dang sbyar ci rigs sbyin/ /rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur nad//lud pa dbugs mi bde skad 'gags/ /skem zhing ⑤rtsib logs zug pa 'joms /sug smel ti rjomu sa 'bras gsum/ /sa nag tsha ba gsum tsi tra/ /sa ra nim pa seng ldeng dang / /sā ⑦la'i 'bras bu las byung dang / /go bye dang ni byi dang ga⑧ /srang ni brgyad brgyad tshad du byas/ /chu ni bcu drug 'gyur byas par⑨/ /bcu drug char gnas bar du bskol/ /slar yang de dang mar bre gang / /bskol ba 'dir ni cu gang ni/ /srang drug khar srang sum cu ⑩bcug /sbrang rtsi srang ni drug cu gzhug /dri sna gsum ni srang re gzhug /gzar bus dkrugs te sde gur byas/ /snga dro zos la 'o ma btung / /bcud len bsdams ⑪pa med pa yin—/ /yid gzhungs mig rno tshe ring la/ /drod skyed skran dang gcong chen nad—/ /skya rbab dang ni mtshan bar rdol⑩/ /myur du 'joms par byed pa yinarka/ /gang yang zhun mar bu ram bcas/ /glo rdol ⑫la bshad zad byed sbyar/ /shing tsha sug grel pi pi ling / /cu gang kha ra rim nyis ⑫'gyur/ /phye mar byas bza' 'am sbrang rtsi dang / /mar dang sbyar te sde gur zos/ /skad 'gags lud 111—467

pa dbugs mi bde/ /zad byed rtsib logs bad kan 'joms/ /'di yi skad 'gags la khyad par/ /sna sman dud pa rngub stsogs bya/ / de la'ang ①rlung las gyur pa la/ /ka sa mar da brda ②ka /briṅga ra dza' khu ba mar/ /bskol ba'am arda ga la bskol/ /dro 'jam ①zos rjes la blud na/ /lud pa lu dang skad 'gags sel/ /rgya shug lo ma'i lde gu ni/ /mar brngos rgyam tshar bcas pa 'am/ /shing mngar dang ni pi pi ling / / bye dang ga rjodang rgun 'brum ⑤dang / /han sa paṇi'i dhirtsa ba rnams/ /til mar bskol ba snar blugs bya/ /'bras chan mar dang bu ram bcas/ /zos na ⑦de rjes chu tshan btung / /'o thug snum can blud pa dang / /snum gyi dugs kyi cho ga bya⑧/ /mkhris pa las gyur 'o ma'i shing / /lde gu bskol ba'i zhun mar ni/ /sbrang rtsir bcas te de rjes ni/ /'o ma bskol te bsgrangs pa blud/ /shing mngar ma du ka 'o ⑨thug /zhun mar bcas pa blud pa 'am/ /ba la dri bzang bi da ri/ /shing mngar k+ṣi ta ⑩bi da ri/ /rgyam tshar bcas pa bskol ba'i mar/ /skad 'gags sna sman bla med yin/ /pra puṇ+ḍa rī ka shing mngar/ /pi pi ling dang bri ha ti/ /ba la 'o ma mar bskol te/ /skad 'gags pa yi sna sman mchog /mngar ba'i sde tshan phye ma ni/ /sbrang rtsi mar sbyar sde gu sbyin/ /bad kan las gyur tsha ba dang / /zas rtsub ba gcin blud par bya/ / kad pha ⑩la dang skyu ru ra/ /tsha gsum til mar sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /ya bak+ṣa ra tsha ba gsum/ / kru trug ⑫tres dang dbyi mong dang / /a ru ra dang sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /nas thug til mar zhun mar dang / /pi pi ling dang skyu rur sbyar/ /bca' sga dang ni pi pi ling / /bza' ba'am sgyug sman rnon po bsten/ /sha kha ra dang sbrang rtsir bsres/ /mngar ba'i sman 111—468

dang lhan cig bskol/ /'o ma 'thung bas ①skad gsang ni/ /chen por smras pa'i ⑤'gags nad sel/ /yi ga 'chus la sna tshogs zas/ /phan pa'i sman dang sbyar ba sbyin/ /phyi dang nang ni sbyang ba dang / /sems dga' yid dang mthun sman sbyin/ /dus gnyis su ni so shing dag /bca' zhing kha ni sbyang bya zhing / /bska bas kha ni bkru ba dang / /rjes su mthun pa'i dud pa rngub/ /da lis kyi ni ri lu skedang / /kha ra ga bur bcas pa sbyin/ /'bras khu ④zla ba'i zer ltar dkar/ /bza' ba yi ga 'byed pa'i mchog /de las rlung 'gyur yi ga 'chus/ /ha re rku ⑤dang pi pi ling / / byi dang rjog dang ra sna dang / /rgyam tsha dang ni dong gra dang / /sug smel ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / /nas tshig ⑦'khus pa'i thal ba dang ⑧/ /shing kun bcas pa mar ram ni/ /chang gi dwangs mar sbyar te btung / /shu dag chus ni slon du gzhug /mkhris gyur bu ram chus slon gzhug /kha ra dang ni zhun mar ram/ /rgyam tsha sbrang rtsir bcas pa sbyinarka/ /bad kan nim pa'i chus slon gzhug /la la phud dang dong gra'i ⑨chu//sbrang rtsi'am chang rnying rno sbyar ba/ /bu ram sbrang rtsi ⑫chang bcas blud/ /ha re rku ⑪sogs phye ma ni/ /sngar bshad chu tshan sbyar ba blud/ /sug smel dang ni shing tsha dang / / nā ga pus pa ⑫na le sham/ /pi pi ling dang bca' sga rnams/ /rim ⑫bzhin cha res bskyed phye ma/ /kha ra dag dang mnyam sbyar bas/ /mchil mang yi ga 'chus pa dang / /snying dang rtsib logs na lud pa/ /dbugs mi bde dang mgul nad 'joms/ /la la phud dang da trig dang / /star bu bca' sga se'u 'bru dang / /rgya shug zho ni gnyis gnyis byas/ /kha ra srang bzhi 'u su dang / /go snyod shing tsha kha ru tsha/ /zho re pi pi ling 'bru brgya/ /na le 111—469

sham ni nyis ①brgya dag /phyer btags yi ga 'byed pa'i mchog /yid 'ong phyi sa 'gags pa dang / /lud pa snying ga rtsib logs na/ /mcher pa gzhang 'brum pho nad sel/ /bal bu'i lo ma na le sham/ /dong gra ②dang ni pi pi ling / /go rims snebazhin du cha res bskyed/ /shing tsha sug smel dang po'i phyed//pi pi ling gi brgyad 'gyur gyi/ /kha rar sbyar ba'i phye ma de/ /drod skyed yi ga 'byed pa dang / /lud pa lu dang dbugs mi bde/ /yi ga 'chus dang slon bro dang / /mcher pa snying nad rtsib logs zug /skya rbab tshad 'khru rims nad 'joms—/ /rlung 'khyel ba ni bde rgyu byed/ /sug smel shing tsha pu shel tse/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis byas pa dang / /nā ga ge sar srang phyed ④dang / /garnya bha dra ⑤srang phyed gzhug /phye btags bu ram rnying pa ni/ /srang ni nyi shu lnga ni bskolaske/ /sbrus te zho gnyis tshad ri lu/ /byas pa'i yon tan de dang mnyam/ /arga sle tres k+ṣa ra'i rjochur/ /nas dang nub gcig spangs nas ni/ /chu dang zan ni sbrus nas su/ /byin te nyams stobs ldan slon gzhug /de bzhin skam sa'i srog chags sha /bsregs pa kha dang tsha ⑦sbyar sbyin/ /zas di skam zhing rab yang dang / /tsa na ka sogs khu ba blud/ /bad kan gyis rab ⑧mchil ma mang / /rlung gis mchil mang skyed ⑨par byed/ /de ni bad kan mchil mar bshad—/ /snum dang dro bas de bsal bya/ /rims 'di cham pa dag dang ni/ /slon pa'i nad la'ang sbyar bar bya/ /mchog tu cham par bsku ba dang / /snum dang dugs kyi cho ga bstan/ /mgo dang lkog ma rtsib ⑩logs su/ /'bras khur snum bcas dugs bya zhing / /lan tshwa skyur dang kha dang tsha/ /sha khu snum dang bcas pa sbyinaske/ /mgo bo snying ga rtsib logs gzer/ /nad gzhi ji bzhin gso bar bya⑩/ /111—470

chu dang rlan can gnas pa'i sha /legs sbyar dkri ba'i dugs bya zhing / /de nas ①snum bzhi'i sbyor ba bsngags/ /nad gzhi ①'dres par gyur pa la/ /rgya spos shing mngar shu ti ①dang / /tsan+dan mar gyi lde gus byug /pa la ra sna til mar dang / /shing mngar ut+pal mar de bzhin/ /ba spru ba dang shi kru ④dang / /ba la ra mnye bi da ri/ /sna sman dud pa rngub pa dang / /zas zos 'og tu snum bsten zhing / /til mar gyis ni bsku ba dang / /de bzhin 'jam rtsi'i las rab bsngagasarka/ /yang na rngabs rwa la sogs pas/ /nad dmigs ji bzhin nad khrag dbyung / /shug pa tsan+dan pu shel tse/ /mar bcas lde gus ⑤bsku ba 'am/ / drur ba rjoshing mngar btsod dang ni/ /nā ga ge sar mar sbyar bsku/ /n+ya gro dha sogs bskol til mar/ /lan brgya bkrus ⑦pa'i mar gyis ni/ /bsku ba'am 'o ⑧ma shing mngar chus/ / blugs par ⑨gyur pa'ang ⑩bsngags pa yin/ /phal cher me drod nyams pa'i phyir/ /ma zhu be snabs bcas 'khru na/ /de la pho ba'i tshad 'khru ba'i/ /skabs su bshad pa'i sman bsten phan/ /zad byed ldan pa'i bshang ba ni/ /rnam pa kun tu bsrung bya ste/ /de yi lus zungs kun zad pas/ /de stobs bshad pa'i stobs kyis gnas/ /rig ⑪pas sha rnams kho na sbyin/ /skom du rgun chang blud par bya/ /shugs ni bkag par gyur pa yis/ /gcong chen gyis ni glags mi rnyed⑫/ /chang dang chang dwangs rgun chang dang / /chang rnying bu ram sbrang chang dang / /ci rigs par ni blud pa dang / /sha ni sbyin pa nyid du bya/ /bu ga'i rgyun 'gags dag phyir dang / /stobs dang mdangs ni rgyas bya'i phyir/ /sgrum dang 'o ma chus gang ba'i/ /snod du lus ni 'bying ⑫bar bya| /phyung nas bsres pa'i ④snum gyis ni/ /bsku zhing lag pas bde bar mnye/ /111—471

bde bar 'dug par gyur pa la/ /dal gyis lde gus ①dril bar bya dzi ban ti dang drur ba ④dang / /btsod dang a shwa garnya dang / /a pa marga ba spru ①ba/ / ag ni man ti ④shing mngar dang / /ba la yungs kar bi da ri/ /ru rta 'bras dang zar ma dang / /mon sran gre'u gnyis ⑤til dang phabs/ /thams cad gcig tu btags nas ni/ /nas kyi phye ni sum 'gyur dang / /zho dang sbrang rtsi lhan cig sbyar/ /'di dag gis ni dril phyis bya/ /sha rgyas mdog bzang stobs skyed byed/ /yungs kar rjoser po'i lde gu dang / /'tsho byed sde tshan dang sbyar ba/ /khrus kyi sman gyis khrus bya zhing / /dus tshigs bde ba'i chus khrus bya/ /dri dang phreng ba sogs pas brgyan/ /bkra mi shis pa 'jigs pa bstan⑦/ /mdza' bshes blta ⑧zhing gru dang ni/ /rol mo mnyan zhing dga' ston bya/ /'jam rtsi 'o ma zhun mar dang / /sha dang chang bsten tshul la gnas/ /lha la brten pa'i cho ga dang / /mchod pa'i las la brtson par bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi ⑨le'u lnga pa'o// //de nas slon pa'i nad dang snying nad dang ⑩skom dad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /slon nad phal cher ma zhu ba'i/ /gnas 'khrugs las byung de yi phyir—/ /rlung ma gtogs la dang por ni/ /smyung byas skyug sman gtang ba phan//stobs ldan rgyun tu slon gyur cing / /nad mang 'gyur ⑩la gtang bar bya/ /de 'og rim gyis bkru sman ni/ /yid 'ong chang rgun chu sogs sam/ /'o mas btang gyur de mod la⑫/ /gyen 'byung nad ni thur du 'byung / /zhi ba'i sman 711—472

ni rtsub pa ste/ /nyam ①chung ba yang de nyid bya/ /zas ni skam zhing yi gar 'ong //goms shing yang ba bsngags pa yin/ /de bzhin smyung ba yu sha dang / /sha khu 'ba' cha skam pa la/ /tshod ma lde gu bza' ba dang / /btung ba dri bzangs pa ④na ka /ro drug zas skom sna tshogs dang / /'bras bu 'khrus ④dang mnye ba dang / /dri zhim 'bras bu me tog skyes/ /zas dang skom la spyod pa dang / /zos ma thag tu 'phral du ni/ /chu grang gis ni gdong bkru bya/ /rlung las gyur pa'i slon pa'i nad/ /rgyam tsha mar bcas dro ba 'am/ /tsha gsum lan tshwa gsum sbyar bas/ /lud pa dang ni snying 'dzag dang / /bcas pa sel bar byed pa yin/ /se 'bru'i khu ba bca' sga dang / /'u su zho dang mar bskol ba'am—/ /chu dang 'o ma cha mnyam pa/ /khron gyi zas tshol sha khu ni/ /'bras skyur rgyam tsha mar shas che/ /kha zas snum po bca' sga dang / /zho dang se ④'brur sbyar ba 'am/ /rgyam tshar bcas pa dro 'jam phan/ /'dir ni bkru sman lan tshwa dang / /snum dang dro bar bcas pa phan/ /mkhris pa las byung ⑤bkru sman phyir/ /rgun 'brum rjobu ram shing khu ⑦dang / /dur byid sbyar ba'i bkru sman btab/ /zhun mar seng phrom sbyar ba gtang / /'phel te bad kan gnas ⑧khyab pa'i/ /mkhris par stimangar dang kha ba yis/ /gyen du drangs la dag gyur nas / /'bras yos kha ra bcas pa las/ /skyo ma'am nas thug blud par bya/ /sā ⑩lu drug cu pa yi chan/ /skam sa'i sha khu muṅga'i khu/ /so ⑪phag bsregs te chu nang gsur/ /shin tu bsgrangs pa'i chu blud pa'am/ /muṅga 'u su pu shel tse/ /pi pi ling dang nub gcig sbangs/ /yang na rgun chu bu ram shing / /sle tres chu mang 'o ma blud/ /'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma dang / /u shir n+ya gro dha'i myu gu/ /111—473

bskol te bsgrangs par ①sbrang rtsi ni/ /btab ste blugs ⑦na slon pa dang / /rims dang tshad 'khru brgyal ba dang / /skom dad che ba mi bzad sel/ /skyu ru ra'i khu tsan+dan bcas/ /muṅga ba la'i chu blud phan/ /rgya shug tshi ④gu kha ra dkararjo//'bras yos spra ⑤tshil pi pi 1nga / /dngul rdo rjosbrang rtsi'am a ru ra/ /rgun 'bru'am ⑦rgya shug dang sbyar phan/ /bad kan las gyur nim pa dang / /pi pi ling dang po son cha/ /yungs kar chu dron gyis slon bya/ /nyam ⑧chung ba la smyung ba bya/ /dong ga la stsogs khu ba bskol/ /bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud—/ /nas kyi skyo ma slon 'joms pa'i/ /sman mang dang ni sbyar ba blud/ /bad kan 'joms zas yi gar 'ong / /btung ba zin thig bu sri na/ /ldong ros dang ni pi pi ling / /na le sham ni skyur rtsi che/ /ka pid ta yi khu ba dang / /sbrang rtsir bcas pas ⑨slon nad sel/ /ka pid ta ⑩dang tsha ba gsum/ /bye tsher sbrang rtsir sbyar ba sbyin/ /mthun pa'i spyod pa byas pa yis/ /mi sdug yul mthong las byung sel/ /srin bu las byung srin bu yi/ /sman du bshad pa rnams kyis ⑪gso/ /lhag ma nad dmigs ji bzhin du/ /de zhi 'gyur ba'i dpyad kyis ⑫gso/ /slon pa'i skabs su rlung gi nad rnams ni/ /lus ⑫zungs zad pas ④nges par ldang gyur ⑫te/ /de bas 'dir ni skyug sman sbyor drags pa'i/ /skabs bshad bcad dang brta ba'i cho ga bya/ /bu ram zhun mar sha khu dge ba che//tsha ba gsum dang 'tsho byed sman mar dang / /'o thug dang ni phan pa'i sde gu yis//rgyun du slon pa zhi ba nyid du bya/ /snying nad rlung gyur ⑩til mar ni/ /sgyur rtsabs dar ba zho ga ⑩chu/ /ldan pa tsha can dro 'jam blud/ /des ⑫ni lto sbos skran yang 'joms/ /til mar lan tshwar bcas dang skyur/ /ba gcin bskol 111—474

ba'ang de dang mtshungs/ /bil ba ra sna rgya shug nas/ /thang shing dang ni ba spru ba/ /rgya sran rtsa ba lnga pa rnams/ /bskol ba'i chu der ①til mar ni/ /bskol ba de ni snar btang dang / /btung dang 'jam rtsir gtang bar bya/ /bca' sga rgyam tsha byi'u ⑤rug pa/ /sle tres shing kun ma nu dang / /a ru ra dang mar bskol ba/ /snying nad rtsib logs gzer skran 'joms/ /kha ru tsha ni srang gnyis dang / /a ru ra ni lnga bcu dang / /zhun mar bre gang bskol rtsib logs / /snying nad skran dbugs mi bde sel/ /se 'bru bca' sga kha ru tsha/ /shing kun star bu phye mar sbyar/ /rlung nad gzhan dbang can snying nad/ /dbugs mi bde ba sel mchog yin/ /ma nu zur pa bca' sga dang / /skyur rtsi che rtsa a ru ra'i/ /lde gu ya bak+ṣa ra dang / /mngar skyur lan tshwa ldan pa 'thungs//bcad snyam sems pa'i gzer 'joms byed/ /rgyam tsha la la phud k+ṣa ④ra/ /shu dag go snyod bca' sga dang / /thang shing sgyur rtsi chen po dang / /zur pa ma nu pa la sha④ /bskol khu 'jam 'thungs yon tan mtshungs/ /tsha lnga zur pa a ru ra/ /bu ram ma nu sgyur rtsi che/ /chang btags lde gu mar til mar/ /brngos te rgyam tshar ldan 'thungs na/ /snying nad rtsib logs mo mtshan zug /skran dang dmu rdzing nad rnam ⑤sel/ /'di la snum gyi rjodugs phan zhing / /sman mar gyi ⑦ni sbyor ba phan/ / skom la sgertsa ba chung ngu lnga'am/ /bca' sga dang ni bskol ba'i chu'am/ /chang gi dwangs ma zho ga chu/ /'bras bu'i ⑨rang skyur blud par bya/ /bya rmyang rengs gzer ma zhur bcas/ /snying la rlung gis gnod gyur ⑩la/ /bya ba 'di bya snying 'dzag cing / /'phar dang gcin snyi bcas pa la/ /sreg pa khrung khrung rma bya dang / / dgo ba ⑪khyim bya snum mang ⑫111—475

phan—/ /snying nad can ①la ba la'i mar/ /yang na skyid de ⑤ba'i mar blud/ /shing mngar lan brgyar btsos ④pa'am/ /de bzhin snum chen mchog tu phan/ /ra sna 'tsho byed dzi ban rjoti/ /ba la bya kri ba spru ba/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba ti ⑤ra dang //shu dag tsha ba gsum dang ni/ /snum chen zhes bya bskol bar bya/ /zho ni bzhi cha de bzhin skyur/ /ji snyed pa las sbyar ba bsten/ /tshim byed brtas byed stobs skyed cing / /rlung gi snying nad 'joms pa yin/ /snying nad rjodrod che 'phar ba dang / /rlung las gyur pa'i snying nad la/ /'o ma zho dang bu ram mar chu dang rlan can sha dag phan/ /'di ma gtogs pa'i snying gi nad/ /bzhi po dag la spang bar bya/ /rlung can rengs dang be+e'u ⑦snabs can/ /tshor med lhag ma rnams la'ang spang / /bad kan 'dres gyur de la ni/ /rtsub drod bshad pa'i bya ba bya/ /mkhris gyur rgun chu bu ram chu/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi ba ru shar⑧//ldan pa'i bkru sman yid 'ong bas/ /sbyangs la mkhris sel rim pa bya/ / glo rdol rims kyi ⑨mkhris skabs bshad/ /phyi nang gi ni sbyang ba bya/ /pu shel tse ⑩dang shing mngar btags/ /kha rar bcas pa'i chu blud ⑪bya/ /ra sna kha ra rgun 'brum ⑫dang / /'tsho byed ut+pal zangs rtsi ba/ /ba la 'bra ⑫go ra mnye ba/ /me da gnyis dang ma te'i mar/ /'o mar bcas pa bskol ba ni/ /mkhris gyur snying nad sel byed yin/ /shing mngar ba spru puṇ+ḍa rī④/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba ka she ru//bca' sga ba lar bcas de dang / /'o mar bcas dang bca' sgar ⑫bskol/ /bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi btab pa dang / /mngar ba'i sde tshan bsdus pa'ang bsngags//til mar shing mngar bcas bskol zhing / /sbrang rtsi btab pa'i 'jam rtsi'ang phan//bad kan las gyur dugs byas la/ /nim pa shu dag chu yis slon/ /rgya sran khu 111—476

ba rgyam tsho'i ①chu/ /chang rno blud cing nas zan sbyin/ /shu dag shing kun lan tshwa gnyis/ /dong gra sug smel la la phud/ /nas tshig 'khus thal pi pi ling / /phye ma dro 'jam chu blud ⑤pa'am/ /'bras bu'i chu'am rang skyur ram/ /rgya sran ba gcin chang rnying blud/ /ma nu bca' sga a ru ra/ /zur pa ra sna pi pi ling //shu dag bskol te blud pa 'am/ /de bzhin bca' sga a ru ra/ /bong ⑦nga dkar po yung ba dang / / kad pa la ni bskol ④ba 'am/ /ro hi ta ka ⑤a shwad tha/ /seng ldeng u dum bā rjor dang / /ardzu na dang pa la sha⑦ /n+ya gro dha bskol tsha ba gsum/ /dur byid phye mar bcas lde gu/ /zos te chu tshan rjes 'thungs na/ /bad kan snying nad sel byed yin/ /bad kan skran skabs bshad mar dang / /k+ṣa ra sna tshogs blud par bya/ /yang na brag zhun bcud len dang / /tshangs pa'i bcud len skyu ru ra'i/ /lde gu'am ri byis ⑧bshad pa 'am/ /bdud rtsi'i mar ni 'di sbyar bya/ /gang zhig zan zos gzer ⑨gyis 'debs/ /zas zhu gyur nas zhi gyur pa/ /de la ru rta byi dang ga⑩ /lan tshwa gnyis dang seng phrom dang / /thang shing bong nga dkar por bcas/ /phye ma chu bskol dro sbyar blud/ /gang zhig zhu nas cher gzer ba/ /de la snum gyi bkru sman ni/ /'bras bu dang ni de bzhin du/ /rtsa ba'i bkru sman sbyin par bya/ /phal cher rlung ni lam 'gags pa/ /ma zhu'i gnas su 'khru bar 'gyur⑪/ /de la myung dang min pa dang / /sbyang bas bde bar rgyu bar bya/ /'bu 'joms pa yi sman kun gyis/ /'bu yi snying nad gso bar bya/ /skom dad rlung dang ⑩mkhris pa 'joms cho ga phal cher bsngags pa yin/ /kun la phyi nang bsil ba dang / /de bzhin zhi dang sbyang bar bya/ /char chu grang mo sbrang rtsir bcas/ /sa ⑫chu'i yon tan de 111—477
