ldan bsngags/ /bong ba rdza skyogs bye ma 'am/ /gshag ma bsreg bcug dwangs mar bcas①/ /bskol te kha rar bcas pa'am/ / drur ba ⑤la stsogs rtsa ba lnga/ /bskol te kha ra btab pa'am/ /'bras yos phyer sbyar skyo ma'ang bsngags / /nas rjen chag tshe sbrang rtsi dang / /kha ra btab pa grang mo'ang phan/ /de bzhin nas thug sā ①lu dang / /ko tra pa ni rnyid pa ni④/ /'o ma bsil zhing nus bsil ba'i/ /sman dang bskol ba'i kha zas ni/ /nad pa chu grang gis bkrus nas/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi sbyin pa bsngags/ /skam sa'i sha khu ⑤lan tshwa skyur/ /med cing mar dang brngos pa yang rjo/ /de bzhin muṅga stsogs khu ba/ /'tsho byed sde tshan khu bar bcas/ /sna sman 'o ma mar bsil sman/ /bskol ba'am bu ram shing khu phan/ /skom sel mkhur ba bkang nas ⑦ni/ /mdo gnas las bshad byas pa'ang phan/ /tsha rims bshad pa'i lde gu sogs/ /rtsol ba chung zhing sems dga' dang / /chu bo mtsho ni chen po stsogs/ /dran pa dang ni mthong ba phan/ /skom dad rlung las gyur pa las⑧/ /zho ni bu ram bcas pa bsngagasarka/ /sha khus nyams brtas bi da ri/ /stsogs te bskol nas bsgrangs pa phan/ /mkhris gyur u dum bā ⑨ra smin/ /khu bar kha ra btab pa phan/ /yang na de bskol bsgrangs pa 'am/ /sha ri ba stsogs sde tshan chu/ /sde tshan de 'dra bskol khu ba/ /bsgrangs pa kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas/ /mngar ba'i sman gyi sde tshan dang / /'o ma can shing bskol de bzhin/ /bi dza pu ⑩ra rgun 'brum dang / /lcang ma n+ya gro dha'i lo ma/ /ku sha 'jag ma'i rtsa ba dang / /shing mngar chu ni bskol ba'ang phan/ /rims la phan sman rgun 'brum stsogs/ /snying po lnga yi chu blud phan/ /bad kan las gyur nim ⑪pa ni/ /chu mchog bskol 111—478

bas slon du gzhug /bil ba 'u su tsha ba lnga/ /'jag ma kru trug ①tres bskol blud / /yang na skyer ba chu ⑦bskol la/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi btab pa blud/ /muṅga'i khu ba pa to la/ /nim pa'i lo ma tsha gsum bcas/ /nas zan mkhur bkang rnon po dang / /sna sman lde gu rnon po'ang bsten/ /nyes kun ma zhu des sti'ajoms pas/ /de bzhin slon gyi bya ba'ang bsngags/ /go bye shu dag tsha ba gsumarka/ /'bras bu skyur pa'am rjochu tshan nam/ /zho ga ⑤chu dang btung ba bsngags / /zas kyi nyes 'byung dus shes pas/ /thug sla'am skyo ma bsil ba blud—/ /ngal bas skom la sha khu 'am/ /skyo ma kha rar bcas pa blud/ /tsha bas bskol la kha rar bcas/ /nas dang rgya shug phye skyo blud/ /lus kun til gyi lde gu dang / /rang skyur bcas pas bsku bar bya/ /chu bsil khrus las skom gyur chang / /chur bsres pa'am bur chu blud/ / chang ni chu phyed bcas pa blud/ /dulan tshwa skyur dang bcas khrus bya/ /snum bcas me drod rab rno la/ /rang bzhin bsil ba'i chu blud bya/ /snum ma zhu la chu tshan blud/ /zhu las skom la thug pa blud/ /zas snum zos pas skom dad 'gyur/ /kha ba dang mnyam bu ram chu/ /bu ram sogs zas zos la skom/ /chu dron blud la de slon bya/ /gcong chen las byung gcong la phan/ /thams cad nyams ni brta ⑦ba phan/ /skem zhing nyam sgechung khong rtsub la/ /sha khu'am ra yi 'o ma blud/ /stod rgyu'i rlung la 'o ma dang / /zad byed lud pa'i sman bskol blud/ /nad rkyen las gyur 'u su ni/ /'bras bskol kha ra sbrang rtsir bcas/ /nad dmigs la ⑨ni bltas nas ni/ /btung ba'i bya ba kun kyang bsngags/ /skom ⑩zhing sngar gyi nad kyis ⑩gzir/ /chu dang 'phrad ⑫par ma gyur na/ /'chi ba'am yun ring 111—479

ba yi nad/ /rnyed par 'gyur bas de yi phyir/ /goms pa'i zas skom sman gyis ni/ /de yi skom dad myur bsal bya/ /de bsal nad ni gzhan dag kyang / /gso ba nyid du nus pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u drug pa'o// //de nas chang nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /nyes pa gang zhig shas cher mthong / /de ni dang por gso bar bya/ /yang na chang nad nad gzhi mtshungs—/ /bad kan gnas kyi rim pas gso/ /mkhris pa rlung gi mthar thug par/ /chang nad phal cher 'byung ba yin/ /dman dang log pa drag 'thungs las/ /nad ni gang zhig skyes gyur pa/ /de nyid cha mnyam 'thungs pa yis—/ /chang nyid kyis ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /chang dang dug ni mtshungs pa las//dug ni rno stsogs yon tan gyi/ /nus pa shin tu che bas na/ /dug gzhan la ni ltos pa yin/ /rno tshe lhag par 'thungs pa dang / /tsha zhing skyur ba dag gis ni/ /chang gis zas kyi ①ro bsrul zhing / /'ju nyer ba tsha bro gang yin/ /myos dang skom rmongs nang du tsha/ /rims dang mgo 'khor skyed par byed/ /chang gis bslangs ④pa'i nad kyis ni/ /rlung rgyu'i bu ga bkag gyur pas/ /mgo dang rus pa tshigs rnams su/ /mi bzad par skeni skyed par byed/ /sbyor ba rjes mthun gyur pa yi/ /chang nyid kyis ni de sel 'gyur/ /chang nad ma zhu zhu gyur na / /zas 'dod lus ni yang bar 'gyur/ /ba tsha ro ni skyur dang phrad/ /mngar ba nyid du myur du 'gyuradu/ /nad ni 'ju bar byed nus pas/ /skyur ba kun las chang mchog yin/ /sngar bshad rno dang dro stsogs dang / /de bzhin 111—480

drod skyed stsogs yon tan/ /de nyid goms pa'i dbang gis ni/ /'di yis ①lus zungs mnyam byed mchog /zhag bdun nam zhig zhag brgyad par/ /chang nad sman gyi sbyor sneb bya/ /dus 'di tsam gyis lam log par/ /gnas pa'i chang nad zhi bar 'gyur/ /sman ni byas gyur nas chang nad/ /de phan chang ni rjes 'brel pa'i/ /nad gang yin pa de la sman/ /nad dmigs ji bzhin sbyin ④par bya/ /de la rlung shas che ba la/ /sgyur rtsi chen po da trig dang //rgya shug se 'bru go snyod dang / /la la phud dang ha pu sha /zi ra tsha gsum lan tshwa gsum/ /sge'u gsher phye chang sbyar ba blud/ /sreg sha ldum rngad bcas pa dang / /snum dang ldan pa'i zas sbyin no/ /snum zhing dro skyur lan tshwar bcas/ /sha tshon khu ba blud pa 'am/ /a mra a rjomra ta ka gtubs/ /g.yos sbyar ba yi drug pa 'am/ /gro dang ma sha ⑤las byas pa/ /rnying zhing yi gar 'ong ba dang / /sge gsher bcas rjopa'i khu ba ni/ /tsha dang sha sogs nang bcug pa'am/ /chang ni dri zhim bsil ba dang / /legs langs dwangs shing tshar bcas ⑦phan/ /se ⑧'bru 'am rtsa ba chung lnga bskol/ /bca' sga 'u su bskol ba 'am/ /zhog ⑨chu 'am tsha chu'am/ /rang skyur dwangs ma blud par bya/ /lus bsku dril dang bkru ba dang / /gos ni dro zhing mthug pa dang / /a ka ru yi dud pas bdug /gur gum ⑫a ka ru yis byug /chung ma nu ma ro smad mdzes/ /lang tshor ⑪ldan zhing yan lag dro/ /dga' bas 'khyud par byed pa dang / /bsnyen bkur byas par gyur pa'ang phan/ /mkhris pa shas cher ⑫chu mang ba'i/ /sbrang rtsi kha ra dang ldan pa'i/ / se 'bru 'bra ⑫go'i khu ba dang / /bha ⑫bya rgun 'brum pa ru sha'i⑫| /khu bsgrangs phye dang kha rar bcas/ /btung ba'ang de 'dra ⑫blud 111—481

par bya/ /yang na mngar ba'i sde tshan bskol/ /khya ba chang bsres sbrang rtsi btab//sā ①lu drug cu pa'i chan ②dang / /ri bong gong sreg gtsod kyi sha /tsa na muṅga skyu ru ra/ /se ①'bru pa to la g.yos sbyin/ /bad kan mkhris 'dres las gyur pa/ /tsha dang skom dad ldan pa yirjo/ /chang ngam chu grang bu ram shing / /khu ba'am rgun chu mang blud ⑤la/ /slon gzhug 'dres pa'i nad la rjoni/ /skyo ma la sogs rim pas phan/ /de yis ⑦me drod 'bar gyur pas/ /zas dang nyes lhag smin par byed/ /lud pa mchil ma khrag bcas 'byung / /rtsib logs nu mar gzer ba dang / /tsha dang bcas pa'i skom dad dang / /snying dang brang ni na ba la/ /sle tres ga dur bskol ba 'am/ /yang na pa to la bskol khu/ /bca' sgar bcas pa blud bya zhing / /gong ma ④sreg gi sha sbyin bya/ /mkhris pa rlung ni rgyas gyur pas/ /shin tu shas cher skom gyur na/ /rlung ni bde bar rgyu byed pa'i⑨/ /rgun chu bsgrangs pa blud par ⑩bya/ /zhu nas ra sha'i ⑪khu ba ni/ /mngar dang skyur ba'i sman sbyar sbyin/ /skom na chu mang bsres pa yi/ /chang blud ra ror mi 'gyur bsrung / /gla sgang se ⑫'bru 'bras yos chu'am/ /yang na 'dab ma bzhi bskol ba'am/ /ut+pal pa to ⑫la sogs sam/ /rang bzhin gyis ni bsil ba blud/ /chang mang 'thungs pas chu yi khams/ /'bri zhing me shas rgyas par 'gyur/ /gre ba rkan mchu skam 'gyur zhing / /byu ni 'byin cing gcong byed la/ /mtshan mo rlung gis bsil byas pa'i/ /chu ni yog tshad blud par bya/ /rgya shug se ④'bru da trig dang / /tsug tra la chu ba'i khu ba/ /skyur ba lnga yis khar bskus tho)na/ /'phral du skom dad sel bar byed/ /chang 'thungs drod ni khrag ⑩mkhris dang / /'dres pas pags pa khyab gyur pas/ /111—482

mi bzad tsha ba skyed byed de/ /der ni rab bsil cho ga bya/ /ma zhu sha khus ①tshim byas la/ /ro hi ni las gtar ga gdab/ /slon dang sgyung ba dag gis kyang / /bad kan shas cher sgyug sman dang ④/ /sgyung ba bca' sga ste ra dang //kaṇ+ḍa ka ①ri ba la ka /gang yang rung ba'i chu blud ④bsal/ /ma zhu med cing bkres dus su/ /sbrang rtsi mang po blud par bya/ /sha kha ra dang sbrang rtsi dang / /chang rnying dag gam rgun chang ngam/ /rtsub pa'i ⑤skyo mar sbyar ba ni/ /dong gra la la phud bcas blud/ /nas dang gro zan nyung shas la/ /rgya sran yu sha nyung zad bcas/ /chu tshan kha dang tsha bar bcas/ /mar ni nyung zad bcas pa sbyin//la phug skam po ra sha'i khu/ /skam sa'i rjosrog chags sha khu ni/ /star bu da trig pa to la/ /tsha ba gsum dang se dze+e'abrur sbyar/ /bca' sga na le sham mang btab/ /rjen rngad gtubs pa dang ldan zhing / /skyur rtsi chen po'i khu bas skyur/ /brngos shing khu ba med pa dang / /ka ra mar dang ka ri ra/ /la sogs yi ga 'byed pa dang / /lan tshwa brgyad po legs bro dang / /gtubs shing be reg ltar btsos pa/ /me drod tshod las sha sbyin zhing / /sbrang chang nad med gyur pa blud| /kha ra dang ni kha ru tsha/ /go snyod da trig star bu dang / /shing tsha sug smel na le sham/ /cha phyed yan lag brgyad par bshad/ /phal cher bad kan chang nad sel/ /bu ga'i rgyun sbyong drod skyed byed/ /rtsub dang dro bas mnye zhing dril/ /khrus dang kha zas sgyung byas dang / /'dod bcas bud med lhan cig gnas/ /mtshan nyid ma log rig ⑧pas bsten/ /phal cher bad kan las byung ba'i/ /chang nad myur du zhi bar byed/ /nad gzhi so so'i shas che las/ /las rnams gang dag bstan pa 'di/ /'di ⑨ni 'dus pa las gyur 111—483

pa| /lhag ma bcu la'ang sbyar bar bya/ /shing tsha nā ga put+pa dang / /pi pi ling dang na le sham/ /go snyod pa ru sha ka dang / /'u su sug smel ma du ka /thang shing ka ①ra dkar dang bcas/ /ka pid ta ②yi khu ba btab/ /ga pur dri yis bsgos gyur pa/ /btung ba shin tu yid 'ong bsne/ /chang nad kun la blud gyur na/ /yi ga 'byed cing me drod skyed/ /chang gis yid ni ma dkrugs shing / /lus la gnod pa mi byed par/ /chang nad mi skyed de yi phyir/ /sems dgar 'gyur ba'i ④cho ga bya/ /chang nad la ni sbyang ba dang / /zhi ba'i las ni byas gyur kyang / /gal te ma zhi bad kan zad/ / nyam chung yang ba ⑤nyid gyur na/ /rlung dang mkhris pa shas che zhing / /chang nad kyis zad 'o ma blud—/ /so ga'i tsha rjobs gdungs pa yi/ /shing las char pa bab dang mtshungs—/ /chang gis zad par byas pa'i mdangs/ /'o mas myur du brtas byed de/ /mdangs dang yon tan kun mtshungs la/ /chang las go ni bzlog pa yinaske/ /'o mas nad ni bcom gyur cing / /stobs skyes ⑦nas ni 'o ma yi/ /cho ga chang yang bzlog byas te⑧/ /rim gyis nyung zad nyung zad spyad/ /ci nas 'joms dang skams gyur pa'i/ /bla brnan ⑨'byung bar mi 'gyur bya/ /de gnyis la ⑩ni 'o ma mar/ /'jam rtsi btang bas brta ba bsngags/ /bsku dang dril phyis khrus dang ni/ /bza' btung rlung ni sel ba phan/ /rig ⑪par chang 'thung gang ⑫gis ni/ /nad ni 'byung bar 'gyur ma yin/ /de la rlung nad la phan chang / /phal cher zan chang bu ram chang / /mkhris pa rgun chang chu dang bcas/ /bad kan chang rnying sbrang rgun chang / /bad kan can gyis dang por btung / /mkhris pa can gyis zos rjes btung / /rlung can gyis ni bar 111—484

du btung / /nad gzhi mnyam pas ci dgar btung / /stsos dang brgyal la phal cher ni/ /rlung dang mkhris pa sel las bsngags/ /thams cad la yang khyad par du/ /mkhris pa shas cher shes par bya/ /bsku byug bsil dang nor bu dang / /chus gtor rlung yab kyis g.yab byed/ /kha ra rgun 'brum bu ram shing / /'bra go tang ①pal khu ba dang / /mngar ba'i sde bskol 'o ma khu/ /yu sha se ②'brur bcas pa blud/ / sā lu rtsa snar ④drug cu pa/ /nas dang 'tsho byed sman mar dang / /dge ba chen po tig ta pyache/ /srang drug 'o ma tsi trar bcas⑤| /pi pi ling dang brag zhun ni/ /bcud kyis dulen kyi cho ga sbyin/ /yang na 'bras bu gsum mar dang / /sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas pa sbyin/ /shugs drag pa la kha dang sna/ /bkag par gyur pa phan pa yin/ /yang na bud med nu zho ni/ /blud pa'am sna nas gtang bar bya/ /pad+ma'i rtsa sdong pi pi ling a ru ra 'am gla sgang ngam/ /byi tsher sbrang rtsir ⑦sbyar ba sbyin/ /rgya shug tshi ⑧gu na le sham/ /nā ga ge sar pu shel tse⑨/ /chu grang dang ni sbyar ba blud/ /myu ru ra yi khu ba 'am/ /a ru ra mar bskol ⑩ba'ang phan/ /ji skad bshad pa'i bya ba dag /nad gzhi'i ⑪shas ni ji bzhin sbyar/ /las ni rnam lnga bya ba dang / /gtar gas khrag ni dbyung ba dang / /snying stobs che zhing shes dang ⑫ldan/ /yul la chags pa med pa phan/ /myos pa shin tu 'phel gyur ⑫dang / /brgyal bar gyur pa dag la ni/ /kun tu zhugs pa'i sman rnon dang / /dug las byung ba dug sman gtang / /kun tu zhugs la rab rno ba'i/ /sna sman dang ni mig sman dang / /dud pas ⑫bud dang khab kyis ni/ /sen mo'i bar du gzugs par byaspyo/ /skra 'bal ⑩bsregs dang sos btab dang / /sdig pa sha sbrang 111—485

gtses pa dang / /mkhur bar tsha dang skyur ba gzhug /kha sral phre'u bdar bar bya/ /'du shes rnyed cing ldang ①gyur nas/ /sgog skya'i khu ba blud par bya/ /tsha ba gsum ni lan tshwar ⑤bcas/ /bi dza pu ①ra'i ge sar sbyin/ /bu ga'i rgyun srang dag bya'i phyir/ /zas yang tsha dro rno ba sbyin/ /brjed pa dran phyir ngo mtshar dang / /yid 'ong lta dang thos pa dang / /glu dang rol mo snyan pa yi//sgra snyan rjortsol ba byed du gzhug /slon sman bkru sman btang dus ⑤rngub/ /khrag ni dbyung bar bya ba dag /rgyun mi chad pa rjospyad par bya/ /sems stor ba yi rgyu las ni/ /slar ldang 'brel pa'i 'jigs pa yis/ /de ni legs par bsrung bar bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u bdun pa'o⑦// //de nas gzhang 'brum gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /thun mong dus su sprin ⑧med par/ /gzhang 'brum can rab nyam ⑨chung min/ /lto sbyangs kha zas yang la nyung / /rjes su mthun pa zos pa la/ /gtsang byas bde legs 'gyur bar ⑩byas/ /bshang dang gci bsal gnod pa med/ /khri 'am spang leb mi gzhan gyi/ /pang par legs brten gnas nas ni/ /gan rkyal 'dug cing ro stod smad/ /drang 'dug nyi mar rkub bstan la/ /rked pa'i phyogs ni bstod par bya/ /de nas brla ⑪dang gnya' bar ni/ / bcings pa'i ⑫gos kyis bsdams nas su/ /gzung ⑫ste drang por 'dug pa la/ /nad g.yog gis ni bzung nas su/ /rkub ni zhun mar dag gis ④bsku/ /de nas mar gyis bskus pa yi/ /cha spyad drang por de gzhug bya/ /rkub nas phyogs par rim gyis gzhug/111—486

de nas 'byung 'gyur mthong ba dang / /cha spyad chud ①par shes gyur nas/ /gzhang 'brum thur ma gos gsher bas/ /sman pas legs par btsir nas ni/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /rlan can thal sman bsreg cig shos/ /thal sman rnon po'i me yis bsreg /stobs ldan mche ba bcad de bsreg /de nas cha spyad phyung nas ni/ /nad pa'i rkub dang ro smad bsku/ /snum gyi nang du 'bying ⑧bar bya/ /de ltar zhag ni bdun bdun zhing / /re re nye bar bcos par bya/ /de nas rlung med khang par ni/ /bzhag la spyod pa bsten par bya/ /gzhang 'brum mang la dang por g.yas/ /de nas g.yon bsal ④de 'og rgyab/ /gzhang 'brum mang po bsregs rjolegs na/ /rlung ni bde bar rgyu byed cing / /kha zas 'dod cing me drod skyed⑤/ /bder gnas stobs dang kha dog skyedarjo/ /chu sog zer gyis btab pa la/ /ba spru ba dang ru rta dang / /garnya muṅga ⑦a ka ru/ /sha ta sgeput+pa thang shing rnams/ /zhib tu btags la lde gu yis/ /lte ba man chad bsku bar bya/ /bshang dang gci 'gags gyur pa la/ /a lam bu sa ba ru ⑨na—/ /ba spru gze ma e raṇ+ḍa/ /a za garnya mu ra rnams/ /bskol ba dro 'jam byas pa yis/ /blugs dang 'byeng ⑩ba'i sbyor ba bya/ /yang na 'o ma snum bcas pa/ /rlung sel sman bskol til mar sbyar/ /zas ni bshang ba sla byed cing / /snum dang ⑪rlung 'joms drod skyed ⑫sbyin/ /de nas bsreg pa mi bya zhing / /bad kan rlung skyes phyir byung ba/ /'gags shing g.ya' la na zhing skrang / /gzhang 'brum bsku ba byas nas ni/ /bil ba'i rtsa ba tsi tra ka /thal sman ru rta bskol ba yi/ /til mar blugs ⑫pa'am sbrul byi la/ /rnga mo phag rgod zhag gis byug④ /de rjes rlan dugs kyis dugs bya/ /yang na gsher dugs spyad 111—487

par bya/ /yang na zan ni til mar dang / /zhun mar snum can kyis dugs bya//ra sna ha pu sha dag dang / /shi kru'i lo ma'i gong pos bya/ /arga'i rtsa ba shal ma li'irka/ /lo ma mi skra sbrul lpags dang / /byi la'i pags pa mar sbyar ba'i/ /dud bdugs gzhang 'brum dag la phan/ /a shwa garnya bri ha ti①/ /byi'u rug pi pi ling mar sbyar/ /ku ba kha bo'i sa bon dang / /yal ga 'jam por rang sgyur dang ⑤/ /sde gu grib mar skams ①pa yi/ /reng bu rkub bcug gzhang 'brum 'jig /ku ba kha bo'i yal ga rtsa/ /thal sman bcas pa'i lde gu ni/ /'ol ma se dang su ra na/ /bum sha yi ni sa bon las/ /reng bur byas pa de dang 'dra—/ /su dhā k+ṣi ④ra yung sde gu/ /khyim bya'i rtug pa pi pi ling / /yung dang 'ol ma se dag ni/ /ba gcin btags pa de dang 'dra/ /snu ⑤ha'i 'o mar btags shu dag /ta ma la rus pri yang ku/ /rnam rgyal kar ka ta sring gi/ /ru rta spangs ma go bye dhidang / /shi kru la phug sa bon dang / /nim pa ka ra bī ⑦ra'i lo/ /pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / /bil rtsa shing kun bcas pa 'am/ /ru rta shri sha'i sa bon dang / /rgyam tsha bu ram pi pi ling / /arga snu ha'i 'o ⑧ma dang //'bras bu gsum gyi lde gu ④bsku/ /arga'i ⑩'o ma snu ha'i sdong / /ku ba kha bo'i 'dab ma dang / /ka rañdza dang ra thug gcin/ /lde gus ⑪gzhang 'brum sel mchog yin/ /'jam rtsi'i ⑫sman ni pi pi ling / /la sogs lde gu'ang bsngags pa yin/ /sman 'di nyid kyis til mar ni/ /bsku ba'i don du bskol bar bya/ /dud pas bdug dang sde gu ni/ /bskus pas gzhang 'brum dag gi khrag /sogs pa 'dzag par byed 'gyur te/ /de nas bde ba nyid du 'gyur/ / skrang zhing ()'dzag par ma gyur dang / /sra ba las ni khrag dbyung ste/ /pad pa 111—488

gtsags ①bu khab kyi ni/ /pir gyis yang dang yang khrag dbyung / /bsil drod snum dang rtsub pa yis/ /nad ni zhi bar ma gyur na/ /de phyir sman pas nad khrag nyid/ /dbyung ba la ni 'bad par bya/ /'o ma tsi tra ka'i ②rtsa phye/ /btab pa las byung dar ba dang ④/ /blud cing de nyid kyi zas ni/ /byin na gzhang 'brum sel bar 'gyur/ /ka pi da ri'i rtsa ba'i phye/ /dar ba gsar pa ༷btab pa blud/ /zhu nas phan pa'i zas byin ⑤na/ /gzhang 'brum nad las thar bar 'gyur/ /gzhang skrang dhigazer bcas me drod 'bri/ /skran nad la ni phan pa'i sman/ /shing kun la sogs blud pa'am/ /bu ram a ru ra sbyar ba/ /byen la de rjes dar ba blud/ /yang na a ru byi dang ga⑦ /dug mo nyung shun tsi tra ka /dar ba dang sbyar blud pa'am/ /dug mo nyung dang pi pi leng / /tsi tra ka dang su ra na/ /cha res ⑧bskyed pa chu dron blud/ /yang na tsha gsum lan tshwa gsum/ /shing kun star bu bcas chu blud/ /bil ba ka pid thar bcas pa'am| /bca' sga kha ru tsha ⑨bcas pa'am/ /go bye la la phud bcas pa'i /skyo ma de la blud ⑩par bya/ /yang na shing kun spa ⑪ma'i 'bras/ /tsi tra ka dang dar ba ⑫sbyar/ /pi lu'i 'bras bu dar bar ⑫bcas/ /zla ba gcig gi bar du sbyin| /zas kyi sngon nyid re re zhing / /ci 'dod par ni blud par bya/ /shin tu me drod chung ba la/ /dar ba kho na blud par bya/ /nyams stobs dus dang gnas ⑫shes pa'i/ /sman pa yis ni dar ba dag /zhag bdun nam ni zhag bcu'am| /zla ba zla gcig bar du blud/ /yang na phyi dro 'bras yos kyi/ /phye ⑫dang dar ba'i lde gu sbyin/ /dar ba zhu nas dar ba ni⑩/ /thug pa rgyam tshar bcas pa blud/ /de rjes dar bar g.yos pa'i zan⑩/ /snum can byin la 111—489

dar ba blud/ /yu sha'am sha khu dar ba can/ /sā ①lu'i 'bras chen ②ran par bza'—/ /rtsub dang mar phyed phyung ba dang / /gang las ④mar ni ma phyung ④ba/ /dar ba nad dang me drod kyi/ /stobs las de ni rnam gsum sbyar/ /dar bas legs bcom gyur pa yis⑤/ /gzhang 'brum slar ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de blugs gyur na rtsa yi ni/ /tshogs kyang skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtsa spubs dar bas dag byas pasarjo/ /lus zungs dwangs mar gyur pa gang / /de ⑦ni nyams dga' mdog dang stobs/ /mchog tu rgyas par byed par 'gyur⑧/ /rlung dang bad kan dag gi nad/ /brgya ⑨phrag dar ba rnying pas 'joms/ /gzhang 'brum gzhig par 'dod pa yis/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑩ri'i lde gus bsku⑪/ /snod du dar ba gsar ⑫pa ni/ /nub ⑫gcig gzhag ste blud ⑫par bya/ /'u su zi ra go snyod dang / /pi pi ling gnyis ha pu sha /shu ti pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /la la phud dang tsi tra ka /ya ⑫ba na gi'i phye ma ⑩dang / /dar ba sbyar ba ⑩mar gyi snod/ /bzhag par gyur pa de las skyur/ /kha ba dang ni rab skyur min/ /skyur dang kha ba bro bar ⑫ni/ /ldang ba'i dar rnying ⑪ci 'dod blud/ /drod skyed mdog bzang yi ga 'byed/ /rlung dang bad kan sel byed cing / /gzhang skrang na bas nyam ⑩thag pa/ /'joms shing stobs ni 'phel byed yin/ /kru trug ⑪tres kyi rtsa ba'i shunaske/ /btags pa'i lde gus bum pa bsku/ /der ni 'o ma ⑫dar ba gzhag /smin pa'i gzhang 'brum sel byed blud/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba a ru ra/ /sle tres tsha ba lnga dag la'ang / /cho ga 'di nyid sbyar bar bya/ /pa ta ha ti pi pi ling ⑫ /shu ti tsha ba lnga g.yer ma/ /zi ra 'u su bil ba'i rkang / /phye mar btags te sbyar bar bya/ /'bras bu skyur po blumar til mar/ /yu sha sha khu thug blastsogs bya//111—490

sman 'di nyid dang chu dang mar/ /bskol ba 'ang drod skyed byed pa yin/ /rim ①'di bshang ba sla ba yin/ /rtug pa 'gags pa bshad bya ste/ /snum stsogs zan dang ldan pa yi/ /chang dwangs snelan tshwa btab pa blud/ /yang na dar ba bu ram chang / /chang sgyur chang dwangs lan tshwar sbyar/ /zas mngar mar dang til mar gyis/ /brngos pa'i ka rañdza'i lo ma/ /steng du phye btab byin gyur na/ /rlung gis ①rtug pa 'gags pa sel/ /bca' sga bu ram bcas pa 'am/ ba ta bu ram mar lan tshwa/ /ba gcin la sngangs a ru ra/ /bu ram bcas pa sbyin rjopa'ang rung / /a ru ra ni nyis brgya gcin/ /bre bcu drug tu gcin du'i bar//bamakha ba sbrang rtsir ⑤bcas pa dag /gnyis gnyis zos nas bad kan gyisarjo/ /gzhang 'brum mdze dang 'or nad dang / /skran dang dmu rdzing gcin snyi 'bu/ /rmen bu shu bas khyab tsho ches/ /skya rbab rlung 'khyil 'joms par byed/ /a za sring gi rtsa ba yi/ /lde gu ra gcin sbyar 'thung zhing / /bu ram bar ⑦ta ka zos na| /gzhang 'brum myur du 'jig par 'gyur/ /dur byed ④'bras bu gsum khur sbyar/ /yang na dar ba a ru ra'am⑨/ /pi pi leng bcas a ru ra/ /mar dang brngos pa'i bu ram bcas/ /yang na dur byid dan dar bcas/ /zos na bde bar 'byung bar byed/ /gzhang na gnas pa'i nad bsal na/ /gzhang 'brum zad par byed par 'gyur/ /se 'bru'i khu ba zi ra dang / /bca' sga bu ram la la phud/ /pa ta dang sbyar dar ba ni/ /rlung gis ⑩rtug 'gags sel byed yin/ /rgan chang yang na bu ram chang / /bca' sga kru trug ⑪tres dang bcas/ /yang na chang ni pa ta dang / /spa 'bras kha ru tsha bcas blud/ /pi pi ling ni bcu bcus bskyed/ /til ni srang phyed btab gyur na⑫/ /'o 111—491

ma bcas 'thungs lus stobs dang / /me drod skyed par ①byed pa yin/ /byi tsher ba dang bil ba dang / /la la phud dang dong gra rnams/ /re re dang sbyar pa tas dze+ekyang / /gzhang 'brum nad ni sel bar byed/ /chu bre drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang / /a ru ra shun bre phyed dang / /skyu ru ra ni bre gang dang / /ka pid ta ④ni srang bcu dang / /pi sha la ni srang lnga dang / /seng phrom shing tsha na le sham/ /pi pi ling dang byi dang garjo /srang ni gnyis gnyis tshad byas bskol / /bzhi cha lus btsags bu ram ni⑤/ /srang ni nyis brgya bcug nas di/ /da ta ki rjoni bre gang gzhug /mar gyi snod du bcug nas ni/ /zla phyed nas ni chang rnying 'thungs/ /me drod skyed cing gzhang 'brum dang / /pho nad skya rbab mdze dmu rdzing / /dbyig ⑦dug rims skran mchin nad dang / /snying nad skran dang gcong chen dang / /slon dang srin bu'i nad rnams 'joms/ /chu bye bcu drug nang dan ti/ /rtsa bcu 'bras gsum tsi tra ka /srang re bskol ba bzhi cha lus/ /bu ram srang brgyad gzhug par bya/ /thams cad snga ma dang 'dra las//rjes mthun cig shos sel bar byed/ /chu bre bcu drug nang dag tu/ /bye tsher ba ni bre gang dang / /dan ti pa ta tsi tra ka /rnam rgyal dong gra ba sha ka /skyu ru ra ni khyor re bskol/ /bzhi cha lus pa de'i nang du/ /ka ra dkar po srang brgyad ⑧gzhug /gzhan dag snga ma bzhin du sbyar/ /rdza ma'i snod kyang pri yang ku/ /pi pi ling dang dbyi mo dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi'i sde gus ⑫bsku/ /bde bar 'byung phyir zas kyi sngar/ /'bras bu skyur bcas mar blud pa'am/ /dbye mo ⑩kru trug tres ⑪bskol mar/ /nas tshig 'khus thal bu ram bcas/ /pi pi ling gi rtsa bar bskol/ /bu ram dong gra nas tshig 'khus/ /pi pi ling rtsa 111—492

pi pi ling / /se ①'bru 'u su dag dang mar/ /bzhi 'gyur zho dang bskol bas ni| /'phyen ②dang bshang gci 'gags pa sel/ /ba la sha ①yi thal ba'i chu/ /sum 'gyur dang ni mar du bskol/ /dug mo nyung sogs phye ma btab/ /drod skyed gzhang 'brum 'joms pa'i mchog /tsha ba lnga dang a ru ra/ /ya bak+ṣa ④ra la la phud/ /lce myang tsha dang kha ru tsha/ /pa ta 'u su na le sham/ /bil ba zho dang bcas pa'i mar/ /bskol ba des ⑤ni chu so gzhang / /'khru zhing gzhang ni nyams pa dang / /gcin sri 'dzag pa sel bar byed/ /pa ta 'u su la la phud/ /tsha ba lnga dang gze ma dang / /bil ba zho dang tsang gi ri/ /khu ba mar gyi bzhi 'gyur bskol/ /lto sbos gcin ni sri ba dang / /rtag tu 'khru dang gzhang 'brum rjodang / /gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad rnams dang / /bad kan rlung ni 'joms par byed/ /rma bya sreg pa 'ur bya ⑦yi/ /sha khu skyur po legs sbyar bsde/ /khyim bya 'am bye'u'i ⑨sha khu ni/ /'phyen ⑩dang phyi sa 'gags la bludarka/ /rgya sne'u dur byid tsi tra ka /dan ti pa ti am+bi ka /la sogs lo ma gzhan yang ni/ /bad kan rlung 'joms tshod ⑪ma ni/ /yang zhing bshang ba sla bar byed/ /shing kun mar dang til mar brngos/ /zho yi spris mar 4)bskol ba dang / /'u su dang ni tsha ba lnga/ /btags pa'i phye dang se ⑫'bru'i bcud| /'u su'i 'dab ma gzhon nu dang / /sge'u gsher gshags ⑫par gyur pa dang / / spos zhim legs bdug dri zhim byas⑫/ /zi ra na le sham dang bcas| /kha ru tsha ni shas cher bro/ /rlung shas cher ⑫rtsub drod chung la/ / sā lu tsa ⑩snar 'bras chan ni/ /ba lang ⑫go ta rnga mo ra'i/ /sha khu tshod ltar g.yos pa dang / /mchog tu sha za rnams kyi sha /rtug skam can la sbyin par 111—493

bya / /chang dang bur chang ka ra'i ①chu/ /rgun chang dar ba rtsab mo dang / /chang rnying ④dang ni zho ga ①chu/ /yang na chu nyung bskol ba 'am/ /'u su bca' sga bskol ba 'am/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka rjori bskol ba blud/ /zas kyi thog ma'am bar dag tu/ /rlung gi rtug skam sel ba sbyin/ /rlung mkhyes bad kan rtug skam rnams/ /bde bar 'byung zhing dri ma sbyang ⑤/ /gzhang khar gzhang 'brum zhi 'gyur zhing / /me drod skyed par byed pa yin/ /rtug skam gyis ni gzir ba dang / /gang yang shin tu khong rtsub dang / /rlung 'khyil gzer gyis nyen pa gang / /de la 'jam rtsi bya ba bsngags/ /pi pi ling dang po son cha/ /bil ba shu ti shing mngar dang //shu dag ru rta kru trug tres/ /zur pa ma nu thang shing rnams/ /btags te til mar la btso zhing / /'o ma til mar nyis 'gyur gzhug /gzhang 'brum rlung gis 'khyil ba la/ /'jam rtsi de ni mchog tu bsngags/ /gzhang 'byung ba dang gzer ba dang / /gcin sri 'khrog ⑦cing 'khru ba dang / /brla rked rgyab na nyam ⑦chung dang / /lto sbos chu sor brten pa dang / /be snabs 'khru dang gzhang skrang ⑧dang / /rlung gis ⑨rtug pa 'gags pa dang / /gang zhig mang du 'byung 'dod pa/ /de dag 'jam rtsis sel bar byed⑩/ /yang na mas gtong bkru sman drag /rtsa ba lnga pa 'o mar bcas/ /ba gcin til mar lan tshwa dang //⑪son cha la ⑫sogs lde gu gtang / /de nas gzhang 'brum ⑫khrag 'dzag pa/ / rlung ngam bad kan dang 'byel ba/ /btags nas de la snum pa dang / /rtsub dang bsil ba ⑫sbyar bar bya/ /de la rlung dang rjes 'brel ba/ /bshang ba gnag cing ⑫sra la rtsub/ /rlung ni thur du 'byung mi byed/ /rked pa brla dang gzhang kha gzer/ /rtsub pa'i rgyur ni gyur pa yin/ /bad kan rjes 'brel bshang 111—494

ba sla/ /skya zhing ser la ①phyi zhing snum/ /spyi ②bag gzhang kha tshor ba chung / /rgyu ni snum lci yin zhes bya/ /rang khrag mtshan nyid las kyang brtags①/ /nad khrag bsal bar bya ba dang / /nyams stobs ji bzhin sgyung ba bya/ /ji srid nad khrag nag po ④byung / /de srid khrag 'dzag gcad mi bya/ /nad ni smin par bya phyir dang / /me drod bskyed par bya phyir dang / /khrag ni gcad par bya ba'i phyir/ /de phan chad ni kha ba blud/ /gang zhig nad kyis stobs zad pa⑤/ /khrag ni rlung gi rjoshes che la/ /btung dang bsku dang 'jam rtsi ru/ /rig pas snum ni sbyar bar bya/ /gang zhig mkhris pa rgyas pa'i khrag /tsha ba'i dus su 'byung gyur pa/ /de ni gcig tu gcad bya yi/ /rlung dang bad kan las gyur minarka/ /bad kan bcas khrag bca' sga dang / /dug mo nyung shun bskol ba blud| /yang na rtsa mkhris bca' sga dang / /byi tsher tsan+dan dmar po 'am /skyer pa'i shun pa pu shel tse/ /nim pa'am se 'bru'i shun bskol blud/ /dug mo nyung shun 'bras bu dang / /bong nga sbrang rtsi skyer khaṇ+ḍa 'am⑦/ /yang na a pa marga yi/ /lde gu ske'abras kyi chu sbyar blud/ /dug mo nyung gi shun pa rlon/ /srang brgyad char chu nang du bskol/ /shun lpags khu ba btsags pa ru/ /btsod dang mo tsa pri yad+ku'i/ /khu ba srang re dag dang ni/ /dug mo nyung gi phye ma bcug/de nas gzar bur ⑨chags pa yi/ /sde gu bskol ba sbyin bya zhing / /thug pa thug sla'i 'o thug gam/ /ra 'am ba yi 'o ma 'am/ /me stobs ji bzhin blud par bya/ /lde gu 'dis ni khrag gi ni/ /tshad 'khru⑩gzhang 'brum sel byed cing / /khrag mkhris nad ni stobs ldan pa/ /steng ngam 'og nas 'byung ba sel/ /dug mo nyung shun srang brgyad cu/ /bre bcu drug bskol brgyad cha blud/ /de ⑪ni cha 111—495

gsum skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /seng phrom gnyis dang mon cha ra/ / se 'bru ①gzhon nu'i shun lpags dang / /bil ba gzhon nu gla sgang dang / /btsod dang da ta ka'i ②'bras bu/ /srang ni re re btags pa yi/ /sde gur byas ①pa gzhug par bya/ /dug mo nyung shun srang bcu dang / /zhun mar srang ni nyi shu dang / /bu ram srang ni sum cu gzhug /bskol la gzar ④bur chags pa dang / /'bru nang zla phyed bcug ste bldag⑤ /gzhang 'brum kun dang pho ba'i nad/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel/ /seng phrom mo tsa ra sa til/ /btsod dang tsan+dan ut+pa la/ /ra yi 'o ma sbyar ba blud/ /de nyid dang ni 'bras chen sbyin/ /shing mngar shun pa byi tsher ba/ /'o ma drur ba rjopa ya su⑦/ /kha ra sbrang rtsir ⑧bcas chu 'am/ /ra yi 'o ma sbyar ba btung / /seng phrom btsod dang pu shel tse⑨/ /sha ma li shun dug ⑩mo nyung / /tsan+dan shing mngar pu shel tse/ /nā ⑪ga ge sar 'bras chur blud/ /la la phud dang dug mo nyung / /pa ta bca' sga skyer khaṇ+ḍa'i⑫/ /bye ma gzer dang bcas la phan/ /khrag ni drag tu 'byung ba la/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri pa ya su⑫/ /gnyis dang bskol ba'i zhun mar bsngags/ /yang na seng phrom da ta ⑫ki/ /dug mo nyung shun 'bras bu dang / /ut+pal pad+ma ge sar mar/ /ya bak+ṣa ra se 'bru'i bcud/ /kha ra pad+ma ge sar dang / /mar sar bcas pa ⑫til sbyar ba'am/ /mar sar sbyar bas ⑩khrag las ni/ /gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum sel bar byed/ /ra yi mar sar 'o ma dang / /skam sa'i srog chags sha khrag dang / /rgya sne'i khu bar ⑩bcas sha khu/ /cung zad skyur dang skyur med pa/ / sā lu tsa spyosnar zho yi spri/ /drug cu pa dang chang sar dang / /chang gi dwangs ma sar pa ni/ /khrag las gyur pa'i sman mchog yin/ /thug pa yu sha sha khu sogs//111—496

yang na kun dong 'ba' zhig gis/ /khrag rgyas gyur pa sel byed de①/ /rlung las gyur pa'ang sbyar bar bya/ /phal cher rlung shas che ②gzhang 'brum/ /khrag 'dzag drags snelas 'byung 'gyur bas/ /de bas lhag par de la ni/ /de bsal ba la 'bad par bya/ /khrag mkhris shas che bad kan dang / /rlung shas che bar mthong gyur ④na/ /de zhi ⑤bya phyir rnam kun du/ /bsil ba'i cho ga spyad par bya/ /gal te des kyang ma zhi na/ /de tshe snum dang dro bas brta/ /sha khu dro 'jam zhun mar ni/ /thog ma nyid du sbyar bar bya/ /de la til mar mar dang ni/ /'o ma dro 'jam blud pa'ang bsngags/ /byi tsher ku sha 'jag ma'i rtswarjo//shal ma li yi dze+eme tog dang / /u dum bā nir n+ya gro dha/ /a shwat+tha stiyi myu gu srang / /gnyis gnyis chu bre ⑩gsum dang ni/ /'o ma bre gang nang du bskol/ /'o ma lus nas tshigs ma btsags/ /khu ba der ⑪ni mon cha ra/ /btsod dang tsan+dan ut+pa la/ /ut+pal ⑫pad+ma'i ge sar dang / /dug mo nyung gi sa bon te⑫/ /'di rnams btags pa'i lde gu bsres⑫/ /'di ni spyi spyobag 'jam rtsir grags⑩//mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar bcas/ /mkhregs dang gzhang ni 'byung ba dang / /khrag 'dzag rims ni 'joms par byed/ /shing mngar pra puṇ+ḍa rī ka /de bzhin mon cha ⑩ra la sogs/ /nyis 'gyur gyi 4)ni 'o ma bskol/ /snum gyi 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya/ /shing mngar ⑪ut+pal seng phrom btsod/ /bil ba tsan+dan ba le ka /dbyi mo ⑥ gla sgang bong nga dkar/ /ba ta ya bak+ṣa ra ⑪mchog /skyer pa shing tsha tsi tra ka /dong ga spang spos thang shing dang / /tsang gi ri yi khu ba mar/ /bskol ba des ⑫ni nyes gsum 'joms/ /gzhang 'brum tshad 'khru pho ba'i nad/ /skya rbab rims ⑫dang yi ga 'chus/ /gcin sri gzhang ni 111—497

nyams pa dang / /chu so sbo dang mkhregs ①pa dang / /be snabs 'khru dang gzhang 'brum sel⑤/ /de blud sman gyi dam pa yin/ / rim gyis mngar ①zhing skyur ba dang / /grang dro la sogs rtag tu ni/ /me drod stobs las ltos ④te gtang / /gzhang 'brum nad las rgyal bar 'gyur⑤/ /rtug skam gyis nyen til mar ni/ /grang ba'i rims la phan pas rjobasku/ /rlan dugs snum can gyis dugs bya/ /de nas reng bu gzhug bya ste/ /sha ma dur byid dan da dang / /ni li ni 'bras pi pi ling / /po son cha lan tshwa nyes 'gyur/ /phyer btags bu ram ba gcin sbyar/ /mar bsgus ring bu mthe bong tsam/ /bcug na rtug skam bde 'byung byed/ /pi pi ling dang po son cha/ /khyim gyi dung pa nyungs ⑦kar bcas—/ /'di dag nyid kyi phye ma ni/ /rkub nas gce 'us 'bud sgepar bya/ /de don med na rab rno snum/ /mas gtong bas ni btsir te gtang / /des ni ⑨gzhang rtsa drang por byed/ /bshang gci 'phyen ni bde bar 'byung / /slar yang 'gags na rlung 'joms pa'i/ /bkru sman snum can gtang bya zhing / /'jam rtsi dag ni gtang bar bya/ /rtsub pas rlung ni rtug skam 'gyur/ /lan tshwa gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ /'bras bu gsum dang dan ti dang / / bse shing ⑩'bras bu tsi tra ka /phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsis ⑩sbrus/ /rdza skyogs kha sbyar 'jim pas byugs⑫/ /du ba nang 'khyems bsreg par bya/ /thal ba dge ba can zhes bya—/ /mar dang lhan cig blud pa 'am⑫/ /'bras chan snum can dang sbyar ④zos—/ /rtug skam 'gags dang gzhang 'brum skran/ /skya rbab dmu rdzing ⑫bde gcin sri/ /snying nad 'or nad pho ba'i nad/ /gcin snyi ⑩mchin pa gzer dang slo⑪/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba 'joms/ /gzhang 'brum la ni gang 111—498

zhig bshad/ /de bzhin rtug skam dag la ①sbyar/ /ka rañdza shun srang ②ni nyis brgya bcu/ /bre bcu drug bskol bzhi cha lus pa der/ /bu ram srang ni brgyad cu tsha ④ba gsum/ /srang brgyad zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma gzhug /'di dag zla gcig bzhag ste langs gyur nas/ /tsha byas mchog tu drod skyed zas 'ju ba'i—/ /nus skyed rlung bder rgyu byas gzhang 'brum dang / /mcher nad skran dang dmu rdzing sel bar byed/ /pu ti ka rañdza ni srang brgyad dang / /tsi tra kaṇ+ḍa ka ri srang nyis brgya/ /chu bre bzhi bcu brgyad bskol bzhi cha lus/ /btsags te bsgrangs par bu ram srang brgyad gzhugabu /dri sna gsum dang tsha gsum se 'bru dang / /pi pi ling gi rjortsa ba sru sru'i rtsa④/ /gu gul ma nu 'u su dbyi mong dang / /spa ma'i 'bras bu sge gsher star bu ni/ /srang re zhib dze+etu btags pa'i phye ma bskol/ /bsgrangs nas sbrang rtsi srang ni nyi shu gzhug /sge gsher sgyur rtsi chen po rgun 'brum rlon/ /bu ram shing gi khu ba btsir ba bcas⑧ mar gyi snod bcug ⑨zla gcig bzhag ste langs/ /skyur ⑩gyur 'di ni gzhang 'brum sog ⑪le ste/ /me drod skyed par byed pa'i mchog yin la/ /skya rbab dbyeg dug dmu rdzing skran mcher pa/ /lto sbos rde'u chags gcin sri 'joms par byed/ /pi lu'i khu ba ras btsags bre bcu drug /mar gyi snod kyi nang du bcug nas ni//da ta ()ki dang rgun 'bru 'bra ⑫go dang / /skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu srang gnyis gnyis—/ /pa ta bong nga dkar po byi tsher ba/ /star bu tsha ba gsum dang shing tsha dang / /sug smel 'u su spra ki ka ko la/ /li shi pi pi ling rtsa byi dang ga⑫ /kru trug tres srang re re bu ram ni/ /srang brgyad rlung med gnas su zla phyed gzhag/des ni gzhang 'brum skran ⑫bcas zhi byed cing / /me yi stobs ni myur du skyed 111—499

par byed/ /yang na rtsa ba bcu pa dur byid dang / /pa ta ar ka ①gnyis dang bong nga dkar/ / kad pa ④la rnams re re srang bcu bcu/ /snga ma bzhin du bsregs pa'i thal ba ni/ /chu bye bcu drug nang du bskol nas ni/ /bzhi cha lus par bu ram srang brgya ①dang / /tsha ba gsum dang dbyi mong a ru ra/ /srang lnga tsi tra ka ni srang gnyis dang / /ya bak+ṣa ra srang gnyis bcug ste bskol/ /gzar bur chags pa'i bu ram lde gu yis/ /skran dang mcher nad gzhang rjo'abrum mdze nad dang / /gcin nad ⑤me drod nyams pa 'joms par byed/ /tsi tra ka yi rtsa ba srang lnga bcu/ /chu srang bcu rjodrug bskol la ⑦brgyad cha lus/ /der ④ni bu ram rnying pa srang brgya ⑨gzhug /slar bskol ⑩ska bar gyur pa de nang du/ /tsha ba gsum dang shu ti a ru ra/ /ru rta gla sgang shing tsha byi dang ga⑪ /tsi tra ka dang sug smel phyer btags bsres/ /des ni gzhang 'brum mje dang skran dang ni//mcher pa dmu rdzing nad ni 'joms byed cing / /rtag tu bsten na me drod skyed par ⑫byed/ /tsha ba gsum dang til dang ⑫'bras bu gsum/ / byi dang ga dang go bye ④tsi tra ka /bu ram ri lur byas bsten ⑫gzhang 'brum dang / /pags pa'i nad ni sel bar byed pa yin/ /so ra na yi rtsa ba kha sbyar bcug /'jim pas bskus te cho ga bzhin bsregs pa⑫/ /lan tshwa til mar bcas pa zos gyur na/ /gzhang 'brum sel bar byed pa'i ⑩dam pa yin/ /na le sham dang pi pi ling dong gra/ /kru trug ⑫tres ni cha re bskyed pa dang / /tsi tra ⑪bzhi 'gyur su ra na dang sbyar/ /bu ram ri lus ⑩gzhang 'brum gcod par byed/ /so ra na yi bcu drug phyer ⑥btags shing / /tsi tra ka ni de yi cha phyed bya/ /bca' sga cha gnyis na le sham cha gcig /bu ram ri lur byas ⑫pas gzhang 111—500

'brum sel/ /a ru ra dang dong gra pi pi ling / /ka rañdza dang tsi tra byi dang ga①/ka ra mnyam phye rgod ma'i kha lta bu②/ /zas phyi ①mang du zos kyang 'ju bar byed/ /dug mo nyung lo ga li pi pi ling / /tsi tra ka dang a ba marga yi/ /sa bon rtsa mkhris rgyam tsha bu ram durnams/ / ri lur byas pas ⑤gzhang 'brum sel bar byed—/ /gal te gzhang 'brum gzhig par 'dod na ni/ /rgyam tsha tsi tra ka dang dug mo nyung rjo/ /tsi li bil ba nim par ⑦bcas pa dag /btags pa'i phye ma dar bar bcas pa btung / /gzhang 'brum skam la ba la ta ⑧ka ste/ /gsher la dug mo nyung shun sman mchog yin/ /kun la dus kun du ni dar rnying mchog /stobs skyed byed cing nad rnams 'joms pa yin/ /rtug pa 'gags pa bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rlung sel me drod skyed par byed pa yi⑨/ /bza' dang btung ba gang yin de bsten bya/ /de las go zlog ⑩pa ni spang bar bya / /gzhang 'brum tshad 'khru pho ba'i nad rnams ni/ /phal cher phan tshun rgyur gyur yin pas na/ /me drod chung na skye'i ⑪che na min/ /de bas de la mchog tu me drod bsrung / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nas 'khru ba gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /'khru ba phal cher ma zhu ba'i| /gnas rten ⑫me drod nyams pa la⑫/ /'byung bas de'i phyir rlung gyur la'ang ⑫/ /dang po sgyung ba byas pa phan/ /gzer dbo bad kan gyis nyam ⑫thag /'khru ba can ni slon du gzhug /nad ni gang zhig sogs pa dag /ma smin zas dang 'dres gyur na/ /'khru ba dag ni 'byung gyur ⑩te/ /shin tu 111—501

slongs te 'byung gyur ①dang / /rang nyid 'khru byed de la ni/ /btang snyoms gzhag pa de nyid sman⑤/ /ma zhu 'khru la dang por di/ /gcod pa'i sman ni gtang mi bya/ /gal te 'gags byed lto sbo ①lci/ /gzer dang tshor ba chung gyur rjol—/ /a ru btang na ⑤nad 'khyil ba/ /'byin pas srog ni ster byed yin/ /nad tshabs 'bring la khyad par du/ /bu ti ka dang dupi pi ling / /bca' sga shu dag a ru ra/ /'u su legs par bskol ba blud/ /yang na bil ba 'u su dang / /gla sgang dong gra ba le ⑦ka /pa tha shu dag ⑧kha ru tsha/ /dong ga bye dang ⑨a ru ra—/ /bca' sga gla sgang bong nga dkar/ /bil ba shing kun dug mo nyung / /nad gzhi chung ba'i tshad 'khru la/ /sgyung ba byas pa bsngags pa yin/ /yang na shu dag bong nga dkar/ /gla sgang par pa ta bskol ba'am/ /ba le ⑩ka dang dong gra ni/ /bskol ba'i chu dag blud par bya/ / bkres shing nyam ⑩chung zas dus su/ /kha zas yang ba rig ⑫pas sbyin/ /des de'i kha zas yi gar 'ong / /me drod lus stobs skyed par byed/ /dar ba'am rang skyur dag gam ni/ /nas thug dag gi skyo ma 'am/ /chang ngam rgun chang dag gi ⑫ni/ /btung ba gang 'os nyer spyad bya/ /kha zas byin pa'i 'og tu ni/ /bil ba gzhon nu zur ba dkar—/ /'u su shing kun da trig se'u/ /zi ra spa 'bras pa la sha /la la phud dang kha ru tsha/ /rgyam tsha rtsa ba chung ngu lnga/ /tsha ba lnga dang pa tha ste/ /smin gcod drod ni skyed par byed/ /bad kan mkhris pa'i shas che la/ /sa la paṇi ⑫ba la dang / /bil ba kṛṇ+ḍa spyopaṇi dang / /se 'bru bskol ba'i thug pa phan/ /pi pi ling rtsa a ru ra/ /thug pas rlung ni bder ⑩rgyu byed/ /nad gzhi mang la 'gags pa dang / /me drod che bar gang zhig 'khru/ /pi pi ling dang 'bras bu 111—502

gsum| / byi dang ga ①bskol bkru sman gtang / /sbyangs ②byas nas ni thug pa dag /rlung 'joms me drod skyed pa drud/ /gang zhig ma zhu smin gyur dang / /me drod skyes nas 'khru 'gyur ④zhing / /'byar bag lbum ④can nad bcas pa /sri shing yang dang yang du ni/ /yang yang 'khru zhing bshang chung ba'am/ /bshang ba ⑤ma 'dres mkhregs rjobacas la/ /zho dang 'o ma mar til mar/ /bca' sga bu ram bcas pa blud/ /yang na rgya shug 'bras bu spangs/ /bu ram til mar ldan pa sbyin/ /bshang ba sri la phan tshod ma/ /snum mang de bzhin sha khu dang / /zho dang se 'bru g.yos pa dang / /sā ⑦lu'i 'bras chen ma sha til/ /muṅga legs par g.yos pa'i zas/ /de ni bkres par gyur tshe sbyin/ /zur ba'i rtsa ba ka pi ta/ /pa ta swa ti ⑧ka'i tshod ma/ /shu sha la la phud dang ni/ /kar ka ru dang sring gi ni/ /yang na cir bi ⑨ta yang rung / /u po ta ka dzi ban ⑩ti//ba gu rtse dang rgya sne'u dang / /lcam pa'am yang na e raṇa dang ⑪/ /lo ni ka yi khu ba dang / /rus sbal bye'u lo ba ka /rma bya sreg pa khyim bya yi/ /sha khu dang yang sbyin par bya/ /bil ba gla sgang ba ru ra/ /bca' sga da ta ⑫ka'i me tog /dar ba bskol ba'i ⑫nas thug gam/ /zho dang sbyar bas ④'khru ba sel//ka pid ta ⑫dang ka tsu ra/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba yu ti dang / /n+ya gro dha dang rdo dreg dang / /se 'bru so ma ra ⑩bal dang / /shal ma li yi lo ma phan/ /bil ba gzhon nu'i lde gu dang / /til btags lde gu'ang de dang mnyam/ /zho yi spris ⑩skyur snum bcas dang / /sbyar dug mkhregs ⑫pa 'joms par byed/ /'u su zi ra na le sham/ /da trig zur pa kha ru tsha/ /se ⑪'bru pa ta da ta ⑫ki/ /'bras gsum cha lnga ka pi ta/ /nas tshig 'khus thal la la phud/ /a mra 'dzam 111—503

bu'i 'bras bu'i rkang / /bil ba drug 'gyur lde gur btags/ /zho dang bu ram muṅga'i khu/ /til mar mar dang g.yos pa dag /gzhan gyis mi thub sbyar thug ①'di/ /drod skyed smin byed 'khru ba gcod/ /yi ga 'byed cing mkhregs ⑦pa sel/ /rgya shug bil ba gzhon nu yi④/ /lde gu 'bras dang nas dang ni/ /mud ga ma sha til rnams dang / /'bru yi yu shar rnam par btags④/ /bshang ba zad cing kha skam la/ /zho dang se 'bru'i khu ba dang / /mar dang til mar lhan cig brngos/ /'bras chan de dang sbyar ba ni/ /bshang zad kha ni skam la sbyin—/ /yang na zho spris snum gnyis brngos/ /bu ram bca' sgar ⑤bcas pa sbyin / /yang na chang ni snum gnyis brngos/ /tshod ma'i don rjodu sbyin pa 'am/ /'bras bu skyur po snum gnyis brngos/ /sgog pa las ⑦byas yu sha 'am/ /snum gnyis dang brngos phye zan ni/ /tsha ba gsum gyi phye btab sbyin/ /de bzhin ma sha legs btsos pa/ /mar gyi snying po blud ⑧pa 'am/ /ra thug lug thug dag gi sha /btsos te btsags pa'i khu ba dang / /se ⑨'bru'i khu ba'i chu dang ni/ /'u su dong gra ⑩snum bcas bskol/ /sā ⑪lu rtsa snar bcas pa ni/ /za zhing de nyid 'thungs pa yis/ /rtug pa zad pa las byung ba'i/ /nad las myur du thar bar 'gyur/ /bu ram til mar bil ba gzhon/ /pi pi ling dang bca' sga yi/ /lde gus rlung gis gnod gyur pa'i/ /gzer thabs mkhregs ⑫dang bcas pa sel/ /seng phrom shun lpags da ta ⑫ka'i/ /me tog rgya shug 'dab ma rnams—/ /zho spris sbrang rtsi ka pi ta'i/ /khu bar sbyar ba blud na phan/ /rlung gis rtug 'gags shas cher ni/ /na zhing mkhregs par byed pa dang / /be snabs khrag bcas skom gdungs la/ /'o ma tshim par blud na phan/ /til mar 111—504

mar gyi steng du ni/ /bzhos ma thag pa'i 'o ma blud/ /yang na a raṇ+ḍa yi rtsa 'am①//bil ba gzhon nu bskol ba blud/ /gla sgang nyi shu 'o ma yi/ /sum 'gyur gyi ni chu bskol ba/ /'khru ba gzer bcas sel bar byed/ /pi pi ling dang ②na le sham—/ /zhib du ①btags pa'i phye dang sbyin/ /des ④ni yun ring ⑤gnas pa yi| /mkhregs rjopa sel bar byed par 'gyur/ /ma zhu med cing gzer gyis nyen| /sgyung ba la sogs pas nyams smad/ /khong rtsub me drod brtags nas ni| /mar ni thal sman rno bcas sbyin/ /yang na rtsa ba bcu ⑦bskol chu/ /zho dang chang gi dwangs mar bskol/ /byu myang tsha dang tsha ba lnga/ /til mar 'phral du nad 'joms byed/ /bca' sga srang drug pi pi ling / /rū ⑧la kru trug tres rgyam tsha/ /srang gnyis til mar bre gang dang / /zho dang bskol ba'i til mar ni/ /'khru ba'i nad ni sel byed yin/ /sha dang 'o ma ⑨mar phyogs gcig /btung dang 'jam rtsi bsku ba ru/ /til mar 'ba' zhig phyogs gcig sbyar/ /bshang mkhregs gzer ni 'joms byed yin/ /de ni rlung sel mchog yin la/ /rlung 'khrugs ⑩ma gtogs gzer mi 'byung / /khams gzhan 'joms pas 'bar gyur pa/ /rlung ni rang gnas brten khyab byed⑪/ /me drod chung la til mar ni/ /sbyar bas bde bar byed pa'i mchog /til mar bcas pa rlung gnas su/ /mkhregs pa gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /dri ma zad cing nad gzhan rang gi ni/ /gnas las 'phos pas rlung ni stobs che ba/ /khong pa gzer zhing mkhregs ⑫par byed pa la/ /phyi nang til mar ma ⑫btang su zhig 'tsho/ /gzhang na ⑫'byung bar gyur pa la/ /'o mar bskol ba'i mar rgya shug /skyur po ⑫tsang gi ri'i khu ba/ /zho dang dong grar ⑩btags pa blud/ /sgyur ba de nyid 111—505

bcug pa dang / /'u su na le sham zi ra/ /kha ru tsha dang tsha ba lnga/ /se ①'bru dag dang sbyar ba ni/ /zhib tu btags pa'i lde gu phan/ /rtsa ba bcu pa bskol ba yi/ /zur ba shu ti ru rta 'am/ /shu dag tsi tra ka bskol ②ba'i/ /snum gyi 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya/ /mkhregs ③dang gzhad ni 'byung ba dang / /gcin sri rked pa na ba dang ④/ /mngar dang skyur bar bskol ba yi/ /mar ram til mar 'jam rtsi gtang / /gzhang 'byung ⑤gzhug pa dka' rjob la/ /bsku zhing dugs ni 'jam byas gzhug /dbus su phug pa'i pags pa ni/ /'ur mthil ⑦'ching ba dag kyang bya/ /rtsa ba lnga ni ⑧chen po yi/ /khu ba dang ni 'o mar bskol/ /byi ⑨ba rgyu ma bton pas kyang / /rlung 'joms lde gu lta bur ⑩bya//til mar bskol gzhang 'byung ba la/ /btung dang bsku bas de gso bya/ /mkhris pa ma zhu rno dang dro/ /spangs la sngon bzhin sgyung ba bya/ /skom bcas ⑪yan lag drug pa'i chu/ /rtswa mkhris thal tros bcas pa blud/ /bkres na kha zas thug pa sogs/ /bri ha ti ⑫sogs nye'u shing pa⑫/ /ba la rnam ⑫gnyis paṇi gnyis/ /bskol ba drod skyed byed pa phan/ /blud kyang rjes su 'brel gyur na—/ /dug mo nyung shun 'bras bu dang / /bong nga dkar po bcas btags phye/ /sbrang rtsi bsres pa 'bras chu blud/ /ba tha ⑩dug mo nyung shun 'bras/ /skyer pa pi pi ling rtsa 'am/ /bong nga bil ba dug mo nyung / /gla sgang ba le ⑩ka bskol ba'am—/ /yang na bong nga dkar ⑩mur ba/ /skyer pa dngul rdo dug mo nyung / /bong nga bca' sga dug mo nyung / /gla sgang kad pal ⑫sbrang rtsir bcas/ /dug mo nyung gi sa bon ni/ /srang gcig bskol ba'i khu ba blud/ /gang zhig sha khu bcas sbyar za/ /mkhris bcas lto ba'i nad sel 'gyur/ /de bzhin gla sgang 111—506

bskol ba'i khu/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba blud pas phan/ /shal ma li yi 'dab ma'i rtsa| /bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa 'am/ /rtsa mkhris gla sgang dug mo nyung / /skyer khaṇ+ḍa dang bcas pa 'am/ /yang na skyer pa ba le ka /bil ba'i rkang dang byi tsher ba/ /til dang seng phrom mon cha ra①/ /btsod dang pad+ma ut+pal④/ /dong gra da ta sneka'i me tog /se ④'bru'i shun pa ut+pal bcas/ /tshigs bcad phyed kyis bshad sbyor ba/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'bras chu ⑤blud/ /skyer pa seng phrom dug mo nyung / /sug smel bskol bas rjosmin 'khru sel/ /seng phrom dang ni a brta/ /pri yang ku sogs sde tshan dang / /bskol ba so sor ⑦blud de bzhin/ /pu tse ⑧shel dang shing mngar dang / /se ⑨'bru'i myu gu pri ⑩yang ku/ /zho dang 'u su'i 'bras bur bcas/ /thug pa lde gus sbyar dugs ⑪bya//de bzhin bil ba ka pid ⑫tha/ /a mra 'dam bu'i rkang las sbyar/ /smin pa'i khu bar ra'i 'o ma/ /mchog tu phan te des kyang ni/ /stobs ldan nad gzhi che ba'i phyir/ /ma zhi na ni bkru sman gtang / / rim kyis ⑫bshang ba khrag dag tu/ /gang zhig 'khru bar gyur pa la'ang / /pa la sha yi 'bras bu yi/ /khu ba dang sbyar 'o ma blud/ /de nas 'o ma dro 'jam tsam/ /nyams stobs ji bzhin blud par bya/ /des ⑫ni dri ma bsal bas na/ /lto yi nad ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /kyi ⑫lce ba yi sbyang ba yang / /pa la sha ltar sbyor ba bya/ /thug sogs rim pa byas kyang ni/ /gal te gzer ni ma zhi na/ /nyes bsal de la me drod stobs/ /las dpags 'jam rtsi myur du gtang / /sha ta put+pa nye shing dang / /bil ba dang ni shing mngar dag /mar 'o til mar bzhi char bcas/ /bskol ba 'jam rtsi'i sman mar yin/ /des ni tsha 'khru ma zhi na/ /spyi ⑩bag 'jam rtsi 111—507

mchog tu phan/ /shal ma li yi lo ma rlon/ /ku sha zlon pas dkris nas ni/ /sa nag lde gu bskus nas su/ /lci ba skam po'i me nang bsregs①/ /'jim pa lus pa de bkog ste/ /gong po de las srang gcig tsam/ /'o ma bre gang nang du mnye—/ /btsags la dwangs ②mar rgya spos dang / /shing mngar sbrang rtsi lde gu ④mar / /til mar ldan pas 'jam rtsi bya/ /khrus byas 'o ④ma 'bras chan sbyin/ /yang na skam sa'i sha khu sbyin/ /mkhris pa'i tshad ⑤'khru rims dang 'or nad skran//rlung nad khrag dang pho ba'i nad sel zhing / /'di dag rjobakru sman mas gtong drag po yi/ /sbyor byas drag tu 'byung ba'ang myur zhi byed/ /dug mo nyung ni bu ram phran/ /ltar bskol dug mo nyung sogs sde/ /a ⑦brta sogs sbrang rtsir bcasaske/ /sde gus 'khru ba thams cad sel/ /smin cing nad med me drod che/ /khrag dang bcas pa skering nas 'khru/ /sna tshogs mdog tu 'khru 'gyur ba/ /sman thum ⑨btsos pa sbyar bar bya/ / kad pa ⑩la yi shun lde gu/ /bil ba'i lo mas dkris nas ni/ /'jim pas bskus te ⑪me nang bsregs⑫/ /khu ba bcir la ⑫bsgrangs pa ni/ /sbrang rtsi'am kha rar ⑩bcas pa ru/ /'khru ba can la ci rigs blud/ /de bzhin 'o ma can shing kun⑫/ /de yi myu gu las kyang bya/ / 'khri shing shun ⑩pa mar dang bcas/ /bskol ba'i rlangs pas btsos pa ni/ /sbrang rtsi bcas pa tsha 'khru ba/ /stobs can drag tu 'byung ba'ang sel/ /mkhris pa'i 'khru ba can gyis ni/ /mkhris pa skyed byed gang bsten pa/ /de yis ⑩mkhris pa 'khrugs gyur nas/ /khrag gi tshad 'khru skom dad rims/ /'debs shing gzhang kha mi bzad 'drul/ /pad+ma ut+pal sa mang ga /mon cha ⑫ra sa bskol ba yi/ /ra yi 'o ma de la phan/ /thal tres shing mngar seng phrom mam /111—508

n+ya gro dha sogs myu gu dang / /sbrang rtsi kha rar ①bcas pa ni/ /btung ba'am gzhang khar blugs pas ②phan/ /de bzhin sha khya sogs skyon ①med/ /mar bcas bsgrangs pa'i ④zas skom phan/ /tang pal 'bras bu'i khu ba ni/ /cung zad skyur zhing ka rar bcas/ /ra yi 'o ma chu phyed dang / /ut+pal dong gra ba le ka /kṛṇ+ḍa ⑤paṇi khu bar bcas/ /thug pas rjokhrag gi tshad 'khru sel/ /zas kyi sngon du mar sar ni/ /sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar ba bldag /khrag 'khru tshabs che la ra 'am/ /ri dwags khrag gi mar brngos sbyin/ /'o ma dang bza' 'o ma btung / /'o ma bsrubs ⑦mar zhag gsum bsten/ /yang na gong ma sreg gi ni/ /sha khu dang zos nad med 'gyur/ /nye shing btags pa 'o ma dang / /lhan cig blud cing 'o mar bza'/ /yang na de dang bskol ba yi/ /mar gyis tshad 'khru myur du sel/ /rgya skyegs bca' sga pi pi t+pang / /skyer pa'i shun pa pu tse shel/ /dug mo nyung dang bcas bskol mar/ /thug sla thug pa dang sbyar bas//nad gzhi gsum las byung ba yi/ /mi zad ⑧'khru ba'ang myur du sel/ /sa nag dung dang shing mngar dang / /sbrang rtsi ra khrag 'bras chu ⑨blud/ /khrag gis ⑩'khru ba sel bar byed/ /pri yang ku dang sbrang rtsi'ang phan/ /til nag btags pa'i sde gu dang / /sha kha ra ni cha lnga ni/ /ra yi 'o ma ⑪sbyar ba blud/ /'phral du khrag tu 'khru ba sel/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi tsan+dan bcas/ /'bras kyi chu dang blud na ni| /khong tsha skom dang gcin nad dang / /khrag tu 'khru las thar bar 'gyur / /gzhang kha tsha zhing 'drul ba la/ /bsil ba'i sman gyis blugs shing bskurka/ /gang tshe yang dang yang du 'khru/ /khrag nyung gzer dang bcas par 'khru| /rlung gis gags ni byas gyur pas/ /ska bas 'byung ba'am ⑫mi 'byung 111—509

byed / /de tshe de la spyi ①bag ni/ /'jam rtsi sngar bshad gtang bar bya/ / kar bu ②da ra shing sha pa/ /la sogs lo ⑦ma cham chom brdungs/ /nas dang bskol ba'i khu ba dedhi/ /mar dang 'o ma bcas par bskol/ /spyi ⑤bag 'jam rtsi btang na rjoni/ /be+e snabs 'khru dang gzhang 'byung dang / /mkhregs ⑦pa'i nad rnams sel byed cing / /skem po stobs ni skyed par byed/ /stag tsher ba dang bskol ba yi/ /mar gyi 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya/ /dang por bshang ba khrag 'dres 'byung / /yang na phyis ni 'khru gyur pa/ /de la nye ⑧shing bskol ba'i mar/ /lde gu'i don du sbyar bar bya/ /kha ra cha phyed dang sbyar la/ /sbrang rtsi bzhi cha bcug pa yi/ /mar sar phan pa'i zas zos na/ /nad de ⑨myur du sel bar 'gyur/ /u dum wā ra ⑩n+ya go dha/ /a shwaṅga ⑪yi myu gu ni/ /brdungs te zhag gcig chu nang sbangs/ /mnyes te btsags par mar bskol la/ /kha ra de yi phyed ⑫btab cing / /sbrang rtsi bzhi cha btab ste blud/ /gang zhig khrag ni thur du 'am/ /gyen du 'byung bar byed la sbyin/ /bad kan 'khru ba rlung bshad pa'i/ /ma zhu smin bya mchog tu bya/ /rjes su 'brel pa de la ni/ /bil ba gzhon nu gla sgang dang / /a ru ra dang bca' sga bskol/ /smin ⑫cing me drod skyed pa blud/ /shu dag dong gra byi dang ga⑩/ bu ti ⑫ka dang thang shing dang ⑩/ /pi pi ling gnyis kru trug tres/ /pi pi ling gi rtsa ba 'am/ /pa ta ⑩tsi tra dug mo nyung / /shu dag pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /pu tse shel dang a ru ra/ /bskol ba'am yang na btags pa sbyin/ /bad kan tshad par 'khru sman ⑫blud/ /kha ru tsha dang tsha ba gsum/ /shu dag shing kun bong nga dkar/ /a ru ra yi chu tshan bcas/ /bad kan 'khru bas nyen la blud/ /ka pid ta ⑪yi rkang dang ni/ /111—510

tsha gsum sbrang rtsi sha kha ra'am/ / kad pha ①la dang sbrang rtsir bcas/ /lto yi nad ni sel byed yin/ /pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir bcas/ /tsi tra ka dang dar bar bcas / /bil ba gzhon nu byin na yang / /'khru ba'i nad ni sel bar byed/ /pa ta gla sgang mon cha ②ra/ /be+el ba dong gra da ta 1ka'am/ /bu ram dar bar rjobacas pa yis/ /'khru ba shin tu gso dka' 'ang sel pi pi ling rtsa la la phud / /dri bzang bzhi dang dong gra dang / /na le sham dang kru trug tres/ /'u su zi ra ba le ⑤ka /kha ru tsha rnams cha mnyam dhidang / /da trig dang ni da ta ⑦ki /bil ba dang ni pi pi ling / /se ⑧'bru dang ni la la phud/ /sum 'gyur ka ra drug 'gyur dang / /ka pid ta ⑨ni brgyad 'gyur byas/ /phye mas tshad 'khru pho ba'i nad/ /zad byed skran dang lkog ma'i nad/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde drod nyams/ /gzhang 'brum cham pa yig 'chus sel/ /smig ⑩rkang dang ni dri sna bzhi/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis la la phud/ /'u su zi ra zho bzhi bzhi/ /pi pi ling rtsa tsha ba gsum/ /srang ni re re se ⑩'bru dang / /kha ra srang brgyad gcig ⑫sbyar 'di/ /bye ma se ⑫'bru brgyad pa yin/ /yon tan gong ma dag dang 'dra/ /kha zas rlung gis 'khru bar bshad/ /sbyar thug la sogs ci rigs sbyin / /na le sham dang bye dang ga /ka pid ta ⑫dang dong grar bcas/ /tsang gi ri dang rgya shug skyur/ /sbyar thug ⑩bad kan 'khru ba sel/ /bad kan zad la sngar bshad pa'i/ /rgya skyegs la sogs srang drug pa/ /nas thug dang ni bsres pa yi/ /mar ni rnying pa sbyin par bya/ /rlung dang bad kan gyis bkag parka/ /bad kan shas cher 'khru ba 'am/ /gzer zhing mkhregs ⑫par byed pa la/ /spyi ⑩bag 'jam rtsi bsngags pa yin/ /shu dag bil ba pi pi ling / /ru rta shu ti 111—511

rgyam tshar bcas/ /bil ba'i mar ram til mar ni/ /shu dag sogs dang bskol ba gtang / /bad kan rlung gis shas cher gzer①/ /cung zad dro ba'i 'jam rtsi gtang / /bad kan zad cing yun ring du/ /'khru zhing nyam ②chung gyur pa na/ /rlung ni nges par stobs che ba①/ /rang gi gnas na brten de skye/ /de stobs che bas 'phral gsod byed/ /de phyir de ni myur du gso/ /rlung gi rjes la mkhris pa ste / /mkhris pa'i rjes la bad kan ni/ /gso ba'am gsum las dang po ④ni/ /gang zhig shas cher gyur pa gso/ /'jigs dang mya ngan dag las kyang / /myur du 'khrugs pas de phyir der/ /rlung bsal ba yi gso ba dang / /dbugs dbyung ba dang dga' bar bya/ /gang zhig gcin med phyi sa dang / /'phyen ⑤ni 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / /me drod che zhing lto ba yang / /de yi khong nad zhi ba yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas las le'u dgu pa'o// //de nas pho ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /pho ba la ni brten pa'i nad/ /ma zhu ba ltar gso bar bya/ /'khru bar bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /de yi ma zhu smin par bya/ /zas kyi dus su nad dug rjosogs/ /tsha ba lnga sogs ldan pa dang / /tsha bro yang ba'i kha zas dang / /gzhan yang drod skyed sbyor ba sbyin—/ /ma zhur thug pa bong nga dkar/ /bca' sga skyur dang bcas pa sbyin/ /btung bar 'khru ba las bshad pa'i/ /chu dang dar ba chang sogs blud/ /pho ba'i nad la dar ba ni/ /drod skyed 'khru gcod yang bas na/ /phan te zhu rjes mngar ba'i phyir/ /mkhris pa skyed par mi byed do/ /bska zhing dro la sbyong byed 111—512

dang / /rtsub cing ①bad kan la yang phan/ /mngar skyur kha bas rlung la phan/ /bsrubs ma thag tu tsha mi skyed/ /skyur ba bzhi po bre gang dang / /tsha ba gsum ni srang gsum dang / /rgya tsha srang bzhi kha ra ni/ /srang brgyad phye mar byas pa ni②/ /tshod ma sran tshod btung ba sogs/ /btung ngo drug sogs la yang gdab/ /ma zhu lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /yi ga 'chus dang skran mchin pa/ /pho ba ④snying nad skya rbab 'joms/ /dong gra gla sgang bong nga dkar/ /bskol ba ma zhu sel byed blud/ /de yi lde gu chu tshan nam/ /bca' sga'am a ru ra bcas blud/ /shu dag la sogs rgyam tshar bcas/ /yang na chang dang sbyar ba blud/ /bshang ba ma smin 'khru bcas la/ /se ④'bru'i chu dang bcas pa yi/ /bil ba dong gra ⑤tsi tra ka /kha ru tsha ni btab ༷pa sbyin/ /bad kan rlung gyur be snabs can/ /khong pa gzer la dug mo nyung / / shing kun ⑦bong nga kha ru tsha/ /shu dag a ru ra chu dron/ /skyugs ⑧pa'i rjes la gzer zhing bsgongs⑨/ /a ru ra dang kha ru tsha—/ /zi ra na le sham bcas phye/ /chu dron dang ni bcas pa ⑩blud/ /dong gra pa ta pi pi ling / /thal tres bri ⑪ha ti gnyis dang / /dug mo nyung dang tsi tra ka /tsha ba rnam lnga thal sman gnyis/ /phyer btags chang zho de'i dwangs ma/ /chu dron rang skyur dag la ⑫blud/ /des ni me drod 'phel byed cing / /khong pa'i rlung ni sel mchog yin/ /lan tshwa lnga dang thal sman gnyis/ /tsha ba lnga dang na le sham/ /la la phud dang shing kun las/ /skyur rtsi chen po'am se 'bru 'am—/ /rgya shug khu bas ri lu ⑫byas/ /smin dang drod skyed byed mchog yin/ /bal bu'i lo ma dbyi mo dang / /pi pi ling ni srang re dang / /pi pi ling dang de rtsa srang / /gnyis gnyis bca' sga srang gsum dang / /dri sna gsum ⑫dang pu 111—513

shel tse/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis byer zhib btags/ /bu ram sum 'gyur dag gis ni/ / ri lu ①byas pa rtag tu bza'/ /de rjes yu sha sha khu dang khru/ /chang rnying 'o ma zho ga ①chu/ /thug pa blud na rlung dang ni/ /bad kan las gyur slon bro dang / /pho ba ④rtsib logs snying ga na/ /rims dang 'or nad skya rbab dang / /skran dang chang nad gzhang 'brum dang / /cham pa mchil ma dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa rnams ni 'joms par byed/ /bshang ba 'gags la de nyid ni//bca' sga'i gong du ⑤a ru ra/ /bcug ste de la sbyin par bya/ /mkhris gyur slon bro la sogs la/ /kha ra bzhi 'gyur bcas pa rjoni/ /bskol ba las ni ri lur byas⑦/ /yang na bu ram kha rar bcas⑧/ /me dang 'phrad ⑨par gyur pa lasaske/ /de ni mchog tu yang bar ⑩'gyur/ /de nas ⑪'di ni ma zhu smin/ /rlung las gyur pa'i pho nad la/ /drod skyed sman dang bcas pa dang / /mar ni nyung zad nyung zad blud/ /me drod chung zhing skyes gyur nas/ /bshang gci rlung ni 'gags gyur na/ /zhag ni gnyis gsum snum btang dugs/ /bsku byas mas gtong drag po bya/ /de nas e raṇ+ḍa yi mar⑫/ /seng phrom gyi ni mar dang ni—/ /thal sman dag gis rlung zhi nas/ /g.yos pa'i nad la bkru sman gtang / /sbyangs nas khong pa rtsub gyur ⑫te/ /bshang ba 'gags la 'jam rtsi ni/ /drod skyed skyur zhing rlung 'joms pa'i/ /sman btsos til mar de la gtang / /de ltar bkru sman drag bkru sman/ /'jam rtsi cho ga bzhin byas la⑫/ /kha zas yang ba dang ldan pa'i/ /zhun mar slar yang bsten par bya/ /rtsa ba lnga dang tsha ba gsum / /a ru ra dang lce myang tsha/ /ra sna pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /thal sman ⑫rnam gnyis zi ⑩ra dang / / bye dang ga ⑩dang zur pa mar/ /tsha dang skyur rtsi 111—514

chen po yi/ /khu ba dang ni sge'u gsher dang / /la phug skam po rgya shug skyur/ /se 'bru tsug kri ①ka'i khu ba/ /dar ba zho dang chang dwangs dang / /rtsab mo dwangs ma rtsab mo dang / /skyur rtsabs ②/dang ni de bskol ba/ /me drod skyed pa'i dam pa yin/ /gzer dang skran dang dmu rdzing dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba dang / /rlung dang bad kan 'joms par byed/ /yang na skyur rtsi chen po yi/ /khu bar ①bskol ba'i mar blud bya/ /'di yi butil mar bskol ba yis—/ /bsku byug byas na rlung sel to/ /rlung dang bad kan ma 'dres rjozhu'am—/ /bad kan rlung shas che ba la⑥/ /sman ni dze+e'adi dag nyid kyi phye/ /chu dron sbyar ba blud par bya/ /mkhris pas me drod nyams gyur pa/ /bkru sman dag gam slon sman gtang / /kha dang yang dang ⑧'khru gcod dang / /tsha mi skyed pas drod bskyed bya/ /phye ma snum dang kha ba yis⑨ / /me drod nye bar bskyed par bya/ /pa to la dang kyi lce ba/ /nim pa pu tse shel rtsa mkhris/ /par pa ta dang dug mo nyung / /shun lpags 'bras bu mur ba dang / / shi kru mngar ⑩po'i 'bras bu dang / /shu dag skyer pa'i shun lpags dang ⑩/ /shug pa dang ni pu shel tse/ /tsan+dan gla sgang la la phud/ /sa nag bong nga tsha ba gsum/ /shing tsha sug smel thang shing dang / /garnya bha dra'i ⑫phye ma ni/ /sbrang rtsi'i lde gur byas bza' ba'am/ /chang ngam chu dang sbyar 'thungs na/ /snying nad skya rbab pho ba'i nad—/ /skran gzer rims nad ⑫yi ga 'chus/ /mig ser 'dus pa'i nad dang ni/ /kha yi ④nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /rtsa mkhris gla sgang pu tse shel//tsha ba gsum dang dug mo nyung / /tsi tra ka ni cha gnyis dang / /dug mo nyung gi shun lpags ni/ /bcu drug cha sbyar zhib tu btags/ /de ni bu ram chu grang 111—515

blud—/ /pho ba'i nad dang skran sel zhing / /mig ser skya rbab rims kyi nad/ /yi ga 'chus dang 'khru ba 'joms/ /dong gra ①bong nga gla sgang dang / /pa ta bil ba skyer khaṇ+ḍa①/ /dug mo nyung gi sa bon dang / /tig ta da ta dze+eka'i me tog /phye mar btags la rjosbrang rtsir sbyar/ /'bras bkrus ⑤chu dang blud na ni—/ /mkhris pa las gyur pho ba'i nad/ / mkhregs 'khrugs rjogazhang 'brum gzhang kha na/ /khrag tu 'khru ba dag la'ang phan/ /tsan+dan shug pa pu shel tse/ /pa ta mur ba bla ⑦ba dang / /shu dag thal tres dbye mo dang / /lo ma bdun pa ba sha ka /pa to la dang n+ya go dha/ /u dum wā ra a shwat+tha⑧/ /be+eg sha ka pi ta ⑨na dang / /pu tse shel dang li ga dur/ /nim pa srang ni gnyis gnyis la/ /chu bra bcu drug bskol ba der/ /ki ra tig ta dug mo nyung / /ram nye ut+pal ⑩pi pi ling / /bskol ba de 'thungs mkhris pa yi/ /pho ba'i nad la blud par bya/ /mjer bshad tig ta'i mar yang blud/ /bad kan las gyur pho ba'i nad/ /slon sman rnon pos slon byas nas/ /tsha sgyur lan tshwa thal sman gyis/ /rim gyis me drod skyed par byed⑪/ /tsha ba lnga dang a ru ra/ /'u su pa ta pa la sha /sgyur rtsi chen po'i myu gu dang / /bskol ba'i thug pa la sogs blud/ /ma du ka yi me tog bre/ /bcu drug bye dang ga ⑩de'i phyed/ /tsi tra ka ni de phyed dang / /bse shing 'bras bu bre bzhi dang / /btsod srang brgyad de ⑫'di dag ni/ /chu bre ④sum cu rtsa gnyis bskol/ /chu bye bcu drug lus bsgrangs ⑫par/ /sbrang rtsi bye do gzhug pa dang / /sug smel pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / /a kar tsan+dan lde gu byug /bum par zla ⑩ba gcig gzhag ste/ /langs nas mnan chang ⑩blud gyur na/ /'di yis pho ba'i drod skyed cing / /nyams brtas khrag mkhris sel bar byed/ /111—516

skems dang mdze dang sha bkra dang / /gci ①snyi ba yi nad rnams 'joms ma du ka yi me tog ni/ /khu ba bskol ba phyed ②du ba/ /bsgrangs par dze+esbrang rtsi bzhi cha btab/ /snga ma bzhin du byas pa'i chang / /phan pa'i zas dang bcas bsten na/ /pho ba'i nad ni thams cad sel/ /de bzhin rgun 'bru ④bu ram shing / /'bra go'i khu ba mnan ⑤pa blud/ /shing kun shu dag pu tse shel/ /bong nga pa ta dug mo nyung / /gze ma tsha ba lnga po zho/ /gnyis gnyis lan tshwa lnga srang re/ /mar dang til mar phul do do/ /zho bye gnyis dang bsres nas ni/ /me ni chung ngu la btsos ste/ /rnying zhing khu ba thim pa dang / /de nas du ba 'khyims par bsregarjo /btags te mar dang bsres pa dag /de las zho gnyis 'thungs nas ni/ /zhu nas ⑦kha zas mngar zos na/ /des ni bad kan rlung nad ni/ /kun dang dug dang dbyig dug 'joms/ /rtswa mkhris dang ni pu tse shel/ /pa to nim pa par pa ⑧ta/ /bsregs la ma he'i gcin dang ni/ /'thungs na me drod skyed ⑨byed yin/ /shu dag ru rta ser po gnyis/ /tsi tra ka dang pu tse shel/ /gla sgang ra yi gcin dang ni/ /bskol ba me drod skyed⑩ byed yin//su ta'i sdong bu srang bzhi dang / /lan tshwa gsum las srang re dang / /par ta ka ni phul gang dang / /arka ⑪srang brgyad tsi tra ka /srang gnyis bsregs la par ta ka'i/ /khu bas ri lu ⑫byas nas ni/ /zas rjes zos na zos pa'i zas/ /myur du lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /gzhang 'brum gsud dang cham pa dang / /snying ⑫nad des ni zhi bar byed/ /kha lud zur pa ra sna dang / /tsha ba gsum dang a ru ra/ /nas tshig 'khus thal swardzi tsu)ka'i/ /thal sman lan tshwa lnga po rnams/ /phyer btags dro 'jam chu dang blud/ /mdog stobs me drod 'phel byed yin/ /111—517

bad kan las gyur ①pho ba'i nad/ /rlung bcas de la mar dang bskol/ /thang la 'bar ②dang srang drug pa/ /de bzhin go bye'i sman mar blud/ /kha ru tsha dang tsha nag dang / /bul tog dang ni swardzi ①ka /nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang / /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri rjosab ta la/ /tsi tra ka ni gcig tu bsreg⑤ /lan bdun bar du gzags rjopa yi/ /thal khu bre do mar bre bzhi/ /bskol la me drod bskyed phyir blud/ /'dus pa las ni lnga po dang / /'di dag nyams stobs ji bzhin bya/ /bad kan mchil mang drod chung la/ /kha rtsub me drod skyed par sbyar/ /bad kan las byung skems pa la/ /snum dang rtsub pa res kyis bsten—/ /nyam chung rid pa'i lus la ni/ /me drod skyed pa ⑦snum ldan sbyin/ /mkhris pa shas che'i drod nyams la/ /kha dang mngar ba ⑧ldan pa sbyin/ /rlung shas che la snum skyur dang / /lan tshwar ⑨ldan pa bsngags pa yin/ /rid pa me drod skyed pa la/ /snum nyid mchog tu shes par bya/ /snum shas che bar gyur pa la—/ /rab lci'i zas kyang sbyin mi bya/ /gang zhig drod chung bad kan zad/ /bshang ba ⑩smin kyang sla ba la/ /de la sman rnor bcas pa yi/ /mar ni nyung zad blud par bya/ /de yis me dang mnyam gnas rlung / /rang gnas bkug ste rang gi ni/ /las la sbyor bas ⑪drod skyed byed/ /de ni me drod skyed byed yin/ /gang zhig bshang ba sra ba yis/ / dka' bas ⑫'byen par byed pa dag /de la lan tshwa bcas pa'i mar/ /zas ni sla bar byed pa sbyin/ /rtsub pas me drod chung la mar/ /yang na til mar drod skyed blud/ /snum mang 'thungs pas drod nyams la/ /thal sman phye ma chang rnying sbyar/ /rtug 'gags pa la mas gtong ba'i—/ /drag po dang ni 'jam rtsi bya/ /nad tshab ⑫che bas me drod nyams/ /111—518

sbyang byas zas kyi cho ga spyad/ /nad byang me drod chung ba la/ /zhun mar 'ba' zhig drod ①skyed byed②/ /lam dang sgyung bas nyam skechung la/ /nas thug mar dang sbyar ba 'am/ /zas bcas blud na stobs skyed cing / /drod skyed brta bar byed pa yin/ /yun ringasalgenyal po spyad pa dang / /mi ni nyamasnyechung skem gyur la/ /mthu rtsal can gyis dhizas tshol ba/ /sha za'i sha khu skyur sbyar sbyin/ /yang zhing dro tsha sbyong byed pa/ /de yis me drod myur du skyed/ /sha yis skyed pa'i sha yin phyir/ /stobs ni mchog tu skyed par byed/ /snum dang mnan chang chang rnying dang / /sman khu phye ma 'phrod pa zos/ /lus la legs par sbyar ba yis/ /stobs dang me drod 'phel bar byed/ /dper na me ni shing sra bas/ /sbar ba yun ring gnas par byed/ /de bzhin khong par gnas pa'i me/ /snum dang bcas pas brtan par gnas/ /ji ltar me ni shing med pa'am⑦/ /me chung shing ni drags pa ltar/ /lus me zas ni ma zos pa/ /zas drags gyur pas 'bar mi byed/ /gang tshe bad kan zad mkhris pa/ /rang gi gnas su rlung zhugs na| /me drod 'phel zhing rab rgyas 'gyur/ /de tshe me ni rlung bcas pas/ /zas smin byas nas lus zungs kyang / /zad cing mdangs 'thor byed pas gsod//zas zos nas ni bde 'gyur la/ /zhu nas mun zhugs snyam sems 'gyur/ /skom dad tsha brgyal dbugs mi bde/ /la sogs me drod drags las 'byung / /zas byu snum sla ⑧rtul ba dang / /grang dang 'ju dka' me drod 'bri/ /'bar ba'i me la chu blugs ltar/ /me drod shas cha stide zhi bya/ /de nas ⑩kha zas ma zhu la'ang / /yang dang yang du zas sbyin bya/ /bud shing med pa'i skabs rnyed ltar//ji gnas ⑪'dir gnas ⑫mi 'gyur bya/ /kri sa ra dang 'o thug snum/ /snum 111—519

khur bu ram g.yos pa dang / /rlan can chu yi srog chags ni/ /tsho ba yi ni sha sbyin no/ /mchog tu nya ni 'jam po dang / /mi 'gul chu la gnas pa sbyin/ /lug sha tshon po dag kyang ni/ /zos na me drod drags pa sel/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi bcas pa 'am/ /mar dang sbyar ba ①skom tshe blud/ /gro yi phye ni 'o ma dang / /mar ni mang por bcas pa blud/ /rlan can srog chags sha khu dang / /til mar ma gtogs snum can blud/ /sha ma dur byid dang bskol ba'i/ /'o ma'i bkru sman blud par bya/ /mkhris pa sel ba'i kha zas dang / /'o thug lan mang sbyin par bya/ /gang zhig byu zhing tshil skyed dang / /bad kan skyed pa'i kha zas rnams/ /thams cad me drod drags ④la phan/ /zos nas nyin par nyal bar bya1/ /zas ni me drod kyis 'ju byed/ /zas med nas ni nad zad byed/ /lus zungs zad par byed par 'gyur/ /lus zungs zad nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zas 'di dag ni rang bzhin gyis mi ④mthun/ /'di ni sbyor dang g.yos kyis mi 'phrod pa/ /de la sogs pa me ⑤shes ci dga' b.raske/ /spyod de me drod stobs las gyur pa yinarjo/ /de bas 'bad pa ⑦kun gyis me drod bsrung ⑧/ /de nyams na ni mi ⑨yi srog nyes nyams/ /nyes pas khyab na nad kyi ⑩tshogs kyis 'debs/ /me drod mnyam na nad med tshe ring 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u bcu pa'o// //de nas gcin 'gags pa'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /rlung las gyur pa'i gcin sri latu〉/ /rlung 'joms til mar gyis lus bsku/ /lte ba man chad 111—520

dugs bya zhing / /rlan dugs lus ni spying ①ba'ang bya/ /rtsa ba bcu pa e raṇ+ḍa/ /ba la nas dang nye shing pa/ /ba spru ba dang ku laza/ /rgya shug dang ni ba ru ②ra/ /sru sru'i rtsa ba bri shi ba/ /til mar zhun mar phag dang dred/ /zhag bskol lan tshwa bcas pa ni/ /'thungs na snegazer 'joms mchog yin no/ /sman 'di dag ni snum pa yidu/ /'bras bur bcas shing sgyur ba dang / /snum dang ldan par zas skom dang / /gong po dkri ba'i dugs dpyad bya/ /kha ru tsha mang btab pa'i chang / /'thungs na gcin gyi nad sel byed/ /mkhris gyur ⑤bsku dang blugs pa dang / /lus bcing bas duni bsil bar ⑦bya/ /nye shing gze ma bi da ri/ /rgun 'bru dze+ertsa yi rtsa ba lnga/ /bskol ba'i nang du sbrang rtsi dang / /kha ra btab pa blud par bya/ /ba sha ka dang ga gon dang / /rgyal mo ga gon le brgan rtsi'i/ /sa bon gur gum rgun chu dang / /'thungs na gcin 'gags nad sel byed/ /shing mngar er ba ru'i sa bon/ /skyer pa 'bras kyi chu dang blud⑨/ / rgun 'bru'i sde gu chur sbyar ba'am/ /⑪rgun 'bru ⑪chur ni sbangs pa blud—/ /bad kan las gyur dugs byas la/ /skyug sman bza' ba rno dro sbyin/ /nas yos thal sman rno ba dang / /dar ba bcas pa sbyin par bya/ /sug smel chang dang sbyar ba 'am/ /skyu ru ra yi khu ba blud/ /bzhad ⑫rus gze ma sug smel dang //tsha gsum sbrang rtsi gcin ⑫bcas blud/ /yang na kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑩ri'i khu/ /sbrang rtsir ⑫sbyar ba blud par bya/ /shi ti ba ra'i ⑫sa bon ni/ /zhib btags dar bar sbyar ba blud/ / ba da sap+ta ⑩paṇi dang / /sle tres dong gra ⑫dug mo nyung / /ke'u ka dang sug smel dang / /ka rañdza bskol sbrang rtsir bcas/ /des ⑪sbyar thug pa'am byi ru yi/ /phye ma 'bras kyi chu dang blud/ / pa ta li yi thal ba'i ⑩111—521

chu / /lan bdun btsags pa til mar bcas/ /nas tshig 'khus thal pa ta li / /pa ri pa tra ①til thal chu/ /shing tsha sug smel na le sham/ /chang dang sbyar ba blud par bya/ /'di dag re re'i lde gur sbyar④/ /bu ram so yis bcad cing bza'/ /'dus pa'i bdag nyid can kun la/ /'di dag gnas skabs ji bzhin phan/ /rde'u chags ring po ma lon dang / /rlung gi lgang ③nad sogs la'ang sbyar/ /rde'u chags nad ni mi bzad de/ /'chi bdag dang ni 'dra bar 'dod/ /gzhon pa'i tshe na sman gyis gso/ /'phel nas 'dral bar 'os pa yin/ /de yi sngon 'byung rjotshul la ni/ /snum 'chos ⑤la sogs rim pas bsngags/ /sru sru'i rtsa ba spra rjotog dang / /a sman da ka ba si ra⑦ nye shing lcam pa pu tse shel⑧/ /a ti pa la ba lu ka / spangs ma dṛk+ṣa ⑨da ni dang / /sha ka'i 'bras bu bya kri ⑩gnyis/ /gud tha gze ma ⑪ku laza/ /nas dang rgya shug ba ra ṇa⑫/ /ka ta ka yi 'bras bu dang / /u sha ka stsogs phye ma btab—/ /'di dag khu ba mar bskol blud/ /rlung gyur ⑫rde'u 'jig par byed//⑪e raṇ+ḍa dang bri ha ti⑫/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑩ri gze ma dang / /bu ram shing phran rtsa ba yi—/ /lde gu zho dang sbyar te blud/ /rde'u chags pa sel byed yin/ /ku sha 'jag ma 'dam bu dang / /ku ta nye'u shing ig ga tha/ /sru sru'i rtsa ba 'jag zlum dang / /bi da ri dang ba ra ⑩hi/ /'bras kyi rtsa ba gze ma dang / /ba lu ka dang pa ta li/ /ba tu la dang bla ⑫bar bcas/ /ba spru ba dang sri sha ka⑩ /de rnams bskol khya mar dang ⑥bskol/ /ga gon sa bon la sogs dang / /ut+pa la yi sa bon dang / /shing mngar dang ⑥ni brag zhun ⑫phye/ /de dag mkhris gyur rde chags sel/ /ba ra ṇa ⑫sogs rlung 'joms te/ /sug smel ha re rku cika'i sde//111—522

gu gul ru rta na le sham/ /tsi tra ka dang bye'u rug pa/ /de dag sde gur byas pa gzhug /u sha ka yi sde tshan bcug /mar bskol ba yis bad kan las/ /gyur pa'i rde'u myur du 'joms/ /rang rang sman ni 'di nyid kyis/ /thal sman 'o ma thug stsogs sbyar/ / pi tsu ka dang ang go ①la/ /ka ta ka la ②sha ka dang //ut+pa la yi 'bras bu rnams/ /bu ram bcas pa'i ①chu dron blud/ /rde phran 'jig par byed pa'i mchog /khrung khrung rnga mo bong bu'i rus/ /gze ma ta la pa tri ka /a za mo dang ka dam pa'i/ /rtsa ba dang ni bca' sga ni④/ /chang ngam chu dron bcas pa blud/ /rde ⑤phran chags pa 'jig par byed/ /ma ri tsi rjoka'i sa bon gyi/ /phye ma sbrang rtsir ⑦sbyar ba dang / /lug gi 'o ma zhag bdun ni//blud na rde'u ni ⑧'jig par byed/ /shi kru'i ⑨rtsa ba bskol ba ni⑩/ /dro 'jam 'thungs pas rdo nad 'joms/ /til dang a pa marga dang / /chu shing dang ni pa la sha /nas tshig 'khus thal lug gcin blud/ /phye ma rde'u chags pa sel/ /yang na lcam pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /gcig tu chang la sogs pa blud/ /yang na de bskol ⑪'o ma blud/ /nad kyis nyen pa sel bar byed/ /a ru ra yi rus pa btsos| /yang na ba spru ba btsos blud/ /yang na 'o ma can zas bza'/ /yang na bar hi shi ka yi/ /rtsa ba 'bras bur bcas pa blud/ /gcin 'gags lhag ma rnams la ni/ /'di yi gso ba lhag ma'ang sbyar/ /bri ha ti ⑫sogs sde tshan bskol/ /gze ma nyis 'gyur gzhug par bya/ /chu 'am 'o ma zhun mar dang / /blud na gcin gyi nad kun sel/ /thang shing gla sgang mur ba dang / /shing mngar dang ni a ru ra/ /chang ngam 'o ma chur ⑫sbyar ba/ /gcin gyi nad ni kun la blud/ /byi tsher ba bskol khu ba 'am/ /ardzu na bskol khu ba ni/ /rgyam 111—523

tsha 'bras bu gsum btab ①la/ /chu tshan dro 'jam sbyar ba blud/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ④ri gze ma bskol/ /yang na nas thug bur phran bcas/ /bi da ra sogs bskol ba 'am/ /khyim bya'i sha yi khu ba blud/ /bi da ri la sogs pa ①dang / /bskol ba'i brag zhun sbyin pa 'am/ /yang na chang ni nad med blud/ /rta 'am shing rtar bskyon nas ni/ /mgyogs par 'gro bas bskyod gyur rjon/ /rde'u de ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /bi da ri ⑤la sogs pa yi/ /sde tshan rnam pa kun tu sbyar//bkru busman don du seng phram ⑦mar/ /'jam rtsi'i las kyang bsten par bya/ /mchog tu 'jam rtsi gong ma bya/ /khu chu'i rde'u chags de yi ni/ /gcin lam sbyangs la stobs che ba'i/ /khu chu'i gnas ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ /skyes pa khu ba 'phel byed pa'i/ /sha dang khyim bya'i sha yis 'grangs⑧/ /'dod pa bdo bas bud med ni/ /dga' ba skyed la nyal po bya/ /gso ba 'di yis bcos kyang ni//ma zhi na ni sman pa yis/ /mtshon ⑨ni legs par brtag byas te⑩/ /gso ba ma bgyi ⑪nges par 'chi/ /bgyis na 'ang dogs par bcas pa las⑩/ de ltar rgyal po la zhus nas/ /las la byang ba'i sman pa ni/ /mang po dang ni dpyad ⑫par bya/ /de nas nad par ④snum bskus shing / /sbyangs shing cung zad nyams smad pa'i/ /lus ni snum bsku dugs bya zhing / /zan ma zos shing bkra shis byas/ /pus mor ⑫sleb pa'i spang ⑩leb la/ /'dug pa ⑩mi yi pang par brten/ /ro stod gan rkyal spyobazhag nas ni/ /gos kyis dkris ⑪pa'i steng du gzhag /de nas de yi sgyid khung dag /bkug nas ras kyis dam pa ru/ /rten ⑩gyi mi dang bcas par spyoni/ /bcings te dbugs ni phyung nas su/ /lte ba man chad bskus ⑫nas ni/ /de yi g.yon rol phyogs su ni/ /mnyes la khu 111—524

tshur gyis mnan cing / /'og tu 'byen ①pa'i bar du babyung/ /de nas g.yon pa'i mdzub ④mo dang / /gung mo'i sen mo zegs nas ni/ /til mar bskus te rkub tu ni/ /srubs mtshams bar du gzhug par bya/ /rde'u lte ba'i gnyer ma nas / /pho mtshan gzhang bar phyin par bya/ /de nas chu so'i gnas su ni/ /gnyer ma med cing dbyung sla ba/ /sor mo gnyis kyis bcir nas ni/ /mdud pa lta bur mtho bar bya/ /srubs mtshams nas gang ma gtogs par/ /gtsags ①bus legs par dral ④nas ni/ /rde'u'i tshad du dbral byas la/ /ci nas chag ⑤grugs med par ni/ /cha spyad rtse ༷mo gug pa yis/ /ma lus par ni dbyung bar bya/ /bud med chu so ngos su gnas/ /de ni mngal gnas pa la brten/ /mtho bar gyur nas cha spyad kyis/ /legs pa kho nar dbral bar bya/ /gzhan du byas na de yis ⑦ni/ /rma nas gcin ni 'dzag par 'gyur//skyes pa'i rma ni dbral nyes na/ /gcin 'dzag pa dang gcig tu 'gyur/ /chu so dbral ba'i rde'u rgyu/ /gcig las grub kyi gnyis las min/ /zug rngu chung las ⑧chu dron gyi/ /nang du de ni spying bar ⑨bya/ /de ltar khrag gis gang mi 'gyur/ /gang la mtshan las ⑩'o ma can/ /shing gi khu ba bcing bar bya//de nas gcin ni dag bya'i phyir/ /bu ram 'grangs ⑪pa sbyin pa dang / /rma la mar dang sbrang rtsi bsku/ /dus gnyis nas thug mar bcas pa'i/ /dro 'jam gcin skyed zhag gsum blud/ /bu ram mang po 'o ma dang / /'bras chan nyung ba zhag bcu sbyin/ /de nas 'bras bu skyur ba dang / /skam sa'i srog chags sha khu sbyin/ /'o ma can shing khu ba ⑩yis/ /rma ni bkrus nas btsod dang ni/ /shing mngar pra puṇ+ḍa rī ka /seng phrom dkar pos bsku 111—525

bar ①bya/ /rma bskus sman ni 'di dag nyid/ /skyer bcas til mar bskol te bskus②/ /'di yis rma zhag bcu dugs bya/ /gcin gyi lam ni zhag bdun na/ /rang gi ④lam nas ma byung na/ /rde'u'i rma ni me yis bsregs④| /rang gi lam nas byung gyur nas⑤/ /phal cher mas gtong rjomangar bas gso/ /rma de 'tshobs kyang lo gcig bar/ /ri bo glang po rta dang niske/ /shing la 'dzeg par mi bya ste/ /shing rtar mi zhon ⑦nyal po spang / /chu la rkyal ⑧bar mi bya'o/ /khu chu gcin rgyu be+eng ⑨pa dang / /me+eg sbubs mtshams ⑩srubs gzhang rtsa dang ⑪/ /pho mtshan mo mtshan rtse mo ni⑫/ /brgyad por mtshon ni gdab mi bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas gcin snyi ba za khu'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /za khu can ni stobs ldan la/ /dang po skyug sman bkru sman ni/ /snum can nyungs kar a ri ha⑫/ /ba ru ⑫ra dang ka rañdza'i⑫/ /snum dang gze ma til mar bskol/ /rang sman ji bzhin bskol ba yi/ /snum bcas skyug sman bkru sman gtang / /gla sgang thang shing dong gra spyobacug /bye'u rug pa sogs khu ba yi/ /'jam rtsi de nas gtang bar bya/ /mkhris pa n+ya gro dha sogs pas/ /sbyangs nas sha khus brta bar ⑩bya/ /gcin nad dang ni skran dang ni/ /skem zhing nyams ni smad pa 'byung / /de bas rjes 'brel bsrung ba'i phyir/ /zhi bar bya ba gtang bar bya/ /sbyang ba ma byas la de nyid/ /gcin nad can ni kun la blud/ /skyer pa skyu ru ra bskol khu/ /sbrang rtsir spyobacas pa nad par blud/ /skyer pa thang shing 'bras 111—526

bu gsum/ /gla sgang chu bskol ①blud pa'ang phan/ /tsi tra skyer pa 'bras bu gsum| /dug mo nyung ni sbrang rtsir bcas⑤/ /yang na sle tres skyu ru ra/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i khu ba'ang phan/ /seng phrom gla sgang kad pa ④la dang a ru ra/ /pa tha bye tsher bye dang ga ④dang ardzu na/ /seng ldeng skyer pa bye dang ga dang dar ba bskol⑤/ /khu ba gsum po sbrang rtsir bcas pas dubad kan sel/ /mkhris gyur pu shel seng phrom tsan+dan ardzu na/ /nim pa pa to la dang sle tre+es skyu ru ra/ /seng phrom ba li ka dang skyer pa da ta ka'i/ /gsum po de dag bskol ba sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud/ /'di dag ji bzhin zas skom dang / /nas dang gro dang sbyar ba dang / /rlung shas che ba'i gcin snyi la/ /snum dang sbyar te sbyin par bya/ /lci ba rta rtug las byung ba'am/ /'od ma las ni skyes pa dag /khur ba zan dron chag tshe ⑦stsogs/ /nas las byas pa'i zan ⑧kyang phan/ /rtsa 'bru muṅga la sogs dang / /'bras rnying drug cu pa rnying phan/ /nyungs kar til btsir ⑨las byung ba'am/ /sbyar thug ⑩skyur dang bcas pa 'am/ /ka pid ta ⑪dang tin tu ka /'dzam bu de sbyar btung ba dang / /tshod ma kha bo sbrang rtsi dang / /'bras bu gsum zan bza' ba skam/ /skam sa'i sha ni bsregs pa dang / /skam pa'am lcags dang g.yos pa dang / /rgun chang chang rnying mnan chang rnying / /rgun chu bskol ba las byung blud/ /a sa na sogs bskol ba'i chu/ /'jag ma bskol chu sbrang rtsi'i chu/ /'bras bu gsum la mtshan mo sbangs/ /nyin par skams la de nas ni/ /legs par btags pa'i phye dag dang / / bu ram ⑫sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud/ /sa la lo ma bdun pa dang / / kam bi l+ya ⑫dang ba ru ra/ /bri ④sha ka dang ka pid ta⑫/ /ro hi ni yi me tog ni/ /phyer btags 111—527
