sbrang rtsir ①bcas sbyin nam/ /skyu ru ra yi khu ba ②blud/ /bad kan mkhris pa'i gcin nad sel/ /gze ma skyer pa seng phrom ⑧dang / /shu dag kad phal ④ardzu na—/ /shug pa lung thang asman ta⑤/ /tsan+dan dang ni a ka ru/ /la la phud dang pa to la/ /ga dur bong nga go bye btsod/ /bad kan rlung la til mar bcas| /mkhris par rjomar de 'dren mar btsos/ /rtsa ba bcu pa zi ra ⑦dkar—/ /dan ti thang shing ba spru gnyis/ /snu ha arga'i rtsa ba dang / /bu ga dam pa a ru ra/ /⑧go bye ka rañdza'i rtsa ba/ /ba ra ṇa ⑨yi rtsa ba dang / /pi pi ling rtsa ma nu'i rtsa/ /re re srang ni bcu bcu dang / /nas dang rgya shug rgya sran lasaske/ /bre gsum chu ni brgyad 'gyur dang / /bskol la bzhi cha lus pa dang / /de dang pi pi ling gnyis dang / / dbyi mo ⑩lcang ma ro hi sha⑪ /dur byid byi dang kam+bi ⑫l+ya/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba bca' sga dang / /mar bre gang dang bskol ba yis//gcin snyi'i nad ni de nyid dang / /'brum phran dug dang skya rbab dang / /khong 'bras skran dang gzhang 'brum dang / /'or nad skem dang dbyig dug dang / /dmu rdzing lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /slon dang tshil ches mcher ⑫pa'i nad/ /dreg mje sbyo byed brjed ⑫byed 'joms/ /mar 'di thang la 'bar gyi yin/ /seng phrom mur ba byi dang ga⑫ /zur pa rgya spos ga bra'i rtsa/ /chu srin sen mo dug mo nyung / /gla ba ru rta pri yang ku/ /gla ⑩gor zho sha tsi tra ka /bong nga bil ⑩sha la gnyis dang / /dri bzang bzhi dang rtsa mkhris dang / /pu tse shel dang la la phud/ /pa ta puṣ+kar spru ⑫la dang / /pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / /dbyi mo dang ni 'bras bu gsum/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis chu bre ni/ /bcu drug la bskol bzhi cha lus/ /btsags te bsgrangs pa'i nang du ni/ /sbrang rtsi bre do 111—528

bcug nas ni/ /zla phyed legs par gzhag pa yi/ /seng phrom mnan chang gcin snyi dang / /gzhang 'brum mdze dang yi ga 'chus/ /srin bu skya rbab pho ba'i nad/ /tshil byed ①pa yi nad sel byed/ /a sa na la sogs pa'i sde/ /sna re srang ni nyi shu dag /chu bre nyis brgya lnga bcu drug /bskol la sdebazhi cha lus pa dang / /bu ram srang ni nyis brgya dang / /sbrang rtsi bre do gzhug pa dang / /dug mo nyung sogs sde gu ni/ /srang re'i gatshad ni bcug pa ste/ /sbrang rtsi pi pi ling gi phye/ /mar gyis bskus pa'i snod dag ni/ /rgya skyegs bskus par ④bcug nas ni/ /nas kyi nang du bcug nas su/ /lcags ni rno la srab pa ⑤dag /seng ldeng gi ni me mdag bsregs/ /ji srid lcags ni zad pa'i bar/ /mang du der rjoni gzhug par bya/ /lcags las byas pa'i chang mnan blud/ /sngon pas yon tan lhag pa yin/ /rtsub pa dril phyis dam du bsdams/ /drag shul mtshan mo gnyid ⑦mi log /tshil dang bad kan 'joms byed gang / /de ni phyi nang las btang phan/ /brag zhun srang brgya snying po'i ④chu/ /sbangs pa'i snying po chu dang ni/ /legs par blud cing sā ⑨lu dang / /skam sa'i sha khu bcas pa bza'—/ /bla brnan ⑩shin tu mang ba yi/ /gcin snyi'i nad ni kun kyang 'joms—/ /'bras phreng (spethor bu rmen bu dang / /tshil ches ⑫mdze dang mtshan bar rdol⑫/ /srin nad rkang bam 'or nad sel/ /'di ni bcud kyis ⑫len mchog yin/ /lam du dugs ⑫dang lham dag ni/ /med par drang srong tshul du ni/ /dpag tshad brgya yi bar du 'gro/ /chu yi gnas ni brko ba 'am⑫/ /ba gcin lci ba bsten pa 'am/ /ba lang dang ni lhan cig 'khyams⑩/ /skem pa'i gcin nad can dag gi/ /zas dang sman tshil mi bskyed pas/ /kham phor 111—529

la sogs 'bras nad ni/ /ma smin skrang pa'i nad ltar gso/ /smin pa la ni rma ltar gso/ /de yi sngon byung ①tshul nyid la/ /'o ma can shing bskol chu dang / /ra thug gcin ni blud pa bsngags/ /gcin snyi'i nad can lto sra bas/ /phal cher bkru sman rnon po gtang / /sug grel sogs kyi ②til mar sbyar/ /rma 'tshob pa yi cho ga bya/ /dong gra la sogs sde tshan skeni/ /btags pa'i lde gus ④dril bar bya/ /a sa na sogs bskol chu blud/ /dug mo nyung sogs zas skom sbyar / /pa ta ⑤thal tres tsi tra ka /sha rang ga pā kan ta rjori/ /sap+ta paṇi dug mo nyung / / kad pha ⑦la dang dong ga'i bye/ /sbrang rtsis lde gu ⑧byas pa 'am//lcags dgu pa yang de bzhin sbyin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas khong 'bras dang rgyu rlugs ⑨kyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /khong 'bras ma smin thams cad la/ /'or nad lta bur gso ba dang / /rgyun tu khrag ni dbyung bar bya/ /min pa la ni rma ltar gso/ /rlung shas che la rtsa ba lnga/ /bskol bas rma ni bkru ba dang / /thang shing sogs sde ⑩shing mngar dang / /til sbyar ⑪rgyam tshas rma bsku bya/ /bkru sman dang ni ldan pa yi/ /dur byed kyis ni rnam sbyangs shing ⑩/ /bi da ri ⑫yi sde bskol ba'i/ /dur byid kyis ni ④rma 'byor bya/ /mkhris gyur 'o ma can chus bkru/ /sle tres shing mngar til gyis bsku/ /btsod dang rgya shug pu shel tsespyo/ /pa ya mya ⑩dang ser po gnyis/ /'bras bu gsum dang shing mngar dang / /'o mar bcas pas rma 'byor bya/ /yang na n+ya gro dha sogs pa'i/ /myu gu shun pa ⑩'bras bu bsku/ /bad kan las 111—530

gyur dong ga'i chus①/ /bkru zhing phye dang ser po gnyis/ /dur byid dang ni til gyis bsku/ /yang na rgya sran dan ti yi/ /sha ma dur byid tsi tra ka /seng phrom rgyam tsha ba gcin bcas/ /til mar gyis ni rma 'tshob bya/ /khrag dang glo bur las gyur pa②/ /mkhris pa'i khong 'bras lta bur gso/ /ma smin nad du byung ba la/ /ba ra ṇa ①sogs sde bskol bar/ /u sha ka yi sde tshan btab/ /snga dro khong ④'bras can la blud/ /bkru sman bcas par bskol ba'i mar de gnyis dang ni ldan par blud/ /ni ru ha dang snum 'jam rtsi/ /de dag gnyis la ⑤sbyar bar bya/ /bza' dang btung dang bsku ba la/ /sbrang rtsi na le sham dkar rjosbyar/ /nad dmigs ji bzhin blud na ni/ /khong 'bras ma smin 'joms par byed/ /kyi lce nim pa 'bras bu gsum/ /shing mngar pu tse shel cha mnyam / /dur byid pa to la'i rtsa ba/ /re re cha ni bzhi par bya/ /sran chung spun pa med srang ⑦brgyad/ /de bskol mar dang bcas pa blud/ /khong 'bras skran skedang me dbal dang / /lus tsha rmongs bag myos rims 'debs/ /skom dang brgyal slon snying nad dang / /khrag mkhris mig ser mje nad 'joms/ /kyi lce ba ni phul gang dag⑨ /brgyad 'gyur chu ru ⑩bskol nas ni/ /de yi khu ba phul gang dang ⑩/ /skyu ru ra yi ⑫khu ba dang / /'o ma mar ni phul re dang / / tig ta ⑫byi tsher kra yan ti/ /gla sgang ram nye ta ma la/ /tsan+dan ut+pal dzi ban ⑫tirka/ /gcig tu bsdus te bskol ba yi/ /mar de yon tan snga mar mtshungs/ /rgun 'bru ⑫'bra go ma du ka /bi ⑩da ri dang nye shing bcas/ /pa ru sha ka 'bras bu gsum/ /de btsos khu ba ⑩mar bskol la/ /'o ma bu ram shing ku ⑫dang / /skyu ru ra yi ⑪khu ba dang / /a ru ra yi sde gur bcas/ /bskol te 111—531

bsgrangs pa de nang du/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi bzhi char btab/ /yon tan snga ma 'drar shes bya/ /nad dmigs ji bzhin rngabs rwa ①sogs/ /yang na gtar gas ⑧khrag dbyung bya/ /khong 'bras smin par gyur pa dze+el/ /khong par gnas pa phyir 'bur bar/ /shes nas de ni bcing bar bya/ /gzer ba der ④gnas gong bur 'dug /de ngos btsir bas tshor ba chung / / tsha ba ⑤la sogs chung gyur dun/ /smin pa yin pas khong 'bras ni/ /brtol te rma ltar gso bar byarka/ /nang gi char gnas khong 'bras ni/ /smin pa'i mtshan ma'ang 'di ⑦nyid yin—/ /smin nas bu ga rnags gyur te/ /de ni steng ma 'og tu dbyung ⑧/ /rang nyid rdol ba'i nad de ni/ /zas phan byin zhing btang snyoms gzhag⑨ /zhag bcu'am bcu gnyis bar du ni/ /sman pas bla brnan las ⑩bsrung bya/ /rnag ni legs ⑪par mi 'dzag ⑩na/ /ba ra ṇa ⑫sogs chu dron nam/ /shi kru sbrang rtsi blud pa 'am/ /de dang sbyar ba'i nas thug blud/ /rgya shug rgya sran nas kyi ni/ /yu sha dang ni bza' ba bsngags/ /zhag bcu yan chad kyi lce ba/ /mar ram ⑫seng phrom dag gis ni/ /nyams stobs ji bzhin sbyang bar bya/ /sbyangs nas tig ta ⑫sbrang rtsi blud/ /'di la kun kyang skran lta bur/ /nad thabs ji bzhin gso bar bya/ /khong 'bras kun dang gnas skabs dang / /thams cad du ni gu gul gtang / /de bzhin brag zhun rang rang gi/ /sbyor bar ⑩bcas te khu ba ⑩blud/ /'bad de smin pa las bsrung bya/ /smin na ⑫shin tu gso dka' yin/ /gzhan yang myur du tsha byed pas/ /khong 'bras zhes ni de la bshad/ /gal te gcin snyi las gyur na/ /gcin snyi ba yi gso ba ⑪bya/ /nu mar byung la 'di ltar ni/ /mi bcing thams cad rma ltar gso/ /dbral tshe ⑪111—532

nu zho 'dzag pa dang / /nu sor nag por ①mi gnod bsrung / /ma smin gnas skabs thams cad du/ /de yi nu zho btsir zhing bzho/ /rgyu rlugs rlung shas che ba la/ /dur byed snum can gyis sbyangs shing ②/ /a mra'i 'bras bu seng phrom mar—/ /e raṇ+ḍa dang skyid de dze+eba'i/ /mar dang sman mar 'dren mar sbyin/ /de nas rlung 'joms sman khu snum/ /lde gu rjoms gtong drag po ⑤bya/ /sha khu bcas pa'i zas sbyin zhing / /shing mngar snum bskol 0'jam rtsi gtang / /rlung 'joms dugs dang bsku mnye bya/ /smin nas dral la rma ltar gso/ /rgyu rlugs khrag mkhris las gyur pa⑦/ /smin dang ⑧ma smin ji bzhin du/ /rma dang skrangs pa'i gso ba bya/ /rgyun tu khrag ⑨kyang dbyung bar bya/ /bad kan las gyur skyer pa yi()/ /phye ma ba gcin sbyar ba blud/ /'di la mnyed thomebya ma gtogs par/ /bad kan rmen bu'i gso ba bya/ /smin nas dbral te dzā ti yi⑫//me tog go bye ang ko la/ /lo ma bdun pa pa to la/ / nim pa yung ba bye dang ga⑫/dug mo nyung dang til mar bskol/ /rma sbyang phyir ni blud pa bsngags/ /tshil las gyur la ⑫bye'u rug sogs/ /ba gcin sbyar te btags pa 'am/ /mgo bo'i skebakru sman dag gis bya/ /rlig pa'i srubs mtshams ⑩ma gtogs par/ /'phel gtsags ⑩kyis ni dbral nas ni/ /tshil ni legs par dbyung bar bya/ /rma ni sbrang rtsi nag tshur dang / /rgyam tsha nges par bskus nas btsems⑫/ /de la tshil ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ /sdong ros sug smel su ma na/ /go bye pi pi ling rū la/ /til mar dag ni bsku bar bya/ /rma ni 'byor bar gyur gyi bar/ /snum dang dugs kyang bsten par bya/ /gcin byung snum gyis ⑪dugs bya zhing / /ras ma phra mos ⑪dkri bar bya/ /srubs mtshams 'og tu dmu rdzing bzhin/ /legs 111—533

par dbral te gzag stipar bya/ /rma bkab ④bcing dang 'byor par bya/ /rgyu ma byung bar gyur pa dag /rlig par phyin par ma gyur la/ /rlung gi rgyu rlugs bzhin du gso/ /ba spru ba ni srang brgya ①dang / /rtsa ba bcu pa e raṇ+ḍa/ /a shwa garnya nye ④shing dang / /pa ya gya dang drur ba ⑤gnyis/ /'dam bu ku sha bu ram gnyis bu/ /a ha ga lar bcas pa ni/ /re re srang ni bcu bcur ⑦byas/ /chu bre brgya rtsa nyi shu ⑧brgyad/ /bskol ba brgyad cha lus pa ru/ /der ni bu ram srang sum cu/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi mar bre do/ /'o ma mar ni bre do do/ /pi pi ling dang de rtsa ba/ /shing mngar rgun 'bru ⑨lce myang tsha/ /la la phud dang dong gra ⑫gzhug /de btsos skyid ⑪de ba zhes bya/ /gzhon sha can gyi bcud len yin/ /rlung dang than pa lam du 'gro/ /bzhon stsogs bsrung ba bsdams ⑫mi dgos/ /skyid de ba dang phyug po dang / /bde ba bsten ⑫dang bud med dang / /bud med rgan mo'i khyo dang ni/ /dpal skyed rtsod pa zlog byed cing / /dus kun du ni brten gyur na/ /mdog mdangs sha ni rgyas byed cing / /rgyu rlugs khong 'bras skran gzhang 'brum/ /pho mtshan mo mtshan rlung gis nyen/ /'or nad dmu rdzing mchin pa dang / /rtug skam nad ni sel byed mchog /snum gyi bkru sman ④'jam rtsi yis/ /gal te rgyu rlugs ma zhi na/ /dang po 'jam rtsi btang spyonas ni/ /de nas chu sor gnas pa ni/ /zla ba kham ⑩pa'i kha 'dra bas/ /rlung lam dgag phyir bsreg par bya/ /mthe bong steng gi rgyus pa ni/ /ser zhing snal ma 'dra ba gang / /khab kyis bteg ste thad ka ru/ /gang na nad yod bcad de bsreg /gzhan dag de las logs gzhan nam/ /srin lag sor mo bsreg ces zer/ /kha cig 'di ni bad kan rlung / /las gyur 111—534

skran mcher la bya zer/ /bi sha tse ①nad gang na yod/ /mthe'u chung srin lag dag la bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi ④le'u bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas skran gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /rlung gyur skran di mi bzad naske/ /phyi sa 'phyen ①ni 'gags gyur na/ /rtsub dang grang byung rlung nad la/ /phan pa'i til mar dag gis gso/ /zas skom 'jam rtsi sbyar ba dang / /bsku byug snum 'tshos ④dugs dpyad bya/ /sgo dang zug dang rengs ⑤pa dang / /'gags pa la ni mchog tu bya/ /snum 'chos rjodugs ni byas pa yis/ /bu ga'i rgyun srang mnyen byed ⑦la/ /rlung shas che ba gzhom bya zhing / /phyi sa sri ba sel skran 'joms/ /lte ba yan chad skyes pa yi/ /skran la mchog tu snum blud ⑧phan//zhu ba'i gnas brtan ⑨'jam rtsi bya/ /lto bar gnas la gnyi ga bya/ /rlung can skran ni drod che la/ /phyi sa rlung ni 'gags gyur la/ /bza' btung nyams brtas ⑩byed pa dang / /snum dang dro ba sbyin par bya/ /rlung gyur skran la bad kan dang / /mkhris pa srung ⑪zhing ni ru ha/ /'jam rtsi bcas pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /yang dang yang du bya ba yin/ /'jam rtsi mchog tu skran 'joms par/ /shes bya de ni rlung ⑫gi nad/ /dang por ⑫rang gi gnas su bcom/ /'phral du skran ni sel bar byed/ /de bas skran la rgyun du ni/ /mas gtong drag po 'jam rtsi bcas / /btang bar gyur pas rlung bad kan/ /mkhris pa'i bdag nyid can rnams sel/ /shing kun dang ni tsha ba gsum/ /rtsabs ⑫ru tsha dang kha ru tsha/ /se ⑩'bru ma nu go snyod dang / /zi ra 'u su la la phud/ /star bu ya bak+ṣa ra dang //111—535

zur pa shu dag tsi tra ka /a za garnya sug smel dang / /bye rug pa ni zho dang bcas①rka/ /mar bskol rlung gi skran sel zhing / /gzer dang lto sbos 'joms par byed/ /spa ma'i 'bras bu tsha ba gsum/ /zi ra go snyod ⑦tsha ba lnga/ /a za mo dang lce myang tsha/ /zho dang 'o ma mar dang ni/ /se ④'bru la phug rgya shug gi/ /khu ba bskol bas rlung gi ni/ /skran dang dmu rdzing lto sbos dang / /rtsib logs snying dang lto rjob gzer/ /mngal nad gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba dang / /rims nad yi ga 'chus pa 'joms rtsa ba bcu pa su sha bi/ /pa la sha ka ⑤ma nu dang / /ba rjospru ba gnyis e raṇ+ḍa⑦/ /ra sna a shwa garnya dang / /ga bra'i rtsa ba zur pa dkar⑧/ /sle tres garnya pa la sha /srang ni gnyis gnyis tshad byas dang / /nyi shu rtsa brgyad nang du bskol/ /nas ⑨dang rgya shug rgya sran dang / /ma sha bre re lhan cig tu/ /chu bre bcu drug nang du bskolaske/ /khu ba der zho bre bzhi dang / /mar bre gang dang slar bskol la/ /se 'bru a mra ta ka dang / /kha lung khu ba bre rer bcas/ /de bzhin rtsab mo skyur rtsabs ⑩tsha/ /g.yer ma shu dag ga bra'i ⑪rtsa/ /ra sna pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /tsi tra ka dang 'u su dang / /ya ba na ga la la phud/ /star bu zi ra nag po dang //go snyod zi ra spa ma'i 'bras/ /ka ra bi ra zangs rtsi ba/ /u sha ka dang dur byid ⑩dang / / dan da mur ba byi dang ga⑫ /se 'bru haste pi pi ling / /gze ma spang spos sru sru'i sngostertsa/ /ga gon rgyal mo ga gon gyi/ /sa bon shu ti thal sman gnyis/ /bye'u rug pa thal tres dang / /ni li na la'i ⑫'bras bu dang / /lan tshwa gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ /bcas pa'i zho yi ⑩sman mang des/ /sngar bshad nad ni gso dka' ⑫dang / /brjed ⑫byed smyo byed gcin sri dang / /111—536

rlung nad gzhang 'brum myur du 'joms/ /tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum/ /'u su dbyi mong byi dang ga① /tsi tra ka ni sde gur byas/ /'o ma mar bskol rlung skran 'joms/ /sgog skya'i rtsa ba srang brgya ②dang / /rtsa ba chen po srang lnga lnga①ske/ /chu srang stong dang de bskol la/ /bzhi ④cha lus par phyed se 'bru'i⑤/ /khu ba chang dang 'bras khu skyur/ /zho rnams de yi phyed phyed dang / /tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum/ /shing kun dbyi mo dul la phud/ /dbyi mong star ⑦bu lce myang tsha/ /thang shing srang ni phyed phyed dang / /mar ni bre gang bcas par bskol / /rlung las gyur pa'i skran kun 'joms/ /gcong chen skabs su bshad pa yi/ /srang drug pa yi mar yang blud/ /'o ma'i skyin pa chang dwangs sam//se 'bru zho spris sbyar ba'i mar⑧/ /rlung las gyur pa'i skran ⑨sel to/ /rlung gi skran la bad kan 'phel/ / dro 'jam ⑩yi ga 'chus pa dang / /snying rgal ⑪khong lci snyom gyur pa/ /de la skyug sman gtang bar bya/ /gzer dang lto sbos ⑫bshang sri la/ /gnas shes byas nas snum bcas pa'i/ /sman mar sman gyi phye ma dang / /khu ba ri lur ⑫byas pa yi/ /rgya shug se 'bru chu dron dang / /dar ba chang dang skyur rtsabs dang / /chang dwangs bcas pa nang par ⑫blud/ /yang na phye ma la sogs pa/ /thug pa sla bor byas pa ni/ /nang par yang na zas sngon blud| /phye ma kha lung khu ba dang / /lan mang bgrungs ⑫par gyur pa yi/ /las ni byed par nus gyur pa'i/ /ri lus ⑩rlung dang bad kan 'joms/ /shing kun shu dag ⑩a ru ra/ /a za ⑫garnya se 'bru dang / /'u su pa ta ti mu sa//ma nu zur pa dkar po dang / /spa ma'i 'bras bu tsi tra ka /thal sman gnyis dang lan tshwa gnyis/ /tsha ba gsum dang zi ra dang / /dbyi mo da trig star bu'i 111—537

phyes—/ /rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i/ /snying ga rtsib ①logs chu so dang / /mjug to mngal dang chu sor gzer/ /bad kan rlung las ②gyur pa'i nad/ /gso dka' skran dang 'phyen ①dang ni/ /gcin dang phyi sa 'gags pa dang / /lkog ma rjo'agags shing snying nad dang / /skya ⑤rbab yi ga 'chus pa dang / /mcher pa gzhang 'brum skyigs bu dang / /rgyu rlugs lto sbos me drod nyams/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba sel④/ /rgyam tsha dang ni la la phud/ /a za mo dang pi pi ling / /dong gra rim bzhin cha res bskyed/ /thams cad dang ni cha mnyam pa'i/ /a ru ra bsres phye ma 'di/ /me ni mngon sum nyid yin no/ /tsha ba gsum dang ti mu sa/ /rgyam tsha dang ni zi ra gnyis/ /cha mnyam shing kun brgyad cha'i phyer⑦/ /mar bsres kham gyi dang por ④zos/ /me drod drag po skyed byed cing / /rlung gi skran ni 'joms par byed/ /shing kun shu dag kha ru tsharka/ /dong gra dang ni la la phud/ /rnam rgyal ma nu ru rta dang / /dur byed dan da'i ⑨rtsa bar bcas/ /cha res ⑩bskyed pa'i phye ma 'di/ /chu dron sbyar 'thungs lto ba'i nad/ /skran dang dmu rdzing la sogs pa/ /seng ges ⑪ri dwags tshogs rnams ni/ /mthu rtsal gyis ni zil non ltar/ /nad rnams 'joms par byed pa yin/ /lce myang tsha dang pi pi ling / /a za mo dang a ru ra'i—/ /phye ma chu dron sbyar blud na/ /skran can bad rlung las gyur tshogs/ /lcags mdas ⑩lus phug bzhin du 'joms/ /ka rañdza yi lo ma dang / / in tra ⑫ba ru ṇa dbyi mo⑫/ /kru trug ⑫tres dang bca' sga ⑩dang / /pi pi ling dang na le sham/ /ma lus rim bkod tho)rgyam tshas bkab/ /bsregs la btags te zho dang ni/ /zho ga chu sbyar blud pa dag /skran dang dmu rdzing 'or 111—538

nad dang / /skya rbab gzhang 'brum nad rnams sel/ /shing kun sum 'gyur rgyam tsha dang / /de las e raṇ+ḍa ①yi mar/ /sum 'gyur de las sgog skya yi/ /khu ba sum 'gyur sbyar ba dag /blud na skran dang dmu rdzing dang / /rgyu rlugs gzer gyi nad rnams 'joms④/ /kha lung khu ba shing kun dang / /se 'bru rgyam tsha kha ru tsha/ /chang gi dwangs mar ⑦sbyar blud na/ /rlung las gyur pa'i skran nad sel/ /bca' sga zho gnyis bu ram zho/ /bzhi dang til nag bkrus srang gcig /gcig tu phye mar btags byin zhing / /'o ma dro 'jam rjes blud na/ /rlung gi snying nad skran gzhang 'brum/ /mngal gzer ④rtug pa 'gags pa sel/ /rlung gyur skran la e raṇ+ḍa'i/ /mar ni chang dang sbyar ba blud//bad rlung 'dres la'ang de nyid blud/ /mkhris pa 'dres la 'o ma bcas/ /gal te mkhris pa 'phel 'gyur ⑤te/ /tsha gyur rjorlung gi skran can la/ /mthun pa ⑦rjes su 'byin byed pa/ /snum bcas bkru sman gtang bar bya/ /des kyang tsha ba ma bri na/ /de la gtar ⑧ga gdab par bya/ /sgog skya bshus pa skam po ni/ /srang bzhi chu dang 'o ma ni/ /brgyad 'gyur gyi ni nang du bskol/ /'o ma ma lus par blud ⑨na/ /rlung gyur ⑩skran dang rtug 'gags dang / /rlung nad gzugs 'khums mi bzad rims/ /snying nad khong 'bras zad byed rnams/ /'o ma de yis myur du 'joms/ /til mar chang dang ba gcin dang / /rang skyur ya bak+ṣa rar bcas/ /blud na skran dang dmu rdzing dang / /lto sbos cig car 'joms par byed/ /tsi tra pi pi ling spru la/ /bca' sga shing kun e raṇ+ḍa/ /rgyam tsha kha ru tsha bcas pa/ /bskol ba blud na gzer ba dang / /lto sbos rtug 'gags sel mchog yin⑪/ /ma nu e raṇ+ḍa'i rtsa ba/ /nas dang byi tsher ba sha 111—539

ka /chu dang bskol te blud na ni/ /lto nad sbos dang gzer 'joms ①byed/ /ma nu e raṇ+ḍa 'jag ma'i/ /rtsa ba thang shing bca' sga rnams/ /chu dang bskol ba'i khu ba blud/ /khong pa phrag pa rgyab gzer 'joms/ /brag zhun dang ni pa ya mya②/ /rtsa ba chen po lnga bskol ba/ /rlung gyur ①skran nad can la blud/ /rtug skam nad la nas kyi ni/ /chag tshe snum dang ldan pa sbyin/ /pi pi ling ngam ④la phug gi /khu ba dang ni sbyar ba sbyin/ /nas kyi zan dron 'o mar bcas/ /rlung gi rtug 'gags nad ⑤la sbyin/ /yang na mon sran gre'u'i chanarjo/ /snum mang lan tshwar ldan pa ⑦sbyin/ /dur byid dan ti ni li ni/ /a ru ra dang kam pi l+ya/ /nas tshig 'khus thal kha ru tsha/ /dong gra ⑧mar dang bcas pa ⑨ni/ /dri mar bcas la bkru ⑩sman gtang / /ni li ni dang 'bras bu gsum/ /ra sna pa la pu tse shel/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri byi dang ga⑪ /srang re chu bre bzhi nang bskol/ /khu ba brgyad cha lus pa ru/ /mar bre gang dang zho bre gang / / su dha k+ṣi ra ⑫srang gcig bskol/ /de las mar bre re re na⑫/ /nas thug thug sla ④sbyar te blud/ /zhu zhing legs par 'khrus nas ni/ /sha khu bza' ba sbyin par bya/ /ni li ni yi sman mar 'dis/ /skran mdze dmu rdzing ngo khabs ⑫dang / /'or nad ⑫skya rbab rims nad dang / /sha bkra mdzer ba smyo byed 'joms/ /khyim bya rma bya gong ma sreg /khrung khrung bye'u'i ⑩sha khu dang / /sā ⑫lu'i 'bras chan chang dang mar/ /rlung gi skran ni ⑪sel ba yin/ /nyung zhing snum la sla zhing dro/ /kha zas rlung skran can gyis bza'/ /btung bar chang gi dwangs ma 'am/ /'u su bskol ba'i chu tshan blud/ /mkhris gyur skran ni snum dro las/ /byung ⑩ba de la rgun 'bru ⑪dang / /a ru ra bskol bu ram bcas/ /kam pi l+ya ⑫dang sbrang rtsi dang ⑫/ /111—540

cho ga'am khrag mkhris gsor bshad pa'i/ /bkru sman blud de 'khrus pa phan/ /rtsub dro las byung skran la ni/ /tig ta'am ba ①sha ka bskol ba'i/ /mar ni blud par byas pa 'am/ /rtswa yi rtsa ba lnga pa 'am/ /'tsho byed sde tshan bshad pa dang ②/ /mar bskol blud na mchog tu phan/ /n+ya gro dha sogs sde tshan rnams④//'tsho byed sde tshan ④'o ma phan/ /de yang bshol du med gyur par/ /sman pas bkru sman dang bskol ba'i/ /mar ram 'o ma dag gi ⑤ni/ /bkru sman nye bar gtang bar bya/ /skyu ru ra dang bu ram shing du/ /khu ba mar ni bre gang dang / /a ru ra ⑦ni bzhi cha bcug /bskol ba'i mar blud mkhris skran sel/ /yang na mkhris pa'i khong 'bras gsor/ /bshad pa'i seng phrom sman mar blud/ /rgun 'bru ⑧shing mngar pa ya ⑨mya/ /shug pa tsan+dan sbrang rtsi rnams/ /'bras bkrus chu dang blud na ni/ /mkhris pa'i skran ni sel bar 'gyur/ /kyi lce ba ni srang gnyis dang / /chu bre do ni bskol nas su/ /brgyad cha lus pa btsags pa ni/ /dro 'jam 'o ma cha mnyam blud/ /yang na de steng 'o tshan ni/ /me drod ji bzhin blud par bya/ /de yis nad ni bsal bas na/ /mkhris pa can gyi skran zhir 'gyur| /tsha la mar grang bsku ba 'am/ /bsil ba'i sman mar bcas pa bsku//chu skyes lo mas reg bya zhing / /snod chus gang la ⑩reg pa phan/ /gzer dang me drod bri 'gyur zhing / /tsha ba'i dang po tshul can gyis/ /mkhris pa'i skran la khyad par du/ /khrag ni lan mang dbyung ⑩ba phan/ /rtsa ba chad skran mi tsha zhing //nye bar zad par 'gyur ba dang / /khrag ni skyur bar mi 'gyur la/ /khrag las gyur pa'i nad kyang med/ /gnyid cing nad ni bsal ⑩ba la/ /skam sar skyes pa'i sha khus brta/ /brtas na nyes pa lhag lus la/ /slar yang mar ni bsten 111—541

par bya/ /khrag dang mkhris pa 'phel gyur pas①/ /skran ni smin par phyogs pa la| /gso ba'i bya ba ma rnyed cing / /mkhris pa'i khong ②'bras ltar gso bya/ /sā ①lu ba dang ra'i 'o ma/ /pa tol skam sa'i sha mar dang ④/ /pa ru sha ka skyu ⑤ru ra/ /rgun 'bru rjo'abra go se 'bru dang / /kha rar bcas ⑦pa'i kha zas bza'//btung ba ba la bri ⑧ha ti/ /la sogs bskol ba blud par bya/ /bad kan las gyur dang po ni/ /slon bya de mi bzod sgyung bya/ /kha dro tsha ba'i thug stsogs kyi⑨//rim par de 'og me drod skyed/ /shing kun la sogs thal sman dang ⑩/ /shing kun star bu nyis 'gyur gtang / /gal te 'bur ram gting ring gyur⑪/ /tshor ba chung zhing sra la brtan/ /lto sbos la sogs ldan pa'i skran/ /dugs byas nas ni snyi bar bya/ /bad kan las gyur skran can gyis/ /mar tsha thal sman bcas chu blud/ /nas tshig 'khus thal tsha ba gsum/ /rgyam tsha shing kun kha ru tsha/ /se 'bru ⑫rtsa ba bcu bskol mar/ /bad kan las gyur skran myur 'joms—/ /bse shing 'bras bu srang gnyis dang / /rtsa ba chung ngu lnga srang re/ /chu bye bzhi yi nang du bskol/ /bzhi cha lus pa de dang ni/ /mnyam pa'i 'o ma mnyam pa'i mar/ / bye dang ga ⑫dang shing kun dang / /nas tshig 'khus thal lce myang tsha/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri rtsabs ④ru tsha/ /zur pa ra sna shing mngar dang / /pi pi ling dang dong gra ⑫rnams/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis bcas par bskol/ /go bye yi ni sman mar ni⑩/ /bad kan skran ni sel ba'i mchog /mchin pa mcher pa'i nad dang ni/ /skya rbab dang ni pho ba'i nad/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba 'joms / /de nas skran can de yi lus/ /ma lus par ni dugs byas la /skran kun la ni thog ma nyid/ /snum chos ⑩dugs ni byas gyur na/ /gso ba 111—542

gang zhig byas pa des①/ /grub kyi rtsub chos kyis mi 'grub/ /snum zhing dugs kyis brlan lus kyi/ /skran ni snyi ②bar gyur pa dang / /ji ltar ①bshad pa'i bum pa ni/ /bzhag pas bkang ④nas de bsal ⑤bya/ /de nas ras nang chud byas te/ /tshad shes pa yi rjoskran dbral bya/ /shing gcad ra rmig ⑦me long rnams—/ /ji snyed pa yis legs par bcing / /des ⑧skran gcig pu dbyi bya zhing ⑨/ /snying dang rgyu mar reg mi bya/ /til dang zar ma'i sa bon dang / /nyungs kar e raṇ+ḍa yis byug /bad kan skran ni lcags kyi snod/ /dro 'jam tsam gyis dugs bya'o/ /de ltar gnas las bskyod nas ni/ /bad kan skran la snum bcas pa'i/ /bkru sman dang ni 'jam rtsi dag /rtsa ba bcu pa ldan par sbyang / /pi pi ling dang skyu ru ra/ /rgun 'bru ⑩sha ma dur byed sogs/ /srang re dang ni bskol ba la⑪/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi zhun mar ni/ /bre ⑫re 'o ma drug 'gyur dang / /lhan cig bskol bar gyur pa 'di/ /'dres pa'i sman mar zhes bya ste/ /skran can 'khru bar byed pa'i mchog /rgyu rlugs khong 'bras gzer ba ni/ /rlung gi nad la bdud rtsi yin/ /yang na ni li ni sman mar/ /srang gnyis tshad du blud pa 'am/ /de bzhin skyid de ba'i sman mar/ /dmu rdzing skabs bshad mar yang phan/ /dan da tsi tra a ru ra/ /srang ni nyi shu rtsa lnga lnga/ /chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol/ /brgyad cha lus btsags a ru ra/ /bcas pa bu ram dan dar mnyam/ /bcug la til mar dur byed phye/ /srang bzhi bca' sga pi pi ling / /zho gnyis bskol bsgrangs ⑫sde gu de/ /sbrang rtsi til mar cha mnyam pa/ /dri sna bzhi bzhi ⑫srang re gzhug /de las a ru ra gcig dang / /lde gu srang gcig bcas zos na/ /bde bar nad ni bre gang 'khru/ /skran dang snying nad 111—543

gzhang 'brum dang ①/ /glo nad lto sbos sbyar ba'i dug④ /mdze dang dmu rdzing nad slong dang / /yi ga 'chus ④dang mcher pa'i nad/ /skya rbab mig ser 'joms par byed/ /'di ni dan da ④tsi tra ka /a ru ra yi lde gu yin/ /su dha k+ṣ-i ⑤ra'i rlan dang ni/ /dur byid dang ni legs bsres ⑦te/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi zho gnyis bcas/ /lde gus ⑦legs par 'khru bar 'gyur/ /ru rta dur byid a ru ra/ / dan da ⑧gu gul nas tshig 'khus/ /ba gcin bcas blud yang na ni/ /gu gul nyi tshe ba gcin blud/ /cho ga grub pa las bshad pa'i/ /bkru sman drag po skran 'joms gtang / /rtsa ba zug cing lhun che la/ /sra zhing phyi la tshor ba med/ /gting ring ma smin pa yi skran/ /thal sman dang ni chang rnying dang / /me yi las kyis bsal bar bya/ /bad kan shas che thal sman ni/ /gzhang 'brum rde'u pho ba'i nad/ /gso ba'i skabs bshad gtang bya zhing / /zhag gcig zhag gnyis kyis chod pa/ /yang na zhag gsum ngal sos la/ /lus kyi nyams stobs nad dag ni/ /'phel 'bri'i las la brtson par bya/ /thang shing dur byed dan da dang / /pu tse ⑨shel dang tsha ba lnga/ /swa ⑩rdzi ka thal nas tshig 'khus⑪/ /pa ta dang ni 'bras bu gsum/ /ru rta ba sar su garnya/ /zi ra nag po srang phyed phyed/ /lan tshwa lnga ni srang re dag /btags pa'i phye ma til mar dang / /zhag dang zho dang mar dang sbrus/ /rdza mar du ba ma shor bsregs⑫| /rdza ma me yi mdog 'gyur de'i/ /thal ba blangs pa 'o ma mar/ /dar ba chang sogs sbyar te blud/ /skran dang rtug 'gags rgyu rlugs dang / /gzhang 'brum dmu rdzing pho ba'i nad/ /srin nad brjed ⑫byed smyo byed gdon/ /mngal nad khu chu las gyur rde'u/ /byi la ⑫sbrul gyi dug rnams kyang / /thal 111—544

ba'i sman 'dis sel bar byed/ /bad kan las gyur skran la snum/ /sha khu 'o ma mar bsten la/ /thal sman btang na skran dag ni/ /gnas nas dum bu dum bu ru/ /bcad nas thur du 'byin par byed/ /me drod chung zhing yi ga 'chus/ /chang goms snum can za ba la/ /rgyun srang dag phyir mnan chad ①dang / /chang rnying skyon med blud par bya/ /sā ②lu drug cu pa rnying pa/ /rgya sran skam sa'i srog chags sha /tsi tra pu ri ①ka rañdza/ / a ti ④man da la la phud/ /ba ri na ⑤yi myu gu dang / /shi kru bil ba gzhon nu dang / /la phug gzhon nu skam po dang / /kha lung shing kun star bu dang / /se 'bru nas chig rjo'akhus thal ba/ /tsha ba gsum dang dar ba dang / /mar dang til mar kha zas sbyin/ /btung bar chang gi dwangs ma dang / /sgyur rtsabs dar ba zho ga chu/ /bi da ⑦la la phud phye ma/ /rtsa ba la ⑧bskol khu ba 'am/ /rgun chang rnying ⑨pa blud par bya//pi pi ling dang de'i ⑩rtsa ba/ /go snyod rgyam tsha kru trug tres/ /chang gi snyigs mar bsres pa yis/ /skran ni myur du sel bar byed/ /slon dang sgyung ba dugs dang ni/ /sman mar blud dang bkru ⑪sman dang / /'jam rtsi thal sman mnan chang dang / /chang rnying ri lu ⑫phan zas kyis/ /bad kan skran can gting zug pas/ /gal te zhi bar ma gyur na/ /de la khrag dbyung tha mar ni/ /mde'u lcags sogs kyis bsreg par bya/ /de nas skran ni mthar thug par/ /sman pas gos kyis dkris nas ni/ /lte ba chu so rgyu ma snying / /spu yi phreng ni ma gtogs par/ /shin tu gting thug ⑫ma yin par/ /mde'u bsregs pa 'am yang na ni/ /gzong bu'i lcags ni bsregs pa 'am/ / tin du ④ka yi shing gis bsreg /de nas bsil bas me dbal ni/ /zhi nas rma ltar gso bar bya/ /111—545

ma zhu rjes 'byel sgyung byas nas①/ /thug pa sogs kyis me drod bskyed/ /rang rang rim dang 'brel ②pa las/ /'dren ma'i gso bas gso bar bya/ /btsas pa'i dus ni 'das gyur pa'i/ /bud med la skran khrag skyes 'byung / /de la lus snum dugs byas par/ /snum gyi bkru sman gtang bar bya/ /til bskol mar dang bu ram dang / /tsha gsum ga bra'i rtsa ba'i ④phye/ /khrag las gyur pa'i skran dang ni/ /bud med zla mtshan med la blud/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba pi pi ling / /thang shing ka rañdza'i shun pa/ /pi pi ling gi rtsa ba yi/ /phye ma ④til bskol chur sbyar ba/ /blud na khrag skran nad sel byed/ /pa la sha yi thal ba ni/ /bre brgyad til mar mar bre brgyad/ /bskol te tshad bzhin blud na ni/ /skran ni snyi bar byed pa yin/ /gal te snyi bar ma gyur na/ /mngal gyi bkru sman gtang bar bya/ /til gyi lde gu thal sman bcas/ /yang na su dha ⑤k+ṣi rar sbyar/ /yang na de gnyis rjodang bsres pa'i/ /nya ni kha bo gtang bar bya/ /phag rgod nya yi mkhris pa yis/ /bsgos pa'i ras ma gzhug par bya/ /yang na bu ram thal sman gnyis/ /phabs ⑦sbyar mngal ni sbyang phyir gtang / /khrag mkhris sel ba'i ⑧thal sman ni/ /sbrang rtsi mar bcas lde gu sbyin/ /sgog skya'i chang ni rnon po dang / /nya yang de la sbyin par bya/ /rtsa ba bcu pa thal sman dang / /'o ma ba gcin mas gtang bya/ /des kyang khrag 'dzag ma gyur na/ /skran 'jig byed pa'i stisbyor ba phan/ /byung nas mar dang til mar bsku/ /bcad pa dag ni mi bya zhing / /sha khu 'bras chan bza' ba dang / /btung ba chang ni sar pa bludarka/ /khrag ni shas cher byung gyur na/ /khrag mkhris sel ba'i gso ⑩ba bya/ /rlung gi nad kyis nyen gyur na/ /rlung gi gso ba kun kyang bya/ /ltor ⑪sgos 111—546

sogs dang ①rtug skam la/ /rlung bsal gso ba ji bzhin bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las②/ gso ba'i gnas kyi snele'u bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas dmu rdzing gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /nad ni shas cher stsogs pa dang / /bu ga'i rgyun srang 'gags pa la/ /dmu rdzing 'byung bas rjode yi phyir/ /rtag tu bkru sman gtang bar bya/ /yang na zla ba gcig gam gnyis/ /e raṇ+ḍa'i mar ba ⑤gcin bcas/ /'o mar bcas pa'am ba gcin nam/ /ma he'i gcin ni blud bya zhing / /ba yi 'o ma blud par bya/ /lto sbos tsha bas nyam rjothag cing / /skom dang brgyal bas non pa la/ /rnga mo'i 'o ma blud par bya/ /rtsub cing rlung shas che ba yi/ /nad ni sbyong ⑦bar 'dod pa yis/ /snum chos ⑧dang ni sman mar dag /dmu rdzing 'joms pa sbyar bar bya/ /srang ⑨drug rtsa ba bcu pa'i chu/ /zho ga chu ni bre brgyad bskol/ /dong gra srang gsum mar dang ni| /til mar bre ni re re dang / /zho ga ⑩chu ni bre bzhi dag⑪ /bskol ba 'di ni blud gyur na/ /dmu rdzing thams cad 'joms par byed/ /rlung dang bad kan las byung ba'i/ /skran la'ang mchog tu phan pa yin/ /bzhi 'gyur chu dang nyis 'gyur gcin/ /kru trug tres srang gcig lde gu/ /bre gang mar bskol thal sman bcas/ /dmu rdzing can la blud par bya/ /nas dang rgya shug rgya sran dang / /rtsa ba lnga ni bskol ba'i chu/ /chang dang rang skyur bcas pa dang / /mar bskol ba yang blud par bya/ /snum 'di snum bcas nyams stobs ni/ / skye zhing ⑫rlung nad zhi gyur nas/ /nad ni gnas nas bskyod pa dang / /cho ga grub bshad bkru sman gtang / /pa to la'i ⑫rtsa 'bras bu gsum/ /skyer ba byi 111—547

dang ga zho re/ /kam pi la ①dang ni li ni/ /tsi tra ②ka zho gnyis gsum bzhi/ /phyer btags ①ba gcin sbyar ba blud/ /'khrus nas thug pa rjosha khu ni/ /skam sar gnas pa'i sha khu sbyin/ /de nas zhag drug 'o ma dang / /tsha ba gsum dang bskol ba ni/ /yang dang yang du blud byas na/ /'di yis dmu rdzing thams cad ni/ /dmu chur gyur kyang 'joms par byed/ /bi sha la dang shang khi ⑤ni/ /dan da seng phrom shun shu dag /rgya shug phre'u rgun 'bru rjodang / /rgya shug sbom chu bu ram chang / /ba gcin dang ni sbyar te blud/ /la la phud dang spa ma'i 'bras/ /'u su shu ti zi ra nag⑦/ pi pi ling rtsa ka ra bīsge/ /a za mo dang zur ba dkarasti/ /shu dag zi ra ⑩tsi tra ka /tsha ba gsum dang khron bu dang / /'bras bu gsum dang thal sman gnyis/ /ma nu ru rta lan tshwa lnga/ / byi dang ga ⑪rnams cha mnyam dang / /dan da cha gsum de bzhin du/ /dur byid bi sha la nyis 'gyur/ /sa da ⑫la ni bzhi 'gyur te/ /phye ma 'di ni sred med bu/ /zhes bya nad kyi tshogs 'joms byed/ /'di bsten nad ni mi gnas ⑫te| /khyab 'jug gis bcom lha min mtshungs/ /dmu rdzing nad ④la dar ba blud//skran can rgya shug chu sbyar blud/ /rlung gis ⑫lto sbos chang sbyar gtang / /rlung nad nyid la chang dwangs ⑩sbyar/ /phyi sa 'gags la zho ga ⑩chu/ /gzhang 'brum can la'ang zho ga chus/ /bcad snyam sems la da trig chus/ /ma zhu ba la chu dron las/ /mtshan bar rdol dang skya rbab dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde skad 'gags/ /snying dang spyopho ba'i nad dang ni/ /mdze dang me drod nyams dang rims/ /mche ba'i dug dang rtsa ba'i dug /dbyig ⑪dug sbyar ba'i dug bcas la/ /ci rigs par ni phye ma 'di/ /khong pa snum dang ldan pa la/ /111—548

blud nas 'khru ru gzhug par bya/ /spa ma'i 'bras bu bya snu dang / /'bras bu gsum dang ni li ni/ /pu tse shel dang kyi ①lce ba/ /dur byid shu dag sa ④ta la//rgyam tsha dang ni kha ru tsha/ /pi pi ling ni phye mar btags/ /se 'bru'i khu ba'am 'bras bu ni/ /gsum gyi khu ba'am sha khu 'am④/ /ba gcin dro 'jam chu las blud—/ /'dis ni skran nad ④thams cad dang / /mcher pa dmu rdzing thams cad dang / /sha bkra mdze nad ma zhu dang / /drod nyams me drod ma snyoms dang //gzhang 'brum skya rbab mig ser dang / /rkang lag zha ba'i nad dang ni/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan rnams/ /bkru sman btang bas myur du sel/ /ni li ni dang tsha ba gsum/ /lcang ma ya bak+ṣa ra dang / /lan tshwa lnga dang kru trug ⑤tres//phye ma zhun mar dhiblud na ni/ /dmu rdzing skran gyi nad rnams sel/ /sbyang byas nyam ⑦chung bar bar du/ /rnga mo ba 'am ra yi ni/ /'o ma sngon bzhin blud par bya—/ /bshol du med pa'i nad la ni/ /bkru sman phyir ni snum bcas gtang / /mchog tu nyam ⑧chung gyur la sbyin/ /a ru ra yi phye ma ni/ /bre gang mar ni bre bzhi dang / /me la bzhus stinas gzar bu yis/ /dkrugs nas nas kyi sbun ⑩pa'i nang / /zla gcig bzhag nas de rjes la/ /phyung ste legs par bzhus nas ni/ /a ru ra bskol khu ba dang / /zho ni sgyur po bcas pa bskol/ /de 'thungs dmu rdzing skran lto sbos/ /gtun 'dra'i rlung nad khong 'bras dang / /mdze dang sbyo byed brjed ⑪byed rnams/ /nye bar 'joms par byed pa yin/ /shrī ⑫khaṇ+ḍa ba'i 'o ma/ /bskol te bsgrangs nas gzar bus dkrugs⑫/ /las byung mar ni snu ha yi/ /'o mar bcas bskol snga mar mtshungs/ /'o ma bre ni bcu drug dang / /su dha ⑫k+ṣi ra bre phyed bcas/ /zhor ⑫gyur bsrubs pa las 111—549

gyur ①mar/ /dur byed bskol ba'ang yon tan de'o/ /mar ni bre gang dag dang ni/ /'o ma brgyad 'gyur nang du ni/ /snu ha'i 'o ma srang gcig dang / /dur byid srang drug bskol de bzhin/ /'di blud 'og tu thug pa dang / /sha khu mngar po'am 'o ma blud/ /ma zhu 'khrus par gyur pa dang / /bca' sga bskol ba'i chu dron blud/ /de nas thug pa de 'og ni/ /ku laṅga yi yu sha blud/ /de ltar khong rtsub zhag gsum blud/ /slar yang thug sogs rim par blud/ /rim pa 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /zhun mar yang dang yang du blud/ /mar ni bskol bar gyur pa 'di/ /sman pa las la byang ba yis/ /skran rnams dang ni dbyig dug dang / /dmu rdzing bsal phyir blud par bya/ /yang na pi lu ④lde gur bskol/ /lto sbos sel bar ①blud par bya/ /seng phrom ni li rjoni mar ram//'dres pa'i sman mar blud par bya/ /nad bsal nas ni rim gyis zas/ /sā ⑤lu'i 'bras chan yang zhing nyung / /byen la dmu rdzing can gyi ni/ /nad rjokyi lhag ma dag bya'i phyir/ /a ru ra ni rdog ma stong / /ba gcin dang sbyar 'o ma blud—/ /yang na pi pi ling rdog stong / /su dha ⑦k+ṣ-i rar legs bsres pa'am⑧/ /pi pi ling ni bskyed sbyin pa'am/ /'o mar 'thung zhing ⑨brag zhun bza'/ /de bzhin gu gul 'o ma dang / /cha mnyam sge'u ⑩gsher khu ba sbyin/ /yang na thang shing tsi tra ka'i/ /sde gu 'o mar sbyar ba blud/ /zla gcig ha ti ⑪pi pi ling / /bca' sga 'o mar bcas pa blud/ /dan da tsi tra byi dang ga /dbyi mo ⑫tsha ba gsum lde gu/ /zho gnyis 'o ma sbyar blud na/ /dmu rdzing 'phel ba sel bar byed//yang na su dh+wa ⑫k+ṣ-i ra mar/ /bcas pa'i kha zas zla gcig sbyin/ /su dhā k+ṣi ra la spyosbangs pa'i/ /pi pi ling dang khur ba spyosbyin/ /gal te rtsib logs gzer zhing 111—550

rengs| /snying brgal rlung gi nad ldang na/ /de la til mar bil ba dang / /thal sman dang ni ldan par sbyin/ / tun tu ①ka dang ba la dang / /pa la sha 'am til sdong dang / /a pa marga ka ta li/ /asdi man+d+ra'i sdethal ba rnams/ /so sor gzags pa bskol ba blud/ /bad kan rlung ngam mkhris pa 'am de gnyis rlung dang 'dres gyur pa/ /stobs ldan rang gi sman bcas pa'i e raṇ+ḍa yi til mar phan/ /thang shing arga pa la sha /ha ti pi pi ling shi kru/ /a shwa kar+ṇa sneb gcin bcas/ /sde gu lto ba'i phyi rim byug /bri shi ④ka li shu dag dang / /bca' sga rtsa ba lnga pa dang / /'u su ru rta ba spru gnyis/ /bskol ba ba ⑤gcin bcas pa blugs/ /'khrus shing lto rjob zhum 'gyur ba'i/ / sa ra ⑦na la sogs dugs bya/ /gos kyis legs par dkri bar bya/ /de ltar rlung gis dze+esgos mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig legs par 'khrus gyur pa/ /slar yang sbos gyur ⑨de la ni/ /snum bcas skyur dang lan tshwa gnyis⑩/ /bkru sman mas gtong drag por bya/ /rlung gis rengs ⑩dang bcas gyur pas/ /gang zhig lto sbos gyur pa'i mi/ /de la thal sman rnon po ni/ /ba gcin bcas pa ⑫mas gtong bya/ /de ltar dmu rdzing spyi yi ni/ /gso ba grags par ⑫bshad pa yin/ /de nas rlung gyur dmu rdzing can/ /bi da ri ⑫sogs mar bskol blud/ /de nas snum gyis zhen byas shing / /yan lag dugs bya bkru sman gtang / /'di la seng phrom mar ram ni/ /'dres pa'i sman mar lan mang blud/ /thug stsogs rim pa byas nas ni/ /stobs bskyed phyir ni 'o ma blud/ /nyams stobs rnyed nas rim rmis ni/ /'o ma de ni spang bar bya/ /yu sha sha khu skyur dang ni/ /lan tshwar bcas pas ⑫me drod bskyed/ /rtug 'gags gyur nas slar snum dang / /111—551

dugs ①bya de 'og mas gtong byadze+e/ /rtsub cing mas gtong sman bcas pa'i/ /rtsa ba bcu pa'i mas gtong sbyar/ /g.yo zhing tshigs rus la 'jug pa/ /rtsub cing 'phyen ④dang phyi sa 'gags/ /me drod che la til mar dang / /e raṇ+ḍa'i mar rlung 'joms pa'i④/ /sman dang bskol ba'i 'jam rtsi gtang / /khrus mi bya la 'o ma mar/ /sha khu la sogs zhi byed gtang / /mkhris pa las gyur stobs che la—/ /mngar dang sbyar ba'i snum chos ⑤bya/ /sha ma dur byid 'bras bu gsum/ /bskol ba'i khu ba'i bkru sman gtang / /de 'og n+ya go dha sogs bskol/ /khu bar dukha ra sbrang rtsi mar/ /ldan pa ni ru ha yang phan/ /de bskol snum gyi 'jam rtsi gtang / /nyam ⑦chung dang po 'jam rtsi gtang / /'o ma mas gtong gis sbyang bya/ /me stobs bskyed cing snum chos bya⑧/ /'o ma dur byid lde gu 'am—/ /e raṇ+ḍa dang bskol ba 'am/ /sa da la dang kyi lce ba'am/ /dong ga bskol ba dag gis bya/ /bad kan bcas la ba gcin bcas/ /rlung can tig ta mar bcas pa'i⑨/ /yang dang yang du bkru sman gtang / /'di dag 'o mar bcas bza' ba'am/ /bi da ri ⑩sogs sde bskol blud/ /dmu rdzing can la 'o thug ni/ /sbyin zhing nye bar bsku bar bya/ /slar yang 'o ma 'jam rtsi dang / /bkru sman yang dang yang du gtang / /rim pas ⑪nges par gnas byas ⑫te/ /ma yengs mkhris gyur dmu rdzing bsal/ /bad kan las gyur snum chos ⑫bya/ /dug mo nyung sogs mar bskol gtang / /nyams stobs ldan pas dugs byas te/ /su dha ⑫k+ṣi ra'i bkru sman gtang / /thug sogs rim dang thal sman tsha/ /ldan pas bad kan sel ba sbyin/ /ba gcin tsha gsum til mar bcas/ /mas gtong drag po bya ba'ang phan/ / muṅga ka ⑫sogs lde gu dang / /snum gyi 'jam rtsi de 111—552

nas gtang / /kha zas 'o ma tsha ba gsum/ /yang na rgya sran khu ba sbyin/ /bad kan 'thas shing lto ba skrang / /rmongs ①bag snying 'phar yi ga 'chus/ /me drod chung ba chang goms na/ /chang snying ②nas tshig 'khus thal blud/ /shing kun dang ni pi pi ling / /'bras bu gsum dang thad shing dang / /ser po rnam gnyis go bye dang / /na le sham dkar pu tse shel/ /seng snephrom shu dag ④bca' sga dang / /bong nga gla sgang ru rta dang / /sa ra na dang lan tshwa dang ⑤/ /btags pa zho dang snum bzhi sbyar/ /du ba ma shor bar bsregs la/ /thal ba de las zho gnyis dang / /chang dang chu dron zho ga chu/ /chang rnying mnan chang sbyar ba blud| /skran dang dmu rdzing gtun 'dra'i nad/ /rtsig pa 'dra dang gsud dang skranarjo/ /snying nad mcher pa gzhang 'brum dang / /rtug 'gags nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /bad kan dmu rdzing nyam ⑦chung la/ /chang rnying dang ni ba gcin dang / /lcags phye dang sbyar btung ba dang / /thal sman til mar bcas pa blud/ /nyungs kar phabs dang la phug gi/ /sa bon btab sgepa'i lde gu yis/ /bsku zhing dmu rdzing dugs bya ba/ /'di la rgyun du sbyang bar bya| /'dus pa las gyur dmu rdzing ni/ /me drod nyams stobs ma zad la/ /nad shas che ltar re thag chad/ /gso ba'i sbyor ba 'di bya'o/ /dan da tra pan ti'i 'bras bu/ /babyung ba'i mar ni blud pa bsngags/ /dmu rdzing gsos kyang ⑨ma 'chos dang / /mchog tu nyes ⑫gsum las gyur la⑪/ /de yi nye du dris nas ni—/ /ka ka da ni ⑫'ol ma se⑫/ /ka ra bī ⑫ra'i rtsa ba dag /btags pa'i lde gu chang sbyar blud/ /yang na bza' btung nang du ni/ /dug kyang rim ⑫pas sbyin par bya/ /gang du sbrul ni khros gyur nas⑫/ /shing tog la ni dug bsgos 111—553

pa① / /de yis 'di yi nad tshogs ni/ /brtan zhing zhen pa lam log zhugs/ /bshig ste phyir ni 'byin par byed/ /dug gis myur du 'jig par byed/ /de bzhin nad med 'gyur ba 'am/ /'chi ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /nad bsal nad de chu grang gis②/ /khrus byas 'o ma'am thug pa blud/ /dur byed kyi ni tshod ma 'am/ /rgya sde'u mar ti ka paṇi⑦/ /ka la sha ka sde'u yi/ /khu ba dang ni bskol ba la/ /skyur dang lan tshwa snum med cing / /shin tu tshos pa'am ma tshos min/ /zas med zla ba gcig sbyin la/ /de nas skom ④na khu ba blud/ /de ltar zla ba gcig gi bar/ /tshod mas ⑤nad ni bsal gyur nas/ /nyam rjochung ba la brtas byed pa/ /rnga mo'i 'o ma blud par bya/ /mcher pa'i dmu rdzing nad gzhi ni/ /ji bzhin snum chos dugs ⑦bya ste/ /zho dang 'bras chan bcas byin larka/ /lag pa g.yon nas gtar ga gdab/ /nyam ⑧stobs rnyed nas slar yang ni—/ /snum blud nas ni sbyang bar bya/ /rgya mtsho'i nya phyis thal sman dang / /'o ma sbyar ba blud par bya/ / pu ti ⑨ka radzi'i thal ba/ /skyur khu kha ru tsha dang niske/ /pi pi ling gi phye btab blud/ /shi ⑩kru bskol ba ⑪pi pi ling / /rgyam tsha tsi tra ka btab blud/ /shing ⑫kun stsogs phye thal sman dang / /mar sbyar me drod ji bzhin sbyin/ /dong gra dan da ⑫pi pi ling / /cha mnyam a ru ra nyis ⑫'gyur—/ /kha ru tsha ni cha phyed bcas/ /phye ma chu dron sbyar ba blud/ / byi dang ga ⑫dang kru trug tres/ /phye dang rgyam tsha shu dag rnams/ /kham skyogs nang bsregs ⑩'o mar bcas/ /blud na skran dang mcher nad 'joms/ /rgya shug lo ma til mar bsres pa dag /legs par mnyes shing bsregs te de 'og tu//gtun bus btsir la de 'og 'o ma blud/ /mcher pa ⑩dmu rdzing tshogs ni 'jig 111—554

par 'gyur/ /ro nyi ta yi lcug ①ma gtubs/ /dmu bu a ru ra bcas chu'am/ / ba gcin ②nang du zhag bdun ni/ /sbangs la de ni blud gyur na/ /mig ser mcher pa skran gzhang 'brum/ /srin nad gcin snyi dmu rdzing 'joms /ro hi ta ka'i shun lpags ni/ /srang ni nyi shu rtsa lnga'i tshad/ /rgya shug bre dor ③bcas pa ni/ /bskol ba'i khu ba byas nas ni/ /tsha ba lnga ni srang re dang / /de dag kun dang mnyam pa yi/ /ro hi ta ka'i shun lpags phye/ /mar bre gang dang btsos nas ni/ /'di blud pa yis myur du ni/ /mcher pa rab tu 'phel ba sel / /chu shing til gyi sdong po dang rjo/ /bu ram shing bsregs ⑤thal ba ni/ /til mar bskol ba blud gyur na/ /bad rlung las gyur mcher nad 'joms/ /ma zhi skran gyi cho ga ltar/ /rlung dang rjobad kan shas che la⑦/ /mcher nad spyi bag ma gyur la/ /me yi las ni spyad par bya/ /mkhris gyur ⑧'tsho byed sna bcu dang / /mar dang 'o ma'i 'jam rtsi gtang / /khrag dbyung sbyang ba bya ba dang / /'o ma blud par gyur pa'ang ⑨bsngags/ /mchin pa mcher pa la ⑩ltar gso/ /gtar ga lag pa g.yas nas bya/ /rgyu ma 'gags gyur dugs byas la/ /ba gcin sman ni rno bcas pa'i/ /til mar lan tshwa bcas pa yi/ /ni ru ha ni 'jam rtsir byas/ /phyi sa sla 'gyur kha zas dang / /bkru sman rnon po 'di la gtang / /rtug 'gags bsal ba'i gso ba ni/ /rlung 'joms byed pa gang yin bya/ /rgyu ma rdol ⑪ba'i dmu rdzing la/ /dugs ma gtogs pa'i gso ba kun//bad kan dmu rdzing lta bur bya/ /sogs pa bzhin du chu gzags shing / /sman pas de ltar ⑫'tsho tsam bya/ /dmu chu la ni chu yi ni/ /nyes sel sman ni dang po ni⑫| /sman rno ba gcin ldan pa dang / /sna tshogs thal sman ldan par sbyin/ /111—555

drod skyed bad kan 'joms pa yi/ /zas kyis ①de ni gso bar bya/ /ra yi ril ma'i thal ba'i chu/ /ba gcin bcas gzags me bskol ba/ /ska bar gyur pa de nang du/ /pi pi ling dang de'i rtsa ba/ /bca' sga dur byid lan tshwa lnga/ /dan da khron bu 'bras bu gsum/ /shu dag karka ta sring ②gi/ /ya bak+ṣa ra pa gta la/ /swa rdzi ④k+ṣa ra zhes bya ba/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis btags phye gzhug /rgya shug tsam gyi ri lu ⑤bya/ /de nas skyur rtsabs dang sbyar larjo/ /blud na ma zhu 'or nad dang / /dmu chu'i nad ni 'phel ba sel/ /de ltar sman gyis ⑦ma thub na/ /rgyu 'gags la sogs dmu rdzing gsum/ /gnyen gyi rgyal po la zhus te//mtshon gyi las ⑧ni spyad par bya/ /rgyu 'gags rdol ba'i dmu rdzing la/ /snum zhen dugs byas lte ba'i 'og /g.yon logs su ni sor bzhi yi/ /lto ba'i phyogs su ⑨bzhag nas ni⑩/ /sor bzhi tsam gyi tshad ⑪dbral la/ /de nas rgyu ma phyung nas ni/ /btags te spu dang dri ma dang / /'byar bag rdo ba la sogs bsalarka/ / brtol ba ⑫zug rngu phyung nas ni/ /rnam par bsal la gzags par bya/ /bu ga dbral la 'char gzhug cing / /zin nas de yi lus kyi ni/ /mgo bo rnam par gcad par bya/ /de rjes mar dang sbrang rtsi yis/ /bskus nas rgyu ma legs par gzhug /de 'og phyi'i ngos nas ⑫rma btsem/ /de nas sa nag shing mngar gyi/ /lde gus ④legs par bsku bar bya/ /de 'og rlung med gnas su ni/ /bzhag la 'o mas gsos pa dang / /snum gyi snod nas bcing ⑫bar bya/ /chu bcas dmu rdzing til mar ni/ /rlung 'joms bskol bas bskus nas ni/ /chu dron blugs pas dugs bya zhing / /lto ba ras kyis ⑫dkris nas ni—/ /rgyu 'gags rdol ⑩par bshang nas ⑫su/ /sor gcig tsam ni dbug ⑫111—556

par bya/ /der ni gce'u bcug nas ni①/ /de la chu phyed gzags par bya /de nas gce'u phyung nas ni/ /til dang rgyam tsha'i sde gu yis/ /rma bskus nas ni bkag nas su/ /ras kyis lto ba dkri bar bya/ /zhag gsum yang na zhag bzhi zhing / /zhag ni bcu drug bar gyis ②bya/ /de ni bar bar dub bste zhing //chu ni nyung zad nyung zad dbyung / /lto ni lhod par gyur pa na/ /shin tu dam du dkri bar bya/ /chu ni gzags pa ①sgyung byas la/ /thug pa lan tshwa snum med blud| /zla drug bar du 'o mas gso/ /zla gsum thug pa 'o thug blud/ /zla gsum bar du 'o thug gam/ /'bras bu skyur bcas sha khu ni/ /lan tshwa snum ni nyung ba blud/ /khre dang ci tse rnying pa sbyin/ /de ltar lo gcig 'bad pa yis④/ /chu yi dmu rdzing legs par gso/ /spang ba rnams ni bsdams ⑤pa dang / /brtan par bya zhing skom med bya/ /gang phyir dmu rdzing thams cad ni/ /nad sogs pa las byung rjobs na/ /de phyir rlung sogs bsal ba yi/ /gso ba kun la bsngags pa yin/ /nad kyis lto ba gang 'gyur bas/ /me drod 'bri bar gyur pa yin/ /de bas nang na ⑦drod skyed pa'i/ /rtsa ba lnga bcas nyung ba dang //lan tshwa snum dang kha ba nyung / /'ju sla'i kha zas sbyin par bya/ /ba gcin dang ni sbangs pa yi/ /drug cu pa yi 'bras dag las/ /thug pa 'o thug btsos nas ni| /ci 'dod par ni sbyin par bya/ /dmu rdzing skyon ni sbyang ba'i phyir/ /de rjes bu ram shing khu blud/ /de ⑧ni rlung mkhris bad kan rnams/ /rang rang gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /shin tu tsha ba'i chu lan tshwa/ /rtsub cing bshang sri grang ⑨zhing lci/ /bu ram til g.yos tshod ma dang / /chu 'thung ⑩lus ni 'khru ba dang / /rtsol drags ⑪lam dub nyin mo gnyid/ /bzhon pas 'gro ba spang 111—557

bar bya/ /shin tu ska sla min zhing mngar/ /dar ba skom du blud pa bsngags/ /rlung la rgyam tsha pi pi ling / /mkhris par ka ra tsha ba gsum/ /bad kan las gyur la la phud/ /rgyam tsha zi ra sbrang rtsi dang / /tsha ba gsum dang ldan pa sbyin/ /'dus pa las gyur sbrang rtsi dang / /shu dag til mar bca' sga dang / /shu ti ru rta lce myang tsha/ /mcher pa rgyun ①'gags dmu rdzing la/ /tsha ba gsum dang la la phud/ /rgyam tsha go snyod spa ⑧'bras bcas/ /rgyu rdol sbrang rtsi pi pi ling /tsha ba gsum dang ldan pa blud/ /chu yi dmu rdzing can la ni/ /tsha ba gsum bcas blud na phan/ /rlung dang bad kan gyis gzir zhing / /lus lci lto sbos yi ga 'chus/ /tshad ①'khru me drod nyams pa la/ /dar ba bdud rtsi lta bu yin/ /sbyor ba kun gyi rjes la ni/ /'o ma nye bar sbyar bya ste/ /lus zungs thams cad brtan byed cing / /stobs bskyed nad ni lhag lus sel/ /sman gyis ④nyams smad gyur lus la/ /'o ma bdud rtsi lta bu yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u bco lnga pa'o// //de nas skya rbab kyi nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /skya rbab nad la dang por ni/ /dge ba chen po'i sman mar ram/ /ba yi lnga dang tig ta che'am//dong ga sogs bskol sman mar blud/ /se'u 'bru phul gang 'u su phyed/ /tsi tra ka dang bca' sga las/ /srang re pi pi ling srang phyed/ /lde gur byas pa mar srang ni/ /nyi shu chu bre bzhi nang bskol/ /skya rbab snying nad gzhang 'brum skran/ /mcher rlung bad kan gyis nyen sel/ /drod skyed lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /sel zhing dbugs 'khyil bder 'byung byed/ /bu btsas dka' dang mo gsham ⑤111—558

la| /'di ni mchog tu bsngags pa yin/ /snum byas skyug ①sman rnon po gtang / /slar yang snum bcas ②bkru sman ni/ /'o ma gcin sbyar btang ba 'am| /mkhur bkang lan mang byas pas sbyang / /dan da'i 'bras bu'i khu ba dro| /tang pal yang na rgun 'bru ①ni/ /srang brgyad zhag gcig sbangs mnyes ④pa/ /de 'thungs skya rbab nad sel to/ /a ru ra btags ba gcin sbyar| /yang na de bskol 'bras bu gsum/ /khron bu ma sha dur byid dang / /thang shing bca' sga'i lde gu ni/ /ba gcin srang brgyad sbyar ba 'am ba gcin lhan cig bskol ba blud/ /de dag nyid ni mar bskol ba/ /blud na'ang nad ni sel bar byed/ /yang na lcags phye ba gcin nam/ /'o mar zhag bdun bzhag pa blud/ /zhu nas kha zas 'o ma 'am/ /sha khu mngar po sbyin par bya⑤| /stod smad sbyangs nas a ru ra/ /sbrang rtsi mar sbyar lde gu sbyin/ /bi sha la dang pu tse shel/ /gla sgang ru rta thang shing dang / /dug mo nyung ni zho gnyis gnyis/ /mur ba srang phyed bong nga 0ni/ /zho gcig de yi phyer btags chu/ /dro 'jam sbyar blud sbrang rtsi sbyin/ /skya rbab rims dang khong tsha dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde skran sbos/ /yi ga 'chus dang ma zhu rlung / /khrag mkhris des ⑦ni sel bar byed/ /sle tres dang ni ba sha ka /'bras bu gsum dang pu tse sgeshel/ /tig ta nim pa rtsa mkhris rnams/ /bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi ⑨ni / /btab pa blud na skya rbab dang / /mig ser khrag mkhris 'joms par byed—/ /tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka /'bras bu gsum dang bye dang ga⑫ /ga dur dang mnyam lcags kyi phye/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi dar ba 'am/ /chu dron 'o mar sbyar blud na/ /mig ser skya rbab snying nad dang / /mdze dang gzhang 111—559

'brum nad rnams sel/ /dong gra ①lcags phye til dang ni/ /bu ram cha mnyam pa yi tshad/ /pi pi ling ni nyis 'gyur gzhug /ri lu skya rbab can la sbyin/ /ta bya ②skyer pa'i shun pa dang / /dbyi mong pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /thang shing rtsa ba gsum stsogs dgu/ /phye mar btags pa nyis 'gyur gyi/ /man du ra'i phye dngul rdo 'dra/ /de dag gi ni brgyad 'gyur gyi/ /ba gcin nang du so sor bskol—/ / ri lur ①bya bar bzod pa dang / /gcig tu bsres te ri lur bya/ /'di ni ma du ra'i ri lu④/ /de zos dar ba 'thungs na ni/ /skya rbab can la srog ster ro/ /mje dang ma zhu 'or nad dang / /brla rengs yi ga 'chus pa dang / /gzhang 'brum mig ser gcin snyi dang / /mtsher pa'i nad rnams zhi bar byed/ /ta bya ⑤brag zhun rngul lcags kyi/ /dri ma sna re rjosrang lnga lnga/ /tsi tra ka dang 'bras bu gsum/ /tsha ba gsum dang bye dang ga⑦ /srang re kha ra srang brgyad sbyar/ /phye ma sbrang rtsisalgesbrus pa yis/ /skya rbab dug dang lud pa lu/ /gcong chen mi bzad rims dang ni/ /mdze dang ma zhu gcin sri dang / /skran dbugs mi bde yi ga 'chus/ /khyad par du ni brjed ⑨byed dang / /mig ser gzhang 'brum nad rnams 'joms/ /dug mo nyung dang 'bras bu gsum/ /nim pa gla sgang pa to la/ /dong gra ⑩bskol ba'i khu bar ni/ /brag zhun srang brgyad zhag bcur ram⑪/ /nyi shu'am sum cu'i ⑫bar du sbangs/ /ka ra dkar po de mnyam dang / /smig ⑫rkang dang ni pi pi ling / /kar ka ta ⑩sring skyu ru ra/ /srang re'i tshad du byas pa dang / /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑫ri'i rtsa 'bras bu/ /srang gcig tshad du byas pa dang / /dri sna gsum ni zho gnyis gnyis/ /sbrang rtsi srang gsum byas pa dang / /ri lu ⑫zho gnyis tshad byas zos/ /se 'bru'i khu ba 111—560

'o ma dang / /bya yi sha khu chu dron dang / /a sa ba dang chang rnying dang / /de ni zos rjes blud pa 'am/ /zas sngon zas kyi rjes blud na/ /skya rbab mdze dang rims mcher pa/ /mgo 'khor gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol/ /rnag ①dang snying nad khu ba'i nad/ /gcin nad drod nyams sel byed cing / /skem dang sbyar dug dmu rdzing dang / /lud ②pa khrag mkhris gsar snepa dang / /'or nad skran dang lkog ma'i nad/ /rgyu rlugs mgo 'khor bcas pa yi/ /nad kun sel zhing dge ba yin/ /rgun 'bru ④pi pi ling bre re/ /kha ra srang ni lnga bcu dang / /shing mngar bca' sga smig ⑤rkang dag /srang ni gnyis gnyis bye mar byas /skyu ru ra khu rjobre bcu drug /nang gzhug lde gu bzhin du bskal⑦/ /bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi bre gang gzhug /de las ⑧zho gnyis tshad zos na/ /gzugs 'khums skya rbab nad dang ni/ /mig ser gyi ni nad 'joms so/ /rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu'i chu/ / rgun 'bru ⑨skyu ru ra'i khu ba/ /bza' dang btung bar sbyar ba ni| /skya rbab mig ser nad sel to/ /de ltar skya rbab nad la ni/ /spyi yi sman ni bstan ⑩pa yin/ /mkhas pas nad dmigs so so yi/ /stobs dbang las kyang sbyar bar bya/ /rlung gyur phal cher snum chos ⑪bya/ /mkhris par rtekha dang bsil ba gtang / /bad kan las gyur rtsub tsha dro/ /'dus par ⑫'dren mar sbyar bar bya/ /sa skezos las gyur sbyang ba ni/ /rnon pos lus las skebasal bar bya/ /de 'og lto sbyang ⑩stobs bskyed phyir/ /de la zhun mar sbyin par bya / /tsha ba gsum dang bil ba dang / /ser po gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum/ /ba spru ba gnyis gla sgang dang / /lcags phye pa ta byi dang ga⑫ /thang shing bre— ⑫ka li dang / /ga bra'i rtsa ba 'o ma mar/ /bskol ba 'thungs na ⑪sa zhag zos/ /111—561

las gyur nad ni thams cad sel/ /de bzhin nā ga ge sar dang / /shing mngar ku sha pi pi ling / /'o maratubaskol ba blud na phan/ /de la sred par gyur na ni/ / byi dang ga dang pa sketa dang / /nim pa bskol ba'i khu ba 'am/ /mur ba dang bsres sa zhag ④dag /sred pa dgag phyir sbyin par bya/ /sa zhag bye brag tha dad nad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i sman sbyin bya/ /mig ser la ni mkhris 'joms sman/ /skya rbab gnod pa med pa sbyin/ /a ru ra ni brgya'i khu bar/ /a ru ra rdog lnga bcu'i phyed④/ /mar ni bre gang nang du bskol/ /skran dang mig ser skya rbab 'joms/ /dong ga bur shing khu ba 'am/ /bi da ri dang skyu ru ra'i/ /khu ba tsha ba gsum bcas la/ /srang gcig blud na mig ser 'joms/ /dan+da bu ram nyis 'gyur gyi/ /lde gu chu grang sbyar ba blud/ /dur byid phye ma sbrang rtsir bcas⑤ / /'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba blud/ /'bras bu gsum mam sle tres sam/ /skyer pa'am nim pa'i khu ba dag /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba nang re ni/ /mig ser gyis ni nyen la blud/ /skyer pa yug snam skyu ru ra/ /mig ser sel ba'i mig sman yin/ /mig ser can gang dri ma ni/ /til btags lta bur byung gyur na/ /bad kan lam bkag rjode la ni/ /bad kan mkhris pa sel bas ⑦gso/ /rtsub grang phyi dang mngar ba dang / /drag shul rlung ni 'gags pa yis/ /rlung dang bad kan gcig gyur pa/ /mkhris pa phyir 'byin de yi tshe/ /mig dang pags pa ser ba dang / /phyi sa skya bar gyur pa dang / /bshang 'gags rgyu ma 'khrugs ⑧pa dang / /snying ga lci ba nyid ⑨'gyur la/ /mkhris pa'i yan lag la brten pa⑩//rid cing drod chung rtsib logs gzer/ /skyigs bu lud pa yi ga 'chus/ /rims 'debs rim gyis spyo'abyung bar 'gyur/ /de la rma bya'am ⑫khyim bya dang / /111—562

sreg pa'i sha khu'am la phug ni/ /skam sa'i ①khu ba'am rgya sran khu②/ /rtsub kha skyur bar sbyar ba sbyin/ /rab tsha skyur dang rno ba dang / /lan tshwa shin tu dro ba'ang bsngags/ /kha lung khu ba tsha ba gsum/ /sbyar ba'i lde gu'ang sbyin par bya| /des ni mkhris pa rang gnas su/ /'jug cing bshang mdog tha mal 'gyur| /rgyu ma 'khrugs sogs bla brnan ⑦bcas/ /rlung yang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /'di yis bla brnan ④zhi nas ni/ /mig ser gso ba'i cho ga bya/ /mig ser khong du zhen pa na/ /brag zhun ba gcin dang sbyar ba/ /gser gyi dri ma'am ta ⑤bya ni/ /ba gcin sbyar ba zla gcig blud/ /ha li sa ka sle tres khurka/ /'o ma ma te'i mar bskol ba'i/ /skyu ru rjor yi khu ba dang / /dur byid sbyar ba'i bkru sman blud/ /'khrus nas kha zas mngar bag ni/ /rlung 'joms mkhris pa 'joms pa sbyin/ /sngar bshad rgun 'bru ⑦lde gu dang / /mngar ba'i sman mar zhun mar sbyin/ /'o ma ⑧mas gtong sman dang ni/ /'jam rtsir ⑨bcas pa bsten par bya/ /me drod bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ /rgun chang chang rnying sbyin bya zhing / /lud pa'i skabs bshad a ru ra'i/ /shing mngar dar ba pi pi ling / /'o mar bcas pas ⑩nad dmigs dang / /me drod ji bzhin sbyin par bya/ /mkhas pas 'or nad skabs bshad pa'i/ /gso ba ⑪skya rbab la yang sbyar/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u bcu drug pa'o// //de nas 'or nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /'or nad yan lag kun zhugs shing / /nad skyes ma smin la dang por/ /sgyung byas kha zas yang ba 111—563

bza'①—/ /bong nga thang shing bye dang ga② /dug mo nyung dang na le sham/ /bskol ba'i chu dron blud par bya/ /yang na a ru ra bca' sga/ /thang shing ba spru bskol ba 'am/ /lcags phye dgu par bcas pa blud/ /'or nad shas cher a ru ra/ /ba gcin bcas pa sbyang phyir blud/ /'bras bu gsum bskol pu tse shel//dur byid lcags phye tsha gsum bcas/ /yang na dze+ede bzhin gu gul lam/ /brag zhun dang ni sbyar ba blud/ /me drod chung zhing ma byun la/ /byu zhing rtug 'gags yang na 'khru/ /tsha ba gsum dang rtsab rjoru tsha/ /sbrang rtsi dar bar sbyar ba 'am/ /a ru ra dang bu ram bcas/ /bu ram bca' sgar ⑤sbyar ba 'am/ /zos rjes dar ba blud par bya/ /sge'u gsher bu ram cha mnyam pa/ /srang phyed tshad kyis bskyed nas ni/ /che tshad srang lnga'i bar du ni/ /zla gcig za zhing yu sha dang / /'o ma sha khu bcasalgezos na/ /'or nad dmu rdzing skran gzhang 'brum/ /gcin dang dbugs mi bde cham pa/ /sgyid snyom ma zhu mig ser dang / /lus skem gdon gyi nad rnams dang / /lud pa bad kan sbyor 'dis sel/ /sge'u gsher dong gra ⑦sde gu'i khu ba dang / /'o ma dag dang mar ni bskol blud na/ /'or nad sprid pa dmu rdzing me drod nyams/ /nad kyis zil non na yang nad med 'gyur—/ /ma zhu med cing phyi sa 'gags/ /'or nad kyis gzir tsha ba gsum//dur byid dan da kru trug tres/ /bskol ba'i 'o ma blud par bya/ /ma ho'am yang na ba gcin nam/ /'o ma btung zhing de dang bza'/ /zhag bdun yang na zla gcig par/ /rnga mo'i 'o ma blud pas gso/ /ti mu sa dang nas tshig thal/ /la la phud dang tsha ba lnga/ /na le sham dang se 'bru dang / /pa ta 'u su star bu dang / /bil ba gzhon nu zho gnyis gnyis/ /chu bre bzhi bskol mar bre gang / /111—564

bskol ba blud na 'or nad dang / /gzhang 'brum skran dang za khu 'joms/ /zho dang tsi ①tra ka bsres las/ /byung ba'i mar ni dar bar bcas/ /tsi tra ka btab bskol ba ni/ /yon tan gong ma mtshungs pa yin/ /thang la 'bar dang tig ta che/ /dge ba'am a ru ra'i sman mar/ /dus shes pa yis sbyin par bya//rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu ba ni/ /bre bzhir a ru ra brgya bskol/ /der ni bu ram srang brgya gzhug /tsha ba gsum dang dri sna gsum④/ /nas tshig 'khus ①thal cung zad btab/ /bsgrangs nas sbrang ④rtsi bre phyed gzhug /de byin nas ni 'or nad dang / /rims skran gcin nad lus skem pa/ /ma zhu khrag mkhris rlung dang ni/ /sgregs skyur kha dog mi sdug dang / /gcin nad rlung gi khu chu'i nad—/ /dbugs mi bde dang yi ga 'chus/ /mcher pa'i nad dang sbyar ba'i dug /dmu rdzing gi ni nad rnams sel/ /nas dang sā ⑤lu 'bras rnying zas/ /rtsa ba bcu pa'i chu dang bskol/ /lan tshwa nyung zhing snum shas chung / /byen na 'or nad sel bar byed/ /rgya sran muṅga'i khu ba ni/ /thal sman rtsa ba gsum dang ldanarka/ /de bzhin skam rjosa'i sha rus ⑦sbal/ /skyin gor ⑧byi dur sha khu sbyin/ /btung ba ⑨dar ba gsar ⑩pa dang / /chang ni sman dang bcas pa blud/ / zi ra ⑪zur pa dzi ban ⑫ti/ /ma nu tsi tra ka ra dang ⑫/ /ya bak+ṣa ra bil ba'i rkang //da trog zho re'i tshad du byas/ /mar dang til mar nang du brngos/ /byen na 'or nad skran gzhang 'brum/ / tshad 'khru dang ni snying gi nad/ /spyome drod chung dang gcin nad sel/ /tsha ba lnga dang sbyar ba yi/ /thug pa'ang yon tan de dang 'dra/ /rdo dreg ru rta sto ne+e ya⑫/ /ha re rku ka a ru ⑫ra/ /shri be ta ka shug pa dang / /chu srin sder mo pri yang ku/ /pri ka thang shing spang spos dang / /111—565

pi pi leng dang dbyi mo ①dang / / ku nan na ta snebya ma ka /ma li ka dang dri sna bzhi/ /bal bu'i lo ma gla sgang dang / / gan+ta pa la sha la ①ni/ /bsku ba'i til mar dag dang ni/ /khrus kyi chu dang lde gu byadhi/ /nim pa arga ba spru ba/ /nag ta ma la'i chus khrus bya/ / yan lag ⑤phyogs gcig skrangs pa la/ /ka ra bī rjor ba spru ba/ /ki shu ka dang pi la sha /'bras bu gsum dang seng phrom dang / / na li ⑦ka dang thang shing dang / /spang sgos ko ⑧sha ta ki dang / /bong nga ta la'i lo ma dang / /dza yan ti dang 'ol ma se/ /ka ka dang ⑨ni sa li shing / / pri sha kaṇi dbyi mo ⑩dang / /ri ti bri ti glang po'i sna/ /lde gu dro 'jam bskus pas ⑪phan/ /de nas rlung gyur 'or nad la/ /zla phyed bar du dur byid dam/ /yang na e raṇ+ḍa mar blud/ /rlung gi rtug 'gags la de nyid/ /zas kyi sngon du 'o ma 'am/ /sha khu blud cing rlung 'joms pa'i/ /sman gyi dugs dang bsku ba bya/ /phyogs gcig skrangs ⑫la kha lud dang / /aldi man+d+ra ⑫spang spos dang / /bca' sga thang shing lde gu bsku/ /mkhris gyur tig ta'i ④sman mar dang / /n+ya gro dha sogs bskol ba blud/ /skom dad che dang rmongs ⑫bag tsha/ /'o ma bsku byug bsel ba bya⑩/ /pa to la rtsa kyi lce ba/ /shing mngar thang shing pu tse shel/ /skyer pa tsan+dan a ru ra/ /da na lcang ma bi la sha /pi pi ling dang mar bskol blud/ /khong tsha mgo 'khor skom dad che/ /'dus pa'i nad dang me dbal skrang / /lus tsha rims dang bcas pa sel/ /bad kan las gyur dong gra ⑩sogs/ /til mar dang ni bskol ba blud/ /rgyun srang 'gags shing me drod nyams/ /rmongs ⑫bag yi ga 'chus pa la/ /thal sman chang rnying mnan chang dang / /ba gcin dar bar bcas pa blud/ /pi pi ling dang 111—566

'ba' cha rnying / /shi kru'i shun pa zur pa ①dang / /ba gcin lde gu dro 'jam sbyar| /bsku dang dril ba'i las la sbyar④/ /ru rta asni man+d+ra ①dang / /rgya sran dong ga tsi tra ka /ba gcin chu ④bskol bas khrus bya/ /tsa rong ⑤a ka ru yis byug /na ga ba ra rjos ra la/ /a za sring ⑦gi am pa ta/ /a za ④garnya zhes bya dang / /a shwa garnya'i lde gu ni/ /yan lag phyogs gcig skrangs la phan—/ /nad gzhi ji bzhin yan lag ni/ /nye ba'i phyogs nas gtar ga bya/ /'dres pa'i nad la nad gzhi ni/ /shas che'i dbang du gso ba bya/ /go snyod pa ta gla sgang dang / /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑨ri tsha ba lnga/ /skyer pa chu dron sbyar blud pa/ /rtsa mkhris bca' sga chu dron blud/ /nad gzhi gsum gyi 'or nad ni/ /yun rings ⑩lon zhing tshabs chen sel/ /sle tres dang ni a ru ra/ /thang shing gu gul ba spru brka/ /ba gcin sbyar blud dmu rdzing dang / /mdze dang skya rbab srin bu'i nad/ /gcin nad bad kan za khu dang / /rlung ni stod du 'byams ⑪pa sel/ de ltar rang rang nad kyi ⑫dbang byas bshad/ /snad pa las byung ba la khrag dbyung zhing / /bsil sman mar khu ⑫byugs shing blugs par bya/ /dug skyes skrang ④la dug sel sbyor ba bya/ /grong dang rlan ⑫can chur gnas sha rid rlon⑫/ /tshod skam til gyi zas dang bu ram can⑩/ /phyer btags zas dang zho dang lan tshwa dang / /kha zas rul bag chang skyur yos sha skam/ /'dres pa'i zas dang lci dang ma goms za/ /tsha ba bskyed dang nyin par gnyid log dang / /mtshan mo gnyid ma log dang nyal po rnams/ /'or nad can gyis de dag thams cad spang / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi ⑫le'u bcu bdun pa'o// //111—567

de nas me dbal gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /me dbal nad la thog ma nyid//sgyung ba dang ni rtsub chos dang / /khrag dbyung skyug sman bkru sman gtang / /snum chos ①spyad par mi ⑤bya'o/ /po son cha dang ①dug mo nyung / /shing mngar bcas pa'am pa to la/ /nim pa'i lo ma pi pi ling / /skyug sman btang na me ④dbal 'joms/ /kyi lce ba yi khu ba 'am/ /rgan 'bru ⑤'bras bu gsum yang rung / /dur byid phye ma btab pa 'am/ /'o ma mar sbyar bkru sman ni/ /khong na zhen pa'i nad la ni/ /khyad par du ni sbyang ba gtang / /sbyang min nad tshabs chung ba la/ /zhi sman tsan+dan ut+pal gtang / /gla sgang nim pa pa to la/ /pa to la sogs nyid dag gam/ /thal tres gla sgang skyu ru ra/ /pu shel tse ni chu bskol blud/ /me dbal skom dad can la ni/ /byi rjotsher ba dang par pa ta/ /sle tres bca' sga bskol ba ni/ /khu ba bsgrangs par ⑦blud par bya/ /skyer pa sran chung pu tse shel/ / pa to la dang 'bras bu gsum/ /⑧nim pa shing mngar kyi lce ba/ /bskol ba mar dang bcas pa blud/ /yan lag nad zhugs nad khrag nyid—/ /thog ma nyid du khrag dbyung bya/ /pags pa sha dang rgyus pa 'drul⑨/ /khrag rul ba las byung ba yin/ /smin zhing bad kan zad pa dang / /rlung dang mkhris pa shas che la/ /tig ta tig ta chen po'i mar/ /kyi lce ba bskol mar phan no/ /khrag dbyung khong pa dag gyur nas/ /nad ni sha wags la gnas na⑩//phyi rol nas ni byug stsogs kyis⑪/ /'phral du me dbal zhi bar 'gyur/ /rlung gyur shu ti gla sgang dang / /'o ma 'u su pa ra hi/ /a ta ka la pi pi ling / /thang shing sha ⑫kru ru rta yi/ /lde gu ⑫byug pa byas na phan/ /mkhris pa n+ya go dha 111—568

sogs sde/ /de bzhin pad+ma ut+pal sogs/ /n+ya gro dha'i ①rtsa gzhon nu dang / /chu shing nang gi lo mar bcas/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba sde gu dang / /lan brgya ②bkrus pa'i mar gyis byug /pad+ma can kyi 'dam bsil ba'am/ /mu tig btags par gyur pa la/ /dung ngam byu ru nya phyis sam/ /yug snam mar dang bcas pa byug /bad kan las gyur 'bras bu gsum/ /shug pa btsod dang pu tse shel//ka ra bī ④ra 'dam bu'i rtsa/ /a nan ta duyi sde gu ⑤bsku/ /da ba lo ma bdun pa dang / /seng sdeng thang shing bkru ④sman dang / /gla sgang dong grar ⑦bcas pa 'am—/ /ba ra ṇa sdestsogs lde gu bsku/ /dong ga yi ni lo ma dang / /sle ⑨sman ta ka'i shun lpags dang / /in+d+ra ba ru na'i lo ma/ /shri sha 'ol ma se ⑩me tog/chu blugs rma bsku sman mar dang / /sde gu'i bye ma ji bzhin du/ /sman ni 'di dag nyid kyis bya/ /rlung rgyas mar ni shas cher bya/ /bad kan gnas shes ma byun la/ /dro dang rtsub pa shas cher sbyar/ /de bzhin mkhris pa'i gnas zhugs la//khrag mkhris la ni mar ldan bya/ /shin tu bsil zhing srab pa dang / /gos srab nang du bzhag pa ni/ /nus pa chung ba yang dang yang ⑪/ /gzhan dang gzhan ni sbyar bar bya/ /'dres pa'i nad la las 'di ni/ /'dren mar bya ba bsngags pa yin/ /me ltar tsha la lan brgyar ⑫ni/ /bkrus pa'i mar gsar ⑫'ba' zhig phan/ /mar gyi nying khu blugs pa 'am/ /shing mngar bskol ba'i chu grang ngam/ /ut+pal pad+ma kha ra'i chu/ /'o ma bu ram shing khu blugs④/ /btung ba bsku dang blugs pa dang / /tig ta chen po'i sman mar phan/ / rmen bu ⑫khrag mkhris sel ba yi/ /gso ba ci rigs legs byas la/ /rlung dang bad kan 'joms par byed/ /glan dang dkri ba la sogs phan/ /men bu me dbal 111—569

gzer bcas la/ /til mar rtsa ba bcu dang bskol/ /ba gcin dron mo chu dron ①blugs/ /yang na shi kru'i lde gu 'am/ /nag ta ma la'i shun pa 'am/ /la phug skam po ba ru ra'i/ /lde gu dro 'jam sdebasku ba phan/ /dan da sneshing tsha tsi tra ka /arka snu ha'i 'o ma dang / /bu ram go bye rus nag mtshur/ /sde gus rdo yang 'bigs byed na/ /bad kan las gyur rmen bu'i nad/ /phyi rol gnas pa smos ci dgos/ /yun ring gnas pa'i rmen bu la/ /la phug rgya sran ku lad+ma'i/ /khu ba thal sman se 'brur bcas/ /gro yi zan dang nas kyi zan/ /rgun chang sbrang rtsi bu ram chang / /kha ra chang gi dwangs mar bcas/ /kha lud khu bar bcas pa dang / /'bras bu gsum gyi sbyor lde gu/ /pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir bcas④ / /thang shing dang ni sle tres dang / /brag zhun gyi ni sbyor ba dang / /gla sgang go bye'i spyor ba 'am⑤/ /sbrang rtsi yi ni sbyor ba dang / /mgo bkru sman dud rngub pa dang / /sngar bshad skran ni bshig pa dang / /lcags gser lan tshwa bsregs pa dang / /rdo bas btsir bar bya ba yin/ /sman 'di yis ni 'jig par byed/ /sbyor ba sna tshogs de dag ni/ /byas kyang zhi bar ma gyur cing / /shin tu sra bar gnas gyur la/ /nad stobs che bar gyur pa ni/ /de 'og 'di la thal sman nam/ /lde gu 'am gser gyis bsregs na rjophan/ /smin par byed pa brnags ⑦byas la/ /dbral nas de nas dbyung bar bya/ /'di la khrag ni brnag 'dod pa⑧/ /yang dang yang du gdon ⑨par bya/ /khrag bsal 'og tu slar yang ni/ /rlung dang bad kan sel sman gtang / /tsha zhing smin pas brnags ⑩gyur la/ /phyi nang rma ltar gso bar bya/ /skyer pa srig sman kam bi l+ya/ /bskol ba'i til mar rma la phan/ /bad kan mkhris pa shas che la/ /111—570

drur ba'i ①khu ba mar bskol phan/ /gso ba'i nad ②kun phyogs dang steng / /khrag byung ba ni phyogs gcig yin/ /me dbal de ni khrag mkhris dang / /ma 'dres pa las byung mi 'gyur/ /'di yi rten ni khrag nyid yin/ /de bas khrag ni mang du dbri/ /nad gzhi mang po me dbal la/ /bkru sman ma gyur mar mi sbyin/ /de yis nad ni sra gyur pasasde/ /pags pa khrag dang sha 'tshed byed/ /rjoyan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u bcwa ⑤brgyad pa'o// //de nas mje nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /mdze nad rjokun la thog ma nyid/ /snum blud pas ni gso bar bya/ /de la rlung shas che ba la /rtsa ba bcu pa sle tres dang / /sha rang ka ta ⑦e raṇ+ḍa/ /mi sha sring gi mar ram nirka/ /til mar bskol te blud pa phan/ /nim pa pa to pu tse shel/ /skyer pa pa ta bye tsher ba/ /par pa ta dang kyi lce ba/ /srang re chu bre brgyad kyi ni/ /nang bskol brgyad cha lus pa ru/ /gla sgang rtsa mkhris kyi lce ba/ /dug mo nyung dang pi pi ling / /tsan+dan zho ni gnyis gnyis dang / /zhun ⑧mar srang ni bcu gnyis bskol/ /tig ta'i sman mar de 'thungs na/ /mkhris pa mdze dang me dbal dang / /'brum phran lus tsha skom dad che/ /mgo 'khor g.yan pa skya rbab 'bras/ /rma 'grams 'bras kyi phreng ba dang / /thor bu khong 'bras skran dang ni/ /zad byed smyo byed myos ⑨pa dang / /snying nad rab rib ngo khabs dang / /sha bkra mig ser pho ba'i nad/ /mtshan bar rdol dang brjed ⑩byed dang / /dmu rdzing zla mtshan mi chod dang / /sbyar dug gzhang 'brum khrag 111—571

mkhris sel/ /gzhan yang mkhris pa las gyur nad/ /shin tu gso dka' rnams la phan/ /lo ma bdun pa par pa ta/ /dong ga shu dag pu tse shel/ /shug pa pa ta 'bras bu gsum/ /ser po gnyis dang thal tres gnyis/ /nim pa tsan+dan pi pi ling / /shing mngar sle tres bi sha la/ /dug mo nyung dang pu shel tse/ /rtsa mkhris mur ba ba sha ka /nye'u shing pu sha pa to la/ /gla sgang byi tsher kyi lce ba/ /skyu ru ra khu nyis 'gyur dang ①/ /de rnams mar gyi brgyad 'gyur chu/ /bskol ba tig ta chen po ste/ /yon tan yang ni sngar bas lhag /bad kan las gyur nim pa dang / /lo ma bdun pa tsi tra ka /ru rta dong gra tsha ba gsum/ /sa la pi la ya'i mar blud/ /kun la go bye'i mar ram ni/ /yungs kar drur ④ba ra'i mar blud/ / byi dang ga snedang a ru ra/ /go bye'i lde gu mar bskol blud/ /dong ga'i rtsa ba dag dang mar/ /lan brgya'i bar bskol mar yang blud/ /seng ldeng bskol ba'i chu bsten na/ /mdze nad myur du sel bar byedaske/ /'di dag nyid kyis ci rigs par/ /snum chos rjobasku ba byas pa'ang phanaske/ /snum gyis zhen la me dbal ni/ /skabs su bshad pa'i sman sbyar gtang / /dpral ba lag pa rkang pa las/ /'di la ⑤gtar ga'ang gdab par bya / /mdze nad tshabs rjochung zhal zhal gdab/ /rwa ⑦sogs kyis kyang khrag dbyung bya/ /mdze nad 'joms pa'i snum gyis ni/ /'di la bar bar brta bar bya—/ /khrag phyung bkru sman gyis sbyang bya⑧/ /lto stong gyur pa mdze can la/ /ci nas rlung gis 'di yi ⑨ni/ /lus mi 'jig pa de ltar bya/ /nim pa sle ⑩tres ba sha ka /'bras bu gsum dang pa to la/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑩ri ka rañdza/ /lde gu chu dang mar bskol ba/ /sman mar rdo rje can zhes bya/ /des ni me dbal mig 111—572

ser rims/ /khrag nad lud pa mdze nad 'joms/ /'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ /dur byid kaṇ+ḍa ka ①ri gnyis/ /dan da dong ga ②pu tse shel/ /shu dag bong nga ①tsi tra ka /pa tar bcas pa zho gnyis gnyis/ /snu ha'i 'o ma srang gcig dang / /bre gang mar bskol lto sra ba'i/ /snum chos ④bkru sman dag tu sbyar/ /mdze dang sha bkra mdzer pa dang / /rgyu rlugs rde'u 'gags skran 'joms byed/ /'di ni rdo rje chen por bshad/ /dan da bre bzhi chu bre ni/ /bcu drug bskol te de mar bskol/ /ko sha ta ki srang gcig gdab/ /de blud steng 'og sbyong byed yin/ /a bar da ka srang brgyad cu⑤/ /bre bcu drug bskol brgyad cha lus/ /khu ba de ni de'i rtsa ba/ /mar ni bre gang bskol bar bya /blud na de bzhin zhag gcig gis/ /bar du chod de legs zhu nas/ /khre rgod rang skyur rjobaskol ba blud/ /mdze nad sha bkra 'bras kyi phreng / /sel zhing bu mang dran 'dzin 'gyur/ / nī li ti ⑦ka'i tshil sbrang rtsi/ /dzā ti'i khu ba mar bcas pa'am/ /seng ldeng a sa na'i ⑧chur bcas/ /dbang po bsdams brtan mje nad 'joms/ /sā ⑨lu nas dang gro dang ni/ /ci tse khre dang muṅga dang / /sran chung dang ni tu ka ri'i/ /tshod ma kha bo skam sa'i sha /'bras bu gsum dang pa to la/ /seng ldeng nim pa go bye ⑩sbyar/ /chang ni sman dang sbyar ba 'am/ /dar ba so ma ra dzar ⑪bcas/ /bza' dang btung ba mje la phan/ /skyur tsha lan tshwa can rnams gnod/ /zho dang 'o ma rlan can sha /bu ram ma sha til mar spang / /ba to la'i rtsa 'bras bu gsum/ /bi sha la ni re re ni/ /cha gsum gyis dbri zho phyed gsum/ /kyi lce ba dang pu tse shel/ /zho phyed dong gra bzhi char ⑫bcas| /de ltar srang gcig brdungs pa dag /bskol ba'i chu ni 'thungs 111—573

gyur na/ /nad kyi tshogs ni sbyong bar byed/ /sman de zhu nas skam sa yi/ /ri dwags bya yi sha khu dang / /'bras rnying chan ①dang sbyar ba bza'/ /sbyor 'di zhag drug bsten na ni/ /mdze nad kun dang skrangs pa'i snend/ /pho ba'i nad dang gcin sri dang / /gzugs 'khums gso dka'i nad rnams dang / /snying nad chu sor gzer rims sel/ / byi dang sdeg yi snying po dang / /a ru ra dang skyu ru ra/ /srang re dan da srang gsum dang / /bu ram srang ni bcu gnyis dag /ri lur byas 'di byin gyur na/ /mdze dang sha bkra ④dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa dmu rdzing gzhang 'brum dang / /gcin nad mcher pa rmen bu'i nad/ /thor bu srin nad skran rnams 'joms/ /grub pa'i sbyor 'di gnod sbyin ni/ /nor bu bzang pos dge slong zhig⑤ /srog 'dor nyid la bshad ces grags/ /tig ta nim pa 'bras bu gsum/ /shug pa bong nga rjopi pi ling / /mur ba dang ni pa to la/ /ser po rnam ⑦gnyis pu tse shel/ /shu dag in+d+ra skeb ru ni/ /dug mo nyung ⑨bcas cha mnyam pa/ /dan da dur byid bram sha mi⑫/ /phyi ma bzhin du nyis 'gyur bcas/ /phye ma sbrang rtsi mar sbyar zos/ /mdze dang za gu ⑪tshor ba chung / /sel ba'i sman gyi mchog yin no/ /'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling / / byi dang ga ⑫dang sbrang rtsi ni/ /til mar mar sbyar lde gu 'am/ /ka ka u dus+thā ⑫ra dang / /nim pa gla sgang byi dang ga⑫ /tsha ba gsum gyi lde gu ni//dug mo nyung gi khu bar bcas/ /drud na lpags nad thams cad 'joms/ /dug mo nyung dang tsi tra ka /nim pa thang shing seng ldeng dang / /lo ma bdun pa a sa na/ /khu bskol mar dang a ru ra/ /sbrang rtsi ldan zos mdze nad 'joms/ /seng ldeng nim pa sle tres dang / /pa to la dang byi tsher bskol/ /seng sdeng la 111—574

sogs lnga pa ste/ /khyab 'jug gis ①ni lha min bzhin/ /mje nad 'phral du 'joms par byed/ /skyer pa nim pa seng ldeng gi/ /shun lpags bskol bas mdze nad sel/ /skyer pa nim pa 'bras bu gsum/ /pa to la rtsa pu tse shel/ /shu dag btsod ni bskol ba yis/ /dam chos la brten 'khor ba ltar/ /khrag mkhris las gyur sdemaje nad gcod/ /sman 'di nyid dang ba yi mar/ /bskol bas rlung gyur mdze nad rnams/ /mchog tu sel bar byed pa yin/ /seng sdeng nim pa skyer pa dang / /sle tres thang shing sna rer bskol/ / pa tha ①skyer pa tsi tra ka /dan da dug nyung pu tse shel/ /ba gcin yang na chu dron bcas/ /zla ba gcig blud mje nad dang / /gzhang 'brum za khu skrang ④nad dang / /skya rbab ma zhu srin nad 'joms/ /rgya skyegs dan ⑤ti 'bras bu gsum/ /mur ba pa tra tsi tra ka /a pa marga byi dang garjo /lo ma bdun pa tsha ba gsum/ /btsod dang skyer pa ma sha ka /nim pa thang shing rtsa ba lnga/ /gnyis po ⑦phye ma ba gcin sbyar/ /zla ba gcig 'thungs phan zas bza'⑧/ /mje yi nad kun 'joms par byed/ /skyer pa pi pi ling dong gra/ /bye dang ga dang pa to ri①/ /tsi tra ka dang ta bya rnams/ /go rims bzhin du cha res bskyed/ /ba gcin sbyar ba'am ri lu ni/ /byin na mi bzad mdze yang 'joms/ /tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum/ /til dang go bye'i phye ma ni/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar| /ri lu byas pa cha bdun pas/ /mdze yi nad rnams 'joms byed cing / /bcud kyis ⑫len dang ro tsar ⑩'gyur/ /so ma ra dza ⑫tsi tra ka /skyer pa du ba ra'i rus pa/ /go bye srin sman 'bras bu gsum/ /bsten na mdze nad ma lus 'joms/ /so ma ra dza byi dang ga⑫ /go bye tsi tra ba ra hi/ /a ru ra 111—575

dang lang ga li①/ /til nag po dang pi pi ling / /bu ram dang ni ri lur bya⑦//mdze yi nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /so ma ra dza ⑦pi pi ling / /de yi rtsa ba bye dang ga'i④/ /snying po lcags rkyag ⑤skyu ru ra/ /til mar lde gu mdze nad 'jomasaske/ /a ru ra dang go bye til/ /bu ram ri lus mdze nad 'joms/ /so ma ra dza byi dang ga④ /bu ram ri lu byas pa'ang phan/ /seng ldeng brag zhun byi dang ga⑦ /sbrang rtsi mar dang ldan za zhing / /phan dang ran par zos na ni/ /'brum phran sha bkra shu ba 'joms/ /kha ra lcags phye byi dang ga⑧ /tsi tra ka dang skyu ru ra/ /pi pi ling gi sde gu yis/ /mdze nad shin tu gso dka' 'joms—/ /gla sgang tsha gsum 'bras bu gsum/ /rtsa ba lnga gnyis thang shing btsod / /nim pa shing tsha lo ma bdun/ /shing tsha tsi tra ka dang ni/ /mur ba bi sha li'i phye ma/ /nas phye dgu cha ⑨sbrang rtsi ni/ /cha gcig sbyar ba 'di rtag tu—/ /'thungs na mdze nad 'joms byed cing / /'or nad skya rbab sha bkra can⑩| /pho nad gzhang 'brum rgyu rlugs dang / /mtshan bar rdol dang 'brum phran dang / /g.yan pa shu⑩ba'i nad rnams 'joms/ /tu pa ra yi rus pa 'am /go bye so ma ra dza dang / /tsi tra ka'i rtsa brag zhun rnams/ /bcud len cho ga ltar bsten ⑫phan/ /de ltar nad bsal nang gi ni/ /nad sbyangs nad ⑫ni phyi rol gyi/ /pags par gnas na sman blugs phan/ /nad kyi dri ma ma dag pa④/ /sman rnon byugs na mdze nad ni/ /bslangs skepas slar ni 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gting zug sra zhing kor kor po'i/ /mdze la dugs bya snyi ba dang / /'bur bar gyur nas mtshon gyis ni/ /zhal zhal btab cing byug ⑫par bya/ /gang zhig pags pa kun nyams shing / /mtshon gyis btab tu mi rung ba/ /de la 111—576

khrag ni phyung nas su/ /thal sman rnon po ①bsku bar bya/ /mje nad rab sra rtsub pa dang / /tshor ba med brtan ④yun ring lon/ /sngags bcas dug khu ④blud par bya/ /dug gi sman ni rjes su sbyar/ /mdze nad rengs zhing tshor ba med| /rngul mi 'byung zhing g.ya' ba la/ /lci skam rgya mtsho'i 1 ba 'am/ /mtshon gyis bzhar la lde gu ④byug /gla sgang dong gra ⑤'bras bu gsum/ /po son cha dang ka rañdza/ /lo ma bdun pa dug mo nyung / /ru rta skyer pa pri yang ku//nyungs kar sbyor bas lus bkru zhing / /lde gus slon sman bkru sman dang / /bzhar zhing lus ni bskus gyur na/ /pags pa'i nad dang mdze nad dang / /skrang dang skya rbab mdze nad 'joms/ /ka ra bī ༷ra nim pa dang / /dug mo nyung dang dong gra ⑦dang / /tsi tra ka'i rtsa ba gcin bskol/ /bskus na mje nad 'joms par byed/ /ka ra bīsher kar rtsa ba/ /dug mo nyung dang ka rasgo'i/ /'bras bu skyer pa'i shun lpags ni/ /so ma na yi myu gu bcas/ /bskus na mdze 'joms grub pa yin/ /shri sha'i shun lpags ras bal gyi/ /me tog dong ga'i lo ma dang / /mon sne'u dme ⑨ru bzhi po ni/ /btags pa'i lde gus mdze nad ⑩'joms| /nim pa ser po rnam gnyis dang / /bye'u rug pa dang pa to la/ /ru rta a shwa ⑩garnya dang / /thang shing shi kru nyungs kar dang / /g.yer ma 'u su gla ba dang / /tsa rong cha mnyam phye mar byas/ /dar bar sbyar ba'i til mar gyis—/ /bskus pa'am ⑫lus byugs dril gyur na/ /mdze nad g.yan pa rlum por bcas/ /'brum phran skrangs pa'i nad rnams sel/ /gla sgang dngul rdo dang ni skyer pa dang / /nag tshur kam bi l+ya ⑫dang ru rta dang / /seng phrom mu zi pog dkar byi dang ga④ /ldong ros ba bla ka ra bī ra'i skeshun/ /phye mar byas 111—577
