pa'i til mar gyis bskus pa'i/ /steng du phye ma'i don du 'di blugs ①na/ /shu ba g.yan pa 'brum bu phra mo dang / /rkang shu la sogs 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yungs kar snu ha'i shing dum btags/ / lde gu me ma ①mur btsos te/ /'dod chags shugs kyis ngo tsha bzhin/ /bskus na glang shu 'jig ④par byed/ /ldong ros ba bla rjon le sham ⑤til mararjo/ /arga'i lo ma'i lde gus mje 'joms byed—/ /de bzhin tsi ⑦tra marda ka rañdza/ /ru rta sbyar ba ba gcin skebatags pa'ang phan/ /gu gul yungs kar na le sham/ /nag tshur dang ni byi dang ga⑨ /shri be+e sha ga sra rtsi ⑩pog /ba bla ldong ros mu zi dang / /ru rta dang ni kam bi l+ya//ser po gnyis dang bcas pa ni/ /'khor los btsir ba'i til mar bsres/ /'di ni mtshon gyis bzhar te bskus/ /nyi mar bsregs na mdze nad sel/ /ta la'i lo ma ⑪na le sham/ /ru rta ldong ros nag tshur bcas/ /zangs kyi snod dang ⑫til mar dang / /zhag bdun legs par spangs pa des/ /zhag bdun bsku zhing nyi mar bsreg⑫ /sha bkra spyo'ajoms par byed pa yin/ /sha bkra ⑫sar pa zla ba gcig /bsten zhing sbyang ba byas na sel/ /a pa marga'i thal ba'i chu/ /lan bdun legs par gzags pa ru/ /pri yang ku yi mar bskol bsarka/ /bskus na sha bkra ⑩sel bar byed/ /ka ka dzang gi rtsa ba dang / /ras bal sa bon 'dab ma dang / /la phug sa bon dar bar sbyar/ /mig dmar gza' la bskus na ni/ /sha bkra ⑩sel ba grub pa yin/ /dzi ban ⑫ti dang skyer pa btsod/ / kam bi l+ya ⑪dang spangs ma ni/ /'o ma mar dang til mar bskol/ /sra ⑥rtsi pog dang sbra ⑫tshil ni/ /btab pa bskus na de yis ⑪ni//rkang lag zhig ⑫pa sel bar byed/ /pags pa gcig pa'i mdze dang ni/ /111—578

'brum phran 'bras ni ber ①ba yi/ /mdze nad 'jig par byed pa yin/ /lo ma bdun pa rtsa ba dang / / shi ri sha yi ②shun wags dang / /ka ra bī ①ra arka dang / /su ma na dang tsi tra ka /thal tres nim pa'i shun lpags ④dang / /ka rañdza dang yungs kar dang / /tsi tra mar dang 'bras bu gsum/ / bye dang ga ⑤dang tsha ba gsum/ /ser po gnyis dang rjotil mar dang / /ba gcin bcas par bskol bas ni/ /pags pa'i nad dang rma 'grams dang / /rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i/ /mje yi nad ni sel byed de/ /'di ni rdo rje dang 'dra bas| /rdo rje can zhes bya ba yin/ /e raṇ+ḍa dang dngul rdo dang / /gla sgang nim pa ka dang ni/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba kam bi l+ya/ / bye dang ga ⑦dang nir gun thi⑧//go bye in+d+ra ba ru ni/ /thang shing khron bu gu gul dang / /ldong ros shri sha pi ti ⑨dang / /lan tshwa tang pal bca' sga rnams/ /cha mnyam snu ha'i 'o ma dang //arga'i til mar lan cig bskol/ /lde gu rdo rje chen po ste/ /rdo rje can pas yon tan lhag /sha bkra ⑩dang ni gzhang 'brum dang / /'bras kyi phreng ba 'joms par byed/ /ru rta ka ra bī ⑪ra dang / /bring ga ra dza arga dang / /shu dag shing mngar rgyam tsha ⑫gcin/ /til mar bskol ba dug bcug pa/ /bskus pas mdze nad sel ba'i mchog /spra ⑫tshil li khri gu gul dang / /spangs ma dngul rdo yungs mar bskol/ /g.yan pa glang shu myur du sel/ /rgya skyegs tsi tra mar da dang / /shri pi ta ④dang tsha ba gsum/ /ru rta yungs kar la phug gi/ /sa bon ser po rnam gnyis kyi/ /sde gu dar bar sbyar bskus na/ /shu ba thams cad sel bar byed/ /tsi tra ka dang shi kru 'am/ /sle tres thang shing a pa mar/ /seng ldeng dha ⑫ba'i lde gu 'am/ /dur byid dan da ⑫pra ban ti/ /111—579

rgya skyegs dngul rdo sug spel lam/ /pur+ṇa ①rna ba'i lde gu ste/ /tshig rkang drug bshad lde gu drug /zho ga ②chu dang sbyar ba yis/ /bskus na bad kan rlung las ni/ /gyur pa'i mje nad sel bar byed/ /ba li ①ka dang ma nu dang / /a kar rjonā ga ge sar dang / /garnya bha dra ⑤gla ba dang / /tsan+dan dang ni pu shel tse/ /cha res bskyed pa'i lde gu yis/ /bad mkhris mje nad sel bar 'gyur / /tig ta'i sman mar brgya bkrus mar/ /bskus na mdze yi tsha ba sel//til mar tsan+dan shing mngar dang / /stag tsher ba dang ut+pa la/ /bcas par bskus na'ang phan pa yin/ /rnags ༷shing yan lag 'drul ⑦ba dang / /lus tsha 'brum bu phra mo 'byung / /pags pa myags dang bcas pa la bsil ba'i sman chus blugs ⑧shing byug /gtar ga bkru sman btang ba dang / /tig ta'i sman mar byin na phan/ /seng ldeng nim pa ba sha ka /dug mo nyung dang 'bras bu gsum/ / bye dang ga ⑨dang sle tres dang / /pa to la dang ba gcin sbyar—/ /phyi dang nang nas btang gyur na/ /srin bu las gyur mdze nad 'joms—/ /rlung shas che la thog mar ni/ /mar btang bad kan shas che la/ /skyug sman mkhris pa las gyur na/ /gtar ga btab ⑩cing bkru sman gtang / /nad sbyangs khrag ni byung ba dang / /gnas ni dag par gyur pa la/ /bsku ba gang zhig byas gyur pa/ /de ni mod la med par 'gyur/ /nad gzhi bsal zhing khrag ni phyung ba dang / /phyi dang nang nas zhi ba'i gso ba bya⑪/ /sman mar dang ⑫ni dus su byin gyur na/ /mdze yi nad ni gso sla nyid du 'gyur/ /mje can nad ni lan mang sbyangs gyur pa/ /de yi srog srung ⑫lan mang 'bad byas te/ /nad ni lhag par phyung bas nyam chung bas⑫/ /rlung ldang myur du gsod par byed 111—580

par 'gyur/ /zla ba phyed cing skyug sman gtang ba dang / /zla ba re re nas ni bkru sman gtang / /mgo bo sbyang ba zhag ni gsum gsum nas/ /zla ba drug drug nas ni gtar ga bya/ /gang zhig slon dang 'khru bar ①dka' 'gyur zhing / /mdze can nad shas che bas khyab gyur pa/ /de ni nges par gso dka' nyid gyur pas| /de bas ②nad ni ma lus dbyung bar bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi ⑦le'u bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas sha bkra dang ④srin bu'i nad gso ba'i le'u ⑤bshad par bya'o/ /gang zhig mdze nad pas kyang 'jigs 'gyur zhing / /myur du gso dka' nyid du 'gyur bas na/ /khang pa 'bar bar gyur pa lta bur rjoni/ /sha bkra'i nad zhi ba la 'bad par bya/ /khyad par du ni dang por ⑦lus la ni/ /sbyang bar bya ba nye bar sbyar bar bya/ /sha bkra la ni so ma ra dza' ⑧khu/ /bu ram chang ngam sha khu bkru sman ni/ /snu ha'i 'o mar sbyar ba blud par bya/ /de 'thungs nas ni lus bskus nyams stobs dag /ci yod pa las nyin mtshan bsten par bya/ /skom dad skyes na ⑨zhag gsum thug pa blud/ /sha bkra'i lus la chu bur byung gyur na/ /de ni tsher ma dag gis brtol bar bya/ /chu bur gzags par byas nas nang re bzhin/ /so ma ra dza ⑩dang ni a sa na/ /pri yang ku dang shu ti chur ⑪bskol blud/ /rgya skyegs shing thal bu ram phran sbyar ba'i/ /chu ni nyams stobs ci yod pa la blud/ /phal gu ⑫skyu ru ra shun ⑫dug nyung shing ⑫/ /khu ba so ma ra dzar bcas pa blud/ /dro bar 'dug snyenas chu bur byung ba la/ /lan tshwa med zas dar bar bcas pa sbyin/ /ba gcin tsi tra ka dang tsha ba gsum/ /sbrang 111—581

rtsir sbyar ba mar gyi snod du gzhag /zla phyed lon nas sha bkra can la blud/ /'di la mdze nad gso ba'i cho ga bya/ /yang na bring ga ra ①dza lcags snod bcug /til mar nang du brngos pa sbyin bya zhing / /a sa na yi sa bon 'o mar bskol/ /de rjes blud na sha bkra 'joms par byed/ /dong ga ②arga pu ti ka rañdza/ /snu ha dzā ①ti'i lo ma ba gcin 0btags/ /lde gus bskus na sha bkra gzhang 'brum dang / /shu ba g.yan pa rma 'grams sel bar byed/ /glang chen gzig gi lpags bsregs til mar dang / /sbyar ba bskus na sha bkra sel mchog yin/ /sbur ba dri ngan dong ga'i 'o ma dang / /sbyar te bskus pa gcig pus sha bkra sel//chu bur bskyed phyir go bye cham chom ⑤brdungs/ /nub mo ba gcin la sbangs nyin grib bskam du/ /de ltar lan gsum byas te zhib tu btags/ /snu ha'i 'o mar sbyar bskus sha bkra 'joms/ /sbrul nag bsregs pa las byung snag ⑦tsha ni/ /ba ru ra yi mar dang sbyar te bsku/ /de bzhin rma bya'i mkhris pa bsregs pa'am④/ /ba li ka bsregs rma bya'i mkhris bsregs phan/ /so ma ra dza' sa bon phul gang dang / /ba bla cha bzhi ⑨dag ni bsres nas su/ /ba yi gcin dang sbyar te btags bskus na/ /sha bkra lpags mdog 'dra bar byed pa'i mchog /glang chen rtug pa legs bsres ( )thal ba ni/ /glang chen gcin dang bsres te gzags gyur pa/ /bre bcu drug tshad so ma ra dza yi⑪/ /sa bon bcu chas btab bskol spyin bag gyur⑩/ /mang du bdar ba de yis bskus na ni/ /sha bkra'i nad ni rnam par 'joms 'gyur zhing / /mdze yi nad dang ⑫sme ba nag po'amaske/ /sha lhag skyes pa'i rma ni sbyong bar byed/ /go bye tsi tra ka dang snu ha dang / /arka'i rtsa ba dang ni 'ol ma se/ /de bzhin tsha ba gsum dang dung dang 111—582

ni| /spangs ma ru rtar bcas dang lan tshwa lngar①/ /thal ba gnyis dang lang ga li ②btags phye/ /snu ha arka'i 'o mar bskol nas ①ni/ /ska bar gyur pa lcags snod nang du gzhag /de ni thur mas bskus na mdze nad dang / /sha bkra smre ④ba nag por gyur pa dang / /mdzer pa gzhang 'brum pags pa'i rmen ⑤bu sel/ /sbyang byas gtar ga btab pa dang / /rtsub chos phye zan zos gyur pa'i / /sdig pa zad par gyur pa yi/ /'ga' zhig gis ni sha bkra du'abyang / /khong pa'i srin yod snum dugs byas⑦/ /bu ram 'o ma nya sogs kyis/ /bad kan srin bu bslangs ⑧nas ni/ /nub mo de ni bde bar gnas/ /bye'u rug stsogs sde ba gcin dang / /chu phyed bcas pa bskol nas ni/ /khu ba de stinang pi pi ling / /po son cha dang byi dang ga⑩ /til mar swardzi k+ṣa ⑪rar bcas /mas gtong bas ni gtang bar bya/ /de nyid de la de nyid dam/ /dur byid lde gu po son cha/ /pi pi ling ni khu bar bsres/ /bkru sman de la blud par bya/ /de ltar steng 'og sbyang byas nas/ /tsha ba lnga ldan thugs stsogs blud/ /tsha dang kha dang bska ba yi/ /sman ni bskol chus blugs par bya/ /dus su byi dang ⑫ga'i til mar/ /'jam rtsi de la gtang bar bya/ /mgo bo'i srin bu mgo nad ni/ /gso bar bshad pa'i rim par bya/ /tsha dang kha ba shas che zhing / /snum nyung kha zas sbyin par bya/ / byi dang ga ⑫dang pi pi ling / /pi pi ling rtsa na le sham/ /na le sham ni dkar po dang / /swardzi ⑩ka ni thal bar bcas/ /nas thug dar bar btsos pa blud/ /gi ⑫ri gar ni shri sha ka /pa ri pa tra ke pu ka /pa la sha 'bras pa ⑫tu ra/ /su ⑩ti ka ni so sor bskol/ /khu ba sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'am| //bye rug pa sogs sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /rta sbangs phye ma byi dang ga⑫ /bskol 711—583

ba'i nang sbangs mang du bza'/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu 'am/ /'bras bu gsum khur sbangs pa sbyin/ /mgo bo'i srin bu'i nad la ni/ /de yi phye ma bud par bya/ /mu sha kar+ṇa'i ①'dab ma ni/ /zhib tu btags pa 'bras phyer bcas//btsos pa'i khu ba sbyin par bya/ /de yi rjes la rang skyur ram/ /dar ba be+e ba tsha ba lnga/ /lan tshwar ④bcas pa blud par bya/ /nim pa a pa marga dang / / nir gun thi snelo'ang de bzhin bya/ / byi dang ga ④yi phye ma dang / /bsres pa'i 'bras phye'i khur ⑤ba sbyin/ /go bye'i mar ni rnying pa la/ / byi dang ga rjoni shun pa bsal/ /cha phyed bcug ste nyi mar gzhag /btung ba 'jam rtsi sbyar bar bya/ /thang shing shri beṣ+ṭa yi snum/ /so sor de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /bshang bar ⑦skyes la lhag par yang / /bkru sman dang ni 'jam rtsi gtang / /bad kan las gyur mgo bo'i nad⑧/ /bkru sman slon dang zhi sman gtang / /khrag las gyur pa'i srin bu la/ /gso ba mdze yi tshul du bya/ /spu 'byi byed la gso ba ni/ /'khor ling skra 'byi ⑨cho ga bya/ /'o ma sha dang mar dang bu ram dang / /zho dang 'dab ma can gyi tshod ma dang / /mdor na mngar dang skyur ba'i khu ba rnams/ /srin bu gzhom par 'dod pas yongs su spang / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las gso ba'i gnas kyi ⑩le'u nyi shu pa'o// //de nas rlung nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /ma 'dres rlung las ⑩dang por ni/ /mar dang rkang dang tshil dang ni/ /til mar blud cing snum gyi ⑫ni/ /sbyor bas legs par gso bar bya/ /de nas snum zhen ngal bso ⑫ste/ /'o mas ④slar yang snum chos bya/ /rlan can grong spyodang chu la gnas/ /sha khu snum 111—584

dang ldan pa gtang / /'o thug kri sar sgyur ①dang bcas/ /lan tshwar ②ldan blud 'jam rtsi gtang ④/ /sna sman skyo byas rjokha zas ni/ /snum byas sbyin cing dugs byas la/ /legs bskus snum dang ldan pa la/ /gseg ⑤ma la sogs dugs bya'o/ /snum gyis zhen byas dugs rjobyas pas/ /g.yo zhing rengs dang gzer bcas pa/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gugs pa ni/ /bde blag nyid du nus par 'gyur/ /ji ltar shing skam dag kyang ni/ /snum bskus bsros ⑦par gyur na ni/ /las su bya bar rung gyur ⑧na/ /srog chags lus ni smos ci dgos//spu brtse ⑨gzer na snyoms ⑩pa dang / /lus skem rengs pa'i nad la stsogs/ /dugs byas myur du zhi 'gyur zhing / /mnyen pa nyid du'ang 'gyur ba yin/ /snum btang bas ni lus zungs rnams/ / bskam pa ⑪myur du rgyas par byed/ /nyams stobs me drod 'phel ⑫'gyur zhing / /de yi srog kyang ring nas ⑫byed/ /lan mang snum dang dugs kyi ni/ /cho ga legs par sbyar bar bya/ /de ltar snum gyis mnyen byas ltor/ /rlung gi nad ni gnas mi 'gyur/ /gal te nad gzhan bcos ⑫pa'i phyir/ /las 'di zhi bar ma gyur na/ /'jam zhing snum dang ldan pa yi/ /snum gyis de ni sbyang bar bya/ /zhun mar seng phrom btsos pa dang / / sap+ta la ⑫dang bskol ba 'am/ /'o ⑩ma e raṇ+ḍa yi mar/ /bskol ba nad sel dge ba blud/ /snum sgyur dro dang lan tshwa sogs/ /zas kyi dri ma tshogs gyur nas/ /bu ga 'gags te rlung bkag pas/ /de phyir de ⑩ni bde rgyu bya| /nyam spyochung bkru sman byar 'os pa/ /de la drod skyed smin ⑩byed pa'i/ /kha zas sbyin pa'am de bcas pa'i/ /mas gtong bkru sman sbyar bar bya/ / sbyang zhing ⑫me drod bskyed ⑩gyur nas/ /slar yang snum dang dugs byas phan/ /111—585

ma zhu'i gnas su ①zhugs pa'i rlung / /slon ⑦byas zas rim byin nas ni/ /ba ra ṇa ①sogs drug pa 'am/ /shu dag stsogs chu dro sbyar blud/ /me drod bskyed ④nas de'i 'og tu/ /rlung can gcig pu'i gso ba bya/ /lto ⑤ba'i phyogs zhugs bil ba rjoni/ /gzhon dang nya shas g.yos byas sbyin/ /lte ba'i 'og zhugs 'jam rtsi gtang ⑦/ /zas kyi sngon du snum btang phan/ /khong par zhugs la thal sman sogs/ /phye ma drod skyed smin byed phan/ /snying gnas sa la paṇi dag /'o ma dang ⑧ni bskol ba phan/ /mgo bor gnas la mgo snum bsku—/ /sna sman dud rngub snum can dang / /rna ba sogs la brta byas ⑨phan//pags par gnas la bsku byug dugs/ /rlung med gnas su gnas pa dang / /kha zas yi ga 'byed pa phan/ /khrag gnas bsil sman bsku ba dang / /bkru sman khrag ni dbyung ba phan/ /sha tshil brten pa bkru sman dang / /mas gtong drag dang zhi bya'i sman/ /rus pa rkang la ⑩gnas pa la/ /phyi dang nang nas snum gyis gso/ /khu chur gnas la sems dga' dang / /kha zas stobs skyed ro tsa phan/ /khu ba rgyu ba 'gags gyur na/ /bkru sman btang bas gso bar bya//'khrus shing zas rim bsten gyur nas/ /sngar bshad pa yi gso ba bya/ /rlung las mngal chags bskams gyur dang / /byis pa skems par ⑪gyur pa la/ /ka ra tang pal shing mngar rnams/ /'o ma sbyar bskol blud pa phan/ /rgyus pa tshigs dang rtsar zhugs la/ /snum tsha dkri ba'i dugs byas phan/ /yan lag 'khums la ma sha dang / /rgyam tsha til mar bskol bas bsku/ /khrag gzags drags la yan lag ni/ /tshor ba med la khyim dud pa/ /rgyam tsha til mar sbyar bas bsku/ /dkri ba'i dugs ⑫ni sbyar bar bya/ /gzhan dbang can gyis 111—586

gzir ①gyur cing / /mig 'gyur mi shes 'dar ba med/ /pho mtshan mi ldang rngul mi 'byung / /phyi rol rtsol ba med 'gyur la②/ /khri yi bcings pas ④ma non pa/ /de la myur du gso dpyad bya/ /der ni thog mar snum zhen bya/ /dugs ④byas sna sman rnon pos ni⑤/ /bu ga sbyang phyir btang ba dang / /bi da ra yi sde bskol dang / /zho dang 'o ma sha khu dang / /mar bskol ba yi dwangs ma blud| des ni rlung nad tshabs che ba'amarjo/ /'phral du khyab par mi 'gyur ro//rgya sran nas dang rgya shug stsogs/ /thang shing la sogs sde tshan ni/ /rlan can sha ni bskol ba dang / /skyur dang 'o ma dag dang ni/ /mngar ba'i sde tshan btab pa yi/ /snum chen dag ni bskol ba yis/ /blugs ⑦dang bsku dang lus spyi ⑧dang / /btung dang sna sman 'jam rtsir bya/ /snum dang dugs ni legs sbyar ba/ /de dang des ni rlung nad 'joms/ /nad shugs bar ma dag la di/ /bad kan sel zhing rno ba yi/ /spyi bo'i bkru sman lan mang gtang / /bud cing gtang bar bya ba yis/ /dbugs rgyu'i gnas ni dag gyur nas/ /des ni dran pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /kha ru tsha dang a ru ra/ /tsha ba gsum bskol rlung chen selaske/ /seng phrom srang brgyad 'bras bu gsum/ /bre gang rtsa ba chen po lnga/ /e raṇ+ḍa dang bri ⑨ha ti/ /dur byid srang re chu bye ni/ /bcu drug nang du bskol nas su/ /bzhi cha lus pa de dang ni/ /mar bre gang dang chu ⑩bre bzhi/ /nas tshig ⑪'khus thal srang gsum bskol/ /de bsten rlung nad ma rungs pa/ /yan lag phyogs gcig kun la zhugs/ /mngal ⑫gyi nad dang rgyu rlugs dang / /skran dang dmu rdzing 'joms par byed/ /ram nye ba ⑫dang a shwa ka'ang / /cho ga seng phrom lta bur bya/ /gso ba 'di ni gzhan dbang can/ /rlung nad ma 111—587

'dres pa la bya/ /nad gzhi 'dren mar 'dren mas bya/ /bad kan bcas pa'i gzhan dbang can/ /snying ga rtsib ①logs na ba la/ /g.yer ②ma shing kun a ru ra/ /ma nu dang ni lan tshwa gsum/ /nas bskol khu ba sbyar ba blud/ /shing kun bca' sga rtsal ①ru tsha/ /se ④'bru star bu bcas pa blud/ /bad kan rlung ni 'dres pa la/ /snying nad gso ba'i skabs bshad phan/ /da rgan phyir ⑤dgye nang gug rjoganyis/ /klad ⑦pa gzhogs phyed na ltar gso/ /til mar gyis bkang snod du bsnyal/ /'dir ni nang gug ⑧rab gso dka'⑨/ /so dang bzhin gyi mdog nyams shing / /yan lag lhod cing dran pa nyams/ /rab tu rngul ba'i gzhung rengs yin/ /de ni zhag bcu las mi 'tsho/ /de las gzhan shugs sman gyur 'tsho/ /lus sgu ⑩ba dang 'on glen dang / /'thing dang zha bo gzhogs phyed nyams/ /'phye ⑪bo'am dbang po ma tshang 'gyur/ /'gram pa nyams pa ⑫'gram pa snum/ /dugs byas nas ni rang gnas gzhug /kha gdangs pa la ⑫kos ko ni/ /bteg la ④mkhas pas gzhug par bya/ /'tham ⑫par gyur pa lhag ma la/ /phyogs gcig gug ⑩pa lta bur gso/ / lce ldibs ⑩gnas skabs ji bzhin du/ /rlung nad kyi ⑫ni gso ba ⑪bya/ /glad pa gzhogs phyed na ba la/ /sna sman spyi bo'i til mar dang / /mig dang rna ba dgang ⑩bar byaske/ /skrangs par ⑪skyug sman gtang bar bya/ /tsha zhing dmar bcas gtar ga gdab—/ /gzhogs phyed skams la snum chos dang / /snum dang ldan pa'i bkru sman gtang / /dpung pa 'jas la sna sman dang / /zas kyi rjes la snum sbyin bya/ /brla rengs pa la snum chos dang / /sbyang byas phan pa ma yin te/ /bad kan ma zhu tshil mang bas⑫/ /de phyir de la rtsub chos kyi⑫/ /zad par bya bas gso 111—588

bar bya/ /nas dang khre dang khre rgod sbyin/ /tshod ma lan tshwa med pa ni/ /til mar cung zad chur bskol ba'am/ /skam sa'i sha ni mar med dang / /sbrang rtsi chu dang chang rnying sbyin/ /phyug po'i rlung la dug mo nyung / /yung ba'i sde tshan shu dag sogs/ /bskol ba rgyam tshar bcas pa 'am/ /ba ra ṇa ①sogs phye ②sbyar blud| /yang na dbyi mo ①'bras bu gsum/ /pu tse rjoshel dang pi pi ling / /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu sbyin/ /yang na dbyi mo ⑤a ru ra/ /tsi tra ka dang thang shing dang / /sbrang rtsir rjosbyar ba'i sde gu sbyin/ /gu gul brag zhun a ru ra/ /ba gcin dang ni sbyar ba blud/ /gla sgang tsi tra tsha ba gsum/ /'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga⑦ /gu gul cha mnyam phye ma sbyin/ /tshil dang bad kan ma zhu las—/ /gyur pa'i nad ni thams cad sel/ /de ltar bad kan shas che zhing / /tshil bcas rlung ni nad sel byed/ /thal sman ba gcin sbyar dugs dang / /blugs dang lus la dril ba'ang bya⑧/ /nyungs kar ka raspru'i 'bras bu/ /ba gcin sbyar bas ⑨bsku bar bya/ /arka aghi man+d+ra dang / /nim pa'i rtsa ba thang shing dang / /bong ba dang ni grog mkhar sa/ /yungs kar sbrang rtsir ⑩bcas pa bsku| /bad kan zad phyir drag shul ni/ /bzod na de la brten par bya/ /thang la mchong dang ci nus kyis/ /nyal po dag kyang yongs su bsten/ /chu mi ⑪g.yo dang lteng ka dang / /chu rgyun bzlog pas chu bo rgal⑫/ /'dir ni tshil dang bad kan dag /zad nas snum la sogs pa gtang / /gnas dang lus zungs sogs brtags ⑫la/ /lhag ma rnams kyang gso bar bya/ /sa ha ra dza ⑫thang shing dang / /dong gra ⑫bskol ba til mar sbyar/ /rlung gis lus gzir la blud ⑫na/ /ci 'dod thogs pa med 'go nus/ /ra sna dong gra tsi tra ka /111—589

zur pa ma nu pi pi ling / /btags pa'i phye ma mar bskol ba/ /rlung nad sel bar byed pa'i mchog /nim pa sle tres ba sha ka /kaṇ+ḍa ka ①ri pa to la/ /srang ni bcu bcu'i ②tshad byas la/ /chu bye bcu drug nang du bskol/ /khu ba brgyad cha lus pa der/ /mar ni bre gang blugs te bskol/ /pa ta thang shing byi dang ga /dong gra khruha ti pi pi ling / /skyer pa shu ti dbyi mo ④dang / /te dzo ⑤pa ti na le sham/ /ru rta dang ni dug mo nyung / /thal sman rnam pa gnyis po dang / /ti mu sa dang kru trug rjotres/ /bse shing 'bras bu pu tse shel/ /shu dag ⑦pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /btsod dang bong nga la la phud/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis tshad byas pa/ /gu gul sbyar ba srang lnga dang / /lde gu btab ste bskol ba'i mar/ /blud na rlung tshad ⑧tshabs che ba/ /rus tshigs rkang la zhen pa'ang 'joms| /mje nad de 'dra'ang sel bar byed/ /bu ga'i rma dang lba ba dang / /mtshan bar rdol ⑨dang 'bras kyi phreng ⑩/ /nam tshong ⑪yan chad nad kun dang / /skran dang gzhang 'brum za khu dang / /gcong chen dbugs mi bde ba dang / /yi ga 'chus dang cham pa dang / /lud pa 'or nad snying nad dang / /skya rbab myos dang khong 'bras dang / /rlung dang khrag gi nad rnams 'joms bil ba gzhon nu'i 'o ma dang / /mar gyi nying khu bskol nas ni/ /de la srang ni ⑫gcig gam phyed/ /sna sman byas mgo'i rlung nad sel/ /de bzhin chu srin nag khra dang / /nya dang rus sbal 'ug pa'i tshil/ /bskol ba ma 'dres rlung la ni/ /khyad par du ni gtang bar bya/ /til gyi tshigs ⑫ma rnying pa dang / /rtsa ba lnga pa so sor bskol/ /gcig tu bsres pa til mar ni/ /'o ma brgyad cha'i nang du bskol / /blud na rlung dang bad kan dang ④/ /'dres pa'i nad ni thams 111—590

cad 'joms/ /pra sa ra ni srang brgyad bskol/ /til mar 'o ma bre re dang / /med ①gnyis dang sha puju⑤/ /btsod dang ru rta ra sna dang / /tsan+dan dmar po dzi ba ka / ra sna ①ram nye ba gnyis dang / /thang shing btags pa'i lde gu dang / /bskol blud rlung nad thams cad sel/ /sa ha ra dza'i ④rtsa ba yal gar bcas/ /srang brgya ⑤rtsa ba bcu ni de dang mnyam/ /nye'u shing srang ni lnga bcu chu bre drug cu ni/ /rtsa bzhi'i nang bskol bzhi cha lus pa der/ /chu srin sder mo ru rta pu shel tsedu/ /tsan+dan sug smrel pri ka pri yang ku/ /na li ka dang rdo dreg ba le ⑦ka /spang spos thang shing btsod dang a ru ra⑧/ /tsa rong shu ti rgya spos du ru ka /srang re cha mnyam 'o mar bcas pa ni/ /til mar bre bzhi lhan cig bskol ba blud/ /rlung nad gso dka' dag kyang 'joms par byed//lus 'dar lus stil rlung 'jug lus rengs dang / /lus bskams pa yis shin tu gzir la sogs/ /skran dang smyo byed cham pa mngal nad 'joms/ /sa ha ra dza srang brgya yi⑩/ /khu bar til mar bre bzhi bskol/ /de rtsa sde gu srang bcu dang / /'o ma bzhi 'gyur bcug ste bskol/ /yang na rgya spos shu dag dang / /ste ra ru rta shu dag ⑪dang / /sug smel rdo dreg spang sgos dang / /shu ti tsan+dan dmar po gzhug /bskol ba der ⑫ni kha ra'i phye/ /srang ni bco brgyad gzhug par bya/ /til mar sman mar ⑫yin par bshad/ /des ni rlung nad ma lus dang / /rlung nad 'khyil dang smyo byed dang / /skran dang rmig rlugs la sogs sel/ /ba la srang brgya sle tres ni/ /bzhi cha ra sna brgyad cha ni/ /chu bre bzhi brgya'i nang du bskol/ /khu ba brgyad cha lus pa dang / /zho dang zho ga chu bu ④ram/ /shing khu tsha dang til mar rnams/ /bre ni bzhi bzhi bskol nas ni/ /111—591

ra yi 'o ma cha phyed dang / /zur ba skyer pa sa ra la/ /sug smel btsod dang a ka ru/ /tsan+dan a ti pa la dang / /shug pa gla sgang muṅga'i lo/ /ha re rku ka ①shing mngar dang / /bya gri nā ②ga bye'u rug pa/ /zangs rtsi ba dang dzi ba ka /gla rtsi lce pog snepa la sha /dzā ti sho ka na rjoli ka /gur gum rdo dreg bi ⑤ka dang / /dzā ti pa la kad pa dul/ /ba li ka dang shing tsha dang / /kun du ru dang ga pur dang / /shri pa sa da ⑦du ru ka /li shi chu srin sen mo dang / /ru rta spang spos ka ko la/ /thi yang ku dang sto de ya/ /rgya spos shu dag bya ma ka /ma du nā ⑧ga gla ba dang / /nā ga ge sar srang re dang / /bskol te btsags par gyur pa ru/ /garnya bha dra'i ⑨lde gu ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bcug pa des/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde dang rims/ /brgyal dang slon skran zad byed dang / /glo 'grams mcher nad skem pa dang / /brjed ⑩byed bkra mi shis pa sel/ /ba le ⑪til mar bzang po 'di/ /rlung gi nad ni 'joms ⑫byed yin/ /btung ba sna sman bsku dang 'jam rtsi ni⑫/ /snum gyi sbyor ba dus su legs bsten na/ /des be+e ma rungs ⑫rlung nad myur zhi ste⑫/ /bud med mo gsham bu yi snod byed 'gyur/ /gang tshe bad kan mkhris pa ni/ /zhu ⑩ba'i gnas 'dug snum dugs kyis/ /zhu nas mkhris pa snang gyur pa/ /de la 'jam rtsis bsal bar bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas las le'u nyi shu gcig pa'o// //de nas dreg nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /dreg nad can ni snum chos ⑩bya / /rlung bsrungs nad gzhi ⑫nyams stobs las/ / dpag ste ⑪khrag ni 111—592

cung zad tsam/ /lan mang du ni dbyung bar bya/ /dmar gzer na zhing tsha ba la—/ /srin bu pad pas ①khrag dbyung ngo / /g.ya' zhing ④na la tsag tsag tsha/ /shas cher tsha la rngabs rus dbyung / /gnas nas gnas su 'pho ba la/ /gtar ga'am zhal zhal gyis khrag dbyung / /lus zhum pa dang khong rtsub cing / /rlung shas cha ④la khrag mi dbyung rjo/ /khrag zad pa la rlung gis ni/ /skrangs pa gting zab rings pa dang / /'dar zhing rtsa rgyus na dang zhum/ /rlung nad gzhan yang skyed par byed/ /snum chos byas ⑤rjes bkru sman ni/ /snum dang ldan pas 'khru ru gzhug /rlung shas che ba'i dreg nad la/ /mar ni rnying pa blud par bya/ /ram nye ba dang sra ba ni/ /pa ya mya dang dzi rjob ka /zangs rtsi ba dang cha snyoms ⑦te/ /'o ma mar bskol dreg nad 'joms/ /rgun 'bru ⑧ma du ka bskol ba'i/ /khu ba kha ra mar bcas pa'am/ /de bzhin sle tres khu bar ni/ /'o ma bskol ba blud par bya/ /til mar 'o ma kha rar bcas /legs par bsres pa blud par bya/ /ba la nye shing ra ⑨sna dang / /pi lu rtsa ba bcu par bcas/ /dur byid ste ra e raṇ+ḍa/ /bskol ba'i 'o mas rlung dreg sel// rtags kyi bar 'di 'grel pa nas ma byung /⑩ ba gcin 'o ma bzhos ma thag /bcas pa'ang nad ni bde 'byung byed/ /mkhris par nye (treshing pu tse shel/ /pa to la rtsa'i 'bras bu gsum/ /sle tres dang tho)ni sman mngar kha/ /'o ma'ang mar dang bskol ba blud/ /nad gzhi shas che'i bkru sman phyir/ /e raṇ+ḍa'i mar 'o mar sbyar / /sbyor ba ji bzhin blud par bya/ /zhu nas 'o ma 'bras chan sbyin/ /a ru ra ni mar brngos pa/ /khu ba blud par bya ba 'am/ /dur byed phye ma ⑫rgun chu 'am/ /'o ma ⑫sbyar ba blud par bya/ /yang na de yi nad gzhi ni/ /111—593

'jam rtsi 'o ma mar bcas sbyar①/ /rlung dang khrag nad gso ba la/ /'jam rtsi las lhag gang yang med/ /mchog tu gzhang dang rtsib logs brla/ /tshigs nad ④dmu rdzing nyam snethag sel/ /bad kan shas che gla sgang dang / /rgun 'bru ④skyer pa bskol ba 'am/ /'bras bu gsum bskol sbrang rtsir bcas/ /yang na ske tres ci rigs blud/ /ji ltar 'tsham par snum blud de/ /slon byas nas ni rtsub chos bya/ /'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ /garnya bha dra ⑤shing tsha dang //cu gang rjoshu dag tsi tra ka /pi pi ling rtsa byi dang gaspyo /spang spos ba sha ka'i shun phrags/ /ri ste dbyi mo lang ga ling / /cha mnyam lde gur byas ⑧pa la//nang par lcags snod bskus te gzhag /nyi ma phyed dus de zos na/ /nad gzhi kun gyur ⑨dreg nad ni/ /gzer dang ldan la ⑩mchog tu phan/ /ko ki lak+ṣa ⑪bskol ba'i khu/ /blud cing de yi tshod ma zos/ /snying rje goms pa'i skyes bu ⑫ltar/ /dreg nad sel bar byed pa yin/ /rtsa ba lnga'am skyu ru ra'i/ /khu ba li li ta yi ⑫zhag /'khrig pa spong zhing 'thungs na ④ni/ /dreg 'theng shin tu gting zug sel/ /de ltar nang gi bstan nas ni/ /de 'og phyi rol gso ba bshad/ /rang skyur bre bzhir ⑫til mar dang ⑩/ /sra rtsi pog ni bzhi char bskol/ /chu nang gzar bus mang du dkrugs/ /rims tsha nad gzir sel mchog yin/ /til mar btsod dang spra ⑩tshil dang / /sra rtsi pog dang thal tres bcas—/ /til mar ska ⑫bas lus bskus na/ /dreg nad ⑪sel ba'i dam pa yinaske/ /rtsa ba bcu dang 'o ma ⑥bskol/ /yang na lde gu chu dron sbyar/ /blugs ⑫na rlung shas che ba yi/ /gzer nad 'phral du sel byed yin/ /lus 'jug rengs dang gzer gyis nyen/ /snum bzhi po ni mngar ba'i sman/ /dro 'jam 111—594

sbyar ba blugs ①par bya/ /tsha bar gyur la grang mo blugasasde/ /de bzhin ra lug ba yi ni/ /'o ma til mar sbyar ba 'am/ /'tsho byed sde tshan bskol ba 'am/ /rtsa ba chung ngu lnga bskol blugs/ /rgun chu bu ram shing khu chang / /rang skyur zho dang zho ga ④chu/ /'bras bkrus chu dang sbrang rtsi'i ④chu/ /ka ra'i chu ni blud ⑤pa'ang phan/ /bud med gzugs sdug snyan par smra/ /lag pa nu ma tsan+da bskus//reg na baṅgal zhing bde ba yis/ /tsha dang na dang rmya ba rjosel/ /mdog dmar tsha dang na bcas la/ /khrag phyung nas ni lde gus bsku/ /stag tsher ba dang shing mngar btsod/ /skyer pa tsan+dan ka ra dkar⑦/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi sa bon phye//sran chung shug pa pu shel tse/ /sde gus tsha na shu ba mched/ /na zhing mdog dmar skrangs pa sel/ /kri sa ra ni rlung 'joms sman/ /snum bcas bskol ba'am muṅga dang / /'o thug nyungs kar til tshigs ma/ /glan zhing dkris pas gzer 'joms byed/ /chur gnas rlan can mthu rtsal gyis/ /zas ⑧tshol sha btags g.yos legs pa/ /'tsho byed sman dang snum bcas pas/ /glan zhing dkri ⑨ba byas gyur na/ /sra zhing gzer la na ba dang / /skrangs dang yan lag na ba 'joms/ /'tsho byed sman dang bskol ba yi/ /'o ma zhag gis bskus na'ang phanarka/ /sa ha ra dza' ⑩rtsa ba dang / / dzi ban ⑪ti mar ra'i 'o ma/ /lde gu bskus pa'am de bzhin du/ /til btags ⑩brngos pa 'o mar sbyar/ /zar ma ⑫'o mar sbyar ba'am/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi 'bras bu ni/ /'o ma dag dang sbyar ba 'am/ /shu ti'i 'o ④mar sbyar ba yis/ /rlung shas che ba'i gzer 'joms byed/ /ba gcin thal sman chang dang bskol/ /mar gyis bskus na'ang de la phan/ /bad kan shas che rgun tsha dang / /bskol ba'i mar bsku blugs pa phan/ /shu dag ru 111—595

rta khyim dud pa/ /shu ti ser po rnam gnyis kyi/ /lde gus bskus na dreg nad ni/ /rlung dang ①bad kan shas che ④sel/ /de bzhin shi kru'i sa bon ni/ /'bras kyi khu ba'i rang skyur ①ni/ /yud tsam btags nas skyur gyur pa/ /blugs ④na bad rlung shas che sel/ /rtogs par sla la byug dang bsku/ /blugs dang lus ni bcing bas gso/ /rtogs dka' mas gtong drag po dang / /bkru sman snum ni glud pas gso/ /bad rlung shas cher dro 'jam sbyar/ /de la byugs ⑤stsogs grang mo yis/ /lus tsha na zhing g.ya' zhing skrangasarjo/ /sra ba rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ /khrag mkhris shas che'i dze+edreg nad la/ /byug pa la sogs bsil bas bya/ /dro bas ⑧tsha zhing na la dmar/ /rngul 'byung gas bar ⑨'byung bar 'gyur/ /shing mngar srang brgya bskol ba yi/ /khu ba bzhi cha lus pa ru/ /til mar bre bzhi 'o ma mnyam/ / ti ra mur ba ⑩ta ma la/ /nye'u shing a gar ⑪pa ya su/ /tsan+dan hi ⑫sa ba ti dang / /spang sgos sle tres me da gnyis| /ram nye ba gnyis shu ti dang / /shug pa rnam gnyis dzi ban ti⑫/ /dzi ba ka dang bi ④sha ba/ /shing tsha gan+da bha dra ⑫dang / /chu srin sin mo ba li ka /btsod dang pra puṇ+ḍa rī ka / shi ri ⑫ba dang bi la sha / ku tan na ta ⑩srang re yi/ /sde gur bcas pa bskol bar bya/ /sbyor ba bzhi pos dreg nad kyi/ /mkhris pa'i rtsa ba rims nad sel/ /ba la'i khu ba lde gu dang / /til mar 'o ma cha mnyam bskol/ /lan brgya'i bar du bskol ba de/ /dreg nad rlung can sel bar byed/ /bcud kyis len gyi dam pa ste/ /dbang po gsal bar byed pa yin/ /tshe ring lus 'phel skad snyan dang / /khu chu khrag gi nad sel byed/ /rgyu ba'i lam 'gags 'khrugs gyur pas⑫/ /tshil lam bad kan shin tu ni/ /111—596

'phel bar gyur pa'i rlung nad la/ /snum rtas dang por phan pa yin/ /der ni phyug po'i rlung nad kyi/ /gso bya dreg nad gso bar bya/ /khrag ni dwangs par byed pa yi/ /snum dang sman gyi sbyor ba bya/ /srog stsogs rlung ni cig car 'khrugs| /ji skad bstan dang nad gzhi bzhin/ /ji ltar nye bar sman rnams ni/ /nad tshul ji bzhin sbyin par bya/ /ma zhu bcas la dugs dang sgyung / /smin bya ①rtsub sman byug pa dang / /rlung stsogs kyis ni ma zhu bsal/ /byas la ma 'dres rlung gso bya/ /skem dang bya rmyang ②yan lag 'khums/ /rengs dang 'dar bu tshor ba med/ /'gram nyams kha yo 'theng po dang / /zha bo ①dreg nad kyis 'theng dang / /tshigs 'khrul gzhogs phyed na ba dang / /tshigs dang rkang rus la zhugs nad/ /'di dag gnas ni gting rings pas④/ /de bas 'di dag gsar btab dang / /bla brnan ⑤med cing nyams stobs ldan/ /'bad na rjo'atsho yi gzhan du min/ /mkhris 'dres rlung ⑦la grang dro yi/ /gso ba'i rim gyis mang du bya/ /'tsho byed sde dang bskol ba yi/ /sman mar dag kyang blud par bya/ /skam sa'i sha dang sā ⑧lu nas/ /bkru sman 'o mar bcas 'jam gtang / /rtsa ba lnga dang ba lar bskol/ /'o ma mas gtong sbyor ba bya/ /sman mar bskol ba'i til mar gyisti/ /'jam rtsi ⑩dus su gtang bar bya/ /shing mngar ba la til mar dang / /mar dang 'o ma bskol ba blugs⑪/ /rtsa ba lnga yi khu ba 'am/ /chu ni grang mo nyid blugs bya/ /bad kan bcas la nas kyi zan / /skam sa'i ri dwags bya yi sha /dugs dang mas gtong bkru sman no/ /slon sman bkru sman bcas pa gtang / /mar rnying til mar nyungs kar las/ /byung ba'i mar ni blud par bya⑫/ /bad kan mkhris pa 'dres pa las/ /dang 111—597

po mkhris pa gso bar bya/ /khrag dang 'dres pa dreg nad kyi/ /gso ba ji skad bshad par bya/ /dugs bsku sha khu 'o ma dang / /snum dang bcas pas sha bkra sel—/ /phyug po'i rlung la gasbun snyi ①dang / /tshil dang rlung 'joms sman gyis gso—/ /rus pa rkang gnas snum chen kyis/ /khu chur gnas la sngar bshad pa'i②—/ /zas dang 'dres la 'ju byed dang ga/ /drod skyed skyug sman yang ba gtang / /gcin 'dres gcin ni 'phel ba dang / /dugs dang 'jam rtsi gong mas gso/ /bshang 'dres e raṇ+ḍa'i mar dang / /'jam rtsi snum ni 'khru byed phan / /lus zungs kun zhugs rlung nad la/ /bad kan mkhris par mi gnod dang / /gang yang rlung ni bder rgyu ba'i/ /sman de rlung nad de la gtang / /'khru bar mi byed snum pa dang / /rtsa rgyun sbyong ④bar byed pa dang / /mas gtong bas ni mngar ba dang / /snum gyi ⑤'jam rtsis gso bar bya/ /nyams stobs ci yod brtags nas ni/ /bkru sman 'jam po gtang bar bya/ /bcud kyis len ni thams cad kyi/ /sbyor ba dag kyang bsngags pa yin/ /mchog tu brag zhun sbyor ba dang / /de bzhin gu gul nyi tshe 'am/ /kha ra srang stong chig brgyar rjobacas/ /pa wa sangs bshad lde gu'ang phan/ /thur sel 'dres la drod bskyed dang / /'khru gcod rlung ni bder rgyu byed/ /gcin gyi gnas ni sbyong byed pa'i/ /sman rnams de la gtang bar bya/ /de ltar srog la sogs pa yi/ /'dres pa'i gso ba mdor bshad yin/ /sman pas de gso rgyas par ni/ /blo yis brtags te ci rigs bya/ /stod du rgyu ba'i ⑦spyi bor bsdu/ /thur sel de las bzlog par bya/ /me dang mnyam gnas mnyam par bya/ /khyab byed gsum du sbyar bar bya/ /bzhi po bas kyang srog bsrung ste⑧/ /der gnas 111—598

na ①ni lus gnas 'gyur/ /de ltar rlung ni lam gzhan zhugs/ /rang rang gi ni gnas su gzhag /khrag mkhris 'dres pa ma gtogs par④/ /'dres pa'i nad ni thams cad la/ /bcud kyis len gyi cho ga bzhin/ /sgog skya bsten na sel bar byed/ /mkhris par 'dres la mkhris sel bas/ /rlung ni bde bar rgyu bar bya/ /khrag dang 'dres la de nyid dang / / 'theng ba'i ①nad bshad sman bya'o/ /khrag mkhris rlung ni sel ba yi/ /bcud kyis len ni sna tshogs sbyar/ /nad gzhi ji ltar bstan pa bzhin/ /gso ba de ltar yang dag bshad/ /nyam thag 'phral du sel ba 'di/ /tshe yi rig byed gnas 'bras bu/ /gso ba phan pa gnod sel dang / /sbyor ba sman dang rtsi dang ni/ /zhi bar byed dang sngags bya ste/ /de dag sman ming rnam grangs yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas kyi ④le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gso ba'i gnas te gnas bzhi pa rdzogs so// //de nas skyug sman gyi cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /de yang rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis 'di ltar bshad de/ skyug sman mchog ni po son cha/ /dur byed rtsa ba bkru sman mchog /gzhan dag nad kyi dbang las ni/ /khyad par du ni gyur pa yin/ /po son cha de mdog skya zhing / /shin tu sngo ba'ang ma yin pa/ /nyin zhag tshes grangs shis pa la/ /sos ka dpyid kyi mtshams su btu/ / phyis nas ⑤'jag ma'i snod du ni/ /bcug ste 111—599

bcings la ba lang gi/ /byu bas snod du ①byugs nas ni/ /'bru yi nang du gzhag par bya/ /'jag mas dkris pas 'jam pa dang / /sbrang rtsi lta bu dri zhim la/ /zhag brgyad 'das par gyur pa dang / /phyung ste de nyid ②nyi mar bskam—/ /de 'og legs par bskams pa dang / /nang gi 'bras bu phyung nas ni / /zho dang zho ga ①chu mar gyi/ /lde gur ④mnyes la slar yang bskam/ /de nas legs par sbas te gzhag /dgos pa'i dus su sbyar bar bya/ /de nas de la tshad tsam du/ /blangs nas cham chom brdungs nas ni/ /shing mngar go bye bi ⑤da ra'am/ /bim pa lcang ma sle sman ta/ /bum rjoti a pa marga dang / /arga gang yang rung ba ni/ /bskol ba'i chu yi nang du ni/ /nub gcig legs par spang bar bya'o/ /de nas sman gyi khu ba de/ /mnyes shing btsags la nang par ni/ /mdo nas bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /legs par blud nas skyug tu gzhug /bad kan las byung ⑦rims cham pa/ /skran dang khong 'bras rnams la ni/ /ji srid mkhris pa snang gi bar/ /khyad par du yang skyug tu gzhug /po son cha yi 'bras bu ni/ /phye ma bskol ba'i khu bar ni/ /'bras bu gsum phye cha gsum btab/ /ko bi da ⑧ra stsogs khur bcas/ /blud na rims dang dmu rdzing dang / /rmen bu 'bras dang 'brum chen dang / /gtun ⑨'dra'i rlung nad sel bar byed/ /mkhris pa bad kan gnas zhugs la/ /dzi mu ta ⑩sogs khu ba blud/ /snying tsha khrag mkhris dag la ni/ /de 'bras 'o mar bskol ba yi/ /'o thug bcas pa blud par bya/ /bad kan las gyur slon bro dang ⑪/ /cham pa mun 'thibs byed pa la/ /de bskol 'o ma las byung ba'i/ /zho yi spris ma'am zho blud bya/ /po son cha sogs lde gu dang / /bskol ba'i 'o ma las byung ba'i/ /111—600

mar sar bad kan gyis drod ①nyams/ /lus skam pa la ①sgyug sman bya/ /po son cha yi khu ba ni/ /bsre zhing cho gas btsags nas ni/ /gzar bur ①chags pa'i bar du bskol/ /byin la de ④bas skyug tu gzhug /lde gu de'am de'i khu ba—/ /bza' dang btung bar sbyar te gtang ⑤/ /po son cha yi 'bras bu'i khu/ /dug mo nyung sogs sde tshan btab/ /nim pa arka gang yang rung / /bskol ba'i khu bar bcas pa ni/ /blud na nyams brtas las byung nad/ /gting zug kun kyang sel bar byed/ /po son cha yi me tog ni/ /zhib btags phreng bsgos bsnams nas ni/ /thug pa sha khu sogs ngoms blud/ /skyid de ba ni bder slon gzhug0 /po son cha med ⑦me tog dang / /'bras bu gzhon nu de bzhin sbyar/ /dzi mu ta ⑧sogs de dang 'dra/ /dzi mu ta ⑨ni khyad par du/ /rims dang lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /skyigs bu la sogs nad la gtang / /'di yi me tog 'o mar btsos/ /'bras bu smin pa 'o thug bcas/ /spu bcas 'o ma'i spris mar sbyar/ / sru med zho yi spris mar sbyar/ /skya ba'am sngor ⑩gyur 'o mar bcug /zho ni sgyur por gyur pa 'am/ /mnan pa'i chang gi dwangs mar ni / /mnyes te zhu bar gyur pa blud/ /bad kan lud pa yi ga 'chus/ /skya rbab gcong chen nad la gtang / /ku ba ko sha ta ki yang / /sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di nyid bya/ /smin zhing bskams par gyur pa yi/ /dzi mu ta yi 'bras bu dag /phye ma srang phyed 'o mar bsres/ /rlung mkhris nad kyis nyen la blud/ /dzi mu ta 'bras gnyis sam gsum/ /brdungs pa de yi khu ba ni/ /dong ga la sogs dgu pa ni/ /gang yang rung ba la sbangs te/ /mnyes la btsags par gyur pa dag /bad kan mkhris rims can la blud/ /dzi mu ta yi phye ma 'am⑪/ /111—601

lde gu chu grang ①sbyar ba dag /mkhris rims can blud bad kan dang / /rlung 'dres rims la chu dron sbyar/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde dang dugage /slon rims bad kan gyis nyen dang / /mun 'thibs byed pa'i nad ldan la/ /ku ⑧ba kha bo'i skyug sman bsngags/ /de ni me tog 'bras bu med/ /myu gu gzhon nu 'o mar btsos/ /bad kan mkhris pa las gyur rims/ /mkhris pa shas cher gyur la blud/ /'bras bu smin pa'i nang gi ni/ /'bras bu phyung ste 'o ma rjobacug/zhor gyur lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /blud de slon du gzhug par bya/ /'bras bu'i nang na zho ga chu/ /mdze dug skya rbab nyid la blud/ /de dang dar ba bskol ba ni/ /rgyam tsha sbrang rtsir bcas pa blud/ /yang na de yi sa bon ni/ /ra yi 'o mar bcas pa dag /dug skran dmu rdzing rmen ⑤bu dang / /'bras dang rkang bam dhind la blud/ /bad kan las gyur lud pa rims/ /skog ma'i nad dang ma zhu la/ /ku dze+eb kha bo'i ④khu ba ni/ /phye dang sbyar ba'i skyo ma blud/ /skran dang rims rnying byeng ba la/ /lde gu sha khur sbyar blud na/ /legs pa kho nar slon gyur zhing / /nyam ⑨chung bar yang 'gyur ma yin/ /ku ba kha bo'i me tog dang / /'bras bu phye mas bsgos pa yis⑩/ /me tog phreng ba mnam pa ni/ /skyid de ba yi skyug ⑪sman yin/ /skran lud dmu rdzing skog ma'i nad/ /bad kan gnas la brten pa'i rlung / /bad kan kha dang mgrin par gnas/ /bad kan 'phel bar gyur pa dag /brtan zhing dkyel ni skyes pa la/ /ko sha ta ka'i skyug sman bsngags/ /'tsho byed nye'u shing zangs rtsi ba/ /kha sral phre'u ram nye gnyis / /shra ba dang ni me da dang / /ma hā me da ma du li/ /'di dag re re'i phye ma dang / /ko sha ta ka'i phye mar bcas/ /sbrang rtsi kha rar sbyar ba ni/ /111—602

lud pa snying ni tsha la bsngags/ /de rjes chu dron blud pa ni/ /bad kan mkhris tsha ldan la bsngags/ /'u su g.yer ma'i khu ba dang / /de yi khu bas dug 'joms so/ /bim pa ka sa marda 'am/ /ba spru ba yi khu bar ni/ /ra dza go ①sha ta ka yi/ /rdog ma gcig gam gnyis mnyes pa'i/ /dwangs ma snying gi nad la blud/ /de bskol 'o ma las byung mar/ /po son cha stsogs ⑦bskol ba blud/ /ko sha ta sogs kha dang tsha/ /mje dang skya rbab mcher pa'i nad/ /'or nad skran nad sbyar dug sogs/ /gting zug pa la bsngags pa yin/ /po son cha sogs drug so sor/ /bskol ba dang ni rlan can sha /ko sha ta ka cha mnyam bskolaske/ /khu ba rgyam tshar bcas pa blud/ /po son cha sogs pi pi ling /cha mnyam ko sha ta kar sbyar/ /yang na ko sha ta ka yi/ /khu ba bu ram shing khu blud| /dug mo nyung ni skyid de ba/ /bad kan mkhris pa khrag bcas dang / /rims dang shu ba snying nad dang / /dreg nad kyis 'theng mdze la bsngags/ /dug mo nyung gi sa bon de/ /nyungs kar ram ni ma du ki/ /bskol ba'i khu ba'am rgyam tsha'i chu/ /yang na kri sa ra ldan blud/ /de yi sa bon arka yi/ /'o mar zhag bdun sbangs pa ni/ /po son cha dang dzi mu sketa/ /ku ba kha bo dzi ban ti/ /dzi ba ④ka ni bskol ba yi⑤/ /khu ba gang yang rung ba blud/ /skyug sman gyi ni gtso bo yi//cho ga phyogs tsam bshad pa yin/ /blo dang ldan pa rjotshul 'di yis/ /gzhan yang ci rigs sbyar bar bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi ⑦le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bkru sman bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /dur byid bska 111—603

zhing mngar la rtsub/ /zhu rjes tsha bar gyur pa yin/ /bad kan mkhris pa zhi byed de/ /rtsub pas rlung ni 'khrugs ①par byed/ /de 'dir sman gyi sbyor ba yis / /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan sel/ /cho ga'i khyad par la brten nas//nad kun 'joms par byed pa yin/ /dur byid rnam pa gnyis su bshad/ /de rtsa dmar nag dkar ba yis/ /rnam pa gnyis su bshad pa yin/ /de las tri byi ta ②mchog tu bshad/ /nyes pa med cing bde bar 'khru/ /brgyal rmongs byed cing skog ma ni/ /rtsub cing gnod par ⑧byed pa dang / /rno zhing myur du 'khru byed pa/ /lto sra nad gzhi shas che dang / /sdug bsngal gyis nyen nad pa la/ / sha ma rjodur byid bsngags pa yin/ /de ni zabs su zug cing 'jam/ /thad kar 'phros pa ma yin pa/ /btus la snying po bor nas ni/ /shun pa skams te sba bar bya/ /de nas de'i 'og de'i ⑤phye ma/ /rgyam tsha dong ga cung zad btab/ /rlung nad la ni skyur las blud/ /mkhris par dusbrang rtsi kha ra mar/ /'o ma rgun 'bru ⑦bu ram shing / /khu ba tang skepal mngar ba yi/ /sman de'i ⑨'bras bu gsum gyi ⑩ni/ /khu bar bcas pa blud par bya/ /bad kan nad la pi lu yi/ /khu ba ba gcin chang sgyur rtsabs/ /tsha ba lnga sogs phye ma ni/ /bad kan 'joms dang ci rigs ⑪sbyar/ /dur byed lde gu khu ba dang / /bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs kha ra/ /sbrang rtsi dri bzang gsum dang bcas/ /lde gu yid 'ong bkru ⑩sman yin/ / a dza garnya smig ⑫rkang dang / /ka ra dur byid bi ⑫da ri/ /phyer btags sbrang rtsi mar dang ni/ /lde gu byin na 'dus pa dang / /rims dang lus rengs tsha ba dang / /skom dad kyis gzer legs par 'khru/ /bu ram shing ni tshal par bkas/ /nang ngos dur byid lde gus bsku/ /gcig tu sbyar 111—604

te phur ma yis①/ /btso ba'i tshul byas de bza' bya/ /shing tsha sug smel mnyam ni li②/ /de mnyam dur byid sha ka ra/ /phye ma sbrang rtsi rgun chu dang / /phye dang gaskyo mar sbyar te blud/ /rlung mkhris bad kan las gyur dang / /me drod chung ba'i nad dang ni/ /skyid de ba yi mi rnams la/ /gnod pa med pa'i bkru sman yin/ / bye dang ga ④yi snying po dang / /'bras bu gsum zhes bya ba dang / /ya bak+ṣa ra pi pi ling / /dur byid kun gyi cha phyed byas/ /sbrang rtsi mar ram bu ⑤ram gyis/ /sde gur byas pa byen na ni/ /skran dang mcher pa dmu rdzing dang / /gzugs 'khums lud pa yi ga 'chus/ /rlung dang bad kan las gyur nad/ /mang po gzhan dag sbyong bar byed/ /pi pi ling rtsa byi dang garjo /'bras bu gsum dang 'u su dang / /tsi tra ka dang na le sham/ /pi pi ling dang dug mo nyung / /zi ra ha ste pi pi ling / /ti ⑦mu sa dang lan tshwa lnga/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis phye mar byas/ /dur byid dang ni til mar gnyis/ /srang ni brgyad brgyad ⑧char bsres dang / /skyu ru ra'i khu bre gsum dang ⑨/ /bu ram srang ni lnga bcu me/ /chur ⑩bskol de las ran tsam ni/ /zos na mdze dang gzhang 'brum dang / /mig ser za khu skran dang ni/ /dmu rdzing mtshan bar rdol ⑪ba dang / /pho ba'i nad dang skya rbab rnams/ /'joms shing cho ga bsrung mi dgos//bu skyed par yang de yis ⑫byed/ /bu ram dge ba can zhes bya/ /dus kun du ni 'phrod pa yin/ /tsha ba gsum dang dri sna gsum/ /gla sgang dang ni byi dang ga⑫ /skyu ru ra ni de ⑫thams cad⑫/ /mnyam pa'i dur byid kha ra dang / /sbrang rtsi'i ri lu byas zos na/ /gcin sri rims dang slon ⑩bro dang / /lud pa sha skem mgo 'khor dang / /zad ⑩byed lus tsha skya rbab dang / /me drod chung 111—605

dang dug ①nad sbyong / /dur byid dug mo nyung sa byabon/ /pi pi leng dang bca' sga rnams/ /sbrang rtsi rgun 'bru chur ④sbyar ba/ /dbyar gyi dus kyi bkru sman yin/ /dur byid gla sgang byi tsher ba④/ /kha ra tsan+dan ba le ka /shing mngar pa ⑤ta la'i phye ma/ /rgun chu dang sbyar ston gyi yin/ /dur byid pa ta kru trug dhitres/ /zi ra shu dag sa ⑦ra la/ /khron bu'i phye ma chu dron sbyar/ /dgun gyi dus su blud par bya/ /dur byed kha ra cha mnyam pa/ /so ga'i dus kyi bkru sman yin/ /dur byed spa 'bras kyi lce ba/ /pa ⑧ta la dang pu tse shel/ /khron bu legs par btags nas ni/ /ba gcin nang du zhag gsum sbangs/ /'di ni dus kun sbyor ba ste/ /snum zhen dri ma nad rnams 'byin/ /sha ma dur byid byi tsher ba/ /gla sgang ha ste pi pi ling / /dug mo nyung dang ni li ni/ /'bras bu gsum dang pu tse shel/ /phye ma sha khu'am mar ram stini/ /chu dron dang sbyar thams cad du/ /khong rtsub la yang gtang ⑩bar bya/ /rims dang snying nad dreg nad dang / /rtug skam la sogs nad rnams la/ /dong ga'i bkru sman lhag par ni/ /'jam mngar bsil ba phan pa yin/ /byis pa rgan po glo rdol ⑪dang / /skyid de ba yi mi rnams la/ /'jam zhing skyon ni med pa'i phyir / /mchog tu dong ga'i bkru sman gtang / /'bras bu'i dus su legs smin pa'i/ /de yi 'bras bu btus ⑫nas ni/ /de ni yon tan ldan gyur pa/ /khur gcig bye ma'i nang du gzhug /zhag bdun lon nas phyung nas ni/ /nyi ma la ni bskam par bya/ /de nas rkang ni phyung nas su/ /snod ni gtsang mar gzhag par bya/ /byis pa lo bzhi lon pa nas/ /lo ni bcu gnyis lon pa'i bar / /lus tsha rtug 'gags kyis gzir la/ /rgun chur sbyar te blud par bya//111—606

dong ga'i rkang ni mnyes pa dang / /bskol ba'i chu ni grang mo blud/ /yang na chang dwangs zho ga ①chu/ /skyu ru ra yi khu ba 'am/ /rang skyur dag dang bcas pa 'am| /dur byid lde gur sbyar ba sbyin/ /dan da'i khu bar de yi rkang / /bu ram rnying pa ②bcug nas ni/ /zla ba gcig gam zla phyed bar/ /mnan pa'i chang ni blud par bya/ /seng phrom rtsa ba'i shun pa ni/ /nang gi shun lpags bor nas ni/ /bskams te bye mar byas nas ni/ /de la cha gnyis bskol te gzags//seng phrom cha ni gsum pa sbangs/ /rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu ba dang / /cha de slar yang sbang bar bya/ /slar yang bskams te phye mar bya/ /de las ①zho gnyis ba gasbun nam/ /chang gi dwangs ma'am zho ga ④chu/ /rgya shug skyu ru ra'i khu ba/ /gang yang rung dang sbyar te blud/ /seng phrom bskol ba'i khu ba dang / /lde gur byas dang kha ra dang / /mar dang bskol ba'i lde gu de/ /bkru sman gyi ni dam pa yin/ /shrī ⑤khaṇ+ḍas nad kyi tshogs/ /shas cher sogs pa'ang 'jig par byed/ /myur du 'khru zhing drags rjopas na/ /lto snyi nyam ⑦chung byis pa dang / /rgan po nad pa yun ring la/ /de ni gtang bar mi bya'o/ /skran dang dmu rdzing sbyar ba'i dug /pags nad gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /skya rbab skran ⑧dang dug gis phog /nad kyis ⑨sems 'khrugs gyur la gtad/ /de ni tsher ma rnon po ni⑩/ /mang pos khyab par gyur pa mchog /lo gnyis pa 'am lo gsum pa//khyad par du ni dgun gyi mthar/ /de ni mtshon gyis rnam bcad la/ /de las 'o ma blang bar bya/ /bil ba la sogs rtsa ba lnga/ /bri ⑪ha ti ni rnam gnyis dang / /bskol ba'i khu ba dang mnyam pa'i/ /su ti'i 'o ma dang bsres la/ /de 'og me yi mdag mar bskam/ /ri lur byas pa zho ga ⑫chu'am/ /chang ngam ba gcin la 111—607

sogs blud/ /dur byid sogs dgu 'bras bu gsum/ /khron bu sa ba tal ①dang bcas/ /su ta'i 'o mas ⑤zhag bdun sbangs/ /sha khu'am mar dang sbyar te blud/ /tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum/ /dur byid dan da tsi tra ka /de bzhin bu ram chus sbyar blud/ /shang gi ni yi 'bras bu ni/ /phub ma med cing ma skams btu/ /de bzhin sap+ta la'i rtsa ba/ /de dag rnon po 'khru ④byed yin / /bad kan dmu rdzing sbyar ba'i dug /skran sogs nad la gtang bar bya| /de gnyis ri lu zho gnyis tsam/ /chang dang rgyam tshwa ④sbyar ba ni/ /bad rlung las gyur snying nad dang / /de bzhin skran gyi nad la gtang / /dan da dra ban ti'i ⑤rtsa ba/ /glang po'i so ltar brtan zhing sbom/ /dmar zhing gnag la rno zhing dro/ /myur du 'khru bar byed pa yin/ /lci zhing rlung nad 'khru byed cing / /mkhris pa bad kan 'ju bar byed/ /de ni sbrang rtsi pi pi ling /lde gus bskus la 'jag ma dang / /'jim pas bskus te mer bsreg cing / /nyi ma cung zad dro bskams pas/ /de rjoyi rno ba bsal bar bya/ /de ni chang dwangs zho ga ⑦chu/ /dar ba mnan chang pi lu yi/ /khu ba gang yang rung sbyar blud//nyam ⑧chung skran dang gcin snyi dang / /dmu rdzing sbyar ba'i dug rnams sbyong / /ba lang ri dwags ra sha ⑨yi/ /khu bar sbyar bas skya rbab dang / /lto srin mtshan bar rdol ⑩nad sel/ /de bskol khu ba lde gu dag /rtsa ba bcu yi khu bar bskol/ /mar gyis ⑪me dbal khong 'bras dang / /'brum phran mchan khung tsha ba sel/ /til mar bcas pas skran za khu/ /gzhang 'brum rtug 'gags bad rlung sel/ /snum chen sbyar bas khu chu bshang / /'phyen ()'gags rlung gi nad rnams sbyong / /dur byid la sogs dgu po ni/ /bkru 111—608

sman gyi ni rab mchog yin/ /a ru ra yang dur byid kyi/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyar bar bya/ / de nas dus su de'i phye ma/ /rgyam tsha dong gra cung zad gdab/ /rlung nad la ni skyur bas blud/ /①bu ram srang brgyad a ru ra/ /nyi shu dan da tsi tra ka /srang re pi pi ling dur byid/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis lhan cig sbyar/ /ri lu bcu ⑤byas zhag bcu bar/ /ri lu re re zos rjes la/ /chu dron blud cing cho ga 'dis/ /de dag thams cad zos gyur na/ /kun zos bsrung ba mi dgos par/ /'dis ni thams cad sel bar byed/ /mchog tu skya rbab pho ba'i nad| /pags nad rlum po gzhang 'brum dang / /g.yan pa'i nad rnams sel ba yin/ /chung ngu'am don ni chen po dang ④/ /chen po ④las ni nyung zad dag /'dre dang dbye ba byas pa dang / /dus dang sbyor ba ldan par byed/ /shing tsha nā ga ge sar dang / /a mra ta ka se ⑤'bru dang / /sug smel kha ra sbrang rtsi dang / /kha lung chang sogs de dang de/ /yi rang rjes su 'thun pa yi/ /rigs dupas bkru sman gtang bar bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa lasaske/ cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas skyug sman dang bkru sman gyi nyes pa grub par bya ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /skyug sman lto ni snyi ba 'am/ /ltogs pa'am bad kan shas chung ba'amarka/ /shin tu rno ba'am grang ba'ang chung / /ma zhu ba 'ang nyam ⑦chung la//blud na nad 'byung re ba nyams/ /de tshe thur byung nad slong 'gyur/ /de la slar yang snum chos ⑧bya/ /sngar gyi skyon bral ⑨skyug sman gtang / /bkru sman ma zhu bad kan dang / /ldan pa'am shin tu rno ches pa/ /dro ba'am lan tshwa ⑩shas 111—609

ches pa/ /yi gar mi 'ong mangs pa yis/ /gyen du brgal bar gyur pa dag /sngar bshad nyes ①pa de la ni/ /grub pa'i sbyor ba de bzhin bya/ /de yang snod du ma chags na/ /gsum po de la blud mi bya/ /gzhan du goms pa'ang zhib ②pa yi/ /sman ni gnod pa med pa gtang / /snum chos ①dugs ni ma byas la/ /sman ni rnying duzhing rtsub pa yis/ /nad bslangs phyin ⑤par ma nus pas/ /mgo 'khor skrangs dudang skyigs bu dang / /mun par mthong dang skom dad che/ /byin snying na zhing lus g.ya' dang / /bla dang kha dog mi sdug pa'i/ /nad ni skyed par byed pa yin/ /snum chos dugs byas sman nyung zhing / /me drod che bas zhu gyur pa'am/ /grang bas rengs pa'am ma zhu bas/ /nad bslangs ⑦nas ni ma phyin pas/ /nad ni de dag nyid bskyed cing / /de nyid sbyor nyes thams cad yin/ /de la til mar rgyam tshas ⑧bsku/ /gshag ma rdo yi ⑨dugs bya zhing / /mas gtong drag byas skam sa'i sha /kha zas byen la 'jam rtsi ni/ /po son cha dang pi pi ling / /thang shing til mar bskol ba gtang / /rlung 'joms rlung gi snum chos ⑩bya/ /be+er yang bkru sman rnon pos sbyang / /nad gzhi che zhing khong rtsub la/ /me drod chung dang sman chung ba/ /rtug skam bcas pas bslangs ⑪pa dang / /nad kyis lam ni 'gags par 'gyur/ /mi bzad sbo dang lte ba dang / /rgyab dang rtsib logs ⑩mgo bo na/ /phyi sa gcin 'gags dbugs mi bde/ /mi bzad pa ni skyed par byed/ /bsku dang dugs dang ring ⑫bu sogs/ /mas gtong drag po 'jam rtsi bya/ /rtug skam sel ⑫ba'i gso dpyad lasaspyo/ /thams cad sbo ba dag la phan/ /rtsa ba lnga pa nas tshig 'khus/ /shu dag pu ti ka rañdza/ /rgyam tsha nas thug legs sbyar bas/ /gzer nad rtug 111—610

skam lto sbos 'joms/ /thal sman se 'bru pi pi ling / /shing kun bca' sga star bu dang / /rgyam tshar ①bcas pa'i chang ngam ni/ /mar ram chu dron sbyar ba ②blud/ /mkhregs shing yongs su 'dzag pa dang / /na zhing bcad snyam sems pa sel/ /sman 'thungs gyur pa'i shugs bkag na/ /rlung la sogs pa'i nad rnams ni/ /'khrugs te snying gi phyogs song na/ /snying nad ④mi bzad skyed par byed/ /skyigs bu lud pa rtsib logs na/ /rmya zhing mig 'gul kha chu 'dzag /dran pa nyams shing lce 'cha' la/ /so ni krig krig 'cha' bar byed / /de la sman pa rjom rmongs pas/ /mkhris pas nyen la mngar ba dang / /bad kan gyis nyen kha ba yi/ /skyug sman dag ni myur du gtang / /de nas de la smin byed pa'i/ /nad kyi lhag ma smin par bya/ /de yi me drod lus kyi stobs//rim gyis mngon par 'phel bar byed/ /shas cher slon gyur rlung gis ni/ /gang gi snying ni gzer gyur pa/ /de la snum gyur lan tshwa sbyin/ /mkhris pa bad kan de las gzhan/ /sman ni 'thungs par gyur nas shugs/ /bkag par gyur pa'am bad kan gyis/ /'gags pa'am shin tu sbyangs gyur pa'i/ /lus la rlung ni 'jug 'gyur bas/ /rengs dang 'dar dang zug pa dang / /lus snyom ⑤dkris snyam sems shing zug /de la rlung ni 'joms pa yirjo/ /snum chos dugs stsogs thams cad bsngags/ /sman thun che la rno ba ni/ /bkres nyen lto snyi la blud na/ /bad kan mkhris pa bshang ba ni/ /bsal nas lus zungs 'dzag par byed/ /de la sbyor drags mngar ba yi/ /sman gyis ⑦lhag ma slon du gzhug /skyug sman drags la bkru sman gtang / /'khrus drags skyug sman 'jam po gtang / /de la chu grang blud pa dang ⑧/ /ro smad bcings pas 111—611

gcad ①par bya/ /stang ②zil tsan+dan pu shel ④tse/ /ra khrag kha ra'i chu dang ni//'bras yos phye ma'i skyo ma ni/ /sbyor drags sel ba'i dam pa yin/ /slon sman sbyor ba drags pa la/ /chu grang dag ni blugs par bya/ /rgun 'bru ④la sogs khu ba mar⑤/ /sbrang rtsi kha ra'i skyo ma blud/ / sgregs pa bcas dupar shin tu skyug /mur ba 'u su gla ⑦sgang dang / /stang zil ma du ka'i ⑧phye ma/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu sbyin/ /slon mthar lce ni 'khums pa la/ /snum dang skyur dang lan tshwa dang / /ldan pas ⑨mkhur ba bkang ba dang / /yid 'ong yu ⑩sha sha khu phan/ /de yi mdun du mi gzhan ni/ /'bras bu skyur ba za ru gzhug /lce phyir byung la til dang ni/ /rgun 'bru'i ⑪lde gu bskus nas gzhug /tshig bkug rlung gi nad la ni/ /mar dang sha dang g.yos pa yi/ /nas thug ⑫sla ba sbyin bya zhing / /snum dang dugs kyi sbyor ba bya/ /sman gyi sbyor ba drags pa yisag/srog ces bya ba'i khrag phyung na/ /gang phyir de ni srog 'phrog pas/ /srog len par ⑫ni yin par bshad/ /khrag de dang ni zas bcas pa/ /khyi 'am bya rog la byin la/ /zos na srog ces brjod par bya/ /ma zos mkhris pa yin par bshad / /yang na ras dkar la bsgos te/ /bskams la chu dron gyis bkrus la—/ /bkrus kyang dag par ma gyur na/ /mkhris pa'o dag na khrag yin no/ /skom dang brgyal dang myos pas nyen/ /de la srog ni myur bsrung phyir/ /khrag dang mkhris pa sel ba yin⑫/ /gso ba 'tsho ba'i bar du bya/ /ri dwags ba glang ma he ra/ /gson pa'i khrag ni phyung ma thag /srog ni 'byor par byed pa blud/ /des ⑩ni myur du srog tu 'gyur/ /de nyid 'jag ma dang mnyes pa'i//khrag ni 'jam rtsir gtang bar bya/ /dur byed tang pal shing mngar dang / /111—612

drur ba ①pu shel tse 'o ma/ /bskol ba mar gyi snying po dang / /stang zil dang ni bcas pa yi/ /'jam rtsi grang mo gtang bar bya/ /spyi bag 'jam rtsi rab grang ba'am/ /mar gyi snying po 'jam rtsi gtang / /gzhang phyir byung la sman khu yis/ /'khru ba gcad la gzhug par bya/ /dran pa stor la rig byed tshig /gling bu glu dbyangs ④nyan du gzhug /①yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas sman mas gtong ba'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /ba la sle tres ra sna 'bras bu gsum/ /rtsa ba lnga pa rnam gnyis srang re'i tshad/ /po son cha brgyad ra sha srang lnga bcu/ /chu nang bskol te bzhi cha lus gyur pa/ /btsags pa la la phud dang po son cha/ /bil ba ru rta sha ta dhiput+padang / /shu dag gla sgang pi pi ling rnams kyi/ /lde gu bu ram sbrang rtsi mar dang ni/ /til mar rgyam tsha dag dang ldan gyur pa/ /dro 'jam cho ga bzhin du btang gyur pa/ /mas gtong mchog ste nad kun 'joms pa yin/ /nad med la phan tshe ring nyams brtas byed—/ /'jam rtsi gong ⑤du lde gu ma smos pa/ /der ni kun la 'di nyid gzhug par bya/ /rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu ba skyur dang ni/ /ra sha bcas pa snga ma btags pa dang / /snum chen gsum ldan mas gtong mchog yin te/ /rlung gi nad kun rab tu 'joms par rjobashad/ /pa la pa tol rtsa ba chung ngu lnga/ /kyi lce ba dang e raṇ+ḍa dang nas/ /bskol ba'i khu ba bre gang ra sha'i khu/ /de'i phyed bcug la bskol te bre gang lus/ /pri yang ku dang gla sgang pi pi ling / /lde gur byas ⑦shing til mar zhun mar dang / /sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha dang ni ldan gyur pa'i//111—613

'jam rtsi btang na me drod 'phel ba dang / /nyams stobs skyed cing sha ni rgyas pa dang / /mig gi gsal stobs 'phral du skyed par byed/ /e raṇ+ḍa'i rtsa ①srang gsum pa la sha /srang gsum rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu dang / /ra sna ba la sle tres ba spru ba/ /a shwa garnya ②dong ga thang shing rnams/ /po son cha brgyad chu bre brgyad du bskol/ /brgyad cha lus par gyur pa de nang du/ /shu dag shu ti ba sha'i ①'bras bu dang / /pri yang ku dang shing mngar pi pi ling / /dug mo nyung gi dhis bon gla sgang dang / /skyer pa'i khaṇ+ḍar ⑤bcas pa zhib btags pa/ /zho gnyis tshad kyi rgyam tshar bcas pa dang / /sbrang rtsi til mar ba gcin dang sbyar ba'iske/ /mas gtong sgyug byed me drod skyed pa dang / /rkang pa byin pa brla dang mjug to dang / /lto ba snying dang pho mtshan na ba dang / /lus lci rlung dang bshang gci 'gags dang skran/ /rde'u rjochags rgyu rlugs ⑦gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad/ /bad kan rlung nad de dang de dag 'joms/ /shing mngar seng phrom tsan+dan a ru ra/ /tsan+dan ut+pal ba yi 'o mar bskol/ /'tsho byed kha ra mar dang bcas pa yi/ /'jam rtsis ④mkhris pa'i nad rnams sel bar byed/ /ra sna ba sha ka btsos byi tsher ba/ /ba la ⑨rtsa ba chung lnga rtswa yi ⑩lnga/ /thal tres tsan+dan shug pa rnam gnyis dang / /shing mngar seng phrom srang ni phyed phyed dang / /chu dang bskol ba'i khu ba de nyid ⑪ni/ /'o ma bre bzhi bskol te chu ⑫du'i bar/ /dzi ⑫ban ti dang me da rnam gnyis dang / /nye spyoshing ram nye ba gnyis bi da ri/ /ka she ru dang kha ra dkar po dang / /dzi ba ka dang pad+ma ge sar dang / /stag tsher ut+pa la dang pad+ma dkar⑫/ /seng phrom kha sral phre'u shing mngar dang / /nā ga ge sar mudzi ta ka dang / /tsan+dan rnam gnyis btags pa mar dang ni/ /111—614

sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha dang ni ldan byas pa/ /bsgrangs pa'i ni ru ha ni gtang bar bya/ /slar phyung skam sa'i sha khu'am 'o ma dang / /'bras chan byen la lus la chu blugs bya / /lus tsha tshad 'khru mngal nad khrag mkhris dang / /snying nad skya rbab mi bzad rims dang ni/ /skran bcas gcin 'gags mig ser la sogs pa/ /mkhris pa las gyur nad ni thams cad 'joms/ /ko sha ta ka dong ga ①thang shing dang / /mur ba gze ma arga dug mo nyung / /pa ta rgya sran bri ②ha ti chur ①bskol| /khu ba srang ni nyi shu lus pa dang / /der ni nyungs kar sug smel po son cha/ /ru rta zho ni gnyis gnyis tshad dang ni/ /sbrang rtsi po son cha yi mar dang ni/ /thal sman nyungs mar srang ni gnyis gnyis bcas/ /mas gtong me drod chung dang yi ga 'chus/ /bad kan las gyur nad ni kun la phan/ /de nas ni ru ha de rjoni/ /snum 'jam skyid de ba dang ni/ /las kyis lus snyom gyur pa'i sman/ /srang ni gnyis gnyis so sor bshad/ /'o ma las ni srang bzhir bya/ /sbrang ⑤rtsi til mar mar khyer re/ /gzar bus dkrugs rjopa mas gtong bas/ /rlung nad 'jam stobs ⑦kha dog skyed/ /til mar chang dang sbrang rtsi mar/ /khyer ni re re'i tshad du byas/ / bil ba ⑧la sogs rtsa ba ni/ /khyor gnyis rgya sran khu ba ni/ /khyor do bcas pas ⑨rlung nad sel/ /pa to la dang nim pa dang / /lo ma bdun pa pu ti ka /ra sna'i khu ba srang gnyis gnyis—/ /mar srang gnyis dang nyungs kar gyi/ /lde gur ⑩bcas pa kha ba lnga/ /bad kan mang dang srin nad dang / /mje dang za khu'i nad rnams 'joms /til mar ba gcin zho ga ⑫chu/ /skyur rtsabs khyor ni re re dag /yungs kar btags pa'i sde gur sbyar/ /rtug 'gags lto sbos sel byed yin/ /pa yas gye ⑫111—615

dang bu ram shing / /sā ①la paṇi bi da ri/ /ra sna khyor re pi pi ling / /lde gu sbrang rtsi mar sbyar ba'i/ /mas gtong khu ba 'phel bar byed/ /de nas grub pa'i 'jam rtsi ni/ /nyes pa med cing 'bras bu che/ /stobs skyed lus 'phel bde bar byed/ /kun du sbyar bya bshad par bya/ /sbrang rtsi til mar cha mnyam pa//rgyam tsha zho gnyis shu ti bzhi/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi rtsa ba bskol/ /mas gtong sbrang rtsi til mar can④/ /bcud kyis len te gcin snyi dang / /gzhang 'brum srin bu skran nad dang / /rgyu ma rlugs pa'i nad rnams sel/ /'di ni shing mngar phye mar bcas/ /mig la phan zhing khrag mkhris sel/ /gla sgang lde gu sbrang rtsi dang //til mar sha khu mar bcas pa/ /'tsho bar byed pa zhes bya ste/ /gzhang gi nad dang brla nad dang / /chu so dang ni rmig pa dang / /pho mtshan zug pa'i nad rnams sel/ /sbrang rtsi mar dang zhag dang ni/ /til mar khyor ni re re'i tshad/ /rgyam tsha zho gcig spa ma yi/ /'bras bu srang phyed bcas pa dag /de yang 'tsho ba yin par bshad/ /e raṇ+ḍa'i ①rtsa bskol ba yi/ /khu ba shu dag pi pi ling / /po son cha yi phye mar bcas/ /sbrang rtsi til mar rgyam tshar bcas/ /'di ni shing rta can zhes bya/ /de bskol shu dag shu ti dang / /shing kun rgyam tsha thang shing dang / /ra sna sbrang rtsi ④sbyar ba yi/ /'jam rtsi nad sel zhes bya dge/ /rtsa ba lnga yi khu ba dang / /pi pi ling dang rgyam tsha dang / /shing mngar sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi/ /til mar grub pa'i 'jam rtsir bshad/ /rtsa ba bcu pa 'bras bu gsum/ /po son cha ni bil bar bskol/ /ba gcin dang ni de btags shing / /pa ta gla sgang dug mo nyung / /lan tshwa po son cha til mar/ /thal sman lan tshwar bcas pa ni/ /rigs pa'i 'jam rtsi bad kan nad/ /skya rbab 111—616

gsud pa'i nad rnams dang / /khu ba rlung ni 'gags pa dang / /rlung 'khrugs pa la bsngags pa yin/ /gla sgang pa ta e raṇ+ḍa/ /sle tres ba la ba spru ba//ra sna btsod dang dong ga dang / /pu shel tse dang kyi lce ba/ /ba ru ra dang pu tse shel / /rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu rnams/ /srang re po son cha rdog ①brgyad/ /de ni chu bre bzhi nang bskol/ /bzhi cha lus pa btsags nas ni/ /'o ma bre do dang bsres la/ /'o ma lus pa slar yang bskol/ /skam sa'i sha khu bzhi cha dang / /sbrang rtsi rgyam tsha shing mngar dang / /shu ti dur byid pi pi ling / /dug mo nyung dang skyer skekhaṇ+ḍa/ /btags pa dang ni bsres pa yi/ /'jam rtsi dro 'jam btang nasheni/ /sha dang me drod lus kyi stobs/ /khu ba 'phel bar byed pa yin/ /dreg nad rmongs bag gcin snyi dang / /gzhang 'brum skran dang bshang gci 'gags| /mi bzad rims dang me dbal dang / /rgyu rlugs lto sbos ④'khrug cing 'khru/ /chu so rked pa brla dku na/ /gnye'u rengs rna ba mgo bo'i nad/ /zla mtshan nad dang sbyo byed dang / /'or nad lud pa rde'u chags dang / /gcin 'khyil ba yi nad rnams 'joms/ /dbang po nyams shing zhum pa dang / /mig la phan zhing bu skyed byed/ /'tsho byed rgyal po bcud len yin/ /ri dwags phra mo mgo chung ba/ /rtsa ba bcu pa bskol ba'i chu/ /spa ma'i 'bras bu shu ti dang / /gla sgang lde gu snum chen bcas/ /mas gtong rlung ni sel ba'i mchog /shin tu ro tsar byed pa yin/ /rma bya'i gshog pa mkhris pa dang / /rgyu ma rkang pa mchu rtug pa/ /bor ba'i sha ni 'ba' zhig dang / /rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu ni/ /srang re dang ni ldan gyur pa/ /chu dang 'o mar bskol nas ni/ /'o ma lus par sbrang rtsi mar/ /bcas dang de bzhin bi da ri/ /shing mngar 111—617

shu ti pi pi ling / /po son cha yi lde gur bsres/ /rgyam tsha cung zad btab pa yirka/ /'jam rtsi stobs 'phel ro tsa'i ①mchog /gong ma sreg ②la sogs pa yang ④/ /cho ga 'di ni so sor bya/ /khron gyis gzas tshol thams cad dang / /mthu rtsal mchu yis zas dhitshol ba/ /chu la gnas pa'ang de bzhin te/ /nya la 'o ma sbang bar bya/ /sram dang ne+e'u le byi la dang / /reg 'jam byi ba rnams kyi sha /re re srang bcu rtsa ba lnga/ /'o ma'i nang du bskol nas ni/ /'o ma der ni po son cha/ /pi pi ling dang lan tshwa gnyis/ /kha ra til mar sbrang rtsi mar / /'jam rtsi btang na bcud len mchog⑤ /rtsol bas dkrugs glo 'grams pa dang / /dbang po nyams dang gzi mdangs stobs/ /khya chu bshang gci 'gags pa dang / /dreg nad kyis 'theng nad rnams dang / /rta dang glang bo shing rtas g.yeng rjo/ /rkang lag chag grugs gyur pa la/ /slar ni bde bar 'tsho byed cing / /ro tsa ⑦byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /kha sral bu ram shing phran las/ /g.yos su byas pa'i 'o thug blud/ /snum zhing bsdams ⑧pa mi dgos pa'i/ /grub pa'i sman ni sbyar bar bya/ /nad 'joms srung ⑨dang bcas pa yi/ /snum gyi 'jam rtsi bshad bya ste/ /rtsa ba bcu pa ba la dang / /ra sna a shwa ⑩garnya dang / /ba spru ba dang e raṇa dang / /sle tres ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / /ba sha ka dang bu ti ka /sa ha ra dza nye ⑪shing ba/ /ka ka na se srang re dang / /nas dang ma sha zar ma dang / /rgya shug rgya sran khyor re'i tshad/ /chu bre drug cu rtsa bzhir ⑫bskol/ /de las bre ni bcu drug lus/ /'tsho byed sde ni srang re bcug /til mar bre ni bzhi dang bskol/ /'di di 'jam rtsir btang gyur na/ /rlung nad thams cad sel bar byed/ /de bzhin skam sa'i 111—618

srog chags sha① /'tsho byed sde dang bcas par bskol/ /shu ti nas dang bil ba sgyur④/ /til mar bskol bas rlung nad ①sel/ /rgyam tsha mdog dmar gyur gyi bar/ /mer bsregs mar gsur rlung nad rjo'ajoms/ / dzi ban ti ⑤dang po son cha/ /me da rnam gnyis sra ba ni/ /shing mngar ba la shu ti dang / /zangs rtsi ba dang pi pi ling / /ka ka ni sa nye rjoshing ba/ /kha sral k+ṣ-i ra ⑦ka ka ri / /zur pa karka ta sring gi/ /shu dag btags pa'i lde gu dang / /til mar mar dang 'o ma ni/ /bzhi 'gyur gyi ni nang du bskol/ /'jam rtsi nyams brtas rlung nad ⑧'joms/ /stobs dang khu ba me drod 'phel/ /khrag dang khu ba'i nad sel byed/ /bu skyed par yang byed pa yin/ /rgyam tsha ru rta po son cha/ /shu ti lcang ma shu dag dang / /ba le ka dang shing mngar ⑨dang / /ga bra'i rtsa ba kad pha la/ /thang shing dong gra ⑩ma nu dang / /me da dbye mo ⑩tsi tra ka /zur pa bong nga byi dang ga⑫ /sha ma dur byed ha re rku⑫/ /nyi ra bil ba ni li ni/ /ti ⑩mu sa dang pi pi ling / /dan da ra sna cha mnyam pa/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi mar ram ni//til mar bskol ba'i 'jam rtsi yis/ /bad kan nad 'joms rgyu rlugs dang / /rtug skam skran dang gzhang 'brum dang / /mcher pa'i nad dang gcin snyi dang / /rlung 'khyil ba dang lto sbos dang / /rde chags nad ni myur du sel/ /yang na be+el ba la sogs pa'i/ /rtsa ba lnga pa spyotil mar bskol/ /yang na bad kan sel sman sbyar/ /til mar dang btang bad kan 'joms/ /yang na po son cha brgyad 'gyur/ /skyur bskol 'jam rtsis ⑩bad kan sel/ /'jam rtsi 'jam pas rmongs gyur ⑫la/ /rnon po ⑫nye bar sbyang bar bya/ /rno bas gnod la ⑪snum pa dang / /mngar zhing bsil ba 'jam pa gtang / /rnon po ba gcin pi 111—619

lu dang / /tsi tra ka dang lan tshwa dang / /thal sman dang ni nyungs kar rnams/ /dus la bab par gtang bar bya/ /'o ma mar stsogs 'jam po yis/ /nyams ①stobs dus dang nad gzhi rang bzhin dag /rnam par phye ste 'jam rtsi gtang bya ba②/ /rang rang gi ni sman gyi sde tshan gyis/ /rang rang gi ni nad rnams bsal bar bya/ /tsha bas nyam thag la bsil ba/ /bsil bas nyen la dro 'jam sbyar/ /de dang 'tsham pa'i sman ldan par/ /'jam rtsi brtags ①te gtang bar bya/ /sbyang bar bya ba'i nad rnams la/ /rtas byed 'jam rtsi mi gtang zhing / /mi gang mdze gcin nad kyis nyen/ /tshil rgyas nad la gtang mi bya/ /nyam chung glo 'grams pa dang brgyal ba dang / /lus skem rid dang sbyangs pa'i lus can dang / /gang yang dri mas tshe 'di gzung rjo'agyur la/ /spyong bar byed pa'i mas gtong gtang mi bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas sman mas gtong ba'i cho gas nad phyin te sos par bya ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /snum chos dudugs ni ma byas dang / /lto lci ba la sman grang snumarka/ /che nyung sman tshad chung ba 'amarjo/ /sman ni ska ⑦ba btang gyur ⑧na/ /de yis nad ni bslangs ⑨gyur dang / /stobs chung ba yi nad ma phyin/ /sbyor ba nyes pa skyed 'gyur zhing / /'phyen dang phyi sa gcin sri dang / /lte ba chu so na zhing tsha/ /dang gar ⑩chags shing gzhang skrangs dang / /g.yan pa'i thor bu mdog mi sdug /mi dga' me drod chung bar 'gyur/ /tshad 'khru'i nyes pa bar ma la/ /sngar bshad sman gyi khu ba gnyis/ /de las gcig ni dro ba yi/ /171—620

btung ba blugs pa ①bsngags pa yin/ /po son cha yi reng bu'i ②dugs/ /dus shes pa yis bkru sman gtang / /bil ba'i rtsa ba dur byid dang / /thang shing nas dang rgya shug dang ④/ /rgya sran chang dang ba gcin bcas/ /mas gtong 'gags pa sel bar byed/ /nad gzhi shas che lus rtsub dang / /lto sra nus pa chung btang na/ /mas gtong nad gzhi bslangs ④nas ni/ /rlung gi lam ni 'gag ⑤par byed/ /rlung ni lam log zhugs pa des/ /lto sbos nad rnams gzir bar byed/ /gzhang dang lto ba tsha ba dang / /rmig pa chu so na byed cing / /snying gar 'gags pas gzer ba dang / /phan tshun du ni 'gro bar byed / /de la lus bsku dugs byas pa'i/ /lus la reng bu gzhug par bya/ /bil ba stsogs sam bi lu dang / /nyungs kar ba gcin bcas mas gtong / /tsi tra thang shing til mar ni/ /bskol ba'i 'jam rtsi gtang rjobar bya/ /shugs ni bkag par gyur pa 'am/ /btsir drags par ni byas pa 'am/ /lan tshwa snum shas chung la tsha/ /sman chung ba yis mas gtong ba/ /'jam pas rlung gis ⑦gyen du 'phul/ /kha dang sna nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de yis brgyal dang snying nad dang / /skom dang tsha ba la sogs 'byung / /brgyal ba'i nad ni mthong gyur ⑧na/ /de yi gdong stil chu grang gtor/ /ngal bsos ⑩bar du g.yab pa dang / /dbugs rngub 'byung ba byed du gzhug /kha sbubs ⑩bzhag ste rgyab rtsib logs/ /lto ba lag pa dron pos mnye/ /skra nas bteg ste sprugs ⑫pa dang / /sbrul dang mche ba can 'jigs bstan/ /mtshon dang thog bab rgyal po'i mis/ /skrag bcas mas gtong thur du 'byung ⑫/ /lag pa gos kyis mgul par bsdam/ /ci nas 'chi bar mi 'gyur bya/ /srog dang gyen rgyu ⑫rlung 111—621

bkag pas/ /thur sel shin tu bder rgyu ①ba/ /grub pa yis ni ④mas gtong bske/ /myur du 'dren par byed pa yin/ /ru rta gla gor zho sha yi/ /lde gu sgyur rtsabs sbyar te blud/ /dro dang rno dang 'khru ba yis/ /mas gtong lugs bzhin 'byung bar byed/ /dur byid a ru ra ba gcin/ /sbyar blud lugs bzhin 'byung bar byed/ /zhu ba'i gnas 'dug dugs byas la/ /rtsa ba bcu pa rgya shug nas/ /rgya sran ba gcin bskol ba yi/ /mas gtong drag po ④sbyar bar bya / /sle tres sgyug ma'i lo ma dang / /pu ti ka rañdza'i shun pa/ /'o ma zur pa thang shing dang / /pu ti ka ni ba gcin bskol/ /til mar bu ram rgyam tshar bcas—/ /bkru sman lde gur bcas pa gtang / /mas gtong brang na gnas pa larka/ /bil ba la sogs lnga bskol gtang / /mgor gnas snar blugs dud pa rngubarjo—/ /nyungs kar lde gus mgo bo bsku/ /mas gtong drod ches rno skyur drags//ska ⑤ches dugs ni drags pa dang / /nad gzhi chung zhing lto snyi la/ /yang dang yang du gtong ba yi0/ /sbyor ba drags pa nyes ⑦'gyur bas/ /lto ba'i nad ni skyed par byed/ /de la bkru sman drag sbyar bas/ /gso dang ⑧mtshungs pa nyid du bya/ /mas gtong thal sman sgyur rno dro/ /lan tshwa can nam mkhris can la/ /gzhang tsha 'brud cing gnod pa dang / /yongs su 'dzag par byed par 'gyur/ /khrag ni btsos pa lta bur 'byung / /mkhris pa'ang mdog mang 'byung bar byed/ /lan mang shugs drag 'byung ba dang / /yang dang yang du brgyal bar 'gyur/ /de la khrag mkhris 'khru ba sel/ /gso ba ⑨rab tu bsngags pa yin/ /tsha ba sogs la dur byid kyi/ /sde gu rgun chur sbyar ba blud/ /de yis bshang rlung mkhris pa ni/ /bsal nas tsha ba la sogs 'joms/ /dag gyur nas thug grang 111—622

mo ni/ /kha ra dang ni bcas pa ①blud/ /'khru ba drags par gyur pa yi②/ /bshang ba zad la kha zas ni/ /ma sha'i khu ba zan dron sbyin/ /zho dang chang ni blud par bya/ /de ltar grub pa'i mas gtong nyes/ /bshad nas snum gyi mas gtong bshad/ /rlung can grang zhing chung ba dang / /mkhris pa rab tsha bad kan 'jam/ /'grangs dze+eches pa la lci ba dang / /bshang ba stsogs la stobs chung gtang / /de ni snum rlung 'dres gyur ④zhing / /zil gyes mnan pas 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rengs dang brla na sbos pa dang / /rims dang gzer dang yan lag na/ /rtsib logs na dang 'dar ba ni/ /snum rlung 'dres la ⑤'byung zhes bya/ /de snum lan tshwa dro dang skyur/ / ra sna bi da dro rjoyi mar rang skyur chang dang rgya shug dang / /rgya sran nas dang bskol ba 'am/ /rtsa ba lnga pa ba gcin bcas/ /mas gtong drag pos legs bsal bya/ /de dag nyid kyi ⑦til mar dang / /dgongs ⑧kar zan zos 'jam rtsi gtang / /skom dang lus tsha rmongs bag dmar/ /mdog nyams rims 'debs mun par mthong / /mkhris pa dang 'dres yin zhes bya/ /kha mngar mas gtong byas te sbyangs⑨/ /lus snyom sgyid zhan rims ⑩drag 'debs/ /cham pa lus phyi yi ga 'chus/ /brgyal bcas ⑩na bas bad kan dang / /'jam rtsi ⑫snum ni 'dres shes bya/ /de la bska dang kha dang tsha/ /chang dang ba gcin la bskol ba⑫/ /po son cha dang til mar dang / /skyur bcas mas gtong ba yis bsal/ /slon dang brgyal ⑫dang yi ga 'chus/ /snyom gzer gnyid che yan lag na⑫/ /ma zhu'i mtshan mar lus tshar bcas/ /de ni 'grangs ⑩ches 'dres shes bya/ /de la tsha dang lan tshwa'i ⑩phye/ /bskol ba'i smin byed sman dang ni/ /bkru sman 'jam po gtang ba 111—623

dang / /ma zhu la phan thams cad phan/ /gcin rtug 'phyen ①ni 'gags pas nyen—/ /lus lci lto ②sbos snying ga na/ /snum dang bshang 'dres yin zhes bya/ /de la snum dugs ring bur ④bcas/ /dur byid bil rjob sogs bskol la⑤/ /mas gtong drag rjodang 'jam rtsi gtang / /rtug pa 'gags pa sel bas kyang / /cho ga bzhin du legs par bsal/ /rtog ⑦pa'am gzhang ni skrang ⑧pa 'am /thug pa legs par 'thungs pa yis/ /rkub ⑨tu snum ni btang gyur pa⑩/ /sdod pa med par shugs kyis spyorgyu/ /de nas ro stod mgrin pa dang / /stod kyi bu ga dag tu'ang ⑫'byung / /de la dur byid rgya shug nas/ /rgya sran ba gcin bskol ba dang / /de dang bskol ba'i til mar ni/ /mas gtong 'jam rtsir bcas pa gtang / /lkog mar byung ba dgag par bya⑫/ /lkog ma ⑫bsdams shing sgyug sman dang ⑫/ /slon bro sel ba'i gso bas kyang ⑩/ /bzlog pa dag ni de la bya/ /snum tshos ma gyur mi gtang ste/ /des ni gzhang khar ⑩chags 'gyur zhing / /de las ⑫nad bcas rmongs bag dang / /g.ya' dang skrang pa skyed par byed—/ /de la mas gtong rnon po dang / /arka'i lor bskol til mar gtang //dbugs ma phyung bar bcing ba 'am⑪/ /ma lus par ni btang ba yis/ /rlung zhugs nas ni 'khrug byed cing / /gzer dang na ba skyed par byed/ /de la gzhang kha bsku dugs bya/ /rlung 'joms pa yi kha zas gtang / /myur du bcug cing phyung ba 'am/ /glo bur du ni bteg ⑥pa yis/ /rked pa gzhang dang brla byin pa0/ /chu so rengs shing na bar 'gyur/ /de la rlung 'joms kha zas dang / /dugs bsku 'jam rtsir bcas pa phan/ /btsir ba'i tshe na bar du grol/ /rlung gis gzhang la gnod gyur nas/ /brang dang mgo bo gzer zhing na/ /brla 111—624

yi nad ni skyed par byed/ /de la bil ba la sogs dang / /po son cha dang dur byid sogs/ /ba gcin dang ni sbyar ba gtang / /btsir drags pa yis khong par ni/ /mi 'dug skog mar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de la mas gtong bkru sman dang / /mgul pa bsdam ①sogs las rnams bya/ /bkru sman sogs pas dag byas nas/ /lus dang nyams stobs me drod chung / /sgo nga gzhon nu'am til mar ni/ /snod ni gang ba ji bzhin du/ /gnod par gyur pa thams cad las—/ /sman pas 'bad de bsrung bar bya/ /kha zas mngar dang yid 'ong sbyin| /de 'og skyur dang lan tshwar bcas/ /de nas mngar dang kha ba sbyin/ /de 'og bska dang tsha ba sbyin/ /ro ni snum dang rtsub pa dang ②/ /phan tshun gnyen por gyur pa bzhin④/ /rim pa nye bar sbyar ba yi④/ /rim pa de ni rnal du dbab/ /kun bzod ⑤nyams stobs brtan pa ni/ /rnal mar gyur pa yin zhes bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas sman gyi cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /sa phyogs skam zhing cha mnyam pa'i//gzhi mnyam gtsang zhing sa gzhi bzang / /dur khrod shing chen lha rjoganas dang / /g.yang sa grog ma can ma gtogs/ /'jam zhing chu ni g.yas na 'bab/ /'jag ma drur ba ⑦dang ldan pa/ /thong lcags kyis ⑧ni ma snad pa/ /ljon shing grib mas ma phog pa/ /kha dog bcud la sogs dang ⑨ldan/ /sman skyes pa ni bsngags pa yin/ /'bus ma zos shing mes ma tshig /'byung ba sogs kyis gnod ma gyur/ /nyi ⑩grib chu la sogs ma nyen/ /ji bzhin dus su bsten gyur 111—625

pa / /rtsa ba che zhing gting du zug /byang gi phyogs su bsten pa bzang / /de nas dge ba la spyod cing / /dad ldan gtsang sbra sgyung ba byas/ /sman ni legs par gnas pa btu/ /'o mar bcas pa dus su sbyar/ /bu ram mar dang sbrang rtsi dang / /pi pi ling dang byi dang ga① /'bru rnams ma gtogs 'o ma med/ /lo gcig 'das par ma gyur sbyar/ /dze+e'o ma ba ni yar ma yi/ / gcin dang lci ba skyon med yin/ /①na tshod stobs ldan lus zungs dang / /rwa 'dzugs ④rmig pa la sogs bzang / /lan tshwa ma gtogs ro lnga'o⑤/ /sman khu yi ni skye gnas yin/ /sman khu sde gu bskol dang grangs/ /phan dang zhes ni bya ba ste/ /sman ni rnam pa lnga ru brtagasame/ /snga ma bzhin du mthu stobs che/ /'phral du btus te brdungs nas ni/ /tshags la ⑦btsir te btsags pa gang / /de ni khu ba zhes bshad do/ /lde gu gsher gyis sbrus btags pa'o/ /de bskol ba ni bskol ba yin/ /bsgrangs pa mtshan mo gzhag pa yin/ /khaṇ+ḍa ⑧'phral du sbyar btsags pa/ /de dag gi ni tshad brtag pa/ /nad stsogs stobs las sbyar bar bya/ /de yang drang srong gis bshad pa/ /tshad kyi nges pa yod min gyi⑨/ /nad dang lto tshad nyams dang ni/ /dus dang yul di rnam brtags te⑩/ /de ltar sman ni gtang bar bya/ /sman kyi khu ba srang bzhi ni/ /'bring tshad tsam du bshad pa yin/ /sde gu zho gnyis dag dang bsres/ /de ni chu srang gsum gyi ⑪tshad—/ /bskol ba'i sman ni srang gcig bya/ /bre phyed chu bskol bzhi cha lus//bsgrangs pa srang gcig srang drug ni/ /de las gzhan pas srang bzhi yin/ /sman mar bskol tshad ma smos par/ /lde gu snum dang gsher rdzas ni/ /bzhi 'gyur du ni skyed de sbyar/ /sho ⑫na ka yis bshad pa ni/ /snum bskol chu ni 111—626

'ba' zhig dang / /khu ba bskol ba ①rim bzhin du/ /lde gu'i cha ni bzhi dang drug /brgyad ni rim ②bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /lde gu sor mor ma 'byar ④dang //snum ni mer bcug sgra med dang / /gang tshe kha dog sogs phun tshogs/ /de tshe der ni myur du dbab/ /mar ni be+e ④ba dwangs ma dang / /til mar lbu ba byung ba dang / /lde gu nal nal por 'gyur zhing / /chu nang 'bying ⑤zhing gyes mi 'gyuraske/ /tshos pa'i tshad geni rnam gsum ste/ /'jam tshos 'byar bag 'byar la rtsub/ /'jam tshos tshig ⑦ma sde gu 'dra/ /'byar bag sbrang rtsi lta bu yin/ /cung zad tshig cing mdog gnag par/ /snang 'gyur de ni tha ma yin/ /de las 'das par don mi byed/ /ma tshos me drod nyams par byed/ /'jam tshos snar btang rtsub ⑧pas bsku/ /btung dang 'jam rtsi 'byar bag bya/ /sha na kar sha lag mthil dang / /spar gang phul bre a da ka /dro ⑨na ba ha rim bzhin du/ /bzhi 'gyur yin par shes par bya/ /rlon pa nyis ⑩'gyur sbyar bya zhing / /gsher pa phul gang stsogs de bzhin/ /btags te sbrus nas gsher med pa'i⑪/ /snum bskol ba la chu gzhug ⑫bya/ /gang du tshad ni ma bshad pa/ /der ni cha mnyam sbyar bar bya/ /sha na gnyis la ba da ⑫ka /de gnyis kar sha go la dang / /ba ru ra dang drang 'khru ⑩med/ /ak+ṣa ⑫bi tsu su par+ṇa⑩/ /lag mthil kham tshad byi la'i sder/ /tin ⑩du ka dang lag pa'i tshad/ /sgra gzhan don ni gcig pa yin/ / shu ti ⑫brgyad pa pi tsu yin/ /srang gcig bil ba pra kun dza⑪/ /sbar gang ⑥a mra bzhi po yin/ /gcig gi ming gi rnam grangs yin/ /srang gnyis khyor gang de gnyis la/ /snyim gang de gnyis ma ni ka/a da ka dang snod ka nas/ /dro ⑪na kum pa bum chen yin/ /tu la srang ni 111—627

brgya yin te/ /de nyi shu la khur du bshad/ /gangs can 'bigs byed ri yis ni| /sa gzhi phal cher khyab pa yin/ /de las dang por bsil zhing phan/ /'bigs byed sman ni me'i rang bzhin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las—/ cho ga grub pa'i gnas kyi le'u drug pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ cho ga grub pa'i gnas te gnas lnga pa lus gso ba'i yan lag rdzogs so// //de nas byes pa gso ba'i cho ga'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /de yang rgyun shes kyi bu la sogs pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis 'di ltar bshad de/ byis pa btsas ma thag phru ma①/ /bsal te rgyam sdetsha mar bskus sbyang / /de 'og btsas pas sdug bsngal la/ /ba la'i til mar blugs par bya/ /de yi rna ba'i drung du ④ni / /rdo gnyis brdungs par spyad ④par bya/ /de nas de yi rna ba ni/ /g.yas par sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /yan lag yan lag las byung khyod/ /snying las mngon par bskyed ⑤pa yin/ /bdag nyid bu zhes bya ba khyod/ /lo brgyar yang dag 'tsho 'gyur zhing rjo/ /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya 'tsho/ /tshe ring por ⑦ni thob gyur cig /rgyu skar phyogs dang mtshan mo dang / /nyin mos khyod ni bsrung ⑧bar shog /bde bar gyur na lte ba ni/ /sor bzhi'i 'og tu srad bus bcing / /de yi 'og tu bcad nas ni/ /lte ba la ni brtod ⑨de bzhag /de 'og lte bar ⑩ru rta yi/ /til mar gyis ni bsku bar bya/ /'o ma can shing bskol chu 'am/ /dri zhim bcud ldan chu dag ni/ /gser ram dngul ni bsregs pa yis/ /bsros pa'i dro 'jam chu yis bkru/ /de nas 111—628
