mdzub mo g.yas pa ni/ /dkris pas rkan ni bteg ①nas kyang / /mgo bor ②ras bal snum can g.yogasag/ /blo dang tshe dang stobs bskyed phyir/ /shu dag pra ma bi sha li/ / shang kha ④put+pa'i lde gu ni/ /mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa dag/sngags btab ha re rku ⑤tsam sbyin/ /gser dang shu dag mu men dang / /ma nu a ru ra'i bye ma/ /gser dang skyu ru ra'i phye ma/ /sbrang rtsi mar bcas lde gu sbyin//de nas mngal chu rgyam tsha ni/ /mar dang bcas pa sgyug tu gzhug /skye dgu'i bdag po cho ga yisarjo/ /btsas pa'i cho ga byed du gzhug /snying la gnas pa'i rtsa rnams ni/ /btsas nas kha ni dbye ba'i phyir/ /nyi ma gsum mam bzhi pa la/ /bud med kyi ni nu zho 'byung / /de bas nyin zhag dang po la/ /dus gsum du ni sbrang rtsi mar/ /byi tsher ba dang sbyar ba la/ /sngags kyis btab ste byis par ⑦byen/ /gnyis pa dang ni gsum pa la/ /lasgri ⑧dang bskol mar blud bya/ /de nas dang po'i nu zho ni/ /bkag pa de la mar sar ni/ /zho gnyis tsam gyi tshad sbyin zhing / /nu zho dus gnyis blud par bya/ /ma nyid kyi ni nu zho blud/ /de yis ⑨lus ni 'phel byed yin/ /de med ma ma shin tu byams/ /skyon med 'khrig pa spangs pa dang / /rigs dang rang bzhin de dang mnyam/ /nad med na tshod dar la bab/ / bu ma shi shing brkam ⑩chags med/ /gnyis kyi 'o ma blud par bya/ /de gnyis zas dang spyod lam ni/ /phan pas 'bad de gso bar bya/ /mya ngan khro dang sgyung ba dang / /lus dub nu zho nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bu ram chang ma gtogs chang dang / /rlan can sha khu 'o ma dang / /'o ma can sman mya ngan stsogs/ /go bzlog nu zho'i rgyun ⑩yin no/ /mi mthun zas ni zos pa dang / /ltogs dang sems ni nyams pa dang / /lus zungs gnod bcas ⑫111—629

sbrum ma yi/ /'o ma byes pa'i nad skyed byed/ /nu zho med na ra 'am ba'i /'o ma bri ha ti ①sogs rtsa'am/ /ste ra gnyis bskol kha rar bcas /yon tan de ldan blud par bya/ /drug pa'i mtshan mo khyad par du/ /bsrung dang gtor ma'i bya ba bya/ /de yi gnyen gyis mel tshe bya/ /shin tu dga' ba nyid kyang bya/ /zhag bcu rdzogs par 'gyur ba ④dang / /rang rig 'tsham pa'i cho ga ni/ /byed du gzhug ①cing btsas ma bslang rjo/ /lus la ldong ros ba bla dang / /gi waṃ ⑤tsan+dan a kar btags/ /rgyu skar lha 'am nye du las/ /dras dupa'i yi ge mnyam pa yi/ /ming ni byis pa la gdags bya/ /de nas rang bzhin dbye las bshad/ /gzugs kyi tshe ni yongs su brtag⑦ /mkhas pas byis pa'i mal stan ni/ /byang ngam shar du mgo bstan la/ /sngas dang gos ni gtsang zhing bkrus/ /'jam zhing gnyer ma med pa yi/ /gos la gdon ni 'joms byed pa'i/ /sman gyi dud skepas bdug par ⑨bya/ /bya rog bsad pa snum gsum dang / /bcas pa'i dud ⑩pas bdug par bsngags⑪/ /bse ru la sogs gson po yi/ /rwar ⑫btags nor bu bzang po sru/ /pras+ho ⑫'tsho byed i— ⑫sogs—/ /sman ni bzang po gdags par bya/ /mchog tu rtag par shu dag ni/ /lag gnyis mgul dang spyi bor gdags/ /des ni tshe dang yid gzhungs dran/ /bde ba skyed byed gdon las bsrung / /zla ba bdun nam brgyad pa na/ /nad med nyin zhag shis pa la/ /ma ma'i pang du spro bsrings la/ /dgun gyi dus su rna ba dbug /khye 'u'i dang po g.yas pa dbug /bu mo'i g.yon pa ⑫dbug par bya—/ /sman pas khab ni g.yas pas gzung ⑩/ /g.yon pas rna shal bzung nas ni/ /rna ba'i khyon gyi dbus las ni/ /mkhur tshos kyi ni phyogs dag tu/ /111—630

pags pa dag ni phug nas su/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer snang ba ru①/ /mi 'gyur brtan por bzung nas ni/ /rgya skyegs kyi ni khu bas bsku/ /dbus su rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i/ /bu ga drang por cig car dze+edabug /de nas rtsa ni g.yas ③pa'i phyir/ /steng 'og ngos gnyis gtang mi bya/ /nag po gnad 'dra ④dmar po ste/ /rtsa de phug na dmar zhing na/ /skrang zhing tsha la sra ba dang / /gnye'u rengs ⑤gzhan dbang can nad skyed/ /de rnams nad gzhi ji bzhin du/ /gso ba dag ni myur du dubya/ /gnad du phug na khrag med cing / / nad dang dmar ⑦sogs 'byung mi 'gyur/ /khab rjes skud pa snum can ni/ /rjes su gzhug pa nyid du byas⑧/ /til mar zlon pas ⑨bsku ba dang / /rgya cher de ⑩ni bskyed par bya/ /rna shal phug nas phan zas byin⑩/ /de 'og sdong bu sbom po gzhug /zhag gsum bzhag nas rma 'tshobs nas/ /rim gyis de ni bskyed par bya/ /de nas de yi so skyes nas/ /nu zho 'thung ⑫las rim gyis bzlog /sngar bshad 'o ma sbyin bya zhing / /kha zas yang dang rtas byed byen⑫/ /nu zho spangs nas bi ya la'i/ /rkang dang shing mngar 'bras yos dang / / ka ra dkar po la du sbyin/ /⑫bil ba gzhon nu sug smel dang / /kha ra 'bras yos drod skyed sbyin/ /'khru gcod da ta ⑩ka'i me tog /kha ra 'bras yos skyo ma sbyin| /gnod pa skyed par mi byed pa'i/ /sman gyis de yi ⑫nad bsal bya/ /shin tu drags ⑩nad ma gtogs gzhan/ /rno sman bkru sman kun tu spangs⑫/ /tshul min skrag par mi bya ste/ /skrag na gdon ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /gos kyi rlung dang gzhan reg dang / /'gom pa la ni de bsrung bya/ / brasnyi nyungs ⑪kar shu dag dang / /rgyam tsha ru rta sha ri ba/ /pi pi ling bcas bskol ba yi/ /111—631

sman mar dran dang yid gzhungs ①skyed/ /tshe 'phel gdon ni mi bzad 'joms/ /'byung po smyo byed zlog par byed/ /so ma ra dza ②shu dag dang / /sbal pa nye shing sle tres dang / /shang ka put+pa brastisnedang / /pra ④ma so ma srang re ni/ /lde gu brgyad cha mar bye gang / /'o ma bzhi 'gyur nang du ni/ /bskol ba de blud dpal yon dang / /tshe blo yid gzhungs dran pa skyed/ /ra yi 'o ma a ru ra/ /tsha ba gsum dang pa ta dang / /shi kru ⑤shu dag lce myang tsha/ /bskol ba'i sman mar dbyangs can de/ /tshig dang blo gros dran pa dang / /ngag gsal me drod skyed par byed/ /shu dag sle tres a ru ra/ /nye 0shing ba dang shang gi ni/ /a pa marga ⑦bskol ba yi/ /sman mar yon tan snga mar mtshungs/ /shu dag dkar po ru rta gser//arga'i put+pa gser dang bcas/ /lcags rkyags ⑧dang ni dung dang gser/ /ka raspru dang shu dag gser/ /rkang pa re res ⑨bshad pa bzhi⑩/ /sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas lde gu/ /lo gcig byin na lus dang blo/ /kha dog nyams stobs skyed par byed—/ /shu dag shing mngar lce myang tsha/ /dong gra shu ti a ru ra/ /ru rta zur pa pi pi ling / /mar bcas lde gu dag dag byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gnas kyi ⑪phyi ma'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas byis pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /'o ma zas dang gnyi gas 'tsho/ /byes pa ⑩rnam pa gsum du bshad/ /de dag gnod med las bder 'gyur/ /gnod pa las ni nad rnams 'byung / /gang zhig chu dang gcig tu ⑫'dres/ /nyes pa yod pa ma yin te/ /'o ma de ni skyon med yin/ /rlung gis gnod gyur ⑫chu steng 'phyo/ /bska ⑫zhing rtsub la sbra ba can/ /de yis 111—632

bshang gci sri bar byed/ /mkhris las gnod gyur ①dro skyur tsha/ /ri mo ser snang ②des tsha skyed/ /bad kan gyis ska lan tshwar bcas/ /sbyin bag ④can la chu nang 'bying / /ldan pa'i mtshan ma 'dren ma ste/ /'dus pa'i mtshan ma gsum dang ldan/ /rang gi mtshan ma ci 'dra las/ /de 'thungs pas ni ④nad skyed 'gyur/ /byis pa rtag tu mi bzad par/ /ngu ba la ni nad shes bya/ /de ni phyogs gang shas cher 'dzin/ /gang du reg par mi bzod pa⑤/ /de na nad yod shes par bya/ /mgo nad mig 'byed las shes bya/ /snying nad lce mchu sos gnon dang / /dbugs dang khu tshur bsdams rjoshes bya/ /khong nad bshang gci sri dang slon/ /nu ma sos 'debs rgyu ma 'khrug /lto sbo ⑦rgyab ni 'gugs ⑧dgye dang / /lto 'gugs pas kyang shes par bya/ /chu so mtshan nad bshang gci sri/ /skrag cing phyogs lta las shes bya/ /de nas ma ma nad gzhi dang / /skyon ni ji bzhin gso bar bya/ /de la nu zho rlung can la/ /rtsa ba bcu ⑨bskol zhag gsum blud/ /yang na ru rta ⑩tsi tra ka /pa ta shu dag pu tse shel| /ga bra'i rtsa ba la la phud/ /thang shing dang ni sa ra la/ /bri— ka ni pi pi ling / /na le sham ni bskol ba blud/ /de nas rlung nad 'joms pa yi/ /sman mar gang yang rung ba blud/ /de rjes chang gi dwangs ma blud/ /snum 'gyur bkru sman 'jam po gtang ⑪/ /de 'og 'jam rtsi'i las bya zhing / /dugs sogs rlung nad 'joms pa ⑫bya/ /bil ba ra sna ti mu sa/ /thang shing sa ra la bcas phye/ /mar dang sbyar ba'i lde gu 'am/ /de bskol kha ra dkar btab sbyin/ /mkhris pas gnod la sle tros dang / /nye shing nim pa pa to la/ /tsan+dan sha ri ba bskol ba/ /ma ma dang ni byis par ⑫blud/ /yang na gla sgang 111—633

'bras bu gsum/ /rtsa mkhris pu tse shel blud bya/ /thal tres la sogs shug pa sogs—/ /pa to la sogs sde bskol blud/ /sman ni 'di bskol mar dang ni/ /mkhris pa sel ba'i bkru sman dang / /bsil sman gyis bsku byug sogs bya/ /bad kan can gyi bdag nyid la/ /shing mngar rgyam tsha bcas pa 'am/ /rgyam tsha shing mngar pi pi ling / /mar sbyar byes pa la blud bya/ /de nas po son cha'i me tog /btags pa sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi/ /lde gus nu ma byes pa'i mchu—/ /bskus pa byen pa der ①slon gzhug /ma ma rnon pos slon du gzhug /de nas thug sogs rim pas snespyad/ /gla sgang la sogs bskol ba blud/ /de bzhin go snyod rgya spos dang / /thang shing dug mo nyung bskol blud/ /yang na gla sgang bong nga dkar/ /shu dag tsha ba lnga bskol blud/ /nu zho nyes gsum dri ma canaske/ /dri mnam 'khru zhing chu dang 'dra/ / mkhregs shing sla la blurgyun bar chad—/ /lbu ba can du 'khru bar 'gyur/ /bshang ba kha dog sna tshogs 'byung / /na zhing gcin ser dkar zhing skabu/ /rims nad skom dad yi ga 'chus/ /sgregs rjopa skam po 'byung zhing glal/ /lus na yan lag rkyong ༷ba dang / /mkhun zhing 'dar la mgo 'khor dang / /sna ⑦mig kha ni shu ba sogs/ /nad ni gzhan dag de las 'byung / /'o ma'i be+e snabs zhes bshad de/ /gnod pa'i nad ni mi bzad yin/ /de la ma ma byis pa la/ /slon sman btang bas myur du gsoske/ /thug sogs rim par bshad pa ni/ /shu dag la sogs sde tshan rnams⑧//skyer pa stsogs pa'ang bong nga dkar/ /ba ta dang ni pi pi ling / /gla sgang pu tse shel bskol blud/ /pa tha bca' sga pu tse shel/ /sle tres rtsa mkhris sha ⑨ri ba//thang shing gla sgang mur ba dang / /dug mo nyung ⑩bcas bskol ba blud/ /nu 111—634

zho'i nyes pa sel ba'i mchog /rjes 'brel nad la ji bzhin du/ /dus shes pa yis gso bar bya/ /so 'byung ba dag nad rnams ni/ /thams cad kyi yang rgyu yin no/ /mchog tu rims dang 'khru ba dang / /lud pa slon dang mgo nad dang / /bad mig 'dzag pa'i nad dang ni/ /shu ba rnams ni skyed par byed/ / byi la'i ①sgal tshigs bye ba ②dang / /rma bya'i gtsug ni 'byung ①ba dang / /byis pa'i so ni skye ba na/ /mi na ba ni cung zad med/ /de la nad ni ji bzhin dang / /nad stobs ji bzhin 'jigs ji bzhin/ /yul dang dus stsogs rnam phye ste/ /sman gyi sbyor bas gso bar bya/ /gnod dang gnod bya de nyid dang / /rims sogs nad kyang de nyid 'byung / /de bas sman ni de nyid de/ /gzhon sha can dang lus chung phyir/ /zas kun sten ④par mi byed pas/ /'di yi ⑤tshad ni chung ngu sbyin/ /mar dang 'o ma la brten rjopas/ /byis pa rtag par khong snum yin/ /de bas 'phral du skyug sman ni/ /'jam po blo dang ldan pas ⑦blud| /'o ma 'o ma zas bsten la/ /nu zho ngoms par byas pas skeslon/ /zas za ba la mar bcas pa'i/ /thug pa sla bar ⑨blud par bya/ /bkru sman gyis gso mas gtong dang / /tshad chung tshad phran dag gis bya/ /bkru sman la sogs ji skad bshad/ /ma ma nyid la gtang bar bya/ /mur ba rgya shug tsha ba gsum| /'bras bu gsum dang 'dzam bu'i shun/ /thang shing pa ta nyungs kar bcas/ /sbrang rtsir ⑩bcas pa'i lde gu sbyin/ /nu zho'i nyes pa sel mchog yin—/ /pi pi ling ngam skyu ru ra/ /da ta ⑪ka yi me tog gi/ /phye ma sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi/ /lde gus rnyil ni byug par bya/ /'ur bya sreg pa'i sha skam gyi/ /bye ma sbrang rtsis sbrus pa yis⑫/ /byes pa'i so yi myu gu ni/ /myur du skyed par 111—635

byed pa ①yin/ /shu dag bri ②ha ti gnyis dang / /pa ta gla sgang pu tse shel/ /bong nga mngar ba'i sman sde dag /bskol ba'i mar kyis so skyed grub①/ /skyer pa thang shing sa ra la/ /bri ༷ha ti gnyis nye ⑤shing ba/ / kṛṇ+ḍa paṇi rjoshri ya se—/ /sbrang rtsi mar sbyar lde gu ni/ /pho ba'i me drod skyed pa'i mchog /rlung ni bde bar rgyu bar byed/ /'khru ba'i rims dang dbugs mi bde/ /mig ser skya rbab lud pa 'joms/ /byis pa'i nad ni thams cad la/ /phan zhing mdog dang nyams stobs skyed/ /btsod dang seng phrom da ta ⑦ki /ku tan na ta ba la gnyis/ /sa ha ⑧che chung gnyis dang ni/ /muṅga be+el ba gzhon nu gnyis⑨/ /ras bal sa bon bcas pa dag /chu bskol ba dang mar dang ni/ /thal sman zho ga chur bskol bas/ /so skyes las byung sna tshogs nad/ /'di yis myur du 'joms byed de/ /'od srungs rgad pos bshad pa yin/ /byes pa'i so skyes nad la ni/ /sngags kyis mngon par gdab ⑩mi bya/ /so skyes pa yi nad gang yin//gso bas rang nyid nyer zhir 'gyur/ /nyin par gnyid drags ⑪chu grang dang / /nu zho bad kan can bsten pas/ /byis pa'i dngas ma rgyu ⑫ba yi/ /rtsa rgyun bad kan gyis bkag pa'i/ /yi ga 'chus dang cham pa dang / /rims dang lud pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas byis pa lus skams shing / /mdog ⑫snum mig ni dkar bar 'gyur/ /rgyam tsha tsha gsum sha rang ④ga /ba ta ko ri ka tam pa/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar skams dang / /yi ga 'chus pa sogs la gtang / /pu tse shel dang a sho ka /tsha ba lnga bcas phye ma phan/ /da ta ⑫ki dang skyu ru ra/ /rgya shug phye ma mar bcas phan/ /sā ⑩la paṇi shu dag dang / /bri ⑩ha ti gnyis ram nye ba/ /pi pi ling dang rgya spos dang / /lcang ma ut+pal ba spru ba/ /ga 111—636

bra'i rtsa ba gla sgang rnams/ /srang re yi ni tshad byas nas①/ /mar ni bre gang bcas bskol ba/ /rtsa rgyun sbyong ba'i dam pa yin/ /a shwa garnya bye'u rug pa/ /bri ②ha ti dang pi pi ling / /bskol ba'ang yon tan de dang 'dra/ /shing mngar seng phrom pi pi ling / /shug pa tsan+dan ut+pa la/ /bal bu'i lo ma sha ri ba//bskol ba'i mar gyis skems pa yi/ /nad ni 'joms par byed pa yin/ /shring gi ma du lung ga dang / /ga bra'i rtsa ba pi pi ling / /thang shing a shwa garnya dang / /ram nye ba gnyis ra sna dang / /zangs rtsi ba dang dzi ba ka /ma sha muṅga paṇi dang / /byi dang ga ④ni lde gur bcas④/ /ri bong mgo bskol khu ba dang / /bskol ba'i mar ni blud gyur na/ /lus skems rgyas par byed pa'i mchog /shu dag sle tres ka ya spru/ /spang sgos tsa rong ra ⑤thug gcin/ /chang bskol til mar bskus pa phan/ /rgya skyegs khu ba cha mnyam dang / /til mar bre gang zho ga dhichu/ /bzhi 'gyur a shwa garnya dang / /skyer pa thang shing ru rta dang / /ha re lce ⑦ka ba li ka /tsan+dan mur ba pu tse shel/ /ra sna nye ⑧shing shing mngar mnyam| /bskol ba'i til mar rgya skyegs sogs/ /zhes bya bskus na phan par 'gyur/ /stobs skyed rims dang zad byed dang / /smyo byed brjed ⑨byed dbugs mi bde/ /rlung gi nad rnams sel bar byed/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po 'joms/ /sbrum ma la yang bsngags pa yin/ /bong nga kar ⑩ka ta sring gi/ /pi pi ling dang sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /lde gu byis pa la sbyin ⑪pa/ /bong nga dkar po gcig po yis⑫/ /lde gus lud pa rims slon bro/ / bla brnan ⑫gyi ni nad sel byed/ /nu zho 'thung ⑫zhing slon pa la/ /de la zhun mar sbrang rtsi dang / /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑫ri bri ha ti⑫/ /'bras bu'i khu ba tsha ba lnga/ /sbyar ba'i lde 111—637

gu sbyin par bya/ /pi pi ling dang lan tshwa lnga/ /ba ri ba ra bye dang ga① /de bzhin lde gur ②sbyar ba sbyin/ /de bzhin tsha ba gsum reg 'jam/ /sha ri da ta ④rma bya sram/ /ji snyed pags pa spu bsregs la/ /snag ④tsha sbrang rtsi mar sbyar phan/ /seng ldeng bal bu ardzu na/ /ru rta pan ta na yi khu⑤/ /'o ma mar dang bcas bskol bas/ /slon bro nye bar sel bar byed/ /gang gi so rjodang bcas skyes dang / /gang gi dang por ⑦ya so skyes/ /bkra mi shis pa de la ni/ /zhi ba bya zhing bram ze la/ /yon dang bcas par ⑧sbyin par bya/ /de bzhin skem byed stimachod par bya/ /bad kan 'khrugs pas rkan gyi shar/ /rkan gyi 'dzer pa zhes bya ste/ / des na ⑩rkan gyi phyogs kyi ni/ /spyi ⑩bo dma' ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rkan lhung nu zho 'gras ⑫pa dang / / ska ba ⑫'thung zhing bshang ba sla/ /skom dang kha g.ya' mig na zhing / /gnya' ba 'degs dka' slon par 'gyur/ /de la rkan 'degs ④nas tshig 'khus⑫/ /thal ba sbrang rtsir ⑩sbyar ba bsku/ /yang na bca' sga pi pi ling / /ba lang gcin ⑩khu rgyam tsha bsku⑫/ /dong gra skyer pa shing tsha yi/ /lde gu n+ya go ⑪dha'i lo mar/ /gtums la ba lang lci bas byug /de rjes me mar myur du bsreg /khu bas rkan dang kha bsku zhing / /mig tu yang ni blugs ⑫par bya/ /ru rta shu dag a ru ra / /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu ni/ /nu zhor bcas pa byis pa ⑩blud/ /rkan gyi 'jer pa las thar 'gyur/ /dri mas gos sam rngul ba las/ /gzhang khar bad kan khrag las 'byung / /rma ni nang dmar ⑫g.ya' ba dang / / bla brnan ⑫mang po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /la las ma mo'i nyes par chabashad/ /gzhan dag lus srul pos byas zer/ /rgyab kyi thor bu gzhang sdebs ⑫zer/ /111—638

la las de ①ming med ces bshad/ /de la ma ma bad mkhris dag /sel ba'i sman gyis nu zho sbyar/ /tsan+dan dkar ②chu bsil ba dang / /ldan pa'i skom ni nang nas blud/ /de dang skyer pa'i khaṇ+ḍa ni/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i ④rma bsku bya//rgya shug 'bras bu gsum blag sha'i④/ /shun pa bskol ba'i chu blugs bya/ /nag tshur gi ⑤wang spangs ma dang / /dngul rdo ba bla rjoldong ros ni/ /skyur dang btags pas bsku bya zhing / /yang na shing mngar skyer khaṇa dang / /dung ni zhib tu btags pa 'am/ /dung gi lte ba sha ri ba'am/ /a sa na yi shun pa ni/ /bye ma btags pa gdab par bya/ /dmar zhing g.ya' ba'i shas che la/ /srin bu pad pas ⑦khrag dbyung bya/ /gzhang sdebs ⑧nad la mkhris pa yi/ /rma la phan pa thams cad bsngags/ /pa ta ⑨gla sgang ser po gnyis/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba byi dong ga /pur+ṇa ⑩rna ba bil bar bcas/ /bri— ⑪ka li tsha ba gsum/ /mar bcas bskol ba tshad tsam bldags/ /sa ⑫zos nad las thar bar 'gyur/ /nad ni gang gi sman gang yin/ /de yis nu ma bskus nas ni/ /yud tsam 'dug la de rjes bkru/ /blud na nad ni de des ⑫sel/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ gnas phyi ma'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas byes pa'i gdon gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /sngon gyi skem byed ⑫bsrung ba'i phyir/ /gdon ni skyes pa'i gzugs can lnga/ /bud med kyi ni gzugs can bdun/ /lha chen po yi sprul pa yin/ /skem byed sa ga lug thug gdong / /khyi gdong ⑫yi dwags zhes bya dang / /bya gdon srul mo grang ba yi/ /srul mo long ma lus srul po⑩/ /de bzhin bzhin gyi rgyan can ma/ /nam gru nam ⑩111—639

gru skem ma'o/ /de rnams kyis ni bzung ba'i tshul/ /rtag tu ngu dang rims kyis 'debs/ / spyi'i tshul skrag ①dang glal ba dang / /smin ma 'degs shing rmya ba dang / /sbra ba slon zhing gyen du blta/ /ma mchu sos 'debs gnyid yar dang / /ngu zhing mkhun la nu zho la/ /mi dga' skad ni 'gyur ba dang / /glo bur du ni sen mo yis/ /rang gi ma ma'i yan lag 'brad/ /de la skem byed kyis zin ②rtags/ /mig gcig mchi ma 'dzag ③pa dang / /yang dang yang du mgo bo rdegs④/ /phyogs gcig ⑤nyams shing lus rengs la/ /rngul bcas skye ba rengs pa dang / /so 'cha' dunu zho la mi dga'/ /sngangs shing ngu la skad gsang nyams/ /kha yo kha chu skyugs ⑦pa dang / /mi bzadasnyepar ni gyen du blta//tshil khrag dri bro yid mi dga'/ /bshang ba khu tshur la bcang zhing ⑨/ /mkhur tshos mig dang smin ma gcig /g.yo zhing mig ni gnyi ga dmar/ /des ni yan lag nyes nyams pa'am/ /'chi ba kho nar byed par 'gyur/ /skem byed brjed ⑩byed mtshan ma ni/ /dran pa nyams shing yang dang yang / /skra 'bal rke ⑪ba 'gugs pa dang / /rnam par 'dud cing glal bzhin du/ /bshang dang gci ba ⑫'byin par byed/ /lbu bar skyug cing gyen du lta⑫/ /rkang lag smin mas gar yang byed/ /nu ma rang lce so yis 'debs/ /kun tu g.yo zhing gnyid yang rims/ /khrag ni rnag gi dri bro ba'o/ /lug thug gdon gyi ⑫rtags kyi nad//sbo zhing rkang pa lag pa dag /'dar zhing sbra ba skyugs ⑫pa dang / /skom dad che 'khru chang pa sdom⑫/ /skad gsang dma' zhing mdog mi sdug / mkhun cing ⑩slon par byed pa dang / /lud pa skyigs bus 'debs gnyid yar/ /so yis mchu gnon ⑫yan lag sdud/ /rengs shing lug thug dri bro la/ /gyen du lta zhing 111—640

dgod ①pa dang / /bar du 'gugs shing rims kyis 'debs/ /brgyal zhing mig gcig skrangs pa yan②/ /khyi yi gdong gi rtags khrugyur pa/ /'dar zhing ba spu ldang ba dang / /rngul zhing mig ni 'dzums ༷pa dang / /rgyab tu gug ⑤cing lce dang so/ /mchu dang rkan sgra 'byin zhing sgyugasarjo/ /bshang ba'i dri 'byung khyi skad 'byin/ /yi dwags kyi ni gdon gyi rtags/ /ba spu ldang zhing yang yang sngang ⑦/ /glo bur ngu zhing ⑧rims kyis 'debs/ /'khru zhing slon byed lud pa lu/ /glal skom mi ro'i dri dang ldan/ /lus ni bskyod ⑨cing g.yo ba dang / /skem zhing rengs la mdog mi sdug /khu tshur sdom ⑩shing mchi ma 'dzag /bya gdon lus lhod 'khru bar byed/ /lce rkan lkog mar rma 'byung zhing / /thor bur na zhing tsha la gnag /tshigs dag tu ni yang yang 'byung / /mtshan mo skye la nyin mo 'bri/ /kha 'am bshang sgo 'gags ⑪pa dang / /'jigs shing bya yi dri dang ldan/ /rims kyis 'debs par byed pa yin/ /srul mo'i slon zhing 'dar ba dang / /lus snyom ⑫mtshan mo gnyid yar dang / /skyigs bu lto sbos 'khru ba dang / /skom zhing gcin ni sri ba dang / /lus lhod ba spu gshor ba dang / /kha ltar dri ni mnam pa yin/ /grang ba'i srul mo 'dar ba dang / /ngu zhing zur gyis blta ba dang / /skom zhing 'khru la rgyu ma 'khrog⑫ /zhag ltar dri ni mnam pa dang / /yan lag logs ⑫gcig grang ba dang / /cig shos dro ba nyid yin no/ /srul mo long ma'i slon pa ⑫dang / /rims dang lud pa gnyid chung dang / /bshang ⑫ba sla zhing mdog mi sdug /dri nga bskus pas myur du skam⑩/ /mthong ba nyams shing mig na g.ya'/ /mig skrangs spyoglo bar gyur pa dang / /skyigs bu mi dgod nu zho 'gras⑫/ /mdog mi sdug cing 111—641

nga ro rtsub/ /mdog nyams nya yi dri dang ldan/ /yang na dri ni sgyur bcas yin//bzhin rgyan can gyis ①rkang pa dang / /lag pa gdong ②ni mdzes pa dang / /rtsa ni nag por snang ba yis/ /lto ba khyab cing rims kyis 'debs/ /yi ga 'chus shing yan lag na/ /ba gcin lta bu'i dri 'byung 'gyur/ /nam gru gnag cing sngo ba dang / /mig dang rna ba sna med cing ①/ /mig 'gul skyigs bu lud pa lu/ /kha ni yo zhing dmar ④ba dang / /lug thug drir ⑤ldan rims 'debs skemarjo—/ /bshang ba sngo zhing sla ba yin/ /nam gru skem mos ⑦lus kun ni/ /rims kyis 'debs par 'gyur ba dang / /skra 'byi zas la mi dga' dang / /skad gsang zhum zhing mdog mi sdug /bshang ba kha dog sna tshogs dang / /lto bar rtsa yi mdud pa chags/ /ngu zhing bya rgod dri ldan la/ /yun ring na bar byed pa yin/ /lto ba rmen bu zlum po 'byung / /bshang ba kha dog sna tshogs 'byung / /lce yi dbus di dma' ba dang / /rkan ni gnag 'gyur ⑧de spang bya/ /kha zas mang du zos kyang ni/ /byes pa gang zhig lus skem byed/ /skom pas nyen cing mig nyams pa/ /de ni nam gru skem mos gsod/ /'tshe ba la dga' mchod par 'dod/ /gdon rnams 'dzin pa'i rgyu yin no/ /de la 'tshe ba'i bdag nyid can/ /byen tshe sna nas 'dzag pa dang / /lce nyams mig ni gting du 'bros/ /'degs byed mig ni mchi ⑨mar bcas/ /nyam ()chung tshig ni dman pa dang / /dri nga ba ni ⑪'byung bar 'gyur/ /skem zhing rang gi bshang dang gci/ /lag pas nyed cing smod ⑫mi byed/ /lag pas bteg ⑫ste 'bad pa yis/ /bdag dang de bzhin gzhan la rdeg④ /mtshon dang shing stsogs kyis rdeg ⑫cing / /'bar ba'i me la 'jug par byed/ /chu nang 'byeng ⑩zhing khron 111—642

par thong / /gzhan yang de 'drar byed par 'gyur/ /skom dad che zhing tsha bas rnag /slon par byed par 'gyur ba dang / /bu ga kun nas khrag 'dzag cing / /'chi ltas byung ba de spang bya/ /dga' ba 'dod pas gzir gyur pa①/ /dben par bud med 'dod smra dga'/ /dri dang me tog phreng rgyan dga'/ /mgu zhing zhi ba gso ba dka'/ /lces ⑤ni kha la nyug pa dang / /mchu rkan gre ba skams pa dang / /dogs pas lta 1zhing ngu ba dang / /sems khong chud cing zhum pa dang //zas 'dod ltogs par gyur kyang ni/ /byin na za bar mi 'dod la/ /gtor ma 'dod pas zin pa ste/ /de ni gso sla yin par bshad/ /gsod ③ 'dod pa la grub pa yi/ /sngags bzlas sbyin sreg byas pas gzhom/ /cig shos la ni ci 'dod par/ /dga' dang gtor ma sogs sbyin pas/ /de nas gso ⑤rung gdon la ni/ /byis pa khang pa dbe+en par bzhag /zhag gsum chag chag phyag dar byas/ /rtag tu me ni gzhag pa yi/ /bu ti'i me tog bsil ma dang / /'dab ma sa bon nyungs kar gtor/ /gdon 'joms til mar sbar ba yi/ /mar mes gdon ni 'joms par byed/ /nad g.yog nyal po chang dang sha /yongs su spangs par gyur pa yi/ /mar ni rnying pas bskus nas ni/ /ba la nim pa star ka ri ༅/ /dong gra thang shing ka tang ga⑦ /'dzam bu dang ni ta ④ma la/ /ka tri na dang lcam pa dang / /a ba marga ma ta li/ / ma du shi kru ⑨zhes bya dang / /ka ka dza ka shwe ⑩ta che/ /bil rkang 'o ma can gyi shing / /ka dam pa bcas ka rañdza/ /chu ni dro 'jam dag gis bkru/ /stag dang gzig ⑪dang seng ge sbrul/ /dom gyi pags pa mar dang bcas/ /bdugs ⑫pas khrus byas 'og tu bdug⑫ /pu ti nyungs kar sha re ga /shu dag go bye la la ④phud//111—643

ru rta mar sbyar bdug ①pas ni/ /gdon kun las ni thar byed yin/ /yungs kar nim pa'i lo ma dang / /shu dag ka ra bī ②ra'i rtsa/ /dro ba mar sbyar bdug ①pas ni/ /gdon ni thams cad sel bar byed/ /ba lang rwa ④dang rus pa spu/ /pags pa byi la'i rtug pa dang / /nim pa'i lo ma pu ⑤tse shel/ /mar dang bri rjoha ti gnyis dang / /ras bal sa bon po son cha/ /nas dang ra spu thang shing dang / /nyungs kar rma bya'i sgo dang pog /skra dang phub ma pha bang ⑦dang / /rdza mar ra thug gcin dang ⑧sbangs/ /zhib btags pa yi bdugs stipas ni/ /'byung po'i gdon ni thams cad dang / /mi bzad rims nad 'joms par byed//byi tsher a mra'i tshi gu dang / /rgya sgos mngar sde na le sham/ /kṛṇ+ḍa ⑩paṇi gla sgang rnams / /lde gur ⑪byas pa mar dang ni/ /'o ma rtsa ba bcu bskol khur/ /bcas bskol de ni gdon 'joms mchog /ra sna e shu ma ti gnyis/ /ba la rtsa ba chen po lnga/ /gla sgang btags te mar dang bskol/ /tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka /thal tres pa tra byi dang ga⑫ /shing mngar shing kun pa ya mya/ /thang shing pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /dug mo nyung dang bcas pa yi/ /lde gu mar dang bskol bas ⑫ni/ /rtag tu byis pa la phan zhing / /nad dang gnod pa thams cad 'joms/ /me drod stobs dang kha dog skyed/ /sha ri ba dang mu ra dang / /brasti⑫shu dag shang khi ni/ /nyungs kar ⑫a shwa garnya dang / /bye'u rug pa ⑫bcas mar ⑩bskol/ /de ni btung dang bsku ba yis/ /gdon rnams thams cad 'joms par byed / /mar gad 'byung po'i rigs ⑫pa ru/ /'og nas bshad pa dag dang ni/ /de bzhin gtor ma sbyin sreg dang / /khrus ni sngags rgyud shes pas sbyar⑫/ /pu ti ka rañdza'i shun pa/ /bar pa ra yi rtsa ba dang / /ku ⑩ba kha bo bi sha la/ /111—644

ka tra ka dang bil ba dang / /ka pi ta bskol des mtshan mo/ /byis pa bkrus na shis pa yin/ /gdon dang bral yang bla brnan ①nad/ /rjes su 'brel pa thams cad la/ /byis pa'i nad gsor ②bshad pa yi/ /sman gyis ji bzhin gso bar bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi sdele'u ste gsum pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ byes pa gso ba'i yan lag rdzogs so// //de nas 'byung po'i gdon gyi nad dmigs shes pa bshad par bya'o/ /shes dang rnam shes tshig dang ni/ /spyod dang snying stobs rang bzhin dag /gang gi rang bzhin 'gyur bar ④snang / /de la 'byung po'i gdon yod bshad/ /'byung po'i gzugs dang rang bzhin dang / /smra dang 'gro sogs spyod pa dang / /gang zhig 'dre ⑤bar byed pa rnams/ /de la de ni zhugs par bshad/ /de ni lha dang lha min stsogs/ /dbye ba ༷rnam pa bco brgyad bshad/ /de 'dzin rgyu ni 'phral gtam ni/ /sngon chad shes rab 'chal ba yi⑦/ /blo yis nyes pa byas gyur nas/ /de yi ⑧chags pa stsogs bskyed nas/ /brtul zhugs spyod dang chos lugs nyams/ /mchod 'os rnams ni brnyas pa dang / /gzhung lugs nyams pa de dag ni/ /sdig dang bdag ni gsod byed ni/ /gdon ni glags skabs tshol byed pas/ /lha la sogs pa'ang rjes gnod byed/ /glags ni sdig la sogs pa dang / /mi dge'i las ni smin pa dang / /gcig pur stikhang stong gnas pa 'am/ /dur khrod sogs par mtshan mo gnas/ /gcer bur rgyu 111—645

ba'am bla ma smod/ /'khrig pa tshul min spyod pa dang / /gtsang sbra med par lha mchod dang / /mi gtsang gzhan dang 'dres pa dang / /sbyin sreg sngags gtor mchod sbyin rnams/ /phyin ci log tu byed pa dang / /mdor na nyin re sogs spyod par/ /spyod pa brten pa las 'das pa'o/ /lha yi gdon gyis ①yar ngo yi//tshes gcig bcu gsum dag la 'dzin/ /lha min gdon ni yar ngo yi/ /bcu gsum mar ngo bcu gnyis la/ /dri za'i gdon ni bcu bzhi dang / /bcu gnyis dag la'ang 'dzin par byed/ /klu gdon tshes lnga la 'dzin byed/ /gnod sbyin gdon ni yar ngo yi/ /tshes bdun bcu gcig dag la 'dzin/ /tshangs pa srin pos ②yar ngo yi/ /tshes brgyad bco lnga dag la 'dzin/ /srin po sha za sogs mar ngo'i/ /tshes gcig tshes dgu bcu gcig la/ /mtshun lha gnam stong tshes bcu dang / /brgyad dang dgu pa dag la 'dzin/ /rgan pa ①la sogs gzhan dag ni/ /phal cher dus de'i thun mtshams la'o⑦/ /lha yi gdon gyis dbang byas pa/ /gdong ni pad+ma kha bye 'dra/ /lta stangs zhi zhing khro ba med/ /tshig nyung dul ⑤dang bshang gci nyung / /kha zas la ni 'dod pa med/ /lha dang bram ze 'byung ba dka'arjo/ /gtsang zhing saṃ skṛ ⑦ta'i skad smra/ /yun ring nas ni mig 'dzums shing / /lus dri zhim zhing mchog ster byed/ /gos phreng dkar po chu bo dang / /ri mtho khang ⑧pa mtho la dga'/ /gnyid ⑨med tshugs pa med pa yin—/ /lha min ⑩gdon kyis zin pa ni/ /yon por blta zhing rang bzhin ngan/ /lha dang bla ma bram ze dang / /'jigs med khengs shing dpa' ba dang / /khro zhing rtsol ba che ba dang / /nga ni drag po khyab 'jug dang / / skem byed ⑪brgya byin yin zhes bshad/ /sha dang chang la dga' zhes bya/ /dri za'i gdon gyis 111—646

zin pa'i rtags/ /rang spyod la dga' lus dri zhim/ /snying dga' glu dang gar yang byed/ /khrus dang skyed mos tshal la dga'/ /gos phreng byug pa dmar la sred—/ /sgog dang rtsed mo la dga'o/ /klu yi gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags/ /mig dmar khro zhing mi 'gyur lta/ /yon por 'gro zhing blta ba dang / /nyin mtshan dbugs rgod lce las ni/ /kha chu 'dzag cing kha 'gram lhag① /bu ram 'o ma khrus la dga'/ /kha sbub tu ni nyal bar byed/ /gdugs mthong na ni 'jigs pa yin/ /gnod sbyin gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags/ /mig dmar bgrad sdecing skrag la 'gul/ /lus ni dri zhim gzi mdangs ldan①/ /gtam dang glu dang khrus dang ④ni/ /phreng ba byug pa la dga' zhing / /nya yi sha sred dga' ba dang / /dga' mgu stobs chen nad med la/ /lag rtse bskyod cing su zhig la/ /ci zhig sbyin zhes smra bar byed/ /gsang tshig smra zhing sman ⑤pa dang / /bram ze la ni brnyas par rjobyed/ /khro ba chung zhing mgyogs 'gro ba'o//tshangs pa srin pos zin pa'i rtags/ /dgod ⑦cing gar la dga' ba dang / /spyod pa gtum zhing glags skabs tshol/ /gshe zhing myur du 'gro ba dang / /sman pa bram ze lha la sdang / /rang la shing dang mtshon sogs brdeg /kye zhes bya ba'i sgra sgogs shing ⑧/ /bstan bcos rig byed 'dod ⑨pa yin/ /srin po'i gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags/ /khro gnyer bcas shing khro bar lta⑩/ /rtabs bag tu ni byed pa dang / /rdeg ⑪sbung rab tu rgyug pa dang / /ngu zhing gdong ni 'jigs rung ston/ /zas ma zos kyang ⑫stobs dang ldan/ /gnyid med mtshan mo rgyu ba dang / /ngo tsha gtsang sbra med cing dpa'/ /gdug cing tshig rtsub smra ba dang / /khro zhing phreng ba dmar po dang / /bud med sha chang 111—647

khrag la dga'/ /sha 'am khrag ni mthong ba na/ /mchu ni ldag ①par byed pa dang //zas za'i tshe na dgod ②pa yin/ /sha za'i gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags/ /sems ni bde bar mi gnas shing / /yongs su rgyug par byed pa dang / /mi gtsang la dga' glu gar dang / /dgod ①dang chang dang sha rlon dga'/ /spyos na gdong ni zhum pa dang / /rgyu med par ni ngu ba dang / /bdag nyid sen mos 'brud pa dang / /khong rtsub lus nyams skad gsang dma'/ /sdug bsngal ba ni brda sprod cing / /'brel dang mi 'brel tshig mang smra/ /dran pa nyams shing gnas stong dga'/ /mi brtan dugacer bu dri ma can/ /srang bar 'khyams ⑤shing gos gyon zhing / /rtswa yi phreng ba rgyun tu thogs/ /shing 'jeg rta la zhon par byed/ /de bzhin phyag dar phung por 'dzeg /mang du za bar byed pa yin/ /yi dwags gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags/ /spyod tshul dri ni yi dwags 'dra/ /sngar zhing zas la mi dga' dang / /rtsa gcod byed pa zhes kyang byaske/ /grul bum gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags/ /tshig mang smra zhing kha gdong gnag /dal gyis 'gro bar byed pa dang / /rlig pa skrang zhing rjo'aphyang ba yin—/ /mi ni ⑦byad stems zin pa'i rtags/ /shing rdo bong ba stsogs thogs shing / /tshal pa gyon te 'gro ba dang / /gcer bur rgyug cing 'jigs bag tu//lta la rtswa yis rgyan ⑧du byed/ /dur khrod gnas ni stong pa dang / /srang bar shing gcig brten ⑨pa dang / /til zas chang dang sha la ni/ /rtag tu mig ni tshags pa dang / /tshig rtsub de ni smra ba yin/ /g.yengs byed kyis ni zin pa'i rtags—/ /chu 'dod zas ni mi slong dang / /sngangs shing mig ni dmar ba dang //tshig rtsub smra bar shes par bya/ /ro langs gdon gyis zin pa'i rtags/ /dri 111—648

dang phreng ba la dga' zhing / /tshig bden smra la yongs su 'dar/ /gnyid che bar ni shes par bya/ /yi dwags mtshun ①lha'i gdon gyi rtags/ /mig mi gsal zhing bzhin ras zhum/ /rkan ni skam par byed pa dang / /mig dang rdzi ma bskyod pa dang / /gnyid che me drod chung ba dang / /g.yon phyogs nas ni gos gyon zhing / /sha dang bu ram til la dga'/ /tshig 'khrul pa ni yin zhes bya/ /bla ma drang srong rgan dang grub/ /dmod pa sems kyi ⑤rjes mthun pa/ /spyod lam kha zas rang bzhin las/ /ci 'dra gdon ni de yin bshad/ /gzhon ⑧nu'i tshogs kyi rjes 'brang zhing / /gcer bu skra ni gyen du badze+es/ /yid mi bde zhing dus tshigs ni/ /yun ring gyur pa'i gdon de spang / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste ④bzhi pa'o// //de nas gdon ⑤gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /'byung po'i rjo'atshe ba mi 'dod dang / /bzlas dang sbyin sreg gtor ma dang / /brtul zhugs tshul khrims mnyam 'jog dang / /sbyin shes brtse la sogs pas bsal/ /shing kun ba bla tsha ba gsum/ /gla rtsi sgog skya arka'i rtsa/ /spang spos a za lo mi dang / /la ⑦ba 'bam po ku ku ti/ /shu dag garnya bri yang ku/ /sar pa garnya til mar ⑧ni/ /ka ka an da ⑨ram nye ba/ /snu ha ka ka ta shring ⑩gi/ /sle tres ma hā na ba li/ /yungs kar dang ni lig bu mig /gdon 'joms sman ni gzhan dag dang / /bong bu rta dang khyi lug dang / /rnga mo go da dred dang ni/ /sre mo reg ⑪'jam byi la gung / /ba lang seng ge stag dang ni/ /rgya mtsho yi ni srog chags kyi/ /pags pa mkhris pa sen mo so/ /sde tshan 'di dang mar rnying ngam⑫/ /til mar 111—649

dang ni bskol ba dag /btung dang snar ni blugs ①pa dang / /bsku ba'i don du sbyar bya zhing / /'di dag phye mas bdug par bya/ /'di yi ri lu byas nas ni/ /mig sman sna sman bya ba dang / /'di yi lde gus byugs ②pa dang / /bskol ba'i khu ba blugs ①par bya/ /sbyor ba 'di yis smyo byed dang / /brjed ④byed bcas pa'i gdon zhi byed/ /nyungs kar ha ti pi pi ling pi pi ling rtsa che ba gsum/ /skyu ru ra dang go da dang / /sre mo bye la rtsa sha yi/ /mkhris pa dang btags sna sman dang / /bsku byug byugs ⑤sogs byas gdon 'joms/ /nyungs kar shu dag shing kun dang / /pri yang ku dang ser po gnyis/ /gi ri kaṇi dkar nag gnyis/ /'bras bu gsum dang shwe rjota dang / /nim pa'i lo ma ka radzi/ /shri sha gnyis dang sa bon dang / /thang shing dang ni tsha ba gsum/ /mar dang ba gcin de bzhi 'gyur/ /bskol ba don grub ces bya ste/ /btung dang snar blugs las sbyar na/ /gdon ni thams cad myur 'joms byed/ /mchog tu lha min gdon sel byed/ /brjed ⑦byed dug dang bkra mi shis/ /sbyo byed gshed khrubyed rims rnams 'joms/ /sman de nyid ni ra thug gi/ /gcin dang sbyar te blud pa dang / /snar blugs mig sman byugs ⑨pa dang / /khrus dang dril ba la sbyar ba/ /sngar bshad yon tan de 'dra zhing / /rgyal po'i sgor yang don grub ⑩byed/ /nyungs kar shu dag tsha ba gsum/ /a shwa garnya ser po gnyis/ /shing kun kun dong rtsa ba dang / /ka rañdza yi sa bon dang / /shri sha yi ⑩me tog dang / /ka bid tha ⑫yi 'bras bu dang / /rgyam tsha ru rta rgya spos dang / / gi ri kaṇi ⑫dkar po dang / /so na ka yi rtsa bar gnas④/ /ra gcin dag dang legs bsgos shing / /ba lang mkhris pa bu ram dang / /ri lu 111—650

byas pa'i sbyor ba de/ /mig bskus snar blugs ①bsku byas na/ /smyo byed rma ni red pa dang / /mtshan mo mi mthong mun 'thibs sdebyed/ /bgegs dang lus chur nub pas ①brgyal/ /dug bskus mda' yis phog pa dang / /gdug pa sbrul gyis zin pa sel/ /ras bal sa bon rma bya'i sgro/ /me tog sman ma bri ha ti//shing tsha spang spos po son cha/ /bye la'i rtug pa phub ma dang / /shu dag mi skra sbrul lpags dang / /glang po'i so dang glang gi rwa/ /shing kun dang ni na le sham/ /ma mnyam bdugs tshupar byas pa yis⑤/ /skem byed smyo byed sha za'i rigs/ /srin po lha yi gdon 'joms mchog /garnya bha dra rjotsha ba gsum/ /gur kum ⑦pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /kaṇ+ḍa ⑧ka ri skyer pa dang / /thang shing dang ni yungs kar gnyisaske/ /ba le ka dang dug mo nyung / /tsan+dan dkar po rgyam tsha dang / /'bras bu gsum dang pu shel tse/ /shu dag ⑨spangs ma pu tse shel/ /tsan+dan dkar po ba la dang / /shing mngar sug smel ldong ros dang / /shug pa rgya spos shri pa sa/ /ma du ka yi snying po dang / /bong ⑩nga gnyis po pri yang ku/ /dbyi mo ru rta skyer khaṇa dang ⑪/ /cha mnyam zhib ⑫btags sde gu dang / /mar rnying gcin kun cha mnyam bskol/ /gdon khus 'debs shes bya bar brjod/ /de blud gdon 'joms mchog yin no/ /rgya spos shing mngar ka rañdza/ /rgya skyegs da ta ⑫pa to la/ /shu dag shing kun pa ta ④la/ /nyungs kar kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang / /ser po gnyis dang pu tse shel/ /rgya shug garnya ⑫pri yang ku/ /tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum/ /thang shing sle tres byi dang ga⑩ /ko sha ta ki ka kan ta/ /shi kru ⑩nim pa dug mo nyung / /shri shi'i ⑫me tog sa bon dang / /gla sgang ru rta dan da dang / /gi ri kaṇi ⑪tsi tra ka /bil ba cha mnyam sde gur byas/ /111—651

mar rnying can gyi sde tshan bcas/ /bskol de yun ring bzhag pa de/ /khus 'debs chen po zhes bshad do/ /rim pa kun gyis ①sbyar na ni/ /gdon rnams kun dang sbyo byed dang / /mje dang rims ni myur du 'joms/ /gdon ni nyi ma gang gang la/ /'dzin pa'i nyi ma de dang der/ /mchog tu sbyin sreg gtor ma sogs/ /sman pas rab tu 'bad de bya/ /khrus dang gos dang sha dang tshil/ /chang dang mar dang bu ram stsogs/ /gang zhig gang la sred gyur pa//de tshe de ni de la sbyin/ /rin chen dri dang phreng ba dang / /sa bon mar dang sbrang rtsi dang / /zas kun kun la sbyin bya ste/ /'di ni spyi yi cho ga'o/ /lha dang bla ma drang srong rgan/ /grub pa lha yi gnas su sbyin/ /de yang lha yi gdon la ni//byang gi phyogs su gtor ma sbyin/ /lha min gdon la sbu 'dod par/ /mtshams kyi gnas su nub tu sbyin/ /dri za'i gdon la ba lang ngam/ /gos dang rgyan bcas gtor ma sbyin/ /mtshun lha klu ②gdon 'bab chu'i 'gramage/ /klu la shar lho mtshams su sbyin/ /gnod sbyin rang gi gnas sam ni/ /chu gnyis 'dus pa'i gnas su sbyin/ /srin por lam gyi ④bzhi mdo 'am/ /tshang tshing 'jigs su rung bar sbyin/ /srin po ⑤lho yi phyogs su sbyin/ /tshangs pa'i m+bin por rjoshar du sbyin/ /sha za la ni khang stong du/ /nub phyogs su ni gnas te sbyin / /phreng ba gtsang zhing dkar po dang / /dri dang 'o thug 'bras chan dang //zho dang gdugs ni dkar po dag⑦ /lha rnams kyi ni gtor mar 'dod/ /shing kun nyungs kar shu dag dang / /tsha ba gsum ni srang phyed phyed⑧/ /mar bre gang dang ba yi gcin/ /bzhi 'gyur dang ni lhan cig bskol/ /de btung snar blugs bskus ⑨pa yis/ /lha yi gdon las thar bar byed/ /shu dag shing kun 111—652

sgog skya rnams/ /ra gcin sbyar ba snar blugs ①dang / /mig bskus lha yi gdon las thar/ /lha min gtor ma 'bras bu ni/ /mang po dag dang pu shel tse| /klu yi gdon la dzā ti dang / /'bras yos bu ram snum khur dang / /'bras chan bu ram bcas pa dang / /zas mchog 'o ma sbrang rtsi dang / /sa nag nā ga ge sar dang / /shu dag pad+ma pu shel tse/ /ut+pal pad+ma dmar po yi/ /'dab mar bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin/ /seng phrom lo ma dkar po dang / /rgya spos nā ga ge sar dang / /nyungs kar chu grang la btags pas②/ /snar blugs mig tu bskus pa'ang phan/ /gnod sbyin gdon la 'o ma zho/ /mar dang 'bras chan bsres pa dang / /gu gul pad+ma thang shing dang / /pu shel tse dang gos dang gser/ /dbyeg ni gtor mar sbyin par bya/ /mar dang 'o ma ba gcin ni/ /cha mnyam bskol ba ①btung ba dang / /snar blugs lus la bskus na phan/ /a ru ra dang ser po gnyis/ /sgog skya shu dag na le sham/ /nom pa'i lo ma ra gcin btags/ /lde gus sna sman mig sman bya/ /tshangs pa srin po'i gtor ma ni/ /nas bye bzhi ni btsos pa yis④/ /chu bye bcu drug til btags bsres/ /gdugs dang gos dang byug pa sbyin/ /seng sdeng srang ni nyi shu dang / /tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum/ /shing kun shu dag shu ti dang / /nyungs kar nim pa'i lo mar bcas/ /sgog skya srang ni phyed phyed dang / /zhun mar phul ni bdun dag dang / /ba gcin sum 'gyur ⑤bskol ba de/ /btung dang snar blugs bskus na phan/ /srin po'i gdon la til phye dang / /me tog dkar po 'bras chan bsresarjo/ /sha btsos rjen pa nim pa la⑦/ /khrag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin/ /nag ta ma la shri sha yi⑧/ /shun wags me tog 111—653

'bras bu dang / /de bzhin pa ta la nag po/ /bil ba'i rtsa ba tsha ba gsum/ /shing kun nyungs kar dug mo nyung / /sgog skya skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu/ /ra gcin dang ni sbyar ba'i sman/ /snar blugs ①mig tu byugs ②na'ang phan/ /'di dag nyid dang mar gyis ⑦ni/ /bzhi 'gyur ba gcin bskol ba ni/ /btung dang snar blugs bskus pa yis/ /srin po'i gdon ni zlog par byed/ /sha za la ni bu ram chang / /til tshig ④til gyi phye ma zho/ /la phug lan tshwa phye zan mar/ /'byung po ⑤'bras chan gtor ma sbyin/ /ser po rnam gnyis rgyam tsha btsod/ /shu ti dong gra pri yang ku/ /shing kun sgog skya tsha ba gsum/ /'bras bu gsum dang pa ta li/ /shu dag gi ri kaṇi dkar/ /shi duri sha yi me tog dmar⑦/ /ba gcin bzhi cha bcas par bskol/ /btung dang bsku ba byas na phan/ /yang na de nyid ra ⑧gcin btags/ /mig bskus snar ni blugs pa ⑨phan/ /lha dang drang srong mtshun ⑩lha dang / /dri za'i gdon la sna sman stsogs/ /rnon po btang bar mi bya zhing / /'di la zhun mar btung la sogs/ /sman ni 'jam po spyad par bya/ /sha za ma gtogs thams cad la/ /mi ⑪mthun sbyin par mi bya ste/ /mthu stobs che ba de khros nas/ /nad pa sman pa bcas gsod byed/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /mgon po phyag ni bcu gnyis pa/ /nad kun gso bar mdzad pa yi/ /sngags bzlas na ⑫ni nad kun sel/ /de bzhin smyo byed brjed byed dang / /gzhan yang sems 'khrul byed pa 'joms /rig sngags rgyal mo rma bya che/ /gtsang byas de la rtag tu bsgrags⑫/ /'byung po'i ⑫bdag po lha chen dang / /de yi 'khor gyi tshogs mchod cing / /de yi sngags grub bzlas na yang / /gdon ni thams cad sel bar byed/ /gang yang 'og 111—654

nas bshad pa yi/ /le'u gnyis las smos pa dang / /gang 'dir ①bshad pa de dag kun/ /phan tshun sbyor ba byas na phan / /②yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste ①lnga pa'o// //de nas smyo byed gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /smyo byed nad gzhi re re dang / /'dus stsogs dug las gyur pa drug /smyo byed ces bya lus dang ni/ /sems kyi nad lam ④log pa ru/ /zhugs pas smyos ⑤par gyur pa yin/ /bza' btung gnod pa dag dang ni/ /snying dang ma goms dri mar bcas /mang nyung ma snyoms bsten pa dang / /yid zhum snying stobs chung ba dang / /nad kyi shugs kyis rjodakrugs pa dang / /rid cing spyod pa ma snyoms dang / /mchod 'os mchod par mi byed dang / /sems las kyis ni sems nyams dang / /dug dang nye ba'i dug las gyur/ /'di yis snying stobs zhan pa yi/ /snying gi nad la gnod byas te/ /blo ni dri ma can byas te/ /yid rgyu ba yi lam bkag nas/ /smyo byed dag ⑦ni skyed par byed/ /de yis ⑧blo dang rnam shes dang / /dran pa 'khrul zhing lus kyi ni/ /bde dang sdug bsngal las nyams te/ /shing rta kha lo sgyur ⑨ba ni/ /med pa lta bur rtsom pa ni/ /kun kyang bsam pa med par spyod| /de la rlung gyur lus sbeg cing / /rgyu med ngu zhing tshig rtsub smra/ /dgod ⑩dang 'dzum dang gar byed dang / /gru len rol mo byed pa dang / /lus bskyod pheg ni rdob pa dang / /gling bu pi wang la sogs kyi/ /sgra yi lad mo yang yang zlos/ /rgyun du kha nas sbra ba 'dzag /phan tshun rgyug cing mang du smra/ /rgyan min pas ni rgyan du byed/ /bzhon pa min pas 'gro ba rtsom/ /111—655

kha zas la ni gdu bar byed/ /de rnyed ①na ni mi 'dod byed/ /mig rlum mig ni dmar ba dang / /kha zas zhu nas nad ldang 'gyur/ /mkhris las spyo zhing khro ba dang / /khu tshur bong ba rdeg cing rgyug /grib ma chu ni grang mo 'dod/ /gcer bur 'dug cing lus mdog ser/ /med par me ni 'bar ba dang / /skar ma mar me mthong ba'o/ /bad kan slon zhing yi ga 'chus/ /kha zas rtsol dang smra ba nyung / /bud med 'dod cing dben la dga'/ /kha chu snabs ni 'dzag pa dang / /'jigs rung gtsang sbra la mi dga'/ /gnyid che gdong ni skrangs pa ②dang / /nub mo shas cher smyo ba dang / /zos ma thag tu ldang ba yinarka/ /'dus pa'i rgyu dang mtshan ma ni/ /kun ldan de yi bdag nyid can/ /smyo byed mi bzad khrupar shes bya/ /de ni sman pas yongs su spang / /nor dang chung ma la sogs bral/ / brnag dka' ④ba las sems gdung bas⑤/ /stso zhing zhum la yang yang brgyal/ /kyi hud kyi hud smre sngags 'don/ /glo bur du ni ngu zhing brgyal/ /de yi yon tan mang du sems/ /mya ngan gyis gdungs sems khong chud/ /gnyid yar rnam par 'khyams pa yin/ /dug gis gdong ni sngo ba dang / /gzi nyams dbang po stobs chung ba/ /shugs kyi bar du'ang 'khrul bar byed/ /mig dmar de ni spang bar bya/ /de nas rlung gyur rjosgo byed la—/ /dang po snum gyi btung ba blud/ /lam 'gags gyur ⑦la dang por ni/ /snum bcas sbyang ba 'jam po bya/ /bad kan mkhris gyur dang po ni/ /snum dang dugs bya skyug sman dang / /bkru sman mas gtong byas pa dang / /mgo bo'i bkru sman dag kyang bya/ /de ltar lus ni dag byas na⑧/ /yid ni dran pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /de lta ⑨na yang rjes 'brangs ⑩na/ /sna sman mig sman rnon po 111—656

— ——— — — ——— —gtang / /sems dga' 1 dbugs 'byung skrag pa dang / /'jigs dang rdeg dang sdigs mo byed 2/ /lus dris byugs dang bsku ba dang / /dud rngub sman mar blud pa dag /sbyar te de ni dga' 'gyur na/ /yid ni tha mal pa la sbyar / /shing kun dang ni rtsab ru tsha/ /tsha ba gsum ni srang gnyis gnyis/ /mar bre bzhi ni ba gcin bcas/ /bskol bas smyo byed 'byung po dang / /brjed byed gdon ni sel mchog yin/ / brasnyi'i 7 bskol khu bye do dang / /mar bre gang dang tsha ba gsum/ /sh+ya ma dur byid bim pa dang / /shang ka put+pa dong ga dang / /sap+ta la dang byi dang ga 9 /zho ni gnyis gnyis lde gu bskol/ /bras+ho'i sa sman mar zhes bshad de/ /mar ni srang res bskyed de btang / /che tshad srang bzhi'i mar zos na/ /smyo byed brjed 1 byed mdze yi nad/ /sel zhing mo gsham bu skyed byed/ /skad snyan tshig gsal dran pa dang / /yid gzhungs dpal ma ni skyed par byed/ /'bras bu gsum dang byi dang ga7 /pa tra e la thang shing dang / /e la ba lu ka dang ni/ /thal tres rnam gnyis ser po gnyis/ /smri ra rnam gnyis pri yang ku/ /rgya spos ru rta bri ha ti/ /nā ga ge sar dong ga btsod/ /se'u 'bru bal bu'i lo ma dang / /dzā ti kha 'bus byi dang gsha /dan da shu dag ut+pa la/ /tsan+dan dkar po zho gnyis nin //zhun mar bre gang bcas bskol ba/ /dge ba'i sman mar zhes bshad 'dis/ /'byung po'i gdon dang smyo byed dang / /brjed 7byed lud pa sdig can 'joms/ /skya rbab g.yan pa skem dang dug /rmongs bag gcin snyi dbyig dug rims/ /khu ba med pa'am bu med pa'am/ /dran pa gdon gyis brlams pa dang / /yid gzhungs med cing tshig 'khrul dang / /dran nyams me drod chung la phan/ //77 657

stobs skyed bkra shis tshe ring zhing / /mdangs skye skal ldan lus rgyas che①/ /bu skyed byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /'di la thal tres rnam gnyis sogs/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig chu dang khrubaskol/ /de yi khu ba mar dang ba/ /lan cig skyes 'o ④bzhi 'gyur dang / /me da rnam gnyis ram nye ba/ / bung tshang ④rdo dang kha sral phre'u⑤—/ /bu ram shing dang paṇi gnyis/ /bskol ba yi ni sman mar 'di/ /dge ba chen po zhes bya ste/ /brtas byed 'dus pa'i nad 'joms shing / /snga ma bas kyang yon tan lhag /spang spos bu ta ke shi dang / /chu rtsa shu dag kha sral pre'u/ /kyi lce ba dang ram nye ba/ /tsa rong dza ya pu tse shel/ /sle tres tsa tra pa ra ha/ /a ti tsa ta sa ta la/ /ma hā dupu ru sha dan dang / /na gu li gnyis skyu ru ra/ /bri— ka la ka dam pa/ /sā ⑦la paṇi bcas bskol mar/ /sha za chen po'i mar zhes bya/ /des ni nyin bzhi pa'i rims dang / /sbyo byed brjed ⑧byed gdon 'joms shing / /blo dang yid gzhungs dran pa skyed/ /byes pa rnams kyi lus 'phel byed/ /bdud rtsi dang ni 'dra ba yin/ /bra⑨snyi in+d+ra byi dang ka⑩ /shing kun spang sgos mur ba dang / /ra sna sgog skya bong ⑪nga dkar/ /shu dag bye'u rug bi sha la/ /nā ga dan ti byi tsher ba/ /dzo ti sma ⑫ti tsha ba gsum / /a ru ra dang sa nag rnams/ /glang po'i gcin btags ri lur byas—/ /grib bskams snar blugs mig bsku zhing / /lus bskus spos bdugs sbyo byed sel/ /nyungs kar dang ni sbyar ba yi⑫/ /sna sman rnam pa sna tshogs phan/ /nyungs mar gyis ni lus bsku dang / /nyungs kar phye ma snar bud ④bya/ /mdo gnas bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /dung rnon shing kun bcas pa phan/ /wa dang reg ⑫'jam 'ug pa dang / /byi ba ra thug dza ⑩ti ka'i/ /gcin dang rtug pa 111—658

sru dang ni/ /pags pa mkhris pa sen mo dang / /spos bdugs ①mig sman lus bsku dang / / byugs dang blugs pa bshad ②par bya/ /bad kan rlung gyur la phal ①cher/ /khyi dang ba lang nya sha ni/ /rul ba'i bdug ④pas bdug par bya//mkhris gyur la ni tig ta'i mar/ /'tsho byed snum ni gnyis kyi mar/ /bza' dang btung ba bsil ba dang / /mngar ba dang ni yang ba bsngags/ /ji skad bshad pa'i gtar ga ⑤gdab/ /yang na sha tshon gyis 'grangs rjobya/ /de 'og rlung med gnas bsnyal nas/ /sems myos pa las thar bar 'gyur/ /khron ⑦pa'i chu ni nyung bar gzhug /ltogs pa nyid du byas te bskams/ /de la chos dang nor ldan pa'i/ /gtam snyan mdza' bos sems dga' bya/ /yang na sdug sgedang bral ba 'am/ /rmad du byung ba ⑨bstan pa 'am/ /bcings la yungs mar gyis bskus te/ / nyi tshan ⑩la ni gan rkyal gzhag /kha sral phre'u'am lcags tsha 'am/ /til mar chu tshan gyis reg bya/ /yang na lcag gis gzhus ⑪nas ni/ /bcings te g.yang sar skyur bar bya/ /yang na rdo dang mtshon med pa'i/ /mun khang mi ni med par gzhug /mche ba ston pa'i sbrul dang di/ /glang dang seng ge glang po ches/ /de ni skrag tu gzhug pa 'am/ /yang na rgyal po'i skyes bu yis/ /dam du bcings te phyir phyung ⑩nas/ /rgyal po'i bka' yis bsdigs pa dang / /'di bsad bya zhes skrag tu gzhug /lus kyi sdug bsngal 'jigs pa ⑫bas/ /srog gi ⑫'jigs par ⑫rab 'jigs pas/ /de phyir kun tu 'khrul pa'i yid/ /nye bar zhi ba nyid du 'gyur/ /grub pa'i sbyor ba 'di dag ni/ /nad dmigs dus sogs ltos te bya/ /sdug dang nor dang bral ba las/ /gang gi yid la gnod gyur pa⑫/ /de la de 'dra rnyed gyur pa'i⑩/ /spyo bsring ⑫dbugs 111—659

dbyung ba yis gso/ /'dod dang mya ngan 'jigs pa dang / /khro dang 'jigs ①pa chang las gyur/ /gnyis dag gis ni gcig la gcig /de dag nyid ②kyis zhi bar bya/ /bshad pa'i mtshan ma las lhag pa/ /gdon dang rjes 'brel yin zhes bya/ /gal te sbyo byed gdon las gyur/ /gdon gsor bshad pa'i sman sbyar bya/ /til btags phye ma nas dang zan/ /snum zhing mngar ba'i kha zas dang / /'bras ni khrag tu sbrus pa dang / /sha ni btses ①pa rjen pa dang / /'bru chang sbyar chang mnan pa'i chang / /a ti musti'i ④me tog dang / /dzā ti sa ha ra dza yi/ /me tog bcas pa'i gtor ma ni/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo ba lang lhas/ /chu bo 'dus pa dag tu sbyin/ /gang zhig sha dang chang spangs shing / /phan la brtson zhing gtsang sbra che/ /snying stobs can la lhan cig skyes/ /glo bur smyo byed 'byung mi 'gyur/ /dbang po'i don ni gsal ba dang / /de bzhin blo dang yid gsal ba/ /lus zungs tha mal par gnas pa/ /smyo byed dang bral mtshan ma yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste ⑤drug pa'o// //de nas brjed rjobyed gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /brjed ⑦byed dran pa nyams pa ste/ /de ni snying stobs blo 'khrul dang / /sems las mya ngan 'jigs sogs kyis⑧/ /gnod gyur ⑨sems las byung ba yin/ /lus sems gtogs ⑩pa'i nad kyis ni/ /smyo byed bzhin du 'khrug 'gyur bas⑩/ /snying stobs nyams zhing snying dang ni/ /'du shes rgyu ba'i rtsa sbubs khyab/ /mun par zhugs snyam sems shing ⑫rmongs/ /'jigs su rung ba'i bya ba byed/ /so 111—660

—byedabyed—byedabyed——— — — — —— — ————— — ——————'cha' lbu ba skyug pa dang / /lag pa rkang pa g.yob pa dang / /gzugs med par yang mthong ba dang / /'khrul 1zhing sa la 'gyel ba dang / /smin ma mi /na/g.yo nad shugs dang / /bral nas sad par gyur pa dang / /de ni dus gzhan dag tu yang / /de bzhin du ni spyod pa yin/ /rlung la sogs dang 'dus pa yi/ /dbye bas brjed byed rnam pa bzhi/ /de ni skye bar gyur pa'i 4tshul/ /snying 'dar khong stong mgo 'khor la/ /mun par mthong zhing sems khong chud/ /smin ma mi sdug mig 5'gyur dang / /sgra mi thos shing rngul 'byung la/ /kha chu snabs ni 'dzag pa dang / /mi 'ju yi ga 'chus shing brgyal/ /lto sbos nyams stobs zad pa dang / /gnyid med skom zhing yan lag na/ /rmi lam glu len gar byed dang / /til mar chang ni 'thung ba ( dang / /de nyid (pegacin du 'byung ba rmi/ /de la rlung gyur gebarla 'gul zhing / /yang dang yang du 'gyel ba dang / /yang dang yang du dran pa stor/ /'du shes rnyed nas mi gsal du/ /mig 'bur yang yang dbugs 'byin zhing / /lbu bar sgyug cing 'dar ba dang / /so 'cha' mgo ni rdebs pa dang / /rlung gis begre ba rgyas par byed/ /yan lag kun du rdebs pa dang / /sor mo mi stoms 'gugs 1 kepa dang / /mig dang pags pa sen mo ni/ /gnag cing rtsub mor snang ba dang / /gzugs ni mi brtan rtsub pa dang / /mi sdug bzhin ras ngan pa yin/ /mkhris pa las gyur brjed spyotebyed ni/ /dran pa yang yang nyams pa dang / /mig mdog 1spepags pa lbu ba ser/ /sa la rdeg 7par byed pa dang / /'jigs rung 'bar zhing khro ba yi/ /gzugs mthong skom dad che ba yin/ /bad kan las gyur ring nas 'dzin/ /yung ring nyid nas sad par byed/ /g.yo 'gul nyung zhing 111— 661

kha chu mang / /kha mig pags pa sen mo dkar/ /gzugs rnams dkar por ①mthong ba yin/ /mtshan nyid kun dang ldan pa spang ①/ /de nas blo sems dran pa dang / /snying ga'i sbubs ni sad byed pa'i/ /slon sman la sogs las rnams ni/ /rnon po yis sdeni sbyang bar bya/ /rlung gyur ④'jam rtsi mang du bya/ /mkhris gyur phal cher bkru sman gtang / /bad kan phal cher skyug sman ni/ /btang bas brjed ⑤byed gso bar bya/ /rnam pa rjokun tu legs dag cing / /legs par spro ni bsring ba ⑦la/ /brjed ⑧byed las ni thar bya'i phyir/ /zhi bar bya ba'i sbyor bar ⑨nyon/ /ba byu ⑩khu ba 'o ma dang / /zho dang gcin dang mar bskol ba/ /brjed ⑪byed rims dang sbyo byed dang / /mig ser sel bar byed pa blud/ /rtsa ba bcu pa ⑪'bras bu gsum/ /dug mo nyung shun ser po gnyis—/ /a pa marga lo ma bdun/ /ni li ni dang pu tse shel/ /dong ga puṣ+kar spru ⑫la dang / /phal gu'i ④rtsa ba byi tsher srang / /gnyis gnyis chu bre bcu drug nang / /bskol ba la ni bzhi cha lus/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba du ba ri/ /pa ta dan da dur byid dang / /tsha ba gsum dang ro hi ṣespyo/ /mur ba rtsa mkhris bu di kha/ /ha ti pi pi ling dang ni/ /ma du yan te thal tres gnyis/ /lcang ma dang ni tsi tra ka /zho ni gnyis gnyis mar bre gang / /de bzhin snga ma'i gsher rdzas bskol/ /'di ni ba yi rnam lnga che/ /brjed ⑩byed rims dang dmu rdzing dang / /mtshan par ⑩rdol ba sel mchog yin/ /'or nad gzhang 'brum mig ser dang / /skya rbab skran dang lud pa dang / /gdon rnams 'joms par byed pa yin/ / bras+ho tho)shu dag ru rta dang / /shang ka puju mar rnying bcas—/ /bskol ba'i mar ni yid gzhungs ⑩byed/ /smyo byed bkra mi shis pa 111—662

dang / /brjed ①byed sdig pa 'joms par byed/ /'tsho byed sde tshan srang re dang / /til mar zhun mar bye re bsres/ /'o ma bre ni bcu drug bskol/ /'thungs na brjed ②byed las thar byed/ /'o ma bu ram shing khu ba⑦/ /bre bzhi dang ni tang pal gyi/ /khu ba brgyad 'gyur dag dang ni/ /'tsho byed sde tshan zho gnyis gnyis/ /zhun mar bre gang ④bcas bskol blud/ /des ni rlung mkhris las gyur pa'i/ /brjed ⑤byed myur du sel bar byed/ /de bzhin 'jag ma'i dhibi da ri/ /ku sha bu ram shing 'o ma/ /bskol ba 'thungs pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /ku sman ta ⑦yi khu ba mar/ /bco brgyad 'gyur dang shing mngar gyi/ /lde gur ⑧bcas pa bskol bas ni/ /brjed ⑨byed sel bar byed pa dang / /blo dang tshig gsal skad snyan ⑩byed/ /ba ni ser skya'i mkhris pa yi/ /sna sman btang yang mchog tu phan/ /khyi dang wa dang byi la dang / /seng ge sogs kyi mkhris pa bsngags| /go da ⑪sre mo glang po che/ /ba lang dred dang pri sha ta'i/ /mkhris pa til mar bskol ba dag /lus bsku snar ni blugs ⑫na'ang phan/ /'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ /nas tshig 'khus thal ko nyon tshe/ /pha ni ⑫dza ka sra rtsi pog /a pa marga ka rañdza'i/ /sa bon til mar ra gcin dang / /bcas pa bskol ba snar blugs ⑫pa'am/ /phye ma sna nas bus pa'ang phan/ /sre mo ske'ug pa spre'u dang / /bya rgod khyi rta bya rog sbrul/ /chu ⑩dang sgro dang rtug pa yi—/ /dud pas 'di la bdug ⑩par bya/ /til mar sgog skya bcas pa 'am /'o ma nye'u shing bsten yang ⑫phan/ / bras+ho'am ⑪ru rta'i khu ba 'am/ /shu dag sbrang rtsir ldan pa'ang phan/ /nad gzhi mnyam du 'khrugs pa las/ /lus dang sems la brten 'gyur nad/ /skyes par gyur pa gang yin de/ /111—663

brjed ①byed gnad ni chen por gnas/ /de bas gso dka' 'di la ni/ /bcud kyis len gyis ④gso bar bya/ /des nyen me dang chu la sogs/ /ya nga ba las rtag tu bsrung ①/ /thar pa na ni yid 'khrul bas/ /khyed kyis 'di ltar byas so zhes/ /mi brjod yul ni yid 'ong bas/ /nyams ④pa'i sems ni brta bar ⑤bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste rjobadun pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ 'byung po'i dze+egadon gso ba'i yan lag rdzogs so// //de nas mig mchu'i nad dmigs shes par bya ba bshad par bya'o/ /nad kun nad gzhi ⑧las bshad pa'i/ /gnod pas ⑨nad ni 'khrugs pa dang / /mchog tu mig la gnod pa dang / /phal mer mkhris pa skyed ⑩pa yis rtsa las gyen du rgyus spyonas ni/ /mig gi yan lag mig mchu grwa⑫/ /dkar nag mthong byed rgyal mo 'am/ /mig kun la gnas nad skyed byed/ /de la rlung ni mig mchu yi/ /rtsa la zhugs par gyur pa dag /nyal nas ldang tshe mig mchu ni//har bag na ⑫dang bcas par byed/ /mig ni rdul gyis gang snyam sems/ /'dzums ④par dka' zhing mchi ma 'dzag /mnyes na bde ba snyam du ⑫byed/ /de ni 'dzums ⑩dka' yin zhes bshad/ /rlung gis mig mchu bskyod nas ni/ /yang dang yang du 'byed cing 'dzums/ / 'di ni 'dzums ⑩pa zhes bshad do//gra mtshams lhod cing tshor ba med/ /rtag tu 'dzums shing mig nyams pa/ /gang yin de ni rlung gnod yin/ /mkhris pas mig mchu'i mtha' mar ni/ /111—664

'brum bu ku mu ta ①yi ni/ /sa bon 'dra slar gang gyur pa/ /'brum phran ku mu ta ④zhes bya/ /tsha zhing 'drul la nad dang bcas/ /dmar zhing reg na mi bzod pa/ /mkhris pas stimig mchur skyes pa de/ /mkhris pas rjoskyes pa yin zhes bshad/ /mkhris pa ⑤rdzi ma'i nang gnas shing / /g.ya' zhing tsha bar byed pa dang / /de rjes rdzi ma 'byi ba sterjo/ /rdzi ma 'byi ba zhes bshad do/ /bad kan las gyur mig mchu'i nad/ /'brum phran dkar po yungs kar 'dra/ /mthug skrangs g.ya' na mig rdul khebs/ /spyi ⑦bag can 'dzag po dag kyang / /har bag 'drul ba ⑧rdu mas khebs/ /bad kan gyis bslangs ⑨mig mchu'i nad//bad kan las gyur rmen bu dkar/ /na zhing smin ma med g.ya' sra/ /rgya shug tsam mam de las ni/ /cung zad chung ba chags pa yin/ /khrag las 'brum phran dmar ba dang / /de mtshungs 'brum phran gyis khyab pa/ /brtsegs pa zhes bya des skyed dmar/ /reg mi bzod pa mig mchu slongs/ /mig mchu'i nang du sha lhag ni/ /sra zhing snum la tsha zhing na/ /mdog dmar ⑩de ni khrag 'dzag cing / /bcad bzhin ⑪'phel byed mig 'brum yin/ /mig mchu'i mtha' 'am ⑩dbus su ni/ /g.ya' zhing tsha la na bcas brtan/ /muṅga tsam gyi khrag 'brum dmar—/ /'brum phran mig nad ces bya'o/ /nad kyis mig ⑫mchu'i phyi rol skrangs / /nang du bu ga phra mos khyab/ /'dzag bcas nang na ④chu yod de/ /pad+ma'i rtsa 'dra pad rtsa yin/ /nad gzhi gsum dang khrag 'khrugs pas/ /mig mchu'i nad ni ldang ba dang / /rgyu med par ni gnyid 'gyur gang ske/ /de ni mig mchu 'khrugs zhes bya/ /nad kyis ⑩mig mchu dri ma khrag /skrangs rnags na ⑩bcas mig mchu sngo/ /g.ya' zhing skrangs la dmar ba dang / /mig mchu 111—665

'byar ba 'byar zhes bya/ /mig mchu'i nad ni sra zhing rtsub/ /'brum phran bye ma 'dra zhes bya/ /gnag cing 'dam 'dra 'dam bu'o/ /mdog 'dra sha ni mang pos rgyas/ /na shas che ba zhes bya'o/ /byis pa so skyes tshe na 'byung / /des ni byis pa'i mig skrang ①zhing / /mig dmar lta bar mi nus la/ /mig mchu gzer zhing spyi ②bag 'dzag /rna ba sna dang mig nyed byed/ /gang yin de di sgra ngan yin/ /rdzi 'gags rdzi ma 'dus shing zhum/ /mig mchu'ang de 'drar gyur pa dang ①/ /rtsub cing nang du kha bltas la/ /spu gzhan yang ni tsher ma ltar—/ /rtse mo rnon po skyes gyur cing ④/ /des bdar mig ni skrangs pa dang / /tsha zhing rlung la sogs mi bzod/ /bton na cung zad bde bar byed/ /mig phugs grwa ⑤mtshams phyi rol du/ /thor bu sra rjozhing mtho ba dang / /dmar zhing mchi ma rnag khrag 'dzag /yang yang rgyas pa slon ⑦pa yin/ /nad gzhi gsum dang khrag las ni/ /mig mchu'i nang na sha'i dum bu/ /rmen bu sra la nad med la⑧/ /phyi rol mi mnyam g.yo mdzer ⑨pa/ /de ltar nyi shu rtsa bzhi po//mig mchu la gnas nad yin no/ /de la dang por sman gyis gso/ /de 'og gnyis dang 'brum bu spang / /rdzi ma 'gags pa gsor rung tsam/ /lhag ma mtshon gyis gso bar bya/ /de dag las kyang rdzi ma 'bye/ /gtsags ⑩par bya la mig mdzer gcad/ /chags dang pad rtsa ku mu ta⑪/ /brtsegs dang 'brum phran slon ⑫pa 'dral/ /mig mchu'i sha sngo bye ma 'dra/ /'byar dang bskyed bya zhes pa ()bzhi/ /'dam chas thosteshas cher byas pa dang / /sgra ⑫ngan bcas pa mtshon gyis bzhar / /⑫yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las—/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u brgyad pa'o// //111—666

de nas mig mchu'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ / 'dzums pa dka' la ①mar rnying ni/ /rgun 'bru'i lde gu chur ②bskol bar/ /kha ra btab dang sna sman dang / /dud pa mig sman snum can gtang / /ku mu ta ①la zhal zhal btab④| /de steng rgyam tsha gdab par bya/ /shing mngar dang ni skyu ru ra/ /pa to la bskol chu blugs bya/ /rlung med gnas la g.yog ⑤mkhas kyis/ /sbyang byas gan rkyal nyal ba la/ /mig mchu bzlog ste dro 'jam chur/ /bsros pa'i gos kyis dugs dubyas la/ /gos kyis legs par dkris nas ni/ /g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub ⑦kyis bzung zhing / /'gul zhing 'gyur ba med par ni/ /de nas mig mchu kun tu ni/ /dkyil 'khor lta bu'i mtshon gyis ni/ /'phred du gdab cing mtshan ma byas/ /de nyid kyis sam lo rtsub bam/ /she ⑧pa li yi lo ma 'am/ /yang na rgya ⑨mtsho'i khru bas brud⑩/ /khrag ni ras bal ye'us phyi/ /khrag bcas ⑩legs par brud ⑫shes nas/ /rang rang sman ni sbrang rtsi dang / /bcas pa de la bsku bar bya/ /de 'og chu dron gyis bkrus la/ /mar gyis blugs ⑫par bya ba dang / /rna ba'i steng dang 'og gi bar/ /nas kyi zan dang sbrang rtsi dang / /mar dang bcas pas dkri ⑫bar bya/ /zhag ni gnyis pa la dgrol ⑫te/ /ji lta bar ni sman blugs shing / /bzhi par sna sman la sogs bya/ /zhag ni lnga pa dag la dgrol/ /mnyam zhing sen mo ltar dmar la/ /skrangs g.ya' drud sogs nad med pa/ /mig mchu sbyar ⑩legs yin zhes bya/ /de las bzlog pa slar bzhar bya/ /bzhar drags pas ⑩ni na ba dang / /rdzi ma 'bye zhing mig mchu 'gyur/ /de la snum dang dugs la sogs/ /rlung la phan 111—667

pa'i sbyor ba bsngags①/ /mar sar gyis ni bsku bya zhing / /seng phrom dkar po mar sar gyis/ /legs par bsku ba byas nas ni/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi rtsa ba yi sde gus byugs ②te phur mas ①btso/ /tshos pa bkrus te bskams nas ni/ /btags pa thum po byas nas ni/ /ra 'am bud med 'o mar ni/ /mnyes pa mig tu blugs rjopar bya/ /de nyid sā ⑤lu thug po che'i/ /lde gu bskus te de ltar byas/ /zho dang zho ga chus rjosbangs pa/ /mig ni bzhar drags gyur la blugs⑦ske/ /yang na zho ga ⑧chu nyi tshe/ /blugs shing skam sa'i sha khu sbyin/ /'brum phran sra zhing mtho ba ni/ /'bras kyi rtse mos brtol bar bya/ /de rjes babyur te cho ga ni/ /lhag ma snga ma bzhin du bya/ /zhal zhal gdab dang 'dral ⑨ba la/ /rim 'dis ⑩mig mchu'i nad kun sbyar/ /khrag mkhris las gyur mngar ba yi/ /sde tshan dang bskol mar gyis ⑪gso/ /snum gyur nas ni gtar ga gdab/ /dur byid bkru sman btang ba mchog /bzhar zhing khrag ni phyung nas kyang / /shing mngar bskol ba'i chus bkru zhing / /tsan+dan dkar po 'o mar ⑩bskol/ /mig mchu la ni blugs pa phan/ /rdzi ma 'byi la khab kyis ni/ /ba spu'i bu ga gtsags ⑫pa 'am/ /srin bu pad pas ④khrag dbyung ngo / /yang na 'o ma'am bu ram shing / /khu bas slon bya mngar bsil sman/ /bskol ba'i mar ni gtang bar bya/ /nag tshur dkar po'i phye ma ni/ /bye'u rug pa'i khu bar bsres/ /zangs kyi snod du bcug pa ste/ /rdzi ma 'bye ba'i mig sman mchog /mig mchu'i sha brud spyobaca' sga dang / /rgyam tsha'i phye ma gdab par bya chu dron gyis bkrus seng ldeng dang / /na le sham dkar tu pa ri/ /chu bskol ba 'am ser po gnyis/ /shing mngar dang ni 'bras bu gsum/ /khu ba sbrang rtsir 111—668

bcas pa blugs①/ /bad kan las gyur zhal zhal byas②/ /nag tshur rgyam tsha pi pi ling / /ldong ros stang zil zhib btags la/ /sbrang rtsir ①bcas pa bsku bar bya/ /skyug sman mig sman sna sman ni/ /bad kan sel ba thams cad phan—/ /chags pa la yang 'di dag bya/ /ma zhi me btsa' gdab par bya /sgra ngan la ni seng ldeng dang / /nim pa'i lo ma 'bras bu gsum/ /mar dang sbyar ba'am pi pi ling / /shing mngar rgyam tsha bskol ba ni/ /ma mas ④blud de slon du gzhug /rgun 'brum dang ni a ru ra/ /pi pi ling bskol bkru sman sbyin / /ser po rnam gnyis pi pi ling / /gla ⑤sgang lde gus nu ma bsku/ /nyungs kar mar bcas dud pas bdug /sbyang ba rjobyas nas pa to la/ /gla sgang dang ni rgun 'brum dang / /sle tres 'bras bu gsum bskol blud/ /byis pa'i mig mchu brud ⑦pa'am/ /srin bu pad pas ⑧khrag dbyung bya/ /a sman ta ka skyu ru ra/ / 'dzam bu'i ⑨lo ma bskol ba blugs⑩/ /byes pa 'o ma mar bsten pas/ /phal cher bad kan nad 'byung ⑪bas/ /de bas dang por ⑫skyug sman nyid/ /nad kun la ni ⑫bsngags pa yin/ /lce myang tsha dang pi pi ling /a pa marga'i 'bras bu mar/ /'o ma shu dag sbrang rtsir bcas/ /po son cha ni shing mngar bcas/ /'o ma kha zas 'o ma dang / /zas la brten pa'i byis pa la/ /rim bzhin blud pas nad kun ni/ /sbyang bar ⑫bya phyir slon sman gtang / /mchog tu sgra ngan nad la phan/ /sabe+e la yi khu ba mar/ /bskol ba gnyis ka sbyong byed sbyin/ /seng phrom shing mngar ser po gnyis/ /nim pa'i lo ma pu tse shel/ /zangs kyi phye mar ⑫bcas reng bu/ /sgra ngan gyi ni nad la phan/ /yang na lcags kyi phye ma bsregs⑩/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi mar bcas phan/ /sug smel sgog 111—669

skya ka ta ka /pha ni dza ①ka na le sham/ /dung bcas chu dang bdar ba dang / / kad pha la bcas ri lu'ang dze+ephan/ /rdzi ma'i 'gags nad 'phel ①ba la/ /sbyang ba byas par gyur pa ni④/ /smin ma'i 'og gi cha gnyis dang / /⑤rdzi ma'i cha gcig bar bar ni/ /nas kyi tshad tsam nas kyi dbyibs/ /'phred du dbral rjol ras rlon pas/ /de yi khrag ni bsal nas ni/ /khrag ni chung bar ⑦gyur pa dang / /bar mtshams muṅga tsam bzhag la/ /khab ni yon pos btsem ⑧par bya/ /dpral ba ⑨ras kyis bcings nas ni/ /de bzhin skud pas btsem ⑩par bya/ /shin tu dam dang lhod min par/ /der ⑩ni legs par btsem ⑫par bya/ /de nas sbrang rtsi'i ⑫mar gyis byug /'di la bcing bar mi bya'o/ /na na n+ya gro dha sogs pa'i/ /khu ba 'o mar bcas pa blugs④/ /zhag lnga pa la skud pa ni/ /bsal te yug snam spyophye ma ni/ /rma la legs par gdab par bya/ /sna sman mig sman rnon po gtang / /zhag bcu'i mthar yang ma sos na/ /mig mtshur brten gnyer bzlog ste bsreg /rdzi ma'i lhag ma tsher zungs kyis⑩/ /phyung la de yi gnas dag ni/ /me yi mdog 'dra'i khab rtses bsreg /phyi rol zlon pa bsregs ⑩pa dang / /thor bu bcad par gyur pa la/ /me 'am thal sman rnon pos bsreg /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u dgu pa'o// //de nas mig zur dang mig gi 'bras bu dkar nag gi nad kyi dmigs brtag pa bshad par bya'o/ /rlung 'khrugs pas ni chu rgyu ba'i/ /rtsar song nas ni chu 'dra ba'i/ /mchi ma mig mchu mig phugs kyi/ /mtshams nas ⑫mchi ma 111—670

byedabyedabyed— —'dzag par 'gyur/ /des ni nad med rtsa dmar la/ /skrangs 'gyur de ni chu 'dzag yin/ /bad kan las gyur spyi 1bag mang / /dkar ba bad kan 'dzag pa yin/ /bad kan gyis skrangs rtse mo rno/ /lan tshwa'i chu bur 'dra ba 'byung / /rtsa ba che zhing g.yo la snum/ /mdog 'dra snye'ajam zhing spyi ( bag can/ /che zhing smin dka' g.ya' dang bcas/ /gzer med bcings pa 4lta bu yin/ /khrag las ⑤mchi ma khrag 'dzag dmar/ /shas cher dro ba khrag 'dzag yin/ /mig mchu gra mtshams dkar po ru/ /'brum phran tsha ( )zhing gzer dang bcas/ /dmar zhing muṅga la'adra la gas/ /khrag 'dzag de ni tshigs can yin/ /rnag 'dzag dri ma khrag dang bcas/ /mig phugs lakyi ni gra mtshams nas⑨/ /yang dang yang du rnag 'dzag cing / /sha lpags 'drul bas mchi mar bcas/ /rnag sla 'dzag pa rma phra zhing / /skrangs shing g.yo ba 4rteche ba dang / /mig phugs mtshams skrangs rnag 'dzag cing / /nad bcas rnag gi chu ser 'dzag /mig phugs kyi ni mtshams nang na/ /skrangs zug tsha bcas chu ser nad⑪/ /mig zur ram ni mig phugs su/ /g.ya' zhing rdzi ma'i bu ga nas/ /rnag 'dzag srin dang rmen bu 'byung / /na bcas srin kyi rmen bu can/ /bcings pa lta bu'i 1srin rmen bu/ /rnag gi chu ser tshigs can dag /mtshon gyis gso bya lhag ma lnga/ /'dzag pa chu ser bcas pa spangs( / /mkhris pas /—stedakar po'i thig le ni/ /nag skepa'am sngo ba'am ser po skyed/ /gur gum me long dri mas gos/ ltar snang na dang tsha ba med/ /'khru zhing skom dad rims dang bcas/ /nad gzhi nya phyis can zhes bya⑪/ /bad kan las dkar sha lhag dkar—/ /ring nas 'phel ba mig mdzer ⑪dkar/ /nad med pa la skrangs pa 111 ——671

dang / /mdog dkar lhun chen ①'jam pa dang / /phyi snum chu yi thigs ②pa 'dra| /bad kan mdud pa zhes byar bshad/ /thig le 'bras phye ltar dkar ba—/ /mtho ba 'bras phye 'dra zhes bshad/ /dkar po'i ri mo dmar pos khyab| /tsha zhing na dang bcas pa dang / / skrangs shing ①mchi mas gos pa med//khrag gyur rtsa yi nges par bshad/ /rtsa'i nyes yal bar bor na ④ni/ /dmar ris de nyid 'phel bar 'gyur/ /khrag bcas rtsa ni brtse ⑤bar byed/ /de yis mig gis blta mi nus/ /rtsa yi dra bas g.yogs shing stug /mtho ba rtsa yi dra ba yin/ /khrag gis rjomig mjer 'jam zhing mnyam/ /pad+ma 'dra ba sha lhag yin/ /nad med ri bong ⑦khrag ltar dmar/ /thig le ling thog ⑧dmar po yin/ /'jam shing nad med myur du 'phel/ /dkar por ⑨khyab byed dmar nag ni/ /khyab pa'i mjer pa zhes bya'o/ /dri ma khrag bcas rtsa'i mdzer pa/ /rtsa rgyus dang 'dra rtsa mjer yin/ /khrag skam gong bu ⑩ltar gnag cing / /sha ni che zhing rgyas pa gang / /de ni sha lhag mdzer pa yin/ /tsha zhing reg na rtsub pa dang / /rtsas g.yogs mig 'bras nag ⑪dang nye/ /'brum phran nyungs kar lta bus rtsa/ /nya phyis rtsa brtse ⑫rtsa'i nyes pa/ /'bras phye 'dus ⑫pa'i ling tog dmar/ /drug po sman gyis gso bar bya/ /lhag ma bdun po mtshon gyis gso/ /de yang sar pa sman gyis gso/ /mjer pa bshad pa lnga po gang / /rgyus pa dang ni rtsas ⑫g.yogs pa/ /nag por phyin zhing pags gas 'dra—/ /mthon po gcad par bya ba yin/ /mthong byed steng du phyin pa spang / /nag po'am mthong byed la mkhris pas/ /pags pa brtol te ling tog ni/ /zug dmar mchi mar bcas pa skyed/ /de yis mig 'bras dkyil 'khor rnag /111—672

'dzam bu smin pa 'drar snang zhing / /dma' ba rma yi ling tog ste/ /de ni gso dka' rim gnyis dag /brtol ba gso ba tsam yin no/ /der ni zug pa la sogs mang / /nag po khab kyis phug snyam byed/ /rim pa gsum ni brtol ba dang / /rma yis khyab pashegasor mi rung / /bad kan las gyur dung ltar dkar/ /shas cher mi ②na gso sla dkar/ /dmar zhing mchi ma spyi snebag 'dzag /'brum phran dmar zhing shin tu na/ /ra yi ril ma 'dra zhing 'bur/ /khrag skyes ra ril 'dra ba spang / /nad khrag bcas pas rtsa'i ling tog /de yis mig 'bras nag po khebs/ /na zhing tsha la dmar ba yi/ /rtsa yis kun tu rgyas gyur ④la/ /rgyu med mchi ma grang dro dang / / ska sla ⑤'dzag pa de spang bya/ /nad gzhi khrag las mthong bcas rnag /'bras bu dkar por rjosgyur byed de/ /sprin dkar gyis ni g.yogs 'dra zhing / / nim pa ⑦ba ni bkas pa 'dra/ /shin tu mi bzad na zhing dmar/ /tsha zhing skrangs pas gzir ba dag /smin pas nyen pa'i ling tog ste/ /mi bzad na ba spang bar bya/ /gang gis mtshan ma nyams pa 'am/ /nang sngo ba 'am dmar bcas pas/ /shin tu 'bur ba'am gting ring ba'am/ /mchi mar bcas shing rtsa'i ⑧rmas khyab/ /rnying pa'am mtho dma' ⑨can dag gam//dbus chad ⑩ling tog spang bar bya/ /nag po'i nad ni gsor rung ⑪dang / /mi rung dbye ⑫ba rnam lnga yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u bcu pa'o// //de nas mig zur dang mig gi ⑫'bras bu dkar po dang nag po'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /mig nad bcings pa sman pa yis/ /dugs byas rtse mo 111—673

'bras 'dras dbug /rtse mo dkyil 'khor 'dra bas bzhar/ /de 'og rgyam tsha pi pi ling / /sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku bar bya/ /de nas snga ma bzhin du bcings / /pa to la'i lo skyu ru ra/ /bskol ba'i sman khu thigs pas blugs 5//tshigs can lcags kyu'i cha sbyad kyis/ /phyi yi mtshams kyi tsha gsum gzung / /'phel gtsags kyis ni phyed gcad bya/ /gzhan du mchi ma rgyu la gnod/ /sbrang rtsi rgyam tshas bskus nas ni/ /mig mdzer lta bur gso bar bya/ /chu ser rnag 'dzag gtar ga gdab/ /de nas de ni bcing bar bya/ / mig rnags 5 cho gar bshad pa yi/ /las kun cho ga ji bzhin bya/ /rgyam tsha sge'u gsher nag tshur dang / /lcags dang zangs ni zhib btags pa'i/ /phye ma'i mig sman btang ba 'am/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i khu ba blugs/ /srin gyi rmen bu lci ba yis—/ /dugs byas brtol te phyi bar bya/ /nag tshur rgyam tsha 'bras bu gsum/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bsku bar bya/ /nya phyis mkhris mchi 'dzag ltar gso/ /bad kan 'dud /8pa 'bras phye gnyis/ /gtar ga ma gtogs bad kan gyi/ /mchi ma 'dzag pa bzhin du gso/ /tsha ba gsum dang kad pha rte la/ /ba lung khu ba'i mig sman gtang / /rgyam tsha dzā ti kha 'bus pa/ /thang shing bca' sga btags pa'i phye/ /chang gi dwangs mas ri lur byas/ /mig sman skrangs dang g.ya' ba selaske/ /rtsa nyes rtsa brtse ling tog dmar/ /rtsa dra khrag 'dzag lta bur gso/ /rtsa yi nyes la khyad par du/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi'i mig sman bsku/ /rtsa brtse ba la sbrang rtsi dang / /skyer pa'i 11khaṇ+ḍa zhib btags mubasku/ /ling tog dmar po zho ga ⑫chu/ /sbrang rtsi kha ra'i thigs pa blugs/ /shel dang gur gum shing mngar dung / /sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i mig sman gtang / /yang na sbrang rtsi dung sbyar ba'am//111 674

kha ra rgya mtsho'i sbra ba phan/ /mdzer par ①bshad pa rnam lnga las/ /dud pa lta bu'i rnyog can dang / /gang yang dmar zhing zho 'dra ba/ /de sman ling tog bzhin du bya/ /cig shos gan rkyal ②bzhag dugs byas/ /kha lung dang ni rgyam tsha dag /sbyar ba'i mig sman bskus nas ni/ /mig btsums nas ni mnye bar bya/ /de ltar mig ni 'khrugs bcas pasne/ /sha lhag skyes pa bskyod nas ni//mgo bo mi 'gyur dam du gzung / /mig mchu mchog tu mi 'gul bya/ /mig zur du ni blta bzhin du/ / mig phug ④mtshams nas mdzer pa mtho/ /gang du gnyer ma 'dus gyur pa/ /der ni lcags kyus dam bzung ba'am/ /ha cang mi che mu tsi tra'am/ /khab bam skud pas blangs nas ni/ /kun nas dkyil 'khor 'dra bas 'dral⑤/ /de nas bton te dral nas kyang / /mig phug mtshams su bsnyen nas ni/ /cha bzhi lus par gcad bya ste/ /mig phug rjortsa dang mchi ma ni/ /'dzag pa'i rtsa la mi gnod bsrung / /mig phug zur bcad mchi ma 'dzag /mig gi rtsa sbubs rma can 'gyur/ /mig 'gram mjer pa cher skyes la/ /mig phug zur du bltas te bya/ /legs par bcad de tsha ba gsum| /rgyam tsha sbrang rtsir bcas pa bsku/ /zhun mar dron mo blugs ⑦pa dang / /sbrang rtsi mar sbyar bskus te bcings⑧/ /de nas zhag gsum la sogs nas / /bkrol nas ka rañdza'i sa bon/ /'o ma bskol ba de bzhin blugs⑨/ /ser po rnam gnyis pa to la/ /shing mngar dang ni rgya skyegs shing / /ka rañdza ⑩yi me tog ni/ /kha 'bus sbrang rtsir bcas bskol blugs⑪/ /zhag bdun nas ni de dgrol bya/ /legs par bcad na nad med 'gyur/ /bcad drags ma chod las nad 'gyur/ /sman khu blugs dang mig sman sogs/ /phyi ba dang ni brta 111—675

bas gso/ /kha ra ldong ros e li ya/ /rgyam tsha bca' sga zho re dang / /skyer pa'i ①khaṇ+ḍa srang phyed dang / /sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i mig sman gyis/ /bad kan las gyur rab rib dang / /chu ser gyis gang ling tog dang / /mig mjer bcas pa'i sha lhag ②sel/ /'bras bu gsum ni gang rung ba'i/ /shun pa chur dze+ebatags lde gur byas④/ /kham phor sbyar ba'i nang du bsregasaspyo/ /de nas tshig nas phye mar btags/ /sman ni lhag ma'i khu ba yis/ /so sor rjolegs par bsgos ④nas ni/ / snag tsha de ⑧bskams slar yang btags/ /rgyam tsha nyis 'gyur bcas pa yi⑨/ /mig sman gsum po de dag ni/ /phyi ba'i mchog tu mu khyud 'chad/ /rtsa yi dras g.yogs rtsa gang zhig /sra bas phyi ba'i sman dag gis—/ /ma zhi 'brum phran de la ni/ /mig mjer cho ga bzhin du gso/ /ling tog nad gzhi'i dbang las ni/ /snum rtsub 'bras bu gsum sbyin zhing / /tig ta chen po'i sman mar sbyin/ /gtar ga bkru sman khu ba yi/ /thigs pa blugs pa la sogs bya/ /snad pa'i ling tog dur byid chu/ /lan gsum bskol ba'i mar blud bya/ /de 'og gtar ga'am pad pa yis⑩/ /mig las khrag ni dbyung bar bya/ /ut+pal rgun 'brum ram nye ba/ /shing mngar bi da ri bskol ba//kha ra ra yi 'o ma 'am/ /chu bskol thigs pa blugs par bya/ /mig dmar mchi ma nad zhi nas/ /de rjes phyi ba'i mig sman phan/ /dzā ti kha 'bus rgya skyegs dang / /yug snam tsan+dan ri lur byas/ /khrag dang mkhris pa dwangs ⑪byed cing //snad pa las gyur ling tog sel/ /phag dang rnga mo glang po che/ /ba lang ra rta bong bu'i so/ /rgya mtsho'i lbu ba mu tig ⑫dang / /na le sham ni bzhi par ⑫sbyar//so yi ri lus snad pa yi/ /ling tog gis khyab sel bar byed/ /ta ma'i lo ma 111—676

ba lang so/ /rgya mtsho'i sbra ba bong bu'i rus/ /zangs ma dung gcin ri lur byas| /ling tog thams cad sel bar byed/ /rin chen so dang rwa ①dang ni/ /khams dang sug smel tsha ba gsum/ /sgog skya ka rañdza'i sa bon/ /rma la phan pa'i sman rnams ni/ /rma bcas rma med gting zug dang / /pags gnas ling tog 'joms sman yin/ /sna sman snum blud sha khu ni/ /blud pas dma' ba bstod par bya/ /nad med ling tog dma' ba ni/ /phur ma btsos dang brta bas bstod/ /ling tog dkar po skyes pa ④dang / /shing mngar thal tres seng phrom chu/ / blugs pas ①seng phrom gtums pa ni/ /chu dron la sbangs thigs pa blugs/ /shing mngar bri ④ha ti'i rtsa ba/ /rgyam tsha dong gra zangs ma ni/ /sgyu ru ra'i 'bras ⑤chu dang btags/ /lde gu zangs ma'i snod la bskudhi/ /nas mar skyu ru ra'i lo ⑦ma/ /dud pas de 'og mang du bdugs/ /de nas ⑧ri lur bya ba ni/ /de ni chu dang sbrang rtsir btags/ /mthon ka chen po zhes bya ste/ /ling tog dkar po sel mchog yin/ /ling tog brtan zhing mthug pa la/ /khrag ni lan mang dbyung bar bya/ /mgo dang lus kyi bkru sman gtang ⑨/ /phur ma btsos pa'ang lan mang gtang / /pi pi ling dang na le sham/ /rgyam tsha shri ⑩sha'i 'bras bu 'am/ /'bras bu gsum bskol rgyam tshar ⑪bcas/ /blud pas gnas las bstod ⑫par bya/ /dung dang rgya shug ka ta ka /rgun 'brum shing mngar sbrang rtsi dang / /mu ra so yi dri ma yi⑫/ /shri sha yi ni me tog bcas/ /tshigs bcad phyed kyis bshad pa 'di/ /mig sman sbyor ba gtang bar bya/ /sgyu ru pa ni dza' khu bar/ /lang ⑫ka li yi thal ba ni/ /nub gcig sbangs te bskams pa'i ⑫phye/ /ling tog bskyod pa'i mig sman yin/ /muṅga sbun pa med 111—677

btags pa/ /dung dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa'ang phan/ /sbrang rtsi ma du ka'i snying po'am①/ /ba ru ra ②rkang sbrang rtsir bcas/ /ba lang rta bong rnga mo'i so /dung dang rgya mtsho'i sbra ba dang / /ardzu ne+e'i ④chus ri lur byas/ /bskyod pa'i ling tog 'jig rjopar byed/ /bstod pa'am zug rngur bcas pa yi ling tog sru la sogs pas ⑤phyi/ /rtsa yi ling tog mthong gnod med/ /snad pa'i ling tog lta bur gso/ /shing mngar stag tsher ram nye ba/ /bri rjoha ti dang a ka ru/ /skyer pa'i mig sman ra'i 'o ma/ /btags pa'i sde gu nas dang mar/ /bcas pa'i dud pas bdug par bya/ /skyu ru ra yi lo ma dang / /ri lur byas pa ⑦mig sman mchog /ma sos ra yi ril ma 'dra/ /mdzer pa lta bur mtshon gyis gso/ /ra'i ril gsor ni mi rung dang / /ling tog de 'dra de bzhin gzhan—/ /nad ma zhi na snum blud cing / /gtar ga gdab pa la sogs bya/ /smad byas de ni bsal byas shing / /dkar zhing mtho ba gso bar bya/ /rgya star go bye lung thang dang / /ta la sbyig ma ka ri ra/ /bsres pa'i thal chu btsags pa dang / /rnga mo'i rus pa'i phye ma bsre/ /mig sman ling tog gso dka' dang / /mdog mi sdug pa 'joms par byed/ /gso sla la yang 'di nyid ni/ /bsten pas sel bar nus pa yin/ /ra yi ril ma ngos gnyis nas/ /khab kyis phug ste chu gzags nas/ /mthe bos mnyam du bcir nas ni/ /rma yi nang ni sha phye dang / /tshil ni zlon pas bkang nas ni/ /dkri zhing dkri zhing dgang bar bya/ /zhag bdun nas ni rma 'byor nas/ /mig 'bras nag po mnyam brtan la/ /mig sman snum can gtang bya zhing / /mar dang 'o ma'i sna sman blugasadze+e—/ /de lta na yang rgyas gyur ⑨na/ /dbug dang bcad sogs bya ba byas⑩//111—678

bcad drags pa yis mig nang du/ /zhugs par mi 'gyur ci rigs bya/ /ling tog la ni rtag par rang gi sman/ /bskol ba'i mar blud sna sman bsten pa dang / /ci nas mthong ba nyams par mi 'gyur bar/ /mig sman rnon po rtag tu bsten par bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ①bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas mthong bar byed pa'i mig nad kyi nad dmigs shes par bya ba bshad par bya'o/ /nad ni rtsa yi nang zhugs pa/ /rim pa dang por ②gnas nas niske/ /gzugs ni mi gsal mthong 'gyur zhing / /rgyu med par yang gsal bar mthong / /rim pa gnyis par phyin pa na/ /med pa dag kyang mthong 'gyur zhing / /yod cing nye bar bsgribs na ①mthong / /ring nas duphra ba mthong bar ⑤'gyur/ /nye dang ring bar gnas pa'i gzugs/ /phyin ci log tu shes par 'gyur/ /nad kyis rlum po'i dbyibs 'dra bar/ /zlum po nyid du mthong bar 'gyur/ /mthong byed dbus rjoganas gcig gnyis mthong / /mang du gnas na du ma mthong / /mthong byed nang du zhugs pa ni/ /che chung ⑦go ni bzlog par mthong / /'og tu gnas pas nye mi mthong / /steng du gnas pas ring mi mthong ⑧/ /ngos la gnas pas g.yas g.yon min/ /nad 'di ⑨rab rib ces byar bshad/ /nad ni rim pa gsum par brten/ /sngon po nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /de yis steng mthong 'og mi mthong / /gos srab kyis g.yogs ltar mthong zhing / /kha dog ji bzhin 'gyur ba dang / /rim gyis mthong ba nyams par 'gyur/ /de lta ⑩na yang yal bar dor/ /rim pa bzhi par phyin 111—679
