nas ni/ /mthong byed mtshan mo nyams byed sbung / /mig gi rgyal mo khebs par byed/ /de la rlung gyur ①rab rib ni/ /long long por ni mthong ba dang / /g.yo zhing rnyog can rtsa dmar snang / /chad 'ga' ④gsal bar mthong ba dang / /dra ba skra shad sbrang bu dang / /'od mthong de ni yal bar bor/ /sngon por gyur la mig dmar la/ /bzhin la sna ni med par mthong / /zla ba med sogs du mar mthong / /yon po'ang drang por mthong bar 'gyur/ /sngon po 'phel na mthong byed ni/ /rdul gyis khebs pa lta bur mthong / /gsal zhing dmar ba'am rgya che ba'am/ /phra ba'am mthong ba nyams par 'gyur/ /de ni mthong ba nyams pa yin/ /rlung gis mig gi ④rtsa 'khums 'gyur/ /mthong byed gting du zhugs pa dag /'di ni gting ring zhes byar bshad/ /mkhris gyur ④rab rib glog dang ni/ /srin bu me khyer me sgon 'od/ /rma bya sreg pa'i sgo dang 'dra/ /phal cher sngon ⑤por mthong bar 'gyur/ /mthong byed mig ni 'khar rjogaya' 'dra—/ /de lta bu ni mthong ba dang / /nyi zla 'khyims ⑦dang me dang ni/ /smig rgyu 'ja' tshon ⑧mthong bar 'gyur/ /bung ba ltar sngo mthong ba med/ /'bras bu snum pa mthong nyams yin/ /mkhris pa ⑨mig ni chung zhes bshad/ /chung mthong de ni thung ngu yin/ /ser zhing dngos po ser por mthong / /mkhris pas tshig par gyur zhes bya/ /bad kan rab rib phal cher ni/ /snum zhing dkar bar mthong ba dang / /dung ⑩dang zla ba kun+da ⑩dang / /kun+da'i me tog lta bus khyab/ /sngon po 'od med nyi zla dang / /sgron mes khyab pa lta bur mthong /mig 'bras dkar por snang bar 'gyur/ /bad kan mthong nyams des mngon ⑫khyab—/ /snum zhing mthong ba nyams 'gyur la/ /chu yi thigs pa pad+ma yi/ /111—680

'dab ma'i steng na gnas ltar g.yo/ /dro na zhum par 'gyur ba dang / /grang bas yongs su khyab par byed/ /zla ba me tog kun+da dung / /shel ltar snang zhing dkar ba yin/ /khrag gi ①rab rib dmar ba dang / /mun par gyur pa mthong ba yin/ /sngon po dmar ba gnag par ni/ /mig gis de ltar mthong ba yin/ /mtshan ma nyams pa ②de 'drar mthong / /'od med mthong ba nyams pa yin/ /ldan pa 'am ni 'dus pa yi/ /rab rib la sogs mtshan ma ni/ /'dren ma yin par shes par bya/ /glo bur du ni rab rib dag /gsal dang mi gsal 'khrugs par byed/ /lhag ma dag gis ①mthong byed ni/ /dmar zhing sna tshogs dag tu snang / /gang gis mthong byed nad kyis khyab/ /sre mo'i mig 'drar ④snang bar 'gyur/ /de ni nyin mthong mtshan mo min/ /ne+e'u le long ba zhes de bshad/ /nyi ma nub par gyur pa na/ /'od mi snang tshe rengs ⑤'gyur zhing / /mthong byed nyams par byed pa ni/ /nad kyi dhilong ba gnyis pa yin/ /nyi ma'i zer gyis phog pa na/ /mthong ba'i lam nas dri ma ni/ /zhu zhing med par gyur nas ni/ /nyin mo gsal bar mthong bar byed/ /tsha bas gdungs te mod la ni/ /chu grang nang du zhugs gyur na/ /nad gzhi gsum dang khrag 'khrugs te/ /drod ni gyen 'gro de nas mig /tsha zhing na dkar dze+edri ma can//nyin mo long long por mthong zhing / /mtshan mo long bar gyur pa dag /de ni dro bas tshig ces bya/ /shas cher skyur ⑧zos nad dang ni/ /khrag dang bcas pas mig khyab 'gyur⑨/ /'drul zhing g.yo la dri ma can/ /de ni skyur gyis tshig ces bya/ /mya ngan rims dang mgo ⑩nad kyis/ /rlung sogs gdungs par gyur pa las⑪/ /rlung sogs 'khrugs shing dud 'thul mthong / /de ni dud pa 111—681

can zhes bya/ /snying stobs chung bas glo bur du/ /ngo mtshar can gyi gzugs mthong ba'am/ /nyi ma 'od can sogs mthong nas/ /mig la brten pa'i rlung la sogs/ /gzi brjid ①nyams pas mig gi ni/ /mthong ba nyams par byed par 'gyur/ /bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog mkhrang bag dang / /rang bzhin gnas ltar nad med 'gyur/ /'di ni phrad pa las byung ba'i/ /mtshan ma nyams pa zhes byar bshad/ /'di las bad kan ma gtogs mtshan/ /nyams dang thung ngu gting zhen spang ②/ /mig sngon drug dang ne+e'u le'i/ /long ba 'tsho tsam lhag ma ni—/ /bcu gnyis po ni gso bar bya/ /de ltar mig nad nyi shu di/ /rtsa bdun dag tu bstan pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas rab rib gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /rab rib sngon po nyid 'gyur zhing / /sngon po ma bcos long bar 'gyur/ /de bas mig nad la rab rib/ /mi bzad myur du gso bar bya/ /'tsho byed srang brgya chu bre ni/ /bcu drug nang bskol bzhi cha lus/ /khu ba 'o ma bre do dang / /mar ni bye gang lhan cig btso/ /stag tsher ba dang ram nye ba/ /seng phrom rgyam tsha pi pi ling / /shu ti shing mngar rgun 'brum dang / /thang shing kha ra 'bras bu gsum/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis btab bskol te/ /mtshan 'thungs rab rib sel mchog yin/ /rgun 'brum btsod dang tsan+dan dkar/ /ram nye ba gnyis dzi ba ka /kha ra nye'u shing me da dang / /shing mngar ut+pal puṇ+ḍa rī/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis mar rnying ni/ /bre gang 'o ma de mnyam bskol/ /de yis mig sngon rab rib dang / /mar gyis 111—682

mgo nad rab rib 'joms/ /nim pa skyer pa pa to la/ /pu tse shel dang pu shel tsi/ /'bras bu gsum dang ba sha ka /byi tsher ba dang kyi lce ba/ /par pa ta ni srang re yin/ /skyu ru ra ni bre gang dang / /chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol| /bye bzhi lus par gla sgang dang / /rtsa mkhris shing mngar dug mo nyung //ba lu ka dang tsan+dan dang / /pi pi ling srang phyed phyed dang / /mar bye gang dang bcas bskol ba/ /des ni rna ①mig sna nad dang / /khong 'bras rims dang mjer pa dang / /'brum phran shu ba mdze nad sel/ /mchog tu ling tog rab rib dang / /mtshan long dro bas tshig pa 'joms/ /'bras bu gsum ni srang brgyad dag /chu bre bzhi bskol bzhi cha lus/ /'o ma de dang cha mnyam dang / /'bras bu gsum gyi sde gu ni/ /srang gcig zhun mar bre phyed bskol/ /kha ra 'am sbrang rtsir ②bcas pa'am/ /'bras bu gsum gyi khu bar bcas/ /'thungs na rab rib thams cad 'joms/ /shing mngar ram nye ba gnyis dang //kaṇ+ḍa kā ri pi pi ling / /a ru ra dang ut+pa la/ /kha ra rgun 'brum srang rer bcas—/ /ra yi 'o ma mar bre re/ /'bras bu gsum dang ba sha ka / bring ga ④ra dza' khu bar bskol/ /'di ni 'bras bu gsum chen mo'irjo/ /mar de mig nad kun sel mchog /'bras bu gsum dang ⑤mar ram ni/ /'bras bu gsum dang shing mngar bcas/ /sbrang rtsi yis ni sbrus gyur pa/ /mtshan mo zos par gyur na ni/ /zla gcig phan pa'i zas bsten zhing / /sgyu ru ra yi chu 'thungs na/ /mkha' lding lta bu'i mig thob ces/ /drang srong mu khyud kyis rjobashad do/ /ta bya ⑦shing mngar lcags dang gser/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi mar rnying dang / /'bras bu gsum dang ci 'dod sbyar/ /bsten pas ⑧rab rib 111—683

'joms mchog yin/ /yang na 'bras bu gsum bskol mar①/ /rab rib can gyis bsten bya 'am②/ /snum khur phye 'am sran tshod ni/ /'bras bu gsum gyi phye bcas pa'am/ /'o thug 'bras bu gsum bcas pa/ /bsgrangs te kha ra sprang rtsi btab/ /zas ma zos pa'am nang par ni/ /rgun 'brum kha ra sbrang rtsi dang / /a ru ra ni so sor bza'/ /rtag tu rab rib can gyis bsten/ /lig bu mig cha drug cu bzhi/ /zangs dang dngul dang gser gyi cha/ /re re gcig tu sbyar ba ni/ /kong ①bu kha sbyar nang du gzhug /'dres par gyur gyi bar du bud/ /de nas de yi ro drug gi/ /tshogs kyi khu ba lan bdun dang / /so sor de la blugs dhipar bya/ /mu tig dung dang be+e ḍūr+ya⑤/ /tsha ba gsum dang de nas bsre//phye ma'i mig sman de gtang bya⑦/ /rab rib thams cad sel byed yin/ /rgun 'brum pad+ma'i rtsa ba yi/ /khu ba 'o ma chang dang zhag /char pa de bzhin lig bu mig /bskol zhing bsku ba byas nas ni/ /phye ma de ni dung dang gzhug /mthong ba gsal byed mig sman yin/ /mig nad thams cad la bsngags zhes/ /lus 'phags rgyal pos bshad pa yin/ /spangs ma srang gnyis rgya shug ⑦gi/ /sol bar bsregs la ra yi ni/ /'o ma mar dang sbrang rtsi yi/ /nang du lan ni bdun bdun bcug /ta bya dang ni na le sham/ /lig bu mig dang pu tse shel//spang spos rgyam tsha a ru ra/ /seng phrom ldong ros pi pi ling / /sug smel rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dang / /stang zil zho ni gnyis gnyis dang / /shing mngar srang gcig bcas pa ni/ /kong ⑧bu kha sbyar nang bsregs btags/ /mig sngon mtshan mo long bar bcas/ /dmar ris de bsten pa yis 'joms/ /phye mas ⑨mchog tu rab rib nad/ /nyi mas mun pa lta bur sel/ /spang spos dri bzang 111—684

gsum dang lcags/ /gur gum ①ut+pal sngon po dang / /kha ra spangs ma sne.a ru ra| /rgya mtsho'i sbra ba 'ching ④bu dkar/ /na le sham dang pi pi ling /stang zil shing mngar dung dang bcas/ /tha skar zla ba'i tshe na ni/ /phye ma mig gnyis la bskus narjo/ /mig mdzer rab rib dmar ris dang / /g.ya' dang mig sngon sogs zhi byed/ /na le sham dang rgyam tsha ni/ /cha re pi pi ling dang ni//rgya mtsho'i sbra ba cha gnyis dang / /skyer pa'i ⑤khaṇ+ḍa cha dgu ni/ /nag pa la bab tshe na btags/ /mig bskus bad kan rab rib 'joms/ /spangs 0ma bsregs te lan mang du/ /ba gcin ra thug ⑦khu ba dang / /skyur rtsabs bud med nu zho dang / /dug gi khu ba sbrang rtsi mar/ /bcug par gyur pa gang yin pa//bye mar byas des ⑧mi yi mig /mkha' lding mig ltar gsal bar 'gyur/ /bring ga ra dza ⑨'bras bu gsum/ /dug dang shing mngar khu ba dang / /mar dang ra yi 'o mar ni/ /zha nye lan ni bdun bdun du/ /bsregs shing bsregs shing btsos pa yi/ /mig sman thur mar ⑩byas pa de/ /mig sman bskol ba 'am ma bskol ba 'am/ /byugs ⑩na rab rib mig mdzer nad/ /chu ser 'dzag dang 'byar bag can/ /g.ya' dang tshor ba med pa dang / /ri mo dmar por snang ba 'joms/ /dngul chu ro nye cha mnyam bya⑩/ /de gnyis stang zil mnyam byas la/ /ga pur cung zad btab pa ⑫yi/ /mig sman rab rib sel mchog yin/ /bya rgod dus su shi ba'i mgo bo ni/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog 'dra gang yin de/ /ba lang phyi bas bsregs ⑫thal lig bu mig /cha mnyam btags par gyur pa'i phye ma yi/ /sbyor 'dis mig gi gsal stobs bya rgod lta bur byed/ /sbrul nag mgor ⑫ni lig bu mig /mar bcas dud pa 111—685

ma shor bsregs/ /spang spos garnya bha dra ①dang / /lhan cig btags pas mig 'bras ni/ /rdol ②yang mig ni srung bar byed/ /sbrul nag shi ba'i ro dang ni/ /sdig pa shi ba'i ro bzhi ni/ /'o ma'i bum par zhag nyi shu/ /rtsa gcig bcug ste bsrul la bsrub①/ /de las mar sar gang byung bas/ /khyim bya gsos te de yi ni| /rtug pas mig ni bsgus gyur na/ /long bas kyang ni legs par mthong / /sbrul nag po yi zhag dang dug④ /stang zil ka ta ka'i 'bras bu/ /khu bar byas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /long ba'ang myur du mthong bar byed/ /na le sham ni rdog ma bcu/ /drub mar cang rjoni srang phyed dang / /spangs rjom srang gcig shing mngar ni/ /zho gnyis 'o mi'i ⑦nang du sbangs/ /du ba ma shor bsregs mig sman/ /khu ba mnyam med ces bya ste/ /rab rib 'joms pa'i mchog yin no/ /ba ru ra yi tshi gu ⑧na le sham/ /skyu ru ra dang spangs ⑨ma shing mngar ni/ /chu thag ⑫byas pa'i ri lu grib mar bskams/ /rab rib myur du 'joms par byed pa yin/ /na le sham dang skyu ru ra/ /rgya mtsho'i sbra ba spangs ⑪ma dang / /dngul rdo dang ni drub mar bcas⑫/ /go rims bzhin du cha res bskyed / /drub mar cha ⑫ni drug pa ste/ /sbyor 'dis rab rib ling tog mdzer/ / gnag dang mig sngon ⑫g.ya' ba sel/ /rin chen dngul dang shel dang gser//lig bu mig dang zangs dang lcags/ /tsan+dan dmar po yug snam dmar/ /phye ma'i mig sman nad kun sel/ /til mar ba ru ra yi mar/ /bring ga ra ⑫dza a sa na'i/ /khya ba lcags kyi snod du bskol/ /snar blugs ⑩mig ni gsal stobs skyed/ /nad kyi tshul las de la lan mang du/ /snum blud gtar ga bkru sman sna sman dang / /mig sman mgo bo'i bkru sman mas gtong dang / /111—686

byed — — ——— —nyams brtas byugs dang blugs 1pas ci rigs gso/ /'di ni spyi yi gso ba yin / /5da ni re re'i mnyan par gyis/ /de la rlung gyur rab rib la/ /rtsa ba bcu bskol khu ba mar/ /'o ma bzhi 'gyur 'bras bu gsum/ /lde gu bskol ba blud par bya/ /de 'og 'bras bu gsum dang ni/ /rtsa ba lnga'i khu 'o ma dang / /e raṇ+ḍa yi til mar bcas/ /bkru sman nye bar gtang bar bya/ / dzi ban )ti yi yal gar bcas/ /srang brgya 5chu bye bcu drug bskol/ /brgyad cha lus pa de nang du/ /til mar 'o ma bre re dang / /ba la gsum dang dzi ban ti—/ /nye'u shing rtsa ba srang re dang / /shing mngar srang ni bzhi dang bcas/ /lcags kyi snod du bskol bar bya/ /lcags snod nyid du zla gcig gzhag /sna sman nam tshong yan chad kyi/ /rlung nad mkhris pa'i nad 'joms shing / /mchog tu mig la gnas pa sel/ /skra gdong gnya' ba phrag nad sel/ /rgyas shing 7gzi mdangs mdzes /8/par byed/ /e raṇ+ḍa dkar 9rtsa ba dang / /thang shing bri ha ti'i 7'bras bu/ /shu dag rgya spos tsi tra dang / /bil ba'i rtsa ba til mar dang / /'o mar bcas bskol snar blugs 1 na/ /nam tshong yan chad rlung dang ni / /bad kan gyi ni nad kun sel/ /stag dang phag dang bya rgod dang / /sbrul dang khyim bya'i tshil dang ni/ /shing mngar so sor 7sbyar te bskol/ /mig sman bskus par 7bsngags pa yin/ /de rjes mig sman lig bu mig /sha khu 'o ma mar rim bzhin/ /snga ma bzhin du blugs na ni/ /rab rib 'joms byed mchog yin no/ /de ltar byas kyang ma zhi na/ /de 'og brta ba'i sa cho ga spyad/ /shu ti ru rta spang spos dang / /shing mngar ram nye ba gnyis dang / /stag tsher ba dang sa ra la/ /pi pi ling dang thang shing ni/ /mar gyi brgyad 'gyur 'o mar 7 /17 687

— —— ——— —ke——— —————— —rte———— — kebaskol—/ /mig brta ba 1/yi mchog yin no/ /ri dag e ne+e ya'i na tshil ni/ /'o mar (ke bskol te gzar bus dkrugs/ /de yi dwangs ma shing mngar dang / /tsan+dan pu shel tse de bzhin/ / shwa bid reg 0'jam go da dang / /khyim bya sreg pa rma bya'i tshil/ /re re zhing ni cho ga dag /'di dag gis ni brta bar snyebya//gsal bar bya dang snum dang ni/ /sman phur btsos pa'i thigs pa'ang blugs ///'dir ni rlung 'gyur (8)cham pa bzhin/ /ni ru ha dang 'jam rtsi bya/ /mkhris pa las gyur rab rib la/ /'tsho byed 'bras bu gsum dang ni/ /bskol ba'i mar ni blud /(/bya zhing / /snum gyis zhen par yigatar ga gdab/ /kha ra dur byid sug smel phye/ /sbrang rtsi 1spesbyar ba'i bkru sman gtang / /rab bsil sman chu blugs 1 byug sogs/ /gdong dang mig dang spyi bor bya/ /thal tres shug pa pu shel tsi/ /mu tig seng phrom tsan+dan dkar/ /ri lu'i mig sman bskus na phan/ /de bzhin garnya bha dra 6 dang / /nā ga put+pa ut+pa la/ /ga pur shing mngar yug snam phan/ /skyer khaṇ+ḍa dang sbangs 7ma dang / / karka ta yi sring gi dang /7/ /skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu shel/ /ga pur cha ni lnga lnga dang / /cha gsum cha re sbyar ba yin / /mig sman rab rib 'joms par byed/ /'tsho byed kha ra ut+pa la/ /'o ma mar bskol sna sman gtang / /bad kan las gyur sle tres dang / /'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling / /mar bskol snum blud gtar ga gdab/ /de rjes dan+da dur byid bskol/ /gla 1 3gor zho sha a ru ra/ /bca' sga pi pi ling phye gdab / /bkru sman dag ni gtang bar bya/ /rtsa ba bcu pa'i khu bar ni/ / ba le ka 1 dang ser po gnyis/ /thang shing pi pi ling 'o ma/ /til mar bskol ba'i sna sman gtang / /dung dang gla 1 rtsi pri yang ku/ /rtsa ba gsum dang 'bras bu 777 688

gsum/ /dri med ri lus mig gsal byed/ /lcags nag phye ma tsha ba gsum/ /rgyam tsha 'bras bu gsum mig sman/ /ri lu nag pos mig gsal byed/ /ri bong bong bu seng ge glang / /rnga mo'i so dang dbral ba'i rus/ /ba lang dkar sru na le sham/ /rgya mtsho'i sbra ba tsan+dan dung / /nu zho ra yi 'o mar btags/ /ri lus rab rib ling tog sel/ /khrag gyur ①mkhris pa lta bur gso/ /bsil chos bya zhing gtar ga gdab/ /rgun 'brum spang spos seng phrom dang / /shing mngar tsan+dan spangs ②ma dung / /pad+ma shug pa ut+pa la/ /ra yi 'o mas ri lur byas / /khrag gyur skerab rib myur du sel/ /ldan pa 'dus pa las ④gyur pa/ /nad gzhi cha ni ji bzhin gso/ /ma du ka dang byi dang ga⑤ /na le sham dang sgron shing dang / /'o ma til mar bskol ba 'am/ /btags pa'i sna sman gdong bsku bya/ /rgya spos ut+pal a nan+ta⑦/ /shing mngar su ni sha na kai⑦/til mar bskol ba'i sna sman dang / /mgo bsku 'jam rtsi bya ba bsngags/ /pu shel tsi bskol khu ba'i nang / /rgyam tsha pi pi ling phye gdab⑧/ /de btsags slar yang mar bcas par/ /bskol la ska gyur bsgrangs ⑨nas ni/ /sbrang rtsi bcug pa'i mig sman ni⑩/ /'dus pa las gyur rab rib sel/ /nub mo rgyu ba'i sems can gyi/ /rus pa rkang gis gang ba dang / /lig bu mig dang bcas pa ni/ /'bab chu'i nang du zla gcig gam/ /zhag ni nyi shu'i bar du gzhag /de nas phyung ste skams nas ni/ /lug ru yi ni me tog dang / /shing mngar bcas pa'i phye mar byas⑪/ /mig bskus 'dus pa las gyur pa'i/ /rab rib sel bar byed mchog yin/ /mig sngo gso ba'ang 'di nyid las/ /gtar ga gdab par mi bya ste/ /nad des long bar gyur pa yin/ /srin bu 111—689

pad pas ①khrag dbyung bya/ /bu ram rgya mtsho'i sbra ba dang / /pi pi ling dang na le sham/ /gur gum sbrang rtsi lig bu mig /spris g.yogs 'tsho ba tsam mig sman/ /'dus gyur ne+e'u le lta bur long / /rab rib skabs bshad cho gar sbyar/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi ba lang gi /lci ba'i khu ba skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /yug snam bal bu'i phye mar sbyar/ /mig sman mtshan mo long la phan/ /na le sham ni zho dang sbyar④/ /mtshan mo mi mthong mig sman mchog /ut+pal yug snam ka rañdza/ /pad+ma ge sar ba lang gi /byu ba'i khu ba dang sbyar ④ba'i/ /ri lus mtshan mo long ba sel—/ /ha re rku ④ka pi pi ling / /rgyam tsha dang ni lig bu mig /ra gcin ri lur byas pa phan/ /pri yang ku dang tsha ba gsum/ /ldong ros ba bla 'bras bu gsum/ /rgya mtsho'i lbu ba ra'i 'o ma/ /ri lu byas pa'i mig sman kyis⑤/ /mtshan mo long ba'i mig nad sel/ /mcher pa'i nang du pi pi ling / /bcug ste ma tshos bar btsos la/ /de bskams sbrang rtsir ⑦btags pa ni/ /mtshan mo mi mthong mig sman mchog /ma he'i mchin pa mcher pa dang / /til mar mar ni lhan cig bza'/ /'tsho byed sna ⑦bcu lo ma ni/ /mar dang lhan cig bskol ba bza'/ /a ti mug ta ⑧e raṇ+ḍa/ /nye'u shing lang ga li'i lo ma mar dang brngos pa bza' bar bya/ /dro na put+pa mar dang brngos/ /bza' dang btung bar ⑨sbyar ba'ang phan/ /dud 'thul mkhris pa skyur bro bas/ /tshig la mar ni rnying pa dag /snum gyur bsil ba'i bkru sman gtang / /bsil sman gyis ni kun tu byug /ba lang lci khu 'o ma mar/ /bskol ba yi ⑩ni mig sman nam—/ /bal bu'i lo ma yug snam bskol/ /phye ma btab pa'i mig sman phan/ /me da seng phrom a nan+ta⑪/ /skyer pa btsod dang shing mngar ni/ /mar gyi brgyad 111—690

'gyur 'o ma bskol/ /til mar bskol ba'i sna sman phan/ /'o ma mar sar gyis brta bya/ /des ma zhi na gtar ga gdab/ /sems las ①nad dang mya ngan 'jigasarka/ /zas rtsub tsog tsog por 'dug ②dang / /skyug sman bkru sman sna sman dang / /sman thigs blugs ①sogs nyes pa dang / /kha zas phyed zhu slon pa dang / /bkres skom la sogs brnags rjopa dang / /mig nad ma bcos yun ring las⑤/ /rab rib nad ldan brta bar bya/ /de la nad gzhi sogs brtags te/ /rang gi sman ni ji bzhin sbyar/ /nyi ma gzas zin me 'od glog la sogs/ /bltas pas mig ni nyams par gyur pa dag /de la bsil sman sogs kyis dhibarta bya zhing / /de bzhin gser bdar mar gyi ⑦mig sman gtang / /mi yis ji srid 'tsho yi bar du ni/ /rtag tu mig bsrung ba la 'bad par bya/ /nyin dang mtshan mo 'dra bar gyur pa yi/ /mi la nor yod gyur kyang don med yin//'bras bu gsum bsten gtar ga sbyang bya dang / /sems dga' mig sman sna sman bcas bsten na/ /bya sha za zhing rkang pa'i rim gro dang / /zhun mar btung bas rtag tu mig bsrung bya/ /kha zas mi 'phrod za ba rtag tu spang / /rab phra ⑧'tsher dang g.yo ba mi lta zhes/ /skyes bu'i mig ni mchog tu bsrung ba'i thabs/ /drang srong chen po mu khyud 'dzin kyis bshad/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas mthong ba nyams pa gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /bad kan las gyur spris ⑨g.yogs pa/ / rba klong ⑩la sogs bla brnan ⑩ni/ /drug po med par gyur pa dang / /legs smin ⑫mthong ba med pa dbye/ /de smin ⑫ma gyur mi 111—691

snyoms la/ /zho ga ①chu 'dra srab pa ni/ /thur ma yis ni drangs gyur kyang / /slar yang gyen du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nad ni mi bzad ②skyed byed cing / /mthong byed be+er yang 'gebs par byed/ /de ni zas ①bcas bla brnan tshubacas//bad kan can gyis myur du skyed/ /bad kan gyis ni mthong nyams pa/ /bad kan dkar bas dkar ba yin/ /de ni nad gzhan gyis zil ⑤gnon/ /kun tu sngo ba'i rjond du 'gyur/ /de la rlung gyur ⑦mig g.yo zhing / /rba klong g.yo zhing dmar skyar 'dug /gseg ma arga'i 'o ⑧ma ni/ /thig stiphran khyab 'dra mthug pa yin/ /gra ma lta bu'i mig 'bras ni/ /'bras kyi gra ma 'bras khyab yin//gra ma bcad pa gra ma tshig /bcad pa ltar snang na ⑩ba yin/ /rma sgro rma bya'i mjug sgro 'dra/ /khar ba'i mdog tu snang ba yin/ /gdugs 'dra kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /spris g.yogs gdugs can zhes bya'o/ /gtar ga mi bya cham pa dang / /lud pa can ni dbye mi bya/ /ma zhu sngar ma sgyugs ⑪pa dang / /rna mig mgo gzer can mi dbye/ /de nas thun mong dus su ni/ /sbyang byas zas zos pa la ni/ /sa phyogs gsal bar snga dro ni/ /sman pa pus mnyam khri la 'dug /nad pa 'dug cing bsdam byas la/ /kha yi dbugs kyis dugs ⑫bya zhing / /mthe bos mig ni mnyes byas nas/ /nad ni g.yos par mthong ba dang / /mi 'gul bar ni mgo nas bzung ⑫/ /rang gi sna la blta bzhin du/ /nag po ④sor phyed ma gtogs shing / /mig 'gram ⑫bzhi cha dor ⑩ba ru/ /mdzub mo gung mo mtheb mo yis/ /mig thur dam du bzung nas ni/ /rang grub bu ga nas 'phred du/ /gzugs shing gyen mnye drang por byas/ /mig g.yon lag pa g.yas pas dbug /mig g.yas lag pa g.yon pas dbug⑩ /111—692

legs par phug na sgra 'byung 'gyur/ /nad med chu ni nyung zhing 'byung / /de rjes nad pa spro bsrings ①la/ /mig tu nu zho blugs par bya/ /de nas thur ma'i rtse mo yis/ /gnod pa med par dal gyis ni/ /mig gi 'bras bu dbyi byas la/ /sna nas dal gyis phul ④bar bya/ /mig na gnas pa'i bad kan ni/ /sna nas brngubs snepas bsal bar bya/ /nad mi bu'agul ba'am 'gyur na ni⑤/ /mig gi phyi rol nas dugs bya/ /de nas gzugs ni mthong gyur rjonas/ /thur ma rim gyis dbyung bar bya/ /mar la sbangs pa'i ras bal gzhug /mig dkris nas ni de 'og tu/ / de las logs ni ⑦cig shos dbab/ /gnyis ka phye na gan rkyal ⑧bzhag /rlung med mal du mgo bo dang / /rkang bsku phan pa'i zas bsten bya/ /sprid pa lud pa sgregs pa ⑨dang / /mchil ma 'dor dang chu 'thung dang / /thur du gtong ba khrus byed dang / /so shing 'cha' bar byed pa dag /zhag bdun bar du spang bya zhing / /snum 'thung ⑩cho ga bzhin du bsdam⑪/ /chu dron gyis ni nyer spyod bya/ /ci nus sgyung bya ⑫na gyur na/ /mar khu dro 'jam blugs par bya/ /nas chan sla ba'am thug pa ska/ /tsha gsum skyu ru ra mar sbyin/ /zhag gsum nas ni de bgrol spyol/ /rlung 'joms pa yi sman gyi ④ni/ /khu ba mig tu blugs ⑫par bya/ /zhag bdun nas ni mig de nyid⑫/ /rnam pa kun tu dgrol ⑩bar bya/ /ji srid mi ⑫gsal brtan gyur pa⑪/ /bsdams la du'abad de gnas par bya/ /gzugs ni phra dang 'tsher ba dag /mod la blta bar mi bya'o/ /dbug nyes mi mthun zos pa las/ /skrang ⑥dang na dang dmar la sogs/ /mig nad ⑫gdung ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nad tshul de ⑫bzhin de gso bya/ /nad dang dmar ba zhi bya'i phyir/ / drur ba ④nas 111—693

dang yug snam dang / /thal tres mar dang ldan pa yi/ /lde gus gdong ni bsku bar bya/ /de bzhin til dang yungs kar bcas/ /kha ①lung khu bas sbrus pa'ang phan/ /thal tres lo ma pa ya su/ /btsod dang shing mngar ra yi ni/ /'o mar ④sbyar ba'i lde gu ①ni/ /dro 'jam bde bar byed mchog yin/ /seng phrom rgyam tsha rgun 'bru ④dang / /shing mngar ra yi 'o mar bskol/ /thigs ⑤pa mig tu blugs pa ④ni/ /na dang dmar ba 'joms par byed/ /shing mngar ru rta ut+pa la/ /rgun 'bru ⑦rgya skyegs kha rar bcas/ /rlung 'joms sman bskol 'o ma ni/ /mar gyi bzhi 'gyur bskol ba dang / /shug pa la sogs lde gus skebatabaske/ /las kun la ni bsngags pa yin/ /des ma zhi na snum chos ⑨dang / /dugs byas ⑩gtar ga gdab par bya/ /gdung ⑪ba'i gso ba dag kyang bya/ /dbug 'drub ⑫mig sman 'jam po bsku/ /tu pa ri'i rtsa na le sham/ / ba bla skyer pa'i ⑫khaṇ+ḍa bsku/ /mig phyed ④bu ram ri lu ni/ /char pa'i chu dang bdar ba gtang / /dzā ti da ba shi ri sha⑫ /karka ta sring gi me tog /mu tig 'bras bu bai ḍūr+ya/ /ra yi 'o mar btags pa ni/ /zangs ma'i snod la sla bar bsku—/ /zhag bdun nas bskol ⑩slar yang ni/ /'o ma dang btags sde gur byasaske/ /ri lu grib ma la bskams pa/ /mig bskus phye ba ⑩mjong ba ni/ /gsal zhing stobs ni skyed par byed/ /byi ru ldong ros lig bu mig /rgya mtsho'i lbu ba na le sham/ /sna nas btang ba'i sman sbyar na/ /bshad pa'i yon tan mtshungs par bstan/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ⑫bcu bzhi pa'o// //111—694

de nas mig nad thams cad kyi nad kyi ①dmigs brtag pa bshad par bya'o//rlung gis mig nad mchi ma 'dzag /sna rgyas cung zad skrangs pa dang / /mur ②'gram dpral mig smin ma kha/ /na zhing zug la 'phar ba dang / /rngu ma skam zhing mchi ma grang / /sla nyung na ba ldang dub can/ /'byed dab 'dzums par ①dka' ba dang / /srin bu 'gro ba snyam du sems/ /mig ni bus pa lta bur snang //zug rngu phra mos rjokhyab snyam byed/ /snum dang dro bas nyer zhir 'gyur/ /mchi ma 'dzag pa zhes bya'o/ /de ma bcos na gdung bar 'gyur/ /rna ba sgra 'byung mgo 'khor dang / /dpral ba mig dang smin ma sogs/ /gtsub ⑤shing gis ni gtsubs rjosnyam byed/ /de yang bag med yal bar bor/ /gdung bas bcom gyur nad de yis/ /sna tshogs tshul ni 'byung 'gyur zhing / /mig mthong nyams byed rma 'byung 'gyur/ /mur ⑦'gram kha dang mjing skepa las/ /rlung ni gzhan du 'jug 'gyur zhing / /mi bzad na la gnag pa dang / /dmar zhing skrangs la mig mi sdug /zhum ⑨zhing kun nas mchi ma 'dzag /de ni rlung gis gzhan gyur yin/ /de bzhin mig ni yon po dang / /chung ba rlung gis ⑩phyin ci log /mkhris pa'i mchi 'dzag mtshan ma ni/ /tsha grang ⑩du ba 'byung snyam sems / /mig chu'i ⑫phyi rol gnag pa dang / /nang na rnag 'drul mchi ma tsha /ser zhing mig dmar ⑫ser por mthong / /rma la lan tshwas ④btab snyam sems/ /me mdag gtor ba 'dra ba dang / /mcher spyopa'i gong bu lta bur snang / /mig nad gdung bar gyur pa yin/ /bad kan las gyur mchi 'dzag ni/ /tshor ba med skrangs rab tu g.ya'/ /gsher zhing snum la shas cher dkar/ /mig gdung spyi ⑩bag 'dzag pa yin/ /gdung ba des ni nag po dma'/ /'bras bu dkar po 111—695

mtho ①ba dang / /cham pas thebs ④shing sna rgyas la/ /mig ni rdul gyis gang snyam byed④/ /khrag gyur dudamar ris mig tu ⑤dmar/ /mig 'bras dkar po dmar ba dang / /khrag 'dzag dmar po mthong ba dang / /mkhris rjopa'i mchi 'dzag mtshan nyid yin/ /gdung ba ④mig ni mtha' dmar zhing / /phyung ba dang ni mtshungs par na/ /me tog ban ⑧du ka ltar dmar/ /shin tu na zhing reg mi bzod/ /lung tang ⑨khrag tu nub pa 'dra/ /gnag cing me ltar snang ba yin//gdung ba rang gi ji bzhin du/ /thams cad 'dzag pa las lhag na/ /mur 'gram so dang mkhur tshos dang / /mgo bo lhag par na bar byed/ /rlung mkhris shas cher drud ⑩snyam sems/ /zug cing na ⑪la phul snyam sems/ /shin tu rtsub cing mig mchu mig /'dzums ⑫dang 'byed par dka' ba dang / /na zhing skams ⑫par gyur pa dang / /grang 'dod smin zhing skam dang bcas/ /mig skam smin pa zhes bya'o/ /nad gzhi gsum ni khrag bcas la/ /skrang 'gyur de ni rab skrangs shing ⑫/ /na dang tsha dang 'dzag dang bcas/ /u dum bā ⑫ra'i 'bras smin 'dra/ /mig 'bras dkar por 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mchi ma grang zhing dro ba dang / /spyi ⑩bag ska sla res kyis 'byung / /skrangs chung cung zad skrang ⑩zhes bya/ /de bzhin mtshan nyid gzhan gyis smin/ /mig smin pas nyen skrang ba yi/ /rtsom che mchi ma rnyog can 'dzag /bad kan gyis bsgos mig 'bras ni/ /dkar po dmar zhing 'drul ba dang / /tsha zhing mthong ba nyams pa dang / /nad ni mal na mi gnas yinaspyo/ /khrag mkhris shas che'i nad kyis spyoni/ /zas kyi dwangs ma skyur por ⑩'gyur/ /mig gi rtsar ni song nas ni/ /mig ni dmar por byed par 'gyur/ / skrang tsha ⑪smin zhing mchi 111—696

ma 'dzag /shin tu lang ①long por mthong na②/ /sgyur gyis bskyed pa'i nad ces bya/ /de ltar kun gtogs dze+end bcu drug /de la gdung bas bcom pa ni/ /mig smin bcas pa spang bar bya/ /rlung gyur dhizhag lngas mig la gnod par byed/ /bad kan las gyur gdung bas ⑤zhag bdun gyis/ /de bzhin khrag gyur zhag gsum gyis 'joms byed/ /mkhris gyur 'phral du log spyod kyis gnod byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u rjobaco lnga pa'o// //de nas mig nad thams cad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /mchi ⑦'dzag sngar byung sketshul nyid la/ /mkhur bkang sna sman rnon po gtang / /rlung 'khrugs ma gtogs nad gzhan la/ /smyung ba dag kyang bya ba yin/ /tsha stidang dmar dang gos pa dang / /skrang ()sogs zhi phyir kun la ni/ /sug smel garnya bha dra ⑪dang / /na le sham dang btsag yug snam/ /lde gur byas pas ⑫bsku bar bya/ /rlung gyur rgyam tsha skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /shing mngar rgya spos tsan+dan nam/ /rgyam tsha dong gra skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /mar gyi nying khu bdar ba 'am/ /yang na seng phrom sbyar ba gtang / /khrag mkhris gyur la spang spos dang / /shug pa shing mngar ra mnye ba/ /bad kan las gyur pri yad+ku/ /ldong ros sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku/ /'dus pa las gyur kun gyis bsku/ /na le sham ni dkar po cha gcig dang / /ldong ros cha bzhi seng phrom cha bcu drug /zhib tu btags te ras gtsang phur mas gtums/ /nad ldang mod la mig tu gdab par bya/ /rgya sran nag po ba lci ra'i ⑫ril khu/ /legs btsos sen mos shun pa bshus gyur pa/ /de 111—697

yis ①mtshan mo lan cig bskus pa yis/ /mig nad 'khrugs pa myur du zhi bar byed—/ /shu ti shing mngar spangs ma a ru ra/ /zhib btags ras kyi thum po lhod par bcing ①/ /zangs kyi snod du sgyur rtsabs nang du bcug /mig tu bzhag na mig nad sna tshogs sel/ /skyer pa srang gasbug chu bre phyed du yang / /khu ba brgyad cha lus par sbrang rtsi btab①/ /de bzhin mig tu rjobaskus par gyur na ni/ /nad gzhi thams cad 'khrugs rjopa'i mig nad sel/ /shi kru'i lo ma'i khu ba sbrang rtsir bcas/ /mig tu blugs na rlung dang mkhris pa dang / /bad kan 'dus pa las gyur mig nad rnams/ /mig nad mang po dag kyang myur du sel—/ /e raṇ+ḍa ni ④gzhon nu'i lo ma dang / /rtsa ba brdungs te ra yi 'o mar bskolarka/ /blugs sam zan dron mig tu glan ⑦pa yis/ /rlung gyur mchi 'dzag nad ni mod la ④'joms/ /rlung gyur pa la bil ba stsogs/ /bskol ba'i sman thigs blugs ⑨pa 'am/ /e raṇ+ḍa'i rtsa bri ⑩ha ti/ /ma du shi kru dro 'jam blugs/ /sha rang gaṣ+ṭa ba la ⑪ka /rgya spos u dum wā ⑫ra'i shun/ /chu dang 'o ma bcas bskol ba'i/ /thigs blugs ⑫gzer ni sel mchog yin/ /btsod dang skyer pa rgya skyegs dang / /rgun 'brum ut+pal shing mngar gnyis/ /bskol te bsgrangs par kha ④ra gdab/ /mig blugs khrag mkhris mig nad sel/ /shing mngar ka she ru'i phye ma/ /ras ma 'jam pos spyolhod par bcing / /char chu'i nang du sbangs pa ni/ /khrag mkhris las gyur mchi 'dzag sel/ /shing mngar skyer pa stag tsher ba/ /thum po nu zho kha rar bcas/ /ra yi 'o mar sbangs pa blugs/ /tsha na mdog dmar mchi 'dzag sel/ /seng phrom dkar po shing mngar bcas /mar brngos legs par btags pa ni/ /ras la gtums te nu zhor mnye/ /111—698

khrag mkhris snad pa'i mig nad sel/ /dong gra nim pa 'bras bu gsum/ /seng phrom ba sha ka'i ①khu ba/ /dro 'jam blugs pas bad kan sel/ /'dus par 'di dag bsres pas ②phan/ /rlung la mar ni rnying pa dang / /mkhris par kha rar ④bcas pa dang / /bad kan la ni tsha ba gsum/ /bskol dang thal sman bcas pa blud/ /de 'og khrag kyang dbyung ba dang / /de nas snum gyur bkru sman gtang / /dro bas tsha ste gzer ba la/ /skam sa'i srog chags sha btags pas / /mgo dang gdong bsku tsha ba la/ /'o ma mar bcas grang mos bsku/ /rab rib gso ba'i cho ga yang / /brtags te ji bzhin gso bar bya/ /cho ga 'di dag thams cad ni/ /gdung ba la sogs rnams la phan/ /gdung ba yong ye ma zhi na/ /smin ma'i steng du me btsa' gdab/ /ba zho snum med kyis dngul dusnodarka/ /byugs te sngon por gyur pa dang / / skams nas zho ga chu ri lur⑤/ /byas pas burlung gyur mig nad 'joms/ /dzā ti'i me tog kha 'bus dung ⑦/ /shing mngar ba la ④'bras bu gsum/ /char chu dang btags ri lur byas/ /khrag mkhris las gyur mig nad sel/ /rgyam tsha 'bras bu tsha ba gsum/ /rgya mtsho'i ⑨sbra ba dung snying po/ /e la ba lu sra rtsi pog /ri lus bad kan mig nad sel/ /shing mngar pra puṇ+ḍa rī ⑩ka /skyer pa srang ni brgyad brgyad dag /chu bre bcu drug nang bskol btsags/ /be+er bskol ska bar gyur pa ni/ /ra gan dud pa srang bcu dang / /na le sham phye zho gnyis gzhug /de la ri lu'am phye mar byas⑪/ /bskus na mchi 'dzag thams cad dang / /dmar na drud pa byed snyam 'joms/ /'phral du mig ni gsal bar byed/ /spyor 'di phyug bdag ces bya ste/ /sman pa rnams kyi gsang ba mchog /mig smin skam 111—699

pa mar blud cing / /'tsho byed kyi ni sman mar ni 7)/ /blud cing mig ni brta (gebya dang / /til mar chung ngu'i sna sman gtang / /'di la 'o ma rgyam tshar bcas/ /dro 'jam thigs pa blugs pa'ang phan/ /bca' sga bud med nu zhor btags/ /mar sbyar mig tu bskus na'ang phan4/ /yang na rlan can sha yi zhag /dong gra rgyam tsha cung zad btab/ /skra ni mar bskus me long gis/ /mnyes te kham phor kha sbyar 5bcug /bsregs 6)te lcags snod mar dang bcas/ /snag tsha ⑦de ni mig sman mchog /skrang bcas cung zad skrangs pa kyel/ /snum chos byas te gtar ga gdab/ /snum byas rgun 'brum a ru ra/ /dur byid mar bcas bkru sman gtang / /seng phrom dkar po mar la brngos/ /phye mar byas te ras la gtums/ /chu dron la mnyes thigs pa blugs( / /gzer 'joms pa yi mchog yin no/ /skyer pa pra puṇ+ḍa rī ka /bskol ba'i thigs pa blugs pas 4 phan / /mchi 'dzag na zhing drud snyam byed/ /sbyar sman 'di dag gtang bar bya / /lcags kyi snod du zangs ma ba gcin sbyarasgospe/ /mar bdug 7mig bskus gzer ni 'joms par byed/ /zangs ma'i snod du ba zho'i spris ma bdar/ /rgyam tsha pi pi ling dang bcas pa mchog /zangs ma'i snod du nu zho dung bdar la—/ /dong ga'i lo ma mar bcas dud pas bdug1she /sbyar sman zhes bya mig tu bskus na ni/ /drud musnyam byed sogs mi bzad nad myur sel/ /u dum wā sara'i 'bras bu ni/ /lcags snod nang du nu zho bdar/ /sha ma'i lo ma mar dud bdugs /mchi 'dzag gzer dmar drud pa 'joms/ /shi kru'i lo ma'i khu ba ni//zangs ma gnyis kyi bar du bdar/ /mar dud bdugs 1/pas skrangs pa dang / /g.ya' dang mchi 'dzag nad rnams 'joms/ /til gyi chu dang khar ba ni/ /777 700

kham ①phor bdar te nim pa yi②/ /'o ma mar bskol dud pas bdug /gzer ram ⑧mchi 'dzag drud snyam sel/ /sbyar sman gyis ni mig bskus te/ /sman shugs zug gzer ④dang bral nas/ /bud med nu zho'i thigs pa blugs⑤/ /lan gsum phan chad de mi bsku/ /bal bu'i lo ma pi pi ling / /rgya spos lcags phye stang zil dang / /dzā ti kha 'bus nag tshur dang / /rgyam tsha ba gcin btags pa yi/ /lde gus zangs kyi snod bskus la/ /zhag bdun bzhag ste ba gcin dang / /btags te ri lur dubyas nas ni/ /de 'og grib ma la bskams te//bud med nu zho dang bdar bsku/ /drud snyam byed dang mchi ma 'dzag /skrang dang g.ya' ba sel bar byed/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑦ri'i shun pa dang / /shing mngar zangs ma'i sgephye ma ni/ /ra yi 'o mas sde gur byas/ /sha mi skyu ru ra'i lo ma/ /mar gyis bskus pa'i dud pas bdug⑨ /bskus na skrangs ⑩dang gzer nad sel/ /skyur gyis bskyed la mkhris pa yi/ /mchi ma 'dzag pa'i cho gas gso/ /bad kan khrag mkhris kyis bskyed dang / /'dus pas bskyed dang sgra ngan dang / /rdzi ma 'gags dang mig smin skam/ /rnag ⑪gi chu ser pad+ma'i rtsa/ /mig mchu'i sha dang skyur skyed cung ⑫/ /mchi 'dzag gdung ⑫ba rlung ma gtogs/ /bcwa brgyad po dag tshag par bshad/ /yun ring du ni na ba yin/ /'di dag gso ba so so yi/ /le'u'i nang du bshad pa yin/ /de'i ④'og mig ⑫tshag spyi yi bshad—/ /de nas mig tshag nad pa ni/ /snum chos ⑩slon ni byas nas kyang / /gtar ga gdab ste khrag dbyung bya/ /bkru sman btang zhing mig chu ⑩ni/ /dag par gyur gyi bar du bzhar/ /spangs ⑩ma srang gcig ⑪na le sham/ /dkar po srang ni nyi shu dang / /skyur rtsabs srang ni sum cu dag⑩ /btags te ⑫zangs 111—701

ma'i snod du gzhug /lo mang ①lon pa'i mig tshag pa'am②/ /chu ser 'dzag sogs zhi bar byed/ /gos dang tsha dang mchi ma 'dzag /g.ya' skrangs de blugs pa yis ①sel/ /bye'u rug ka rañdza'i sa bon/ /dzā ti'i me tog kha 'bus pa/ /brdungs te bskol la dubatsags nas ni/ /khu bar byas pa de dang ni—/ /stang zil dang sbyar mig sman ni/ /mig tshag g.ya' dang chu ser 'dzag /g.ya' zhing 'drul ba sel mchog yin/ /skyer pa'i khaṇ+ḍa sra rtsi pog /ra gan dud pa ldong ros dang / /rgya mtsho'i sbra ba rgyam tsha dang / /na le sham dang btsag yug snamabu/ /sbrang rtsi btags pa'i mig sman ni/ /mig tshag 'drul g.ya' sel bar byed/ /rgya spos a ru ra'i khu bar/ /dngul rdo btags pas mig tshag sel/ /thang shing snum dang bcas pa ni/ /ra gcin nang du sbangs pa'ang phan/ /rgyam tsha 'bras gsum pi pi ling / /dung gi snying po pu tse shel/ /zangs ma'i phye ma rjobacas ri lu/ /mig tshag ling tog sel bar byed⑦/ /yang na nag tshur phye ma ni/ /bye'u rug pa'i khu bar sbangs/ /zangs ma'i snod du zhag bcu bzhag /de yis ④mig tshag chu ser 'dzag /rdzi ma 'byi ba sel bar byed/ /ldong ros dang ni skyer pa'i ⑨khaṇ+ḍa dang / /de mnyam zangs ma'i phye ma zhib tu btags/ /phye ma mig sman thur ma gcig gis kyang / /rji ma bskyed cing mig tshag 'dis sel byed⑩/ /rgya skyegs bring ga skyer pa nirgudz+re/ /khu bar ⑪ras kyi dum bu lan bdun sbangs/ /sdong bu ⑫mar me de bus las byung ba'iske/ / snag tsha mig tshag ⑫sel bar byed mchog yin/ /mig mchu mang du zhal zhal bya/ /de bzhin gtar ga bya ba dang / /bkru sman yang yang bya ba ni/ /mig tshag can gyi ⑪nad pas bsten/ /rnag gi chu 'dzag ma zhi'i mthar/ /thur 111—702

ma phra mos bsreg par bya/ /de ltar mig nad dgu bcu bzhi/ /nad gzhi mtshan nyid gso ba dag /phan tshun 'dres pa med par ni/ /ma lus par ni bshad pa yin/ /skyes bu nad med pa yis kyang / /nas dang gro rnyingastodrug cu pa/ /sā ①lu khre rgod rnying pa dang / / muṅga la ⑧sogs bad mkhris 'joms/ /zhun mar mang du btab pa dang / /tshod ma de 'dra skam sa yi/ /sha dang se 'bru kha ra dkar/ /bsten zhing char chu btung ba dang / /gdugs bcang lham ni bgo ba dang / /cho ga bzhin du nad sbyang ba①/ /rnam pa kun tu bsten par bya/ /shugs bkag pa dang ma zhur za/ /phyed zhu za rjodang rtug 'gags za/ /tsha dang phyi sa 'gags byed pa'i/ /zas dang spyod lam sman kun spang / /rkang pa gnyis kyi dbus na rtsa sgom po/ /gnyis gnas de yis mig ni nang du khyab/ /de bskus byug dang dril ba la sogs pa/ /rkang par byas na mig tu 'gro bar 'gyur//dri ma tsha dang snad pa la sogs pasarjo/ /de gnod gyur na mig la gnod par 'gyur—/ /de bas mig la phan 'dod lham dang ni/ / bsku dang ④dril dang byug pa ⑦sogs bsten bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u bcu drug pa'o// //de nas rna ba'i nad kyi dmigs shes pa bshad par bya'o/ /cham pas btab dang chu la rtse/ /rna ba brud ⑧pas rlung 'khrugs shing / /sgra yi log pa'i ⑨sbyor ba dang / /ldang ba'i rgyu gzhan gyis 'khrugs nas/ /rna ba'i rtsar ni rlung zhugs te⑩/ /rna ba'i bu gar shugs drag gzer/ /gzhogs phyed na zhing rengs pa dang / /grang ba dag ni mi 'phrod cing / /ring nas rnags ⑪shing 111—703

smin nas kyang / /chu ser cung zad 'dzag par byed/ /rgyu med rna ba stong snyam semasarka/ /zhum dang rgyas pa snyam du byed/ /mkhris gyur ①tsha bcas na zhing gzer—/ /grang 'dod skrang zhing ④rims kyis 'debs/ /myur du smin zhing smin nas kyang / /chu ser ser por ①'dzag par byed/ /chu ser des ni gang gang du/ /reg pa de dang der rnags rjo'agyur/ /bad kan las gyur mgo 'gram pa/ /mgrin pa lci zhing nad shugs dal/ /g.ya' zhing grang la dro ba 'dodaske/ /smin nas rnag ⑤dkar ska ba 'dzag /snad la sogs pas gnod gyur pa⑥/ /rna ba gzer bar byed par 'gyur/ /khrag dang mkhris pa ltar na ⑦dang / /mtshan nyid cung zad lhag pa yin/ /nad gzhi 'dus pas gzer ba dang / /skrangs sgebacas rims 'debs mi bzad na/ /res kyis grang dang dro ba 'dod/ /'on pa lta bu nyid du 'gyur/ /smin nas rnag ni dkar dang nag⑨ /dmar dang ska ba 'dzag par 'gyur/ /sgra thos rtsar ni rlung zhugs pa/ /rgyu med par ni sna tshogs pa'i/ /sgra ni yang dang yang du thos//de ni rna ba'i sgra zhes bya⑩/ /rlung ni bad kan dang 'dres pa'i/ /rna sgra yal bar bor na ni/ /skad gsang mthon por smras pa ⑪thos/ /rim ⑫gyis 'on pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rlung gis spyobad kan bskams gyur pas/ /de la rna bar ⑫gos gyur na/ /na zhing phyi la 'gags gyur pa/ /de ni rna ba 'gags zhes bshadaske/ /bad kan las ni rna ba g.ya'/ / skrang sra ⑫de yi ming gis bshad/ /mkhris pas bad kan tshig gyur pa/ /nad bcas pa 'am nad med kyang / /rnag ⑩ska 'dzag cing mang du 'drul/ /rna ba rnag can byed par 'gyur/ /rlung sogs pa yis rna ba'i sha /khrag la gnod gyur 'drul bar za/ /srin bus 111—704

bskyod cing mi bzad na/ /rna nad srin bu can zhes bya/ /rna ba phug ①pa'i rma las byung / /rma ni snga ma'i mtshan nyid can/ /khong 'bras 'gyur ba'am ⑤gzhan du'ang 'gyur/ /thor bu 'brum bu skrangs las 'byung / /de las rna ba rnags pa dang ①/ /'on par byed pas gnod par 'gyur/ /mngal du rlung gis rna ba'i sha /zhum du'agyur 'khums pa zhes bya'o/ /mngal du sha mdzer sra na med/ /pi pi ling 'dra mang po'ang gcig /nad med pi pi ling zhes byaske/ /'dus pa las gyur gas pa ⑤ni/ /mdog 'dra na zhing sra ba dang / /skrang rjo'agyur de ni ma gsos na/ /smin nas nyungs mar lta bur ni/ /'dzag cing 'tsho ba dka' bar 'gyur/ /rma 'tsho bas kyang nges ⑦par ni/ /rna ba'i sha ni zhum par 'gyur/ /rtsa la gnas pa'i rlung gis ni/ /rna shal skam pa de ming can/ /rna shal pi wang rgyud ltar phra/ /sra ba rgyud can zhes bya'o/ /gzhon sha can ni yun ring du/ /btang snyoms bor nas 'phral ⑧du bskyed/ /rna shal skrangs shing ⑨nad bcas la/ /dmar zhing 'byar bar gyur pa ni⑩/ /de ni rlung gis 'byar zhes bya/ /gnod 'gyur rgyan lci khur sogs kyis/ /khrag dang mkhris pa 'khrugs gyur pas/ /dmar zhing tsha na smin pa dang / /skrang ⑪dang 'brum bu 'brum phran dang / /dmar zhing tsha la rnags ⑫pa yin/ /rlung dang bad kan gyis rna shal/ /skrang ⑫zhing nad med sra ba dang / /brtan zhing mdog 'dra g.ya' ba dang / /de ni mnye ba zhes byar bshad/ /phug nyes rna ba brgyangs pa las/ /g.ya' bcas tsha gang smin zhing na/ /'dus pa las gyur skrangs pa de/ /sdug bsngal 'phel byed ces bya'o/ /bad kan khrag gyur srin bu phra/ /g.ya' zhing gnag la rnag bcas pa/ /srin bu phra mos 111—705

bldags zhes bya/ /de ma gsos na rna shal ①za/ /de las 'dus gyur ⑦pi pi ling / /gzer can gas 'khums gsor mi rung / /rgyud can gcig pu 'tsho ba tsam/ /lhag ma rnams ni gso bar bya/ /de ltar rna ba'i nad kyi ni/ /dbye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar bshad/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ②bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas rna ba'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /rlung las gyur pa'i rna nad larka/ /sha khu blud cing rlung 'joms pa'i/ /sman bskol mar ni mtshan mo bludarjo//rna ba dugs byas de rjes la/ /a shwat+tha ⑤dang e raṇ+ḍa/ /bil ba arka'i lo ma dang bu/ /til mar rgyam tshar ⑦bcas pa dang / /phur ma btso ba byas pa yi/ /khu ba dro 'jam tsam mam ni/ /la phug gu gul rna ba dgang ⑧/ /rlung 'joms sde tshan skyur rnams dang / /gcin gyi nang du snum chen ni/ /bskol ba de ni rna ba'i nad/ /mi bzad pa yang myur du sel/ /rtsa ba chen po lnga yi shing / /gang yang rung ba ⑨gso mas dkri/ /til mar gyis bskus 'bar ba'i rtse /snum 'dzag 'phral du nad sel byed/ /de bzhin thang shing ru ⑩rta dang / /sgon shing las kyang de bzhin bya/ /rlung nad cham pa la bshad pa'i/ /gso bas ⑪'dir yang phan pa yin/ /mgo bo bkru dang chu grang btung / /nyin mo'ang yongs su spang bar bya/ /mkhris gyur kha ⑫ra dkar por bcas/ /mar gyis snum byas bkru sman gtang / /rgun 'brum shing mngar nu zho bskol/ /rna ba bkang ba'ang bsngags pa yin/ /shing mngar tsan+dan drur ba ⑫dkar/ /pu shel tse dang ram nye ba/ /seng phrom pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / /pad+ma'i sdong bu dzi ba ka/111—706

btsod dang thal tres bskol ba dang / /shing mngar khu ba bre gang dang / /'o ma bre do bcas pa dag① /til mar phul gang bskol ba dang / /'di yis rnar blugs rna ②dgang bsku/ /yang na sbrang rtsi nyi tshes dgang / /gzer dang tsha dang na ba sel/ /shing mngang ①la sogs mar dang bcas/ /rna ba kun tu byugs na'ang phan/ /bad kan las gyur pi pi ling / /mar bskol snum gyur skyug tu gzhug /bad kan sel ba'i sna sman dang / /mkhur bkang dugs dang dud pa brngubadu/ /sgog skya sgo'u ⑤gsher shi kru dang / /la phug chu shing mu rang gdu /bskol ba'i khu ba dam ⑦pa ni/ /dro 'jam rna bar blugs na'ang phan—/ /arka'i myu gu skyur khur btags/ /til mar rgyam tshar bcas pa gang //snu ha'i shing bu brus ④par ni/ /bcug la arka'i lo mas g.yogs⑨/ /phur ma btsos pa'i ⑩tshul du bsreg /de yi khu ba gzer 'joms mchog /ma du lung ga'am ka pid ta'i⑩/ /khu bas bkang ba byas na'ang phan/ /yang na tshas bkang de rjes la/ /rgya mtsho'i sbra ba'i phye mas gdab/ /ra lug gasbun dang 'od ma'i shun/ /til mar bskol bas bkang na phan/ /yang na nyungs mar shing kun dang / / e raṇa ⑫dong gra bskol ba blugs/ /khrag gyur mkhyes pa lta bur gso/ /gtar ga myur du ⑫gdab par bya/ /smin zhing rna ba khrag 'dzag la/ /dud pa mkhur bkang sna sman sbyar/ /sbu gu'i cho ga dag dang ni/ /rma red cho ga gang yin bya/ /gos par ye'us dus gnyis su/ /rna ba phyi zhing ④dag par bya/ /gu gul dud pas bdugs nas kyang / /sbrang rtsi yis kyang dgang bar ⑫bya/ / bye'u rug khu ba bskol ba dang / /bu ram khu bas bskol ba yi/ /⑫ras bal ye'u rab phras byug /de yi phye ma gdab par bya/ /111—707

gzer dang rnags ①dang lci ba la/ /cho ga 'dis ni bzlog par bya/ /pri yabyu dang am pashra④/ /shing mngar dang ni da ta ki①/ ut+pa la yi lo ma dang / /btsod dang seng phrom rgya skyegs dang / /ka bid ta rjoyi khu ba dang / /til mar bskol te de blugs ⑤na/ /rnag 'dzag pa ni myur 'chad byed/ /sgra bcas 'on pa dag la ni/ /rlung gi bugazer 'joms sman gtang bya/ /bad kan las gyur bad kan ni/ /slon sman sogs kyis dang bor bsal/ /e raṇ+ḍa dang shi kru dang / /la phug gzhon nu'i lo ma dang / /khu ba til mar bzhi 'gyur dang / /lo ⑦ma brgyad 'gyur bcas pa dang / /shing mngar ram nye ba'i lde gu/ /bcas par ⑧bskol ba rnar blugs dang / /bsku ⑨dang rna ba bkang ba yis sgra bcas 'on dang ⑩gzer ba 'joms/ /shing kun bong nga dkar po dang / /shu ti skyer shun sardzi ka /til mar tsha dang bcas bskol bas/ /bkang na gzer dang chu ser 'dzag /sgra bcas 'on pa sel bar byed/ /rna ba sgra dang bcas pa la/ /nyungs mar gyis ni bkang na phan/ /la phug skam pa'i ⑪dum bu yi⑫ske/ /thal ba shing kun bca' sga dang / /shu ti ru rta shu dag dang / /thang shing shi kru skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /ya bak+ṣa ra rtsabs ru tsha/ /rgyam tsha rngul tsha sardzi ka /stag pa'i tsher ma ⑫kha ru tsha/ /gla ④sgang rgun tsha bzhi 'gyur dang / /kha lung khu ba de dang 'dra/ /chu shing khu ba mnyam bskol ba'i/ /til mar bkang bas rna ba'i nad/ /g.ya' dang sgra bcas 'on pa dang / /rnag 'dzag gzer zhing srin bu can/ /shin tu gso dka' thal sman gyi/ /til mar gyis di myur du 'joms//kha dang so yi nad la'ang phan/ /de nas tshor ba med pa la/ /nye ba la ⑫ni gtar ga gdab/ / skrang zhing ⑩rnags la thos pa ni/ /mi gsal gyur la skyug 111—708

sman btang / /byis pa rgan dang yun ring du/ /lon pa'i 'on pa spang bar bya//sgra bcas rnags par gyur pa la/ /snum dang dugs byas dag par bya①/ /rna ba sbyangs nas ④de rjes la/ /rna ba sbyangs pa'i til mar dag /kha lung khu ba rgyam tsha dang ④/ /tsha dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa'ang blugs④/ /dag byas ⑤rtsub par gyur na ni/ /mar gyi nying khus dgang bar bya/ /rim 'di rna spabs gang la'ang bya/ /g.ya' dang skrang la rna rjosman sogs/ /bad kan sel bar byed pa phan—/ /skrang ⑦la tshwa dang dro bas byug /rna ba rnag 'dzag 'bu can la/ /rna ba chu 'dzag gso bar bya/ /mchog tu rna nad srin can la/ /nyungs mar dron po blugs ⑧par bya/ /rna ba'i 'bras la khong 'bras kyi/ /gso ba dang ni skyug sman gtang / /snad pa'i khong 'bras gso ba ni/ /mkhris gyur rna gzer ⑨gso bar bya/ /'brum pa thor bu sna ltar bya/ /rna ba gas pa ma smin la/ /rna ba'i khong 'bras ltar gso zhing / /nad gzhi ji bzhin las kyang bya/ /rna shal ⑩skam la rlung gzer ltar/ /rna ⑪sman bsku ba la sogs bya/ /dugs bya ⑩snyi bar gyur pa na⑫/ /rna shal ⑫til mar bskus shing mnye/ /shing mngar pi la ya'i sa bon—/ /a shwa garnya nas bcas spyobasku/ /de nas rgyas byed snum gyis ni/ /bsku ba rtag tu bsten par bya/ /nye shing a shwa ⑩garnya dang / /e raṇ+ḍa dang pa ya su⑩—/ /dzi ba ka dang 'o mar bcas/ /til mar bskol bas bsku ba ni/ / rna shal spyorgyas byed mchog yin no/ /'tsho byed sde tshan lde gu dang / /rlan can sha ni bskol ba dag /rna shal ⑪'phel zhing rgyas byed yin/ /rna shal ④rab zad bcad ⑥pas ni/ /lhag ma sbyar la gso zhing bskyed/ /de bzhin rgyud 'dra 'tsho tsam bya/ /'byar ba la yang cho ga 'di/ /gnod gyur ⑫bsel sman bsku ba 111—709

dang / /srin bu pad pas ①khrag dbyung bya/ /'dzam bu a phra'i lo ma dang / /ba la shing mngar seng phrom til/ /btsod dang ut+pal ka dam pa②/ /thal tres til mar bcas pa dang / /sgyur rtsa bas bcas par ①bskol ba 'di/ /til mar bsku bar bubya ba dang / /me dbal skabs bshad mar gyis bsku/ /mnye ba go ta karka ta/ /zhag dang bcas pa'i til mar dang ④/ /ta la'i lo ma arka dang / /a shwa gan+dha bye'u rug pa/ /so ma ra dza 'bras bu dang / /rgyam tsha lang ④ka lir bcas bskol/ /til mar bsku ④bar bya ba dang / /rna ⑧sman rnon po gtang bar bya/ /dbug nyes pa la a sman ta⑨/ /'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma ni/ /bskol ba'i khu ba blugs ⑩par bya/ / rna shal ⑩til mar gyis bsku zhing / /shing mngar btsod dang stag tsher ba/ /yung ba'i phye ma zhib bo ⑫gdab//rgya skyegs bye dang ga ⑫bskol ba'i/ /til mar gyis ni bskus na phan/ /srin bus zos la ba'i ④lci bas/ /lan mang du ni dugs byas la/ / bye dang ga ⑫yi snying po ni/ /lug gi gcin sbyar lde gus bsku/ /dug mo nyung dang ing gu dang / / e raṇ+ḍa ⑩yi sa bon dang / /dong ga'i shun pa lde gus bsku/ /yang na de dag ⑩nim pa yi/ /lo ma na spyole sham dang bcas/ /sbrang rtsi'i lde gus rma la bsku/ /rna ba chad la sbyang byas te/ /skyon med khrag dang de 'tsham pa'i/ /bcing ba dag gis sbyar bar bya/ /sbyar nas 'phral ⑪bcad sbyang bar bya/ /de nas skra mthar mdud byas te/ /rna shal ( ste bcad dang zhal zhal bya( me/ /bcad pa dang ni bsrung bar bya/ /mtshams ni mnyam par sbyar bya zhing / /mthon dman med ⑫pa nyid du bya/ /zhun mar dang ni sbrang rtsis byug /ras bal gyis ni glan pa dang / /skud pas ⑫dam lhod ran par bcing / /rma yi khrag ni bcad pa yi/ /111—710

byed byedasman gyi phye mas 6 gdab bya zhing / /spyod pa de la bsten par bya/ /zhag bdun nas ni ma btsos pa'i/ /til mar bskus la ras bal dgrol/ /legs 'byor spu ni skyes pa dang / /mtshams 'byor — mnyam zhing brtan pa dang / /tshad ldan nad ni med pa dang / /rim gyis rna ba skyed par byed / /nya lcibs kha sral phre'u dang / /pri (5ha ti 'bras ser po gnyis/ /ba la ha ti pi pi ling /a shwa garnya nyungs kar ser/ /ko sha ta ka'i rtsa ba dang / /ka ra bī (6ne+er ru shi ga /lo ma bdun pa bil beb la/ /sa nag sbrang ma'i gnas dang ni/ /bye'u chu skyes srin bu'i sha /de bzhin seng phrom sdong bu rnams/ /'di dag lde gu til mar 8bcas—/ /ma he'i mar dang glang po rta'i/ /gcin dang bcas par 9bskol ba ni/ /bskus na rna ba 'phel byed mchog /de nas na tshod ldan pa yi/ /sbyang ba byas nas rna ⑩chad gso/ /sna dang mnyam pa'i sha lpags ni/ /mkhur tshos las /1rteni bcad nas kyang / /rna ⑫dang nye ba'i sha lpags ni/ /srab mo nyid du bzhar bar bya/ /de nas ras bal bcas pa yi/ /khab kyis mkhur ba btsem par bya/sna bcad mtshon gyis bzhar nas ni/ /mkhur tshos las (debacad pags pa yis/sa//sna ni lags mor lebatsem par bya/ /kha yi dbugs ni dbyung ba'i phyiral / /snar ni sbu gu can gzhug bya/ /de rjes til mar slon par 1 bsku/ /rma ni khya sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bsku/ /khrag bcad pa yi sman gzhan yang / /zhib tu btags pa'i phye mas gdab/ /de nas mar dang sbrang rtsis 1‘bsku/ /bcings la spyod pa bstan ḍa )par bya/ /de nas gnas skabs shes byas nas/ /rma gsar gso ba'i cho ga bya/ /rma 'byor sna yi nye 'khor gyi/ /sha lhag legs par gcad par bya/ /de nas shin tu zhib tu btsem/ /dma' ba dag kyang bskyed par bya/ /111 71 1

bcad ma thag la ci rigs par/ /bzhag ste cho ga 'di nyid bya/ /mchu bcad pa la sbu gu dag /ma gtogs sna sbyar ①bzhin du bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ②bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas sna nad kyi dmigs shes pa bshad ①par bya'o/ /ba dumo rlung dang rdul dang ni/ /smra drags gnyid log gnyid yar drags/ /sngas ni mtho dang ⑤dma' drags dang / /chu gzhan 'thungs par gyur pa dang / /chu mang 'thungs dang nyal po dang / / skyugs dang mchi bum bkag pa yis/ /rlung shas che ba'i nad 'khrugs nas/ /sna ni sra ⑦ba nyid 'gyur zhing / /cham pa skyed par byed pa yin/ /'phel na zad pa skyed par byed/ /de la rlung gyur ⑧cham pa ni/ /kha skam dz+red pa drag tu 'byung / /sna 'gags zug cing na ba dang / /mur ⑨'gram so dang klad pa dang / /smin ma nas ni sna rtse'i bar/ /srin bu rgyu ba snyam du sems/ /skad 'gags ⑩ring nas smin pa dang / /mchil snabs grang bar 'dzag pa yin/ /mkhris gyur skom dad rims kyis 'debs/ /mgo 'khor sna nang 'brum pa 'byung / /sna rtse gnag cing dro la rtsub/ /mchil snabs dmar ser 'dzag pa yin/ /bad kan lud pa dbugs mi bde/ /slon zhing lus lci yi ga 'chus/ /kha mngar bro zhing g.ya' ba dang / /mchil snabs snum dkar ska ba 'dzag /'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /rgyu med 'phel dang 'grib par byed/ /nad khrag sna yi rtsar zhugs nas⑪/ /cham pas 'debs par byed 'gyur ba/ /brang na tshor ba med ⑫pa dang / /mig dmar dbugs kyi dri mi zhim/ /mig dang rna ba sna g.ya' zhing / /'di ni mkhris gyur 111—712

mtshan nyid ldan/ /cham pa thams cad ma gsos na①/ /gnod pa mi bzad skyed byed 'gyur/ /ji skad bshad pa'i bla brnan ④ni/ /'phel bas dbang po kun gnod byed/ /me drod nyams nyes ①dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa brang dang rtsib logs zug /glo bur du ni shas cher 'khrugs/ /kha dri nga zhing skam par byed—/ /sna nang 'drul zhing skam pa dang / /yang yang sna ④'gags dag par byedaske/ /snabs ni rnag 'dra dkar zhing dmar/ /dud bupa can ni 'dzag par 'gyur—/ /'di la srin bu snum zhing ring / /dkar zhing phra ba 'byung bar du'agyur—/ /de smin mtshan ma lus yang zhing / /sprid pa zhi bar gyur pa dang / /snabs ni spyin zhing ser ba dang / /dri dang ④ro ni tshor ba yin/ /snar ni rnon po brngubs ⑧pa dang / /nyi 'od skud pa rtsa sogs dang / /rlung 'khrugs byed pa gzhan gyis kyang / /sna yi mtshul par zhugs gyur pas/ /bskyod de rlung ni 'khrugs gyur pa/ /sum mdor zhugs 'gyur ⑨'gags nas ni/ /ldog ⑩nas mi bzad dz+red pa ni/ /snabs 'dzag bcas par ⑪skyed par byed/ /sna yi bu ga skem byed cing / /rlung gis ⑫bad kan skyed par byed/ /sna nang gra mas gang snyam sems/ /dbugs 'byung dka' bar gyur pa de/ /sna skams pa zhes bya bar bshad/ /sna rgyas pa ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /sna ni bkag pa 'drar sems shing / /rlung gis 'gag par ⑫byed par 'gyur/ /dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub 'gags pa las/ /bu ga gdangs pa lta bu yin/ /mkhris pas ⑫sna khung rnags gyur pa/ /sha lpags tsha zhing gzer dang bcas/ /de ni sna yi shu bar bshadaske/ /bad kan las gyur chu ser ni/ / chu 'dra rgyun du ⑫'dzag pa dang / /mchog tu mtshan 'dzag de ⑩ming can/ /bad kan 'phel bas sna khung du/ /bu 111—713

ga 'gags shing cham pa skyed/ /dbugs ni ngar ngar por ①'byin zhing / /cham pa las kyang nad tshabs che/ /sna las lug ltar rnag ②'dzag cing / /rgyun du spyin bag ser po dang / /smin ma'i rnag ni 'jag 'gyur zhing / /de yi sna ni snabs bcas ④yin/ /khrag gi rjosna ni tshig snyam sems/ /phyi dang nang du reg mi bzod/ /du ba lta bu'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /bsregs ⑤'dra de ni 'bar ba yin/ /rkan gyi phugs su nad 'khrugs pas/ /rlung ni kha dang sna nas 'byung / /mchil snabs dri nga 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de ni sna nad rul pa yinaske/ /'dus pa'am snad pa las gyur pa'i/ /rnag rjodang khrag ni sna nas ⑦'dzag /mgo bo tsha zhing na byed pa/ /de ni rnag khrag can zhes bshad/ /rlung gis mkhris pa bad kan dag /sna ni skams par gyur pa las/ bad kan skams te gong por gyur④/ /de ni bsgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /'brum bu thor bu nad gzhi yi/ /mtshan nyid ci 'dra dag las dbye/ /kun las dbugs 'byung dka' ba dang / /rgyun du chu 'dzag sprid pa 'byung / /sna 'gags lta bur smra ba dang / /sna nas rnag 'dzag klad pa na/ /de ltar rnam pa bco brgyad las/ /cham pa ma rungs 'tsho ba tsam/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas sna nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /sna nad kun las ⑨dang por ni//rlung med khang par 'dug nas ni/ /snum chos dugs dang skyug sman dang / /dud pa brngub dang mkhur bkang bsten/ /gos ni lci zhing dro ba bgo /mgo bo shin tu mthug pas dkri/ /kha zas yang skyur lan tshwa snum/ /dro ba dang ni 111—714

bska ba bza'/ /bu ram 'o ma skam sa'i sha /lan tshwa tsha ba gsum shas che/ /nas dang gro ni mang po dang sti/ /zho dang se ④'bru'i khu ba bsten/ /la phug gzhon nu'i khu ba dang / /ku lat+tha yi khu ba'ang bsngags/ /rtsa ④bcu'i khu ba dudro 'jam mam/ /chang snying rjodwangs ma blud par bya/ / tsa rong a ldi man+d+ra dang rjo/ /shu dag zi ra go snyod snom⑦/ /bal bu'i lo ma tsha ba gsum/ /dbyi mo ⑧da trig star bu dang / /zi ra tsi tra srang gnyis gnyis/ /shing tsha garnya bha dra ⑨dang //sug smel zho ni gnyis gnyis dang / /bu ram rnying pa srang lnga bcu/ /bskol te ri lur byas pa ni/ /zos na cham pa dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa lu ba 'joms byed cingalge/ /skad snyan yi ga 'byed mchog yin/ /shu ti'i ⑩shun pa ba la dang / /so na ka dang e raṇ+ḍa/ /bil ba'i rtsa ba dong grar ⑫bcas/ /zhag mar spra tshil dud pa brngub/ /yang na phye dang mar dang bcas/ /kham phor sbyar ba'i nang du bcug /bsregs pa'i dud pa brngub par byaspyo/ /khrus dang mya ngan khro ba dang / /shas cher gnyid log chu grang spang / /rlung gyur cham pa rlung 'joms pa'iske/ /sman ni bskol ba'i khu ba 'am/ /lan tshwa lnga ni bskol ba 'am bi da ri sogs sde bskol blud/ /dugs dang sna sman la sogs bya/ /gzhogs byed nar bshad gso ba'ang bya/ /khrag mkhyes las gyur thug pa ni/ /mar sar mngar ba'i sman bskol blud/ /sman chu blugs shing byug pa dang / /nus bsil grang mo dag gis bya/ /da ba'i shun pa 'bras bu gsum/ /shi ri paṇi ④pri yad+ku//shing mngar seng phrom til mar kyi/ /bcu 'gyur 'o ma skyer par ⑫bcas/ /bskol ba'i sna sman gtang bar bya/ /bad kan las gyur sgyung ba dang / /yungs kar lde gus mgo bsku 'am/ /thal sman bcas pa'i mar blud de/ /111—715

slon gzhug rgyam tsha tsha ba gsum/ / byi dong ga ①dang dug go nyung / /zi ra ra gcin sbyar ba yi/ /sna sman dag ni gtong bar bya/ /'dus gyur tsha dang rno sbyar ba'i/ /mar gyi sna sman blugs ②pas gso/ /gcong chen srin gso'i rim gyis 1ni/ /cham pa ma rung dhi'atsho tsam bya/ /tsha ba gsum dang e raṇ+ḍa/ /thang shing ru rta byi dong ga⑤ /bong nga dkar po ing gu dang / /dur byed par ta ka'i sa bon/ /nyungs kar nye'u 'phral rus pa dhidang / /aghi man+d+ra'i ⑦me tog dang / /pi lu shi kru'i sa bon dang / /rta sbangs khu ba gcin dang ni/ /glang po'i gcin dang gcig tu sbyar/ /zar ma'i skud dkris reng bu yi/ /dud pa kha dang sna nas brngub/ /smin dang dz+red pa 'byung zhes pa④/ /sna sman rnon po bud pas ⑨phan/ /bca' sga ru rta pi pi ling / /rgun 'brum bye dong ga'i ⑩lde gu/ /mar ram til mar bcas bskol ba'i/ /sna sman sprud pa rnags pa sel//sna skams pa la ba la'i mar⑪/ /btung sogs sha khur sbyar ba bza'/ /snum gyi dud pa dugs kyis gso/ /sna rgyas la yang cho ga 'di'o/ /sna rnags 'bar la mkhris 'joms sman/ /chu 'dzag sna sman sogs rnos bya/ /rnags ⑫can la ni bad kan gyi/ /gso ba dang ni 'dra bar bya/ /rgya skyegs dang ni ka radzi/ /na le sham dang byi dang ga⑫ /shing kun bu ram pi pi ling / /lug thug gcin sbyar sna sman ni/ /slon byas 'og tu gtang bar bya/ /shi kru dan+da bri ha ti/ /tsha ba gsum dang lce myang tsha/ /bye'u ⑫rug pa dang bye dang gaspyo /til mar bskol ba'i sna sman yang / /btang na mchog tu phan pa yin/ /rnag dang khrag can sar pa ni/ /khrag gi cham pa lta bur gso/ /shin tu 'phel la rma 'khyims ltar—/ /'brum bu rmen bu tsha ba la/ /dan ti dur byid lce myang tsha/ /ldong 111—716

—ros dang ni pi pi ling / /tsi tra ka yi sde gu ni/ /mar dang sbrang rtsir (1 sbyar ba yiske/ /reng bu snar ni gzhug par bya/ /shi kru la sogs sna sman yang / /rnag can gso ba'i skabs su bshad/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu pa'o// //de nas kha nad kyi dmigs shes pa bshad par bya'o/ /nya dang ma he phag gi ni/ /sha dang la phug rjen pa dang / /ma sha'i sran tshod 'o ma zho/ /tsha dang bu ram shing kun (gedang / /'brum phran kha sbubs lanyal bsten dang / /so shing gis snad goms pa spong )/ /dud pa mkhur bkang sgyugs 5)pa dang / /gtar ga dbug buni nyes pa yi( // /bad kan shas che'i nad 'khrugs pas/// /kha yi nang gi nad skyed 'gyur/ /de la rlung gis mchu gas sgo9)'gyur/ /mchu ral ba yi nad ces bshad/ /rlung gis mchu la gnod gyur pal/ /mchu sra nad tshabs che ba yin/ /mchu gas rdol ( (bar 'gyur ba dang / /gnag cing rtsub pa mchu 'khrugs yin/ /mkhris pa tsha ba mi bzod ser/ /'brum phran nyungs kar 'dra bas khyab/ /myur smin mang du rnags pa yin/ /bad kan las gyur grang ba yisa.e /mi bzod lci zhing skrang ⑫pa dang / /'brum phran dkar pos khyab pa yin/ /'dus gyur sna tshogs par snang zhing / /dri nga'i spyi pibag 'dzag pa dang / /glo bur shas cher skrang zhing 7zhum/ /na dang mi na rnag mi snyoms/ /khrag las gyur pa khrag 'dzag cing / /khrag gi mdog dang 'dra ba dang / /'di la 'bra go lta bu yi.a/ /khrag zad chu bur 'byung ba yin/ /sha gyur sha yi gong po 'dra/ / rim gyis 7srin bu skye zhing 'gul/ /tshil gyur g.ya' zhing 'drul 18ba dang / ///1 717

skrang ①'jam til mar lta bur 'dzag /snad pa las gyur gas pa dang / /yang dang yang du 'bye 'gyur la/ /slar yang 'drub par 'gyur ba ②dang / /mchu ni ①g.ya' bar byed pa yin/ /rlung dang bad kan 'dres pa las/ /chu yi chu bur lta bur 'byung / /mkhur ba'i 'bras 'byed skrang zhing rjobartan/ /mkhur ba tsha zhing rims dang bcas/ /rlung gyur ①so nad dro la sred/ /grang bas reg na lhag par na/ /gzer zhing bcag rjopa snyam du sems/ /grang bas zhig par de bshad do/ /rlung dang chu yis so brtse ⑦ba/ /grang dang skyur ba sgemi bzod par/ /sgyur ba zos pa nyid kyis 'gyur/ /nad bcas 'gul bar byed pa yin/ /so gas so ni zegs pa dang / /na zhing zug la g.yo ba yin/ /so 'gul so ni g.yo ba dang / /za ba'i tshe na lhag par na/ /so sto so ni mi sdug par—/ /so rnams skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /so lhag so ni skyes pa ste/ /de ni 'phel ba zhes kyang bshad/ /skye bar 'gyur ba'i ⑨tshe na ni/ /na zhing skyes nas ⑫de zhi byed/ /ma bkrus so yi dri ma 'am/ /bad kan rlung gis skams pa las—/ /dri nga brtan gyur ⑪so dreg yin/ /de ni yal bar bor ba las so ni dum bur zegs gyur pa/ /grugs shing so ni gogs pa yin/ /khrag dang mkhris pa rlung gis so/ /sngon por gyur pa so sngon yin/ /nad kyi ⑩rlung ni shas cher 'a gyur—/ /rtsa bar bcas pa'i so la brtan⑫/ /so dbus skams te stong ⑫par byasaske/ /so ⑫ni zas kyi dri mas gang / /rul bas srin bu phra mo ni/ /skye bar 'gyur thonyete de 'og tu/ /rgyu med brnag dka' thorteldang dub can/ /sbom che gnag la shas cher na/ /bcad pa 'drar snang rnag khrag 'dzag /de ni so srin can zhes bya/ /bad kan dang ni khrag gis rnyil/ /rnags ⑫shing rul bar 111—718

'gyur ba dang / /mnyen la ①zags shing gnag ②pa de/ /grang bas nyen pa yin par bshad/ /khrag mkhris rnags ①pa las byung ba/ /rnyil ni tsha bar byed pa dang / /khrag gis skrangs pa mtho dhib dang / /g.ya' zhing khrag ni 'dzag pa dang / /khrag chad nas ni rgyas par 'gyur/ /so na ⑤'gul zhing nad rjotshabs chung / /kha dri mnam gyur nyer ⑦bdar yin/ /so ni gnyis sam gsum thad kar—/ /bad kan las gyur rgya shug tsam/ /skrangs pa sra zhing mi bzad na/ /myur du smin pa so 'bur yin/ /rnyil ni nad bcas khrag gis ni/ /phyi dang nang du skrang zhing ⑧lci/ /na zhing tsha la gas pa las/ /rnag khrag 'dzag so'i ⑨khong 'bras yin/ /so rtsar khrag mkhris las gyur nadaspyo/ / skrang zhing nad ⑫dang bcas pa dang / /kha chu 'dzag cing rnyil 'drul ba/ /khong stong gi ni nad ces bya—/ /'dus pa las gyur rims ⑫dang bcas/ /rnag dang bcas pa'i khrag 'dzag la/ /so yi dz+rel mtshams zhig ⑫pa ni/ /khong stong chen po zhes bshad do//bad kan gyis ni so yi mthar/ /sha mdzer ltar skrang ④'gram pa dang / /rna ba na byed spyod lam nyams/ /de ni sha lhag ces byar bshad/ /rnyil ni bdar bar gyur pa las/ /nad tshabs chen por 'byung 'gyur ⑫zhing / /gang zhig so ni 'gul gyur pa/ /de ni snad pa ⑩las byung yin/ /rnyil la brten ⑩par byed pa'i nad/ /gsor ⑫rung yal bar bor ba gang / /nang du de ni nad 'dzag pas—/ /des ⑩ni rgyun lam phra ba skyed/ /de ni yang yang rnag 'dzag cing / /pags pa sha dang rus pa 'bigs/ /de yang rang rang mtshan nyid ni/ /ji skad bshad pas lngar ⑥shes bya/ /lce ni sha kha'i lo ltar rtsub/ /tshor ba med gas rlung gnod yin/ /mkhris pas tsha zhing nad bcas 'gyur/ /mdzer pa 111—719

dmar pos khyab pa yin/ /bad kan las gyur shal ma li'i/ /tsher mas khyab gyur ①lci zhing mthug /bad kan mkhris pas 'og tu skrang / /mtho ②zhing gyong bar byed pa dang / /smin na ①nya yi dri 'dra la/ /sha 'drul chu ser can zhes bya/ /lce rtsa'i 'og dang 'brel pa ni/ /skrang zhing lce yi rtse mo 'dra/ /mdzer pa byung ④zhing kha chu 'dzag /lce ni rengs shing rtsub pa dang / /g.ya' dang nad bcas tshig mi thon/ /za bar mi nus lce lhag yin/ /de dang 'dra bar lce steng na/ /gnas pa'i nye ba'i lce zhes bya/ /rlung 'khrugs pa ni rkan gyi shararka/ /'brum phran sra zhing nad bcas 'gyur/ /mang zhing mthug la 'dzag par bcas/ /rkan gyi 'brum phran zhes de bshad/ /bad kan khrag gis rkan phugs su/ /nya yi be+eng pa 'dra zhing 'jam/ /'phyang ⑤zhing skrangs la spyi 0bag can—/ /kha zas sna nas 'byung bar byed/ /skog 'gags skom dang lud pa dang / /slon byed skog ma'i sha lhag yin/ /rkan gyi dbus ⑦su nad med sha /'dus pa rkan 'dus zhes bya'o/ /rkan gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dra/ /khrag las skyes pa chu bur yin/ /bad kan 'khrugs pas ring nas 'phel/ /nad med rus sbal 'dra zhes bya/ /bad kan tshil gyis rgya sran 'dra/ /nad med brtan pa 'bur ba yin/ /mkhris pas ⑧rnags pa smin zhes bya/ /rnag 'dzag nad dkyel che ba yin/ /rlung mkhris las gyur tsha nyon mongs/ /rkan skam de yi ming can yin/ /lce dang 'brel pa lkog ma'i nad/ /sha yi myu gu myur 'phel zhing / /mi bzad lam ni 'gog byed pa⑨/ /myur gsod byed pa gag pa yin/ /de ni rlung gyur ⑩ sgog ma kha/ /skam byed 'gram pa rna ⑪nad skyed/ /mkhris pas rims skom rmongs bag can/ /sgog 'gags dud pas bdugs snyam sems/ /111—720

—— — — — ————— — — —— ——— — — — ——myur smin myur du 'phel ba dang / /dmar zhing reg na mi bzod 1byed/ /bad kan gyis dkar 'byar bag can/ /khrag gyur 'brum bus khyab pa dang / /me mdag 'dra zhing rna 5nad skyed/ /mkhris pa las gyur mtshan nyid mtshungs/ /'dus gyur rnag /phugs gting ring zhing / /mtshan ma kun dang ldan pa yin/ /bad kan shas cher skrangs pa dang / /rmen bu rgya shug 'dra zhing mtho/ /gra ma tsher mas gang snyam byed/ /lam 'gag 5byed pa rtsa ba yin/ /zlum zhing mtho la tsha ba dang / /lkog ma'i ngos gnas 'dus pa yin/ /'gram pa'i mtshams nas mgul ba'i nad/ /ras bal sa bon lta bur zlum/ / spyi bag nad tshabs chung bar skrang / /sra ba mchu rtse can zhes bya/ /phyi dang nang du mi bzad skrang / /lkog ma'i lam gyi gtan pa 'dra/ /mgo lci sgrum dang kha chu 'dzag /rims skyed lkog mchu 'dzings pa 8 yin/ /skrangs pa shas cher mi na zhing / /chu 9zheng de 'dra gdu bu yin/ /nad kyi 7 lkog ma sha mdzer ni/ /gcig gam mang skyes 11 nad tshabs chung / /dbugs 'byin dka' zhing zas mid dka'/ /rtsa ba che ba lkog ma'i mtshon/ /sha yi mdzer pa mang pos khyab/ /rab skam 2tsha la mgo bo na/ /mdung ltar shin tu nad skyed byed/ /mdzer pas khyab pas mdung 'dra yin/ /skog ma kun ni myur khyab cing / /myur skye myur smin ngashas cher na/ /rul pa'i rnag 'dra 'dzag gyur pa/ /skrangs pa skog ma'i khong 'bras yin—/ /lce yi mtha' ma lkog ma sogs/ / skrang zhing sasmin pa med pa'i nad/ /brtan pa ( khrag gis skyed byed pa1 / /nad med lkog ma'i rmen bu yin/ /rlung dang bad kan tshil gyis ni/ /lkog ma'i phyi rol be+e ba skyes1 / /de ni 'phel bar gyur pa'i 1‘tshe/ /rlig pa ltar 'phyang na ba med/ /de ni rlung gyur — dmar 77/ 72/

——ba'am gnag /na zug rtsa ris nag por bcas/ /'phel bas skog ma kha skam zhing / /lce yis ro mi tshor bar byed/ /bad kan las lci 2reg na grang / /brtan zhing skya la g.ya' dang bcas/ /'phel na rkan dang skog mar chags/ /kha ni mngar ba bro bar byed/ /tshil gyur bad kan lta bur na4 / /de ni 'phel 'bri lus 'dar byed5/ /'phel bar byed pa'i tshe na ni/ /gog mar sgra bcas skad gsang nyams/ /bad kan gyis ni rlung rgyun bkag /shog skam 6 skad gsang nyams pa dang / /dka' bas dbugs 'byin mon 7 zhugs snyam/ /rlung las skad nyams gang yin 'gyur/ /rlung di kun tu 'gro byed pas/ /kha nang 8rma ni 'pho bar byed/ /dmar la rtsub pa skyed byed cing 9 / /mchu dmar pags pa lhod pa dang / /lce yis grang ba mi bzod phyi/ /gas shing tsher mas khyab 'drar snang / /kha mnam gdangs par 7dka' ba ni/ /kha yi shu ba zhes byar bshad/ /bad kan gzhang 'brum skran sogs kyisanya1/ /'og tu gnod par byas pa'i rlung / /gyen 'byung 12kha ni dri mi zhim/ /de ni steng gi rkub 1 ces bya / /mkhris gyur kha shu kha rnag cing 1 / /tsha na kha ni tsha /lo bro la/ /rma la lan tshwas byugs snyam sems/ /khrag las gyur pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /bad kan las gyur kha mngar bro/ /g.ya' zhing sa rma ni 'byel bag can/ /mkhur tshos nang du brten nas ni/ /'brum bu gnag cing skya ba 'byung / /de ni mnye zhing bcad pa dang / /bskyod na 'phel bar byed pa yin/ /nad ni khrag bcas gyur kha shu/ /kha shu nad ni khrag bcas 'gyur/ /'dus pa mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /de nyid so shing la sogs la/ /mi dga' kha dri mi zhim 'gyur/ /1/ mchu dang mkhur tshos so rtsa dang / /lce dang rkan dang mgul pa dang / /kha dang thams

cad dag gi ①ni/ /nad ni bdun cu rtsa dgu yin/ /bcu gcig gcig dang bcu dang ni/ /bcu gsum de bzhin ②drug dang brgyad/ / bcu gnyis bco brgyad ④dag dang ni/ /de dag go rims bzhin du sbyar/ /so sto sha dang khrag gyur dumachu/ /chu bur chu ni med pa dang / /rkan gyi rus sbal 'brum phran dang //ming ⑤khong stong stong che chung 'dzings/ /skad nyams so sngon steng gi rkub/ /mdung 'dra gdu bu chu ser can/ /'dus gyur mid pa mchu nad dang / /khrag dang 'dus gyur gag pa dang / /so gogs so ni chag pa dang / /smin pa'i nye ba'i lce dang ni/ /skog ma'i lba ba skad nyams dang / /dbugs mi thon pa lo gcig lon/ /so brtse gsang ba 'tsho ba tsam/ /lhag ma mtshon dang sman kyis gso—/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas kha nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /mchu ral ba yi mtha' brud ༷de//btsems la ⑦rma ltar gso bar bya/ /shing mngar seng phrom kra ku ⑧ni/ /thal tres ut+pal shra pa ④ni/ /mon sne'u dme ⑩ru pa to la/ /til mar bskol bas bsku bar bya/ /rlung 'joms mngar ba'i sde tshan dang / /bskol ba'i til mar sna sman gtang / /rlung gyur ⑪mchu nad sra rtsi pog /spra ⑫tshil gu gul thang shing na⑫rka/ /snum chen bskol ba'i ras bal dag /sbangs pa'i ye'us glan par bya—/ /shing mngar phye mar bcas pa dang / /de nyid kyis ni bsku bar bya/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi lo ma ni/ /'o mar bskol bas spyosbubs dugs byaspyo/ /mchu ral skabs bshad sna sman dang / /mgo bo brta ba ⑩dag kyang bya/ /mkhris pas ⑩111—723

snad pa'i mchu nad la/ /srin bu pad pas ①khrag dbyung bya④/ /seng phrom sbrang rtsi sra rtsi pog /shing mngar bcas pa'i phye ma ①gdab/ /sle tres shing mngar rma shing dang / /bskol ba'i mar gyis bskus na'ang phan/ /mkhris pa'i khong 'bras ltar yang gso/ /khrag las gyur pa sar pa la/ /de dag nyid kyis gso bar bya/ /bad kan las gyur mchu nad la/ /pa to'i dhithal ba tsha ba gsum/ /sbrang rtsi dang ni sbyar bas ⑤bsku/ /gtar ga byas nas phye ma gdab/ /bad kan 'joms par byed pa yin④/ /dud brngub ⑦sna sman mkhur bkang bya/ /tshil gyur ⑧dugs byas dbral nas ni/ /me yis nges par bsreg par bya/ /pri yang ku dang 'bras bu gsum/ /seng phrom sbrang rtsir stisbyar bas bsku/ /chu yi chu bur brtol nas sbyang / /sman rnon ⑩sbrang rtsis bsku bar bya/ /gting ring ba'am rab 'phel la/ /thang ⑪sman dag gam me btsas gso/ /mkhur ba'i chu ser smin skabs su/ /skrangs pa'i nad ltar gso bar bya/ /so grang ba la dugs byas la/ /so rtsa brud ⑫de til mar bsregs⑫/ /gla sgang rgyam tsha sbrang rtsi dang / /se'u 'bru'i shun pa 'bras bu gsum/ /skyer pa'i ④khaṇ+ḍa 'dam bu'i rkang / /bca' sga sbyar bas bsku bar bya/ /'o ma can ⑫bskol mkhur ba bkang / /e raṇ+ḍa'i mar sna sman gtang / /so brtse ⑩de bzhin bye ba la/ /rlung 'joms gso ba thams cad bya/ /til dang shing mngar sbrang rtsi ni/ /'o mar bskol ba'i mkhur bkang bcang / /so 'gul ba la rtsa ba bcu'i/ /khu ba mar bskol mkhur ba bkang / /spangs ⑩ma seng phrom pi pi ling / /'bras bu gsum dang rma shing dang / /rgyam tsha yis ni bdar bar bya/ /snum bag gis ⑫ni sna sman dang / /mkhur bkang gnas skabs ⑪ji bzhin bsten/ /so lhag skyes la ⑫111—724

thal sman gyis/ /bskus te gogs par ①gyur pa dang / /srin can so ltar phyung nas ni/ /de tshe de dang 'dra bar gso/ /khrag ni chod par ma gyur na/ /bsregs la rma ltar gso bar bya/ /so dreg chags la so rtsa la/ /gnod pa med par bsal bar bya/ /thal sman sbrang rtsir bcas pas ni/ /de yi 'og tu bsku bar bya/ / so gogs pa la'ang 'di ②nyid dang / /so brtser bshad pa'i gso ba snebya—/ /srin can so ni mi rjo'agul la/ /dugs byas nas ni khrag dbyung bya/ /snum gyis bsku zhing mkhur bkang dang / /sna sman kha zas rlung 'joms sbyin/ /khong stong bu ram spra tshil gyis/ /gang ba'i thur mas bsreg ⑤par bya/ /lo ma bdun pa arka yi/ /lo rjoms bkang na srin gzer 'joms/ /shing kun nag tshur kad pa ⑦la/ / sardzi ka dang byi dang ga⑧ /ru rta'i phye ma ras la ⑨gtums/ /sor glan zug gzer myur du 'joms/ /yang na 'di nyid bskol ba yi/ /til mar mkhur bar dgang ⑩bar bya/ /yang na bri ha ti rnam gnyis/ /bu ga dam pa e raṇ+ḍa/ /bskol ba'i khu bas ⑪mkhur ba bkang ⑫/ /de ltar gso ba mang po yisarka/ /nad ni zhi bar ma gyur na/ /skam pa phra mo dag gis sam/ /so dbyung ba yi cha sbyad kyis/ /dang po rtsa ba nas bslangs te⑫/ /gtan nas de ni dbyung bar bya/ /til mar shing mngar phyer bcas pa'am/ /sbrang rtsis de 'og mkhur bkang bya/ /de 'og shing mngar bi da ri/ /sri da ka dang ka she ru/ /til mar bcu 'gyur 'o ma dang / /bskol ba'i sna sman gtang bar bya/ /rid cing nyam ⑫chung rgan po dang / /rlung nad kyis nyen so mi dbyung / /ya so dbyung bar mi bya ste/ /de ni bla brnan ⑫mang po skyed/ /de yang 'byin na snum pa dang / /mngar dang bsil ba'i rim pas gso/ /grang bas nyen la khrug 111—725

dbyung zhing / /sbrang rtsir bcas pas ①bsku bar bya/ /gla sgang ardzu na'i shun pa—/ /pri yang ku dang skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /bca' sga sbrang rtsir sbyar ba ④bsku/ /de bskol bas ni mkhur bkang dang ①/ /mngar sman til mar bskol snar blugs④//rnyil ni nye bar bdar ba la/ /chu tshan mkhur bkang bas dugs bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'dra ba'am sha kha ⑤yi/ /lo mas mang du brud par bya/ /rgya skyegs rma shing pri yang ku/ /rgyam tsha ru rta btsag yug snam/ /na le sham dang bca' sga dang / /shing mngar skyer pa'i khaṇ+ḍa dang / /mar gyi snying po sbrang rtsi dang / /sbyar ba de 'og bsku bar bya/ /mar khu'am til mar mkhur sbo ba/ /dro 'jam de yi rjes la bya/ /mngar ba'i sde dang bskol ba'i mar/ /mkhur bkang sna sman byas na phan/ /so 'bur ba la dugs byas la/ /bcad dang dbug dang brud pyapar bya/ /shing mngar bca' sga sardzi ka /rgyam tsha'i phye ma bsku bar bya//so yi khong 'bras tsha dro rno/ /rtsub pa'i mkhur bkang bsku bar bya/ /pu tse shel dang ba spru ba/ /ru rta nas tshig 'khus ⑦phyir bdar/ /bsil sman gyis ni smin mi gzhug /smin nas ⑧dral la gting ring bsreg /khong stong bcad de brud ⑨nas ni/ /gla ⑩sgang seng phrom 'bras bu gsum/ /shu ti rma shing skyer khaṇ+ḍa//rgya skyegs shing mngar kad pha ⑪la/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bsku bar bya/ /de nyid khu bas mkhur ba bkang ⑫/ /shing mngar seng phrom drur ba ⑫dkar/ /thal tres tsan+dan a ga ru/ /ka ra dkar po btsag yug snam/ /pad+ma dkar po stag tsher ba/ /bskol ba'i til mar sna sman gtang thoste/ /sha lhag skyes pa bcad nas ni/ /shu dag te dzo ba ti dang / /pa ta nas tshig 'khus thal ba/ /sardzi ka dang sbrang rtsis ⑩bsku/ /'bras bu gsum dang pa to la/ /nim pa bskol 171—726

bas mkhur ba bkang ①/ /snad pa las byung nad la ④ni/ / dkyil 'khor rtse mo 'dra bas sbyangs⑦/ /de nas thal sman sna sman gtang / /mkhur bkang la sogs bsil sman gtang / /lus kyi gong 'og nas sbyang 0bya/ /de 'og mgo bo'i bkru sman bya/ /so yi rjortsa ni sos nas kyang / /phyung ste nad dang ldan pa yi//bu ram spra tshil bkang bas bsreg /dzā ti seng ldeng spra tshil dang / /gze ma bskol ba'i khu bas bkru/ /'o ma can shing chus mkhur bkang / /de bskol til mar sna sman gtang / /rlung gyur dhilce ni rtsub pa la/ /rlung gi dze+emachu nad gso bar bya/ /mkhris pa las gyur lce nad la/ /bzhar te khrag ni dbyung bar bya—/ /bsku dang mkhur ba bkang ba khrudang / /sna sman mngar ba dag kyang bya/ /de bzhin bad kan las gyur la/ /nyungs kar tsha ba gsum la sogs/ /sman ni rnon pos gso bar bya/ /ste las ⑨chu ser 'dzag pa gsar/ /mtshon mi reg par de bzhin gso/ /lce lhag skyes pa lce bteg ste/ /lcags kyus lce lhag drangs nas ni/ /rtse mo dkyil 'khor 'dra bas bcad/ /rno dang dro bas bdar sogs bya/ /nye ba'i lce la khrag gzags te/ /nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal bas bdar—/ /sha lhag skyes la ⑩bad kan 'joms/ /sna sman mkhur bkang bdar bar bya/ /ga gon sa bon lta bur ni/ /'phel zhing rtsa ni mi mngon dang / /rtse mos byu yi rtsa ba slebs/ /lcags kyu yis ni bzung nas kyang / /rtse mo dkyil 'khor 'dra ba yis/ /rtse mo rtsa ba ran par gcad/ /bcad drags khrag zags ⑪'chi bar byed/ /bcad chung nad ni 'phel bar byed/ /bong nga ba ta na le sham—/ /shu dag ru rta pa ri la/ /rgyam tsha sbrang rtsir ⑫bcas pa yis/ /bcad ⑫pa dag ni bdar bar bya/ /pa ri pe la kun ta ta'o/ /pu tse shel dang bong nga 111—727

dkar—/ /ba ta nim pa ra sna dang / /shu dag chu yis mkhur bkang bya/ /'dus dang so 'bur rus sbal 'dra/ /de bzhin bzhar te gso bar bya/ /rkan rnags ①ma smin pa la ni/ /nag tshur sbrang rtsi skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /bsku bar bya'o bsil ②dang mngar/ /sman bskol khu bas mkhur bkang bya①/ /smin nas na ya'i gzhi ltar dras/ / dro dang rno dhibs bsku bar bya/ /ba ⑤sha ka dang pa to la/ /nim pa la sogs rno ba yi/ /sman gyi khu bas mkhur ba dgang / /rkan skam skom dad gdung med padhi/ /zas zos rjes la zhun mar ni/ /bca' sga pi pi ling bskol blud—/ /skyur bas mkhur ba spo ba bcang ⑦/ /skam sa'i sha khu snum pa dang / /zhun mar 'o ma'i sna sman gtang / /lkog ma'i nad la gtar ga gdab/ /sna ⑧sman la sogs rnon po bya/ /skyer pa'i shun pa skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /dug mo nyung bskol khu ba blud/ /a ru ra yi khu ba ni/ /sbrang rtsir ldan pa sbyin par bya/ /'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ /nas tshig 'khus thal skyer ⑨pa dang / /tsi tra ka dang skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /pa ta te dzo ba ti dang / /nim pa tsha dang ra gcin bskol/ /mkhur ba sbo dang ri lu dang / /phye ma gdab pa dag kyang bya/ /lcang ma gi ri kaṇi ⑫dang / /gla sgang thang shing bca' sga dang / /shu dag dan da mur ba yi/ /lde gu dro bskus skrangs nad sel/ /de nas phyi nang dugs byas te/ / sor gdub ⑩cha spyad dag gis sam/ /rgyam tsha ldan pa'i sen mo yis/ /rlung gyur ⑫gag pa bzhar bar bya/ /rtsa ba lnga bskol mkhur bkang dang / /til mar mkhur sbo sna sman gtang / /mkhris pa las gyur gtar ga gdab/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi pri yang ku/ /seng phrom rma shing bcas pa bdar/ /de bskol khu ba mkhur bar bcang / /rgun 'brum pa ru sha ka bskol/ /mkhur ba bkang ba'ang phan 111—728

pa yin/ /khrag las gyur pa'ang de bzhin du/ /gtar ga gdab ste gso bar bya//bad kan las gyur khang pa ①yi/ /dud pa tsha ba'i sman bcas gdab/ /a pa marga'i 'bras bu dang / /gi ri kaṇi byi dang ga② /rgyam tsha tsan+dan til mar bskol / /sna sman mkhur bkang bya ba bsngags/ /de bzhin ④'dus dang rtsa ba dang / /mchu rtse skog ma'i mtshon la'ang bya/ /khong 'bras khrag gzags 'bras bu gsum/ /gi wang yug snam skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /seng phrom rgyam tsha rma shing dang / /pi pi ling bsku mkhur bkang bya/ /rlung las gyur pa'i be+e ba la/ /dugs byas nas ni khrag dbyung zhing / /til dang zar ma leb rgan rtsi/ /pi la ya dang btsod du'abras kyis/ /rma 'drub nas bskus ⑤dkri bar bya/ /shi kru seng phrom tar ka ri/ /tang rjopal ha ti pi pi ling / /ba spru ba dang a ru ra/ /arka'i ⑦rtsa ba po son cha/ /e kai ṣi ⑧kar bcas pa ⑨ni/ /chang ngam rang skyur ⑩btags pas bsku/ /lde gus ⑪yang dang yang du bsku/ /sle tres nim pa dug mo nyung / /han ⑫sa pa ti ba la gnyis/ /thang shing dang ni pi pi ling / /bskol ba'i til mar blud par bya/ /bad kan la yang 'di dag ni/ /bya zhing lhag par dugs bsku bya/ /a za ⑫garnya bong ④nga dkar/ /a za ⑫shing gi bi sha l+ya/ /ku ⑩ba kha bo 'ol ma se/ /shi ri sha dang rgya skyegs shing / /thal chu'i lde gus bsku bar bya/ /thal ba drag ⑩po gcin bskol btsags/ /khre rgod za zhing btung bar bya/ /dug mo nyung sogs lan tshwa lnga/ /til mar lhan cig bskol ba blud/ /bad kan 'joms pa'i dud pa dang / /slon sman sna sman la sogs bstenaspyoske/ /tshil gyur pa la gtar ga gdab/ /bad kan 'joms pa'i cho ga bsten| /'di la a sa la sogs pa'i/ /khu ba gcin ni snga dro blud/ /des ⑪111—729

ma zhi na thams cad ni/ /smin byas rma ltar gso bar bya/ /kha shu la ni 'bras bu gsum/ /pa ta rgun 'brum dzā ti yi/ /'o ①mar bskol ba'i sbrang rtsir bcas//kha ni bsku zhing bcang bar bya/ /yang na zin thig la ①sogs sde/ /bza' zhing bsten pa nyid du bya/ /rlung gi kha shur pi pi ling / /rgyam tsha sug grel phye ma gdab/ /yang na rlung 'joms sman bskol ba'i/ /til mar sna sman mkhur bkang phan/ /khrag mkhris gyur la khrag mkhris 'joms/ /bad kan las gyur de 'joms bsten/ /'brum phran sra zhing brtan pa la/ /sha kha'i lo ma sogs kyis bzhar/ /'dus pa las gyur gso ba ni/ /nad gzhi ji bzhin shas cher bya//chu bur gsar zhing ma 'phel ba/ /bcad la sardzi ka'i thal ba/ /bca' sga sbrang rtsi ①gdab par bya/ /de bskol mkhur ba bkang bar bya/ /sle tres nim pa'i rjolde gu ni/ /sbrang rtsi til mar bcas pa'ang rung / /nas zan za zhing til mar rnos/ /sna sman dang ni bsku dubyug bya/ /kha dri nga la slon sman dang / /dud pa sna sman rnon po gtang / /btsod dang seng phrom da ta rjoki/ /shug pa bri yang ku yi chus/ /kha yi nang ni bkru ④ba dang / /phye mas kha ni dag par ⑧bya/ /grang nyen nye bar bdar bshad pa'i/ /sna sman la sogs bsten par bya/ /'bras bu gsum dang rtsa mkhris tsi ⑨tra ka /shing mngar nyungs kar gla sgang tsha ba gsum/ /ya bak+ṣa ra ser po rnam gnyis dang / /da trig tsan+dan lcang ma star bu dang / /a shwat+tha dang 'dzam bu'i myu gu dang / /da nan ⑫dza ya ka ra bī ⑪ra'i shun—/ /seng ldeng snying po bskol te ska bar gyur⑫/ /de yi phye ma ⑫btab ste ri lu bya/ /de ni kha nang rtag tu bzhag gyur na/ /mchu dang rkan sogs nad ni mi bzad 'joms/ /mchog tu kha skams pa dang gag pa dang / /ro mi tshor sel 111—730
