lus 'phags bdag pos bshad/ /seng ldeng srang brgya chu bye bcu drug bskol/ /khya ba de dang tsan+dan a ga ru/ /gur gum pa la pa ri pe la dang / /thang shing seng phrom rgun 'brum pu shel tsi/ /btsod dang tso ①tsa shug pa byi dang ga④ /pri ka rgya spos kad pal chu srin sder①/ /sug smel dhe dhim ka dang rma shing bcas/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis til mar bre gang bskol/ /de ni btung dang sna sman mkhur bkang bya⑤/ /kha yi nad kun 'joms byed bya rgod ltar/ /mig gsal rna ba phag 'drar gsang bar byed/ /tsa kra mar da buskyer pa seng phrom gyi/ /lde gu gdong la byugs par gyur na ni/ /ngo khabs sme ba dri ma ④la sogs sel/ /zla ba lta bu'i mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /sa ha ra dza srang stong chu bre ni/ /bcu drug nang bskol brgyad cha lus pa ru/ /seng ldeng 'dzam bu shing mngar e raṇ+ḍa⑧//a mra a ti ma ra ⑨ut+pal sngo/ /zhib btags til mar bre gang nang du bskol/ /de ni kha yi nang du bcangs gyur na/ /kha yi nad kun 'joms shing khyad par du//so yi phreng ba 'gul ba brtan par byed/ /seng sdeng snying po srang ni nyis brgya dang / /a ri me da sa ni srang brgya ⑩dag /chu bre drug cu bzhi bskol bzhi cha lus—/ /btsags te slar yang ska ba'i bar du bskol/ /de nang dbyi mo ⑪rma shing ba le ka /tsan+dan rnam gnyis seng phrom stag tsher ba/ /shing mngar rgya skyegs a dza ri ⑫rnam gnyis/ /da ta ki ⑫dang kat+pa la'i 'bras bu/ /ser po rnam gnyis 'bras bu gsum dang ni/ /dri sna bzhi dang gla sgang a ru ra/ /btsod dang spang spos n+ya gro dha'i myu gu/ /shug pa btsod dang e la ba lu ka /zho ni gnyis gnyis btab ste bsgrangs pa ru/ /dzā ti pa tra dzā ④ti pha la dang / /li shi a ko la dang ka ko la/ /srang re ga pur srang bzhi gzhug par bya/ /de 111—731

las ①ri lu byas la rtag tu ni/ /khar bzhag na ni kha nad thams cad sel/ /bskol dang reng bu'i sman ni go bzlog pa/ /btags ④pa 'di yi ①til mar bskol bar bya/ /kha nad kun sel bar ni de bshad do/ /so brtan byed pa'i mchog kyang 'di nyid yin/ /ri lu 'di ni seng buldeng sbyar til mar/ /a ri me da sa dang bskol ba dag /nyin re bsten dupar byed na nad med pa'ang / /so ni nges par brtan par byed pa yin/ /rgun 'brum sle tres dzā ti'idumyu gu dang //skyer pa byi tsher 'bras bu gsum bskol ba'i⑦/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'di ni ⑧mkhur bar bcangs/ /kha yi nad du gtogs pa thams cad sel/ /skyer pa pa ta ru rta gla sgang btsod/ / yung ba ⑨seng phrom te dzo pa ti dang / /pu tse shel gyi phye ma sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /bskus na rnyil ⑩nad nyam thag g.ya' ba dang / /rnag dang 'dzag pa'i ⑪nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /khyim gyi dud pa pa tha ⑫skyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /tsha ba gsum dang nas tshig 'khus thal ba/ /tsi tra ka dang lcags phye 'bras bu gsum/ /te dzo ba ti sbrang rtsir sbyar ba ni/ /nag po khar bcangs so dang mgul nad sel/ /skyer pa'i shun pa ldong ros lce myang tsha/ /ba bla nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba'i phye/ /sbrang rtsi mar sbyar phye ma ser po can/ /khar bzhag so dang mgul ba'i nad rnams sel/ /ba gcin a ru ra bskol thim gyur pa—/ /shu ti ru rta ba li ka'i phye zos/ /nang gi kha nad phra mo yan chad ni/ /rgyal por brten na gnod pas mi tshugs bzhin/ /nang du bzhag na nad rnams sel bar byed/ /lo ma bdun pa gla sgang pu shel tse/ /a ru ra dang tig ta pa to la/ /shing mngar dong gra ⑫tsan+dan pu shel tse④/ /bskol ba 'thungs na kha yi shu ba 'joms/ /pa to la dang bca' sga 'bras bu gsum/ /bi sha l+ya ⑫dang 111—732

tig ta kyi ①ste ba/ /sle tres bskol ba sbrang rtsir bcas blud dam⑤/ /khar bzhag kha yi nad kun ma lus 'joms/ /skyer pa bskol ba'i khu ba ni/ /ska gyur ①yug snam btsag dang bcas/ /sbrang rtsir bubacas pa kha nang bzhag /shu ba rma 'khyims sel bar byed/ /nim pa shing mngar pa to la/ /ba sha ka dang dzā ti dang / /seng ldeng a ri me da sa⑤/ /'bras bu gsum po re re la'ang / /de bzhin du ni gtang bar bya/ /seng ldeng lcags phye 'bras bu gsum/ /ma ta yan ti du.ardzu na/ /a ti ma ra ⑦bskol ba ni/ /mkhur bcang kha nad ⑧so nad sel/ /kha dang so rtsa mgul nad phal cher ⑨ni/ /bad kan khrag las mang du 'byung ba yin/ /de bas nad de bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /nad khrag lan mang du ni dbyung bar bya/ /mgo dang lus kyi sgyug sman bkru ⑩sman dang / /kha dang tsha dang mkhur bkang bcang bar ⑪bya/ /de bzhin bad kan khrag ni sel ba yi⑫/ /gso ba'i nad ni phal cher bsngags pa yin/ /nas dang rtsa 'bru phub ma med byas la⑫/ /thal sman mang ④du sbangs shing sdum med bza'/ /khu ba bstan ⑫pa la sogs gang gzhan ni/ /bad kan sel bar byed pa phan pa yin / /srog ni ⑩rlung gi lam la gnas pas ⑩na/ /bag med pa yis 'gag par 'gyur ba ⑫yin/ /de bas lkog ma'i nad kyi gso ba ni/ /shin tu myur bar bya ba kho na ⑪yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas mgo bo'i nad kyi dmigs shes par bya ba bshad par bya'o/ /du ba nyi tshan kha ba dang / /chu dang rtse dang gnyid drags dang / /gnyid yar rdul 111—733

dang mdun gyi rlang ①/ /mchi ma bkag dang dus drags dang / /chu 'thungs chang 'thungs drags pa dang / /srin bus shugs ni bkag pa dang / /sngas ②dang bsku byug dril phyis la/ /mi dga' rgyun du thur du blta/ /ma goms dri dang zas gnod zos/ /mang du smras pas mgo bo yi/ /nang du nad ni skyed par byed/ /de la rlung ni 'khrugs pa las/ /mur 'gram gnyis ④su shin tu zug /'gram so phug pa snyam du sems/ /smin ma'i mtshams dang dpral ba niske/ /rtsang ba snyam sems rab tu na/ /rna bar rjosgra yis gnod par byed/ /mig ni phyung ba snyam du sems/ /mgo bo 'khor ba lta bur sems/ /tshigs rnams bye ba snyam du byed⑤/ /rtsa yi dra ba shin tu 'phar/ /mjing pa 'gram pa 'byar snyam byed/ /gsal ba rjomathong bar mi bzod cing / /sna chu 'dzag cing glo bur du/ /na ba dang ni nad gzhi byed/ /mnye zhing snum bskus dugs byas dang / /bcings pas bde bar 'gyur ba yin/ /mgo bo tsha ba'i ⑦nad ces bya//klad ⑧pa'i gzhogs phyed na ba ni/ /gzhogs phyed nad ces bya bar bshad⑨/ /zla gcig zla phyed nas ldang de⑩/ /rang nyid zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /shas cher 'phel na mig dang ni/ /rna ba dag kyang ma rung ⑪byed/ /mkhris gyur mgo bo tsha ba dang / /dud pas bdugs snyam sems rims 'debs/ /rngul zhing mig tsha brgyal ba dang / /mtshan mo grang bas rtse 'jil 'gyur/ /bad kan las gyur yi ga 'chus/ /mgo lci tshor ba med cing grang / /rtsa mi 'phar zhing sgyid snyom ⑫la/ /nyin mo nad chung mtshan mo ldang / /rmya zhing mig ni skrangs pa dang //rna ba g.ya' zhing slon pa yin/ /khrag gyur ⑫mkhris pa las cher na/ /'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /'dren ma'i zas kyis spyi bo yi/ /khrag dang 111—734

sha ni 'drul byas pas/ /'dus pa'i nad ni 'khrugs 'gyur zhing / /mgo bo'i srin bu skye bar 'gyur/ /des ①ni mgo bo'i khrag 'thung zhing / /sems ni 'khrul par byed pa yi④/ /mi bzad nad ni skyed par byed/ /lud pa rims dang nyams stobs zad/ /mgo bo rtsub skrangs dbug ④snyam na/ /tsha zhing mgo 'gul rnags pa dang rjo/ thod pa rkan dang mgo bor ⑤ni/ /g.ya' zhing skem la tshor ba med/ /snabs kyi mdog ni dmar ba la/ /rna ba sgra bcas srin skyes rjond—/ /rlung shas che bas ⑦mgo 'dar zhing / /de yi ming can nad skyed byed//mkhris shas che ba'i ⑧ rlung sogs kyis/ /mur 'gram skrang zhing ⑨khrag bcas la/ /mi bzad tsha zhing na la dmar/ /glal zhing rims 'debs skom mgo 'khor/ /kha nang kha bro gdong ser zhing / /myur du gsod byed mur 'gram can/ /zhag gsum nas ni srog 'joms shing / /myur du gso ⑪na 'tsho ba yin/ /rlung mkhris rjes 'brel ⑩mur 'gram mig /smin ma dpral ba na ba dang / /'phar bar byed pa skyed par byed⑫/ /nyi ma 'char bar gyur pa nas/ /nyi ma phyed kyi bar du 'phel/ /de phan chad ni bde bar 'gyur/ /ltogs na de ni lhag par na—/ /grang dang dro la nges ⑫pa med/ /de ni nyi ma 'khor zhes bya/ /de ltar mgo bor gtogs pa'i nad/ /rnam pa bcur ni bshad pa yin/ /gzhan yang ⑫thod pa la brten nad/ /dgu po mgo bo bzhin bshad bya/ /klad pa rlung ni spyo'akhrugs gyur pa/ /nang na gnas pa'ang nad skyed byed/ /mdog gnag ⑩nad chung skrangs pa yin/ /de ni nye ba'i mgo zhes bya/ /'brum phran thor bu khong 'bras ni/ /nad gzhi ji bzhin brjod par bya/ /thod par ljan ljin mang po dang / /khrag dang mkhris pa'i 'bu las spyoni/ /khre dang nyungs kar lta bur 111—735

'byung / /'brum phran srin gyi nad skyed 'gyur/ /rlung dang mkhris pa ①'khrugs pa las/ /pags pa rtsub cing gas pa dang / /g.ya' zhing skra 'byi tshor ba med//gyur pa mi bzad yin zhes bya/ /mkhris pa rlung dang 'dres pa ni/ /ba spu'i nang du zhugs gyur pa/ /skra ni 'byi bar byed pa yin/ /de nas bad kan khrag bcas pas/ /ba spu'i bu ga 'gag ④byed de/ /de yis gzhan dag mi 'byung ba//'khor leng skra 'byi zhes bya ste/ /gzhan dag skra 'byi zhes byar 'dod/ /spyi cer skye ba'ang de bzhin du/ /skra 'byi de la rim gyis 'byung / /de ni rlung gyur ①mes tshig 'dra/ /mkhris gyur rlan can rtsa yis khyab/ /bad kan pags pa'i mdog dkar mthug /pags pa rang gi ji bzhin snang / /'dus gyur ④mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /sen mo'i mdog 'dra gsor mi rung / /mes bsregs lta bur spu med gang / /tsha bcas de yang gsor mi rung / /mya ngan khro dang ngal las byung / /lus kyi drod ni mgor zhugs pas/ /nad des skra ni btsos nas ni/ /de la skra dkar skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni rlung gyur yid tsam ⑤gnag /sra zhing rtsub la chu mdog can/ /mkhris pa tsha zhing mdog ser yin//bad kan las gyur snum zhing 'phel/ /sbom zhing mdog ni dkar ba yin/ /'dus gyur mtshan ma 'dren ma yin/ /mgo bo'i nad las byung ba gzhan/ /mdog ngan reg na mi bzod yin/ /'dus pa las ni gyur pa yi/ /spyi cer skra dkar gsor mi rung / /lus kyi 'gyur ba las byung ba/ /bcud kyis rjolen gyis gso bar bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //111—736

——— —de nas mgo bo'i nad gso ba'i le'u rtabashad par bya'o/ /rlung las gyur pa'i mgo nad la/ /rlung nad gso ba'i cho ga bshad/ /'di ni mtshan mo zhun mar blud/ /de rjes 'o ma dron mo blud/ /ma sha rgya sran muṅga 'ang rung / /mar dang ldan pa de bzhin sbyin/ /til mar til gyi sde gu ni/ /'o ma dang ni lhan cig blud/ /glan dang babyung ba'i 2 dugs dag ni/ /sha dang 'u su las byas phan/ /rlung 'joms rtsa ba bcu la sogs/ /bskol ba'i 'o ma snum can blud / /sna sman dud brngub snum can dang / /mgo dang rna ba brta bar bya/ /ba ra ṇa sogs sde tshan brdungs/ /'o ma chu phyed bskol ba yi/ /'o ma lus pa de bsgrangs la/ /bsrubs te snying po blangs nas ni/ /de nas mngar ba'i sde tshan bskol/ /mar gyi sna sman blugs pa bsngags/ /'dir ni 'o ma'i sde tshan bskol / /mar dang kha rar bcas pa blugs9 / /ras bal sa bon shing tsha dang / /gla sgang dzā ti kha 'bus pa/ /chu dron btags rkapa'i sna sman ni/ /mgo bo'i nad kun 'joms byed yin/ /khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur pa/ /kha ra gur gum mar bskol gtang / /ru rta rgya spos ut+pa la/ /tsan+dan mar sbyar mgo bskus phan/ /rlung shas che la 'jigs yod pas/ /gtar ga 'di la mi bya'o—/ /des ma zhi na bad rlung la/ /rnge btsa' ji skad bshad pa bya/ /gzhogs phyed na la'ang de bzhin tes/ /nad dang 'brel pa'i gso ba 1 bya /shi ri sha yi sa bon dang / /a pa marga'i rtsa ba dang / /kha ru tsha bcas sna sman gtang / /yang na sa la paṇi 7'am/ /tsha kra marda gang yang rung / /skyur khu dang sbyar lde gus 5bakhru/ /nyi ma ltar 'khor de yi tshe/ /gtar gas khrag ni dbyung bar bya/ /mkhris pa las gyur mgo nad la/ /snum chos byas nas gtar 777 737

ga gdab/ /mgo dang gdong byugs ①sman chu blugs①/ /slon khrus mas gtong bsil bar bya/ /'tsho byed dang bskol 'o ma dang / /mar ni sna sman btung ba blugs④—/ /khrag las gyur pa'ang 'di nyid bya/ /mur du'agram can la gtar ga spang / /bad kan mgo nad mar rnying dang / /snum chos ⑤byas la tsha bas slon—/ /dugs dang byug pa sna sman sogs/ /rtsub dro rno ba'i sman gyis gso/ /'dir ni smyung rjoba'ang bsngags pa yin/ /'dus pa las ni 'dren mar gso/ /srin gyur sna sman khrag blugs te/ /de yis 'bu ni brgyal bar 'gyur/ /khrag gi dri yis ra ro nas/ /kha dang sna nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas sna sman dud brngub rnos/ /de ni nye bar dbyung bar bya/ /nyungs ⑦kar nim pa ing gu dang / /pi lu'i mar dang sbyar ba yi/ / byi dang ga ⑧dang sardzi ka /dan+da shing kun ba gcin bskol/ /sna sman so sor gtang bar bya/ / byi dang ga ⑨ni ra gcin dang / /sbyar ba'i sna sman 'bu 'joms mchog /nya rul bcas pa'i sna sman dang / /dud pa dag kyang brngub par bya/ /srin bus khrag ni 'thungs pa'i phyir/ /'di la khrag ni dbyung mi bya/ /mgo 'dar rlung gi mgo nad kyi/ /gso ba me btsa' ma gtogs ⑩bya/ /nye ba'i mgo nad skyes pa yi/ /rjes dang skyes ma thag la ni/ /rlung nad kyi ni gso ba bya/ /smin nas khong 'bras gso las bya/ /'brum phran 'brum bu khong 'bras la/ /smin dang ma smin ji bzhin bya/ /srin las srin bu pad pa ⑪yis/ /gtar ga byas te nim pa'i chu—/ /blugs shing rta sbangs khu ba ni/ /lan tshwa shas cher btab pas bsku/ /nim pa pa to la'i lo ma/ / yungs mar ⑩/ bcas pa zhib btags bsku/ /ba gcin 'ba' cha rnying par sbyar/ /khyem bya'i rtug pa dag gis bsku/ /gyo mor 111—738

ru rta brngos pa dang / /til gyi phye mar bcas pa yis/ /glog ①pa bskus na g.ya' ba 'am/ /chu 'dzag tsha ④ba sel bar byed/ /ma la dzi dang tsi tra ka /ka ra bī ①ra ka rañdza/ /til mar spu gris bregs pa yi/ /rjes bskus 'khor ling du'abyi ba sel/ /des ma zhi na mgo bo yi/ /sbyang bya slon sman ⑤sogs pa byaske/ /mi bzad pa la dang por ni/ /dpral ba'i rtsa la gtar ga bya/ /mgo bo'i bkru sman sna sman gtang / /shing mngar pi la ya'i sa bon/ /ru rta ma sha nyungs kar dubacas/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gus dze+ebasku/ /rgya skyegs dong ga'i lo ma dang / /tsakra marda skyu ru ra/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bskus kyang ⑧phan//khre rgod rtsa ⑨bsregs thal ba ni/ /chu dang sbyar bas bskus na phan/ /'khor ling skra 'byi'i nad la ⑩ni/ /nye bar gtar ga gdab pa dang / /zhal zhal byas te na le sham/ /ldong ros spangs ⑪ma nag tshur bsku/ /yang na 'ba' cha'i thang shing ngam/ /'ol ma se yi 'bras bu'i rtsa/ /yang na lang ka li'i rtsa ⑩ba'am//ka ra bī ra'i ⑫khu ba 'am/ /kaṇ+ḍa kā ri'i ④khu ba ni/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pas bsku ba 'am/ /dha du spyor yi lo ma 'am/ /bse shing 'bras bu'i khu bas bsku/ /til gyi me tog gze ma dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsir ⑩bcas pa 'am/ /glang po'i so bsregs til mar bsres/ / 'khor ling ⑩'bye ba'i sman mchog yin/ /skra dkar skye la lug gi rwa'i⑫/ /snag tshas de bzhin bsgu bar bya/ /ji srid skra ni skyes ⑪kyi bar/ /chu blugs pa ni spang bar bya/ /spyi cer skra dkar gnyer ma mang ⑥/ /skra ser skyes la sbyang byas nas⑪/ /sna sman gtong 3dang mgo bkrus la| /byug pa rnams kyis ⑫gso bar bya/ /bri snyeha ti sogs til mar bskol/ /'tsho byed bskol ba'i sna sman blugs⑫/ /nim pa'i mar gyis ⑩zla ba gcig /111—739

sna sman btang ste 'o ma blud/ /shri sha e raṇ+ḍa dang rams/ / bring ga rā ①dza' khu bar sbangs/ /se'u ①lu til dang ba ru ra/ /pri yang ka ka ti'i ①sa bon/ /cha mnyam lcags la dubaskol nas ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od la skams nas ni/ /mar 'dzag pa yi sna sman gtang / /'o ma 'thungs pas skra dkar sel/ /sa ha ra dza bye'u ⑤rug pa/ /bring rjog ra dza' khu ba ni/ /bre gang til mar phul gang dang / /shing mngar srang gcig btab ste bskol/ /a sa na 'am ⑦rdo snod dam/ /lug gi rwa yi nang du gzhug /ka ra bī ⑧ra pa ya su/ /'o ma dang ni zhib btags pa//skra dkar phyung ba'i rjes bskus shing ⑨/ /sbangs na skra dkar sel bar byed/ /bi la ya dang shing mngar dang / /'tsho byed sde tshan til nag dang / /sa nag 'o ma'i lde gu yis/ /gdong bskus gnyer ma spu ser sel/ /til dang pad+ma ge sar dang / /shing mngar sbrang rtsi skyu ru ra/ /sde gu 'di yis ⑩mgo bskus na/ /skra 'phel gnag par ⑪'gyur ba yin/ /spang spos ru rta til nag dang / /thal tres ut+pal sngon po dang / /'o mar btags te sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /skra ni 'phel bar byed pa'i mchog /lcags phye bring ga ra dza ⑫dang / /'bras bu gsum dang sa nag po/ /bu ram shing khur zla gcig gzhug /skra dkar rtsad nas skyur bar byed/ /ma sha khre rgod skyur rtsabs dang / /nas thug lcags phye tsha mang btab/ /zhag gsum bzhag ste btags pa yis/ /bya dkar yang ni nag por byed/ /shing mngar tsan+dan stag tsher ba⑫/ /pi pi ling dang ut+pal dang ⑩/ /skyu ru ra khu til mar bskol/ /sna sman bsku ba byas gyur na/ /skra dkar dang ni klad ⑫pa yi/ /nad kun 'joms par byed pa yin/ / nye'u shing dzi brnyi'i ⑩khu ba / /'o ma mar dang til mar dang / /'tsho byed bskol ba'i sna sman gyis/ /111—740

——nam tshong yan chad nad kun sel/ /rma bya'i sgro mkhris rgyu ma dang / /rkang pa rtug pa chu te bor ba'i/ /sha dang ba la /5/rtsa ba bcu/ /ra sna shing mngar srang gsum gsum/ /chu bskol khu ba mar bre gang / /'o ma bre gang bcas bskol ba//mngar ba'i sman sde'i lde gu btab/ /de btung mas gtong bsku ba dang / /sna sman dag tu bsten pa yis / /nam tshong yan chad nad kun sel/ /sman 'di dag gi desde gu dang / / dzi brnyi 6/dang 'bras bu gsum/ /me da pargun 'brum dbyi mo dang / /pa ru sha ka sa mang ga /ga bra'i rtsa ba tang pal dang / /karka ta sring kha sral phre'u/ /ma hā me da /8/ta la dang / /'bra go pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang / /pad+ma'i sdong po khardzu na/ /shing mngar nye'u shing dzi (ba ka /bi da ri dang bu ram shing / /thal tres rnam gnyis bri ha ti/ /mur ba gze ma zangs rtsi ba/ /sring ga ta dang ka she ru/ /ra sna sbi /7ra lca ba dang / /sug smel zur ba ma nu dang / /ba spru ba dang cu gang dang / /ram nye ba dang byi tsher ba/ /ma du ka dang star ga dang / /a bi shu ka muñdza ka /zho ni gnyis gnyis phyer btags /31dang / /mar bre gang dang 'o ma ni/ /bzhi 'gyur dag dang bskol ba'i mar/ /'di ni rma bya chen mo ste/ /rma bya las ni yon tan lhag /lus zungs /mdabang po nyams skad 'gags/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde nyen 'joms/ /zla mtshan khu ba'i skyon la'ang phan/ /mo gsham la yang bu skyed byed/ /byi ba khyim bya ngang pa dang / /ri bong dang yang de bzhin sbyar/ /nam tshong yan chad gtogs pa'i nad/ /nyis 7brgya sum cu rtsa gcig yin/ /de dag phan tshun ma 'dres par/ /rgya cher rab tu bshad pa yin/ /drang srong rnams kyis laskyes bu'i mgo/ /rtsa ba 'og ni yal gar bshad/ /de phyir rtsa ba la gnod pa'i/ /1 11 741

nad ni ①myur du gso bar bya/ /gang la dbang po kun rten ②zhing / /gang la srog rmi gnas byed pas/ /des na yan lag dam pa yi/ /srung ④ba la ni 'bad par byarjo/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ stod ⑤gso ba'i yan lag rdzogs so// //de nas rma gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /rma ni lhan cig skyes glo bur/ /red dang ma red dbye ba gnyis/ /lus rjokyi nad gzhis skyed lhan cig /phyi rol rgyus byung ⑦glo bur ba'o/ / nad dang 'dres pa red pa yin/ /⑧de med dag pa ma ⑨red yin/ /rma red kha rgyas zhum pa dang / /shin tu sra ba'am ⑩shin tu snyi/ /shin tu mtho 'am shin tu dma'/ /shin tu grang ngam shin tu tsha/ /dmar zhing skya 'am gnag pa nyid/ /rnag ni dri mnam yongs su 'dzag /sha dang rtsa rgyus 'drul ba dang / /g.yos ⑪shing mched la rab tu na/ /g.yo zhing tsha la skrang ba ⑫dang / /g.ya' ba la sogs bla brnan spyobacas/ /yun ring du ni 'tsho ba dka'/ /rma red ⑫mtshan mar shes par bya/ /de ni khrag bcas nad bco lnga/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i rma/ /gnag cing smug ⑫dmar thal mdog dang / /thi ba'i ⑩rus pa lta bur snang / /zho ga chu 'am 'bras bkrus ⑩chu/ /'dra ba'i chu sla ⑫nyung ngu 'dzag /sha zad shas cher na zhing zug /rtsub cing tsheg tsheg tsha ba yin/ /mkhris gyur myur rnags ⑫ser ba dang / /sngo zhing ser skya'am kham par 'dug /gcin dang thal chu rgya skyegs khu⑩/ /til mar 177—742

'dra chu mang du 'dzag /rma la thal sman btab ltar na/ /dmar zhing tsha la rnags ①pa yin/ /bad kan las gyur mdog skya g.ya'/ /chu ni ska ba mang du 'dzag /rma kha sbom zhing na ba dang / /rtsa rgyus ②kyis khyab nad tshabs chung / /khrag gyur byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar/ /khrag dang bcas pa'i rnag 'dzag cing / /rta bres kyi ni dri ltar bro/ /mkhris pa'i mtshan ma dag dang ①ldan/ /gnyis sam gsum mam thams cad las/ /gyur pa'i mtshan ma 'dren ma yin/ /bye yi mdog 'dra 'jam zhing mnyen/ /rma kha smug cing 'brum phran can/ /mnyam pa ④dbus ma cung zad mtho/ /bla brnan ⑤med rma dag pa yin/ /pags pa sha dang rtsa rgyus dang / /tshigs dang rus pa nang grol gnadabu/ /brgyad po der ni rma gnas pa/ /phyi ma bzhin du gso bar ⑦dka'/ /gso sla snying stobs me drod sha/na tshod nyams stobs ldan pa'i rma/ /zlum zhing dkyus ring rim gsum pa/ /zur bzhi pa ni gang yin dang / /de bzhin dpyi rkub pho mtshan mchu/ /rgyab dang kha nang mkhur tshos ⑧byung / /gso dka' ⑨mig dang so dang ni/ /sna dang mig zur lte ba dang / /srubs ()mtshams lto ba rna ba dang / /rtsib logs mchan khung nu mar byung / /lbu ⑪ba rnag 'dzag rlung 'byung zhing / / zug rngur ⑫bcas shing stod nas 'dzag /mtshan bar rdol ⑫zhing kha nang bltas/ /de bzhin rked pa'i rus par gnas/ /mje can dug gis phog pa dang / /lus skem gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /rma ⑫steng rma ni byung ba gang / /rma de gso bar ⑫dka' ba yin/ /me dbal rims dang tshad par 'khru/ /lud pa lu dang skom dad che/ /gnyid med pa dang dbugs mi bde/ /me drod chung bar gyur pa yi//rma ni 'tshob par ⑩mi 'gyur ro/ /mgo bo'i thod pa chag gyur cing / /klad 111—743

rgyas mtshan ma snang de bzhin/ /chu ba rul zhing rtsa chad dang / /rma phugs ①ring dang srin bus zos/ /rus pa chag dang zug rngur ①bcas/ /dug bcas pa dang ma rtogs ④dang / /bcing ba nyes dang snum ches dang / /rtsub pas spu sogs bdar rjob dang / /bskyod ⑤dang khong pa ma dag dang / /'grangs dhidrags nyams smad drags pa dang / /chang 'thungs ⑦nyin par gnyid log dang / /nyal po la brten mtshan gnyid yar/ /rma ni log par gsos pa dag /gses kyang 'drub ⑧par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig nang ni thi ⑨ba'i mdog /'dra zhing rnags ⑩pa med pa dang / /brtan zhing 'brum bu rnyid ⑪bcas pa/ / 'tshob par ⑫'gyur bar de bshad do/ /de nas 'dir skrang ⑫gnas skabs su/ /gang la nye ba de las sbyang / / sbyangs pas ⑩skrangs par gyur pa dang / /rma ni myur du 'tshob par ⑫'gyur/ /skrangs pa'i skabs su rgyun du ni/ /nye bar spyod pa bsil bas gso/ /de yis nad med chu lta bur/ /mod la zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rma skrang ⑩sra bar gyur pa dang / /nad bcas mdog ni mi sdug dang //dug can la ⑩ni khyad par du/ / pad pa sogs shes spyokhrag dbyung ngo / /nad khrag bral nas ⑪mod la ni/ /skrang 0dang mdog dmar nad zhir 'gyur/ /khrag dbyung spyonas ni cung zad lus/ /reg na nus pa rab bsil ba/ /shin tu zhib par de nyid btags/ /bu ram shing khu 3'o mas sbrus/ /lan brgyar bskus ⑫pa'i mar dang bcas/ /gzhan ma skam par yang dang yang / /rjes su mthun par bskus na phan/ /byugs ④dang blugs pa de bzhin bya⑫/ /u dum bā ⑪ra n+ya gro dang / /blag sha ⑪lcang ma a shwat+tha'i⑫/ /shun pa mar dang ⑩bcas bskus na/ /skrangs pas ⑫sel ba'i mchog yin no/ /rlung shas che zhing mkhrang 111—744

ba dang / /sra zhing nad tshabs che ba dang / /khrag 'dzag pa dang rma skrang ba①/ /'di lta bu yi rma la ni/ /rlan can sha btags la dugs bya/ /zar ma til ni brngos pa dang / /'o mas dbal ni bsad pa dag /de btags bskus na tsha na ②sel/ /rma skrangs brtan zhing nad tshabs chung / /bad kan rlung 'joms snum bsku zhing / /de yi rjes la 'od ma yi/ /sbu gus rim gyis dugs bya'o/ /zhu bar bya phyir lag mthil lam/ /mthe bo yis ni mnye ①bar bya/ /nas dang gro dang mon sran sde'u/ /btsos te btags pa'i lde gus bsku/ /gal te de yis ma zhum dun/ /de nas de ni dkri bar bya/ /ma smin pa ni zhi 'gyur la/ /smin na rnags pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rgya shug ⑤til dang zar ma dang / /rgyam tsha phabs dang ru rta'i phye/ /zho skyur zan dron gyis glan zhing / /dugs byas nas ni dkri bar bya/ /legs smin skrangs pa phyogs gcig 'dus/ /bcir bas dunye bar bcir gyur pa/ /dral bar 'os la dral bya zhing / /shin tu 'jam por gyur pa'ang dral/ /gu gul zar ma ba lang so/ /khron bu phug ron rtug pa dang / /thal sman 'phrod dang thal sman de/ /smin pa'i sman gyis brtol bar bya/ /nang na rnag 'byung sgo phra zhing ⑦/ /mtho bar gyur dang ④gnad la gnas/ /snum med btsir ba'i sman kyis ni/ /kun nas rab tu btsir bar bya/ /bsku ba bskams na ⑨bcir ba yi/ /las la ⑩btang snyoms nyid du bya/ /de yi rma sgor mi bsku ste⑪/ /de 'dras nad ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /sran ma nas dang gro dang ni/ /ma sha shu dag ⑩bra bo dang / /sman ni spyi ⑫bag can dag gis/ /pags pa'i rtsa ba rab tu bsdams/ /gcin snyi ⑫mdze yi rma dang ni/ /shas cher red pa'i rma dag la/ /dong ga bye'u ⑫rug pa sogs kyis/ /lan ni bdun bdun bkru 111—745

sogs bya/ /ma dag nim pa pa to la'i/ /lo ma bskol bas bkru bar bya/ /rma ①dag pa la n+ya go dha/ /la sogs shun wags bskol bas bkru/ /shing mngar til dang pa to la/ /dur byid dan da ser po gnyis/ /nim pa'i lo ma rgyam tshar bcas/ /lde gus bskus na rma sbyong byed/ /rma ni kha phrag nad mtshams gnasaske/ /dan da rgyam tsha lang ka li/ /dud ⑤byid sbrang rtsir sbyar ④ba yi/ /reng bur byas pas rma sbyang bya/ /rlung gis rjoganod cing khrag bcas shing / /mi bzad na la nas dang gro/ /spra tshil shri ba kra ka ⑤dang / /thang shing mar bcas dud rjopas bdug /khrag mkhris dag ⑦gi shas che la⑧/ /shin tu bsil ba'i sman gyis bsku/ / skam zhing stisha nyung gting ring rma⑩/ /sha skyed pa yi sman bya ste/ /shug pa n+ya gro dha sogs dang / /ba la a shwa garnya til/ /bskus te sha ni bskyed par bya/ /sha za'i sha ⑩ni cho ga bzhin/ /g.yos su byas te sbyin par byaske/ /sems dga' ba dang sha za yi/ /sha zos na ⑫ni sha 'phel 'gyur/ /sha snyi ⑫'bur bar gyur pa la/ /dzā ti'i me tog nag tshur dang / /ldong ros ba bla gu gul dang / /tsi tra ka sogs ④lde gus bsku/ /sha 'bur bar ⑫ni sra ba dang / /g.ya' zhing ring nas 'tsho ba dang / /rma ni na zhing sbyang dka' la/ /thal sman las kyis ⑩sbyang bar bya/ /rde'u dbyung ⑩rma ni gcin 'dzag dang / /gang gzhan khrag ni 'byung ba dang / /gang zhig bcad nas sbyar ba dag /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /gso bar byed bzhin mi 'grub na/ /de ni me yi las kyis ⑫gso/ /skyon med rma la rma 'byor ba'i/ /sman dang sha skyed gang yin sbyararka/ /a shwa garnya seng phrom dang / /shing mngar btsod dang kad pha ⑪la/ /da ta smyoki yi me tog gi /phye ma rma 'tshob byed pa'i mchog /rnag dang sha ni 111—746

med pa dang / /sha yi gnas su ma 'drubs parasti/ /til dang shing mngar bcas pa yi②/ /lde gus rma ni 'tshob par snebya/ /snum dro mngar dang kha ba dang / /bska rjobs thams cad sel bar byed/ /nim pa'i lo ma sbrang rtsir bcas—/ /bskus pas rma sbyor mchog yin no/ /snga ma gnyis dang zhun mar sbyar—/ /myur du rma 'tshob byed pa yin/ /til 'drar nas kyi lde gu ni/ /de dang 'dra bar la la 'dod/ /khrag mkhris dug dang glo bur dang ⑤/ /gting ring tsha dang bcas pa'i rma/ /'o ma rma 'byor dusman dang ni/ /bskol ba'i mar gyis ⑦rma 'tshob bya/ /bad kan rlung gyur ⑧rma 'byor sman/ /til mar bcas pas rma 'tshob 'gyur/ /nag tshur seng phrom a ru ra/ /li khri dngul rdo sra rtsi pog /spangs ma po son cha'i ⑨phye ma/ /til mar bcas pa rma 'tshob mchog /mnyam zhing sha ni brtan pa dang / /pags par gnas la phye ma phan/ /u dum wā ⑩ra a shwat+tha/ /'dzam bu seng phrom kad pha la/ /ka ⑪ku seng phrom phye mas gdabarka/ /pags pa myur du skyed par byed/ /rgya skyegs ldong ros btsod dang nirka/ /ba la dang ni ser po gnyis/ /sbrang rtsi mar sbyar sde gu yis/ /bskus na pags pa dag byed mchog /skyer pa a mra'i rus pa dang / /nā ga ge sar pri yang ku/ /tsan+dan ser po dngul chu rnams/ /sde gu ba lang lci khu dang / /sbyar ba bskus par gyur na ni/ /pags pa mdog 'drar byed mchog yin/ /ba so dud pa ma shor bsregs/ /skyer khaṇ+ḍa dang til mar sbyar⑫/ /bskus na spu ni skyed par byed/ /de bzhin rkang bzhi'i sen mo spu/ /rus pa pags pa rwa rmig ⑫bsregasarka/ /snag tsha til mar dang sbyar bas/ /bskus na sru ni skyed par ⑫byed / /smin ma la ni cha spyad spyokyi/ /las bshad phan dang gnod pa bsten⑩/ /111—747

rlung gyur rma la rtsa ba lnga/ /gnyis dang rlung 'joms sde tshan phan/ /mkhris gyur shug pa n+ya go dang ①/ /sde tshan gnyis dang mkhris 'joms gtong / /bad kan las gyur dong ga'i sde/ /bad kan 'joms par byed pa gtang / /'dren ma las gyur 'dren mar ②byas/ /'di dag gis bkru byugs ①pa dang / /sman mar til mar sman khu dang / /phye ma ril bu bdun po ni/ /rma la ci rigs sbyar bar bya/ /dzā ti nim pa pa to la'i lo ma/ /skyer pa yung ba thal tres pu tse shel/ /spra tshil spangs ma shing mngar a ru ra/ /ka rañdza yi sa bon btsod dang btsosarjo /mar bskol 'dis ni rma kha chung ba dang / /nad la brten zhing rnag ni 'dzag ⑤pa dang / /rma yi phugs ring nad bcas phugs ring ba'irjo/ /rma ni dag cing 'tshob par byed pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las phyi ma'i gnas kyi ⑦le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas 'phral du byung ba'i rma'i ⑧gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /rma gang snad ⑨pas 'phral du ni/ /byung gyur glo bur rma zhes bya/ /de ni mtha' yas kyang yan lag /gnas pa ⑩rnam pa brgyad du bshad/ /bshus dang bcad dang rnam par bcad—/ /rab tu 'phyang ⑪dang lhung ba dang / /phug dang gshags dang grugs pa'oske/ /de la bshus pa chu ser ram/ /khrag ni nyung zad 'byung 'gyur zhing / /pags pa tshos pas tsha ⑩'gyur yin/ /de las tshos gyur ⑫bcad pa yin/ /de las chos ⑩pa rnam bcad yin/ /rab 'phyang rus par lhag ma lus/ / lhung ba ⑫lus las phogs ⑩pa yin/ /zug rngu phra mo 'bigs pas phug /khong pa ma gtogs bsnun ⑩pa yin/ /snga ma las gzhan gshags ⑫pa yin/ /khrag dang 111—748

rkang ni 'dres gyur pa/ /mtshon gyis drag tu bsnun ①pa yis/ /rus bcas rgya cher snad grugs pa/ /de la 'phral du byung ba'i rma/ /zug gzer shin tu che ba la—/ /shing mngar mar dang bskol ba 'am/ /ba la'i khrutil mar dro 'jam blugasarka/ /snad ①pa'i tsha ba zhi bya'i phyir/ /bsku ba la sogs snum pa dang / /bsil dang mngar ba'i rjosman gyis ni/ /de yi mod la blugs ⑤par bya/ /'phral gyi rma ni rgya che la/ / sbyar ba'i duphyir ni sbrang rtsi dang / /mar gyis mchog tu bsku bya zhing / /mkhris 'joms bsil ba'i gso ba bya/ /nad kyi ⑦rtsom pa che ba la/ /steng dang 'og nas sbyang bar bya/ /sgyung ba bya zhing 'bras chan sbyin⑧/ /rgyun du gtar ga gdab par bya/ /bshus dang grugs pa 'di nyid de/ /cho ga 'di nyid lhag par sbyar/ /de gnyis khrag ni nyung shas 'dzag /smin pa'ang ⑨myur ba nyid du 'gyur/ /phal cher rma ni shas cher 'byung / /gzhan las khrag ni 'byung gyur la/ /de yis khrag ni zad gyur pas/ /rlung 'khrugs nad ni skyed pa las⑩/ /rlung 'joms sman dang bskol ba yi/ /snum blugs pa dang sman chu blugs⑪/ /dugs dang bsku dang dkri ba dang / /snum gyi 'jam rtsi rnams kyang bya/ /de ltar zhag bdun par bshad pa'i/ /'phral gyi rma byung cho ga bshad/ /zhag bdun nas ni shugs zad nas/ /sngar bshad pa yi cho gas ⑫spyad/ /'dir ni phal cher spyi'i ⑫cho ga /re re'i ⑫gso ba bshad bya ste/ /shus spyol na ba myur bsal phyir/ /rma la phan pa'i phye mas ⑩gdab/ /bcad pa rma sel lde gus bsku/ /rnam par bcad dang rab 'phyang la/ /cho ga bzhin du btsem pa dang / /bcing ba dang ni btsir bar ⑫bya/ /mig bcar ba ni gsor mi rung / /ma zhar phyir ni 'phyang ba la/ /rang gi gnas su legs 111—749

gzhag cing / /rtsa ma 'chol bar byas nas ni/ /pad+ma'i 'dab mas g.yogs nas ni/ /lag pas dal gyis hūṃmanan par bya/ /de nas shing mngar dzi ②ba ka /zangs rtsi ba dang at+pa la/ /mar dang 'o ma bcas bskol ba'i/ /sman thigs blugs dang sna sman dang / /brta ཿba'i cho ga dag kyang bya/ /mig nad thams cad sel mchog yin/ /mig phugs zhugs la mgul pa bsdam/ /slon dang lud pa dz+red pa 'byung 7/ /yang na dbugs 'byung dbugs brngub (gyebasdam/ /rma byung mig gi gso ba bya/ /rna ba bogs pa btsems ⑥nas ni/ /bu ga til mar dag gis tshudagang / /ltag pa'i sum mdo chod gyur te/ /rlung ni du'abyung bar gyur pa kyela'ang / /mnyam du bzhag ste bar mtshams nishāsna / /med par btsems te bcing bar bya/ /de ljormil ra yi mar sar gyis/ /blugs pa dag ni rab tu bsngags/ /gan rkyal bzhag ste kha zas sbyin/ /legs par spyod lam bsdams te nyal/ /yan lag thad kar gnas pa yi/ /rma byung yan lag legs gzhag ste/ /btsems la dkri shā5zhing bcing bya zhing / /gos ni mthug pos bcing bar bya/ /pags pa'i 'ur mthil bcing bas (snyeni/ /phrag 6pa'i rma la bcing bar bya/ /rlig pa 'phyang la rkang par ni/ /sbu ⑩gus chu ni gtor nas kyang / /rlig pa bcug ste ras bal dang / /bcas pa'i khab kyis btsem par bya / /'ur mthil babyung bar byas pa la/ /rked pa nas ni srad bus gdags//der sani rma ni 'drul gyur pas/ /snum dang dugs kyi las mi bya/ /pri yang ku dang a ga ru/ /sug smel dzā ti par pa ta/ /tsan+dan ldong 7ros skyer pa dang / /sle tres dang ni spangs dzosnyem dang / /til mar bskol bas rma 'tshob byed/ /yan lag ma lus chad pa la/ /til mar bskol bas bsregs nas ni/ /sgye'u bcing 111—750

bas ①bcing bar bya/ /de nas rma ltar gso bar bya/ /phug pa zug rngu phyung bas gso/ /grugs dang chag grugs gso bar bya/ /mgo bo'i zug rngu dbyung ba laske/ /skra yi ye'u gzhug par bya/ /gzhan du klad rgyas 'dzag pa yis/ /rlung 'khrugs de ni gsod par 'gyur/ /rma 'tshob nas ni rim kyis ④ni/ /skra ni dal gyis dbyung bar bya/ /klad rgyas 'dzag la srog chags ni/ /gzhan gyi klad pa sbyin par ①bya/ /gzhan las zug rngu phyung nas ni/ /rma der rjoring bu snum can gzhug /phugs ⑤ring kha ni chung ba dang / /rma gang rjornag dang khrag 'dzag la/ /'khor los bcing ba'i til mar blugs/ /de ni sbu gu chung ngus gtang / /khong pa brtol te khrag gis gang / /brgyal zhing snying ga rtsib logs na/ /rims 'debs lus tsha lto spo skom/ /zas la mngon par mi dga' zhing / /bshang ba gcin dang 'phyen ⑦'gags la/ /mig dmar rngul 'byung dbugs mi bde/ /kha nang khrag gi dri bro zhing / /lus kyang dri mi zhim par 'gyur| /ma zhu'i gnas na gnas pa'i khrag /khrag tu yang ni sgyug par byed//shin tu shas cher lto sbo zhing / /gzer nad kyis kyang gnod par byed/ /zhu ba'i gnas na gnas pa'i khrag /gzer bcas lus ni lci bar byed/ /lto ba man chad grang ba dang / /bu ga las kyang khrag 'byung 'gyur/ /gnas ni zhig par ma gyur kyang / /khrag ni 'dzag par gyur pa yis/ /bu ga las ⑧ni 'gengs byed de/ /lgang pa'i ngos nas 'gengs dang 'dra/ /khrag nad yod pa de la ni/ /rkang lag kha dang ⑨dbugs grang zhing / /mig dmar gdong ⑩ni skya ba dang / /lto sbo ba ni spang bar bya/ /ma zhur gnas la ⑪sgyug sman gtang / /zhu ba'i gnas la gnas pa la/ /bkru sman dang ni ni ru ha/ /snum med dro bas 111—751

byedasbyang bar bya/ /nas dang rgya shug rgya sran gyi/ /khu ba snum ni med pa dang / /nas thug kha zas bza' ba dang / /lce myang tsha dang ldan pa sbyin/ /khrag ni mang du 'dzag pa dang / /khong pa snad la khrag blud 3/bya/ /rgyu ma 'byar dang chad par 2nyen/ /khong pa snad pa gnyis su bshad/ /dang por brgyal sogs chung ba yin/ /gnyis pa shas cher gnod par byed/ /rgyu ma 'byar ba the tshom bcas /rgyu ma chad pa 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /gang gi bshang dang gasbun dang 'phyen / /rang gi lam las byung gyur la/ /bla brnan rnged par rdol —)gyur kyang / /'tsho bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /ma rdol /5 rgyu ma byung ba ni/ /gzhug par bya zhing gzhan du min/ /gog ma'i 6mgo bo bcad nas /7 ni/ /de yang gzhug ces la la smra/ /rdul dang khrag dang rtsa yis gos/ /'o mas legs par bkrus nas ni/ /sen mo bregs te mar gyis bskus/ /rim gyis 8/legs par gzhug par bya/ /skam 9po 'o mas sbangs nas ni/ /mar sar mang po bsku bar bya/ /sor mos mgul pa mnye ba / dang / /chu yis kyang ni gtor bar bya/ /de ltar rgyu ma nang zhugs nas/ /de yi tshe na btsir bar bya/ /rma kha chung dang sbom pa yis /rgyu ma khong par ma chud na/ /de yi tshad tsam lto ba ni/ /dbral 17te nang du gzhug par bya/ / gnas su rkilegs par 'dug gyur nas1 / /de rjes rgyu ma'i rma btsem bya/ /gnas su legs par ma bzhag na/ /de ni 'khrugs pas ྾'chi bar 'gyur/ /de rjes ras kyis dkris nas ni/ /mar gyis bsku zhing blugs par bya/ /de nas dan da til mar dang / /sbyar ba'i 'o ma dro 'jam blud/ /des ni bshang ba snyi ba dang / /rlung ni bde bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ji skad bshad pa'i spyod pa bsrung / /lo gcig bar du 'bad par bya/ /lho las tshil 111 752

ni byung gyur na/ /thal ba 'am ni sa dag gam/ /ro bska ba yi rtsa ba dag /zhib tu btags pas btab nas ni/ /de nas srad bus dam du bcing / /sman pa mkhas pas gcad ①par bya/ /mtshon rnon me la bsregs pa yis lan cig kho na gcad par bya/ /gzhan du byas nas gcod pa'i tshe/ /na zhing sbo 'am ④'chi bar 'gyur/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pas ①rma bcings la/ /kha zas zhu nas 'o ma mar/ /dan ti rgya skyegs gze ma dang / /shing mngar kha ra bskol ba bludaske/ /shing mngar bcas pa sngar gyi ni/ /cho gas na dang tsha ba sel tshil gyi rmen bur 0bshad pa yi/ /til mar bskus na'ang phan pa yin/ /bal bu'i lo ma shug pa dang / /spang spos ha re rku ⑤ka dang / /a ga ru dang tsan+dan dang //pad+ma'i sa bon ser po gnyis/ /u shi ra dang shing mngar bcas/ /bskol ba 'phral gyi rma la ni/ /'tsho bar byed pa'i dam par bshad/ /mtshon gyis bsnun pas mi mngon pa/ /g.yang sa mthon po nas lhung ba/ /rlung mkhris 'joms sman 'drangs pa dang / /mnye dang bsku dang busbyang ba bya/ /lus tshigs bye ⑦dang mnyes pa dang / /gnad ⑤du bsnun pas nyen pa la⑨/ /snod chen til mar gyis bkang ⑩bar/ /gzhug cing sha khu sbyin par bya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas chag grugs gso ba'i le'u ⑪bshad par bya'o/ /lhung dang snad sogs kyis rus tshigs/ /tshigs dang tshigs min chag gyur ⑫gnyis/ /tshigs byung gyur na brkyang dang bskum/ /nus pa me+ed pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gzhan dag shin tu skrangs pa dang / /gnas skabs kun tu rab tu na/ /bskyod pa chung 111—753

ngu'ang ①mi nus shing / /btsir na sgra ④dang bcas pa yin/ /de ltar chag grugs mdor bsdus pa'i/ /mtshan nyid yin te de dbye ba/ /chag pa'i dbye bas ④du mar 'gyur/ /de dag kun gyi gso ba ni/ /ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du ni/ /de bzhin de ni nye bar bstan/ /mang du phra mor rjochag pa dang / /reg na sgra ni 'khrol ba dang / /gang du rus pa chag pa yi/ /bar du rus pa phra mo zhugs/ /yang na snad pas chag pa las/ /cung zad lus par gyur pa dang / /gang yang bteg ⑤pa'i tshe na ni/ /rma ltar rkang du nub pa dang / /nus zhan busbeg par gyur pa dang / /rlung can nyung zad spang bar bya/ /dpyi yi rus mig chag pa dang / /gang yang tshigs bye lhung ba dang / /ro smad zhib metu grugs pa 'am⑧/ /chag par gyur pa gang yin dang / /thod pa'i mtshams ni ma 'byor pa'am/ /de bzhin dpral ba phye mar gyur/ /gang yang mur 'gram chag pa dang / /ltag pa nu ma'i bar chab/ spang / /rus pa legs par chag gyur kyang / /bzhag nyes bcings ni ⑨nyes pa dang / /gang zhig bskyod pas gnod gyur pa⑩/ /de yang spang bar thonyubya ba yin/ /gdod nas rus pa'i tshigs dag ni/ /nyes par skyes gyur ⑫de yang spang / /rus pa gzhon nu gug pa dang / /sbub ⑫can chag par gyur pa dang / /thod pa gyes ④par gyur pa dang / /gzhan yang mang du gas pa rnams/ /de nas dma' ba bstod par bya/ /mthon po mnan par bya ba yin/ /nung ⑫du nub pa drang bar bya/ /'og tu song ba steng du drang / /'degs ⑩dang mnan dang smad pa dang / /pags pa bsdus te bcing ba dang / /de ltar bzhag pa'i thabs kyis ni/ /lus su gtogs pa'i tshigs ⑩thams cad/ / g.yo ba'am ⑫mi g.yo gang yang rung / /legs par bzhag ste mi 'gyur bya/ /111—754

— ———byed————— — — ———ras ma mar ni mang bas dkri/ /u dum bā 1 ra ka dam pa/ /ardzu na dang a shwat+tha—/ /sardza dang 2ni pa la sha /'od ma las byung shun zheng che/ /'jam pas legs par 'jar ba dang / /rten dang bcas shing mi 'gyur ba'i/ /shun pa'am dum bu dag dang ni/ /'jag mas legs par dkri bya zhing / /ras kyis /5)steng du glan par bya/ /bcing ba lhod par gyur pa yis6/ /mtshams sbyor brtan por mi 'gyur ro/ / dam pos shin tu na zhing tsha/ /rnag 8 dang skrangs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sos ka'i dus su zhag gsum gsum/ /dgun gyi dus su bdun nas dgrol/ /thun mong 9 dus su zhag lnga nas/ /yang na chag pa'i dbang las dgrol/ /de nas n+ya gro dha sogs pa'i/ /khu ba bsil ba'i chu blugs nyabya/ /de ni nang bcas rtsa ba lnga/ /'o ma bskol ba blugs 7par bya/ /mkhas pas til mar 'khor los mabacir/ /rlung 'joms sman dang bcas pa ni/7/ /dro 'jam tsam ni bsgu bar bya/ /dus dang yul gyi dbye bas bya/ /khu ba shin tu grang mo 7ni/ /rgyun du blugs shing lde gus bsku/ /ba gsar sa'o ma mar dang bcas//mngar ba'i sman dang bskol ba dag /rgya skyegs khu bar bcas pa ni/ /chag grugs can la nang re blud/ /chag grugs rma dang bcas pa ni7/ /rma la shing mngar mar shas che/ /lde gu bskus pa'am yang na ni/ /lhag ma chag grugs 1/༄lta bur gso/ /rma yi sha ni 'phyang ba la/ /sbrang rtsi mar gyis 1—bskus nas ni/ /sman pas rma ni kha sbyar nas/ /bcing pa dag kyang legs par bya/ /de ni mnyam zhing legs bzhag nas/ /pri yang ku dang kad pa la/ /seng phrom btsod dang da ta 1 ki /phye mas 2legs par bdar bya 'am/ /seng phrom da ta ki'i phye ma/ /btab na myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /de ltar chag grugs gso ba yin/ /717 755

lus zungs brtan la dgun gyi tshe/ /sha chen nad gzhi chung ba'i rma/ /gso sla gzhan ni gso bar ①dka'/ /na tshod dang po bar ma mtha'/ /zla gcig gnyis dang gsum rim gyis/ /cho ga ji skad bshad bsten na/ /rma 'byor brtan par 'gyur ba yin/ /rked pa rje ngar brla chag na/ /spang leb la ni nyal na ②phan/ /de bzhin bsdams ①phyir phur pa lnga/ /byas nas ④nye bar brtod ⑤byas te/ /rje ngar ngos gnyis la gnyis gnyis/ /rkang mthil drang po gcig bzhag brtodadu/ /sta zur ram ni sgal tshigs sam/ /gdong dang de bzhin phrag pa rus⑦/ /tshigs byung chag grugs byung gyur na/ /cho ga 'di bzhin spyad par bya/ /tshigs ni byung nas yun ring la/ /snum bsku dugs kyis mnyen ⑧byas te/ /'di bshad thabs dang rang gi blos/ /rang gi gnas su legs par gzhug /tshigs ⑨min chag ste 'drubs spyopa dang / /bcings ⑪nyes pa yis gsos pa la/ /brdungs te chag grugs bsrang ⑫bar bya/ /de nas chag grugs bzhin du gso/ /chag nas ci nas ma rnags ⑫pa/ /de ltar sman pas 'bad par bya/ /sha dang rtsa rgyus 'drul na ni/ /tshigs ni 'drubs par mi 'gyur ro/ /chag grugs can la rlung nad kyi/ /skabs bshad snum ni sbyar bar bya/ /stobs bskyed spyor ba bzhi po dang / /'jam rtsi'i las kyang bsten par bya/ /sā ④lu'i chan dang sha khu ⑫mar/ /'o ma rgyas byed bsil ba bsten/ /chag grugs can la rus pa'i mtshams/ /'byor byed tshad tsam sbyin par bya/ /de ni mtshams sbyor byed pas na/ /rmya bar byed pa bsngags pa yin/ /lan tshwa tsha ⑩dang thal sman dang / /snum dang nyal po nyi tshan dang / /rtsol ba bsten par mi bya zhing / /chag grugs zas rtsub bsten mi bya/ /til nag phub ma 111—756

med pa ras sra'i nang du gtums①/ /chu yi nang du zhag bdun nye bar sbangs gyur cing ④/ /'di ni bteg ste ④nyin re legs par bskams nas ni/ /de bzhin 'o ma chu dang shing mngar nang du bskol/ /slar yang 'o mar dusnga ma bzhin du sbangs te bskams/ /phub ma med cing rdul ⑤med zhib tu btags nas ni/ /spang sgos ba la dhika dang btsod dang chu srin sen/ /shu ti ku tan na da ru rta ba la ⑦gsum/ /tsan+dan gur gum dang ni thal tros a ga ru/ /sgron shing sra rtsi khrupog dang thang shing shug pa'i sde/ /de yi phye ma dri zhim 'o ma lhan cig btags/ /dri yi sman ni ma lus 'o mar bskol ba bcing/ /rdo dreg ra sna saṃ ⑨shu ma ti dang / /ka she ru dang garnya pri yang ku/ /rgya spos gan+ta bha dra ⑩seng phrom dang / /pa ya ⑪su dang mur ba ⑫'o mar bcas/ /spang spos sogs dang til mar de bskol ba/ /dri yi til mar mchog 'dis ⑫rus pa dag /brtan zhing myur du zhi bar byed mchog yin/ /rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur nad kyis khyab/ /sbyor ba sna tshogs bsten pas sel ba yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas mtshan bar rdol ④gyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /glang po rta la zhon te 'gro—/ /gnas dang mal sar tsog pur 'dug /gzhang 'brum nad kyi rgyur bshad dang / /gzhan la'ang brten par gyur pa dang / /mi dge smin par gyur pa dang / /'phral du dam pa la smad pas/ /phal cher 'brum phran dang por 'byung / /rkub kyi phyi 'am nang du ni/ /rma ni sor tshad ⑫gnyis sam gcig/sha khrag gnod par gyur las 'byung ⑩/ /chu sor gcin gyi gnas nye bar/ /111—757

byung ①bas 'dzag pa'i rang bzhin can/ /de ni mtshan bar rdol ④zhes bya/ /kun kyang ma gsos 'drul byed cing / /mo mtshan chu so gzhang gi bar/ /shas cher 'jig par byed pa dang / /bshang gci 'phyen ①dang khu chu ni/ /bu ga'i nang nas rim gyis 'byung / /nad gzhi re re ldan pa 'dus/ /glo bur ba dang brgyad du bshad/ /ma smin 'brum bu zhes byar bshad/ /smin pa mtshan bar rdol ༷yin no/ /rtsa ba mi mngon nad tshabs che/ /shas cher g.yos shing rma 'khyims 'khrugasadhi/ /mtshan bar rdol du'agyur shes par bya/ /de las gzhan du de mi byed/ /de las rlung gyur 'brum bu ni/ /dmar zhing gnag la na ba dang / /zug cing 'phar bar byed pa yin/ /mkhris gyur rnga mo'i mgrin ltar ring / /dmar zhing srab la shas cher tsha/ /thal mdog dud pa 'thul bcas yin—/ /bad kan las gyur brtan zhing snum/ /rtsa ba che zhing mdog skya g.ya'/ /rlung mkhris las gyur mdog gnag cing / /dmar zhing tsha la mi bzod na/ /bad rlung las gyur cung zad gnag /smin par dka' ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /'dus gyur ⑦rkang pa'i mthe bo ⑧'dra/ /nad ni sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur zhing / /gzer dang skam dang yi ga 'chus/ /rims dang slon sogs kyis gnod byed/ /yal bar bor la ⑨smin pa dang / /rma nyid du ni 'gyur ba yin/ /de la ⑩rlung gyur 'brum bu ni⑪/ /kha phra mang pos khyab byed de/ /ko tshags bzhin du kha mang zhing / /rim ⑫'phel chu ser sla ba dang / /lbu ba can ni rgyun du 'dzag /ko tshags kha brgya pa zhes bya/ /mkhris pa las gyur rnga mo'i mgrin/ /bad kan las gyur spyi ⑫bag ni/ /mang 'dzag yongs su 'dzag ces bya/ /rlung mkhris las gyur bshang sgor ni/ /yongs su mched pa kun khyab cing ⑫/ /der ni ra ba'i 111—758

'obs kyis ni/ /bskor ba lta bur 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rlung dang bad kan las gyur grang / /gzhan du drang por song 'gas ①byed/ /bad mkhris las gyur sngar bshad pa'i/ /gzhang 'brum la brten de ldang ②zhing / /de las gzhang 'brum rtsa bar g.ya'/ /skrang ①dang tsha ba la sogs skyed/ /de ni myur smin rdol 0gyur na/ /gzhang 'brum rtsa ba rnag can yin/ /rgyun mi chad ⑤par 'dzag byed de/ /gzhang 'brum 'di ni mtshan bar rdolarjo/ /'dus pa las gyur dung 'dra ba⑦/ /dung ni 'khyil pa'i dbyibs dang 'dra/ /'di yis gzhang ni zhig ⑧byed cing / /mi bzad lam ni zhig par byed/ /gang tshe sha la brkam ⑨pa yis/ /rus pa'i dum bu zos gyur pas⑩/ /thad kar song bas lam log zhugs/ /rdol ⑪zhing snad par byed pa yin/ /de tsha gas pas rnags ⑫pa dang / /sha ni 'drul bar byed pa yin/ /der ni srin bu skye 'gyur zhing / /gzhang ni kun tu za bar ⑫byed/ /ring por mi thogs des 'jig byed/ /de ni lam log rma skyes yin/ /de las na tsha g.ya' la sogs/ /rma gso ba las shes par bya/ /de las drug po gso dka' yin/ /'dus gyur ④rma skyes spang bar bya/ /sel ba'i gnyer mar ⑫phyin pa dang / /srubs mtshams la ni brten pa'ang spang ⑩/ /de nas 'brum bu'i tshe nyid ni/ /'di ni 'bad de gso bar bya/ /sbyang dang gtar ga chu blugs sogs/ /ci nas smin par mi 'gyur bar/ /'di ni 'bad de gso bar bya/ /smin nas be+er yang snum chos ⑩dang / /dugs byas nas ni lus spying spyobya/ /gzhang 'brum lta bur bsdams nas ni/ /gting ring legs par brtag ⑩bya zhing / /rtsa ba 'am ni rtse mo 'am/ /phyi bltas nang du bltas pa brtags⑫/ /de la nang bltas btsal nas ni/ /gtsags ⑪bus 111—759

legs par gcad par bya/ /phyir bltas ma lus par bcad la/ /thal sman dag gis gso bar bya/ /de nas thal sman btab pa 'am/ /yang na sman pas me btsa' gdab①/ /rnga mo'i mgrin la thal sman bsku/ /ko tshags kha brgya sbubs gcig pa/ /bcug nas legs par gcad par bya/ /de 'drubs ②nas ni lhag ma'ang gcad/ /gzhan du gzhang ni zhig ④nas 'chi/ /'obs rjoltar khyab pa'ang de bzhin du/ /thal sman ba gcin sbu gus gso/ /gzhang 'brum mtshan bar rdol la ⑤sngar/ /gzhang 'brum la ni sman phye gdab/ /rma skyes pa la re thag bcad—/ /zug rngu dbyung ④ba'i cho ga bzhin/ /zug rngu phyung ④ste srin 'joms pa'i—/ /bza' dang byug pa sbyar bar bya/ /glan dugs sru gu can la sogs/ /snum chos legs sbyar nad la phan/ /ko tshags 'dra dang thams cad la/ /ba lang ngogs dang kun tu bzang / /gshol phyed pa dang gshol gyis bya/ /brtags ⑧te nye bar sbyar bar bya/ /ngos ⑨su 'debs par byed pa'i mtshon/ /ba lang ngogs zhes bya bar bshad/ /kun tu gtong ba kun tu bzang / /ngos la gcod pa gshol phyed pa/ /ngos gnyis su ni gshol gyis bcad⑩/ /'dzag pa'i lam ni ma lus pa⑪/ /thams cad me yis bsreg par bya/ /slar yang 'di lta'i gnod mi bskyed/ /sman pas de yi bar bar du/ /de yi lto sbyang la 'bad bya—/ /byi la'i rus pa 'bras bu gsum/ /khu ba sde gur byas pas ⑫bsku/ /dzo ti sma ti ma la yu/ /sle sman ta ⑫ka bi sha l+ya④/ /dur byid pa ti ba tra ka /ka ra bī ⑫ra sra rtsi pog /shu dag su dha k+ṣi ⑩ra dang / /arka'i ⑩lo ma til mar bskol—/ /mtshan bar rdol la bskus na ⑫ni/ /'di ni phan byed mchog tu bshad—/ /shing mngar seng phrom pi pi ling / /sug smel ha re rku ⑪ka dang / /111—760

ser po gnyis dang pri yabyu/ /rgyam tsha thal tres shug pa dang / /pad+ma'i snying po da ta ki /spra ①tshil ru rta sra rtsi pog /kha lung 'o mar bcas pa dang / /til mar lhan cig bskol ba yis/ /bskus na 'brum bu mdze dang rma/ /gcin nad sbrang rtsi 'dra ba 'joms/ / byi dang ka ②snying 'bras bu gsum/ /pi pi ling rtsa pi pi ling / /sbrang rtsi til mar sbyar ba yi/ /sde gu zos na srin bu'i nad/ /mtshan bar ④rdol dang mdze nad dang rjo/ /gcin snyi ba dang smas rjopa dang / /rma 'khyims 'tsho bar byed ④pa yin/ /sle tres sug grel byi dang ⑦ka /dug mo nyung dang ba ru ra/ /skyu ru ra dang a ru ra/ /gu gul rim gyis cha res sgebaskyed/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba 'di zos na/ /'brum bu sbom dang mtshan bar rdol⑨/ /nad ni sel bar byed pa yin/ /pi pi ling dang tsi tra ka / byi dang ga ⑫dang dug mo nyung / /cha mnyam phyed kyi 'bras bu gsum—/ /kun dang cha mnyam gu gul dang / /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu yisaske/ /nad ni thams cad 'joms par byed⑩/ /gu gul srang lnga pi pi ling / /'bras bu gsum ni srang re dang / /shing tsha sug smel zho gnyis gnyis—/ /sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'i sde gu ni/ /zos na mtshan bar rdol ⑫ba dang / /mje dang skran nad 'joms par byed/ /de nyid dang ni bca' sga'i phye/ /legs par bsres par gyur pa dang / /rtsa ba bcu yi khu bar ⑫bsres—/ /mchog tu rlung gi nad sel byed/ /seng ldeng snying po 'bras bu gsum gyi phye/ /a sa na bskol khu ba dang bsres dang / /cha mnyam gu gul sbrang rtsi sde gur ⑫byas/ /mdze 'brum gcin snyi mtshan bar rdol ⑫nad sel/ /'di ni mtshan bar rdol ⑩gso'i bye brag bshad/ /sman gyi mtshan nyid lhag ma gang yin pa//111—761

rma yi dbang byas yongs su bsten pa dang / /gso thabs dgos pa legs par brtags te sbyar/ /rta zhon stobs 'gyed shugs ni 'gegs pa dang / /chang 'thungs nyal po ma zhu ma goms dang / /drag shul las ni sna tshogs rma 'drubs na/ /lo gcig bar ram de las lhag pa spang / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las—/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas rmen bu dang thor bu dang rkang bam dang 'bras kyi phreng ba'i nad dmigs shes pa ①bshad par bya'o/ /nad ni bad kan shas che ba/ /khrag dang sha dang tshil la brten/ /zlum zhing mtho bar skrangs pa de/ /mdud pa 'dra bas rmen bur bshad/ /de ni nad gzhi khrag sha ②tshil/ /rus rtsa rma las gyur pa dgu/ /de la rlung gyur ①rgya che zhing / /zug cing bye ba snyam sems na/ /gnas nas gnas gzhan dag tu 'pho/ /rgyu med par ni 'phel zhing 'bri/ /'jam zhing lgang pa lta bur rgyas/ /brtol na khrag ni sla ba 'dzag /mkhris gyur tsha zhing mdog ser la/ /dmar zhing myur du smin pa yin/ /brtol na khrag ni dron mo 'dzag /bad kan las gyur nad med sra/ /reg na grang zhing dkar la g.ya'/ /smin na rnag ni ska ba 'dzag /nad 'khrugs khrag las gyur rmen bu/ /srin bu dang ni bcas par 'gyurarjo/ /sha dang rtsa la gnas pa yi/ /rmen bu tshor ba chung ba dang / /mkhris pa'i mtshan nyid 'dra ba yin/ /sha ⑤che'i gnod gyur dhisha las ni/ /sha skyed zas la rmen bu 'byung / /snum zhing che la sra ba dang / /rtsa yis khyab cing bad kan 'dra/ /tshil skyed pa yis tshil 'phel ba/ / sha 'am pags par ⑦phyin gyur pa/ /rlung gi rmen bu shin tu snum//111—762

'jam dang brtan par byed pa yin/ /bad kan dang ni mtshan nyid mtshungs/ /lus 'phel 'bri ba mtshungs pa yin/ /de brtol tshil mthug dmar ba dang / /dkar dang gnag pa 'dzag par 'gyur/ /rus pa chag dang snad pa las①/ /mtho dang dma' bar gyur pa ②de/ /rus pa'i rmen bu zhes bya'o/ /rkang gis song ba'am drag shul gyis/ /dub par gyur nas ①chu brgal bas/ /rlung gis rtsa grang mekhrag bcas pa⑤/ /rlung gis btsir te 'khums nas ni/ /yon por byas te bskams pa dang / /mi rjo'aphar nad byung ⑦rmen bu chags/ /de ni rtsa yi rmen bur bshad/ /rma ni ma 'drubs 'drubs ma thag /ro ni thams cad zos gyur pa'am/ /rlon pa dkris pa ⑧med pa 'am/ /yang na lus ni snad gyur pas⑨/ /rlung ni nad khrag ma phyung ba/ /ma sbyangs ⑩rma ni bsrubs pa las//tsha zhing g.ya' dang bcas gyur pa/ /rma yi rmen bur de bshad do/ /gsor rung nad gzhi khrag tshil gyur/ /sra zhing 'gyur dang sbom pa dang / /gnad dang mgul pa stor ⑪gnas yin/ /mdud pa cher chags thor bu ste/ /rmen bu de yi mtshan nyid can/ /nad gzhi la sogs gyur drug yin/ /phal cher bad kan tshil rgyas yin/ /brtan pas smin par mi 'gyur ro/ /rtsa la gnas pa'i khrag nad kyis/ /'khums pa'i rjes la ⑫gnod 'gyur zhing / /smin pa de tshe rgyas par 'gyur/ / sha yi gong po bcas par 'gyur/ /⑫sha yi myu gus ④khyab gyur zhing / /skyes pa de las nad khrag ni/ /rgyun mi 'chad par mang du 'dzag /de ni khrag gi thor bu yin/ /de las sha khrag las gyur spang / /bzhi po gzhan dag gso bar bya/ /dang por chu sor gnas pa 'am/ /ro smad la brten bad kan rgyas/ /sha khrag nad kyi ⑫rkang par ni/ /dus su skrang bar ⑩byed 'gyur 111—763

zhing / /rim gyis stug po nyid du 'gyur/ /de ni rkang bam zhes bya'o/ /rlung gyur gas shing gnag pa dang / /rgyu med na zhing rtsub cing na/ /mkhris pa las gyur ①ser ba dang / /tsha dang rims kyis 'debs pa yin②/ /bad kan snum lci nad ①tshabs chung / /sha yi mdzer pa chen pos khyab/ /de ni mang du 'dzag pa dang / /lo gcig 'das pa spang bar bya/ /kha cig lag pa sna dang mchu/ /rna ba rkang pa ltar 'byung gzerarjo/ /rkang bam skyes par gyur pa de/ /rlan can gnas su mi bzad skye/ /nad ni tshil mgrin mjing pa mig /mchan khung chu sor rjoganas pa dag /mdog 'dra sra zhing snum pa dang / /par ta skyu ru ra 'dra dang / /gting zug 'bras ni cher 'byung ba/ /ring zhig lon na ⑦smin par byed/ /de las kha cig nad med smin/ /kha cig 'dzag dang g.ya' ba yin//kha cig skam zhing kha cig skye⑦/ /yun ring du ni gnas par byed/ / drur ba ⑧bzhin du 'bri zhing 'phel/ /'brum chen 'bras phreng ⑨zhes bya'o/ /de ni rims ⑩bcas skyugs ⑩pa dang / / chom lud rtsib ⑫logs zug pa yang ⑫/ /rma la mi 'phrod bsten pa yis/ /skrang ④dang smin pa khyad par med/ /sha sogs nang du rnag zhugs 'gyur/ /ring du 'gro bar byed pa yin/ /de ni ring du 'go bas 'go/ /sbubs ltar 'dzag pa sbu gu yin/ /drang po sbu gu gcig yin te—/ /de nyid sna tshogs 'gro bas 'gro/ /de ni nad gzhi re re 'dus/ /zug rngu'i rgyus 'byung lngar 'gyur ro/ /rlung gyur spyond bcas rma sgo sra⑩/ /mdog mi sdug cing lbu ba 'dzag /nub mo lhag par 'dzag pa yin/ /mkhris gyur skom tsha ⑩rims kyis 'debs/ /ser bro spyornag ni dri mnam 'dzag /nyin par lhag par 'dzag pa yin/ /bad kan ska zhing spyi ⑪bag 'dzag /g.ya' 111—764

zhing sra bar gyur pa dang / /mtshan mo lhag par 'dzag pa yin/ /'dus gyur mtshan ma kun ldan spang / /nang na gnas pa'i zug rngu ma phyung zhing / /sbu gu skyed par byed ①pa gang yin de/ /lbu ba can la sla zhing dro ba dang / /khrag bcas rnag ni nad bcas rtag tu 'byung / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas rmen bu la sogs pa'i nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /rmen bu ma smin pa la ni/ /rang rang skrangs pa'i nad ltar gso/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri bri ha ti②/ /tsi tra ka dang pi pi ling / /bskol ba'i mar gyis lus sbyang bar/ /'dod pa dag gis snum chos ④bya/ /sbyang byas sman rdon lde gus rjobasku/ /rmen bu lan mang dugs byas te/ /yang dang yang du mnye bar bya/ /'di ni mchog tu rlung la bya/ /khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur pa'ang / /gtar ga bsil ba'i sbyor kun bya/ /bad kan las gyur rlung ltar gso/ /'on kyang smin na de bcad de/ /khrag yod pa ni mes bsreg bya/ /ma lus par bcad lus gyur na/ /slar yang 'phel bar byed par 'gyur/ /sha yi rma las gyur rmen bu/ /de bzhin 'tsho ba tsam du bya/ /tshil las gyur pa'ang ⑦'di nyid dang / /til dang 'o ma'i sde gus bsku/ /ras ni nyis rim dag gis dkri/ /tog rjolcags la sogs bsregs pas bsro⑦/ /yang na mtshon gyis dbral ⑧nas ni/ /tshil phyung nas ni legs par bsregs⑨/ /rtsa yi thor bu sar pa la/ /sa ha tsa ra'i ⑫til mar blud⑪—/ /rlung 'joms sman gyis dkri dugs bya/ /'jam rtsi dang ni gtar ga bya⑫//thor bu rmen bu lta bur ni/ /rang gi ji bzhin byas rab phan/ /rkang bam rlung 111—765

gyur 'phel ba la/ /snum zhing dugs bcas dkri 1ba dang / /long mo'i sor gnyis gong du ni/ /gtar ga gdab par bya ba dang / /e raṇ+ḍa'i 5mar 'o ma dang / /ba gcin sbyar ba zla gcig blud/ /zhu nas 'bru rnying bca' sga dang / /'o ma dang sbyar kha zas sbyin/ /de bzhin dur byed 'o ma blud/ /des ma zhi na mes bsreg bya/ /mkhris gyur long mo'i 'og tu ni/ /khrag dbyung mkhris pa sel kun sbyar/ /bad kan las gyur mje bo las/ /khrag gtar nas kyi kha zas ni/ /sbrang rtsir 4bcas pa'i sman khu blud/ /'phel ba'i tshe na pi pi ling / /a ru ra ni bsten par bya/ /yungs kar bri 5ha ti gnyis kyi/ /rtsa ba'i sde gus byug par bya/ /yang na 'u su'i lde gus byug /'bras kyi phreng ba steng 'og nas/ /sbyang zhing dan da tra ban 6ti/ /dur byid ko sha ta ki dang / /de ba ta la'i mar bskol blud/ /bad kan tshil ni 'joms pa yi/ / dud pas dz+wamakhur bkang sna sman btang / /gtar gas khrag ni 8 dbyung ba dang / /skyer pa'i tshokhaṇ+ḍas gcin yang blud/ /rmen bu ma smin pa la ni/ /rgyam tsha bca' sga na gu li/ /bsku zhing sra bar 1 rgyam tsha yi/ /thum bus dugs byas mnye bar bya/ /sha mi la phug shi 12kru yi/ /sa bon nas dang yungs kar bcas/ /dar ba 1 sgyur po btags bsgus na/ /rmen bu'i mdud pa zhi / bar byed/ /smin par 'phrigs na khrag dbyung zhing / /bad kan mkhris pa sel bas gso/ /ma smin pa ni phyung nas kyang / /thal sman me btsas gso bar bya/ /dzo 5ti dre ti lang ga lisnga / /shu ka na sa'i 'bras bu dang / /ka ka tig ta kar ko ṭishā7/ /de ba ta la'i sa bon dang / /bi sha l+ya dang ni rgun tirta—// /ko sha ta ki 9pa ta rnams/ /srang ni phyed dang dug zho gnyis/ /ka raspru'i mar bre gang dang 2/ /ni rgun ti yi 711—766

khu ba ni/ /bre bzhi bskol bar gyur pa 'di'i/ /btung dang bsku byug snar btang na/ /'bras kyi phreng ba gsor mi rung / /yun ring lon zhing rnag 'dzag sel/ /long ka li yi sdong bu yi/ /lde gu til mar de bzhi 'gyur/ /nir gun ti yi khu bar bskol/ /sna sman sogs btang 'bras phreng sel/ /tsan+dan thang shing na le sham/ /dur byid gla sgang ser po gnyis/ /srang re dug ni srang phyed dang / /ba gcin sbyar te zhib tu btags/ /bra ①s+ho'i khu ba arga yi/ /'o ma ba lang lci khur bcas/ /yungs mar bye gang bcas bskol ba/ /btung ba la sogs par bsten na/ /mdze dang rma ni 'khyims pa dang / /'bras kyi phreng ba myur du sel/ /shu dag rgya skyegs a ru ra/ /pu tse shel dang tsan+dan dang //til mar bskol ba blud na ni/ /'bras phreng rtsa bar ②bcas pa sel/ /sha ra pung ka'i rtsa ba ni/ /'bras kyi chu dang btags gyur pa/ /sna sman bsku bas 'brum bu dang / /dug srin 'bras kyi phreng ba 'joms/ / ut+tam ④ka ris rtsa ba dang / /bi lu'i lo ma seng phrom dang / /sa ha tsa ra pya.a ru ra/ /shing mngar shu ti tsi tra ka /thang shing til mar 'o ma mnyam/ /sna sman bsku byug byas pa'ang phan/ /ba lang ra lug rta rmig bsregs/ /nyungs mar sbyar te bsku ba 'amarka/ /sbrul nag bya rog rang nyid shi / ing gu dang ni ⑤sbyar ba bsku/ /de ltar ma zhi nad kyi ni/ /logs gzhan byin pa la gnas pa'idu/ /chu so'i steng ngam ⑦'og nas ni/ /tshil phyung nas ni mes bsreg bya/ /gyen du 'greng skeba'i rkang pa gzhal/ /de yi ⑨tshad kyi rting pa ru/ /de las ⑩rmen bu dbyung bya zhes/ /drang srong mu khyud kyis bshad do/ /rting pa nas bzung sor ni bcu gnyis na/ /dbang po'i chu so yod spang nad kyi ni/ /g.yon du dbral ⑪te nya sgong 'dra dbus 111—767

nasarka/ /dra ba drang zhes legs thos kyis bshad do/ /mi yi long mo rna ba'i bar du gzhal/ /de yis ①brgyad pa rting ②pa'i cha bgos te/ /byin snying gnad kyi drang thad ma gtogs dbral④/ /tshil ni dbyung bar bya zhes gzhan dag 'chad/ /rlung gyur sbu gur dugs dhibyas la/ /dbral te a pa marga yi/ /sbu gus til dang rgyam tshar bcas/ /btags pa'i sde gus rjolegs par bsku/ /mkhris pa las gyur til dang btsod/ /nā ga dan ti ser po gnyis/ /bad kan las gyur rgyam tsha til/ /dan da nim pa lan tshwas bskurjo/ /zug rngu las byung dbral ⑦te dbyung / /til dang mar dang sbrang rtsis bsku⑧/ /mtshon dbral ⑨mi rung chu tshod kyis/ /legs par btsal te nang du dbug /thal sman la sbangs skud pa yis⑩/ /rma tshol kha ni shas cher dral/ /rma red kha ni dog pa dang //phugs ⑪ring la yang sbyar bar bya/ /reng bu gang dang til ⑫mar gang / /de ni rma 'khyims ⑫la yang bsngags/ /e raṇ+ḍa'i spyo'abras lde gus bsku/ /sbu gu'i rma spyor byed mchog yin/ /rgya shug 'bras bu ⑫shun pa dang / /lan tshwa rgya skyegs bcas pa dang / /gla ⑩gor zho sha'i lo ma dang / /pri yang ku dang nu zho dang / /arka snu hi'i 'o mar sbyar/ /reng bus rma 'khyims myur 'tshob byed/ /rgyam tsha'i tsha dang rtsabs ru tsha/ /lce myang tsha ni legs par bsregs/ /gla ⑩gor zho sha khyem dud pa/ /a mra ta ka seng ldeng gi/ /lo ma dzi na ⑫skyer pa gnyis/ /lde gus bsku ba sogs bsten na/ /skyabs ⑩med mi brtan skyes bu yi/ /'byor pa bzhin du 'grib par byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu pa'o// //111—768

de nas nad phra mo'i dmigs shes pa ①bshad par bya'o/ /bad rlung las gyur 'brum phran ni/ /snum zhing mdog 'dra mdud pa can/ /nad med muṅga 'dra ba ni/ /byis pa las skyes ra'i 'gram pa/ /de gnyis las byung shar gnas mthug② /nas 'dra nas zhes ①bya ba yin/ /'bras byer zlum po rtse mo med⑦—/ /rnag nyung rtag ⑤mtho 'bras byer yin/ /rmen bu lnga 'am drug 'byung zhing / /rus sbal ltar mtho rjorus sbal yin/ /rna ba'i steng ngam ⑦kun tu ni/ /'brum phran sra zhing mi bzad na/ /ut+pal rtsa 'dra pa na sa/ /skrang ⑧shing cung zad na la brtan/ /'gram pa'i mtshams su de gnyis las/ /'byung ba rdo yi bong dhibu yin—/ /shal ma li yi tsher ma 'dra/ /'brum phran nad ⑩bcas mthug po ⑪ni/ /nang na tshil yod lang tsho la/ /byung ⑫ba bzhin ni ma rung ⑫byed/ /bad kan rlung gyur pad+ma yi/ /tsher ma 'dra bas khyab gyur cing ④/ /dkar zhing nad ni med pa dag /pad+ma'i tsher ma can zhes bya/ /mkhris pa las gyur 'brum phran zlum⑫| /u dum bā ⑩ra'i 'bras smin 'dra/ /shas cher tsha zhing rims 'debs byedarka/ /gas pa kha bye zhes bya'o/ /lus kyi nang ⑩dang gdong la ni/ /tsha zhing nad dang rims skyed cing / /sran chung tsam la de'i mdog can/ /'brum phran mthug po srin chung zhing spyo/ /de bas 'brum bu nad tshabs che/ /sdug bsngal byed pa 'brum bu yin/ /rlung mkhris las gyur 'brum bu'i nad/ /pad+ma'i snying po lta bu yi/ /'brum phran gyis ni phug pa yin/ /de dag nyid skyed bong bu yinashi/zlum zhing rgya che mtho ba dang / /mdog dmar 'brum phran dag gis khyab/ /phal cher rlung las mchan khung du/ /nye ⑩bar skyes pa mchan khung spyo'abrum/ /mkhris pa las gyur 'brum phran ni/ /phra zhing mthug pa 'bras yos 'dra/ /de 111—769

'dra'i chen po cig ①byung ba/ /dri can zhes ni grags pa yin/ /tsha ba'i rdul gyis lus gdungs ④la/ /'brum phran nad bcas stug po ⑦ni/ /dbyibs dang chad mdog ske tshe 'dra/ /de ni ske rjotshe zhes bya'o/ /mkhris pa shas che'i nad kyis ni—/ /me dbal lta bur dal gyis mched/ / skrang zhing snum rjol srab cing dmaraske/ /rim skyed dra ba'i bong bu rjoyin/ /mkhris pa shas che'i 'brum bu ni/ /rim skyed sha la gnod byed pa/ /mchan khung phyogs byung spyome'i mdog can/ /'dra ba de ni me skyed yin/ /zhag lnga 'am ni zhag bdun nam/ /zla ba phyed nas ⑧srog 'phrog byed/ /nad gzhi gsum skyes 'brum bu zlum/ /nam tshong yan chad skyes sa skor⑨/ /mchan khung chu sor bi da ri'i⑩/ /rtsa ba ltar sra bi da ⑪ri/ /tshil dang bad rlung ⑫las gyur pa'i/ /rmen bu rtsa rgyus sha la gnas/ /brtol na mar zhag sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /'dzag gyur de la rlung shas che/ /sha skam rmen bur byas nas ni/ /gseg ma lta bur skyed par byed/ /khrag ni dri mnam rnags ⑫pa dang / /kha dog sna tshogs 'byung ba yi/ /nad kyis ⑫de la khrag 'dzag pa/ /de ni 'brum bu gseg ma can⑫/ /lag pa rkang mthil tshigs dang ni/ /nam tshong yan chad gog mo ⑩yi/ /mgo ltar rim gyis ⑩rmen bu ni/ /phra mo mang pos khyab byed la⑫/ /na zhing tsha la g.ya' zhing 'drul/ /kun tu skyes te grog mo'i ⑪mgo /rkang mthil gshags ⑫mas brud pa 'am/ /tsher ma sogs kyis snad pa yi/ /'brum bu phur pa ltar mtho ba/ /skyes te mdzer ⑪pa 'dra zhes bya/ /shugs bkag pa yis rlung dag ni/ /gzhang dang rkang pa la gnas pa/ /phyi dang nang du rgyu byed pa/ /lam rgyu de las ⑫bshang ba ni/ /dka' bas 'byung bar byed pa'i nad3/ /gzhang 'gags pa zhes bya bar 'dod/ /rlung mkhris kyis 111—770

ni sen mo yi/ /nang gi sha smin nad skyed pa/ /ma snad nad dang tshim pa dang / /nye ba'i sen mo zhes bya'o/ /snad pas gnag cing ①rtsub pa dang / /sra ba sen mo ngan zhes bya/ /'dam ni gnod byed la reg las④/ /nang na g.ya' zhing rnag bcas pa/ /sor mo'i 'bras 'byer ①zhes bya'o/ /pags pa til 'dra gnag pa la/ /nad med byung gyur rjorme ba ste/ /de nyid 'bur ba mdzer pa yin/ /mdzer pa las kyang chen por gyur/ /dkar nag pags pa'i mdzer pa yin/ /de 'dra'i 'brum bu skyes pa ni/ /dmar po rgya skyegs nor bu yin—/ /dkar ba'am gnag par lhan cig skyes/ /rlum pa'am mtshan ma zhes bya'oske/ /mya ngan khro dang rlung mkhris sogs/ /'khrugs te gdong ni srab 'gyur zhing / /thig le nag po ngo shig can/ /gdong las ⑤gzhan 'byung khabs zhes bya/ /rlung gyur rjongo shig rtsub par snang / /reg na rtsub cing gnag pa yin/ /mkhris gyur mtha' ma cung zad sngo/ /bad kan las gyur ⑦mtha' dkar ⑧g.ya'/ /khrag gyur mtha' ma zangs mdog can/ /skam zhing tsha ba tsag tsag byed/ /rlung gis bad kan bslangs ⑨gyur pa/ /pags par phyin te bskams gyur nas⑩/ /de las pags pa skya 'gyur zhing / /rim gyis tshor ba med 'gyur la/ /g.ya' ba chung zhing 'drul ba med/ /bem po de ni tshor med yin—/ /skyug sman nyes dang ma zhu dang / /bad mkhris lus la gnas bslangs ⑪pas—/ /rab g.ya' zlum po gor gor po/ /dmar po mang du 'byung 'gyur zhing / /rjes 'brel ldan pa zlum por bshad/ /de ltar nad ni phra mo yi/ /dbye ba sum cu drug tu bstan/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu gcig pa'o// //111—771

de nas nad phra mo'i ①gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /ra yi 'gram pa ma smin pa//srin bu pad pas ④khrag dbyung ngo ①/ /nas 'dra dugs ni byas nas su/ /thang shing ru rta ldong ros dang / /ba bla'i lde gu bskus te bzhu/ /rdo yi bong ④bu'ang de ltar gso/ /smin pa ra 'gram rma ltar gso/ /bzhin gnod seng phrom 'u su dang / /shu dag btags pa'i lde gu 'am/ /n+ya gro dha yi lo ma 'am/ /rgya star lo ma tsha sbyar bsku/ /des ma zhi na skyug sman dang / /sna sman dpral bar gtar ga gdab/ /pad+ma'i tsher ma nim pa yi/ /khu ba'am nim pa mar bskol bar/ /sbrang rtsi dang ni bcas pa blud/ /nim pa dong gar sbyar bas ⑤byug /kha bye sogs nas dra bong b.rarjo/ /sa skor ⑦bcas pa mkhris pa yi/ /me dbal lta bur gso bar bya/ /me skyed pa ni spang bar bya/ /dra ⑧ba'i bong bu sgyung ba dang //gtar ga gdab dang rtsub chos dang / /lus kyi sbyang ba skyu ru ra'i/ /sbyor ba'i bsil sman byugs ⑨pas gso/ /bi da ri ⑩la khrag gtar zhing / /bad kan rmen bu lta bur gso/ /gseg ma lta bu'i 'brum phran la/ /tshil gyi men bu lta bur gso/ /gog ⑪ma'i mgo 'dra bu ga mang / /cher skyed skrang zhing ⑫gnad la gnas—/ /rkang pa lag par ⑫byung ba spang / /cig shos la ni khrag byung ⑫la/ /rgyam tsha dong ga spyosle tres dang / /ci tse rgya sran rtsa ba dang / / dan da ⑫til btags nas phyes ⑩bsku/ /smin pa la ni nad can sha /thams cad legs par sbyang spyobar bya/ /mtshon gyis ⑩bcad la de rjes la/ /thal sman yang na me yis bsreg /mdzer pa 'dra la gtsags ⑥bu yis/ /ma lus bcad la snum gyis bsreg /gzhang 'gags pa la nor bu ni/ /'gags pa lta bur gso 111—772

bar bya/ /nye ba'i sen mo sbyangs ①pa yis/ /tsha ba bsal te mtshon gyis gso/ /sen mo ngan la'ang de bzhin bya/ /rkang pa'i chu ser dag la 'ang 'bras bu skyur po nag tshur bcas/ /til dang gi ④wang nim pa yi/ /lo ma'i lde gus bsku bar bya/ /sme ①ba mdzer par ④bcas pa ni/ /me shel thal sman dag gis bsreg /yang na me btsa' gdab par bya/ /de bzhin bags mjer rgya skyegs nor/ /mtshon gyis bcad de de bzhin gso/ /mtshan ma can sogs gsum po la/ /nye ba'i phyogs la gtar ga gdab/ /'o ma can shing myu gu shun//'o mar ⑤btags pas bsku bar bya/ /ngo shig ardzu na'i shun pa 'am/ /btsod dang sbrang rtsi rjosbyar ba yi/ /lde gu'am rta dkar rmig ⑦pa ni/ /bsregs pa'i snag tsha mar sbyar bsku/ /tsan+dan dmar po btsod dang ni/ /ru rta seng phrom pri yad+ku—/ /sran ⑧chung n+ya gro dha'i ⑨myu gu/ /lde gus ngo shig sel byed cing / /bzhin mdangs gsal bar byed pa yin/ /zi ra gnyis dang til nag dang / /yungs kar 'o mar bcas pa ni/ /btags pa'i lde gus gdong bskus na/ /ngo shig sel zhing zla 'drar byed/ /sran chung phub ma med brngos pa⑩/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi mar btags bsku/ /tsher ma rno ba'i shal ma li'i⑩/ /'o mar btags pas ⑫bskus na phan/ /rgya shug tshi ⑫gu bu ram bcas/ /sbrang rtsi ri bong khrag sbyar bsku④//ru rta kha lung khya ba yi/ /nang sbangs sbrang rtsir bcas pa 'am/ /rkang mar rtsa ba ⑫ra'i 'o ma/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i lde gu'ang phan/ /rkang mar rtsa ba ba lang rus//sbrang rtsi ⑩mar dang bcas pas ⑩bsku/ /'dzam bu a mra'i lo ma dang / /ser po rnam gnyis zho ga ⑫chu/ /bu ram sar pa sbyar ba 'am/ / tin du ⑫ka yi lo ma yi/ /khu bar btags pa yang ⑪mdog gsal byed/ /ut+pal sngo dang ru rta dang / /111—773

tsan+dan ser po pri yang ku/ /rgya shug tshi ①gu'i lde gu yis/ /gdong ni bskus zhing ④dril gyur na/ /pad+ma'i mdog dang 'dra bar byed/ /sman ni 'di dag btags pa dang / /shing mngar dang bcas bskol snum ni/ /nad gzhi ji bzhin ma lus la/ /btung dang bsku ba la sogs bya/ /nas dang seng phrom sra ①rtsi pog /spra tshil sbrang rtsi pu tse shel/ /mar dang bu ram ba gcin ni/ /gzar bur chags kyi bar du bskol/ /de bskus pa yis dusme ba dang / /ngo shig mdzer pa myur sel byed/ /gdong ni pad+ma 'drar byed cing / /rkang pa pad+ma'i ⑤'dab 'drar byedabu/ /gur gum shing mngar pu shel tse/ /tsan+dan ser dang rgya byegs dang / /tsan+dan dkar dang n+ya gro dha'i/ /rkang pa gzhon nu shug pa dang / /de bzhin pad+ma ge sar dang / /ut+pal sngon po btsod dang bcas/ /srang re chu bye bzhi ⑦nang du/ /bskol te bzhi cha lus pa ru/ /rgya skyegs btsod dang le brgan rtsi⑧/ /shing mngar gur gum zho gnyis gnyis/ /phye ma til mar srang brgyad dang / /de yi nyis 'gyur 'o ma bskol/ /de ni sna sman tshul bsten na—/ /sme ba ngo shig skra dkar dang / /gnyer ma gdong gi dri ma sel/ /gdong gi sha rgyas mdog gsal ⑨byed/ /btsod dang seng phrom sha ba ⑩ri/ /rgya skyegs ldong ros du ba ri/ /gur gum ru rta ser po gnyis/ /gi ⑪wang tsan+dan rnam gnyis dang / /n+ya gro dha yi lo ma dang / /dngul chu rma shing tsan+dan ser/ /dha du ra yi shun pa yi⑫/ /sa bon pad+ma ge sar dang / / spra tshil spangs ⑫ma shug pa sogs/ /zhag dang 'o ma rkang dang mar/ /'o ma can shing 'o ma ni/ /bskol ba'i mar ni bskus gyur na/ /ngo shig gnyer ma sogs 'joms shing / /bzhin ni pad+ma'i mdangs 'drar 'gyur/ /bring ⑫ga ra dza' khu bar ni/ /'o ma 111—774

chu bskol sna sman bsngags/ /pags pa tshor med la rlung gi/ /gso ba dang ni me btsa' bya/ /pags nad zlum por bad mkhris bshad/ /mdze nad sel ba thams cad phan/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu gnyis pa'o// //de nas gsang ba'i nad kyi dmigs shes pa bshad par bya'o/ /bud med nyal po spangs pa las/ /mod la bsten par gyur pa 'am/ /nad dang bcas shing dogs pa las①/ /dri ma can nam zla mtshan nam/ /skye gnas gzhan dang mi 'dod dang / /bgrod min gsar du btsas pa dang / /dga' ②ba'i mthar ni dug can sogs/ /chus reg pa 'am ma bgrus ①dang / /bskyed pa'i bsam pas sman rnon po'irjo/ /lde gu la sogs bskus pa dang / /khu tshur so dang sen mo dang / /gra ma dug can gyis reg dang ⑤/ /shugs dgag pa dang yun ring du—/ /reg pa rtsub pas bdar ba 'am/ /nad gzhi 'khrugs pas rjogasang bar zhugasarka/ /sos 'dzin lta bu la sogs nad/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum 'byung bar 'gyur / /sos 'dzin lta bu 'dir lnga ste/ /nad gzhi re re khrag las gyur/ /'dus pa'i nad las gyur pa'o/ /de la rlung gyur pho mtshan skrangs/ /nad mang rtag ldang pags 'gas pa'o/ /mkhris pa las gyur skrang ④rims 'debs/ /u dusmra skera'i 'bras smin 'dra/ /bad kan gyis mkhrang snum pa dang / /g.ya' zhing skrangs la lci ba yin/ /khrag gyur 'brum bu nag po 'byung / /khrag 'dzag rims kyis 'debs par byed/ /'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun dang ldan/ /rlig 'bras gnyis kyang skrang bar ⑨byed/ /mi bzad ⑩na zhing lhung ba dang / /111—775

gas shing srin bu skye ba yin/ /de las khrag gyur 'tsho ba tsam/ /'dus pa las gyur 'chi bar byed/ /nad 'khrugs pa las pho mtshan gnas/ /sha khrag las ni pho mtshan gyi/ /phyi 'am yang na nang du ni/ /mdzer pa g.ya' bar byed pa 'byung / /khrag ni spyi ①bag 'dzag par byed⑤/ /mo mtshan de 'dra ①gdugs ltar 'dug /de ni 'brum nad dum gsos na/ /pho mo'i khu khrag nyams byed gsod / /pho mtshan gyi ni phyi 'am nang / /bad kan khrag gyur 'brum phran ni/ /tshad dang dbyebs ni yungs kar 'dra/ /stug ⑤po'i yungs kar zhes byar bshad/ /bad kan khrag gyur 'brum bu ni/ /ring zhing mang por gyur pa la/ /dbus nas gas pa gang yin pa/ /de ni nges par 'joms shes bya/ / na zhing rjob sru brtse ⑦bar byed/ /khrag mkhris las ni ⑧'dzam bu yi/ /rus pa ltar 'dug khong stong can/ /'bras byer gcin snyi 'drar shes bya/ /khrag mkhris las gyur 'brum phran ni/ /ma sha muṅga 'dra mchog yin/ /pad+ma'i steng du ge sar bzhin/ /'brum bu ⑨'brum phran gyis khyab pa/ /de ni pad+ma can zhes bya/ /lag pa gnyis kyis rab mnyes pa/ /de ni mnyes pa'i 'brum bur gyur/ /mtshan ni mnyes par gyur pa las/ /rlung 'khrugs gyur pa mnyes pa yin/ /mi mnyam sra zhing yon por ⑩ni/ /rlung 'khrugs gyur pa gtun ⑪shing yin/ /rlung gis mnyes pa la sogs pa'i/ /nad 'khrugs mtshan gyi pags pa ni/ /ldog cing tsha la nad ⑫bcas shing / /la lar ⑫shu ba dag tu 'gyur/ /'dus shing mdud pa chags pa ni/ /de yi ④nor bu thur ⑩du 'phyang / /pags pa ldog pa'i nad ces bya/ /bad kan bcas las g.ya' ⑩zhing sra/ /rma 'tshob dka' ⑩zhing pags pa gas/ /gas pa'i nad ces bya bar bshad/ /rlung gis pags pa skeganod 'gyur zhing / /111—776

nor bu 'byar zhing gcin 'gag ①'gyur/ /de las rgyun phra ②nad med 'byung / /nor bu'i kha ni 'gags ④gyur pas/ /de ni nor bu'i nad ces bya/ /bad kan las gyur mtshan gyi nad/ /gra mas gang snyam mdud pa'i nad/ /gra mas gnod pa'i khrag gi nad/ /tshor ba nyams pa de ming can/ /rlung dang khrag mkhris las gyur pa/ /bu ga'i rtse mo phra rjob yis/ /mtshan gyi nang ni kun tu khyab/ /de ni kha brgya pa zhes bya/ /khrag mkhris las gyur pags pa rnams⑤/ /tsha zhing rims bcas pags pa smin/ /'dus pa las gyur sha rnams nirjo/ /thams cad ngan pas ⑦smin pa yin/ /'brum bu gnag cing dmar ba yi⑧/ /'brum bu dag gis ⑨gnod 'gyur shing / /pho mtshan shin tu na ba gang / /de ni khrag gi 'brum bu yin/ /sha yi mdzer pa sngar ⑩bshad do/ /khong 'bras nad gzhi gsum las skyes/ /'dus pas mtshan ni rnags gyur cing ⑪/ /sha ni nag por gyur pa dang / /kun nas zhig ⑫par byed pa gang / /de ni til nag ces brjod bshad/ /sha las gyur pa'i 'brum bu rnags⑫/ /khong 'bras til nag ces bya ba/ /bzhi po ④'di dag spang bar bya/ /lhag ma rnams ni myur du gso/ /kha zas gnod pa zos pa dang / /mal stan mi bder nyal ba ⑫dang / /nyal po bsten ni drags pa dang / /nang na nad khrag sman gnod dang / /sa bon nyes pa rnam smin las/ /mngal gyi nad ni ⑩nyi shur 'gyur/ /rlung gis mngal la gnod gyur pas/ /na zug yangs shing tshor ba med/ /grog mas khyab pa snyam du sems / /sra zhing rtsub pa sgra dang bcas/ /zla mtshan sla zhing sbra ba can/ /nyung zhing gnag pa 'dzag par byed/ /chu so rtsib logs lhod pa dang / /na zhing rim gyis skran bskyed la/ / rang rang ⑩nyes pa de dang de/ /de ni rlung 111—777

can yin zhes bshad/ /de nyid shas cher spyad na skrang ①/ /bcas pa nyal po drags zhes bya/ /shin tu gzhon lal 'khrig pa spyadasno/ /rgyab dang chu so byin par ni/ /na zhing mngal la gnod byed pa/ /de ni spyad sngas pa zhes bya/ /shugs 'khyil ba yi mngal du ni④/ /rlung gis gnod par gyur pa las⑤/ zla mtshan lbu ba can 'byung ba/ /'khyil ba lta bur snang gyur pa/ /nad 'di 'khyel pa can zhes bya'u/ /gang tshe rlung ni ⑦rtsub pos bu/ /skye zhing skye zhing gsod byed pa/ /skyes 7nas gsod pa zhes byar bshad/ /'grangs ⑨drags mi mnyam gnas par ni/ /'dod pa 1 sna spyad pas rlung 'khrugs shing / /gzhan gyis gnod par gyur pa las/ /mtshan gyi bu ga sha rus la/ /gnod gyur mngal ni yon bor 'gyur/ /na gyur nang du kha bltas yin/ /kha zas rlung can bsten pa yis/ /zla mtshan rlung gis gnod gyur zhing ⑪/ /bud med mo mtshan zhum gyur par⑩/ /byed pa de ni khabs ⑫mig yin/ /dus su shugs bkag rlung 6'phel bas/ /bshang dang gci ba 'gag 6byed cing / /mo mtshan skam par byed pa dang / /shas cher na ba mngal skams yin/ /zhag drug gam ni zhag bdun nas/ /rlung gis nyubye mngal gnas khu ba 'byin/ /nad bcas pa 'am ⑫nad med pa/ /de ni khu ba slon zhes bya/ /bud med mngal dang sa bon gyispyo/ /nyes pa rlung gis gnod gyur zhing / /'khrig par mi dga' nu ma med/ /ma ning yin te gsor mi rung 1(/ /mngal gyi nang du rlung gis ni/ /gnod gyur mo mtshan khong 7khar gnas —nye/ /bye ba'am lhod par gyur pa dang / /rlung can bzhin du na gyur pa/ /sha ni mtho bar gyur pa ste/ /mo mtshan che nad tshabs che ⑫bya / /mkhris pa mngal na gnas pa yi 3 / /nang gi nad gzhis gnod gyur pa/ /111—778

tsha ba'am rnag lhapar byed 'gyur zhing / /dri mnam rims kyis 'debs pa dang //shin tu tsha zhing ro ltar mnam/ /zla mtshan sngo nag ser por 'dzag /nad de mkhris pa can zhes bya/ /zla mtshan cher 'dzag khrag can 4yin/ /bad kan skyed par byed pa yis/ /mo mtshan gnod gyur na ba med/ /grang zhing dkar la g.ya' ba dang / /spyin bag tu ni 'dzag par byed/ /nad de bad kan las gyur ④ yin/ /rlung mkhris 'khrugs pas zla mtshan zad/ /tsha zhing lus skems mdog mi sdug /de ni khrag zad pa zhes bya/ /mkhris pa shas che nyal po bsten//sgrid ⑤ pa sgregs pa bkag pa las/ /mkhris par bcas pa'i rlung gis ni/ /mngal du gnod pa skyed par 'gyur/ / skrang zhing d+ku nyam thag reg mi bzod/ /zla mtshan sngo dang ser por ⑦'byung / / pho ba'i thulto ni lci ba dang / /'khru zhing yi ga 'chus par byed/ /chu so brla ni na zhing zug /rims skyed yongs rgyas nad ces bya/ /rlung dang bad kan nad kyis khyab/ /mngal nas skye zhing spyi ⑨bag 'dzag /nye bar 'dzag pa zhes bya'o/ /srin bu skyes shing g.ya' bas 'dod pa las⑪/ /rab gdungs ⑪ de ni rnam par g.yeng zhes bya/ /dus min spyod par gyur pas rlung / /bad kan khrag dang 'dres gyur te/ /zla mtshan lam ni ⑫'gag byed de/ /mngal du lte ba 8skyed par byed/ /de ni pad+ma'i snying po yin/ /nad gzhi gsum ni mo mtshan gyi/ /mngal nas ④rang rang gnod pa skyed / /'dus pa las gyur nyes pa yin/ /de ltar bud med mngal nad kyis//khu ba 'dzin par mi byed de/ / des na yomangal du bu mi chags( 7/ /mi bzad nad kyang skye 'gyur zhing / /khrag 'byung ⑩gzhang 'brum skran la sogs/ /rlung sogs nad ni kun skyed byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/111—779

phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu gsum pa'o// //de nas gsang ba'i gnas kyi nad gso ba'i le'u ①bshad par bya'o/ /sos 'dzin 'dra ba gsar byung la/ /pho mtshan dbus na ④gtar ga gdab/ /bsil ba'i gso bas sbyang bar bya①/ /khyad par du ni bkru sman gtang / /smin na til gyi lde gu ni/ /sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas pa bsku/ /'dzam bu a mra klu shing dang / / nim pa kam rjopo dza' myu gu/ /rgya shug bil ba sa li ka /rgya skyegs til ⑤ni sha yi shun/ /'o ma can gyi shing gi shun/ /'bras bu gsum ni chur bskol ba'i/ /khu ba des ni bkru ba dang / /de bskol til mar gyis rma 'tshob—/ /spangs rjom seng phrom btsag yug snam/ /sug spel ldong ros ba bla ⑦dang / /nag tshur rgya skyegs skeskyer khaṇ+ḍa/ /rgyam tsha ha re khu ka yi/ /phye ma ⑨sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku⑩/ /sos 'dzin lta bu'i rma 'tshob byed/ /kham phor sbyar bar ⑪'bras bu gsum/ /bsregs pa mar bcas ⑫rma 'tshob byed/ /'di ⑫ni spyi yi gso ba yin/ /re re skrang ba ④lta bur gso/ /sman pas ci nas rnags par ni⑫—/ /mi 'gyur de ltar 'bad par bya/ / rnags na rgyus pa rtsa dang sha /zhig ⑩pas pho mtshan ma rungs 'gyur/ /'brum pa bcad dang bsregs pa yi⑩/ /gso ba sos 'dzin lta bur bya/ /brud nas ⑫yungs kar phye ⑪zhib dang / /bskol sman phye mas ⑩gdab par bya/ /til mar de nyid kyis bsku zhing / /rma 'tshob pa yi gso ba bya/ / mnye gso ba ni ⑥'di nyid bya/ /de dag ⑫gnyi gar gtar ga gdab/ /khong stong la ni gtar ga bya/ /rnags ⑫la rma ni dag par bya/ /tin du ka dang 'bras bu gsum/ /seng phrom sde gu til mar bskucha/ /'bras 111—780

byer la ni gtar ga gdab/ /gso ba'i rim pa 'di nyid bya/ /mchog ces bya ba'i 'brum bu ni/ /brtol te lcags kyus blangs te bcad/ /lde gu phye ma sman khu niske/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pas gso bar bya/ mnye ①dang pad+ma can la ni/ /mkhris pa'i me dbal gso bar bya/ /pags smin tshor ba med pa la'ang / /pho mo'i gso ba 'di nyid bya/ / mnye la ②dugs ni bya ba dang / /ba la'i ①sman mar dro 'jam blugs/ /mngar ba'i sman sbyar dkri dugs bya/ /gtun rjoshing 'dra la gtar ga gdab/ /bad kan rmen bu lta bur gso/ /pags pa ldog la mar gyis bsku/ /sa ⑤lba la sogs snum gyur pas/ /zhag gsum mam ni zhag lnga ru / /dkri ba'i las ༷ni spyad par bya/ /dugs bya de yi 'og tu ni/ /snum gyur pags pa drang bar bya/ /nor bu rim gyis btsir nas ni/ /chud nas nye bar dkri bar bya/ /nor bu yang yang snum chos ⑦bya/ /kha zas snum can sbyin pa'ang phanaske/ /gas pa la yang cho ga yi/ /rim pa ji bzhin byas pa'ang ⑧phan/ /'gags pa stisbu gu kha gnyis pa/ /rgya skyegs kyis spyoni dkris pa la/ /snum bskus ⑩bu gar bcug nas ni/ /rlung 'joms snum ni blugs par bya/ /sbu gu zhag ni gsum gsum nas/ /legs par bskyed de spang bar ⑫bya/ /sbu gu'i sbyor bas ma grub na/ /mkhas pas mdoms ⑫kyi srubs can ni/ /bor te mtshon gyis dral nas kyang / /de 'og rma gsar ⑫cho ga bya⑫/ /rmen bur ⑩sbu gu'i dugs byas la/ /snum zhing dro bas dkri spyobar bya/ /kha brgya pa ni bzhar nas kyang / /bska ⑫ba sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bsku/ /khrag gi 'brum bu khrag gi ni/ /khong 'bras bzhin du gso bar bya/ /kun la rma yi gso ba ni/ /gnas skabs ji bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /mngal kyi nad la mang du ni/ /snum chos spyodugs dang 111—781
