mas gtong sogs/ /rlung 'joms pa yi gso ba bsngags/ /rlung las gyur la ①mchog tu sbyar/ /bud med kyi ni mngal gyi nad/ /rlung ma gtogs par 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de bas rlung ni bsal byas la/ /nad gzhan gyis ②ni gso sman bya//ba la'i ①til mar blud bya zhing / /'dren ma skye de'i 'o ma blud/ /snum chos ④dugs ni byas te mngal/ / nyes par ⑤gnas pa mnyam du gzhag /yon po lag pas drang por bsrang bu/ /zhum pa slar ni bskyed par bya/ /byung ba ⑦slar ni gzhug bya zhing / /gyes pa yongs su bzlog par bya/ /mngal ni gnas nas g.yos gyur pa/ /bud med zug rngur gyur par 'dod/ /bud med la ni slon sman sogs/ /'jam po yongs su sbyar bar bya/ /rnam pa kun tu dag gyur nas//'jam rtsi bsku byug sman khu blugs/ /byugs nidang ye'u gzhug la sogs/ /gso ba'i las ni lhag ma spyad/ /rgun 'brum tang pal 'bras bu gsum/ /ka sa mar da ⑨ser po gnyis/ /sle tres nye'u ⑩shing sher+ya ka /shu ka na sa ba spru ba/ /pa ru sha ka zho gnyis gnyis/ /mar ni bre gang bcas par bskol/ /de blud mngal gyi rlung nad dang / /bu skyed byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /zi ra go snyod pi pi ling / /shu dag rgyam tsha ba sha ka /nas tshig 'khus ⑪thal ti mu sa/ /tsi tra ka dang kha rar bcas/ /btags te chang gi dwangs mar sbyar/ /mar brngos de ni byen gyur na/ /mngal nad rtsib logs snying nad dang / /skrangs dang gzhang 'brum sel bar byed/ / kha lung khu ba ka sha'i ⑫rtsa ba/ /zi ra nag po go snyod dang / /sen rtsi rgyam tsha'i phye ma ni/ /chang dang sbyar te blud par bya/ /ra sna gze ma ba sha ka /bskol ba gzer 'joms mchog yin no/ /sle tres dan da 'bras bu gsum/ /bskol ba'i khu ba'ang blugs ⑫par bya/ /rgya spos kaṇ+ḍa ka ri 111—782

dang / /ru rta rgyam tsha thang shing rnams/ /bskol ba'i khu ba til mar bskol/ /sbangs pa'i ye'us mngal nad sel/ /mngal nad mkhris pa las gyur pa/ /chu blugs stibasku byug ye'u yis/ /gso ba bsil zhing mkhris 'joms pa/ /snum chos ⑦don du mar gyis bya/ /nye'u 1shing rtsa ba srang bzhi brgya/ /brdungs te bcir ba'i khu ba dang / /'o ma de mnyam mar bye ( ni/ /bzhi yi nang du bskol bar bya/ /'tsho byed sde tshan nye'u grushing dang / /pa ru sha ka rgun 'brum dang / /pi la ya dang ba la myeganyis/ /shing mngar zho ni gnyis gnyis phye/ /bskol te bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi dang / /pi pi ling ni srang brgyad brgyad/ /ka ra dkar po srang bcu gzhug /de las srang ni phyed phyed sbyin/ /mngal khrag khu ba'i nad sel zhing / /ro tsa bu skyed byed mchog yin/ /glo rdol zad byed khrag mkhris dang / /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba dang / /mig ser rlung dang khrag dang ni/ /me dbal dang ni snying nad dang / /brjed ⑩byed kyis nyen da rgan dang / /myos byed ⑧ skem byed 'joms par byed/ /de bzhin 'o ma zhun mar dang //'tsho byed sde tshan bskol ba ni/ /bu skyed mkhris pa las gyur pa'i/ /mngal nad sel ba'i dam pa yin/ /ba la /bre ni sum cu gnyis/ /bskol ba'i ⑪til mar mar bye bzhi/ /'o ma bzhi 'gyur pi pi ling / /ka ka ma kyesi ka ra dkar/ / dzi ban ti ⑫dang ram nye ba/ /sbri ra nye shing zi ra gnyis/ /mon sran gre'u pa ya su/ /ma sha ⑫parte sra ba ni/ /pi lu'i lo ma lhan cig bskol/ /blud na rlung mkhris las gyur pa'i/ /mngal nad sel zhing bu skyed byed/ /khrag gi mngal nad khrag mdog las/ /rjes su 'byel ba brtags nas kyang / /nad gzhi tsho 7bsags pa'i tshul las ni/ /khrag bcad pa yi sman gtang bya/ /shing mngar 111—783

sbrang rtsi chu shing rtsa/ /ta la'i sa bon skyer pa'i rtsa/ /pri yang ku dang 'bras drus ①chuske/ /sbyar ba blud na khrag 'dzag pa/ /mdog skya dmar po sel bar byed/ /pa tha ②'dzam bu a mra yi/ /tshi gu ④dang ni brag zhun dang / /skyer pa'i ④khaṇ+ḍa e baṣ+ṭa⑤/ /btsod dang shal ma ༷li'i thang chu/ /dug mo nyung gi shun lpags dang / /gur gum bil ba bong nga dkar/ /seng phrom gla ⑦sgang btsag yug snam/ /shing mngar tsan+dan dmar po dang / / kad pa la ⑧dang tsa ma ⑨ka /ka ṭang ka ⑩dang dug mo nyung / /bye tsher ba dang da ta ⑪ki/ /ma du ka dang stang zil ni/ /skar ma rgyal la bab pa na/ /btus shing btags te ⑫sbrang rtsi dang / /'bras kyi chur ⑫sbyar blud na ni/ /gzhang 'brum tshad par 'khru ba dang / /gang yang khrag tu 'khru ba dang / /gang yang srin bu'i nad rnams dang / /byis pa'i nad gang yin pa 'joms/ /mngal gyi ⑫nad dang zla mtshan nad/ /gnag cing dkar dang dmar ba sel/ /phye ma rgyal gyi rjes 'gro ba/ /phan zhes rgyun shes bu yis bshad⑫—/ /bad kan las gyur mngal nad la/ /rtsub dang dro ba'i sman kun sbyar// skyu ru'i lo ma da ta spyoki/ /shing mngar ut+pal lig bu mig /'dzam bu a mra'i tshi ⑩gu dang / /seng phrom sa nag kad pa ⑫la/ /se'u 'bru shing tsha tin du ⑪ka /u dum bā ⑫ra bil ba gzhon/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis btags pa'i phye/ /ra gcin 'o ma nyis 'gyur dang / /til mar bye gang bskol bar bya/ /de bsku ba ⑫dang 'jam rtsi dang / /ras bal ye'us gzhug par bya/ / skrang zhing phyir log ⑫mtho zhing sra/ /de bzhin spyi bag 'dzag pa dang / /phyir 'bur nang du zhum pa dang / /'brum bu gzer dang bcas la phan/ /nas zan a ru ⑫sbyar chang dang ④//bu ram chang dang til mar bsten/ /pi pi ling dang lcags phye dang / /a ru ra 111—784

sbyor sbrang rtsi phan/ /nag tshur rgyam tsha 'bras bu gsum/ /a mra 'dzam bu'i tshi ①gu bcas/ /da ta ka'i ④phye sbrang rtsir sbyar/ / spyi bag ske'adzag pa dag par byedarka/ /rgya skyegs 'dzam bu da ta duki/ /so ma ra dza la mang gi/ /sra rtsi pog gi phye ma yis/ /dri mi zhim dang spyi ⑤bag 'dzag /rnags rjoshing sra ba sel bar byed/ /dong ga la sogs sde tshan ni/ /bskol ba'i khu ba blugs ⑦par bya/ /sra zhing rtsub par gyur pa la/ /mnyen pa'i cho ga bya ba dang / /sha brdungs pa yis ⑧glan pa dang / /kri sa ra dang 'o thug gzhug /dri ngar ⑨til mar dri zhim pa'am/ /lde gu dri zhim bsku ba 'am/ /dri bzangs ⑩kun gyi phye ma 'am/ /rul ba'i dri ni sel byed gzhug /bad kan can la phal cher sman/ /tsha ba ba gcin mas gtong phan/ /mkhris pa shing mngar 'o mar bcas/ /rlung gyur skyur bcas til mar phan/ /'dus pa las gyur nad la ni/ /thun mong gis ni gso ba phan/ /de ltar mngal ni dag gyur na/ /sa bon skyon med tha mal bar//rnam par shes pa 'jug pas na/ /bud med la ni bu chags 'gyur/ /skyes pa yi ni dbang po yang / /las rnam ⑪lnga yis dag bya zhing / /mdog las nad gzhi brtags nas ni/ /nad bcas de 'joms sman gyis ⑫gso/ /ru rta rgya spos shu dag ⑫btsod/ /'bras bu gsum dang ka ra dkar/ /shing mngar me da ser po gnyis/ /la la phud dang pu tse shel/ /shing mngar ⑫ram nye pa ya su / /a shwa garnya nye'u shing pa/ /zho ni gnyis gnyis btags pa'i phye/ /mar bre gang dang 'o ma ni/ /bzhi 'gyur bcas pa bskol bar bya/ /blud na mngal dang khu ba yi/ /nyes pa thams cad sel byed cing / /tshe ring lus ni rgyas byed la/ /yid gzhungs pa dang bkra shis dang / /bu skyed par ni byed 111—785

mchog yin/ /'bras bu'i sman mar zhes byar bshad/ /zla mtshan rgyu tshe 'thungs ①gyur na/ /bu ni 'chi bar byed pa yang / /'tsho zhing sbrum ma rnams la ⑤bsngags/ /'di ni mchog tu byes pa yi/ /lus rgyas gdon 'joms byed pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mchon spyad kyis dze+egaso ba'i yan lag rdzogs so// //de nas dug nad gso ba bshad par bya'o/ /sngon ni lha dang lha ma yin/ /bdud rtsi 'dod pas rjobasrubs pa na/ /bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i sngon rol du/ /skyes bu shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /mche ba bzhi pa gzi brjid 'bar/ /skra ser mig ni me 'bar ba/ /de mthong 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyur/ /des na 'di ni dug ces bya/ /tshangs pas hūṃ ⑤zhes brjod pa dang / /bslu ba'i bdag nyid can spangs te/ /gzugs de rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i/ /gzugs la de ni zhugs par gyur/ /brtan dug nus pa mi bzad par/ /sdong bu la ni gnas pa gang / /ka la ku ta dbang po'i bu/ /btsan dug ha la ha la sogs/ /rgyu ba'i dug ni mi bzad gyur/ /sbrul dang phag dang mche ba canarjo/ /rgyu ba dang ni mi rgyu ba'i/ /bcos ma ma yin dug tu bshad/ /bcos ma sna tshogs sman la ⑦ni/ /sbyar ba sbyar ba'i dug ces bya/ /de ni sbyor ba'i dbang las ni/ /shin tu ring nas gsod pa 'am/ /skrang ⑧dang skya rbab dmu ⑨rdzing dang / /smyo byed gzhang 'brum la sogs bskyed/ /rno dro rtsub cing dang ba dang / /khyab 111—786

cing myur gsod yang ba dang / /'dar zhing phra ①la ro mi gsal/ /'ju bar mi byed pa yin no/ /rno sogs yon tan dang ldan pas/ /de ni mdangs las go bzlog yin/ /mi 1ni rlung mkhris shas che ba/ /srog ni 'phral du 'phrog par byed—/ /dug gis lus su snephyin pa dang / /dang por khrag la gnod par byed/ /bad kan mkhris pa rlung rjes la/ /nad gzhi grogs dang lhan cig 'byung / /de nas snying la gnas nas ni/ /lus la gnod par byed par 'gyur/ /mi rgyu'i dug ni btang gyur na/ /bye gnag lus ni rengs pa dang / /brgyal dang slon dang sngang rjodang ngal/ /gnas skabs dang por ⑤'byung bar 'gyur/ /gnyis par 'dar zhing rngul ba dang / /tsha zhing lkog ma na ba dang / /dug gis ma zhu'i ④gnas phyin na/ /snying ni na bar byed par 'gyur/ /gsum par ⑦rkan ni bskams pa dang / /ma zhu'i gnas su shin tu gzer/ /de'i mig nyam ⑧chung ser ba dang / / skrang ba ⑨nyid du 'gyur ba dang / /zhu ba'i gnas phyin zug pa dang / /sprigs bu lud pa rgyu ma 'khrug⑩ /dug gi shugs ni bzhi pa la/ /mgo bo lhag par phyi bar 'gyur/ /lnga par mchil snabs 'dzag pa dang / /lhu tshigs na ba ⑪'byung 'gyur la/ /mdog mi sdug cing nad kun 'khrug⑫ /zhu ba'i gnas kyi 'og tu na/ /drug par 'du shes nyams pa dang / /shin tu 'khrul ⑫bar byed par 'gyur/ /bdun par phrag ⑫gong sgal tshigs dang / /dpyi tshigs bye na 'chi 'gyur yin/ /dug gi shugs ni dang po la/ /slon zhing chu grang dag gis gtor/ /mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa yi/ /dug gi sman ni myur du blud/ /gnyis par skyug spyosman bkru sman gtang / /snga ma bzhin du dug sman blud/ /gsum par dug gi sman blud cing / /de bzhin mig sman sna 117—787

sman gtang / /bzhi par ①snum dang bcas pa yi/ /dug gi sman ni btang na phanaske/ /lnga par ②shing mngar khu ba dang / /sbrang rtsir ①sbyar ba blud na phan//drug par du'akhru ba lta bur gso/ /bdun par ⑤sna sman dud pa dang / /spyi bor rgya gram byas nas ni/ /sha 'am khrag ni gzhug par bya/ /ko sha ta ki lang ga li/ /pa tha rjolcam pa a ru ra/ /sā ⑦lu sle tres shi ri sha /gi ri kar ni yung ba dang / / ha yang ⑧sbrang rtsi ba spru ba/ /bri ha ti gnyis tsha ba gsum/ /sha ri ba dang ba la ste⑨/ /'di rnams bskol ba'i khu ba dang / /bskol ba'i nas thug ⑩bsgrangs par ni/ /sbrang rtsi mar dang bcas pa gzhug /gnas skabs gzhan la dug 'joms pa'i/ /sman dang gso ba thams cad bya/ /shing mngar tsan+dan ma du ka /pad+ma ge sar de bzhin bya/ /dngul rdo rgya spos ru rta dang / /ba bla ldong ros pri yang ku/ /tsha ba gsum dang 'bu su hang / /nā ga put+pa ge sar bcas / /shing mngar spang spos ha re rku/ /gi ⑪wang mon sne'u rme ru dang / /shi ri beṣ+ṭa ⑫sra rtsi pog /shu ti gur gum ba la ⑫dang / /bal bu ta ma ⑫la'i lo ma—/ /stag pa dang ni pu shel tse/ /ser po gnyis ni sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /bu mo khrus dang smyung ba byas/ /gos ⑫dkar bgos pa byas nas ni/ /dge sbyong bram ze mchod byas te/ /dug sman mchog ni sbyar bar bya/ /de tshe sman pas sngags 'dis spyoni/ /bdag nyid bsngags spyote brjod par bya/ /skyes bu seng ger ⑫phyag 'tshal lo/ /sred med bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar khyab 'jug g.yul ngor ni/ /gzhan gyis pham par ma mthong ste/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis kyang / /bdag la dug med grub par shog /na mo be+e ḍūr+ya ma de/ /hu ṭu hu ṭu rak+ṣa mospyo/ sarba bi ṣe bh+yaḥgo ri/ garnya ⑥ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ma tang gi ⑪swā 111—788

hā / /'thag pa'i sngags gnyis pa ni/ ha ri mā ye swa hā/ ba ha mā ye swā ①hā| /ma lus dug dang ro langs dang / /gdon gyi las ②dang sdig pa ①dang //gsod byed nad dang mu ge dang / /'thab par 'dod dang 'jigs pa la/ /sman btung sna sman mig sman bsku/ /gdu bu la sogs la sbyar byarjo/ /'di ni zla shar zhes bya ste/ /zhi dang bde legs byed mchog yin/ /dug rnying dug sel sman gyis ⑤zil mnan pa/ /nags me rlung dang nyi tshan gyis bskams pa'am /rang bzhin gyis ni yon tan mi ldan pas/ /nyams pa'i dug ces bya ba'i dug tu 'gyur—/ /'di ni nus pa chung bas mi rtogs te/ /bad kan dang 'dres lo ni mang por gnas/ /des nyen gyur pa mdog ngan 'khru bar byed/ /nad khrag skom dad yi ga 'chus pas nyen/ /brgyal dhizhing slon la rnam rmongs skad 'dzer dang / /dug gis ⑦dmu rdzing mtshan mas gnod par 'gyur/ /ma zhu'i gnas brten bad kan rlung nad skyed/ /zhu ba'i gnas brten ⑧mkhris dang rlung nad ⑨skyedaske/ /mi yi yan lag zhig cing ⑩skra 'byi bas/ /ji ltar bya ni spu btogs lta bur byed⑩/ /dwangs ma'am khrag la gnas par byed na ni/ /lus zungs las byung nad ni sna tshogs skyed/ /mdun gyi rlung dang ma zhu grang ⑫/ /yul dmus gnod zas nyin par nyal/ /lus zungs gnod par byas pa na/ /de bas gnod pa'i dug ces bshad/ /gnod pa'i dug nyen dugs byas ⑫la/ /steng dang 'og nas sbyang bar bya/ /gnod pa'i dug ni sel ba'i sman/ /sbrang rtsi sbyar te lde gu sbyin/ /pi pi ling dang bya ma ka /spang spos seng phrom sug smel dang / /ku tan na ta sardzi④ka /ru rta shing mngar tsan+dan dang / /yug snam btsag spyodang sbyar ba'i sman/ /gnod pa'i dug sel zhes bya ⑩ste/ /gzhan 111—789

yang zlog par byed pa yin/ /dug mdas phog par gyur pa dag /yang dang yang du mun 'thibs byed/ /mdog ni mi sdug gyur pa dang / /myur du yid 'byung sdug bsngal ①'thob/ /'dis ni srin bus khyab pa ltar/ /lus tsha tsag tsag ④por 'gyur ro/ /gdong mo rgyab dang phrag pa mgo/ /lhu tshigs rnams su na bar byed④/ /khrag ni nad can gnag pa 'dzag /skom dang brgyal tsha rims kyis 'debs/ /mig ni gnag cing slon pa dang / / btud mar lud pa rjodabugs mi bde/ /rma dmar mtha' mar ⑤ser ba dang / /dbus ni gnag cing shin tu na/ /'phral du skrangs shing rnags dupa dang / /sha yang nag por gyur nas ni/ / gnag cing ⑦shin tu 'drul bar byed/ /spyi ⑧bag can du 'dzag par byed/ /gnad du phog par ma gyur pa/ /myur du snying la phan byed bya/ /zug rngu phyung la lcags bsregs pas/ /rma ni legs par bsreg par bya⑨/ /yang na mu ka ka ⑩dang ni/ /gi ri kaṇi dkar po ⑪dang / /kad pa la yi shun pa dang / /btsod dang shir sha bya rgod sen/ /bsregs pa'i thal bas bsku bar bya/ /shu ka na sa bong ⑫nga dkar/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i ⑫rtsa bas bsku—/ /dug 'thung spyosos btab gso ba dag /ci rigs par ni de la bya/ /rma yi sha ni rnags ⑫pa la/ /mkhris pa'i me dbal lta bur gso/ /bde phyir khyo la bud ⑩med dang / /rgyal po la ni dgras bslab ste⑩/ /zas dang sbyar ba'i dug bsres pa/ /nye ⑫'khor skye bor ⑪ster bar 'gyur/ /sna tshogs lus kyi dri mar bcas/ /mi mthun sman dang thal ba dang / /nus pa chung bar gyur pa'i dug /sbyar ba'i dug ni sbyar ma yin/ /des nyen mdog skya rid pa dang / /me drod ⑩nyams shing lud pa dang / /dbugs mi bde dang rims kyis ⑪nyen/ /111—790

rlung ni mi mthun rgyu ba dang / /gnyid che yid ni zhum par byed/ /gcin snyi lto ba mchin pa dang / /mcher pa na zhing skad gsang dma'/ /nyam ①chung sgyid ni zhan pa dang / /skrangs shing rtag tu sbo ba dang / /rkang pa lag pa skam zhing zad//rmi lam du ni ce spyang dang / /byi la sbrul dang ne+e'u le dang / /spre'u mthong zhing phal cher ni/ /nags tshal mtsho ni skams par mthong / /bdag nyid nag por mthong 'gyur zhing / /ser po nag por mthong bar byed/ /mig sna rna ba med pa dang / /de yi ②dbang po nyams par mthong / /'di dang gzhan yang ④gnod pa yi/ /bla brnan ④mi bzad mang pos ⑤gtses/ /'ga' zhig 'phral du ma gsos na/ /sbyar dug gis nyen 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dbyig dug dhislon byas kha zas ni⑦/ /de la phan pa'i bza' btung sbyin/ /sbyangs nas gser ni bsten bya zhing / /mdo nas ⑧bstan pa bzhin du bya/ /gser dang zangs ⑨kyi phye ma ni/ /sbrang rtsi kha ra dkar po ⑩sbyar/ /lde gus dug ni mi bzad dang ⑪/ /dbyig dug thams cad sel bar byed/ /mur ba sle tres pi pi ling / /rgya spos dbyi mo ⑫pa to la/ /gla sgang shu dag tsi tra ka / bye dang ⑫ka ni dar ba dang / /chu dron zho ga chur ④sbyar ba/ /skyur khu dang sbyar blud na ni/ /dbyeg dug gi ⑫bcom me drod sbyong / /zur ba ma nu phug ron gyi/ /sha bskol khu ba bsgrangs pa ni⑩/ /dbyig dug skom dang lud pa na/ /skyigs bu dbugs mi bde rims selaske/ / dug gi ⑩rang bzhin dus dang zas/ /nad gzhi lus zungs tshogs 'dus pa/ /dug gi nyam nga zhes bshad de/ /bkres skom nyam spyoni chung ba dang / /khro dang mya ngan 'jigs dang ngal/ /ma zhu ba dang 'khru ba dang / /mkhris pa rlung ni 'phel ba dang / /til gyi me tog 'bras bu snum/ /sa yi rlangs pa 111—791

'brug sgra dang / /gling bu pi wang rol mo yi/ /sgra dang mdun gyi ser bu dang / /ut+pal dri dang myos pa yis/ /dug gi nyam nga 'phel bar byed/ /dbyar ni char gi ①dus yin pas/ /bu ram lta bur rlan can 'gyur/ /lus la khyab byed dbyar 'das nas/ /ri byi ge'achar bas de med byed/ /de bas sprin bral dus su ni/ /nus pa chung ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de ltar rang bzhin goms pa dang / /gnas dus shugs stobs che chung ba/ /brtags te mkhas pas shes byas la/ /de rjes gso ba'i las spyad bya/ /bad kan can ni ⑪slon dang dro/ /rtsub dang rno ba'i sman bsku zhing / /bska dang kha dang tsha ba yis④/ /zas kyi dug ni bsal bar bya/ /mkhris can bkru sman sman chu blugs/ /shin tu bsil ba'i sman bsku zhing / /bska dang kha dang mngar ba dang / /mar bcas kha zas sbyin pas gso/ /rlung gi bdag nyid can mngar dang / /skyur dang lan tshwa mar bcas pa'i/ /bza' ba mar bcas ⑤bsku byug dang / /de bzhin sha ni bza' bas gso/ /bkru sman bsku byug kha zas sman/ /mar med rjobasngags pa ma yin no/ / dug kun ⑦gnas skabs thams cad du/ /dug 'joms mar dang 'dra ba yi/ /sman ni gzhan dag yod min te/ /mchog tu rlung shas che la phan/ /bad kan gnas zhugs gso bar sla/ /mkhris pa'i gnas brten 'bad pas gso/ /rlung gi gnas su zhugs pa'i dug /shin tu gso dka' gsor mi rung / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu rtsa lnga'o⑧// //de nas sbrul gyis zin pa gso ba'i le'u ⑨bshad par bya'o/ /mdor na 111—792

sa yi steng na ①sbrul/ /gsum ste gdengs ka can lus 'khyil/ /khra bo yin te de yi ni/ /dbye ba mtha' yas gyur pa sdedag /skye gnas dbye bas ①rgyas par ni/ /dgos pa med phyir ma bshad do/ /mchog tu rtsub dang tsha ba dang / /sgyur dro mngar bsel dag las ni/ /gdengs ka can la sogs pa'i dug /rim gyis rlung sogs 'khrug rjopar byed/ /gzhon dang rgan po bar ma dang / /dbyar dang dgun dang sos kar ni/ /'di dag dug ni 'phel 'gyur zhing / /gzhan dag dus tshigs rnams su 'gyur/ /'khor lo gshol ⑤dang g.yung drung gdugs / /lcags kyu'i mtshan mar ldan pa yinadhi/ /gdengs ka can ni myur 'gro ba/ /thams cad gdengs ka can zhes bya/ /lus 'khyil sna tshogs pa yi ni//zlum por ⑦'dug pa lus 'khyil zhing ⑧/ /ring zhing 'gros ni bul ba yin/ /ri mo sna tshogs ldan pa dang / /snum zhing kha dog sna tshogs pas/ /chu stizheng bris 'gyur khra bo yin/ /go dha'i ⑩bu ni go dha ⑪can/ /dug ni gdengs ka can mnyam ⑫la/ /rkang bzhi po yi sbrul gzhan ni/ /'di dag nyid ⑫ni 'dres pa lasarka/ /'dren ma'i mtshan nyid can te des/ /'dus pa'i nad ni ldang bar byed / /zas kyi don dang 'jigs pa dang / /rkang pas reg las ⑫dug rab 'khrugs⑫rka/ /rkang gi ⑩rgyu dang 'dres ⑩pa dang / /lha dang drang srong gshin spyorjes bskul/ /sbrul gyis zin par gang bshad pa/ /phyi ma bzhin du dug shas che//'jug pa'i rgyu ni shes byas nas/ /gso ba ji bzhin bya ba yin/ /phal pa sdig can ngang tshul bas/ /lam bkag nas ni gnas pa yin/ /gang du kha chu gsher ba tsam/ /lus la snang bar byed 'gyur zhing ⑪/ /mche ba'i rma ni mi mngon gang / /de ni mchus gnod ⑫byed ces bya/ /mche ba gcig las ⑫rjes 111—793

gnyis mngon/ /khrag med gyur pa bldags zhes bya/ /mche ba'i rjes ni khrag bcas gnyis/ /rnam par bcad ①pa'o de gsum ni/ /sha bcad shin tu phug ②pa dang / /khrag dbyung so ①yis zin zhes bya/ /mche ba'i rjes ni bzhi snang ba//de bzhin sos 'dzin btsir bar bshad/ /de las dang po dug med ④gnyis/ /phyi ma gnyis po gsor mi rung / /sbrul gyi dug ni khrag dag la/ /ma brten lus la gnod mi byed/ /khrag ni cung zad la brten yang / /til mar thigs ⑤pa bzhin du mched/ /sngar ma sgrul gyis reg pa las/ / 'jig pas ༷rlung ni 'khrug par byed/ /lan 'ga' skrang bar byed pa de⑦/ /sbrul gyis lus ni ⑧bcom zhes bya/ /bgod dka' mun par zug gyur pa⑨/ /la la rtog ⑩pas zin pa dang / /dug gi shugs ⑪dang slon dang rims/ /brgyal ba'am tsha ba skye ba 'am/ /na zhing rmongs bag 'khru bar 'gyur⑫/ /de ni rtog pa'i dug ces bya//dug bcas nad kyis zug pa dang / /skrang ⑫dang g.ya' dang rims bcas pa/ /la la tsha zhing rmen bur 'gyur⑫/ /de las bzlog pa dug med yin/ /gdengs ka can shugs dang po la/ /nad khrag nag por ⑫'dzag par 'gyur/ /mig dang gdong sogs gnag pa dang / /srin bu rgyu ⑩ba snyam du sems/ /shugs gnyis par ni rmen bu skye/ /gsum par mgo ni lci bar 'gyur/ /bzhi par ⑩mig 'byed dka' ba dang / /sos btab rnags ⑫shing mchil ma slon/ /lnga par tshigs 'bye ⑪snyam sems dang / /rgyud gzhan tshigs ni 'jig pa dang / /lus tsha skyigs bu 'byung ba yin/ /drug ⑫par snying na lus phyi zhing / /brgyal zhing 'khru la zas mi 'ju/ /bdun par khu ba'i gnas phyin nas/ /phrag gong rgyab dang sgal tshigs ⑥dang / /rked pa zhig pa snyam sems zhing / /spyod lam 111—794

thams cad las nyams 'gyur/ /de nas lus bskyil ①bas zin na/ /nad khrag ser por 'gyur ba dang / /de yi lus ser tsha ba skyed/ /gnyis par skrang bar ⑤'gyur ba yin/ /gsum par ①sos btab rnags 0pa dang / /rngul dang skom dad skye bar 'gyur/ /bzhi par khong tsha ⑤rims kyis 'debs/ /lnga par lus kun khyab par tsharjo/ /sbrul ni khra bos zin gyur na/ /khrag ni skya bor 'gyur ba dang / /des ni lus mdog skya bor 'gyur/ /gnyis par ⑦lus ni lci bar 'gyur/ /gsum par ⑧sos btab rnags ⑨pa dang / /mig dang kha sna las 'dzag 'gyur/ /bzhi par mgo lci gnye'u rengs ⑩'gyur/ /lnga par lus tshigs na ba dang / /grang ba'i rims kyis 'debs par byed/ /lhag ma gnyis po snga mar ⑪mtshungs/ /shugs ni lnga par gso ba dag /bya yi de las phan chad min/ /chu yis g.yeng ⑫dang chags pas zad/ /skrag dang ne+e'u les 'phen pa dang / /grang ⑫lhags nyi tshan rlung dang nad/ /bkres skom ngal bas gzir ba dang / /phyogs gzhan nas ni rings par 'ongs/ /dug spangs pags pa brjes pa dang / /'jag ma sman ⑫dang tsher ma can/ /nags na ⑩rgyu ba gang yin dang / /rig pa la sogs brten phyogs gnas/ /sbrul de dug ni chung bar 'dod/ /dur khrod bste gnas shing gcig sogs/ /tshes lnga dang ni dus tshigs dang / /tshes brgyad tshes dgu thun mtshams dang / /nam phyed dang ni nyi ma'i gung / /bra nye smin drug mchu dang skag /sa ga chu stod khrums stod dang / /snrubs dang bra nye yud ⑩tsam la/ /gnad du bzung ba spang bar bya/ /zin pa'i mod la bzhin skya zhing / /skra ni 'bye bar ⑫byed pa dang / /lce 'khums yang dang yang du brgyal/ /dbugs grang gang yin de mi 'tsho/ /111—795

skyigs bu dbugs mi bde zhing slon/ /lus can zin pa'i mod la ni/ /snying naso gzer bar 'gyur ba dang / /cig car 'byung ba de mi 'tsho/ /'du shes stor zhing lbu bar skyugs①/ /rkang pa lag pa bzhin gnag sbung / /sna zhom yan lag zhig ⑤pa dang / /tshigs lhod sdebashang ba 'khru ba yi/ /dug 'thungs pa dang sprul gyis zin/ /dug can mda' yis phog gyur pa④/ /tshul ni 'di dag snang gyur na⑤/ /srog zad par ni 'gyur ba yin/ /sna sman rnon po mi tshor zhing / /rma nas khrag ni mi 'byung la/ /dbyig rjopas bsnun na rjes mi mngon / /gshin rje'i thad du 'gro ba yin/ /de las gzhan du sman pa yis/ /'bar ba'i khyim nas 'byung ba bzhin/ /lkog mar phyin pa'i srog bsrung zhing / /dug ni myur du bsal bar bya/ /lus can dug gis zin gyur pa⑦/ /grangs brgya'i ⑧bar du gnas nas ni/ /lus zungs khrag sogs la gnod cing / /lus la khyab par byed pa yin/ /dus 'di'i ⑨bar du gdug pa yi/ /mche bas zin pa bcad sogs las/ /bya zhing ci nas lus la ni/ /dug gi yal ga ma 'phros bya/ /zin pa'i mod la ⑩myur du ni/ /sbrul ni de nyid za ba 'am/ /sa 'am bong bar ⑪gcod byed na/ /rings pa kho nar sman pa yi⑫/ /mchil mas byug par bya ba 'am/ / rna spabs ⑫kyis ni so rjes bsku/ /mche bas btab pa'i gong du ni/ /sor bzhir ras ma las byas pa/ /gso ma'am 'od ma la sogs bcing / /sngags shes pa yis grub sngags bzla④/ /chu lon gyis ni chu lta bur—/ /bcings pas dug ni 'phros mi 'gyur/ /dug gi bcings sogs nyen pa yi/ /rtsa las rgyu bar mi 'gyur ro/ /btsir nas sos btab dbyung bya zhing //tshigs dang gnad du ma chud de/ /sa bon nyams pa'i myu gu bzhin/ /dug 111—796

shugs de ①ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /lus 'khyil so rjes mkhris bskyed dze+epas/ /de ma gtogs pa ①gzhan dag ni/ /be+egs dang gser la sogs pas sam/ /mgal me yis ni myur du bsreg /me yis thal bar byed 'gyur na/ /ci phyir ④de ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sa dang lci ba sman sogs kyis/ /kha bkang nas ni gzhib par bya/ /chings ma'i nang nas khyasha che'i phyogs/ /mchog tu zhal zhal bya ba dang / /yan lag mche bas zin bcas pa/ /dug sman gyis ni yang yang bsku—/ /tsan+dan pu shel tse ldan pa'ikhye / /chu yis kyang ni blugs par bya/ /dug gis khyab par gyur pa la/ /gtar ga gdab pa gso mchog ste/ /khrag ni phyung bar gyur pa name/ /ma lus dug ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dug bcas khrag ni dri mi zhim/ /mer bsregs sgra ni tseg tseg zer/ /nad gzhi ji bzhin dag gyur pa mi/ /khrag ni snga ma bzhin zhes bya/ /kyertsa ni snang bar ma gyur na/ / rngabs rwa srin bu pad pas gtar⑩/ /khrag phyung ba yi lhag ma ni/ /dug gi drod kyis zhugs ⑪gyur pa/ /shin tu bsil ba'i sman bsku dang / / blugs pa yis ⑫ni bsal bar bya/ /dug gi shugs kyis ma zhu bas/ /brgyal dang myos dang snying 'dzag 'byung / /de ni bsil sman blugs pa dang / /rlung yab spu ldang byed pas bsal/ /khrag ni be+e bar gyur na dug /'phral du shugs ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /dug gi ⑫rno bas snying 'dar byed/ /de bsrung phyir ni zhun mar dang ⑫/ /mar dang bcas pa'i sbrang rtsi 'am/ /dug sman mar dang sbrus pa blud// de yi spyosnying ni 'gag ⑩byed pas/ /snying gar bad kan sogs par byed⑩/ /lus lci nad ni bslangs spyopa dang / /snying 'phar de ni slon du gzhug /gsher dzas skyur rtsabs rgya sran dang / /til dang chang sogs ma gtogs pa/ /111—797

dug sel ba yi slon sman gtang / /des ni lus la khyab mi 'gyur/ /sbrul dang nyes pa rang bzhin dang / /gnas dang shugs kyi khyad par ni/ /phra mo yan chad legs ①brtags la/ /gso ba khyad par can bya'o/ /srin bu ba ri'i rtsa ba dang / /gi ri kaṇi ④dkar po'i chu/ /btung ba gdengs ka can bzhin sbyar/ /sna sman ru rta sbrang rtsi gtang / /sbrul nag gis ni zin pa la/ /khrag gtar nas ni bca' ba dang / /na go la ni sbyar ba bsku/ /yang na rtsa rnon dug gis bsku/ /btung bar ①btsod dang sbrang rtsi dang / / khang pa'i dudud pa mar sbyar blud/ /gdengs ka can dang ri mo can/ /mi bzad dug gis ⑤zin pa la/ /tan du li ya tang pal dang / / gi ri kaṇi durnam gnyis dang / /kha lung khaṇ+ḍa se'u 'bru dze+eni/ /btung dang sna sman mig sman bya/ /a shwa garnya rgun 'brum dang / / gi ri kaṇi sa ⑧nag dang / /ha ti pi pi ling dang ni/ /bye'u ⑨rug pa'i lo ma dang / /bil ba se 'bru ka pid tha⑩/ /cha ni phyed phyed sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /dug sman yin te khyad par du/ /lus 'khyil ⑩sbrul gyi dug la phan/ /lo ma lnga dang 'bras bu gsum/ /shing mngar nā ga put+pa dang / /e la ba lu ⑫dzi ba ka /zangs rtsi ba dang pu shel tse⑫/ /kha ra shug pa ut+pa la/ /sbrang rtsi dang sbyar kha ba can—/ /zhes bya lus 'khyil dug 'joms so/ /bskus na skrang ⑫dang shu ba mched—/ /'brum bu rims ⑫dang lus lci sel/ /tang pal n+ya gro dha'i myu gu/ /dzi ba ka dang zangs rtsi ba/ /ka ra dkar po shing mngar btsod/ /khu ba lus 'khyil ⑩dug la blud/ /'od ⑩ma'i shun pa sa bon dang / /bca' sga pa to la'i sa bon/ /shir ⑫sha'i sa bon pu tse ⑪shel/ /'bras kyi rtsa ba bong nga dkar/ /shu dag ba gcin bcas par btags/ /yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ste/ /111—798

go na sa ①yi dug 'joms so/ /ru rta bong nga pu tse ②shel/ /ha re rku ①ka khyim dud pa/ /rgya spos sbrang rtsi tsha ba gsum/ /sbyar bas ri mo can dug sel/ /'dam bu khra bo 'dras zin na/ /sa brkos ④'og tu thun gnyis gzhug /phyung ste bzhar la mar sar dang / /'bras dang sa yi sde gus byug /'bras bu gsum gyi phye ⑤btab pa'i/ /mar ni rnying pa blud par bya/ /zhu zhing bkrus nas nas zan ni/ /sran tshod dang ni bcas pa sbyin/ /ka ra bī rjor arka yi/ /me tog lang ka le'i rtsa ba/ /pi pi ling dang na le sham/ /pa ta skyur rtsabs lde gur byas⑦/ /'di ni sbrul gzhan gyis zin pa'i/ /sbrul gyi dug kun ⑧sel ba yin| /shir sha'i me tog khu ba dang / /na le sham dkar ⑨zhag bdun sbangs//btung dang sna sman byas gyur na/ /sbrul gyi mche bas zin pa sel/ /rgya spos ru rta srang gnyis gnyis/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi srang bzhi bzhi/ /'di blud 'jog pos zin pa yang ⑩/ /bde ba skyed par byed pa yin/ /de nas gdengs ka can gyi shugs—/ /dang por khrag ni dbyung bar bya/ /dug sman sbrang rtsi zhun mar dang / /bcas pa myur du blud par bya/ /gnyis par ⑪slon sman btang nas ni/ /de bzhin dug sman blud par bya/ /gsum par ⑫dug sman sbyar bya zhing / /mig sman dang ni sna sman gtang / /bzhi par sgyug sman btang nas ni/ /sngar bshad pa yi nas thug blud/ /lnga pa drug par ⑫bsil sman gyis/ /bsku zhing sman chu yang yang blugs/ /slon sman rnon po gtang bya zhing / /dug sel nas thug blud ④par bya/ /bdun par ⑫dug sman rnon po yi⑩/ /mig sman dang ni sna sman gtang / /de nas spyi bor rgya gram du/ /zab mo'i mtshon gyis batral ⑩nas ni / /der ni sha 'am khrag gam ni/ /pags pa dag ni gzhug par bya/ /111—799

lus 'khyil ①shugs ni gsum pa la/ /slon sman btang la nas thug blud/ /drug par sman be+e rtul ②po 'am/ /shug pa la sogs sde tshan blud/ / khra bo'i ④shugs ni dang po la/ /zhal zhal zab tu gdab bya zhing / /ku rjobs khrag ni bton nas ni/ /snga ma ⑤bzhin du dug sman blud/ /drug par mig sman rnon po dang / /sna sman phye ma bud pa gtang / /ma smos pa yi shugs las ni/ /gdengs duka can skabs bshad ltar gso/ /sbrum ma byis pa rgan ⑦po la/ /gtar ga mi gdab 'jam pos gso/ /shing tsha ldong ros rgya spos nyung / /ku sha'i khu ba chu srin sen/ /ta ma la yi ge sar dang / /'bras bu chu grang ⑧sbyar ba blud/ /'di yis dbang po'i rdo rjes ⑨ni/ /lha min lta bur dug 'joms byedarka/ /bil ba'i rtsa ba bye'u ⑩rug pa'i me tog /rgya spos thang shing ka rañdza'i 'bras bu/ /ser po rnam gnyis 'bras bu gsum dang ni/ /tsha ba gsum po ra gcin zhib btags la/ /btung dang sna sman mig sman sbyar ba yis/ /sbrul dang lu da ⑪byi ba sdig pa sogs/ /dug dang dbyig dug ⑫ma zhu gsud dang rims—/ /mi ni gdon kyis zin pa bde bar byed/ /sos btab bsku ba la sogs kyis/ /ma lus ston ⑫par gyur kyang ni/ /nyams pa'i dug ni ji bzhin dang / /slar yang shugs ni ④skye bar byed/ /dug dang bral nas rlung 'khrugs na—/ /snum la sogs pas gso bya zhing / /til mar chang dang rgya sran chu/ / ma gtogs ⑫rlung ni sel ba sbyin/ /mkhris par mkhris pa'i rims sel ba'i/ /sman khu sman mar 'jam rtsis gso/ /bad kan sbrang rtsir ⑩bcas pa yi/ /dong ka la sogs sde yis gso/ /sprul gyi rus pas ⑩gnod 'gyur dang / /de bzhin rtog pa'i dug gis nyen/ /ka ra rgun 'brum pa ya gya⑫/ /shing mngar kha ra 111—800

sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i chu dang bcas/ / gtor zhing spro bsring ①dga' bar bya/ /ke ke ru dang mu tig margad dang / /bai ḍūr+ya dang rdo rje mthon ka che/ /ras bal sa bon dug gis gnod pa'am/ /kha ba can gyi ri las skyes pa yi/ /so ma ra dza dang ni ba spru ba/ /de bzhin dro ⑤na ma hā dro ④na dang / /sbrul la yod pa'i nor bu ma na dhisi/ /nus pa dang ni ldan par gyur pa yi/ /dug ni dug gzhom bya phyir bcang bar bya/ /nub mo'i dus su rgyu tshe khyad par du⑤/ /gdugs dang khar rjogasil sgra dang bcas pa bcang /de yi grib ma sgra yi skad phyung na⑦/ /sbrul gyi tshogs ni 'byer bar byed par 'gyur / /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu drug pa'o// //de nas srin bu'i dug nad gso ba'i le'u ⑧bshad par bya'o/ /sbrul nyid kyi ni bshang gci dang / /kha chu sgo nga lus rul ⑨skyes/ /nad ni re re 'dus pa dang / /ldan pa'i srin bu'i ⑩dug rnam bzhi/ /rlung gi srin bus zin gyur na/ /shas cher na zhing zug par byed/ /me yi srin bus ⑪'dzag pa chung / /tsha zhing dmar la shu ba mched/ /ba lu'i 'bras bu smin pa 'am/ /'bra go'i 'bras bu smin pa 'dra/ /bad kan shas ches nad ⑫tshabs chung / /u dum wā ⑫ra smin pa 'dra/ /shas cher 'dzag pa'o 'dus pa yi/ /mtshan nyid thams cad ldan pa dang / /shugs ni sbrul dang 'dra ba dang / / skrang ba ⑫'phel zhing khrag dri mnam—/ /mgo dang mig lci brgyal mgo 'khor/ /dbugs mi bde na spang bar bya/ /kun tu skrang ba ⑫lte ba can/ /tsha ba g.yo zhing yi ga 'chus/ /sdig ⑩111—801

pa'i dug ni rno ba ste/ /dang por ①me ltar sreg par byed/ /steng du myur du mched ②byed cing / /mche ba ①'og tu 'dug dupa yin/ /zin ma thag ni rab na gnag /gas pa snyam du sems shing zug⑤ /de ni lci ba rjosogs rul dang / /dug gis phog sogs ⑦rul pa dang / /sbrul rul pa ⑧las skyes pa yi⑨//dug tshabs chung dang 'bring dang che/ /tshabs chung ser zhing dkar dang gnag /rtsub dang phra zhing gzig spyomadog can/ /spu drang tshigs ⑪ni dmar ba dang / /dmar zhing lto ba dkar ba yin/ /bar ma lto ru ⑫tshigs gsum pa/ / rkod pa ser ⑫skya dmar ba yin/ /dug che ser skya phra ⑫ba dang / /ri mo can la khrag 'dra zhing / /me 'dra tshigs ni gnyis sam gcig /lto ba dkar zhing dmar ram gnag /des zin ⑫lce ni skrangs pa dang / /lus rengs rims kyis nyen pa dang / /bu ga las ni khrag nag slon⑩/ /dbang po'i don ni mi shes shing / /rngul zhing brgyal la kha skom ⑩dad/ /rmongs shing nad kyis nyen pa dang / /sha ni zhig ⑫par byed pa ste/ /phal cher srog ni 'dor bar byed/ /mchu sbom pa yi kha yis ni/ /'debs shing gsor rung sdig pa las/ /lhag par na byed lus rengs shing / /mtshan gyi sbubs ⑪ni ldang ba dang / /lus ni rngul bar byed 'gyur zhing / /sos 'debs chu grang snyam du sems/ /de nyid rnga ⑫mo dud ka dang / /mtshan mo rgyu bas mtshan mo can/ /srin bu rlung mkhris shas che zhing / /rnga mo byi ba bad kan can/ /rnga mo dud pa zhes bya ba/ /phal cher rlung shas che ba yin/ /nad ni gang dang gang gi ni/ /mtshan ma shas che ba las brtags⑫/ /de dang de las gso ba'i sman/ /yon tan mi mthun pa yis gso/ /snying gzer stod rlung gis rengs shing / /rtsa mi snang zhing rus tshigs na/ /mgo 'khor 111—802

lus bcings ①snyam du sems/ /mdog gnag rlung las gyur pa'i dug /dran nyams dbugs ni tsha bar byed/ /snying tsha kha ni kha bro la/ / sha 'gas skrang bar ②byed pa dang / /khrag ser ba ni mkhris pa can/ /slon zhing snying na yi ga 'chus—/ /kha chu 'dzag cing chom ④pas 'debs/ /grang bcas kha ni mngar bar rjobro/ /bad kan shas che'i dug nad yin/ /'ba' chas rma ni bsku ba dang / /rlung sel til mar gyis bsku dang / /sbu gu ma smin 'bru dugs dang / /brtas ⑤par bya ba'i cho gas rjophan/ /mkhris pa can la sman chu blugs/ /shin tu grang ba'i lde gus bsku/ /bad kan can la mebazhar zhing bcad/ / dugs dang skyug ⑧sman btang bas gso/ /srin bu rnam pa gsum po la/ /gso ba rnam ⑨pa gsum pos ⑩phan/ /dugs dang bsku dang sman chu blugs⑪/ /phal cher dro 'jam gtang bar bya/ /gzhan du brgyal dang mche ba yis/ /rnag dang 'drul bar byed ma gtogs/ /mi ⑫skra yungs kar ser po dang / /bu ram rnying pa'i dud pas bdug /dug dang mche ba'i dug kun la/ /mchog tu phan par 'drob skyong ⑫'chad/ /dug sel sman ni thams cad dang / /sbyang ba'i las kyang bya ba yin—/ /srin bu sdig pa mi bzad dug /'bus zin sbrul gyis zin ltar gso/ /tan ⑫du li ya cha mnyam pa'i/ /dur byid ⑫dang ni zhun mar blud/ /'bu yi dug gis gangs can ltar/ /bskyod par nus pa ma yin no/ /'o ma can shing lde gus bsku/ /sbyangs tho)byas srin bu'i dug sel byed/ /mu tig lde gus bskus na yang / /skrang ⑩dang dug dang tsha ba sel/ /shu dag shing kun byi dang ga⑫ /rgyam tsha ha ti pi pi ling / /pa tha ⑪bong nga tsha ba gsum/ /'drob ⑥skyong gis ni bshad pa yin/ /yan lag bcu pa'i dug sman ni/ /'drob skyong 111—803

gis ni bshad pa dag /blud na srin bu'i dug kyang sel/ /sdig pa'i dug gis 'phral zin la/ /'khor los babyung ba'i til mar bsku/ /sa la paṇi bskol ba yi/ /dro 'jam yang na gzhan dag blugs/ /rgyam tsha dang ni bcas pa yi/ /zhun mar yang dang yang du blugs/ /yang na skyur rtsabs dro 'jam mam//rgyam tsha 'o mar nyubacas pa blugs/ /mar dang brngos pa'i go snyod dang / /rgyam tshar bcas pas grudakri bar bya/ /mche bas zin pa dugs byas la/ /zhal zhal btab ste 'bras bu gsum/ /ser po gnyis dang tsha ba gsum/ /shir sha'i me tog bsku bar bya/ rgyam tsha kha lung ba gcin skyur/ /bye'u rug pa'i rtse mo btags—/ /'ba' cha'am lci ba dro 'jam tsam/ /bskus na'ang phan par 'gyur ba yin/ /btung ba (1zhun mar sbrang rtsir bcas/ /yang na 'o mar kha ra btab—/ /phug ron rtug pa a ru ra/ /rgya spos bca' sga kha lung gi/ /khu ba dang sbyar blud pa rgo/ /sdig pas zin pa'i sman mchog yin/ /rnga mo'i so ni chu bal bcas/ /sdog pa'i dug ni 'joms par byed/ /shing kun pa la kha bulung gi / /khu ba dang sbyar sde gu dang / /mig sman ri lur byas na ⑤ni/ /sdig pa'i dug ni sel mchog yin/ /ka rañdza dang ardzu na/ /gi ri kaṇi se lu dang tsa/ /shir sha'i me tog dug mo nyung / /zho ga chu dang btags bskus na/ /sdog pa'i dug ni sel bar byed/ /gang zhig rmugs shing rngam pa 'thon⑦/ /bla zhing mi bzad na gyur pa/ /de la yung dang a ru ra/ /btsod dang bong nga be+e pi ling /bil ba gzhon nu na le sham/ / bā ta 87ka yi khu bar btags/ /lde gus byugs na phan pa yin/ /sbrang ma gdug pa'i dug kun la/ /zho dang mar ni blud bya zhing / /gtar ga gdab cing sna sman dang / /mig sman gyi ni cho ga bya/ /111—804

dro zhing ① snum dang skyur ba dang / /rlung 'doms ⑤kha zas sbyin par bya/ /dong gra byi ba'i rtug pa dang / /kha ③lung khu ba sla ba ④dang / /rgyam tsha pu shel tse sbyar ba'i thu / /lde gus dang ⑥ma'i dug myur 'joms/ /sdig pas zin pa'i tha mar ni/ /dug ni shas cher langs gyur par/ /zin pa'i rma la dug gis bsku/ / uts+tsha ṭi 3 ka'i gso ba'ang 'di/ /glang po che yi rtug pa'i steng thu/ /ro hi sha'i rtsa se'u'i kyechu/ /sde gur byas btags bsgus na ⑩ni/ /'di ni sbrang ma'i dug 'joms mchogatshonyu /shir sha'i sa bon arga yi/ /'o mas lan gsum bsgos pa ⑩ni/ /pi pi ling gi phye mar bsres/ /dug sman 'dis ni srin bu'i dug /sbrul dang lu da spyobyi ba yi/ /dug ni sel bar byed pa yin/ /shir sha ka rañdza yi sa bon dang spyo/ /gur gum ru rta ldong ros bcas pa yi/ /dug sman 'dis ni mtshan rgyu'i ⑫sdig pas zin/ /sel bar byed pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /srin bu las ni rab gdug pa/ /ba ni bcu drug yin par bshad/ /gzhan dag nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'dod / /⑩kha cig de bas mang bar 'dod/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyi rjes 'brang ba/ /stong phrag yod ces gzhan dag 'chad/ /bla brnan ⑫gzugs ni mang gyur pa⑫/ /dug can pa ni gcig pur 4yam̐'adod/ /de yi gzugs dang ming dag ni/ /shin tu 'dres pas shes par dka'/ /gnas kyi nges pa yod min pas/ /de phyir nad las bshad par bya/ /nad gzhi so so'i gso ba dka'/ /'dus pa las gyur gsor mi rung / /des zin mkhris gyur tsha ba dang / /skom dad chu bur rims kyis 'debs/ /rmongs bag rab tsha dmar ser mdog /rnags du shing rgun 'bru'i ( rnya'abras bu 'dra/ /bad kan las gyur sra zhing skya/ /pa ru sha ka'i 'bras bu 'dra/ /gnyid che grang rims 111—805

lud pa lu/ /shin tu g.ya' bar byed pa yin/ /rlung gyur rtsub cing gnag pa dang / /tshigs na rims kyis 'debs par byed/ /de yi dbye ba nad kyi ni/ /rang gi mtshan nyid las shes bya/ /gsor mi rung ba snying tsha zhing / /lud ①pa skyigs bu mgo kyend dang / /'brum phran dkar dang ser dang gnag /dmar dang skya ba las 'byung ge'agyur/ /'dar zhing 7skrangs la tsha ba dang / /skom dad lang /ltazhing sna 'chus la/ /mchu gnag 7 so ni g.yo 7ba dang / /rgyab dang mid pa bcom snyam sems/ /'dzam bu'i 'bras bu smin 'dra ba'i/ /khrag ni mchus bldags rma las 'dzag /'dus gyur mtshan nyid kun ldan zhing / /ming ni mang por gyur pa yin/ /de dug rnon bo bar ma dang / /dman pa'i dbye ba ④gsum du 'gyur/ /ma bcos zhag bdun zhag bcu dang / /zla ba phyed kyi rims kyis ⑨gsod/ /ba dang mchu rings ⑩thams cad kyang / /glang shu kor kor por byed cing / /dkar dang gnag dang dmar dang ser/ /gnag pa'am 'jam zhing mtho ba dang / /dbus su gnag pa'am sngo ba laskye/ /mtha' ma dra ba lta bus khebs/ /mched cing skrang bar ⑫byed pa dang / /tsha zhing mang ⑫du na ba dang / /rims 'debs myur du rnags ⑩shing 'drul/ /rul zhing gas par byed pa dang / /rnag gis gang du reg gyur pa'i/ /phyogs der yang ni rma skyed byed/ /dbugs dang mche ba bshang gci dang / /khu chu kha chu sen mo khrag /brgyad po gnod byed khyad par du/ /dug ni kha la gnas pa yin/ /ba ni lte ⑫ba yan chad 'dzin/ /srin bu stod smad kun tu gnod/ /de ⑩gnod byas pa'i gos la sogs/ /lus la reg na nad skyed byed/ /ba dang srin bu las gyur dug /nyin 7phyed bar du tshor mi 'gyur/ /de nas dang po'i spyonyin 111—806

zhag la/ /khab kyis gtsags pa snyam du sems/ /mdog mi gsal zhing g.yo ba dang / /cung zad g.ya' zhing nad dang ldan/ /gnyis par mtha' ma shin tu mtho—/ /'brum bu phra mos khyab pa 'dra/ /mdog gsal gyur na dbus dma' ①zhing / /g.ya' zhing rmen bu lta bur snang / /gsum par rims ②bcas sru ldang zhing / /'khor ling dmar por ①snang ba dang / /kham phor gzugs 'dra phal ④cher ni/ /ba spu'i bu ga 'dzag par 'gyur/ /nyin zhag bzhi par cher skrangs shing ⑤/ /mgo 'khor lus tsha dbugs mi bde/ /lnga par dug ldang las gyur pa'i/ /nad ni de dang de dag bskyed/ /drug par rjogand du khyab par byed—/ /bdun par ⑦srog ni 'joms par byed/ /de ltar dug ni rnon po dang / /bar ma dman pa dbye bar bya/ /de nas nyin zhag nyi shu ni/ /gcig na yong ye zhi bar 'gyur/ /de 'og ba yis ⑧zin pa ni/ /mtshon gyis rma ni gnod ⑨par bya/ /'dzam bu'i mchu la sogs pas bsreg /mkhris pa las gyur bsreg mi bya/ /rtsub cing spu ni gyes pa dang / /gnad dang tshigs ⑩la sogs la gnas/ /zin nas kun tu khyab gyur pa/ /gcad ⑪par mi bya bsreg mi bya/ /bsreg pa dug sman rgyam tsha dang / /sbrang rtsir sbyar bas bsgu bar bya/ /de rjes 'o ma can shing bskol/ /sman khu shin tu bsil mo blugs/ /rngabs ⑫rwa sogs sam gtar ga yis/ /thams cad la ni khrag dbyung bya/ /de nas bsil sman bsku ⑫blugs bya/ /sle sman ta ka a shwaṅga④/ /ba ru ra dang pri yang ku/ /shug pa ser gnyis sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /ba dang srin bu la sogs pa'i⑫/ /dug 'joms las ni thams cad byed/ /ser po rnam gnyis rma shing btsod⑩/ /pad+ma ge sar rgya spos ⑪ni/ /sbrang rtsi mar sbyar tsam pa ka /snga ma bas kyang yon 111—807

tan lhag /lci khu btsir dang ①ka ra dkar/ /a pa marga ldong ros dang / /ba bla skyer pa bya ma ka /yug snam sbrang rtse ②mar de bzhin/ /rgya spos na le sham sug spel/ /ru rta shing mngar sbrang rtsi mar/ /sbyar ba'i sman ni man+da ra/ /rgya spos seng phrom pu tse shel/ /shu dag pa tha sug smel dang / /gur gum sgos ngad ldang ①de bzhin/ /nad gzhi mang la dug 'joms pa'i/ /sbyang ba byas pas gso bar rjobya/ /shing mngar dang ni po son cha/ /ko sha ta ki ang ko la/ /sin ⑤du ba ra 'bras chur sbyar/ /'thungs na bad kan las gyur dug /myur du slon par byed pa yin/ /shir sha'i lo ma me da dang / /rtsa ba bu'abras bu ang ko la'i/ /rtsa bar bcas pa'ang de bzhin no/ /'bras bu gsum dang ni li ni/ /dur byid la sogs bkru sman gtang / /skrang dang ⑦tsha sogs zhi gyur na④—/ /rma yi lte ba dbog par bya/ /ba bla le brgan rtsi'i me tog /khron bu byi ba'i rtug pa dang / /dur byid rgyam tsha dan dang ⑨sbyar/ /lte ba 'byin par byed pa yin/ /de bzhin u ta ma ka ra'i⑩/ /rtsa ba smin pa'i ⑪shun bcas pa'i⑪ /rgyam tsha ru rta pu tse shel/ /dan da pa ya mya ⑫sbyar ba'am/ /ra dza ko sha ta ka'i rtsar⑩—/ /dar ba'i tshigs ma'ang sbyar bar ⑫bya/ /lte ba bcad pa'i dus su ni/ /dug sel ba yis brta bar tsu)bya/ /sgrum chos (rtem lus bya ba ni/ /zhun mar nyid kyis bya ba yin/ /til mar gyis ni rtswa skesogs la/ /me mched lta bur dug 'phel byed/ / be kang ka ta ba li ⑪ka /thal tres gla sgang spri ⑩ka dang //tsan+dan nya lcibs so na ka /ut+pal rgya spos shing mngar dang / /shing tsha shug pa na gu li/ /po son cha'i rkang lhan cig sbyar/ /skyer pa gla sgang sar pak+ṣi/ /bca' sga pi pi ling rtsa ba/ /pi pi ling dang tsi ⑪tra ka /ba ru blun dang a ka 111—808

ruske/ /bil ba nim pa pa ta li①/ /ru rta nā ga ge sar dang / /se'u lu ②lhan cig sbyar ba dang / /bil ba tsan+dan ut+pa la/ /rgya spos bca' sga pi pi ling / lcam pa ④nim pa ru rta dang / /chu srin sder mo dzi ban ④ti/ /ga bra'i rtsa ba pa ta li/ / dzi ban ⑤ti dang po son cha/ /shing tsha sbyar ba de dag ni/ /mig sman snar blugs byug pa dang / /sman chu blugs pa'i spyor ba yis/ /mkhris pa bad kan rlung rjogyur pa'i/ /lu ta'i dug ni ji snyed pa/ /tshul khrims la gnas ngan 'gro bzhin/ /'di yis dug nad kun 'joms byed/ /seng phrom shug pa pad+ma ge sar dang / /tsan+dan dmar ser pri yang ku'i me tog /pad+ma pu shel tse dang pa ya su'i⑦rka/ /sbyor ba kun gyis ba yi dug kun 'joms/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu bdun pa'o// //de nas byi ba dang a lo ka'i dug gso ba'i le'u skebashad par bya'o/ /khu chu can dang mi brtan bu/ /rgod dang sgra can pags pa dang / /rnying pa'i so dang khu byug dang / /ser skya dang ni nag po dang / /dmar ser khra bo dkar po dang / /thi ba skra dkar byi ba dang / /phus pa dang ni bra byi ste/ /byi ba'i stidabye ba bco brgyad yin/ /gang du 'di yi khu chus phog /khu bas ⑩phog dang reg pa ni/ /lus kyis lus la reg pa der/ /khrag la gnod cing mdog skya la//thor bu rmen bu dri mnam dang / /shu ba kor ⑪ling yi ga 'chus/ /mgo 'khor skrangs ⑫rims rab tu na/ /nyam ⑫chung 'dar zhing ldu tshigs na/ /spu ldang dran nyams khrag 'dzag dang / /yun ring du ni gnas par byed/ /bad kan can gyi ⑩bye ba yi/ /phru ⑫gu mang reg skom slon 'gyur/ /byi ba 'khrig spyod dug 111—809

gso dka'/ /yang dang yang du ldang bar byed/ /yan lag kun skrangs mdog mi sdug /rnags ①shing 'on la rims kyis ②'debs/ /mgo lci kha chu khrag 'byung zhing / /slon pa gso dka'i mtshan nyid yin/ /phus pas zin pa de dri broske/ /ldang ①pa skrangs shing chu mdog nyams/ /sbrang rtsi 'dra ba'i rmen bus khyab/ /khye'i rjodug bad kan shas cher 'khrugs⑤/ /'du shes rgyu ba'i rjortsa mang gnas/ /gnod cing 'khrug ⑦par byed pa dang / /lus zungs la ni mi bzad gnod/ /kha chu 'dzag dang long dang 'on/ /kun tu rgyug par byed pa dang / /mjug ma 'gram pa phrag gong lhod/ /mgo na gdong ni dud ⑧pa yin/ /de yi so yis ⑨zin na rma/ /tshor ba chung zhing khrag rnag 'dzag /mgo snying na zhing rims ⑩'debs rengs/ /de rjes skom dang brgyal bar 'gyur/ /'di yis gdug ⑪cing mche ba can/ /ce ⑫spyang dom dang dred dang gung / /stag dang spyang ki la sogs pa/ /gzhan dag kyang ni shes par bya/ /g.ya' zhing zug la mdog mi sdug /tshor ba med gnas rims mgo 'khor/ /tsha zhing dmar la na zhing gnag /skrang zhing ⑫rmen bu skye zug 'khums/ /rma ni 'gags shing ④'brum bu 'byung / /lte ba can du zlum por 'gyur/ /kun tu dug bcas mtshan ma 'di / /dug med de las bzlog pa yin/ /gang gis bzung ba de'i ⑫spyod tshul/ /sgra sgogs rgyu med par de'i gzugs/ /chu dang me long sogs mthong 'chi ma bzung bar yang sgra dang ni/ /mthong bas sdang bar ⑫byed pa ni/ /chu yis skrag ces bya ba ste/ /zin pas de yang spang bar bya/ /bye ba'i dug gis zin ma thag /rma ni mde'u bsregs pas bsreg /yang na me long dag gis bya/ /gzhan du lte ⑩bar mi bzod na/ /bsregs nas rma las ⑩khrag dbyung zhing / /111—810

zhal zhal byas la shir sha dang / /yung ba rgya spos gur gum dang / /sle tres kyi ①ni lde gus bsku/ /khyim gyi dud pa skyer pa dang / /rgyam ④tsha dang ni btsod dag gi—/ /sde gus byi ba'i dug sel zhing / /lte ba 'bur ba'ang 'joms par byed—/ /de nas skyur bas bkrus nas ni/ /gi ri kar ṇi pa lin di/ /bil ba'i 7rtsa ba sle tres dang / /chu dang btags 2 pa'i lde gus bsku/ /dug dang skrang spusel sman gzhan dang / /yang na gtar ga myur du gdab/ /ni li ni bskol shi ri sha /ang ko ⑥ la yi khu bas slon④/ /ko sha ta sgoki shir sha dang // dzi mu ta ka'i 'bras ⑨bu dang / /po son cha ni phye mar btags/ /zho ⑩sbyar blud la dug slon gzhug /shu dag ru rta po son cha'am/ / dzi ban spyoti ni ba gcin btags/ /cho ga snga ma bzhin ⑫blud na/ /dug gi nad ni thams cad sel—/ /dur byid ni li ni dang ni/ /'bras bu gsum gyi bkru sman bsngags/ /spyoshir sha'i snying po'i ④'bras bu yis⑫/ /mgo bo'i bkru sman dag kyang phan/ /ba lci'i khu ba ⑫tsha ba gsum/ /phye ma zhib ⑩btags lde gus spyophan/ /ba lang lci ba ka pid ta'i⑪/ /phye ma sbrang rtsi'i du sde gu bza'/ /taṇ+ḍa stsoli yi rtsa ba dang / /bskol ba'i mar ni blud na'ang phan/ /gi ri kar ṇi ⑫ser po gnyis/ / 3shing mngar btsod dang sle tres phan/ /thal tres rtsa ba mar bskol ba/ /ka pid ta ④yi rnam lnga'ang phan/ /sin du ba ra rgya spos dang / /shi kru bil ba'i rtsa ba dang / /shu dag gze ma ba spru ba/ /dzi mu ta dang bcas pa ste/ /de rnams khu ba sbrang rtsir bcas/ /blud nas ⑤'bras chan sā ⑩lu zho/ /byin na byi ba'i dug nad sel/ /sha ra pung ga'i spyophye ma ni/ /dar bar sbyar ba blud pa'ang phan( kye/ /saṃ ko ⑥la yi rtsa ba ni/ /ra thug gcin sbyar lde gus ni/ /btung dang bsku ba la 111—811

sbyar na/ /byi ba'i dug kun sel bar byed/ /ka pid ta ①yi snying po dang / /ti la ka dang til dang ni/ /saṃ ④ko la yi rtsa ba ni/ /ba yi 'o ma'am gcin sbyar blud/ /ti la ka'i gdong ①yal ga yi/ /ba yi 'o ma sbyar ba blud/ /yang na sher+ya ka'i rtsa ba/ /sbrang rtsi 'bras bu sbyar ba blud/ /ku ba kha bo zhag gcig ni/ /chu la sbangs pa'ang blud par bya/ /sen du ba ra'i burtsa ba dang / /byi ba'i ⑤rus pa bong nga dkar/ /rgya sgos chur btags sna sman sogs/ /sbyar rjobs byi ba'i dug sel byed/ /byi ba'i dug ni lhag lus pa/ /sprin mthong bas ni ldang byed pa'am—/ /nad ni 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /ji lta bar ni 'phel bar byed/ /de la gnas skabs thams cad du/ /gso ba thams cad sbyar bya zhing / /rang gi gso bar spyogang bshad dang / /de bzhin nyams pa'i dug sel sbyor/ /a lang ga ⑧yi so yis zin/ /mar bskol ba yis bsreg par bya/ /dug sman de dang ⑨de bsku zhing / /mar gyi snying po blud par bya/ /'di la arka'i 'o mar bcasarka/ /bkru sman dag kyang myur du gtang / /saṃ ko la'i rtsa ⑩byang phyogs chu⑪//srang gsum mar ni srang gcig blud/ /dha du ra ⑫yi 'bras bu dang / /gi ri kar ṇi ⑫ba spru ba/ /bskol ba'i khu ba blud par bya/ /til btags sde gu spyo.arka lcagasaske/ /'o ma bu ram bsres ⑫byin na/ /sprin sogs rlung gis ⑩gtor ba bzhin—/ /a lo ka yi dug 'joms byed/ /sngags bcas sman dang rin chen bcas/ /zhi bar byed pa dag kyang sbyar/ /rkang bzhi pa dang rkang gnyis pa'i/ /so 'am sen mos snad gyur pa/ / skrang zhing rnags ⑩la mdog dmar zhing / /tsha na chu ser 'dzag pa la/ /a shwa kar+ṇa kad pha ⑫la/ /han sa pa ti ⑪go dzi ha/ /yug snam ser po gnyis kyis bsku/ /so dang sen 111—812

mo'i dug 'joms byed/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u ste ①sum cu brgyad pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ mche ba gso ba'i yan lag rdzogs so// //de nas bcud kyis skelen gyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /tshe ring dran dang yid ①gzhungs dang / /nad med gzhon dang lang tsho dang / / gzugs bzang mdog rjodang skad gsal dang / /lus dang dbang po'i ⑤stobs skyed cing / /tshig grub ro tsa mdangs ldan pa/ /bcud kyis rjolen gyis 'thob ⑦par 'gyur/ /dwangs ma la sogs yon tan can/ /thob gnas ⑧yin phyir bcud kyis len/ /na tshod dang po'am bar ma'i tshe/ /dbang po thul bas de sbyar te/ /snum chos ⑨bya zhing gtar ga gdab/ /rnam pa kun tu sbyangs byas gtang / /ma sbyangs pa yi lus la ni/ /bcud kyis len dang ro tsa ba'i/ /sbyor ba dri ma can gyi ⑩ni/ /gos kyi ⑪tshon ltar don med 'gyur/ /bcud kyis ⑫len gyi sbyor ba ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su drang srong 'dod/ / spyil bor 'dug ⑫pa gtso bo ste/ /rlung dang than pas nyen cig shos/ /khang pa rlung med 'jigs pa med/ /chos ldan yo byad 'byor pa'i gong / /sa phyogs shis pa'i byang phyogs su/ /khang pa sum rim skar khung chung / /dud pa nyi tshan sbrul dang rngul/ /bud med glen mas ma bgrod par/ /yo byad sman pa sta gon byas/ /khang pa legs par byi dor bya'o/ /de nas tshes grangs bzang khrus byas/ /mchod 'os mchod la 'jug par bya/ /der ni sbyang ⑫byas dag gyur nas/ /bde zhing stobs ni skyed spyopa dang / /111—813

tshangs par spyod dang brtan par ldan/ /dad par ①ldan zhing dbang po thul/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bde ba dang / /brtul zhugs ④chos la mchog tu gzhol/ /lha ni rjes su dran par ldan/ /rigs ①pas gnyid log gnyid mi log④ /sman la dga' zhing tshig 'jam pas/ /bcud kyis len ni ⑤brtsam par bya/ /de dhinyid snum chos ⑦dugs byas nas/ /a ru ra dang skyu ru ra/ /rgyam tsha bca' sga pi pi ling / /shu dag yung ba bye dang ga⑧ /bu ram chu dron sbyar ba ni/ /blud na legs par 'khru bar 'gyur/ /de nas lus ni dag 'gyur zhing / /thug ⑨sogs rim par ⑩spyad nas kyang / /zhag gsum mam ni zhag lnga 'am/ /zhag bdun bar du zhun mar bcas/ /nas thug dag par gyur gyi bar/ /sbyin zhing bshang rnying dag par bya/ /de ltar lto ni sbyangs byas nas/ /goms par shes pas ⑪gang zhig la/ /gang zhig 'tsham pa de kun brtags⑩/ /bcud kyis len ni sbyin par bya/ /a ru ra stong de'i sum 'gyur/ /skyu ru ra dang bcas pa dang / /rtsa ba lnga po lnga rnams ni/ /srang ni nyis brgya lnga bcu dag /chu ni bcu 'gyur nang du ⑫bskol/ /khu ba bcu cha lus pa ru/ /a ru rnam ④rgyal skyu ru ra/ /brdungs la ⑩rus pa phyung nas ni/ /khu ba de yi nang du ni/ /shing tsha sug smel pi pi ling / /ga dur skyer ⑩pa a ru ra/ /tsan+dan ma du ka par ṇi/ /shaṃ ka put+pa ka na ya/ /shu dag gla ba shing mngar dang / / byi dang ga ⑩ni phul re'i tshad/ /kha ra dkar srang stong chig brgya/ /zhun mar bre ni bcu gnyis dang / /til mar bre ni brgyad bcas pa/ /lde gur gyur gyi bar du bskol/ /phab ⑫la bsgrangs par sbrang rtsi ni/ /srang ni sum brgya nyi shu gzhug /de nas gzar bus dkrugs nas ni/ /mar gyi snod du gzhug par bya/ /gang zhig zas ⑪111—814

gcig la mi gnod/ /de ni 'di yi tshad du bshad/ /zhu ba'i tshe na drug cu pa/ /'o mar bcas pa'i kha zas sbyin/ /bcud kyis ①len 'di tshangs pas bshad/ /dge zhing dpal yon can yin zhing / /mkha' la gnas dang byis pa rtse/ /de bzhin dka' thub pas bsten byasadze+e/ /lus snyom ngal dang skra dkar dang / /gnyer ma'i skyon ni spang 'gyur ①zhing / /yid gzhungs dran dang stobs ldan zhing / /tshe ring bar yang 'gyur ba yin/ /skyon med a ru ra dang skyu ru ra/ /stong dang pi pi ling ni stong dang bcas/ /rgya skyegs shing gzhon thal ba'i chu rjosbyar ba—/ /snod du bzhag ste legs par sbangs nas ni/ /slar phyung grib mar ⑤bskams te phye mar byas/ /kha ra dkar po bzhi cha mar dang ni/ /sbrang rtsi bzhi 'gyur bcas pa mar gyi ni/ /bum par bcug ste sa brkos rjopar bzhag la/ /zla ba drug lon nas ni slar phyung ste/ /snga dro'i dus su me drod ji bzhin bza'/ /rtag tu mthun pa'i zas ni bza' bar bya/ /de ltar ma lus zos na lo brgya 'tsho//nad med pa dang skra dkar gnyer ma med/ /lus kyi stobs 'phel rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / /mchog tu dran gsal yid ni gzhungs par 'gyur/ /skyon med rgya skyegs shing rlon pa/ /thor to bcad la gzhog ⑦pa yi/ /sdong bu khru gnyis brkos pa'i nang / /skyu ru ra ni sar pas dgang / /rtsa ba'i bar du 'jag mas dkri/ /pad+ma skyes pa'i 'dam gyis bsku/ /de nas rlung ⑧med gnas su ni/ /lci ba sar pa gtsang mas stibatso/ /tshos shing skyu ru ra sbangs nas / /sbrang rtsi mar bcas mi yis bza'/ /de rjes 'o ma mar bcas pa/ /ci 'dod par ni btung bar bya/ /de nyid kyis ni zla gcig bar/ /bsten zhing spang bar bya ba rnams/ /de ⑩ni 'bad de spang bar bya/ /chu ni grang mo 111—815

lag pa yis/ /reg pa tsam yang mi bya'o/ /de ltar zhag ni bcu gcig 'das/ /skra so sen mo lhags ①par 'gyur/ /de nas nyin zhag cung zad nas/ /gzugs bzang bud med la phod cing / /stobs ni glang po dang 'drar 'gyur/ /mchog tu yid gzhungs snying stobs dang / /blo ldan lo stong 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /rtsa ba bcu pa ba bla dang / /gla sgang thal tres dzi ba ka /ut+pa la dang paṇi ⑤gnyis—/ /karka ta sring pi pi ling / / me da ④sug smel ta ma la/ /'tsho byed rgun 'brum a ka ru/ /ma nu zur ba ba spru ba/ /ram nye ba gnyis sle tres dang //ka ka na sa a ru ra/ /ba sha ka'i rtsa bi da ri/ /srang re gcig tu bsres nas ni/ /skyu ru ra'i 'bru rjolnga brgya ni/ /chu bre bcu drug nang du bskol/ /de yi khu ba bzhi cha lus/ /sgyu ru ra yi rus pa bsal/ /mar dang til mar srang bcu gnyisarka/ /nang du legs par brngos nas ni/ /ka ra dkar po srang lnga bcu/ /btags te lde gu'i tshul du bskol/ /snum phyed kyis rjoni sbrang rtsi gzhug /smig dhirkang srang ni bzhi dag dang / /pi pi ling ni srang gnyis dang / /dri bzang bzhi ni srang gcig gzhug /de la tshad tsam bza' bya zhing / /khang par gnas shing 'phrod zas bsten/ /'di ni drang srong 'pho bas bstan/ /drang srong 'pho bas gang zos ⑦pa/ /rgas pas nyen par gyur pa yang / /bud med kyis ⑤ni mig tu sdug /cho ga bzhin du bsten gyur na/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde rims dang / /skems ⑨dang snying nad dreg nad dang / /gcin dang khu chu la gnas dang / /skad 'gags pa yang sel bar byed/ /byes pa rgan dang glo 'gram gcong / /red ⑫pa'i nyams stobs 'phel ba byed/ /yid gzhungs dran dang mdangs ldan dang / /nad med nyid dang tshe 'phel dang / /rlung ni 111—816

bde bar rgyu byed cing / /bud med la phod stobs dang ni①/ /dbang po gsal zhing me drod skyed/ /shing mngar smig ②rkang pi pi ling / /lce myang tsha dang bcas pa dang / /lcags ni sna re gser dang ni/ /shu dag sbrang rtsi zhun mar ram/ /kha ra dkar po 'bras bu gsum/ /lo gcig bsten na bcud len 'gyur/ /nad kun 'joms shing dran pa dang / /yid gzhungs blo ni skyed par byed/ / ma du ka paṇi yi sdekhu ba 'am/ /shing mngar phye ma rjo'o mar bcas pa ni/ /lhan cig sbyar ba me drod ji bzhin sbyin/ /sle tros shang ka put+pa'i me tog bcas/ /lde gur sbyar ba ⑤me drod ji bzhin du/ /bsten na tshe ni sbyin par byed pa dang / /nad 'jig stobs skyed mdog ni gsal byed cing / /me drod skad gsal yid gzhungs skyed par byed/ /bcud kyis len gyi sbyor ba 'di dag las/ /shaṅka put+pa'i sbyor 'di yid gzhungs mchog /spangs rjom pu tse shel dang pa ya mya/ /shing mngar thal tros tsan+dan 'bras bu gsum/ /shu dag tsha ba gsum dang ser po gnyis / /pa to la'i rtsa ⑦rgyam tsha zhib tu btags/ /mar dang 'o ma bre ni bcu drug dang / / shaṅka put+pa'i ⑧khu ba sum 'gyur bskol/ /blud na glen pa'ang tshig la dbang 'gyur ⑨zhing / /thos 'dzin sgobs pa che zhing nad med 'gyur/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba sdong bu dang / /ge sar nang gi sa bon rnams/ /gser bcas mar dang 'o ma ni/ /bre ni bcu drug nang du bskol/ /pad+ma lnga yi thig le zhes/ /sa steng dag tu grags pa yin/ /tshul bzhin bsten na skyes bu ni/ /nyams stobs zad pa ⑩'phel bar byed/ /gang zhig ut+pal sdong bu lo⑪/ /rtsa ba ge sar ldan bskol ba/ /ut+pal bzhi par grags pa yin/ /gser dang bcas pa'i bcud len gyi⑩/ /sbyor ba bsten na ba lang yang / /yid gzhungs 'gyur 111—817

na mir ①ci smos/ /braste sdeshu dag shang ka put+pa dang / /rgyam tsha mang tsha k+ṣa ra bi sha la/ /bras+ho ④so bar tsa la pi pi ling / /re re nas ni gsum gsum tsam tshad dang rjo/ /gser ni nas gnyis dug ni til 'bru tsam/ /zhun mar srang gcig 'di dag zhib tu sbyar/ /legs par btang ste zhu bar gyur nas ni/ /mar bcas kha zas lo gcig bar du bsten/ /dran dang yid gzhungs blo ni 'phel 'gyur zhing / /nad dang rgas pa dag las 'das pa dang / /snyom dang ngal dub sel byed lo brgyar ⑤'tsho/ /dpal dang gzi brjid mdangs dang rjoldan par 'gyur/ /khyad par du ni mdze nad sha bkra skran/ /dug dang dbyig dug rims dang smyo byed dang / /srid srung rig byed sngags byas gshed byed dang / /rlung nad stobs chen 'dis ni zhi bar byed/ /na ga ba la ⑦ston gyi tshe/ /skar ma rgyal la bab par btu⑧/ /de yi rtsa ba zho gnyis tsam/ /phyer btags 'o ma sbyar te btung / /yang na mar dang sbrang rtsir sbyar/ /bldag cing zas med 'o mas 'tsho/ /de ltar lo gcig zos gyur na/ /lo brgyar ⑨'tsho zhing stobs ldan 'gyur—/ /gze ma 'bras bu skyes pa ⑩rtsa bar bcas/ /grib mar bskams te zhib tu btags nas ni/ /rang gi khu bar ⑪sbangs pa de las ⑫ni/ /che tshad khyor gang tsam ⑫du byas gyur gang / /de dang 'o mar sbyar nas bza' bya zhing / /zhu nas 'o ma srang ni nyis brgya zos/ /gzugs bzang skal ldan lo brgya thub pa dang / /'dod spyod khyu mchog ba lang tshogs gnas 'dra/ /ba ra ti yi sdong bu rlon pa ni/ /'o mar sbyar ba zos shing 'o ma btung / /zla gcig bar du kha zas 'o mas 'tsho/ /rgas pa'i tshogs las nges par rgyal bar 'gyur/ /yang na de yi sdong bu'i phye zhib mo/ /rang gi khu ba dang ni legs sbyar ba/ /mar dang sbrang 111—818

rtsir sbyar ba'i lde gu bza'/ /yang na de bskol mar ni btung bar bya/ /de bzhin a ti ba la bi da ri/ /shing mngar dang ni mon ①sne'u dme ru dang / /dzi ban ②ti dang ra sna a ru ra/ /sa la paṇi sle tres skyu ru ra/ /shang ka put+pa man du ka paṇi①/ /a shwa garnya dang ni nye'u ④shing rnams/ /sbyar ba btang na yid gzhungs blo dang ni/ /rgas sra na tshod brtan zhing stobs skyed byed/ /tsi tra ka yi me tog ni/ /ser po dkar nag las ⑤shes bya/ /cho ga bzhin du bcud len sbyar④/ /go rims bzhin du yon tan che/ /de yi rtsa ba grib mar skam / /phye mar btags pa sbrang rtsi mar/ /'o ma chu dang zla gcig bar/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bsten byas la/ /phan pa'i zas ni za byed na/ /lo brgyar ⑦'tsho zhing nad med la/ /yid gzhungs stobs dang mdangs ldan zhing / /lus rgyas me drod ⑧'bar bar 'gyur/ /til mar lde gu zla gcig bar/ /bsten na rlung nad gso dka' 'joms/ /gcin sbyar sha bkra mje nad 'joms//dar bar sbyar bas ⑨gzhang 'brum sel/ /go bye legs par smin pa ni/ /'bras kyi phung po'i nang du gzhug⑩ /sos ka'i tshe btus dgun tshe phyung ⑪/ /mngar zhing snum dang bsil ba yi/ /sman sbyar de yi rdog ma brgyad/ /brgyad 'gyur chur ni bskol nas ni/ /khu ba de yi brgyad cha lus/ /'o ma dang sbyar grang mo btung / /de rjes nyi ma re re zhing / /go bye rdog ma re res ⑫bskyed/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bar du ni/ /gsum gsum gyis bskyed de phan chad/ /bzhi bcu'i bar ⑫bskyed de 'og tu④/ /bskyed pa bzhin du dbri bar bya/ /bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du ni/ /stong gi bar du gtang bar bya/ /bdag nyid bsdams shing 'o ma mar/ /sā spyolu drug cu'i 'bras chan bza'/ /de bzhin 111—819

dus ni sum 'gyur bya/ /sbyor ba'i mtha' yang spyad par bya/ /sngon gyi legs smon 'thob 'gyur zhing / /khyad par du ni me drod skyed①/ /gcin snyi srin bu gzhang 'brum mdze/ /tshil las gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum 'joms/ /go bye'i 'bras bu skyon med pa/ /brdungs shing zhib tu btags pa ni/ /bum par bcug steng ②sa nag bskus/ /sa brkos ①pa yi nang du gzhug /kun nas ba yi lci bas bskor/ /de sbyar me la ④btsos nas ni/ /de las 'dzag pa'i ⑤khu ba gang / / blangs pa rjonyin zhag gzhan ④la ni/ /de yi brgyad 'gyur sbrang rtsi dang / /nyis 'gyur mar dang sbyar ba ⑧ni/ /cho ga snga ma bzhin bsdams te/ /bsten na yon tan de nyid thob/ /go bye'i 'bras bu smin te lhung gyur pa/ /bre bzhi'i tshad tsam dang ni so phag dang / /bdar ba'i phye ma dag dang ⑨chu dang mnye//bkrus te rlung la legs par bskams nas ni/ /brdungs te chu bye bcu drug nang du bskol/ /bzhi cha lus pa btsags te ⑩bsgrangs pa yi/ /khu ba de dang 'o ma bre bcu drug /bskol te bzhi cha lus par gyur pa dang / /de dang mnyam pa'i zhun mar bcas par bskol/ /de'i nang kha ra'i phye ma ci ran gzhug /de ni gzar bus dkrugs pas gcig tu gyur/ /'bras kyi phung por zhag bdun legs par sba/ /bdud rtsi 'dra ba ⑩de bsten skyes bu gang / /chu 'am 'o ma sha khu 'thungs gyur na/ /dran dang yid gzhungs blo gros stobs dang ldan/ /snying stobs dang ldan gser gyi mdog dang 'dra/ /tshe ring ba yang des rgo thob par 'gyur—/ /chu bre bcu drug nang du go bye ⑫ni/ /sum brgya bskol te bzhi cha lus pa ru/ /til mar bre bzhi der ni bcug nas kyang / /tig ta bong nga gnyis dang 'bras bu gsum/ /brag zhun skyer shun da lis ⑫phye ma gdab/ /bskol na 111—820

mdze nad ma lus 'joms par byed/ /go bye skyu ru ra 'am tsha 'am ni/ /zho yi spris ma til mar 'o ma 'am/ /bu ram 'o thug mar ram sbrang rtsi 'am/ /nas zan dag gam til btags sde gur byas/ /sran tshod dag dang lhan cig sbyar ba ni—/ /lus rgyas yid gzhungs tshe ring byed mchog yin/ /go bye'i 'bras bu rnon po ni/ /smin pa me dang 'drar ①gyur pa/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyar ba ni/ /bdud rtsi dang ni 'dra bar 'gyur/ /bse shing 'bras bu zhu ma bcos pa'i/ /bad kan nad dang nad rnying ni/ /'brel pa gang yin de med cing / /me yi drod kyang myur du (kyeskyed/ /rlung dang tsha bar rnyi'adug pa ni/ /khyad par du ni spang bya zhing / /rgya sran zho dang tsha dang ni/ /til mar bsgu dang me bsten spangs⑤ske/ /du ba ri ⑥yi shing zhes bya/ /nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i ngos nas skye/ /chu rlabs g.yo bas bskyod pa dang / /rlung gis ⑦lo ma g.yengs pa yin/ /de yi 'bras bu dbyar gyi tshe/ /legs par smin pa btu bar bya/ /'bras bu de las rkang phyung nas ③/ /bskams te phye mar btags nas ni/ /til bzhin bcir bar bya ba 'am/ /le brgan me tog bzhin du bskol/ /de yi mar bsags gyur pa ni/ /chung zad pa yi bar du bskol/ /phab ste ba yi lci ba yidu// /nang du zla phyed tsam du gzhug /de 'og de las phyung nas ni/ /snum zhing dugs byas dri ma bsal/ /zas kyi dus ni bzhis chod par/ /nang par zho gnyis tsam zhig ① )btung / /mar de nyi ma shis pa shātel/ /sngags 'di yis ni dag par bya/ /rkang pa gnyis ⑩po brtson pa che/ /lus zungs thams cad skyong ⑫byed par—/ /'khor lo dbyig pa dung thogs laspyo/ /mi 'pho bas ni khyod la bsgo/ /de spyogang 'di yi nad steng dang ⑩/ /'og gi nad ni du ma ⑩sel/ /dgongs ⑪111—821

ka snum dang lan tshwar bcas/ /nas thug grang mo btung bar bya/ /mar de zhag lnga'i bar du btung / /spang bar bya ba thams cad spang / /zla phyed mud ga'i khu ba btung / /mdze nad kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /de nyid seng ldeng khu ba ni/ /sum 'gyur dang ①di legs par bskol/ /snga ma bzhin du zla phyed gzhag /legs par bsdams te zla gcig btung / /de yis lus ni bsku ba dang / /ji skad bshad pa'i zas zos pa'i/ /sbyor ba 'di yis myur du ni/ /mdze can mi ni gso bar bya/ /de nyid seng ldeng med par ni/ /zhun mar sbrang rtsi ldan par btung / /zla phyed bar du sha khu btung / /lo ni nyis ②brgyar 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /de nyid zhag ni lnga bcu'i bar/ /sna sman du ni btang gyur na/ /lus rgyas thos ④pa 'dzin pa dang / /lo ni sum brgyar 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /pi pi ling ni pa la sha'i/ /thal chur sbangs shing mar dang brngos/ /rdog ma gsum gsum snga dro dang / /zas kyi sngon du bza' bar bya/ /bcud len yon tan 'dod pa yisarjo/ /sbrang rtsi dang ni sbyar te bza'/ /pi pi ling bcu nyin re zhing / /rim gyis bskyed par ⑤gyur pa dag /de bzhin 'o mar sbyar te rjobaza'—/ /de bzhin du ni ⑦dbri bar bya/ /sman zhu nas ni drug cu pa'i/ /'bras chan ⑧'o ma mar bcas bza'/ /pi pi ling ni stong gi bar/ /btang na 'di ni bcud len 'gyur/ /stobs dang ldan la de btags sbyin/ /stobs dbri ⑨ba la bskol te blud()/ /de bzhin ra yi 'o ma dang / /nyis stong gi ni bar du gtang / /pi pi leng gi sbyor ba 'dis/ /lud pa dbugs mi bde mgul nad/ /gcong chen gzhang 'brum pho ba'i nad/ /gcin snyi skya rbab mi bzad rims/ /'or nad slon dang skyigs bu dang / /mdzer ⑪pa dreg nad 'joms par byed/ /111—822

pi pi ling ni srang phyed lde gur byas①/ /lcags kyi snod bskus nas ni ④nub gcig bzhag /de dang chu ni snyim gang nang par btung / /lo gcig bza' btung spyod pa ci 'dod bsten/ /bca' sga ske tres shing mngar byi dang ka /ba la a ti ba la ①'bras bu gsum/ /gla sgang thang shing yung ba a ka ru/ /mu zi pad+ma ut+pal kru trug rjotres/ /da ta a shwa kar ṇa ⑤a sa na/ /ba la'i rjolo ma'am snying po de bzhin du/ /pi pi ling bzhin lcags snod bsku sogs bya/ /lo brgya 'tsho zhing rgas dang ⑦na las thar/ /'o ma snyim gang gi ④ni bcud len sman//sbyar ba 'di yis lcags snod bskus pas ⑨ni/ /sngar bshad yon tan bas kyang lhag bskyed cing / /tshe yang de ⑩las nyis 'gyur skyed par byed/ /a sa na dang seng ldeng gi/ /khu bar ⑩so ma ra dza sbangs/ /sbrang rtsi ru rta mar dang ni/ /a ru ra dang lcags phyer ⑫bcas/ /lde gu lo gcig bar zos na/ /rgas dang mi 'phrod zos pa las/ /nad ni yongs su 'dor bar byed/ /mdze nad mi bzad pa yis ni/ /lus ni ⑫nyen gyur gang yin pas/ /so ma ra dza til nag gnyis/ /lo gcig bar du bsten na ⑫ni/ /de ni zla rgyas lta bur 'gyur/ /gang gi ⑫so ma ra dza sbun pa med/ /btags pa 'o ma lhan cig zhor mnan pa'i/ /snying po phyung la sbrang rtsi'i lde gu bldag⑫ /de rjes de nyid kyi ni dar ba btung ⑫/ /mdze yi nad kyis yan lag nyams pa dang / /sna chad sor mo brul ba la sogs pa//shing bcad rjes la ljon shing skye ba ⑫ltar/ /de ni nges par skye bar ⑪'gyur ba yin—/ /sgra gcan bdud rtsi brkus ⑥pa na/ /rke ⑥bcad pa las 'dzag ⑫gyur pa'i—/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs pa sar lhung ba/ /sgog skya nyid du gyur pa yin/ /lha min lus las byung ⑫bas na/ /de phyir bram zes ④de mi bza'/ /mngon du 111—823

bdud rtsi las byung bas/ /de ni bcud kyis ①len mchog yin/ /grang ba'i dus na'ang sgog skya bsten/ /dpyid dus bad kan shas cher bza' sos ka'i dus su'ang spyad bya zhing / /dbyar ni rlung gis gzir tshe bza'/ /dgun ni snum zhing bsil ba dang / /mngar bas nye bar bsres pa dang / /de ni phreng ba rgyan dag dang / /'khor dang lhan cig bsten par bya/ /de yi lde gu dpyid kyi tshe/ /kha ba can gyi yul skyes pa/ /shun pa bshus nas mtshan mo ni/ /chang sogs la ni spang bar bya/ /de yi khu ba nang par ni/ /ras ni gtsang mas btsags nas kyang / /chang ni legs par langs gyur pa/ /cha ②gsum dang ④ni sbyar ba 'am/ /chang gzhan dag gam til mar ram/ /rang sgyur ram ni zho ga chu/ /de tshe nyid sbyar nad par ni/ /tshad dang ldan par sbyin bya zhing / /'o ma zhun mar zhag dang rkang / /skam sa'i sha khu so sor ni/ /bskol ba nad gzhi ji bzhin blud/ /yang na sman khu 'ba' zhig blud/ /dang por mkhur gang tsam 'thungs na④/ /mid pa'i sbubs ni dag par byed/ /rgyun tu blugs pa'i dugs byas na/ /na zhing ⑤zug pa dag la phan/ /skyug cing brgyal ba'i nad la niske/ /'phral du chu grang dag kyang blud/ /ngal ba med cing lus kyi ni/ /gzi mdangs brtan pas lhag ma sbyin/ /tsha ba bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /shin tu bsil bas bsku bya zhing / /mu tig ga bur phreng ba can/ /chu thigs phre'u dubasten par bya/ /'di yi tshad chen phul gang ste/ / nyi tshe ⑦la ni de yi phyed/ /sgog skya srang gcig btags pa ni/ /zas dang bcas pa'ang ⑧bsten par bya/ /zhu nas sā ⑨lu rnying pa'i chan/ /dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba/ /yu sha 'o ma skam sa yi/ /sha khu dang ni lhan cig bza'/ /skams ⑩par gyur na chang dang ni/ /111—824

chur ①sbyar ba ni blud par byaske/ /chang mi btung na rang sgyur ram/ /rgun 'brum chu ni blud par bya/ /de yi lde gu mar dang bcas/ /mar ni ①snod du gzar bus dkrugs④/ /zhag bcu gzhag gam de bzhin du/ /zhag dang mnyam sbyar ⑤spyad par bya/ /sgog skya shun pa bshus pa'i snying po ni/ /bsregs ⑪sha dag gam bza' ba sna tshogs sam/ / sha btubs ⑦ pa 'am mar dang tshar bcas bza'/ /kha zas nyung ba ci 'dod spyad par bya/ /khrag dang mkhris pa'i nad ni ma gtogs pa/ /nad gzhi ma lus ldan par 'gyur ba 'am/ /rlung nad nyi tshe ⑧dang ni ldan gyur la67/ /sgog pa las lhag gzhan sman yod ma yin/ /chu dang bu ram 'o ma (7 sred/ /sha chang skyur la mi dga' zhing / /ma zhu ba ni spong mi nus/ /sgog skya nges par gnod pa skyed/ /mkhris pa ldang ba'i 'jigs pa yi⑪/ / tha mar ⑫bkru sman 'jam po gtang / /de ltar bcud len yon tan ni—/ /yongs su rdzogs pa 'thob spyopar 'gyur/ /sos ka'i tsha bas ⑩gdungs drags las/ /rgya skyegs khu ba ltar 'dzag gang / /gser sogs 'byung khungs ⑫drug gi bcud/ /de ni brag zhun zhes byar bshad/ /de ni kun kyang kha zhing tsha//shas cher me drod zhu rjes tsha/ /gcod par byed de de las ⑩ni/ /be+egs las byung ba rab tu bsngags/ /ba gcin dri bro (shweganag pa dang / /gu gul 'dra zhing gseg ma med/ /spyi spyobag snum zhing skyur ba dang / /bska ⑪zhing 'jam la lci ba yi/ /brag zhun de ni mchog yin no/ /nad dang nad pa rjes mthun par//sman dang brag zhun cha mnyam byas/ /lcags kyi snod du sbyar bar bya/ /dang por du chu ni nyi tshes bkru/ /de 'og bskams la bskol dang bsrespyo/ /brag zhun sman dang mnyam byas la/ /brgyad cha'i nang du bskol bar 3bya/ /khu ba brgyad 111—825

cha lus btsags pa①/ /dro 'jam nang du brag zhun gzhug /de dang 'dres gyur bskams nas ni/ /sman chu'i nang du slar yang gzhug /de ltar rang rang sman 'phrod ni/ /bskol ba'i khu bar lan bdun sbangs/ /de nas tig ta'i sman mar gyis/ /snum chos ②byas nas sbyar byas te/ /'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba dang / /shing mngar pa to la'i khu ba/ /brag zhun dag ni re re yang /zhag gsum bar du blud par bya/ /de nas de la sbyor ba ni/ /dus dang sbyar te blud par bya/ /de ltar brag zhun mi rnams la/ /shin tu phan par byed pa yin//yon tan ma lus skyed byed cing / /'phral du gnod par mi byed do/ /zhag bdun phrag gcig phrag gsum dang / /phrag bdun zho gnyis srang phyed gcig /dman dang bar ma chen po yi/ /brag zhun go rims bzhin du sbyar/ /lus ni shin tu sbyangs byas ①la/ /brag zhun sbyang ba gtang 0bar bya/ /zangs dang lcags dang dngul dang gser/ /kun dang yang na re rer sbyar/ /'o ma dang ni lhan cig gtang / /bcud len 'bras bu myur du 'grub/ /rgya sran mon sde'u dme ⑤ru dang / /phug ron sha ni rtag tu spang / /gang zhig brag zhun gyis ni mngon sum du/ /ma bsal nad ni sa steng yod ma yin/ /dus su cho ga bzhin du bsten gyur na/ /nad med nyams stobs rgya chen skyed par byed/ /khang par gnas pa'i khom ldan can/ /phun sum tshogs dang ldan la phan/ /de las gzhan du de rnams la/ /nyi ma rlung gi tshe na dubasten/ /rlung dang nyi tshan bcas sbyor ba/ /bde ba'i longs spyod med na yang / /gang zhig lus la mi gnod pa/ /mchog tu de ni bshad par bya/ /chu grang 'o ma sbrang rtsi dang / /mar ni re re gnyis gnyis dang / /gsum mam ⑦yang na thams cad ni/ /zas 111—826

sngar 'thungs na rgas sra byed/ /bu ram sbrang rtsi bca' sga dang / /pi pi ling ngam rgyam tsha dang / /a ru ra ni gnyis gnyis dag① /rtag zos bde zhing lo brgyar ⑤'tsho/ /a ru ra ni mar nang bsres①/ /bza' zhing mar de 'thungs na ④ni/ /rgas sra lus ni yun ring gnas/ /stobs ni 'phel bar byed 'gyur te / /ji ltar dam pa ⑤byas gzo ba/ /lan cig phan 'dogs ji lta bzhinarjo//skyu ru ra khu ⑦sbrang rtsi dang / /kha ra mar dang lde gu byas⑧/ /bsten zhing 'phrod pa za ba'i mi/ /rgas pa'i gnod pa 'jig 'gyur te/ / nyis bsrung ⑨bstan bcos rgya chen mtshungs/ /skyu ru ra dang byi dang ka⑩ /a sa na yi snying po'i ⑩phye/ /lcags phye til mar sbrang rtsi yi/ /mar bcas sde gu bsten na ni/ /na tshod mdzes pa ma nyams 'gyur/ /lcags phye bye dang ka ⑫yi phye ma dang / /mar dang sbrang rtsi bsres la ⑫lo gcig tsam/ /a sa na yi za ma tog nang gzhug⑫ /bsten na stobs ldan tshe ring skra gnag 'gyur/ / byi dang ga spyodang go bye bca' sga rnams/ /mar dang sbrang rtsir bcas pa gang gis zos/ /rgas pa'i chu bo nad kyi rba rlabs can/ /na tshod ldan pa'i skyes bu de brgal 'gyur/ /seng ldeng a sa na yi khu ba dang / /'bras bu gsum dang sbrang rtsi mar sbyar ba/ /cho ga bzhin du bsten pa'i mi rnams ni/ /tshe ring 'gyur ba 'di las ngo mtshar med/ /dzi ⑩ba ka yi khu ba sor mor chags/ /kha ra sbrang rtsi mar dang 'bras bu gsum/ /skyes bu dam pas bsten par gyur na ni/ /rgas dang nad ni nges par bzlog spyopar 'gyur/ /ba spru ba ni sar pa srang phyed dang / /'o mar btags pa zla phyed zla ba gnyis/ /zla drug lo gcig bar du 'thungs na ni/ /rgas shing rnying pa'ang slar ni gzhon par 'gyur/ / mur ba ang spyoshu ma ti bri ha ti/ /ba la pu 111—827

shel tse dang pa ta ①dang / /a sa na dang thal tres a ka ru/ /pri yang ku dang tsan+dan re re yis②/ /cho ga'ang ba spru ba dang mtshungs pa yin/ /nye'u ①shing sde gu khu bar bskol ba dang / /zhun mar kha rar dubacas pa za byed pa/ /de ni 'tsho ba'i lam du zhugs gyur tshe⑤/ /nad kyi rkun pos choms dupar mi 'gyur ro//a shwa gan+ta 'o mar bcas pa ni/ /mar ram til mar chu dron sbyar ba dang / /zla phyed bsten na nyam ⑦chung lus rgyas shing / /ji ltar lo tog gzhon la char bab ⑧mtshungs / /nyin re til nag srang ni re re dag /zos pa'i rjes la chu grang 'thungs ⑨gyur na/ /lus ni shas cher ⑫rgyas pa nyid 'gyur zhing / /'chi ba'i bar du so ni brtan par 'gyur/ /gze ma sle tres skyu ru ra'i phye ma/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi cha mnyam ⑪sde gu zos/ /ro tsa lus brtan nad kyi sdug bsngal zhi/ /lo brgya 'tsho zhing skra ni nag por 'gyur/ / til nag ⑫a ru ra dang sgyu ru ra/ /ba ru ra dang bcas pa brdungs nas bsten⑫/ /mi de rma bya bzhin du mdangs ldan zhing / /yid du 'ong ba'i spyobade ba thob par 'gyur/ /brag zhun mar dang sbrang rtsi bye dang gaspyo /a ru ra dang lcags phye dngul chu dang / /ta ⑫bya bsten na lus zungs rdzogs 'gyur te/ /yar ngo zla phyed rdzogs pa'i zla ba 'dra/ /gang zhig bring ga spyor dza'i khu ba zla ba gcig /nyin re rgyun du bsten par byed pa dang / /'o ma 'thungs te stobs dang brtson 'grus ldan/ /lo brgyar spyo'atsho ba dag kyang spyothob par 'gyur/ /shu dag kyang ni zla ba gcig bsten zhing / /'o ma'am mar ram til mar bcas pa bsten/ /gdon gyis mi tshugs pa yi lus 'gyur zhing / /yid gzhungs tshig ⑪ni shin tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /ma du ka paṇi yi ⑪mar dang brngos/ /zla gcig bar du zas ma zos par bsten/ /111—828

gzugs ni rgya cher 'tsho zhing spobs pa che/ /gzhon zhing mdangs ldan yon tan ldan par 'gyur/ /'bras bu gsum dang tsang gi ri dang ni/ /lcags phye srang ni lnga bcu las byas shing / /ko sha da ①ka'i khu ba'i nang du btags/ /ri lu sum brgya byas nas ri lu de④/ /grib mar bskams te ④rim gyis ma lus paradhi/ /bkru sman bya zhing thug sla'i rim pa dang / /thug ska gar po sha khu 'bras chan dang //mar la bsten zhing zla gcig lus bsdams la/ /zla gcig 'das ⑤nas rang dga' nyid du spyad/ /'bad pas dus kun tu ni ma zhu spang / /lo gcig bar du sbyor ba 'di bsten na/ /gang zhig gso dka'i nad kyis nyen pa'ang / /shin tu stobs che ⑦skyes bu'i bya ba rdzogs/ /lus rgyas 'jam zhing mig dang rna ba gsal—/ /gzhon pa nyid dang ⑦lo ni lnga brgyar 'tsho/ /seng sdeng shir sha ba dang ⑧a sa na/ /rma bya a ru ra dang sgyu ru ra/ /go bye byi dang ga ⑨btags chu ⑩'gyur ni/ /bco brgyad nang bskol lcags kyi dum bu gzhug /lcags kyi snod du zhag gsum nyi ma yi/ /'od kyis bsros la de rjes me la ni/ /lcags kyi phye ma zhing par ⑪byas te bskol/ /de btsags khu ba cha gcig 'o ma ni/ /cha gasbug de bzhin gso ma'i khu ba gcig /nye'u ⑫shing bskol ba'i khu ba cha gsum dang / /'dir ni mar sar cha ni bzhi dang sbyar/ /'di dag gcig tu lcags nag snod du bskol—/ /kha ra rdul med de bzhin sbrang rtsi dang / /de bzhin mar dang bsres par gyur pa dang / /'phrod pa'i zas ⑫dang skom dang spyod lam bcas/ /srang re rtag tu bsten par gyur na ni/ /dpal dang ldan zhing nyes pa bsal ba dang //nags kyi ma te lta bu'i stobs ldan zhing / /rta ltar mgyogs la lus ni brtan pa dang / /skra ni bung ba'i mdog ltar gnag pa dang / /kha ni dri zhim bud med 111—829

mang bsten nus/ /tshig gsal yid gzhungs phun sum tshogs pa dang / /zla gcig bsten na me drod che ba yin/ /de ①ni mi yi seng ge'am me 'am ni/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra'i lus 'dzin 'gyur/ /mi yi seng ge'i sbyor ba 'di//zos na nad kyis ④mi nyen te/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i lag pa yis/ /lha min tshogs ni 'jigs dang 'dra/ /bring ga ra dza' ④myu gu'i cho ga 'dis/ /brngos shing mar bcas zos la dhibasdams dang bcas/ /lto sbyangs pa la a sa na'i khu ba⑤—/ /'o ma 'thungs shing zas kyi bya ba byed/ /zla gcig bar du bsten par gyur na ni/ /bde dhizhing lo ni nyis brgya'i bar du 'tsho/ /lan cig ⑦smras pa'i tshig kyang zin gyur zhing / /dran dang dbang po nyams pa med par 'gyur/ /gang zhig sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /til mar bsten par byed pa dag /de yis yon tan de thob ⑧cing / /lus ni nag po nyid du 'gyur/ /bcud kyis len ni dus dang rjes mthun zhing / /bsten nus 'bras bur bcas pa bshad pa yin/ /gzhan dag phan yon bcas pa yod mod kyis⑨/ /rnyed par dka' bas bdag gis ma bshad do/ /bcud kyis ⑩len gyi cho ga las/ /nyams pas gal te nad skye ⑪na/ /bcud kyis len de spangs nas ni/ /de yi sman ni ji bzhin bya/ /bden par smra zhing khro ba med/ /dbang po bsdams shing ⑫bdag nyid thul/ /zhi zhing dam pa'i spyod la ⑫dga'/ /rtag tu bcud len yin zhes bya/ /yon tan 'di dag ldan gyur pas/ /gang zhig bcud len bsten gyur pa/ /de ni dga' zhing tshe ring la/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du bde/ /spyod pa bstan bcos ⑫rjes 'jug cing / /gam na gnas pa'i sems dang mthun⑫/ /don la blo ni ma 'khrugs pa⑩/ /bcud kyis len ni rdzogs pa yin/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i 111—830

snying po bsdus pa las/ phyi ma'i gnas kyi le'u sum cu ①rtsa dgu pa'o// //yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa las/ rgas pa gso ba'i yan lag rdzogs so// //de nas ro tsa gso ②ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /skyes bus rtag tu yul bsten ①pas/ /ro tsa bar duni 'dod bya ste/ / dga' dang brta rjodang bu rgyud ni—/ / yon tan ldan pas bude la gnas/ /bu tsha'i rgyud ④ni skyed byed cing / /'phral du yang dag dga' byed gang / /gang gis rta ltar rab stobs ldan/ /bud med la ni thogs med 'gro/ /bud med la rab chags 'gyur ba/ /gang dang gang gis 'phel 'gyur ba/ /de ni ro tsa dze+ebyed pa ste/ /lus kyi stobs kyang skyed pa'i mchog /chos dang grags dang tshe ring dang / /'jig rten gnyis ka'i ⑨bcud len 'gyur/ /gcig tu skyon ni med pa yi/ /tshangs par spyod la bdag yi rang / /snying stobs chung ba nyon mongs pas⑩/ /gnod par gyur pa'i nad bu can/ /lus mi ⑪zad pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /ro tsa'i ⑫cho ga brjod pa yin⑫/ /nad med lang tsho ldan pa dag /ro tsa ba ni sten byed pa/ /dus tshigs kun la nyin re zhing / /nyal po bya ba dgag pa med/ /de nas snum gyur sbyang ⑫byas pa/ /ni ru ha dang 'jam rtsir bcas/ /mar dang til mar sbrang rtsi dang / /sha khu 'o ma kha rar bcas/ /'o ma sha dang sha khu bza'/ /sbyor ba shes pas dang por gtang / /de nas ro tsa byed sbyor ba/ /khu ba bu tsha 'phel byed bya/ /me tog dri mnam grib am med/ /'bras bu med pa gyur pa'i shing / /yal ga gcig pa'i shing gcig bzhin/ / bud med med mi ⑩de dang 'dra/ /111—831

gom 'gros 'khror zhing tshig mi ①gsal/ /rdul gyis g.yogs ②pa ltar snang zhing //bzhin ras snabs kyis gos dhipa yang / /snying ni dga' bar byed pa yin/ /reg pa dang ni mthong stsogs la/ /bu mnyam bde ba yod min na/ /gang zhig chos dang grags par ldan/ /nga rgyal rigs 'phel smos ci dgos/ /lus sbyang rjobyas te ci nus ⑤par/ /ro tsa'i sbyor ba brtsam par bya/ /'dam bu gung rjoshing 'jag ma sogs/ /pu shel tse dang bi da ri/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ⑦ri'i rtsa ba dang / /ba la ⑧'tsho byed zangs rtsi ba/ /ram nye ba gnyis me da gnyis/ / nye'u shing par+ṇa ⑨rnam gnyis dang / /a shwa garnya ⑩kha sral phre'u/ /a ti ba la ba spru ba/ /bi da ri ti pa ya gye⑪/ /ra sna gze ma dzi ban ⑫ti/ /shing mngar sa la paṇi ⑫rnams/ /re re'ang srang ni gsum gsum cha④/ /mon sran gre'u ⑫bre bzhi dang / /chu bre sum cu gnyis nang ⑩bskol/ /khu ba bre bzhi lus pa ru/ /mar bre bzhi dang bi da ri/ /skyu ru ra dang bu ram shing / /bre ni bzhi bzhi gzhug par bya/ /'o ma mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang / /bi ra kha sral ram nye gnyis/ /shing mngar phal gu pi pi ling / /rgun 'brum 'bra go bi da ri/ /ma du ka dang nye'u ⑫shing pa/ /'di dag btags te bcug nas ni/ /de bskol btsags pa'i nang du ni/ /ka ra dkar po smig ⑫rkang ni/ /sman ni bre re gzhug pa dang / /pi pi ling ni srang bzhi dang / /na le sham ni srang gcig dang / /shing tsha sug smel ge sar rnams/ /re re srang ni phyed phyed phye/ /sbrang rtsi srang ⑪ni bcu drug sbyar/ /de las ⑩nyin re srang re bza'/ /'o ma dang ni sha khu btung / /des ni rta ltar spyod ⑥gyur cing / /mchil pa lta bur 'dod pa spyod/ /bi da ri dang pi pi ling / /sha ⑫li 'bras rtsa pi ya li/ /kha sral phye ma phul re dang / /de bzhin sbrang rtsi srang 111—832
